original: ekena yasya yaminaḥ pramadeva dehamardhena rājati pumāniva cāpareṇa
tattvakramādatha ca na pramadā pumānvā śreyāṃsi vardhayatu sa smaraśāsano vaḥ
sā hi sarvasya prāṇāpānāntarālavartinī vigataprādurbhāvatirobhāvā sramyakprayogapariśīlanātmanā karmayogena mananādinā jñānayogena ca samyagadhigamyate
tataḥ paramavidyopādānādantaḥ saṃkalparūpakramavān śrotragrāhyavarṇābhivyaktirahitastṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmo madhyamārūpo jāyate
sā kila dvayoḥ pariṇāmayormadhye sadā tiṣṭhatīti madhyametyucyate
viśiṣṭaṃ khamākāśaṃ rāti prayacchatīti vikharo dehendriyasaṃghātaḥ
tathā ca śrutiḥ—‘na ha vai saśarīrasya priyāpriyayorapahatirasti
aśarīraṃ vā va santaṃ priyāpriye na spṛśataḥ
śrutirapyāha—‘catvāri vākparimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ
guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti
kā punastā vāco yāsāmiyamadhiṣṭhātrītyata uktam—‘dhvanirvarṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityāspadacatuṣṭayam
tatra śabda eva ka ityapekṣāyāmayaṃ vibhāgo dhvanirityādiḥ
arthastu stambhakumbhādilakṣaṇo soke śāstre ca prasiddhaḥ
rasānvitaṃ kaviḥ kurvankīrtiṃ prītiṃ ca vindati || 2
prītiḥ saṃpūrṇakāvyārthasvādasamuttha ānandaḥ kāvyārthabhāvanāda-śāyāṃ kaverapi sāmājikatvāṅgīkārāt
yadyapi kāvyaśabdo doṣābhāvādiviśiṣṭāveva śabdārthau brūte, tathāpi lakṣaṇayā śabdārthamātre prayuktaḥ
tridhā hi sāstraśarīram—‘uddeśaḥ, lakṣaṇam, parīkṣā ce'ti
nirdoṣaṃ doṣātyantābhāvavat, avayavaikadeśavartinā śvitreṇeva kāminīśarīrasya varṇamātragatenāpi doṣeṇa kāvyavairasyaniyamāt
ayameva hi prācaḥ kavervyāpāro yaddoṣahānaṃ nāma
‘nāstyeva tatkāvyaṃ yatra paramparayāpi vibhābādiparyavasānaṃ na bhavati’ iti kāśmīrikāḥ
doṣāḥ padānāṃ vākyānāṃ vākyārthānāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa
abhimatapratītivyavadhāyakatayā vighnabhūtaḥ śaśvatkāvye heyatāmāsādayati sa eva doṣaḥ
avāntaravibhāge tu kriyamāṇe pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirupādhibhiḥ saṃkulamityāha—ṣoḍaśeti
anantarbhāve tu doṣatvameva nāstītyabhiprāyaḥ, na tu deśīyarāganyāyena svamataprakāśanam
asādhu cāprayuktaṃ ca kaṣṭaṃ cānarthakaṃ ca yat
saṃdigdhaṃ ca viruddhaṃ ca proktaṃ yaccāprayojakam || 5
deśyaṃ grāmyamiti spaṣṭā doṣāḥ syuḥ padasaṃśrayāḥ
kathaṃ padapratīkadoṣā na gaṇyanta iti śaṅkāmabhipretyāha—spaṣṭā iti
tathā na bādhate skandho yathā bādhati bādhate || 1 ||’
atra bādhaterātmanepaditvād ‘bādhate’ iti syāt, na punar ‘bādhati’ iti
śabdāḥ śiṣyante prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaparikalpanayā jñāpyante yena tacchabdaśāstraṃ trimunivyākaraṇaṃ tena viruddhaṃ tadāmnātaprātisvikaviśeṣaparityaktamato na deśīyapadānāmasādhutbam
tathā ca prācyaiḥ—‘nātha te kucayugaṃ patrāvṛtaṃ mā kṛthāḥ’ iti anyakārakavaiyarthyamiti, ‘salīlapāṇidvayalolanālamānartitātāmradalaṃ dadhantīm’ iti ca tādṛśamevodāhṛtam
atra kecidāhuḥ—‘bādhatidhātuṃ saṃskārapracyāvanena bādhate iti bādhatibādhastasya saṃbodhanaṃ bādhatibādheti
sa sasti kiṃ vacantīme kambaḥ śambaṃ ghariṣyati || 2 ||’
yadyevaṃ loke prayujyamānasya sādhutaiva prasaktā ityata uktam—kavibhiriti
sa hi dhātuḥ ‘ghṛtaghṛṇāgharmebhyo nānyatra yujyate’ iti pūrvācāryāḥ
pophullūti nīpaḥ kālo'yaṃ carkarti hṛdayaṃ mama || 3 ||’
kāvyaprakāśakṛtā padaikadeśaḥ kaṣṭa uktaḥ, yathā—‘tadgaccha sidhdyai’, 'apekṣate pratyayamaṅgalabdhyai’ ityatra ‘dhyai’ ‘dhyai’ iti, tatrāha—padamiti
na hi samastavastukaṭutva eva padaṃ kaṣṭatvamāsādayati
ekadeśakaṣṭatayā padakaṣṭatvamiti cātrāpi na daṇḍavāritamiti bhāvaḥ
evaṃbhūto varṣāsamayo mama vidūrakāntasya hṛdayaṃ carkarti punaḥ punaratiśayena vā chigatti
bhūyasāṃ kaṣṭapadānāṃ samabhibyāhārādvākyadoṣa iti bhrāntiḥ syāttatrāha—kriyāpadānīti
sa vai devaḥ khalu tvāṃ tu punātu madanāntakaḥ || 4 ||’
dyotanīyamarthamantareṇa prayuktamavyayamanarthakamabhimatam, ata eva prācyaiścādipadamavyayamiti prayogabījakathanārthaṃ nahi nirmūlaḥ prayogaḥ saṃbhavati vṛttinirvahaṇasamarthaḥ
caḥ samuccayādiṣu caturṣu prasiddhaprayogo na ca teṣāmanyatamo'pyatra saṃbhavati
tathā ca—‘ādāvañjanapuñjaliptavapuṣāṃ śvāsānilollāsitaprotsarpadvirahānalena ca tataḥ saṃtāpitānāṃ dṛśām
saṃpratyeva niṣekamaśrupayasā devasya cetobhuvo bhallīnāmiva pānakarma kurute kāmaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇā
’ ityatra dṛśāmiti bahuvacanamanarthaṃkaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇāyā ekasyā evopādānāt
na cātra vyāpāre dṛkśabdo vartate, añjanapuñjalepādīnāmananvayāpatteḥ
bahutvakartra bhiprāyaphalābhāve kathanaṃ dvayorasādhutvamiti rājamārga eva bhramaḥ
nahi svarūpata eva kiṃcidasādhu sādhu vā saṃbhavati
‘vibhajante na ye bhūpamālabhante na te śriyam
āvahanti na te duḥkhaṃ prasmaranti na ye priyām || 5 ||’
atra vibhajatervaṇṭane, ālabhatermāraṇe, āvahateḥ karaṇe, prasmaratervismaraṇe rūḍhiḥ
na tu viśeṣasevāyām, abhito lābhe, samantādvahane, prakṛṣṭasmaraṇe ceti
ata eva yadabhisaṃdhāya prayujyate na kathaṃcana yasyāsāvartha iti anvarthamanyārthamiti nāma
bhajiḥ sevārtho virupasargastadgataviśeṣadyotakastataśca yathā vidyotata iti
atra viśiṣṭadhātvanurūpaprayogābhidhānaṃ tathātrāpi bhaviṣyatīti bhramo bījamatra śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt
nahi tāni svarūpata eva tathāpi tvarthaviśeṣo viśeṣa evāśvagośvādivaditi
atra daśabāhuḥ, trilocanaḥ, pañcavakra iti tucchamevābhidheyamatucchaśabdairuktamiti apuṣṭārtham
nahi tathā kriyamāṇamalpīyasīmapi prakarṣatāṃ puṣyati yena tyājyaṃ na syādityapuṣṭapadena sūcitam
atra jaladharo meghaḥ, vāridhiḥ samudraḥ, bṛṃhitaṃ gajānām, hreṣitamaśvānāmiti lokaprasiddham
dvitīye tu yogamātre prayuktamasaṃgataṃ śaktiśūnye prayuktaṃ śattkyaikadeśe prayuktamiti bhinno'rthastadetatsarvaṃ vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atra jaladhareti
tataśca yadviśiṣṭasya yogasya śaktiviṣayatayā na tena saṃketaḥ
yatra ca samudrādau prayogo na tadupādhibhiḥ samudratvādyaiḥ saṃbhūya śattkyā saṃketaḥ
kṣārādipadopasaṃdānena ca samudrādau prayoga unnīyata ityāha—tadiheti
ata eva na tadavasthasya padaṃ vācakamata eva cākṣamatvādasamarthamiti saṃjñayaiva vyavahriyata iti saṃkṣepaḥ
apratītaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ prasiddhaṃ śāstra eva yat || 10
‘kiṃ bhāṣitena bahunā rūpaskandhasya santi me na guṇāḥ
pratītāpratītasamabhivyāhārarūpaṃ hi vākyamaśāstrajñaviṣayaṃ prayuktamabhimatārthapratītiṃ na janayitumīṣṭe
teṣāṃ rūpaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskāro vijñānamiti pañcaskandhāḥ
‘tatra bhavaḥ’ iti che svārthike ca kani nañsamāse pṛṣodarāditvānnalopābhāva iti bhāṣyaṭīkā
premṇo vyāpakā guṇā na santi me na ca vyāpakamantareṇa vyāpyaṃ bhavatīti vyāpakānupalabdhiprayuktatvātpremābhāvasya tathopālambhe vācyatā nāstīti bhāvaḥ
dūre yasyārthasaṃvittiḥ kliṣṭaṃ neṣṭaṃ hi tatsatām
atra vinā garutmatā jita indrastasyātmabhavo'rjunastasya dveṣī karṇastasya guruḥ sūryastatpādairabhihato loka ākāśamabhinandati
himāpaho vahnistasyāmitro jalaṃ taddhārayanti ye meghāstairvyāptamiti vyavahitārthapratyayaṃ kliṣṭametat
tathā sati vācakatāyāmapi jhaṭiti pratipattirna bhavati
yadāha—‘neṣṭaṃ hi tatprasitānām’ iti, ayamevārtho vyavadhānapadena vāmanādibhiruktaḥ
na cātrāpi kiṃcijjhaṭiti pratītyanuguṇaṃ niyamakāraṇamastīti yuktameva vyavadhānam
tathā ca candragomī ḍaprakaraṇe ‘hanterḍaḥ’ ityeva sūtritavān
himāpaho vahiriti kvipi vyabhicāraṃ dṛṣṭvā ‘brahmabhrūṇa-’ ityādi sūtritaṃ candragominā
hariśabdena ca sahastrāṃśuḥ so'pi na tena nāmnā bahubhirucyata iti gūḍhatvam
yasya padasya dvāvarthau siddhaścāsiddhaśca taccedaprasiddhe prayuktaṃ tadā gūḍhārtham
‘gauḥ śarākṣipayaḥsvargapaśumedavacaḥsu ca’ ityāmrāto'pi tathā nākṣṇi prayujyate yathā paśubhedādāvityāha—na ca gośabdasyeti
‘hariḥ kṛṣṇe ca siṃhe ca mekārkabhujageṣu ca’ iti svasaṃketitasyāpi hariśabdasya na tathā ravau prasiddhiryathānyatretyāha—so'pi neti
atra paṅktiśabdena daśasaṃkhyā, anekajanāmetyanena cakram, taṅraityanena rathastābhyāṃ daśarathastasya tuk bālako lakṣmaṇastena jita ulūkajidindrajit
atra paśuśabdena gośabdo lakṣyate teneṣavastadidaṃ svasaṃketakalpitārthaṃ neyārthamucyate
asyārthaḥ—yatpadaṃ nānārthasvaparyāyalakṣaṇayā vivakṣitapratītiparyantaṃ nīyate tatkalpitārthamiti kecit
prayojanaṃ vinā rūḍhaṃ lakṣaṇāparigrahe na doṣaḥ
tathā ca dvirepharathāṅganāmādipadānāṃ rephadbayānugatabhramarādiśabdalabhaṇādvāreṇa ṣaṭpadādau vṛttirvṛddhavyavahāraparamparānupātinīti teṣāṃ prayogo'yukta eva
ata eva ‘turaṅgakāntāmukhahavyavāhajvāleva bhittvā jalamullalāsa’ ityādikamapi neyārthamiti kāśmīrakāḥ
anekajo dvijaścakravākastasya nāma cakraṃ rathaikadeśastaddhārayatīti dhārayatermūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ
atra paśuśabdena gośabdo lakṣyata iti prṛtāpekṣayā
sa eṣa hi mahādevastriṣu lokeṣu pūjyate || 12 ||’
atra vahnirarkaḥ śivo veti na niścīyate
tathāhi—sa eṣa hi mahādeva ityatra sa kimeṣa hi mahādeva iti cchedo vidhīyatāṃ mahādeva iti vā sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāve saṃdihyate
vahnyarkāvapi hi bhagavato nīlalohitamūrtibhūtau himāpahau ca na niścayakṛditi dūṣaṇatābījapradarśanam
sādhucara ityatrāpi ‘bhūtapūrve caraṭ’ iti caraṭpratyaye kiṃ pūrvaṃ sādhurathavā careṣṭapratyaye sādhuṣu caratīti padameva saṃdihyate tena padāvayavaḥ saṃdigdha iti kenaciduktam, tadapyapāstam
apūrvāḥ kīrtaya ityanena yathādbhutāḥ kīrtaya evamakīrtayo'pyucyante
tathā hi—anuttametyādau prakaraṇādibhiḥ stutiparatve vyavasthite uttamatvābhāvādinā viruddhenārthena tatra paryavasāyayituṃ na śakyate
iha tu stutinindayoryaugapadyamasaṃbhāvitamata evaikasya saṃbhave tvaparasya bādha eva
’ iti galagrahaśabdasya kaṇṭhagrahapratidvandvinyarthe vivākṣite pūrvaprakrāntānandadāyitvaṃ bādhyate
atrānuttama iti bahuvrīhitatpuruṣābhyāmapihitamiti ‘vaṣṭi bhāguriḥ’ ityādinā vikalpenākāralopavidhānāt
yathā—‘apūrva yadvastu prathayati vinā kāraṇakalām’ iti śabdarūpāntarameva viruddhopacāyakamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdadoṣatāvyavasthitiḥ
atra tamālaśyāmalamityādīni sāgaraviśeṣaṇāni tāni na hanūmato laṅghane'tiśayaṃ sūcayanti
tadeva hi kavīnāmupādeyaṃ yadvākyārthe prakṛṣṭakāṣṭhāṃ puṣṇāti
na ca tamālaśyāmalatvādiviśeṣaṇāni kathaṃcitprakarṣamarpayanti yāni dūratvādīni tathā na teṣāmupādānam
atra gallatallādayaḥ śabdā avyutpattimanto deśyā dṛśyante
vyutpannānāmanyādṛśī cchāyā deśyānāṃ ca na tādṛśīti deśyavedyapadasamabhivyāhāre prāyeṇa chāyāvairūpyaṃ bandhasya bhavatīti sahṛdayahṛdayasākṣikaṃ doṣabījam
tallamalpasaraḥ, laḍahaṃ manoharam, maḍahaṃ kṛśam, vosaṭṭaṃ vikasitam, kandoṭṭaṃ nīlotpalam, moṭṭāyitaṃ vilāsaḥ
‘chatrākāraśirāḥ śirālasarasasthūlaprakāṇḍo mahā- nmadhye bhānusutābhrasindhuvipulābhogo vaṭaḥ pātu vaḥ
kāyaikye vikaṭaprasāritamahājaṅghaṃ mahīsuptayo- ryaḥ khaṇḍendukirīṭakaiṭabhajitoḥ kāṭaśriyaṃ karṣati || 16 ||’
sabhāyāṃ sādhurityarthe tenāpi śāstre vyavahāra iti pradarśanārthamasatyaśabdenāślīlamanūdya vyācaṣṭe
sa cārthaḥ kvacitprakṛto'prakṛto'pi śleṣopasthita ekadeśātsmṛtimātrārūḍho vā
ardhaṃ harerardhaṃ harasyeti śarīraikye kāṭaśabdasyāsabhyārthatve tadviśeṣaṇānāmapyasabhyatvamiti tānyādāya vyācaṣṭe—atra chatrākāreti
yā rātrau vidyāmabhyasato mantramāvartayatastava priyā samāyāti sā yakṣiṇī
ataḥ kathaṃ te dhanaṃ pelavaṃ komalam
prakṛtapadāni tvasabhyārthāntarāṇi tānyuddhṛtya vyācaṣṭe—tadetadyā bhavataḥ priyeti
yā bhavataḥ priyeti ekaṃ padaṃ yābho maithunaṃ tadvataḥ priyetyarthāt
kṛtaḥ kṛkāṭikāyāṃ te pādaḥ prāṇena yāsyatā || 18 ||’
he cūtavṛkṣa, kokilasya vācā kaṭutvena duḥkhadāyitvāt kiṃ māṃ bhāpayasi
nanu tava kṛkāṭikāyāṃ prīvāyāṃ pādaṃ dattvā calitā mama prāṇāstena mayā jitam
kāṭavaśabde kāṭa ekadeśaḥ kṛkāṭikāśavde kāṭiketi lopaḥ
kheṭake grāme yadbhaktaṃ sūpaścotpadyate tasya pattanasya nagarasya yā valabhī tasyāṃ suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhālliṅgādanumīyate tṛptyarthayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati

anye tu vyācakṣate—bhaktasūpapadanāmā dakṣiṇāpathe viṣayastatsadmani kheṭake valabhīnāma kasyacidvirūpākṣādhiṣṭhānasya tatraiva pattanasya hehale iti strīṇāmavyājamanyonyapremātiśayagarbhasya bhāṣitasyeti
śapathadānena vinā pravāsayati anyatra prahiṇoti gṛhe samyak sthitaṃ priyaṃ sāṅnā na, kiṃ tu piśācīvadanucitakāriṇītyartho'bhimataḥ
anyatra pravāsanamuccāṭanaṃ saṃsthānaṃ vināśaḥ vināśasya panthāstasya dānam
marīcerapatyaṃ mārīcaḥ kāśyapaḥ saṃkrandanādīnindrādīn dvādaśa putrānādityānutpāditavān
tacca kālāntakasya bhagavato mahādevasyālaye yāḥ kṛtyāḥ kriyā bhagavadārādhanarūpāstāsāṃ phalamityarthaḥ
mārīcaśabde mārakadeśaḥ kṛtyā iti subantapade kṛtyetyekadeśaḥ, kālāntakālaya ityatrāntaketi, saṃkrandane śabdakrandaneti
pardate hadate vamati niṣṭhīvatīti śabdānāṃ ghṛṇāvadarthatvam
ata eva ‘na garbhiṇyāḥ pibetkṣīraṃ pāragarbhikakṛttu tat’ iti vaidyakam
tava kapolau dṛṣṭvā puraḥsthitastava priya īṣaddhāsyaṃ kurvan kapolayorhāsyajyotsnayā pūjāṃ karotītyarthaḥ
anyatra bāṣpeṇoṣmaṇā klinno mṛdūbhūtaḥ gaṇḍo vraṇaḥ
tadevaṃ padadoṣāṃllakṣayitvā kramaprāptavākyadoṣā lakṣaṇīyā iti tānvibhajate—
bhinnaliṅgavacane ityādau tu dvandvalakṣaṇasya samāsasya pūrvavartināṃ bhinnādipadānāṃ pratyekamanvayaḥ
ata eva bahuvrīhau lāghavaṃ tatra nādaraḥ
gāṇḍīvī kanakaśilānibhaṃ bhujābhyā- mājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ || 25 ||’
atra gamitavatīti ktavatoḥ karmaṇi, ājaghna iti ātmanepadasyākhāṅgakarmaṇi prayogādapaśabdau
apaśabdatvaṃ pada eva niyataṃ vākye saṃskāraprasakterabhāvādapaśabdatvaṃ na vākyadūṣaṇam
tathā hi—‘kartari kṛt’ iti niyamātkarmaṇi ktavaturasādhuḥ
‘akarmakācca’ ityanuvṛttau ‘āṅo yamahanaḥ’ ityātmanepadamakarmaka eva prāptaṃ 'svāṅgakarmakācca’ iti vākyaikavākyatāparyālocanayāsvāṅgakarmaṇyasādhuḥ kathaṃ vākyadūṣaṇatā
nahi yathā bādhṛdhātuḥ parasmaipadānta ityevāsādhutvam, tathātra padāntarasaṃnidhānāpekṣatve'dhyavasīyate
bhūtānāmadhipatinā śilāvitāna iti yāvannānusaṃdhīyate tāvadgamitavatīti kiṃ kartari karmaṇi veti saṃdehānivṛtteḥ
tathā gāṇḍīvī viṣamavilocanasya vakṣa ityetāvatpratītya kathamājaghna ityasvāṅgakarmaṇi ātmanepadamadhyavasānayogyam
iyameva hi vākyadoṣatā yadanekapadanirūpyatā nāma vādhatītyatrāpi kiṃ bādhaśabdāt kvibantāttip, uta bādhṛdhāturiti saṃdeha iti kudeśyam
‘tena tvāmanunāthate kucayugam—‘ ityādikamatratyamudāharaṇaṃ pramādāt kāvyaprakāśakṛtā padadoṣeṣu likhitam
kramabhraṣṭaṃ bhavedārthaḥ śābdo vā yatra tatkramaḥ || 21
atra mātaṅgamatha turaṅgamiti vaktavye turaṅgamatha mātaṅgamityarthaḥ
kāntipratāpau coktvā sūryācandramasoḥ samāviti śābdaḥ kramabhraṃśo lakṣyate
arthakamabhraṃśaḥ kathaṃ śabdadūṣaṇamata āha—iti vaktavya iti
mātaṅgo dīyatāmatha taddānasāmarthyaṃ nāsti tadā turaṅga iti vaktavye racanāvaiparītyamātramatrāparādhyati
visaṃhito virūpo vā yasya saṃdhirvisaṃdhi tat
atra meghānilena amunā etasminnasaṃhitayā vivakṣāmītyabhisaṃdhānaṃ visaṃgiḥ
dvitīyaṃ yathā—‘uḍḍīya gagane dūraṃ calan ḍāmaraceṣṭitaḥ
’ nanu yadi saṃdhikārya vaikalpikaṃ kathamatra doṣa ityata āha—na saṃhitāmiti

yadi saṃhitāpratiṣedhaḥ syāttadā sakṛdvisaṃdhikaraṇena tathāvairūpyaṃ bhavatīti kaveraparādho na saṃbhāvyate, yadi tu pratiṣedho nāsti asakṛdvopādānaṃ tadā vyaktavairūpyapratibhāsātkathaṃ na doṣa ityarthaḥ
tena tātparyabhede lāṭānuprāso'bhidheyamede yamakaṃ ca na doṣaḥ
tathā ca pāramarṣaṃ sūtram—‘śabdayoḥ punarvacanaṃ punaruktamanyatrānuvādāt’ iti
taccābhidhānaṃ tenaiva padena paryāyeṇa vā saṃbhavatīti śabdamādāyaiva tasya vyavasthā punaruktiratraiva pade bhavati, tatko'tra matvartha ityata uktam—yatra taditi
unmanayantīti unmanasaṃ kurvantīti ṇici iṣṭhavadbhāve ṭilope ca rūpam
śeṣāṇi viśeṣaṇāni—gambhīrā māṃsalāḥ, stanayitnavaḥ śabdāyamānāḥ, taḍitvantaḥ prakṛṣṭataḍidyuktāḥ
atra karkaśakaṇṭake daṇḍe'ṅgāni ghaṭṭayan haṃsaḥ padminyā mukhaṃ cumbatīti vaktavye yathānirdiṣṭarūpe vighaṭṭitavibhaktikayuktitvāvdyākīrṇam
ata eva nāpārthakatvena saṃkaraḥ samudāyārthasya pratīyamānatvāt
asti kaściduccāraṇayorviśeṣo yena vākyārthapratītiḥ kkacidāhatya bhavati
‘kāaṃ khāai khuhio kūraṃ phellei ṇibbharaṃ ruṭṭho
suṇaaṃ geṇhai kaṇṭhe hakkeia ṇattiaṃ ṭhero || 30 ||’
[kākaṃ khādati kṣudhitaḥ kūraṃ phellati nirbharaṃ ruṣṭaḥ
śvānaṃ gṛhṇāti kaṇṭhe hakkāyati naptāraṃ sthaviraḥ ||]
atra kākaṃ kṣipati, kūraṃ khādati, kaṇṭhe naptāraṃ gṛhṇāti, śvānaṃ bhīṣayate, ityādau vaktavye yathoktapadavinyāsaḥ saṃkīryate
vākyāntarasaṃvalitāni padāni vākyāntaramanupraviśya tathā pratītiṃ vighnanti, yathā samudāya eva dūṣito bhavati
kūraṃ bhaktaṃ kṣudhitaḥ khādati, kākaṃ ca nirbharaṃ ruṣṭaḥ san kṣipati, śvānaṃ ca nivārayati, naptāraṃ ca kaṇṭhe gṛhṇāti sthavirajātiḥ
ākāṅkṣākrameṇa kiṃcitpadaṃ kasyacidvākyasya saṃbaddhamiti jñāyata eva
‘āujjaa piṭṭiae jaha kukkuli ṇāma majjha bhattāle
[āvarjya pīḍyate yathā kukkuro nāma mama bhartā
ṣoḍhā padaṃ bhavati—prakṛtistham, komalam, kaṭhoram, grāmyam, nāgaram, upanāgaraṃ ca
yathā ca—pāḍiva āmāṇa siṇivaṃ ālagoletyādi, tyajjhatujjhauttāvilavihatthatiacchetyādi ca
yathā śuddhaṃ payaḥ pācayāṃbabhūva tā piba, āhiṣātāmityatra
yathā ca—ā ī i e ityādi
deśīpadāni sarvāṇyeva saṃskṛteṣu hastavivāhabhaginīhārakaṅkaṇādikam, tuṃbha aṃbha haliddāsāhajjādikaṃ ca
tadevaṃ sthite pratipadaṃ kavīnāṃ ko'pi kramo nirvāhyo na tvakasmādevālūnaviśīrṇabhāvo vidheyaḥ
yuktirucitā yojanā sā prakṛtisthādīnāṃ vibhinnānyathānītātyuktiriti yāvat
jaha kukkuli yathā kurkurī nāmaśabdaḥ prākāśye prakāśameva tāḍitamityarthaḥ
atra prathame pāde āujjhie, ityupanāgaraṃ prakṛtisthaṃ ca

tadihaikarūpa eva karmakaravadhūlakṣaṇe grāmye vaktari ekarūpa eva vākyārthe sarvadoṣatirodhāyakarasadīptyabhāve ca yathā bhāṣāṇāṃ vyatikaro dūṣaṇaṃ tathā grāmyādīnāmiti sahṛdayamātravedyaścāyaṃ panthā ityavahitairbhavitavyam
eteṣāṃ ca svarūpaṃ svayameva guṇībhāvaprastāve leśataḥ prakāśayiṣyati teneha saṃkṣiptavān
tathā hi—‘tyajato maṅgalakṣaume dadhānasya ca valkale
’ atra prathamādiṣu pādeṣu kṣaumacīravismitarāgapadāni upanāgarāṇi śeṣāṇi grāmyāṇi
evamanyatrāpi pratyekaṃ dvandvasamudāyaiḥ pratipādamupakramopasaṃhāranirvāhakramaḥ svayamupalakṣaṇīya ityāstāṃ tāvat
‘yogyo yaste putraḥ so'yaṃ daśavadana lakṣmaṇena mayā
atra yogyo yaste putro lakṣmaṇena mayā mṛtyuvaśaṃ nīyata iti vākyasya rakṣainaṃ yadi śaktiriti vākyāntareṇa sagarbhatvādgarbhitam
madhyapraviṣṭaṃ vākyaṃ pūrvottarabhāgābhyāmekībhūtasya garbhāyamāṇamekakharasaprasūtāṃ pratītiṃ vighnayadātmanā sahaiva samudāyavirasakakṣāmārohayati
vākyāntaravākyasya viśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ pratītivyavadhāyaka iti yāvat
kārakavibhakteḥ kriyākāṅkṣaṇaśīlāyāstāmasaṃgamayya madhya rakṣainaṃ śaktirityetāvatā garbhasthānīyena virasīkaraṇamityāha—atra yogyo ya iti

evaṃ vākyarūpatābhaṅgahetūndoṣānabhidhāya tatraiva kāvyabhāvapratyūhahetavo'bhidhātavyāste ca guṇabhaṅgadvārakāḥ, alaṃkārabhaṅgadvārakāḥ, chandobhaṅgadvārakāḥ, yatibhaṅgādvārakāśceti caturdhā viprathante

tataśca yadyapi prathamaṃ guṇabhaṅgadvārakā vaktumucitāstathāpi teṣāṃ bahutvāddurūhatvācca sūcīkaṭāhanyāyena paścātkaraṇamalaṃkārabhedādiṣu ca madhye pratiyogidvārālaṃkārabhaṅgasya prādhānyamiti taddvārā doṣāṃllakṣayati
upamā upamitiḥ sādṛśyabhinnopamānavācina upameyavācinaśca liṅgaṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ yasya sā tathoktā
vibhāgavākye sahitāvasthayoruddeśādiha ca militayorudāharaṇāttathābhāvo doṣatvamiti bhrāntiṃ nirasyati—tadidamiti
ekamudāharaṇaṃ natvekaḥ saṃmitra upādhiḥ pratyekameva tvasti samarthatvādityarthaḥ
śaśīva dhavalā haṃsī haṃsīva dhavalā diśaḥ || 35 ||’
ihaśabdo yeṣu madhyeṣūpamānasya stokaviśeṣaṇatayopameyanyūnetyuktaṃ tathādhikopamamiti vakṣyati—saṃhatetyādi
rocanāviliptastanītyanena kamalasyopamānaṃ netrapadaṃ mṛṇālasyopamānaṃ bāhupadaṃ ca nopāttaṃ tadapi ca saviśeṣaṇamupādeyaṃ bhavati
mātrāpi nānarthikā kavinopādeyeti sāhityavidāmnāyavyavasthitāvupameyaviśeṣaṇasyopamānaviśeṣaṇatayā prayojanacintāyāṃ pūrvavadeva pratītipratyūhasya sulabhatvādanuktatvāditiśabdapradhānakatāmācaṣṭe
yadyapyekasya viśeṣaṇādhikye viśeṣaṇanyūnatve vānyaviśeṣaṇasya nyūnādhikabhāvo niyatastathāpyupamānagatameva dvayaṃ nirūpyate
tatra hi dṛṣṭamupameye pratibimbakalpamupasthāpyate tenānto nopameye tayornirūpaṇamiti
tameva dhīro vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta brāhmaṇaḥ || 38 ||’
atra pañcamavarṇasya laghoḥ sthāne guroḥ karaṇācchandobhaṅgaḥ
tasya viparyāsaśchandobhaṅgo vyakta eva vairasyahetuḥ prāhuriti
tamevātmānaṃ brahmāparaparyāyaṃ vijñāya śravaṇamanananididhyāsanairupāsya prajñāṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ sākṣātkurvīta
atra caturthasthāne yatau kartavyāyāṃ tadanyatra yatikaraṇādbhagnayatīdam
śravyaḥ paṭhiti vicchedo yatirvicchidya vicchidya paṭhyamānā bhāratī svadate
śravyatopalakṣaṇārthaṃ ca dvimunivedādisaṃjñayā tatra tatra vivicyate
tathā cāsti kaścidviśeṣo yena kriyamāṇāpi viratirna saubhāgyapadaṃ puṣyati
sa ca viśeṣo nāma bhāgabhedo'svarasaṃdhikṛtaśca prāyeṇa eteṣāṃ svabhāvaviśeṣādeva sthāne kriyamāṇāpi viratiranyatraiva paraṃ prakāśate
‘vedacchedā śālinī mo'tha tau gau’ ityupalakṣaṇaṃ śravyarateḥ
pradhānāvimarśe hi vākyaśarīrameva na niṣpannaṃ syāt
muddhāṇo mūrdhā tatrābaddhā bhugnā śaśilekhā yena
yaśca saṃdhyāyai praṇatastaṃ pramathanāthaṃ pramathā gaṇāsteṣāṃ nātham
asyāṃ ca gāthāyāṃ strīmayavyāpārarūpatā bhagavataḥ pratīyate iti rahasyamārādhyā manyante
atra bhinnānāmapi padānāmekapadatā pratibhāsaheturanatikomalo bandhaviśeṣaḥ śleṣaḥ
ata eva pānakarasanyāyena saṃbhūyacitrāsvādaparyavasānakṣamaṃ guṇasaṃvalanameva rītiriti locanakāraḥ
yathā citrasya lekhā uttuṅgapratyaṅgalāvaṇyonmīlanakṣamā, tathā rītiriti dvitīye vistaraḥ
tenāyamarthaḥ śabdārthobhayapradhānatayā sāmānyatastridhā bhūtvā śleṣāditrikavivakṣayā pratyekaṃ tridhā bhavatīti
teṣu śabdasya prāthamyāttatpradhānakaguṇabhaṅgaḥ prathamaṃ vivektavya ityāha—tatreti
atra pūrvārdhasya mṛdubandhatvāduttarārdhasya ca gāḍhabandhatvātsamabandheṣu viṣamamiti viṣamo nāma śabdapradhānaḥ samatāviparyayo doṣaḥ
sa eva saṃdarbho mṛdumadhyakaṭhoravarṇanirvyūḍhāstistro bandhajātayastatraikarūpe vākyārthe ekaiva jātirupādeyeti tadviparyāso vairāgyahetureva
akaṭhorākṣaraprāyatābandhasya sukumāratvaṃ tadviparthaye kaṭhoratā śrutikaṭutvaṃ bhavati
asitā kṛṣṇā ṛtirvartma yasya kṛṣṇavartmā vahnistasya tugapatyam
svarge kṣiyanti nivasanti ye devāsteṣāṃ patiḥ senānītvāt
sa evaṃbhūto bhagavān kumāro'midbhirasnigdhai rūkṣaiḥ śubhradṛgdṛṣṭairdhavalākṣivilokitaiḥ sakrodhanibhālane tārakābhāgasyordhvatayā nayanāttathābhāvo jātirvo yuṣmākaṃ dviṣaḥ śatrūñjeghnīyiṣīṣṭa
iha tu padānāmatathābhāve rti dri cchi ityādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ parasparasaṃnidhāne ghaṭanaiva kaṭhoretyāha—atrātikaṭhoratvāditi
śrutamātrasyaiva yasyārthaścitte pratiphalati sa prasannaḥ śabdaḥ
‘paścādiva gatirvācaḥ purastādiva vastuna’ iti sahṛdayavyavahārārthaviṣayatvaṃ prasādo'rthanirūpaṇīya iti bhavatyarthapradhānaḥ
’ iti vākyadoṣeṣu parigaṇanamabhyacchatayā ca śabdānāṃ pratītiḥ skhalantī dūṣaṇatāmasya sthāpayati—anaṅgakamiti
nanu haṃsyāgamanapathālaṃkaraṇakālo rātristasyāṃ ca tuṣārakiraṇa eva tadalaṃkārakārī kimanayā varākyetyata āha—yasyeti
tatsadṛśalāñchano valakṣagurvalakṣo gauḥ kiraṇo yasya śubhrāṃśuścandraḥ
sā ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānurūpārthanirūpaṇīyatayārthapradhāneti tadviparyayo'pi tatpradhāna iti pūrvavanneyam
ata eva vivakṣitavākyānyathānupapattyā neyaḥ kalpanīyo'rtho yasyeti neyārthamityartho'pi ghaṭate
tathā hi—samudramadhyātpṛthivyāmuddhriyamāṇāyāṃ mahāsuravimarde teṣāṃ daṃṣṭrayā pāṭanena rudhiraśabalatayā lohitatvamudadheriti vākyārtho'bhipretaḥ
kanye kāmayamānaṃ māṃ tvaṃ na kāmayase katham || 46 ||’
rasasya dīptiḥ kāntiragre vivariṣyate tenārthapradhānatā vyaktā
tathāhi—kanye iti saṃbodhanena rasavirodhinīvilasitā kṣamatā pratīyate
‘smaraḥ kharaḥ khalaḥ kāntaḥ kāyaḥ kopadhanaḥ kṛśaḥ
cyuto māno'dhiko rāgo moho jāto'savo gatāḥ || 47
atra satyasamastapadāmidhāne satyapi cārthasaukumārye śleṣādiguṇasāmapryabhāvānna vaidarmī rītiḥ
nanu samāsabhūyastvamojo'bhidhāsyate tatkathamasyābhāvo'rthapradhāno'pi kathaṃ ca doṣa ityata āha—khaṇḍayanrītimiti
śabdasya tu pāruṣyaśaithilyavyatikaralakṣaṇā sā ca kvacitsamāsadīrghatayā vyajyate

tadevaṃ tattvavyavasthitau pūrvācāryavyavasthityā guṇakāṇḍe samāsabhūyastvamojolakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicaritaguṇamadhye samāsaratanāsauṣṭhavaṃ vaktṛkṣamatayā guṇa ityabhiprāyādviśeṣaṃ tatra vakṣyāmaḥ—tadidamiti
nahi prauḍherabhāve guṇasaṃbandhanātmikā rītirnāmeti viparyayapadena sādhāraṇena pāruṣyaśaithilye darśayati—atreti
yadyapyatrānuprāso'sti tathāpi rītimantareṇa mṛtaśarīra iva kāvye nālaṃkaraṇatāmadhyāste
tataśca na prakṛtaḥ ko'pi camatkārāvirbhāva iti nāsyaiva kāvyatāṃ prayojayatītyarthaḥ
viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ strīṣu rājakuleṣu ca || 48 ||’

atra nakhināṃ ca nadīnāṃ ceti pṛṣṭhyantaccakāreṇa rīterupakrame śṛṅgiṇāṃ śastrapāṇināmiti cakārānirvāhāt strīṣu rājakuleṣu ceti ṣaṣṭhīparityāgādamadhurārthatvācca mādhuryaviparyayanāmāyaṃ śabdārthapradhāno guṇaviparyayo doṣaḥ
yadāha—‘śṛṅgāra eva madhuraḥ paraḥ prahlādano rasaḥ
tataśca śabdadūṣaṇaprastāve pṛthakpadatāmātrapratyayo yadyucyate gauḍīyā dṛṣṭā syāt, iti rītikhaṇḍanaparyavasāyitayābhidhānām
bhavati hi kadācitkaveḥ śaktivaśātsollekhe'pi samāse rasavyaktiḥ
yathā—‘yāte dvāravatīṃ tadā madhuripau laddattasaṅgānatāṃ kālindītaṭarūḍhavañjulalatāmāliṅgya sotkaṇṭhayā
’ evaṃ cāskhalitapratītiviṣayasyaiva saṃdarbhasya rasatvaṃ padaghaṭanārūpasya ca saṃdarbhasyānirvāhādeva pratītiḥ skhalatītyāha—tadanirvyūḍhamiti
nakhināṃ ca nadīnāṃ ceti cakāreṇottaratra tatparityāge'nupapattirjāgarti tadeva pratīteḥ saṃvala- nam
astu tarhi vastvasattve'pyekadiḍyādhuryasaṃpattau kāvyatāpratilambha ityata āha—amadhurārthatvācceti
idaṃ ca ghaṭanāyā mādhurye paramaṃ rahasya-mityāha—yayā kayāciditi
auṣṭhyakaṇṭhyādikaṃ vā tadrūpasamānaśrutikamādau yasya tathābhūtasya padasya pratyāsattiḥ
tadidamapuṣṭārthatvādanutkṛṣṭaviśeṣaṇamanudāraṃ niralaṃkāramācakṣate so'yamaudāryaviparyayo nāma śabdārthapradhāno guṇaviparyayo doṣaḥ
kāvyarūpatāprayojakaṃ śabdārthayorvakratā udāratā nahi vakratāmantareṇa kāvyapadavīprāptistadāha—‘yattu vakraṃ vacaḥ śāstre loke ca vaca eva tat
tadevaṃ vākyadoṣā~llakṣayitvā kramaprāptā vākyārthadoṣā lakṣaṇīyā iti tānvibhajate—
khinnaṃ caivātimātraṃ ca paruṣaṃ virasaṃ tathā || 44
taṃ brāhmaṇī pṛcchati putrakāmā rājanrumāyāṃ laśunasya ko'rthaḥ || 50 ||’
‘madrakāṇām’ iti pāṭhe gītakaviśeṣāṇāṃ vā saṃgatiḥ, kathaṃ vā putrakāmāyāstatpraśnasaṃsargaḥ, kathaṃ ca rājanniti saṃbodhanaṃ ghaṭate, putrakāmāyāśca rumālavaṇārthapraśnaḥ
atrāhiṣātāṃ dṛṣṭvetyetābhyāmeva tāviti, raghuvyāghrāvityanenaiva rāmalakṣmaṇāviti, tanumityanenaiva khāmiti, ahauṣīdityanenaiva vahnāviti, gamyata iti gatārthatvam
na ca śarabhaṅgāśramagamanaṃ tanuhomo vāgrataḥ kathāśarīropayogīti niṣprayojakatvam
ato'yaṃ vyarthanāmā vākyasya mahāvākyasya ca doṣo bhavati
ārthyā ca vṛttyā labdhasya śāstretihāsādau śabdavṛttyā bhaṇanamapaunaruttayāyetyarthapunarukterbhidyate
vijñāto vā vigato vārtho'bhidheyaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya tavdyarthaṃ svatantraṃ ca dūṣaṇamiti vaiśeṣike vaktavyam
tathā cārthasiddhāyāṃ prāptau śabdenopādānamanucitaṃ lokānusāreṇa kāvye dṛśiścākṣuṣa eva jñāne prayujyate
yathā—‘mayā tāvaddṛṣṭo na khalu kalikandarpandarpanṛpaterguṇaistulyaḥ ko'pi kvacidapi kimaśrāvi bhavatā
iti praśnaṃ śrutvā kvaṇitamiva karṇāntikamagānmṛgākṣīṇāṃ cakṣuścaṭulabhavatā cāntataralam
’ yathā vā—‘naivādarśi na cāśrāvi phalaṃ malayabhūruhaḥ
’ cakṣuśca prāptameva gṛhṇātītyarthalabdhāyāṃ prāptau kathaṃ śabdenopādānam
raghuvyāghrādiprakaraṇādikamāsādya viśeṣaparyavasāyi yaugikatvānna tu viśeṣa eva śaktam
evaṃ ca prakaraṇādinā raghuvyāghrapadaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇaparameveti pūrvārdhe tayoreva prakrāntatvāduttarārdhe sarvanāmnā parāmarśo yujyate, na tu svaśabdena
yathā—‘karau dhunānā navapallavākṛtīrvṛthā kṛthā mānini mā pariśramam
juhotiśca vahnyādhārakameva havirdravyatyāgamabhidhatte tena ‘vahnau’ ityapi na vācyam
na cāśramagamanatanuhomau kariṣyamāṇavīrarasocitakathāśarīre kāmapi śobhāmātrāmarpeyata iti vākyasya mahāvākyasya ceti yathāsaṃkhyamanvayaḥ
asya raghukulabhuvaḥ śarabhaṅgāśramagamanamitihāsāccakṣuṣaḥ prāptasyaiva jñānajanakatvaṃ śāstrāt
tathā hi—‘prasādhitasya-’ ityādiśloke śleṣopahitena vyatirekeṇa kāpyapūrvā kṛṣṇasya lakṣmīstatkāle babhūveti tātparyārthaḥ
tathā hi—manorathetyādau manorathe yaḥ priyo vallabhastadālokarasena lolekṣaṇe capalalocane tava māteyamārādvṛttirdūravārtinī
ato naitādṛśaṃ sānurāgāṅganājanayogyaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṣamā iti vyavasthāpanānnāvalokayituṃ śaktā tato niḥśaṅkamālokasveti vākyārtha uteyamāradvṛttiḥ samīpadeśavartinī
tathā cedṛśaṃ kulāṅganānucitaṃ cāritrakhaṇḍanaṃ draṣṭuṃ na kṣamā na sahiṣṇuratomānayanacāpalaṃ kāṣīṃriti
na ca mitho virodhinorekatra vivakṣā saṃbhavati
na ca mātuḥ prakopaśaṅkayā priyavilokanarasotkāyā manorathabhaṅgo na bhavatītyarthaḥ
‘kārāviūṇa khauraṃ gāmaulo majjio a jimio a
kārayitvā kṣauraṃ gāmaulo grāmapradhānapuruṣa iti deśīyāḥ
majjio a susnātaśca jimio a bhuktavāṃśca tato nakṣatraṃ tithivārau ca jyautiṣikaṃ praṣṭuṃ calitaḥ
tithivārajñānāntaraṃ kṣurakarma, tataḥ snānabhojane, iti laukikaḥ kramastasya viparyāso vyakta eva śrutivacanāt
kriyamāṇe'pi racanāvaiparītyena kramabhraṃśaḥ samādhīyata iti nāsau śabdadoṣaḥ
atra pūrvārdhopāttānāṃ kramo na viparyastaḥ kiṃtu kṣaurottarārdhoktayorityāha—atra kṣurakarmaṇa iti
roai diaro taṃ saṃṭhavei pāsseṇa vaccanto || 56 ||’
tatrāsati viśeṣahetau yajjātīyamartha budhdyā vyavasthāpya vacanopakramastajjātīyasyaiva samastavākyanirvāho yukto na tvantareṇa parityāgena bhedaḥ
ādipadena svataḥ saṃbhaviviśeṣāṇāmupamādīnāṃ kaviprauḍhinirmītānāṃ ca rūpakādīnāṃ parigrahaḥ
vivāhya navavadhūḥ sāsuraaṃ śvaśuragṛhaṃ dolikayā nīyamānā roditīti svataḥsaṃbhavī
navapariṇītāsvabhāvalakṣaṇārthastāvadupakrāntastathā sati yo janmābhyastapitṛgṛhaviyogavedanādūnamānasāyā atyantāpariśīlitena devareṇa saṃsthāpanaprakāraḥ sa na jātau niviśate
tasyaucityāttasyā eva hi kiṃcana vaktavyaṃ bhavatītyāha—atra prakrāntasyeti
goṣpadapramiti pūrerṇijantād ‘varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām’ iti ṇamul, ūlopaśca
‘khāhi visaṃ, pia muttaṃ, nijjasu mārīa, paḍau de vajjam
[khāda viṣaṃ, piba mūtraṃ, nīyasva māryā, patatu te vajram
‘khāda viṣaṃ, piba mūtraṃ, nīyasva māryā, patatu te vajram’ itthaṃ mātā putramākośati
yato bālo dantairmātuḥ stanaṃ daśatīti jātistasyāḥ punarevaṃvidhaṃ paruṣābhidhāyitvamanucitam
aprastutaḥ prastāvamantareṇa sūcico raso yatra tattathā
ekarasaprakrame hi virodhirasāntaraprastāva eva kriyamāṇo naucityavān
na caucityama- ntareṇa rasasya padasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavati
tava vanavāsa ityādau pitṛmaraṇānubhavaprāptaśokaprakarṣāyāḥ śṛṅgāraprastāvanā virasāyate
sā hi svabhāvata eva karuṇena sahaikavākyasamāveśavirodhinī
arthastu rasātmāvirodhena padaṃ badhnāti tataḥ kāntiviparyayādbhedaḥ
na ca karuṇoktirupakrāntā yatastadanirvāhe khedasaṃbhāvanā syāt
tathā ca bhinnameva duṣṭatābījaṃ tadetatsarvamapi saṃdhāya vyācaṣṭe—atreti
utkṛṣṭajātīyasyopameyasya hīnajātīyena sāmānyamabhidhīyamānaṃ śābdanyāyena bodhayadanucitameva bhavati
nanvatra rūpakabalena varṇanīyasya paśutāvagamyata iti yuktamanaucityam
nahyatra prastutopaślokasya sārameyatāvagamyate agre prasaraṇamāplutya nihananaṃ ca sādṛśyamupāttamucitameveti naitat
tattvapratibimbe sādṛśyapratītirapi śabdena kriyamāṇā loke kāntiṃ prati puṣṇāti
na hi kadāpi hīnena sādṛśyoktau varṇanā sajīvā pratīyate
hīnenotkṛṣṭaṃ yathā nopamīyata iti lokamaryādā tathotkṛṣṭena hīnam
tathā hi—cakravākopamitimanusaṃdadhatāṃ viśeṣāvagatividhurāṇāṃ ca sahṛdayānāṃ pratītiḥ skhalantī janayatyeva vairasyamiti sūkṣmekṣikayā dūṣaṇam
atra kopānalanirdagdhamugdhamanmathaśarīrasya harasya nitambanirgatasrotasā himavadgiriṇā sahāsādṛśyādidamasaṃdṛśopamam

yadyapi balavattvādinā pratīyamānaṃ himavadbhagavatorasti sādṛśyam, tathāpi vācyopamābhrameṇāyaṃ nibandhaḥ, sā ca na saṃpannā, nahi roṣeṇa vidagdhamanmathaśarīradāho vistṛtanitambanirgatagaṅgāsrotaḥpratibimbabhūtaḥ
dhāturaṅgarañjito gaṅgāpravāho'bhimatasya bhavati lalāṭanetrāgnijvālāpratibimbamityapi na vācyam, yenāndhatvaprasaṅgāt
kathaṃ ca manmathaśarīradāhaḥ pratibimbāyata ityāśayena vyācaṣṭe—atreti
viśeṣaṇayorbimbapratibimbabhāvābhāve viśiṣṭayorupamānaṃ saṃbhavatīti matvā viśeṣaṇadvayamadoṣāyaiveti vyākhyātavān
‘kumudamiva mukhaṃ tasyā gauriva mahiṣaḥ śaśīva kāvyamidam
atra kumudamukhayorgomahiṣayoḥ kāvyaśaśinośca pratīyamāne śarattaruṇyośca vidhīyamāne sādṛśye upamānopameyasyāprasiddhatvādaprasiddhopamamidam
kamalamukhayoriva kumudamukhayorgogavayayoriva gomahiṣayoḥ kāvyaśabdayoriva kāvyaśaśinorasti sādṛśyaṃ saurabhādikamevānupāttamapi prasiddhatayā pratīyamānam
śarattaruṇyostu na tathā prasiddhamiti vikasitapulakāṅkurā bhātītyetābhyāmupāttam
viśiṣṭabhānasya ca dvayānugatatvenaiva pratīyamānatvāttathāpi pada ivālaṃkāre'pi kavibhiraprayujyamānatvameva doṣa iti vyācaṣṭe—atreti
uluā haṇanti kāe, kāā ulue vi vāanti || 64 ||’
ulūkā dhnanti kākān, kākā ulūkānapi vāyanti
svaṃ rūpaṃ camatkārakāri kavipratibhāmātraprakāśanīyaṃ rūpaṃ tadevālaṃkārakakṣāmadhiśete
na cātra tathā kiṃcidabhihitamato na jātyalaṃkāraḥ
kathaṃ tarhi vakratābhāvarūpadīrghapuccha ityādeḥ śabdadoṣādbhidyate tadāha—saviśeṣaṇāditi
tatra viśeṣaṇaprayoge śabdānāmeva vakratāvyatirekeṇāpavāda iti śabdadūṣaṇamiha tu na tathā
kiṃ tūktameva svarūpaṃ na vakramiti vākyārtha eva duṣṭaḥ

atrodyatasya paraṃ hantumiti saṃbhogārambhaviṣayā, stabdhasya vivaraiṣiṇa iti varāṅgaviṣayā, patanaṃ jāyate'vaśyamiti retovisargaviṣayā, kṛcchreṇa punarunnatiriti naṣṭarāgapratyānayanaviṣayā aślīlavākyārthaviṣayā pratītirbhavati
paramanyaṃ hantumudyatasya vivaraiṣiṇa iti pramādakṛtāvadhānasya stabdhasyātmanyutkarṣābhidhānenānyānavadhīrayataḥ patanamāvaśyakamudgamaḥ kṛcchrāditi saṃsargo'bhimataḥ
sa pramāṇenaiva tato lokādivirodhasyālaṃkārasamayasiddhasya pramāṇavirodhaparyavasāyitvaṃ vivakṣannāha—
tatra deśakālādau pratyakṣata eva varṇyamānasyābhāvo niścīyate iti deśādivirodhaḥ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
atra padminyā naktaṃ kumudvatyā ahni madhau niculānāmunnidratvādyabhāvānnidāghasya cāmeghadurdinatvāt
kālo naktaṃ dinartava iti kālakṛto'yaṃ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
yadyapi kālasvarūpamapratyakṣaṃ tathāpi tadupādhīnāṃ vyavahārāṅgateva pratyakṣatā cetyāha—kālo naktaṃ dinartava iti
tatra jaṅgamaṃ gāvāśvādi sthāvaraṃ latāvṛkṣādi rāṣṭrādāveva deśaparibhāṣā idaṃ prakārāntareṇa deśaśabdenābhidhīyate
ādhūtakesaretyādau udāharaṇe kvacideva vyaktiviśeṣe kesarādisaṃbandhapratipādanaṃ kathamanyathā teṣāmeraṇḍaṃ nirdiśati
nahi viśeṣataḥ kāpi kūrmapṛṣṭhavyaktirastīti sāmānyākāreṇa vivakṣitam
tataśca kamalajāteḥ paṅkajaprabhavāyā eva niścayātkūrmapṛṣṭhādudgame na kaścitpramāṇaṃ kadāpi kasyāpyavataratītyāśayavān vyācaṣṭe—atreti
atra svayaṃ vaktureva ‘yāvajjīvamahaṃ maunī’ ityādipadānāmuktyā pratijñāvirodhātpratijñāviruddhamidam
tathā hi—nāyaṃ maunī vacanavattvādityabhyupagamya maunābhāvaparyavasannamiti tṛtīyo'yamanumānavirodhaḥ
dvitīyapakṣakakṣīkaraṇena caturthodāharaṇe ‘brahmacārī ca me pitā, mātā ca mama vandhyā’ iti vaktā yasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ sa pitṛpadenābhimato na ca tasya brahmacāritvaṃ saṃbhavati
mātā jananyevābhidhīyate na ca tasyā vandhyātvaṃ saṃbhavati
nahi smarābhatvaṃ loke prasiddhaṃ kitu smaratulyatāṃ vadan sopamānatvamabhyupagacchati
ahaṃkāro mānaḥ sa na śatruvijaye sādhanam
yadāha—sa raghurāṣṭro vilalāsa ityupakramya kauṭilyācāryaḥ mānādrāvaṇaḥ paradārānaprayacchan duryodhano rājyāṃśaṃ ceti
atrottaroṣṭha ityuparitana oṣṭha uttaroṣṭhamantaramukhaṃ nayanāntaṃ ca muktvā cumbanavaddaśanacchedyasthānānīti kāmasūtram
tataśca ṣaḍvā pañca vā svarā bhavanti bhinnagrāme na tu sapta
kāmaśāsravirodhaprastāve kathaṃ kalāvirodha udāhriyata ityata āha—tadaṃśatvāditi
gītādikalācatuḥṣaṣṭeḥ kāmāṅgatayā kāmasūtrakārairupadeśādbhavati tadvirodhe kāmaśāsravirodha ityarthaḥ
evaṃ padānāṃ vākyānāṃ vākyārthānāṃ ca yaḥ kaviḥ
vaiśeṣikāstu te nūnaṃ doṣatve'pi hi ye guṇāḥ || 61
atra bhinnānāmapi padānāmekāpadatāpratibhāsahetutvena saṃdarbhasya suśliṣṭatvādayaṃ śleṣo nāma śabdaguṇaḥ
tadevaṃ doṣalakṣaṇe vṛtte kramaprāptā guṇā lakṣayitavyāḥ
kimeṣāṃ mitho bhedanibandhanam, kathaṃ cālaṃkārebhyo guṇānāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ, rasasya hi doṣābhāvāditrayasaṃskṛta eva padalābha ityasti paścādbhāve nibandhanamiti tatrāha—alaṃkṛtamapīti
tathā hi—yadi kāvyasya rasapradhānātmakatāmāśrityāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ, alaṃkārā api tarhi tatpravaṇā eva
atha nāyaṃ niyamo yatsarvatra rasaḥ pradhānamiti, tadātra guṇeṣvapi kathaṃ tadālambananiyamaḥ
kiṃ cātra prasādādivat śleṣādayo'pi śabdārthagatā eva pratyabhijñāyante tatkathamayaṃ vibhāgaḥ
yadyapi śabdārthā jñāyante, tathāpi rasapravaṇā iti cet
lokaśāstravacanātigāmī kaścidviśeṣaḥ śobhāpadābhilapyo bhavannasmiñśravyaśabdaḥ śabdārśau viṣayīkaroti
yadāha—‘kāvyaśobhāyāḥ kartāro dharmā guṇāstadatiśayahetavastvalaṃkārāḥ’ ityanye, tadapi na
nahi teṣāṃ rītiśarīrāntarniveśaḥ kaiścidabhyupagamyate, tasmādālaṃkārikasamayānupātī śleṣādyanyatamo guṇaḥ
tata eva ca śobhākāritvena guṇānāmapyalaṃkārapakṣanikṣepaṃ kariṣyati
yathā—‘kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā kiṃ vā madabhyāgamakāraṇaṃ te
ācakṣva matvā vaśināṃ raghūṇāṃ manaḥ parastrīvimukhapravṛtti
arthastvātmatulyo'dhiṣṭhāyakatayā paścādgrahyatayā cāntarastena tadāśritā guṇā apyāntarāḥ
‘mādhuryaujaḥprasādāstraya eva guṇāḥ’ iti dhvanikārasya mataṃ nirasyati—caturviṃśatiriti
śliṣṭāni ghaṭitāni padāni yatra tasya bhāvastattā
na ca ghaṭanāmātrasya guṇabhāva iti śaṅkyam
śobhanatvaṃ ghaṭanāyā masṛṇatvamekatāpratibhānasāmarthyaṃ yadbrahmaṃ sūtramuraḥsthala iti
‘mni’ ityatra makāro bhakāreṇa, nakāro dakāreṇa samānaśrutika ityādi boddhavyam
tathā ‘pṛthakpravāhau’ iti kakārasya pavargagamanaikatā pratibhāsate, ‘pravāhāvākāśa’ ityaukārasyāvādeśena varṇāntaraniṣpattyā
tena vakṣaḥsthaladakṣiṇavāmabhāgayorlambamāno dvisaro hāra iti labhyate
atrāsyeti padena nānyasya hāra itthamanupamo na cānyasya vakṣaḥsthalamākāśavadunnatavistīrṇamiti bhagavataḥ sakalajagadvilakṣaṇatvadhvanirityārādhyāḥ
‘gāhantāṃ mahiṣā nipānasalilaṃ śṛṅgairmuhustāḍitaṃ chāyābaddhakadambakaṃ mṛgakulaṃ romanthamabhyasyatu
viśrabdhaiḥ kriyatāṃ varāhapatibhirmustākṣatiḥ palvale viśrāmaṃ labhatāmidaṃ ca śithilajyābandhamasmaddhanuḥ || 76 ||’
tatra pratīyamānaviṣayo yathā—‘evaṃvādini devarṣau pārśve pituradhomukhī
’ atra śrutāvagatādeva vākyāllajjādayo hastadattā iva prakāśante
ādyo yathā—‘candre kalaṅkaḥ sujane daridratā vikāśalakṣmīḥ kamaleṣu cañcalā
mukhāprasādaḥ sadhaneṣu sarvadā yaśo vidhātuḥ kathayanti khaṇḍitam
atra prathamapāde gāhantāṃ mahiṣā iti grāmyam
ciraparasparavārtānabhijñānāddivā niṣpalāyanena romantho'paricita ivāsīttasyedānīṃ śikṣākrameṇa yadi paricayaḥ syādityabhyasyatviti dhvaniḥ
nanu cātra kartṛprakramabhedo dūṣaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati
āpātaśauṇḍeṣu pariṇatibhīruṣu ca mahiṣeṣu svabhāvabhīteṣu mṛgeṣu na tathāyaṃ saṃrambhate yathā punarāvṛtticatureṣu prakārakovideṣu ca varāheṣu
tataśca teṣāmucitakriyāsu kartṛtāmātrameva na soḍhavāniti sāṃprataṃ kartṛtābhyanujñānena vyajyate
tatastṛtīyāyāmaucityaniveśinyāṃ prakramabhedo'pyucita eveti vyaktivivekakārādīnāmapi saṃmataḥ panthāḥ
idaṃ ceti cakāreṇa cedasmaddhanurārūḍhamavatīrṇaṃ vā tadaiva saṃrambhagocarāṇāṃ bhayavisrambhāviti kopaprakarṣaḥ
avaiṣamyeṇa bhaṇanamityanena vāgbhedaḥ svareṣu hrasvāntyāḥ, vyañjaneṣu vargāntyā dantyāśca mṛdavaḥ komalā varṇāḥ
dīrghāḥ svarāḥ vyañjaneṣu ṇakāravarjaṭavargarephaśaṣahā adantyasaṃyogāśca prasphuṭāḥ
śeṣāṇi vyañjanāni dantyasaṃyogāśconmiśramadhyamā varṇāsteṣāmanyatamairvarṇairyo bandhanavidhistaṃ prati yadavaiṣamyeṇa upakramanirvāhādinā karaṇena bhaṇanamuktiḥ sā samatā
nanu ‘raktāśokakṛśodarī kva nu gatā tyaktvānuraktaṃ janaṃ no dṛṣṭeti mudhaiva cālayasi kiṃ vātābhibhūtaṃ śiraḥ
tadevaṃ nirvāhyatraividhyātsamatā trirūpā bhavati grāmyā paruṣā upanāgarikā ca
yathā—‘puraḥ pāṇḍucchāyaṃ tadanu kapilimnā kṛtapadaṃ tataḥ pākodrekādaruṇaguṇasaṃvardhitavapuḥ
śanaiḥ kośārambhe sthapuṭanijaviṣkambhaviṣame vane pītāmodaṃ vadaramarasatvaṃ kalayati
bālendumayūkhamukulajālaniculitāsu parameśvarajaṭāvallarīpu bhramaṇādhyāsādivādyāpi himādrikuñjeṣu jhāṅkārigaṅgāmbha iti pratīyamānotprekṣā
upanāgarikā yathā—‘vasane paridhūsare vasānā niyamakṣāmamukhī dhṛtaikaveṇiḥ
atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddhaśīlā mama dīrghāṃ virahavyathāṃ vyanakti
valīṣu tasyāḥ skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ || 78 ||’
pṛthagiva padāni yatra bhāsante sa pṛthakpadaḥ saṃdarbha ityupamāgarbho bahuvrīhiśca
aucityena hi samāsavyatireka ākṛṣyate kadācidanuddhato vā samāsaḥ
yathā—‘teṣāṃ gopavadhūvilāsasuhṛdāṃ rādhārahaḥsākṣiṇāṃ kṣemaṃ tatra kalindaśailatanayātīre latāveśmanām
vicchinne smaratalpakalpanamṛducchedopayoge'dhunā te nūnaṃ jaraṭhībhavanti vigalannīlatviṣaḥ pallavāḥ
’ atra tacchabdo yeṣāṃ vilāsasaṃpattisvabhāvalabdhaprakarṣāṇāmanubhava eva sākṣīti viśeṣaprādhānyavivakṣayā nasamāsenānigamanāt
na yā kāpi vadhūḥ, api tu gopasaṃbandhinī kṛtagopācāracāturīparādhīnā
nānyatra nīrasaprāye kvacana sauhārdaṃ kiṃ tu vilāsa eva
so'pi na yaḥkaścit, api tu gopavadhūsaṃbandhītyevaṃ bahūnāṃ piṇḍībhāvavivakṣayā samāsa evocitaḥ
yadyapi rādhāsaṃbandhasya vaivakṣikaṃ prādhānyamiti na samāsaḥ pratibhāsate tathāpi yadanyasya rādhārahasi niveśaḥ kṣama iti bhāvayansuhṛdāmityapahāya sākṣiṇāmityuktavān
pakṣmāvasthāne'dharatāḍane stanataṭanipāte valibhaṅgaskhalane nābhinimnapnāptau jalabindūnāṃ kartṛtānirdeśātsvācchandyamunmīlitam
nidāghatāpacchidā rajoharaṇena vasuṃdharā saurabhonmīlanena mayūrakekāyitādinā tribhuvanasyāpi ye camatkārāspadamiti dhvanitam
samasta eva gumphe dvitrāṇi tricaturāṇi prasphuṭānyakṣarāṇi niveśyante sa kilāntarāntaropadaṃśanyāyena citrāsvādaparyavasāyī sukumāra iti prācāṃ matam
maṇḍalīkṛtyetyādau prathamapāde maṇḍeti, kṛtyeti, barheti atra saṃyogatrayam
dvitīyapāde ṇṭheti, rmeti ca saṃyogadvayamupanyasya gītidīrghasvaraniveśo rūpāntaramādāya viśeṣaśobhāhetuḥ
tṛtīyapāde keti na iti pranṛtyantīti ca dīrghavisargasaṃyogā iti vyantaram
nanu aniṣṭhurākṣaramayatvaṃ sukumārateti vaktavye prāyaśabdaḥ kena prayojanenetyata āha—atreti
na cāyamarthaguṇaḥ sa hi vākyārthe dharmiṇi nirūpyate
ayaṃ tu padasamudāya iti yuktaṃ śabdaguṇeṣu pariṃgaṇanam
atra vande ityuttamapuruṣavacanenaivāhamiti prāptam ‘asmadyuttamaḥ’ ityatra sthāninītyabhidhānāt
tadevaṃ yādṛśo yāvāṃśca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaprakāro'bhimataḥ sa sarva eva vāgityādyupāttaśabdasamudāyamātreṇa niṣpratyūhamavagamyata ityarthavyaktiśabdārthavyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atreti
‘nirānandaḥ kaunde madhuni vidhuro bālabakule na sāle sālambo lavamapi lavaṅge na ramate
priyaṅgau nāsaṅgaṃ racayati na cūte vicarati smaraṃllakṣmīlīlākamalamadhupānaṃ madhukaraḥ || 81 ||’
atra bandhasya chāyāvatvenaujjvalyaṃ tadeva ca kāntirucyate
kecidāhuranuprāsabahutvamiti, tadasat—‘tasyāḥ susrāva netrābhyāṃ vāri praṇayakopajam
yathā—‘vrajati gaganaṃ bhallātakyā dalena sahopamām’ iti
ata evāha—‘purāṇacitrasthānīyaṃ tena vandhyaṃ kavervacaḥ’ iti
camatkāritvaṃ tu sahṛdāhlādakatvamasti hi tulye'pi vācakatve padānāṃ kaścidavāntaro viśeṣo yamadhikṛtya kiṃcideva prayuñjate mahākavayo na tu sarvam
‘katte maṇāma iccaṃ saccaṃ kavie samaṃ samaggesu
’ kāntavarṇānuprāso'pi kānta eva bhavatīti matvānuprāsotkaṭamudāharati—nirānanda iti
asti kunde madhu paraṃ na kamala-sajātīyamityāsakto nānandamalabhata
bālatve bakulakusumānāṃ na madhuprādurbhāva iti etatkāle ratiṃ na prāptavāniti vidhura ityanena vyajyate
kālāntare'pi sāle madhuno'saṃbhavādālambaḥ pratyāśāmātrabandho'pi na tasyāsīt
āmodaprakarṣādantaḥ kṣaṇaṃ nipatya rasamanāsādayaṃllavaṅgamanusaratīti lavamityanena dhvanyate
chāyaujjvalyaṃ kāntirityekārthatayā loke prasiddhaṃ tadiha yathā śabdeṣu saṃgacchate tathā pūrvācāryaprasiddhyā vivecanīyamityabhiprāyaḥ
‘ārohatyavanīruhaṃ praviśati śvabhraṃ nagaiḥ spardhate khaṃ vyāleḍhi viceṣṭate kṣititale kuñjodare līyate
antarbhrāmyati koṭarasya vilasatyālambate vīrughaḥ kiṃ tadyanna karoti mārutavaśaṃ yātaḥ kṛśānurvane || 82 ||’
atra vikaṭākṣarabandhatve nṛtyadbhiriva padairyadvākyaracanā sā udāratā
asti tāvannṛtyantīva padānīti sahṛdayānāṃ kvacidarthe vyavahāraḥ
sa ca na nirviṣayo nāpyasya viśeṣa iti tatpramāṇakameva guṇāntaramavasthitamiti kaścivdyācaṣṭe
tathā tu na kathaṃcittsvarūpamudbhidya darśitaṃ bhavati
dvitīyapāde'pi prasāraṇenopakramyata iti naiva nirvahaṇamantarāntaravarohakramo bhavati
vana ityanena yatra sarvathaiva pratīkārāsaṃbhava iti niraṅkuśonmādaceṣṭitamevopabṛṃhayati
kiṃ tadyaditi na śakyaṃte gaṇayitu munmādaceṣṭitānīti prakāśantetyeti granthilāvicchedāt
ata eva parasmaipadayornirantaramāvāpaḥ kāntiviśeṣakaratvādupādeya eva bhavatīti
śubhre sadmani pallavinyupavane vāpyāṃ navāmbhoruhi krīḍādrau ca saśādvale vivalitagrīvairvimuktā dṛśaḥ || 83 ||’
bahūnāṃ madhye yaḥ ślāghate sa utkarṣavān

tadiha kāvye vākyārthapoṣādhāyakatayā sahṛdayahṛdayāvarjanakṣamatvena ślāghāviṣayatve viśeṣyatvaṃ ca vākyārtho'tastadviśeṣaṇapadeṣu yathoktarūpa utkarṣo'bhimato'nudāraścāyaṃ guṇa iti svarūpaviśeṣakṛtātkāntiśarīrāntargatāccamatkāritvādbhidyate
śrutimātreṇeyaṃ daśā darśane tu na jñāyate kathaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
sahaseti yāvatkrīḍāsahacarāṇāṃ dhavalagṛhādīnāmapi ca premānurūpamāpṛcchyate tāvānapi samayo na labdha iti dhvanyate
yasyānyena dharṣaṇaṃ svapne'pi na buddhiviṣaya āsīt
sopadravasyāpi yasya na tyāgaḥ kadāpi kathaṃcidabhūditi vyajyate
nirgacchatāmiti hṛdayavamukhyena punaḥ punaravatiṣṭhamānānāmasaṃbhavadrūpaṃ nirgamanamiti dyotyate
śatrūṇāmiti bahuvacanena yadaikāvaskandamuddiśyāyaṃ pracalati tadā sarveṣāmiyaṃ daśā bhavatīti pratyāyyate
viyogavedanādūnamānasānāmudgato'pi bāṣpasrāvādantareva vicchidyata iti lavapadena dhvanyate
śubhra iti yatra candrātapena pallavitāḥ kāntayaḥ kṣaṇadāvilāsavihāreṣu kāmapi rasamātrāmutkarṣayantīti vyanakti
vivalitagrīvatayā ca pabhdyāṃ palāyanameva na tu śarīravalanamapīti
viracitanutibandho mūrdhni sadyaḥ purāreḥ pariṇatabahukalpabrahmaṇāṃ brahmaghoṣaḥ || 84 ||’
tathā ca samāsasya bhūyastvaṃ vaipulyavikaṭatvamiti yāvat
nahyeka eva samāso rūpabhedamādāya guṇatvamanalaṃkāratvaṃ ca prayojayatīti kimanupapannam
bahūnāṃ kalpānāṃ brahmāṇa iti caturṇāṃ padārthānāṃ piṇḍatve catvāripadāni samabahuvrīhirūḍhibhirbhujagarajjubhiriti granthidṛḍhatābodhanāya rūpakam
jīvanānantarameva trāsāveśātstutirūpa eva vrahma-ghoṣaṃ udacaraditi bhagavatastrailokyagrahe niraṅkuśaprabhāvaḥ sadyaḥpadena sūcyate
athavā cedāgamānāmātmalābhānantarameva parameśvarastutirūpatātparyāvasānamiti sarvasyā api śruteḥ parameśvarapravaṇatvamananyasādhāraṇabhaktiprahvatāṃ ca kavirabhipraiti
dhūmotpīḍastaruṇamahiṣaskandhanīlo davāgneḥ svairaṃ sarpansṛjati gagane gatvarānabhrabhaṅgān || 85 ||’
ūrjito mahāprāṇastasya bhāva aurjityaṃ tatra saṃdarbhasya mahāprāṃṇatā gāḍhatvamantarāntarāvilambitanayadbhiḥ prayogaiḥ kuṇḍilatvam
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe prathamapāde vicchinnabhugna ityatra tālavyadvayam
caturthapāde rephāntasaṃyogā bhṛdavo ya iti na kāpi kaṭhoratā pratibhāsate
tathā—‘haste līlākamalamalakaṃ bālakundānuviddham-’ ityāderagāḍhaprathamatṛtīyayorapyasti dhāraṇī mahāprāṇatā vyaktetyāha—atreti
‘saujanyābhbunidhe budhapriya guṇaprākāra dharmadruma- prāroha pratipannavatsala mahātyāginvivekāśraya
lakṣmyāvāsa manasvinīmanasijavyāpāradīkṣāguro śrīmanmuñja kimityamuṃ janamupaspraṣṭuṃ dṛśā nārhasi || 86 ||’
atra saujanyāmbunidha ityādīnāṃ priyārthānāṃ padānāmupādānaṃ preyaḥ
parapriyākhyānaṃ cāṭūktistatra yadvidhīyate sa preyo nāma guṇaḥ kiṃ tu kriyata ityāha—priyatarākhyānamiti
pratyayāṃśe tātparyaṃ loke sādhāraṇa eva priya ityucyamāne yastatrāsādhāraṇaḥ prakarṣo'vasīyate sa ityartho bhavati
uktikhaṇḍairupacito'rthaḥ sannasanvā bhavatu kavipratikṛṣṭā sūktireka eva tribhuvane bhūyasīnāmapāmadhiṣṭānam
sūkṣmaguṇapratibimbabhāsitayā yāvadabhimatadāyitayā ca prītidhvanitayā ca prakarṣamarpayati—guṇaprākāreti
yathā prākāre uparyupari śilādīnāmavasthitirevamahamahamikayā tvayi guṇānām
athavā yathā prākāraḥ kalatrāvekṣaṇasthānamevaṃ bhavānapi guṇānāmeva procyate
tathā ca dharmatarorupari brahmalokādibaddhavistārasya bhagavadrūpaḥ prāroho bhūpṛṣṭhamadhitiṣṭatīti ko'pi prītau prakarṣaḥ

upakartavyatayā pratipannaḥ svīkṛtastatra vatsalo jhaṭiti snehārdrāntaḥkaraṇastenāṅgīkṛtabhaṅgabhīrutāmātreṇa puruhūtādivannāpi śleṣāviśleṣānvitatayā balikarṇādivatkiṃ tu bhavān sindhuriva vāñchitādikamupakāraṃ karotīti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
tyāgināmapi yaḥ pūjyaḥ sa mahātyāgī tena nūnaṃ dadhīciprabhṛtayo viśrāṇitārthā api na tava tulyatāmāroḍhumīśata iti pūrvavat

yathākartavyatājñānaṃ vivekastasyāśrayo viśrāntisthānaṃ yadi tvaṃ mūlastambho nābhūstadā kamāśritya vivekaprāsādaḥ padamāropayedityādikaṃ svayamūhanīyamiti tadetatsarvaṃ sūcayannāha—priyārthānāṃ padānāmiti
vyutpattiḥ suptiṅāṃ yā tu procyate sā suśabdatā
‘tasyājīvanirastu mātaravamā jīvasya mājīvato bhūyādvā'jananiḥ kimamba’ januṣā jantorvṛthā janmanaḥ
yastvāmeva na vandate na yajate nopaiti nālokate nopastauti na manyate na manute nādhyeti na dhyāyati || 87 ||’
atra ajīvaniḥ—ajananiḥ—ityādīnāṃ suvantānāṃ vandate—yajate—ityādīnāṃ tiṅantānāṃ ca vyutpattiḥ suśabdatā
subantānāṃ tiṅantānāṃ ca bahūnāmapi cakārādimantareṇa ghaṭanāsauṣṭavārpakatayā camatkārakāritvamityarthaḥ
tvadanyadevatāpravaṇasya janmādikaṃ viphalamiti vadataḥ ko'pi bhagavatīviṣaye bhaktiprakarṣo'vasīyate
anye tu vyācakṣate kaveḥ padaparicayāntarī vyutpattiḥ
tayorekamubhayaṃ vā yatra niveśyamānaṃ vyutpattimabhivyanakti tatra sauśabdyamiti lakṣaṇārthaḥ
tathā hi—ajīvaniriti sopādhisiddhakṛdantaṃ jīvitamupanyasya tadeva jīvasya jīvata iti nirupādhisiddhasādhyārthābhidhāyikṛdantamupanyastavān
dvitīyapāde janijīvamivopakṣipya janinā janmeti tameva prakāradvayenopāttavān
ekaikadhātuprapañcānāṃ subantānāṃ durghaṭamekasaṃdarbhapraveśaṃ tattaducitakriyāsaṃgamena vihitavāniti subantavyutpattiriti dik
dhyāyatīti nididhyāsanaviṣayatayā pratyagjyotīrūpateti parāparabhedabhinnā bhagavatī stutā bhavati
manyate manute iti yathā sāmānyaviśeṣābhidhāyinau tathādhyeti dhyāyatītyapi
tiṅantānāṃ ca durghaṭo'pi paraspara-manvayaḥ kenāpi prakāreṇa ghaṭita iti pūrvavadvoddhavyaḥ
matiḥ sakṛdevāvṛtta iti noktaḥ bhūyasā hi loke vyapadeśo dṛśyata iti
parimlānaprāyāmanuvadati dṛṣṭiḥ kamalinī- mitīyaṃ mādhuryaṃ spṛśati ca tanutvaṃ ca bhajate || 88 ||’
pratyeṣaṇaṃ dīyamānasya grahaṇaṃ cetanadharmaḥ sa virahavatyā acetane'dhare samāropitaḥ
tadabhimukhapravartanamavataraṇamapi cetanadharmaḥ so'cetane kapole samāropitaḥ kiṃcitpāṇḍutāmavadyotayati
na ca pratyeṣaṇavatsāmastyena grahaṇamapi tu saṃmukhībhāvamātramityāśayāt
tathā ca pūrvavanmādhuryaṃ puṣṇāti, anuvādo'pi cetanadharma eva so'cetanāyāṃ dṛṣṭāvāropitaḥ paryuṣitakamalacchāyāmakhaṇḍāmevātra bodhayati
paraprakarṣābhimukhe'pi vipralambhe kadācitsaṃkalpopasthitaprāṇanāthāyāṃ dṛṣṭau kāntī bhavatīti prāyaḥpadena sūcitam
prakṛtāpekṣayā kriyākriyāvatoḥ sādṛśyābhāvānneyaṃ gauṇī kiṃ tūpacaritaiva śuddhetyāha—upacāreṇeti
‘kevalaṃ dadhati kartṛvācinaḥ pratyayāniha na jātu karmaṇi
atra śrutāvagatavākyārthasya sṛjati—saṃharati—śāsti—stūyate—iti śabdānāmantaḥsaṃjalparūpeṇa sūkṣmatayā sūkṣmatvam
yathā karituragādirūpakāṇāṃ pāṣāṇaśilādāvabhivyaktamavasthitau sūkṣmarūpatā tathā śabdānāṃ śrūyamāṇānāmapi kathamanyathā vākyārthabhāvanadaśāyāṃ śeṣaniyamenonmeṣaḥ

kevalamityādau sṛjati—saṃharati—śāstayo dhātavaḥ kartaryeva bhagavadviṣaye prayujyamānāḥ pratyayānprayojayanti na karmaṇīti vākyārtho yadā bhāvyate tadaivāyaṃ sṛjati saṃharati śāsti, na tu sṛjyate saṃhriyate śiṣyate iti śabdāḥ prakāśante
atra stautiḥ karmaṇyeva pratyayaprayojako na kartarīti vākyārthabhāvanāsamaya eva nāyaṃ kiṃcitstauti kiṃtu sarvaiḥ stūyata eveti śabdā unmiṣanti
yāvadeva vākyaṃ śrūyamāṇamavagamyate tasyaiva bhāvanāpallavaḥ paścādavasīyata iti vaṭabījanyāyamupodbalayati
‘maulau dhāraya puṇḍarīkamamitaṃ tanvātmano vikramaṃ cakrāṅkaṃ vaha pādayugmamavanīṃ doṣṇā samabhyuddhara
lkṣamīṃ bhrūnikaṭe niveśaya bhava jyāyāndivaukaspate- rviśvāntaḥkaraṇaikacaura tadapi jñātaṃ hariḥ khalvasi || 90 ||’
atra nābhyāṃ puṇḍarīkadhāraṇaṃ parimitavikramatvaṃ cakrāṅkitakaratvaṃ daṃṣṭrayā vasudhoddhāraṇaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaniveśitalakṣmīkatvamindrāvarajatvaṃ ca dhvanayatīti gāmbhīryam
yena śabda eva dhvanyate sa śabdadhvanirabhimata iti kecit, tanna
athavā dhvanayatīti dhvaniḥ śabdātmako yatrāsti padasamudāyastadgāmbhīryam
tathā hi puṇḍarīkapadaprastāvātsitacchatre niyatābhidhānaśaktikaṃ kāṃsyatālānusvānasthānīyāṃ sitāmbhojavyaktimupajanayaccopalabhyate

tadapītyapiśabdena virodhadyotinā haribhāvamācaranniti pratīyate puṇḍarīkadhāraṇāderubhayatulyatvānmaulāvityādiviruddham, atastadviparītasthānīyaṃ viṣṇau dhvanayatprasiddhibalānnābhyādikameva dhvanayati
anyathā tu prakṛtāsaṃgatiśaṅkayā na vācyārthapuṣṭiḥ syāt
so'yaṃ virodharūpamūlaḥ pratīyamānavyatireko vākyārthaḥ śabdadhvaniścātra jīvabhūtaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi ‘panthia na ettha sattharamatthi maṇaṃ pattharatthale gāme
unnaapaoharaṃ pekkhia uṇa jai vasasi tā vasasu
’ ityādau vastuvarṇanaṃ? na hyatra śleṣanyāyo na vā samāsoktinyāyaḥ saṃbhavati
ye tu vadanti śabdasyābhidhāvyatiriktā vṛttireva nāstīti, lakṣaṇāpi tairanaṅgīkaraṇīyā syāt
prakṛtyanugatasvārthābhidhānaṃ hi vibhaktīnāṃ vyutpannamiti ghoṣapratiyogikādhikaraṇabhāvayogyaḥ kaścidartho gaṅgāpadasya vaktavyaḥ
evaṃ puṇyatvādi- pratītistata eva bhavantī dhvananamupasthāpayatītyādikamasmābhiḥ kāvyaprakāśavivaraṇe prapañcitam
‘janaḥ puṇyairyāyājjaladhijalabhāvaṃ jalamuca- stathāvasthaṃ cainaṃ nidadhatu śubhaiḥ śuktivadanaiḥ
tatastāṃ śreyobhiḥ pariṇatimasau vindatu yathā ruciṃ tanvanpīnastani hṛdi tavāyaṃ viluṭhati || 91 ||’
atra kathamahaṃ tvatkucataṭe viluṭhāmītyabhiprāyasya vistareṇa prakāśitatvādayaṃ vistaraḥ
yatra stoke'pi vācye vacanapallavaścamatkārakārī tatra sa eva guṇakakṣādhirohaṇakṣama iti śabdaguṇeṣu yukto vivektumata evoktiṃ viśeṣyatayā nirdiśati
janaḥ puṇyairityādau kathamahamityādau nirdiṣṭo'pi vakrābhiprāyarūpo'rtha uktipallavena prakarṣamānīyate
tathā hi jana iti taṭasthoktyā na mamedṛśāni bhāgagheyāni yenāhatya mano nirvahati
yāyāditi saṃbhāvanābhiprāyeṇa liṅā muktāphalapariṇatiyogyajaladhijalaprāptisaṃbhāvanāpi kasyacideva dhanyajanmana iti prakāśite ko'pi kāraṇaprakarṣaḥ
jalamuca ityanena yeṣāṃ na jaladānameva vyāpāraḥ, api tu viśvasaṃtāpacchidurāṇāmanyopakārapravaṇatayā śuktimukhaparyantamapi nayanamupapadyata iti

tathāvasthamityanena yadaiva smarāvasthā tadaiva jaladharaiḥ pānamāśaṃsāmātragocaro na tu pūrvavatsaṃbhāvanāmātragocaraḥ, ata eva śubhairiti samayavilambanasya prāktanapuṇyamānahetukatvādityādi svayamavaseyam
tvatkucataṭe luṇṭhanamatyalpapuṇyasya na saṃpadyata ityetāvānevārtho vivakṣāviṣaya iti kāryavikāsasyaiva camatkārārpaṇe prāgalbhyamiti śabdapradhānakatayā yuktamatra parisaṃkhyānamiti
asti kaścidviśeṣo yatra vākyasaṃkocaḥ prakṛtaucitīvaśena camatkārakāraṇam

tathā hi—sa mārutītyādau mārutinā yadoṣadherānayanam, yacca tayā vyathāharaṇam, tadubhayamapītihāsakathāvistareṇa pratipāditamiha tu ślokārdhamātreṇeti śabdadattabhara evāyaṃ guṇo yadyapi bhavati, tathāpi yāvadvivakṣitopādānakāvyarūpeṇārthasaṃkoco vaktavyaḥ
sa ca tathāvidhavakroktisaṃkroca eva bhavatītyuktāveva saṃkoca ullikhati
ata evopakṣiptamapītihāsārthamapahāya tvarāviṣṭena kavinā prakṛtamuttarārdha evāsaṃhitaṃ pūrvottarārdhasāmañjasyāya saṃkṣipyaiva prakṛtamapyuktam
vāci vastuni cāpyanye nānye vāci na vastuni || 93 ||’
yāvanti varṇāni vinā prakṛtamanusartumeva na śakyante tāvanmātramayatvaṃ vākyasya saṃmitatvam
yathā pūrvamudāhṛtam—‘kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā’ ityādi
anena nāmapadayoḥ pallavarūpatvātsaṃmitatvābhāve kathamābhāsatvaṃ bhavatīti visbhṛtavyamicāriguṇaprakaraṇasya bhāṣitamupekṣaṇīyam
keciditi sarvanāmna evābhimatakaviviśeṣe parya-vasānaṃ sāmarthyena saṃbhavatīti nādhyāhāraśaṅkā
‘ehyehi vatsa raghunandana pūrṇacandra cumbāmi mūrdhani ciraṃ ca pariṣvaje tvām
āropya vā hṛdi divāniśamudvahāmi vande'thavā caraṇapuṣkarakadvayaṃ te || 94 ||’
tathā hyucyate—anena gandhena rasena vā sarvaṃ bhāvitamiti
harṣādibhāvitacetaso hi vīciprāyā uktibhedāḥ prādurbhavanti yairapratyūhameva bhāvo'bhivyajyate tadidamuktaṃ yā bhāvato vācaḥ kāvyarūpāyāḥ pravṛttirniṣpattiḥ saiva bhāvikam

tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe ehītyekenaiva yuṣmadarthāvinābhāvinābhimukhīkaraṇe vṛtte dvitīyasya yadupādānam, pūrṇacandreti yadagrimakriyāsvanupayuktasyaivābhidhānam, cumbāmīti kariṣyamāṇasyāpi yo vartamānopadeśaḥ, cumbāmītyatra viśeṣaṇamanupādāya pariṣvaja ityatra ciramiti yadviśeṣaṇopādānam, tvamiti yogyārthasyāpi prayogaḥ pūrvopāttavaduttarakriyāspardhitayā yadekasyaiva vahanasya bhāṣaṇameva samastasamakakṣatayaiva yadvahanābhidhānam, vatsetyabhidhāya caraṇau banda iti yā virūddhoktiḥ, yacca te ityasyāvagatārthasyāpi vacanam, tatsarvamadharmasiddhameveti bhāvārthasya niṣpāditayā svādaheturbhavati
pravartante hi laukikānāṃ snehārthānāmutkalikāprāyā vācaḥ svadante ca
yathā—‘iyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriyamamṛtavartirnayanayorasāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahalaścandanarasaḥ’ iti
‘varāhaḥ kalyāṇaṃ vitaratu sa vo yasya śaśabhṛ- tkalākoṭīkāntaṃ kramavigaladabhyudbhṛtibhiyā
yatīnāmārohāvarohau vivakṣitau kvacitkaviśaktivaśādyadyavdyārūḍhā avarūḍhā iva prakāśante
kramāduccairuccairgiriśikharabhājāmapi nṛṇāmayaṃ dūre dūre bhavati bhagavānambaramaṇiḥ
tathā hi prakṛtodāharaṇe varāhaḥ kalyāṇamityatrākāradvayaṃ tulyajātīyaṃ nirdiśya sa vo ityatrokāreṇa tuṅgatvamiva vidhāya dvitīyapādopakrame kalākoṭīkāntamityatrābhinnajātīyārohaparamparā vihitā
śete ityatrāpi na sollekha ārohaḥ so'yamānubhaviko guṇaḥ ślokārdhaślokapādaślokāṃśakrameṇa narasiṃhavadbhavati
kramairitastataścaraṇavinyāsairvigalantī asaṃpadyamānā yābhyuddhṛtirabhyuddharaṇaṃ tasyā yā bhīrbhayaṃ tayeti kecit
anye tu vadanti—krameṇa vigaladabhyuddhṛtibhayamūrdhvanayane sphuṭanādibhayaṃ yasyāḥ sā kramavigaladabhyuddhṛtibhiyeti
‘grāvṇā nāsi gireḥ kṣatā na payasā nārtāsi na mlāyitā na śvāsaiḥ phaṇino'si na tvadanugā nāyāsitā kvāpi na
svaṃ veśma pratigacchatoriti muhuḥ śrīśārṅgiṇoḥ saspṛhaṃ sā praśnottarayugmapaṅktirubhayoratyāyatā pātu vaḥ || 96 ||’
yādṛśī padasaṃniveśatvenopakramyate tādṛśyā vṛttanirvāhaḥ kvacidviśeṣaśobhāvaho bhavati

ekādaśavṛtterapyabhiprāyasamagrakāvyajīvabhūtatvādetasyā eva nātiprasaṅgo'pi tathā prakṛtodāharaṇe prathamotthitāyā abdhiduhituravyājasarvāṅgīṇalāvaṇyamavalokayitā kṛṣṇaḥ svacakṣuṣoḥ kṛtārthatāṃ gamitavān
idānīmadharoṣṭhamudrābhedena yadi varṇamātrāmapi bhāratīṃ niścarantīmākarṇayāmi tadā śrotrayoḥ saphalatā bhavediti manyate
na cetthameva mugdhāṅganānāmālāpaḥ pravartate api tu nāyakasannidhau bhayādeveti prathamaṃ pṛcchati—grāvṇā nāsi gireḥ kṣateti
anantaraṃ ca yadi na vakṣyāmi tadā dhṛṣṭāmākalayiṣyatīti jānatyā dvayamuttaramaucityāpannaṃ syāt śiraḥkampa ekākṣaraṃ ca
tadanantaraṃ vyājarasāyāḥ kiyadadhikavacanaśravaṇotkaṇṭhitaḥ sarvaṃ lokaprasiddhaṃ bhayahetuṃ smārayanpṛcchati—mlāyiteti
abhimatasyāniṣṭaṃ svapne'pi na sajjata iti dṛṣṭāsīti noktam
evaṃ prasiddhamapi vacanapallavanena samastamugdhāṅganāprasiddhena vacanonmudraṇaprakāreṇa pṛcchati—tvadanugeti
sarvākāreṇottamatāmabhijñāyamāno dṛptaḥ svaveśma pratyeva gatavān na tu pṛṣṭavāniti
viśiṣṭā bhaṇitiryā syāduktiṃ tāṃ kavayo viduḥ || 76
punarapi tadeva kathayasi mṛtāṃ nu kathayāmi yā śvasiti || 97 ||’
atra kuśalaṃ tasyā iti pṛṣṭe kuśalamakuśalaṃ veti vaktavye yo'yaṃ jīvatītyādyuktibhaṅgyā jīvitamātraśeṣatāpratipādanaprakāraḥ sa kāvye śabdaguṇeṣūktisaṃjñāṃ labhate
yathā supto'sīti praśne gṛhe devakule vetyādi
etatprasiddhivyatikrameṇa tu yā kācitkavipratibhayā bhaṇitirākṛṣyate sā bhavati lokottarā
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe kuśalapraśne kuśalaṃ veti lokaprasiddhamatastadeva vaktumarhati
yattu tadapahāya jīvatītyupāttamaparatrāpi praśne tathaivoktaṃ tatpratibhākṛṣṭatayā sāmiprāyamunnīyata ityāha—atra kuśalamakuśalamityādi
‘abhyuddhṛtā vasumatī dalitaṃ ripūraḥ kṣiptakramaṃ kavalitā balirājalakṣmīḥ
atraikajanmani kṛtaṃ yadanena yūnā janmatraye tadakarotpuruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || 98 ||’

atra prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorebhyo nāgaropanāgaragrāmyebhyo vā padebhyo'bhyuddhṛtādīnāṃ grāmyādīnāmubhayeṣāṃ vā padānāmāvāpodvāpābhyāṃ sanniveśacārutvena yo'yamābhyāsiko nālikerapāko mṛdvīkāpāka ityādirvākyaparipākaḥ sā prauḍhirityucyate
tadyathā—nālikeraphalaṃ pakvaṃ tvaci kaṭhinaṃ śirāsvavivṛtakomalaprāyaṃ kapālikāyāṃ kaṭhinataraṃ tathā kaścitsaṃdarbho mukhe kaṭhinastadanantaraṃ mṛduprāyastataḥ kaṭhinataro nālikerapāka ityucyate
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe prathamapāde'bhyuddhṛteti varṇacatuṣṭayamāramme kaṭhinaṃ ‘vasumatī dali’ iti varṇaṣaṭkaṃ komalaṃ ‘taṃ ripūraḥ’ ityanusvārarephadīrghairakṣaracatuṣṭayaṃ kaṭhinataram
kāvyaṃ kartuṃ vicārayituṃ ca ye jānanti tadupadeśena karaṇe yojane ca paunaḥpunyena pravṛttirabhyāsaḥ
so'yaṃ racanāsiddhiviśeṣaḥ kathamanyathā tajjātīyameva padamanyatra saṃdarbhe niveśitaṃ na tathā svadate
suptiṅvyutpattilakṣaṇastu vārtākapākaḥ kaiściduktaḥ, sa tu suśabdatālakṣaṇaguṇa eva
yathā drākṣāphalaṃ tvaca ārabhya komalamantarā dvitricaturāsthisaṃpāditaṃ kiṃcitkāṭhinyamevaṃ kaścitsaṃdarbhamupakramopasaṃhārayoḥ komala eva madhye kaṭhina eva
yadvacca pariṇataṃ sahakāraphalamāramabhādeva komalamasthani tu kaṭhoraprāyamevamaparaḥ saṃdarbho mukhādāramya mṛdurantare kaṭhinataraḥ sahakārapāka ityucyate
yathā—‘kamalini kuśalaṃ te suprabhātaṃ rathāṅgāḥ kumudini punarindāvudgate tvaṃ ramethāḥ
sakhi rajani gatāsi tvaṃ tamo jīrṇamuccairiti taralitapakṣāḥ pakṣiṇo vyāharanti
teṣāṃ śleṣa iti proktaḥ saṃvidhāne susūtratā || 78
‘dṛṣṭvaikāsanasaṃsthite priyatame paścādupetyādarā- dekasyā nayane nimīlya vihitakrīḍānubandhacchalaḥ
īṣadvakritakandharaḥ sapulakaḥ premollasanmānasā- mantarhāsalasatkapolaphalakāṃ dhūrto'parāṃ cumbati || 99 ||’
ghaṭanāśleṣaḥ’ iti sūtrayitvā ‘kramakauṭilyānulbaṇatvopapattiyogo ghaṭanā’ iti vāmanena vyākhyātam
asyārthaḥ—idaṃ kṛtvā idaṃ kartavyamiti kramastatraiva kauṭilyaṃ lokātigāminī vakratā

tathā ca kameṇa kauṭilyenānulbaṇatayā upapattyā yojanamarthasya śleṣa iti tatra saṃvidhānakramānulbaṇatvena sūtraśabdenopatte svapadena kauṭilyamuktamaghaṭamānasyeva vākyārthasya buddhicāturyeṇa ghaṭaneti vākyārthaḥ
aparā nāyikā ca tatsakhī pracchannanāyakapremapātraṃ tenaikāsanasaṃgatiḥ
priyatame iti tadanurañjanameva jīvitasarvasvamiti manyamānasya yugapatpravṛttiḥ
ādareṇa nimṛtapadanyāsatā tathā bhūtvā yugapatkarābhyāṃ nayanadvayapidhānaṃ lokaprasiddhā keliḥ
īṣaditi kandharāmātraṃ yathā calate na tu śarīramapi
ata eva premṇā svagocaralokottaratvābhimānarūpeṇa tattadanekabhāvormibhirāndolanaṃ manasa ullāsaḥ
atra padminīvikāsakaraṇe udayaśailāvataraṇe kokaśokaharaṇe tamovidāraṇe cānukto'pi sūryalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prakaṭamupalakṣyate
samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasaṃsargātmani vākyārthe darpaṇatala ivānupāttasyāpi vivakṣitasya vastunaḥ pratibhāso'rthaprasādaḥ
‘agre strīnakhapāṭalaṃ kurabakaṃ śyāmaṃ dvayorbhāgayo- rbālāśokamupoḍharāgasubhagaṃ bhedonmukhaṃ tiṣṭhati
īṣadbaddharajaḥkaṇāgrakapiśā cūte navā mañjarī mugdhatvasya ca yauvanasya ca sakhe madhye madhuśrīḥ sthitā || 101 ||’
yena rūpeṇa loke'rthaḥ pratītastadanatikrameṇa tasyoktiḥ samatā
anyathā muktvā vrajatītyataḥ ko viśeṣaḥ syāt
mugdha iti koṣātprathamamudbhidyamānā kurabakakalikā kāntānakhavatpāṭalā bhavatīti madhuśriyo bālyam
tataḥ prauḍhimāpadyamānāsu kalikāsu śyāmo vantabhāgaḥ sphuṭitatvāddvidhāvatiṣṭhata iti yauvanam
‘bhrūbhede sahasodgate'pi vadanaṃ nītaṃ parāṃ namratā- mīṣanmāṃ prati bhedakāri hasitaṃ noktaṃ vaco niṣṭhuram
antarbāṣpajaḍīkṛtaṃ prabhutayā cakṣurna visphāritaṃ kopaśca prakaṭīkṛto dayitayā muktaśca no praśrayaḥ || 102 ||’
atra vāsavadattālakṣaṇasyārthasya kope'pi yo'yaṃ vinayāvambanena kopacihnanihnavastanmādhuryam
śṛṅgārakaruṇau hi madhurau tatastavdyañjako'rtho'pi madhurastasya śarkarādirasasodaraṃ mādhuryam

yathā hi—śarkarārasaḥ sahṛdayasyāsahṛdayasya vā, susthasyāsusthasya vā, jhaṭiti rasanāgramarpitaścamatkāramāvahati, tathā cittadrutisāracarvaṇaikaprāṇarasavyañjako'rthastena tavdyañjanaśaktisamudraikanirvahaṇaṃ vākyārthasya mādhuryamiti paryavasito'rthaḥ
tatra vāsanāparipākavaśādudayavyayavatīṣu dīptacittavṛttiṣu jāgarūkāsvapi samastanyagbhāvanayā virodhaḥ saṃpadyata iti krodhādāvapyatīvratā ityuktam
tathā hi—bhrūmede ityādau gātraskhalitādinā kadācidaparāddhe nāyake premasvabhāvādīrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇavyabhicāriprādurbhāvāttadanubhāvabhrūbhedodgamo ratiprakarṣādbhaviṣṇunāvahitthena nyagbhāvyate
evaṃ ‘īṣanmāṃ prati bhedakāri hasitam’ ityādau mādhuryamunneyam
‘sadyaḥ purīparisare'pi śirīṣamṛdvī sītā javātricaturāpi padāni gatvā
atra sītāyāḥ purīparisare'pi kiyadasti gantavyamiti vacanaṃ śṛṇvato rāmasya śirīṣamṛdutadaṅgāvalokanenāśruṇo'vatāraḥ saukumāryamāha
sahagantumutsukā kathamevaṃ sukumāraprakṛtiḥ kāntāreṣu bhaviṣyasīti vāryamāṇāpi hṛdayavaimukhyena pabhdyāmatitvaritaṃ gamiṣyāmīti snehamūḍhā tricaturāṇi padāni javādgatavatī
svarūpaṃ svamasādhāraṇaṃ kavipratibhaikagocaraṃ camatkārirūpaṃ tasya sākṣātkathanam
īṣadvikasvarasya kumudasya kiṃcidvighaṭamānavahiḥ palāśasaṃbandhiṣu śītātapāsaṃparkādatyantaviśadānāṃ dalānāṃ pṛṣṭhāni pākalohitarekhāṅkitāni dṛśyante
ata evāmodate kiṃcidudbhidureṇa mukhena garbhapiṇḍitamāmodaṃ muñcatīti
‘mā garvamudvaha kapolatale cakāsti kāntasvahastalikhitā mama mañjarīti
anyāpi kiṃ na sakhi bhājanamīdṛśīnāṃ vairī na cedbhavati vepathurantarāyaḥ || 105 ||’
atra nāyikāyā sapatnyāmīrṣyānubandhena pratipāditasya priyatamānurāgalakṣaṇasya śṛṅgārasya dīptarasatvaṃ kāntiḥ
raso'bhimānātmā śṛṅgārastasya dīptatvaṃ vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāribhiḥ samyak saṃcalitena sthāyinā nirantaramupacīyamānasya paramakoṭigamanam
tathā hi—mā garvamityādau yatra bhaṅgeṣu bahutarasūkṣmabhaṅgaviśeṣamayamañjarīlikhitena bahirviṣayātirodhānalakṣaṇatādavasthyāt prakāśanena nāyakasya sapatnyāmanurāge vicchāyabhāvoktiḥ
svātmani tu sahasāvirbhavatsāttvikapratipādanena jīvitasarvasvābhimānātmakratisthāyibhāvaprakāśane tasyā: sāpekṣabhāve nāyikāyā api tadavasthaiva sā pratīyate
‘prāṇānāmanilena vṛttirucitā satkalpavṛkṣe vane toye kāñcanapadmareṇukapiśe puṇyābhiṣekakriyā
dhyānaṃ ratnaśilāgṛheṣu vibudhasrīsaṃnidhau saṃyamo yadvāñchanti tapobhiranyamunayastasmiṃstapasyantyamī || 106 ||’
bhūtiḥ saṃpattasyā utkarṣo lokātigaprakarṣastasyaiva sahṛdayacamatkārārpakatatyā guṇadhurādhirohaṇakṣamatvāt
vanasya kalpatarusaṃbandhaḥ saṃpat, tatraiva satpadena muktāstabakamāṇikyamañjarīcīnāṃśukakisalayādiviśeṣadyotinā prakarṣaḥ
vrīḍāsmitaṃ tasya tadā tadāsīccamatkṛto yena sa eva devaḥ || 107 ||’
viśvanātha iti yadājñāvaśaṃvadā trilokī so'pi yatprārthayata iti, valaye'pītyapiśabdena yasyaikadeśaḥ kurupāṇḍavanidhananidānatayā vikhyātastasyāpi deye lajjata iti
devāsurakinnarādirayaṃ jaṅgamasthāvaraprapañco yaducchvāsavilasitaṃ so'pi camatkṛta iti padārthānabhihitaḥ prakarṣo'bhidheyaḥ
‘tānyeva yadi bhūtāni tā eva yadi śaktayaḥ
arjunabhujasahasracchedādinā yasya paraśu(rāma)rvaradānena tribhuvane'pi prasiddha ityādi
ūrjitaśabdo'haṃkṛte prasiddhastātkālikanimittopanipāte vāsanāvikāsāttamonirbhedasthāneṣu suptaprabuddha iva sthāyibhirasaṃsṛjyamānaḥ prathamaprādurbhūto'bhimāno'haṃkāra ityucyate
rūḍhaḥ sūkṣmāvasthāto dvitīyāmāvirbhāvadaśāmāpanno'haṃkāro yasya sa rūḍhāhaṃkārastasya bhāvastattā
‘rasavadamṛtaṃ kaḥ saṃdeho madhūnyapi nānyathā madhuramadhikaṃ cūtasyāpi prasannarasaṃ phalam
sakṛdapi punarmadhyasthaḥ sanrasāntaravijjano vadatu yadihānyatsvādu syātpriyādaśanacchadāt || 110 ||’
iha tu vākyārthasya vaktṛprītigocaratvamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ
amṛtamiti yasya prasādāttridaśairamaratvamāsāditaṃ nānyatheti pratyakṣasākṣike vastuni pramāṇāntarānusaraṇam
‘devavrate vāñchati dīrghanidrāṃ droṇe ca karṇe ca yaśo'vaśeṣe
atra mumūrṣāmaraṇādīnāṃ dāruṇārthānāṃ dīrghanidrāṃ vāñchati yaśo'vaśeṣa ityādibhiḥ suśabdaiḥ paryāyeṇa bhaṇanaṃ suśabdatā
‘darbhāṅkureṇa caraṇaḥ kṣata ityakāṇḍe tanvī sthitā katicideva padāni gatvā
āsīdvivṛttavadanā ca vimocayantī śākhāsu valkalamasaktamapi drumāṇām || 112 ||’
atra gamane sati priyajanāvalokanābhilāṣiṇyāḥ śakuntalāyā darbhāṅkuracaraṇakṣativalkalavyāsaṅgādivyājāvalambanaṃ samādhiḥ
cittavṛttiṣu balādāvirbhavantīṣu prakṛtarasaucityavirodhiprakarṣātprakaṭamanāvaraṇīyāsu ca yadanyathā samarthanaṃ tavdyājāvalambanaṃ prastutocitasamādhānātmakatvāt
anantaraṃ tūtkaṇṭhātaralitāyāḥ kathamālokamātreṇāpi kṛtārthaḥ syāditi parāvartanam
līlāgṛhe pratikalaṃ kilakiñciteṣu vyāvartamānavinayaṃ mithunaṃ cakāsti || 113 ||’
khyātiṃ ca sattvapuruṣānyatayādhigamya vāñchanti tāmapi samādhibhṛto nirodhdum || 114 ||’
cittavṛttinirodho yogaḥ; sa eva vyutthānahetubhiranāskandanīyaḥ sabījaḥ
vākyārthasyaiva yathoktarūpatve tatpratipādakapadānāmavaśyaṃ tathābhāvo bhavatīti vaiśeṣikādbhedo vakṣyate
‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite devākarṇaya yena yena sahasā yadyatsamāsāditam
kodaṇḍena śarāḥ śarairariśirastenāpi bhūmaṇḍalaṃ tena tvaṃ bhavatā ca kīrttiranaghā kīrtyā ca saptābdhayaḥ || 115 ||’

saṃgrāmāṅgaṇetyādau tu śatruśiraśchedātsaptābdhivyāpinī tvayā kīrtirārjitetyetāvānvākyārtho laukikasādhāraṇatayā ca camatkārāspadamiti saṃgrāmāṅgaṇasaṃgatireva na tathā yathā vīramātrasyocitā tatrāpi cāpasamāropaṇamiti kāpyutsāhaśaktiḥ
ata eva balavadāśrayaprasaktaluṇṭākavadhena yadavasitaṃ tenaiva tadāsāditamiti sopaskārakartṛkarmaprapañcena vikāsanameva kāvyapadavīprāptibījam
atra śāstre vistarapratipāditasya dharmasya ślokārdhenoktatvādayamarthasaṃkocaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ
tasyetyarthasya samāse guṇībhūtasyāpi budhdyā vibhajya parāmarśaḥ
atra tena tena viśeṣeṇa vistarataḥ pratipādayitavyasya dharmasya yatkiṃcidātmanaḥ pratikūlamanyasya nācaraṇīyamiti sāmānyenābhidhānamapravṛttapravartane pragalbhāyamānamatisundaramābhāsate
śabdārthau yatra tulyau staḥ saṃmitatvaṃ taducyate
‘indurmūrdhni śivasya śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅkaḥ stane deyādvo'bhyudayaṃ dvayaṃ tadupamāmālambamānaṃ mithaḥ
saṃvādaḥ praṇavena yasya dalatā kāyaikatāyāṃ tayo- rūrdhvadvāravicintitena ca hṛdi dhyātaḥ svarūpeṇa ca || 117 ||’
atra praṇavalakṣaṇasyārthasya tulyatvena yathāvadvibhajya viniveśanaṃ saṃmitatvam
śabdasyārthau tayorvibhajya viniveśanaṃ saṃmitatvamiti kecit, tanna
arthamuddiśya śabdatulanaṃ kāvyabhāvabījaṃ śabdaguṇaḥ, śabdamuddiśya tvarthatulanamarthaguṇaśca

tathāhi—parameśvarasya mūrdhni bālenduḥ, pārvatīstane nakhāṅka iti pṛthakśabdenoddiśya tadupamāyogyatayā kāyaikatāyāṃ dalanaṃ hṛtpadmanavamadvārayordhyānena yugapatsaṃnidhānamiti samyagvibhajya tulitasyeva praṇavasya pratinirdeśa iti
‘dṛṣṭiṃ he prativeśini kṣaṇamihāpyasmadgṛhe dāsyasi prāyeṇāsya śiśoḥ pitā na virasāḥ kaupīrapaḥ pāsyati
ekākinyapi yāmi tadvaramitaḥ srotastamālākulaṃ nīrandhrāstanumālikhantu jaraṭhacchedā nalagranthayaḥ || 118 ||’
atra tamālamālāvalayitasarittīrakṛtasaṃketāyāḥ kulaṭāyāḥ svatanau bhāvināṃ parapuruṣanakhakṣatānāṃ nalagranthyālekhavyājagopanena sābhiprāyabhaṇanaṃ bhāvikam
śabdaguṇe padānāṃ bhāvyarthaniṣpāditā iha tvarthasyeti viśeṣaḥ

tathā hi—dṛṣṭimityādau tanumālikhantu jaraṭhacchedā nalagranthaya ityuktyā vinyasyamāna eva bhāvinalagranthyālekhyarūpārthaḥ kulaṭāsvarūpānusaṃdhānadattāntaḥ karaṇasya pratipatturanantarameva svaiṃravihāracihnagopanamabhivyanakti
‘śubhe ko'yaṃ vṛddho gṛhaparivṛḍhaḥ kiṃ tava pitā na me bhartā rātrau vyapagatadṛganyacca badhiraḥ
hu huṃ huṃ śrānto'haṃ śiśayiṣurihaivāpavarake kva yāminyāṃ yāsi svapihi nanu nirdaṃśamaśake || 119 ||’
tena yatra sahṛdayahṛdayaṃgamādarthātkāṃsyatālānusvānusvānanyāyena tādṛśamarthāntaramavagamyate sā gatiriti lakṣaṇārthaḥ
sarvākāramanavadyāyāstāvaddāsyamapi nāyamarhatīti hṛdayānukūlamarthaṃ praśnādavagatya gṛhaparivṛḍha ityuttaram
asmādapi mama nāyaṃ ko'pi kiṃ tu gṛhasvāmīti hṛdayasaṃvādinamarthamavadhārya kiṃ kava pitetyādikamapraśnottaraśṛṅkhalā gaveṣaṇīyā
‘tvamevaṃsaundaryā sa ca ruciratāyāḥ paricitaḥ kalānāṃ sīmānaṃ paramiha yuvāmeva bhajathaḥ
api dvandvaṃ diṣṭyā taditi subhage saṃvadati vā- mataḥ śeṣaṃ cetsyājjitamiha tadānīṃ guṇitayā || 121 ||’
nāyakasya nāyikayā tasyāśca nāyakeneti parasparotkaṇṭhāprakarṣo vivakṣitaḥ
‘tvadvaktrenduvilokanākuladhiyā dhātrā tvadīyāṃ śriyaṃ nikṣipya pratirājakeṣu viduṣāṃ lakṣmyā tvamāpūritaḥ
tenaite niyataṃ daridrati gṛheṣveṣāmiyaṃ dṛśyate naināmādriyase tvamicchasi nu tāṃ tvāmeva sā dhāvati || 122 ||’
atra tvadvaktravilokanākulena dhātrā tvadīyā lakṣmīḥ śatruṣu nikṣipya viduṣāṃ ca lakṣmīstvayyāropitā
yā ca viduṣāṃ lakṣmīstayā tvamāpūritastena te daridrāḥ
iyaṃ ca vidvadgeheṣveva dṛśyate ityetāvataḥ prabhūtasyārthasyānekavākyena pratipāditatvādvivakṣitārthanirvahaṇaṃ prauḍhiḥ
kaverabhimatasya bhūyaso'pyarthasya svalpenaiva vākyena pratipādanaṃ prauḍhiḥ

tathā hi—tvāṃ nirmāya jagadvilakṣaṇavastunirvahaṇacamatkṛtasya dhātustvadvaktrenduvilokanaṃ tadāsaṅgena tvadarthanirbhitāyāḥ śriyaḥ pratirājakeṣu bhramaṇakrameṇa saṃcāraṇaṃ tatpūrvāparapratisaṃghāta (na)balādvidvabhdyo lakṣmīmākṛṣyetyādiko bhūyānarthaḥ stokena vākyenopanīta iti
te ca doṣā api santo guṇībhāvamāpannā ucyante
huṃ hu muñca mamameti ca mandaṃ jalpitaṃ jayati mānavatīnām || 123 ||’
padavākyavākyārthadoṣāṇāṃ guṇatvāpattaye nityaṃ ye bhavanti, te'nukaraṇādiṣu madhye doṣaguṇāḥ smṛtā iti saṃbandhaḥ
yadyapi cānukaraṇādikā eva na guṇāḥ, tathāpyanukriyamāṇādyabhedopacāreṇoktam
yeṣu padadoṣeṣu mliṣṭamlecchitaprabhṛtīnāṃ yāsādhutā nirūpitā, sā guṇatvamanukaraṇe prapadyata ityanvayaḥ
mamameti kiṃ muñca muñceti mliṣṭamuta mameti na niścīyate
yaccāśaktijamasādhurūpam, tasyānukaraṇe sādhutvamiṣyata ityuktam, anukriyamāṇaṃ tu svarūpapadānukaraṇatayā pūrvārthatyāgena sāghveva
patkāṣiṇo'pi no yānti ye vacanti prayuñjate || 124 ||’
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ surāṣṭre na mahārāṣṭre ca noṣṭriṇaḥ || 125 ||’
virodhinaḥ syuḥ śṛṅgāre tena varṇā rasacyutāḥ
ta eva viniveśyante bībhatsādau rase yadā
tadā taṃ dīpayantyeva tena varṇā rasacyutāḥ
tvāṣṭrā rākṣasāstvaṣṭurapatyaṃ vṛtrastasyāririndrastasya rāṣṭre svarge na santi
babhau mukhenāpratimena kācana śriyādhikānāṃ prati menakā ca na || 127 ||’
atra khaluśabdasya caśabdasya ca pādapūraṇamātre'pi prayojane yamakatvādguṇatvam

yoṣitāmityādābatitarāṃ nakhalūnaṃ yoṣitāṃ gātramujjvalatayā nonamityeva paryāpte dvitīyapāde tadubhayamapi yamakārambhakaṃ satprastutopayogitayā kavivyutpattipuraskāra pravṛttamapajahāti doṣabhāvamupādatte ca guṇatvamiti
atra khātaya ityādīnāṃ ghargharikādau dhṛṅaścānavasthāne na rūḍhiḥ
gūḍhārthe tu prahelikādau tanna duṣyatīti teṣāṃ doṣaguṇatvam
tathā ca—tadvidyasaṃbhāṣāyāṃ vidagdhairupanyāsaiḥ svārthāpratyāyakatvalakṣaṇabījābhāvānna doṣaḥ, guṇastu bhavati
tadayaṃ vākyārthaḥ—he kani kanye, tavāhlādakacaraṇabaddhā yathoktaviśeṣaṇā ghargharikāḥ sākṣādbhavanti śrotreṇa pratyakṣīkriyante
atra prastāve mama prāṇā uddīpanaprakarṣamasahiṣṇavo dhāriṇo'navasthitā iti
atra dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtimiti kalpopapadaṃ mahīruhamiti hiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipumityasya tucchārthatve'pi cchando'nurodhādguṇatvam
tathā hi—bhinnasargāntairityādinā sargāṇāmautsargikaikavṛttanirvāhaucitye sa yathoktasaṃkṣiptaśabdāpraveśātpararūpeṇa tadarthatvasya vivakṣitatvācca śabdavikāse na doṣaḥ, kiṃ tu guṇa eva
prakṛtodāharaṇe dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtimiti kalpopapadaṃ mahīruhamiti ca nidarśanaṃ manyante
tenāyamarthaḥ—pallavākhyaśabdaguṇe tāvattucchatā camatkārakāritayā guṇadhurādhirūḍhaivāvistaraviviktaviṣayatayā kva viśeṣaguṇasya bhavatīti jijñāsāyāṃ tu chando'nurodho vihitaḥ
asti kaścidevaṃ viṣayo yatrāsamarthasya cārutayā guṇabhāvaḥ
tathā hi—yadyapi gaṇapāṭhādavyaktaśabdaḥ kūjitam, tathāpi loke pakṣiviṣaya eva niyatam, tathā cābhimataviṣaye prayuktaṃ pakṣivirutākāramāvedayati
yadi tu kutaścidviśeṣājjhaṭityeva pratītiṃ janayettadā kathaṃ doṣaḥ
yathāvadviniyogaḥ kāryastasya prakārasākalyaṃ śarīram, śabdacchalātkāyaḥ, ātmā sārabhūtaḥ kṣetrajñaśca
rūpaṃ saṃjñā saṃskāro vedanā vijñānamiti pañca skandhāḥ
atrātmanā padaṃ śabdaguṇamiti pituḥ padaṃ madhyamamiti cākāśaviṣayā kāñcīguṇasthānaṃ nitambaviṣayamiti sarvaprasiddherjhaṭityeva pratītiṃ karotīti kliṣṭasyāsya guṇatvam
ihāpi tadeva dūṣaṇatābījaṃ jhaṭiti pratītijanane sati samādhīyate

tathā hi—prakṛtodāhaṟaṇe uttarārdhe harirityabhidhānādātmanaḥ padamiti hareḥ padamiti saṃpannam, asya ca sāmānyaśabdatvādākāśaviṣayā pratītiryadyapi jhaṭiti notpattumarhati, tathāpi śabdaguṇamiti viśeṣaṇena padārthāntarādyavacchidya vivakṣitābhimukhī pratītirupajanyate
yadyapi padamiti sāmānyaṃ tathāpyākāśasyaiva madhyamacaraṇavinyāsasthānatvena prasiddherna tathocitapratītivyavadhānam
caraṇādārabhya varṇanākrame nitamba eva kāñcīniveśanasyocitatvānna pratī-tivyavadhānam
avaśyaṃ na varṇanakrame'pi kāñcīguṇasthānamaninditāyā ityatra kāñcīguṇasthānaśabdasya nitambaviśeṣaparyavasānārthaṃ kavīnāmaucityaprasiddhiraṅgīkartavyeti
nanu cātmanaḥ padaṃ śabdaguṇatvamityatra prasādaḥ kasmānna bhavati
udāharaṇasyādūṣaṇatvātsāmānyaśabdasya viśeṣaparyavasānam, anyacca samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasaṃsargarūpe vākyārthe svacchasalila ivābhimataviśeṣapratibimbanamityupādhidvayasya saṃkarācca
maṇḍukkamakkaḍā vi hu honti harīsappasiṃhā vi || 133 ||’
maṇḍūkamarkaṭā api khalu bhavanti harisarpasiṃhā api ||]
bhavati cābhidhānakopa iva vyākhyāne jhaṭiti pratyayaḥ
asmādṛśā api mandapratibhānāḥ kavayaḥ kaviśabdavācyā harivṛddhaśālipramukhāśca lokottarapratibhāśālinastadavayavatāṃ vikhyāte cāvikhyāte ca śabdāḥ sādhāraṇā bhavanti
tato doṣatvābhāvaḥ prativastulakṣaṇālaṃkāraparyavasāyitayā ca prakṛtārthānuguṇatvena guṇatvalābhaḥ
atra mayūrabarhacandrakasaṃketena kalpitasya candranāmno neyārthatve'pi prahelikātvādguṇatvam
'jianāu’ iti pāṭhe jitanauka iti sa evārthaḥ
tataśca ‘prācyāḥ pratīcimardhacandro gataḥ’ iti prātaḥkālodbhedo vākyārthaḥ
‘aṇuṇenti ajiṇaṇāu’ iti pāṭhe subhagamāninaṃ kāntamanunayantyā mayā jñāta hati khaṇḍitakāminīkhedoktiḥ
na caitāsāṃ lakṣaṇānāmasti kiṃcitprayojanamiti neyārthatvaprasaktau prahelikābhāva eva samādhānahetuḥ
nanu cocchīrṣapādāntarapadayorastu, mayūrakalāpa ityādau tu katham
barhe bahūnāṃ bahule kathamekasya pratītirityabhidhāne'pi kadācitkliṣṭasya viśeṣaguṇaḥ syāt
nātra neyārthatā, kiṃ tu tena saṃketena kalpitasya candranāmna iti
atredaṃ vaktavyam—tasya nāmna ityanena candrakapadamupasthāpitam, na ca tena sahāsti candrapadasya sādṛśyamiti
atra tasminnapatye ityaniścitasyāpyapatyaviśeṣasya saṃdigdhatve'pi gauryāmiti prakaraṇena gamyate
meghacchavirityasya ca navaśyāmādipadānupādāne'pi śaurisaṃbaddhatvānnavameghacchavirmeghaśyāmacchaviriti vā viśeṣo niścīyata iti tasyāpi guṇatvam
mahībhṛta ityādāvapatyaśabdo yadyapi gaurīśabdo'pi taditaradattapada iti saṃśāyakajātīyo bhavati, tathāpi tacchabdopasthāpita eva vivakṣitaviśeṣe paryavasyannapajahāti doṣatvam
tacchabda eva kathaṃ tamarthamupanayatītyatra tu prakaraṇameva jāgradavasthamasti

meghacchavirityatra tu yadyapi meghapadaṃ śyāmāśyāmadattapadatayā saṃśāyakajātīyam, tathāpi prasiddhapadanīlavarṇārthagaurīpadasamabhivyāhārācchabdāntarasaṃnidhirapi viśeṣe niyamayati tadvā chavipadaṃ vā viśeṣe paryavasyati
evaṃ navameghacchaviriti cokte yathā niyamenārthapratītirapratyūhā bhavati tathā meghacchavirityukta iti
kathaṃ punaridaṃ kliṣṭasya vaiśeṣikaṃ na bhavati ko vākyabhūtena bhavati
kiṃ tu saṃśāyakatvamāpādayataḥ pratibhāso'pyuktayuktyā nivartata ityabhimatam
evaṃ vastu prakṛtamabhisaṃdhāya vākyaracane tadupamardakavastvantarapraveśo virodhaḥ
yatra dve api vastunī prakṛte vastvantarameva vā prakṛtaṃ tadyathoktarūpābhāve kathaṃ doṣaḥ
tathā hi—abhidhāyetyādau dūtavākye saṃdhivigrahayormitho virodhinorapi vivakṣitaṃ sa doṣaḥ
saruṣaḥ sakrodhasya tava mānanāṃ pūjāṃ śiśupāla icchati
abhimukhaṃ sotkaṇṭhaṃ mano yasya sa tatheti saṃdhipakṣe
vigrahapakṣe tvanuśayaḥ krodho bhavataḥ sakāśādabhi bhayaśūnyaṃ mano yasyeti nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ
saruṣo mānanā upayogastadiha nisṛṣṭārthasyobhayopanyāso yadrocate tadvidhīyatāmityabhisaṃdhāya racita iti guṇatvamityubhayavivakṣāpakṣe vyākhyānam
yadā tu śāsanaharo dūtastadodyateṣvapi śastreṣu yathoktavaktāro dūtā bhavantīti nyāyena vigraharthamevābhimataḥ vipakṣasyāpi prarocanā dūtakartavyeti mukhe saṃdhiḥ paryāyabhūto yukta eva
atrāsiśyāmamityākāśaṃ prati, sāgramityanena ca varṣasahasraṃ prati viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi dūrotpatanaciratapaścaraṇayorupayogavivakṣāyāṃ guṇatvam
tasya yadi viśeṣasvarūpābhidhāne paryavasānena prayogo na tarhi doṣaḥ
tathā hi—ākāśamityādau nātiśyāmatārūpaṃ viśeṣamākāśe kāṃcidapi viśeṣamātrāmunmudrayati, ākāśasya sarvadā tadrūpānapāyāt
ākāśasahasrayostu yadeva rūpabhāvedanīyamityatraitāvanmātrābhiprāyeṇa nāsti dūṣaṇam, tathāpi nāntarīyakayorabhidhāne kiṃ prayojanaṃ yenānayorguṇabhāvasaṃpattirityata āha—dūra iti
kṣaṇamātramapi na viratirāsīditi sāgrapadābhiprāyo'ta eva nātra paunaruktyam
saṃdarbhacchāyāvaiṣamyamatra kaṣṭatābījamiti pūrvamuktaṃ tatra yadi samānacchāyaśabdamadhyaniveśanena pratikṣipyate tadā kathaṃ doṣaḥ
‘tasmai himādreḥ prayatāṃ tanūjāṃ yatātmane yojayituṃ yatasva
atra kecidyathāsaṃkhyaṃ vyācakṣate—ghṛṇāvadādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ krameṇa saṃkhyānagopanalakṣaṇāni doṣatvābhāvabījānīti, tadasat
prāyeṇa lokānusāri kāvyadarśanaṃ bhavatyataḥ pratisvaṃ bhedatritayasaṃbandhādupapannaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ syādityabhidhāya pūrvakrameṇodāharati—atreti
yathā śivaliṅgasya saṃsthāna ityatra yadyapi mukhyavidhaiva śivaliṅgapadamślīla evārthe, tathāpyavigānenādiprayogayogitvānna vrīḍādānakṣamaṃ tathehāpi taddhīryeti
śivaliṅgetyatra bhagavatsaṃbandhaḥ prayojaka iti tu tulyamatrāpītyāha—taditi
atra hi jagadantaryāmiṇo bhagavatastadvirodhitayā prasiddhirupajīvyā tadupajīvane vrīḍādāyinī pratītiranutthāyinyeva
sa te'nuneyaḥ subhago'bhimānī bhaginyayaṃ naḥ prathamābhisaṃdhiḥ || 142 ||’
yasya padasya vyutpattilabhyamarthāntaraṃ grāmyam, yasya vā samabhivyāhāralabhyam, tatra gopanaṃ samādhānabījam
tadubhayaṃ bhavati rūḍhervā balavattvaṃ jaladharādiṣviva tathā tātparyonnayanapratibandhena viparītārthatātparyonnayanaparyavasānaṃ vā
yathodāhariṣyamāṇe tathā ca pratīterapratyūhe dūṣaṇatābījābhāvastatra prathamakakṣāpakṣīkaraṇenādyamudāharati
rūḍhyupasthāpitaḥ prāthamiko'rthastasya bhāvo jhaṭiti vākyārthajñānaṃ tasya bhāvanā vāsanā tayā gopanaṃ camatkārārpaṇamatirodhānam
tatra kutraciduktivaicitryādekadeśo jhaṭiti smārakaḥ, kvacittathaiva samudāyaśaktyā viparītārthopasthāpanājjhaṭiti svārthaṃ samudāya eva pratipādayati
tadevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yatrādye grāmyatvaṃ tato'nyatraiva bahudhā lakṣaṇāttadidamuktam—anyatra lakṣitatvāditi
‘bhadre māri praśastaṃ vada sadasi mudā nṛtya kṛtye muhūrtaṃ mṛtyo ratnaiścatuṣkaṃ viracaya racayārātrikaṃ kālarātri
cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālāmupanaya vinayasvāyatāṃ bhairavīrṣyā- mevaṃ deve bhavānīṃ vadati parijanavyāhṛtistrāyatāṃ vaḥ || 144 ||’
atra mārīkṛtyādīnāmaśastārthānāmapi padānāṃ samastamaṅgalāyatanasya bhagavato viśveśvarasya saṃbandhenoktatvādguṇatvam
parameśvarasya maṅgalāyatanatvaṃ tatsaṃbandhimātrasyaiva maṅgalībhavananiyamena śāstretihāsādau prasiddhatvāt
taduktam—‘tathāpi smartṝṇāṃ varada paramaṃ maṅgalamasi’ iti
atra dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kālavaśānmedinīpṛṣṭhe nipatantītyasyāmaṅgalārthāntaratve'pi ‘haṃsānahaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāniti vyapadiśāmi’ iti vakṣyamāṇavākyaguptatvādguṇatvam
raṅgamaṅgalāntaḥ svastyayanapravṛttasya sūtradhārasya maṅgalārthādhikāravastuprastāvanaṃ tāvadbuddhipūrvakamatra na saṃbhavati haṃsānahamityādinā tātparyasya niyamitatvāt
svaśaktyā tu padārthāntaramā- bhāsayanti padāni doṣatayā na pratibhāsate
atra rāgātiśayahetubhūtayoḥ kāminīkapolacandramasoḥ svarūpabhāvanāmāhātmyenārthāntarabhāvanā gupteti gaṇḍanisyandabindurityasya ghṛṇāvadarthāntarasyāpi na doṣatvam
