guṇavṛttivyāpārāśrayeṣvavāntarādipadeṣu prathamata evānyakriyādidharmāṇāmanyatrārope samādhiprādurbhāvā-danutthānaṃ doṣābhāvatvadvāraṃ, tataśca mukhya eva sthāne jugupsādāyitvaṃ pūrvācāryaślokenaiva vyācaṣṭe—atretyādi
tathā ca jagannayanānandabhūtasya niḥśeṣitāśeṣatamasaścandramaso yadidamabhipretakāminīkapolalāvaṇyabindumātratayā bhānaṃ taducitameveti
tena yatra doṣatā nāsti tatra viṣaye rasaprakāśasāmagryābhantarbhāvātkathaṃ na guṇatvam
‘antraiḥ kalpitamaṅgalapratisarāḥ strīhastaraktotpala- vyaktottaṃsabhṛtaḥ pinahya sahasā hṛtpuṇḍarīkasrajaḥ
etāḥ śoṇitapaṅkakuṅkumajuṣaḥ saṃbhūya kāntaiḥ piba- ntyasthisnehasurāḥ kapālacaṣakaiḥ prītāḥ piśācāṅganāḥ || 151 ||’
atra śrṛṅgāriṇo hi jagadapi śrṛṅgāramayaṃ paśyantīti bībhatsarase'pi mādhavenāntrādiyadānāmantarāleṣu niveśitānāṃ maṅgalapratisarādipadānāmadoṣaḥ
aucityākṛṣṭapadaghaṭanā tadvaśatvaṃ tadākṛṣṭatvamata eva virodhisaṃgatatayā vijātīyayorapyaucitīvaśena kāntiviśeṣonmīlakatvāt patrapuṣpavyatikarajamālāsādṛśyaṃ darśayati—nīlamiti
yastvayamakasmādeva maṅgalādipadānāṃ śṛṅgārānuyāyināmiha niveśaḥ sa kathaṃ doṣabhāvādapanetavyaḥ, kathaṃ vā guṇatvamāsādayitavyamityato hetugarbhaṃ vyācaṣṭe—atra śrṛṅgāriṇa iti
tathā ca pūrvaṃ bībhatsarasānvaye'pi prakṛta śrṛṅgārabhaṅgo mā bhūdityetadarthameva kavinā ‘mama hi’ ityādinā pratijñāya ‘līneva’ ityādivāsanādṛḍhatvamupapāditam
ata eva pratipadaṃ rūpakamāviṣṭābhiprāyamevaṃ śrṛṅgāramayaṃ śrṛṅgārāṅga-tayā rasatāpannam
ata eva sūtritasya bībhatsasya prakṛtena bādhāt prakṛtārthānupoṣa iti
doṣā hi pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva vibhaktā ityata āha—
bhavanti nava tenaite pūrvoktā daśa pañca ca || 108
ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyā saṃkhyeye bartate, tataḥ saṃkhyāne saṃkhyeye cābhidhānāt kevalasaṃkhyānavacanatvena gavāṃ viṃśatiritivatpadasamāśrayetyupapannam
atra ‘na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām’ iti kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe kimeṣāṃ duṣkaramityapabhāṣaṇe'pi saṃbandhamātravivakṣāto guṇatvam
yasya vastuno nānārūpāṇi vijātīyarūpāṇi tatra tadrupavivakṣāvaicitryācchabdacaicitryaṃ saṃgacchata iti doṣatvābhāvaḥ
niyatarūpavivakṣā hi mahākavīnāṃ na lāvaṇyamanusaṃdhāya bhavitumarhati

tathāhi—ākṣipantītyādau eṣāṃ duṣkaramityatra khalarthayoge ‘na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatunām’ ityanena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhādeṣāmiti kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhīti duṣṭajātīyatāmādāya śeṣarūpaviśeṣavivakṣā samādhānahetuḥ
asti hi ṣaṣṭhyarthasya saṃbandhasya dvarūpyam—saṃbandhasāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca janyajanakabhāvādiḥ
yathā koṣasamagrāṇāṃ rājñāṃ vipakṣaśrīharamupadiśya yatkimapi saṃbandhimātrameva na duṣkaraṃ tathā padmānāmiti samarthayāmahe
nanu saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ doṣatā mā bhūt, guṇatvaṃ tu kathamiti yathoktamabhisaṃdhāya paramataṃ likhati—idaṃ hīti
tadyadi kutaścidviśeṣādaskhalitaiva pratītirupajāyate tadā bījābhāvena tathābhāvo nivartata eva
sa ca viśeṣaḥ pratipadamanukramituṃ na śakyate iti ko'pi yatna iti sāmānyena pratipāditam

tathā hi—bandhutyāga ityādau bandhutyāgatanutyāgadeśatyāgānkameṇoddiśya tathaivānudeśo'pyarhati na tvādimamuddiśya tato'ntyastato madhya iti uddeśānudeśalakṣaṇaśāstrakramabhraṃśajātīyatve'pi saṃbandhajñānahetuyatnakaraṇādadūṣaṇatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate
avaśyaṃ cānena krameṇātra vaktumucitaṃ tanutyāgasya vijātīyatāvivakṣayā pṛthageva vaktumarhatvāt
ataśca ‘madhyama āyatakleśa ādyantau kṣaṇikajvarau’ iti vacanamucitamiti ārthakrabhamabhraṃśaḥ kathaṃ na bhavati tatrāha—vaktuśceti
na ca durvacake prāyaḥ pragṛhyādau ca duṣyati || 113
sa ito'bdaṛtāvṛtapriyo na ṛcastvaṃ na yajūṃṣi ūhase || 155 ||’
virūpo durvacako visaṃdhirvigataṃ saṃhitākāryaṃ durvacake kalāviśeṣarūpatayānumate saṃhitākāryaniyamaḥ
pragṛhyaṃ ‘īdūdevddivacanaṃ pragṛhyam’ ityādinā yatra pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihitā, ādigrahaṇādvināpi pragṛhyasaṃjñayā yatra prakṛtibhāvavidhānaṃ tathodāhariṣyate
yatra vā vaktuḥ khedādinā vicchidya pāṭhe viratirbhavati
prayujyanta iti prayuktayo durvacakāśca tāḥ prayuktayaśceti durvacakaprayuktaya iti karmadhārayaḥ
he nageḍje parvatarājaputri, khamākāśaṃ bheḍ bhānāṃ nakṣatrāṇāmīḍīśvaraścandraḥ so'vidyamāno yatra
apsu rohatītyabruṭ padmaṃ tadvanmukhaṃ yasyā iti devīsaṃbodhanam
cedīdṛśaṃ tarhi sadhryaṅ sahacaro bhavāsmākamiti gauryā uttaram
uttarārdhe vinaiva pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ prakṛtibhāvavidhānaṃ yatra tattritayodāharaṇam
yajūṃpi ūhasa iti 'iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca’ ityanena
atra hanyate hanyata iti śabdapunaruktaṃ cārusarvāṅgī varārohetyarthapunaruktaṃ tadubhayamapyanukampādyatiśayavivakṣāyāmadoṣa iti guṇatvam

tathāhi—hanyata ityādau hanyata iti yadyapyabhidheyatātparyamiti śabdapunaruktajātīyaṃ bhavati, yadyapi ca varārohetyabhidhāya cārusarvāṅgītyabhinnābhidheyatātparyaṃ paryāyarūpatvādarthapunaruktajātīyam, tathāpi virahavedanādūnāyāmanukampātiśayādasakṛdupādānamahirahirbudhyasveti lokānusārāt
padānāṃ vyutkamo yatra krameṇa vyutkameṇa vā
tavdyākīrṇaṃ vidustasya na doṣaḥ kvāpi tadyathā || 116
atra ‘mā sma jugupsata’ iti vaktavye ‘jugupsata smainamaduṣṭabhāvaṃ maivam’ iti padavyatikramasya ‘vyaste'pīcchanti kecit’ iti luṅlaṅorviśeṣalakṣaṇatvādguṇatvam
anulimpati kapālam, paridadhāti vastramityapi kṛtena tasyaivārthasya lābhāt
yadā tu kapālaṃ paridadhāti dukūlamanulimpatīti kriyate tadā bhavati saṃnidhiviparyāsastadetavdyākīrṇasaṃkīrṇayostulyaṃ, tadidamuktam—krameṇa vyutkrameṇa vā
nanu ‘smotare laṅ ca’ ityanena māśabdāduttaraṃ yatra smaśabdaprayogastatra luṅlaṅorvidhāne padakramaniyamaḥ kṛtastatkathaṃ sma mameti prayukte so'rthaḥ pratyetavya ityata āha—vyasta iti
viśeṣeṇa lakṣyata iti viśeṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ tasya bhāvastattvam
‘bāle nātha vimuñca mānini ruṣaṃ roṣānmayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ khedo'smāsu na me'parādhyati bhavānsarve'parādhā mayi
tatkiṃ rodiṣi gadgadena vacasā kasyāgrato rudyate nanvetanmama kā tavāsmi dayitā nāsmītyato rudyate || 158 ||’
yatra vākyaikavākyatāyāmavāntaravākyeṣu parasparapadārthapraveśena yathābhimatasaṃsargapratītiḥ skhalitā bhavati tatra saṃkaro dūṣaṇam, pratīteraskhalane tu na doṣaḥ
atra ‘bāle vimuñca māṃ prati ruṣam’ iti prathamapraśnavākyam
tatra bāle iti vākyapratīkānantarameva nātheti vākyāntarapratīkasya nirdeśaḥ saṃkīrṇajātīyatāmākārayitumudyataḥ praśnottaraprabhāvādapodyate
saṃkīrṇayorapi vākyayoḥ paryāyanirdeśe bhavatyeva vākovākyamiti cet, na
tathā hi bāle iti padaṃ paracittānabhijñāyāḥ kṣudrasahacarīvacasi viśvāsabhājaḥ sopālambhaṃ saṃbodhanamāviṣkaroti
etadākarṇyānantarameverṣyākaṣāyakāminīvacanamucitamiti nātheti saṃbodhanaṃ sābhiprāyam, prabhurasi na punarasmāsu dattāśayo na vā svādhīnatāsaubhāgyabhāgiti vivakṣitatvāt
upalakṣaṇaṃ ca dvayoriti ekasyāpi vaktuḥ prahelikādau tadvidyaviṣaye tadābhāṣaṇasyocitatvāt
vijātīyavākyadvayasaṃdaṃśapatita-pade kimidamanenānvīyate'nena veti saṃdehasaṃkīrṇatāsaṃśayo'pi saṃkaramadhyāsīna eveti guravaḥ
ayameti putro rājñaḥ puruṣo'pasāryatāmityatra rājapadaṃ saṃdaṃśapatitaṃ kiṃ pūrveṇātha pareṇānvīyata iti saṃdihyate
‘hā to jo jjaladeu naiva madanaḥ sākṣādayaṃ bhūtale tatkiṃ dīsai saccamā hatavapuḥ kāmaḥ kila śrūyate
ai dūe kialeu bhūtapatinā gaurīvivāhotsave aiseṃ sacca ji bollu hastakaṭakaḥ kiṃ darpaṇenekṣyate || 159 ||’
atra grāmyaḥ praṣṭā nagaramāgato rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā grāmyaiḥ prakṛtisthaireva vā padaiḥ prākṛtena pṛcchati—‘hā to jo jjaladeu’ iti
nāgaraśca tamanujighṛkṣurupanāgaraiḥ komalairvā padaiḥ savakrokti pratyācaṣṭe—‘naiva madanaḥ sākṣādayaṃ bhūtale’ iti
atha grāmya āhitapratibhaḥ pūrvapadānurodhādardhaprākṛtenaiva grāmyopanāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalairvā padaistamupālabhate—‘tatkiṃ dīsai saccamā hatavapuḥ kāmaḥ kila śrūyate’ iti
atha nāgaro jñātatatprāvīṇyaḥ pādānurodhādeva ardhaprākṛtena grāmyopanāgaranāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorairvā padaiḥ samādhatte—‘ai dūe kialeu bhūtapatinā gaurīvivāhotsave’ iti
atha grāmyaḥ ślokasamāpteḥ pādasya taduttarasya cānurodhādgrāmyāṇi prakṛtisthāni vā tricaturāṇi padāni prākṛte noktvā pādārdha eva tiṣṭhati—‘aiseṃ sacca ji bollu’ iti
atha nāgaro jitakāśī grāmyo-panāgaranāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorairvā padaiḥ ślokamuttaraṃ ca pūrayati—'hastakaṭakaḥ kiṃ darpaṇenekṣyate’ iti
praṣṭuḥ saṃskṛtapadeṣu vapurityupanāgaraṃ śeṣāṇi grāmyāṇi, prativaktuśca hastavivāha gaurīpadāni grāmyāṇi, bhūtapatineti nāgaram, śeṣāṇyupanāgarāṇi
api tu grāmyāditrikasya vā prakṛtisthāditrikasya veti vikalpenopanyāsaprayojanamanujñāsaṃpattistena doṣatābhāvaguṇībhāvau pratipāditau
yathā hi—nānāvarṇārabdhamālekhyacitraṃ yathā vā bhinnaprakāratantunirvātaḥ paṭaścitrapaṭastathā nānābhāṣābhirārabdhaṃ kiṃcitkāvyaṃ citramucyate
tena rūpadvayasaṃpattau yuktipoṣaḥ syādevaṃ yathaucityākṛṣṭanānābhāṣāvyatikarajamekaṃ saṃbhavatītyāśaṅkya/ saṃkṣepātsarvaṃ bhāṣāsaṃkaramevodāharati—yatheti
saṃkaramācitīṃ ca vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atra grāmya iti
yadvā yānpṛcchati teṣveva bahumāno dhanyāste ye nāmagotrādikametasya jānantaḥ satatamenamavalokyanta ityāśayāt
tadetatsarvamādarśayituṃ praśnaṃ pṛthakkṛtya darśayati—hā to ityādi
‘hā to’ iti mahārāṣṭrabhāṣāyāṃ praśnakākurayaṃ sa ityarthe
sa iti yo nāmaitannagaranāyakatvenāsmadgrāme'pi vahuśo vikhyātakīrtiriti camatkāraḥ
atra sarvāṇyeva padāni nātihīnapātre grāmye prakṛtibhavānyapabhraṃśapadāni deśīpadatvena sarveṣāṃ grāmyatā
‘jo jjaladeu’ ityekasaṃyogavarṇāpāditagauravaṃ ca prakṛtisthaṃ tadatra prākṛtagrāmyayoraucityākṛṣṭam
api tu saṃdarbhārambhastena prakrānta iti vivakṣitam
praśno-ttaropanyāso hi prakṛtyaiva ca nāgarakā grāmyamatavirodhino vakroktirasikā bhavanti
yadi tasya grāmye jaghanyabuddhiḥ kimityuttarameṣa dāsyatītyata uktam—anujighṛkṣuriti
yadyapi nāgarasya nāgarāṇi padāni prayoktumarhanti, tathāpi grāmyānugrahe kartavye tadbodhayogyamevābhimataṃ na tu nāgarakatvam
tarhi grāmyaireva kuto na bravītītyapi na vācyam
svabhāvata eva prākṛtaprakṛtisthānāṃ saṃskṛtaprakṛtisthānāṃ prauḍhatvaṃ bhavati

tena yadyapi grāmyaprayuktajātīyānyeva saṃdarbhaikarūpatāsidhdyarthaṃ ghaṭayitumucitāni tathāpyaucitīprāptasaṃskṛtapadaniveśane yadi prakṛtisthatvamādriyeta tataśchāyāvairūpyaṃ syādityāśayena komalaprāyāṇyeva niveśitānītyāha—komalairveti
bhūyasā vyapadeśo bhavatīti lokanyāyānusārāt ‘sākṣāt’ ityekasya prakṛtisthatve'pi komalairityuktam
sākāṅkṣapraśne ca kimarthaṃ lokottaro ‘jo jjaladeu’ nānyaḥ kaścittādṛgiti bhāvo vivakṣitastatra netyevoktenānugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ syādityadhikamapi kiṃcidvaktumucitamityāha—savakroktīti
naivetyevakāreṇa manuṣya evāyaṃ na bhavati dūre tadviśeṣarūpo ‘jo jjaladeu’ iti prakāśitam

māmekāntato nāgarakavṛttaparicayaparādhīnaṃ mā śaṅkiṣṭhā ityāśayaśauṭīryeṇa nāgarakaprayuktajātīyaireva padaiḥ praśno yogyo na caitāvataiva sarvathā prakṛtityāgo'rhatītyataḥ svaprayogayogyānyapi prayogamarhanti tatrārdhaṃ prakṛtivaiśasenārdhaṃ prākṛtamardhaṃ grāmyaṃ ca praśnavākyānucitamityāha—pūrvapadānurodhāditi
asti grāmyasya ‘kila śrūyate’ ityetābhyāṃ saṃdihānatvaṃ kiṃcivdyutpannatvaṃ connītamiti kimapyalīkameva buddhikauśalāttathā pratīyamānamabhidhāya pratāraṇamupapadyate

tanmātraparatvācca sarvākāramadhikāvyutpattirāhatya darśayitumarhatīti tarkitamityādipade yāvatī grāmyasya vyutpattistābadanukaraṇaṃ kiyadadhikavyutpattipuraskāramarhatītyāśayavānuttaramavatārayati—atheti
‘ai dūe’ iti pāṭhe dūaṃ vyājo'nena vyājena
nanu na kvacidevaṃ śrūyate tatkathaṃ grāmyasya prabodho bhavatītyāha—gaurīvivāhotsava iti
mā śrūyatāmupapattyā tu siddho dvitīyo yadi kāmaprādurbhāvo na syātkathaṃ gaurīpāṇigrahe bhagavata utsāha ityatastenaiva karuṇāsaṃtānaśāntātmanā bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ syādityarthaḥ
paccheti prakṛtistham, ai iti kaṭhoram, kialeu iti komalam, bhūtapatineti tathā, gaurīvivāhotsava iti prakṛtistham
tato nāgarakaprāmāṇyadattabharaḥ praśno ghaṭata ityāśayavānavatārayati—atha grāmya iti
prakṛtyāpanna eva, tena yathā prathamaṃ ‘hā to’ ityādipraśne gatistathātrāpīti grāmyaprakṛtisthayorupanyāsaḥ
yadi cāyameva samastaṃ nirvāhayannaśeṣaśaṅkānivṛttyupayuktamuttaraṃ nāgarasya niveśitaṃ syāditi taduttarānurodhena pādārdha eva vilambo'pyucitaḥ
evaṃ grāmyatāpratāraṇasiddhau kimatra sarvalokasākṣike vastuni vakroktyaiva pūrvavyutpattimātraniveśanenottaraṃ dattvā ślokapūraṇameva nāgarasyocitamityāśayenottaramavatārayati—atheti
haste iti prakṛtistham, kaṭakamiti komalam, darpaṇenekṣyate ityete prakṛtisthe, iti prakṛtisthādīnāṃ supariceyatvādgrāmyādīnyeva vyācaṣṭe—tatra ceti
‘diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭā mahī sādhyate siddhā sā ca vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata
viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namo yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam || 160 ||’

atra ‘yathoktā mahī sādhyate, siddhā sā ca viprāya pratipādyate iti vaktavye, yeyaṃ vīrādbhutarasavaśapravṛttena ‘vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romā ñcitāḥ paśyata’ iti vākyena prakṛtavākyokterasamāptāveva ‘viprāya ityādipadavicchittiḥ sā rasāntaratiraskṛtirityucyate
tayā cedaṃ vākyāntarasagarbhamapi vākyaṃ na doṣāya bhavati
rasāntaraṃ rasaviśeṣaḥ prakṛtarasānusaṃhito rasastena tiraskāro doṣabhāvasya, tasmin sati tathākṛtaṃ vākyamiṣṭameva kavīnāmupādānayogyameva anyathā neṣṭaṃ duṣṭamevetyarthaḥ
tenāyamartho bhavati—prakṛtarasatirodhāyakatvaṃ kila dūṣaṇatābījaṃ tadatirodhānenaiva nivartate
tathā hi—diṅmātaṅgānāṃ ghaṭayā vibhaktāḥ pṛthagudbhidya vyavasthāpitāścatvāra āghāṭā yasyāṃ sā, tathā tena ‘saptadvīpā vasumatī sādhyate’ iti vivakṣitam

ye tāvadbharatabhagīrathaprabhṛtayaḥ prathitapratāpātiśayāsteṣāṃ taddūṣaṇapariniṣṭhitaśaktīnāmekasyāpi samastakṣattravaṃśonmūlanena navakhaṇḍamedinīsiddhau notsāhaśaktiḥ śravaṇagocaratāmayāsīditi lokottarā paraśurāmasyotsāhaśaktirāvedyate
'siddhā sā ca’ ityanena yāvadabhilaṣitaṃ tāvadeva siddhamityaho vijigīṣuteti pūrvavadevābhiprāyaḥ
evamabhihite ‘viprāya’ ityādikamasti vākyaśeṣabhūtam, tadvicchidyaiva madhye ‘vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ’ iti vākyena sagarbhatā, sā na doṣāya
anena hi vākyena lokottaravastubhāvanātmakavibhāvasaṃpattau prādurbhavan vaktumabhimato raso vyajyate
sa ca vīrānusaṃdhānaheturvīrādbhutayoḥ samānabhūmikayoranyonyānugamanena pratikūlatā virahatā

tatra yathā śṛṅgāraraudrabībhatsānāmeka-praghaṭṭakena sūtreṇa saṃnipātitairapi hāsyakaruṇabhayānakairna tiraskāraḥ, ‘svāṅgamavyavadhāyakam’ iti nyāyāt, tatheha vīrasyādbhutenāta evādbhutādudvelasya prādurbhūtaputrakāṅkuralakṣaṇānubhāvapradarśanam—‘paśyata’ iti
na cātra doṣodāharaṇe ‘mayā’ iti kārakavibhakterutthitākāṅkṣāyā ‘rakṣainam’ ityādinā svarasaṃbādhastathātra saṃbhavati, 'siddhā’ ityetāvatyapi darśite vākyārthaparyavasānāt
na ca saṃpūrṇe rase ‘vadanta eva’ ityādikamabhidhātumarhati
evaṃ rasānubhāvanātṛptasya tatraiva punaḥ punarutkaṇṭhāyāṃ jigīṣukaraṇīyalavdhapātrapratipattiviśeṣasphoraṇe ‘viprāya pratipādyate’ ityuktam
atra ‘puṃso yoṣita iva’ ‘śamo lajjeva’ ‘parākramo vaiyātyamiva’ iti liṅgabhedaḥ
‘paribhave surateṣviva’ iti tu liṅgabhedo vacanabhedaśca dṛśyate
sa caiṣāmeva parasparamupamānopameyabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ paryāyāntarābhāvādanyathākartuṃ na śakyata iti sahṛdayānudvejakatvānna duṣyatīti doṣasyāpi guṇatvam
atra prāgvadeva paryāyāntarābhāvāt ‘sa lohakārabhastreva’ iti liṅgabhedasya na doṣaḥ
yatra tu kathaṃcittathābhāvo na bhavati, tatra doṣatvahānirucitaiva
tathā hi strīpuṃsayoreva prakṛtānuguṇopamānopameyabhāvavivakṣāyāmāvaśyakaṃ liṅgavaṃcanabhedayoranyataradekasya puṃsa upameyatvena dāraśabdasya bhinnavacanatvaniyamātkalatrapadaṃ bhinnavacanameva
na ca puṃvacanaṃ kiṃcitsamānasvabhāvamasti yenāyaṃ prakāro nivarteta
evamananyagatikā bhinnaliṅgatā bhinnavacanatā vā sāhityasamayavidāmudvegaṃ notpādayati
evaṃ śamalajjayoḥ parākramavaiyātyayoḥ paribhavasuratayośca boddhavyamityāśayavān vyācaṣṭe—atreti
‘rataṃ, rahaḥ, śayanaṃ, mohanam’ iti suratavācināṃ sarveṣāmeva napuṃsakatā na duṣyatīti sahṛdayahṛdayānudvejakatvāditi heturguṇatvetvābhiprāyikaḥ

vahnividhmāpanacarmapuṭo bhastrā sā yathā vātena pūryate, vātaṃ ca muñcati, na tu kiṃcitpuruṣārthamāsādayati, tathā trivargaśūnye'pi bhastrāparyāyasya samānaliṅgasyābhāvena sahṛdayānāmanudvegālaṃkārasaṃpattyā guṇatvamupapannamityāha—atra prāgvadeveti
muktātmā naḥ śivaṃ nemiranye'pi dadatāṃ jināḥ || 163
na cedaṃ vācyamatrevādirna vidyata iti nopamātvam
ivasyāpinā samuccayārthena tulyadharmāṇāṃ tu ‘dharmasya prabhavaḥ’ ityādibhirvacanaśleṣairviṣayāpahārāt
yathā agrato dyotakalopa upamāyām—'komalāpāṭalau tanvi pallavaścādharaśca te
yatra sadṛśātsadṛśapratipattistadupamānam, yatra dvayoḥ sādṛśyamabhidhīyate pratīyate vā sopamā’ iti prabandhenāgrato vakṣyāmaḥ
tasya sarvālaṃkārasādhāraṇatvātkevalaṃ sādṛśyamalaṃkāra iti darśane upamāyāmudāhriyate
ārhatānāṃ nemināmā jinaviśeṣo'nye jinā ṛṣabhanāthaprabhṛtayaḥ prājyamucitaṃ tathābhūtaḥ prabhāvaḥ siddhirūpo yasya tādṛśo nemiḥ śivaṃ dadatāṃ dadātu
pakṣe vo yuṣmabhyaṃ śivaṃ dadatāṃ dadatviti
rajaśca tamaśca rajastamasī te aste kṣipte yena sa tathābhūto nemiḥ
mukto nirāvaraṇa ātmā ātmaśabda ātmavacanaḥ svarūpavacana iti vā bahuvrīhistādṛśo nemiḥ
nanu ca liṅgādibheda upamāyā dūṣaṇatvamuktam, iha tvalaṃkārāntara udāhriyate, tatkathaṃ pūrvāparasamañjasatvam
tathā ca kvacitprasiddhasya prakṛte saṃbandhapratītistebhyo bhavati bimbapratibimbanyāyāśrayaṇāt
ekamuddiśya prasiddhānyadharmavidhānaṃ tu yathevādiriti viṣayavirodhānna prayujyata iti
syādetat— ivavadvāyathādiśabdā yatparāstasyaivopamānatāpratītistathā cānenedaṃ tulyamiti sādhāraṇadharmavidhirūpā kathamupametyata uktam—tulyadharmāṇāṃ tviti
nātra vacanaśleṣatulyadharmāgamaḥ, api tu tathā ‘vyavasthitānāmeva śabdatantratā’ iti ‘dharmasya prabhavaḥ’ ityādibhirdvivacanaśleṣaistathāpi viṣayopahṛta iti
tarhi prakṛtodāharaṇe nāstyevopamā, kathaṃ vacanabhedasya guṇībhāva udāhriyata ityāha—yatreti
yadyapyabhidhīyamānaṃ nāsti sādṛśyam, tathāpi pratīyamānopamā vyavahriyatāmityarthaḥ
tadyathā 'mukhaṃ padmam’ iti rūpake, ‘mukhaṃ padmaṃ vā’ iti saṃśaye, ‘na mukhaṃ padmameva’ ityapahnave
ata eva dve bhinnaliṅgavacane ityatra nopamāgrahaṇam
ciraṃtanairhi bharatamuniprabhṛtibhirdve eva yamakopame śabdānugatālaṃkāratve neṣṭe
tatprapañcanamātraṃ tu punaranyairalaṃkārakāraiḥ kṛtamupamāyāḥ prabhūtaviṣayatayā prādhānyāccodāhṛtamatisphuṭaṃ bhavatīti saṃkṣepaḥ

indrāyudhamindradhanurekamupamāne upameye pītaṃ vāsaḥ śārṅgamabjaḥ śaṅkha iti trīṇi viśeṣaṇāni tadihādhikaviśeṣaṇaviṣaya iti jijñāsāsamakālamevāprasiddhendubimbayorupamānayormeghānusaṃdhānāt skhalanābhimukhī pratītiravalakṣyate
na caivaṃ stanitādīnāmiti kathaṃ pratītiriti vācyam
yathopapattiparyanto yāvatopamānaviśeṣaṇatvena prakṛtamupameyaviśeṣaṇapratibimbatā nīyate tadatikrameṇaikapratītyanurodhe kalpitenāpyupameyaviśeṣaṇenetyarthaḥ
yadi vopamāne dharmoddhāṭanānumānāt ‘śaṅkhacakragadādharo viṣṇuḥ’ iti prasiddheḥ śārṅgamanumeyam
upamānaviśeṣaṇānāṃ yāvatpratīti na grahaṇamiti prakāśayituṃ pāramārthikastvayaṃ siddhānta ityāha—yadi veti
taha a ṇhāā si tumaṃ sacche golāṇaītūhe || 166 ||’
tathā ca snātā bhavasi tvaṃ svacche godānadītīrthe ||]
atra dvitīyaikādaśatrayoviṃśativarṇānāṃ saṃyogaparatvādgurutve'pi ṇhālhādisaṃyogasya tīvraprayatnoccāraṇena pūrvalaghutve na chandobhaṅga iti guṇatvam
prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ sthānakaraṇavyāpārastasya tīvratvamudrekastata eva hi piṇḍākṣarādīnāmakaṭhoratvamābhāsate
ādigrahaṇādivahikārau sānusvārau ca kevalau padānte vartamānau tattadbhāṣāviṣaye'vaseyau
kvacideva hi varṇe tathāvabhāsate na tu sarvatra
tadupalakṣaṇameva ‘raha vaṃjaṇasaṃjoe’ [ ‘rahau vyañjanasaṃyoge’ ] ityādikaṃ chandovicitau darśitam
snātumavatīrṇe tvayi aṃśukārdhamudbhraṣṭaṃ sadabbhantamārdrobhūtaṃ yathā calatvaṃ sthitestathāvagamyate na tvantarjalaṃ jalakelisthānamavatīrṇa ityabhiprāyaśeṣaḥ
kathamanyathā godāvarīnadyāḥ svacchaṃ jalaṃ dṛśyate iti
atra dvitīyaikādaśādisthāneṣu yadyapi saṃyogātpūrvabhāve gurutvaṃ vidyate-rtathāpi tīvraprayatnoccāraṇīyaśakārahakārādisaṃyogamahimnā nāvacchedaśravyatā kaluṣīkriyata iti
ityādi nāmadhātubhāge svarāsaṃdhāne ca paṭhitivicchedo na bhavatītyuktaṃ sa tadullaṃṅghanamātreṇa samādhīyate śobhāṃ puṣyatīti
kāryākāryāṇyayamavikalānyāgamenaiva paśya- nvaśyāmurvīṃ vahati nṛpa ityasti cāyaṃ prayogaḥ || 167 ||’

atra pādatraye caturthasthāne yatau kartavyāyāṃ pañcamasthāne kṛtatvādaparatra ca pādasya madhyabhāge niviṣṭakevalasvaratvād yatibhraṃśe'pi svarasaṃdhikṛtatvādavibhinnanāmadhātuśarīratvācca na doṣatvam
nāmabhede ca śeṣeṣu na doṣa iti sūrayaḥ
lupte padānte śeṣasya padatvaṃ niścitaṃ yathā
kāryākāryeti ca nāmabhāgamullaṅghya vicchedaśravyatā ca parasya yaṇādeśena ‘kiṃcidbhāvā’ iti ‘nṛpa’ iti ca svarasaṃdhāne vicchedo'ta eva śravyatvamapi
nanu padacchede svarasaṃdhānapaṭhitivirāmaḥ sollekho lakṣyate, na tu catuṣpāde tathāstīti kathaṃ śravyatvamata āha—lupta iti
saṃdhau vikāro yatvayalopādikaṃ kāryaṃ, tathā ca padānte sati padaccheda evāyamikāro'vatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ
aśarīraṃ kriyāhīnaṃ kriyāpekṣā na yatra tu
atra triṣu pādeṣu padāni kriyāpadaṃ nāpekṣante
caturthe tu nahītyādibhiḥ santītyapekṣate na caitāvatāmīṣāmasāmarthyaṃ bhavati
yadāha—‘yatrānyat kriyāpadaṃ nāsti, tatrāsti bhavatīti padaṃ prathamapuruṣe prayujyate’ iti
pradhānāvimarśe hi dūṣaṇamityuktaṃ tadupāttānāmeva padārthānāṃ pradhānagarbhīkaraṇe tatpratibandhe'vaśyavidheyamanyaṃ prati guṇībhāve vā samādhīyate
‘nahi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ’ ityatra tu sattākriyāyāḥ sakalapadārthāvyabhicārāt ‘apekṣyate’ iti siddhiḥ
tadetadvākyaṃ kriyāpradhānamiti dadarśa ‘sa pradhānaṃ viśeṣyamātraṃ tu vākyārthe’ iti paramārthaḥ
tena ‘rādhā rahaḥ sākṣiṇām’ ityādāvāvaśyakavidheyasākṣibhāvādiguṇatayā rādhāsaṃbandhādīnāṃ vaivakṣikaprādhānyānāmapi pradhānatvāvimarśo na doṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati
pāruṣyaśaithilyābhyāṃ vinā kṛtaṃ śliṣṭamityuktaṃ tasya viparyayo viparītaṃ vākyaṃ śithilaṃ bhavati
evaṃvidhamapi caitadanuprāsasauṣṭhavātpadānāmekatāpratibhāse samādhīyata udbhaṭānuprāsatayā ca kāntiprādhānye gauḍīyarītiprādhānyena guṇatvamāsādayati tadidamuktam—bandhaprāśastyagauravāditi
yatra hiśabdasyārtho'nyathānyathārūpaṃ bhajate tatrāvaśyaṃ tadanuyāyinā padasaṃdarbheṇa bhinnarūpeṇa bhāvyam
śarāvatyāḥ prāgdeśabhavāḥ paurastyāstadīyahevākaprācuryabhāja eva hi khaṇḍarītayaḥ
atra yadyapi malayānila eka eva vākyārthastathāpi candanapraṇayena pravṛddhasaurabhe manda ityābhyāṃ śṛṅgārāṅgatāpratītāvunmiśraḥ saṃdarbhaḥ
malayamāruta iti komalaḥ, vararāmāmukhānilairityapi tathā, tatrāpyārabhaṭīprakāśane spardhata iti sphuṭam
tadevaṃ samatāviparyāse'pi viśeṣaṇānāmarthānāṃ bhinnabhinnarasānupraveśe pṛthagarthālaṃkāraḥ prakāśante
teṣāṃ matena tasyāpi dūṣaṇaṃ naiva vidyate || 128
so'yaṃ dīptarasānupraveśādaucityena guṇatvaṃ bhajata iti vyaktam
anīcayā tuṅgyā budhdyā māyāyāmasya avidyāvistārasyāyāsaṃ glāniṃ vicchedaṃ yācanīyā prārthanīyā
tadiha tathā varā(?)saṃniveśasya camatkārakāritvena prasādo'pi sahṛdayaślāghāviṣayo guṇatāmadhyāsta iti
‘māṃ bhavantamanalaḥ pavano vā vāraṇo madakalaḥ paraśurvā
vāhinījalabharaḥ kuliśaṃ vā svasti te'stu latayā saha vṛkṣa || 172 ||’
tathā hi—‘mā bhavantamanalaḥ’ ityādau vṛkṣasamabhivyāhāreṇa dahanādīnāṃ yogyatayā śīghrameva dhākṣīdityādikriyānvayo'vasīyate
rasasyādīptiḥ kāntiviparyayo vacanāparādhena dūṣaṇatāmadhyāste, sa samādhīyate'tra grāmyoktiparihāreṇaiva
‘yo yaḥ śastraṃ bibharti svabhujagurumadaḥ pāṇḍavīnāṃ camūnāṃ yo yaḥ pāñcālagotre śiśuradhikavayā garbhaśayyāṃ gato vā
yo yastatkarmasākṣī carati mayi raṇe yaśca yaśca pratīpaḥ krodhāndhastasya tasya svayamiha jagatāmantakasyāntako'ham || 174 ||’
tadidamuktam—‘dīptārthaṃ badhyate yatra taddīptaṃ cenna duṣyati’ iti
‘prasīda caṇḍi tyaja manyumañjasā janastavāyaṃ purataḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ

tathā hi—prasīdetyādau praṇayakelikupitakāminīprasādanāyāṃ śṛṅgāravirodhisamāsavyatikareṇa rīterapyapakrame roṣalakṣaṇabhāvānubhāvabhūḥ stanakampavarṇanāyāṃ samāso'nupraviṣṭa iti vyaktaḥ pūrvarīteranirvāhaḥ
‘kvākāryaṃ śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ kva ca kulaṃ bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā doṣāṇāmupaśāntaye śrutamaho kope'pi kāntaṃ mukham
kiṃ vakṣyantyapakalmaṣāḥ kṛtadhiyo rekhaiva sānyādṛśī cetaḥ svāsthyamupehi kaḥ khalu yuvā dhanyo'dharaṃ dhāsyati || 177
atra śrutiśālino nāyakasya vāsanāparipākavaśādvipralambhāveśe'pi prathamaṃ prādurbhāvaḥ—‘kvākṛtyaṃ śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ kva nu kulam’ iti
tadevaṃ śāntarasānuyāyinamanantarameva bādhitvā cittānurañjakaprakṛtarasāvyabhicāriṇā autsukyasya prādurbhāvaḥ—‘bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā’ iti
tasyāpi kvāpi nirdoṣaḥ prayogo dṛśyate yathā || 137
na śrutā bhārate yena tasya janma nirarthakam || 178 ||’
atra gītāviduravākyādīnāṃ kathāyāmaprayojakatve'pītihāsavyājena caturvargapratipādanasyārambha eva pratijñānādguṇatvam
dṛśyata ityanena tatra tatra prakṛtasaṃgatau satyāṃ doṣābhāvo'vaseya iti darśitam
yadyapi bhagavadgītāyāṃ mokṣādhikāriṇāmastyeva prakṛtaśāntarasaparipoṣakatvam, tathāpi tadantargatānāṃ bhūyasāmāhatya nāsti
bhīṣmaviduravākyānāṃ tu dharmādhikāre prakṛtānāṃ vyakta eva niṣprayojanaprastāvaḥ

itihāsarūpe prabandhe satyapi śāntasya vākyārthābhāvena bahūnāmitihāsānāṃ trivargādhikāritvāccaturvargapratipādanameva maharṣerabhimatam, dharmāditritayasya ca prāsaṅgikatayā na pūrvavadasyārthaikatāvirodhaḥ
evaṃ ca vyutpādayitavyaviṣayajijñāsopādāne dharmārthapravṛttaye vākyamidaṃ saphalatāmāsādayadguṇa eva bhavati
atraikenaivopamānena śauklyapratītau śeṣopamānapādānāṃ vyarthatve'pi yaśasaḥ smaryamāṇatvagīyamānatvastūyamānatvaśrūyamāṇatvairhṛdayādiṣu śrīkhaṇḍādivadanasthānasya pratīyamānatvādguṇatvam
śrīkhaṇḍenaivopamāne yaśasaḥ śuddhatvamavagataṃ śleṣopamānapadāni kevalakṛtakarāṇīti vyarthatvaprasaṅge smaraṇādiviśeṣavivakṣayā tiraskriyate, yathāsaṃkhyādibhaṅgisaubhāgyena ca guṇībhāva iti
‘asāraṃ saṃsāraṃ parimuṣitaratnaṃ tribhuvanaṃ nirālokaṃ lokaṃ maraṇaśaraṇaṃ bāndhavajanam
adarpaṃ kandarpaṃ jananayananirmāṇamaphalaṃ jagajjīrṇāraṇyaṃ kathamasi vidhātuṃ vyavasitaḥ || 180 ||’
'asāraṃ saṃsāram’ ityuktvā ‘paribhuṣitaratnaṃ tribhuvanaṃ nirālokaṃ lokam’ ‘jagajjīrṇāraṇyam’ iti yaduktam, tasya viśeṣānabhidhāyakatve'pi rasākṣiptena vaktrābhihitatvādguṇatvam
‘asāraṃ saṃsāram’ ityanena sthāvarajaṅgamaprapañcasya niḥsāratāṃ pratipādya ‘jātau jātau yadutkṛṣṭaṃ taddhi ratnaṃ pracakṣate’ iti
uṇṇaapaohare pekkhiūṇa jai vasasi tā vasasu || 181 ||’
atra kenāpi pathikayūnā prāvṛḍārambhe grāmaṇīvadhūḥ pīnonnatastanī sattharaamiti srastarakavyājena śastarataṃ yācitā
taṃ pratyācakṣāṇeva yathoktaṃ brūte—‘kuto'tra grāmaṇīgṛhe srastarakaḥ, kuto vā śastaṃ ratam
unnatau payodharau mama hṛdaye nabhasi vā payodharāndṛṣṭvā yadi vasasi tadā vasa’ iti tadetasya gopanāya vdyarthaireva padaiḥ prayuktamiti saṃdigdhasyāpyasya guṇatvam
yadā tu saṃdeha eva tātparyamavadhāryate tadā sa eva rañjakatayālaṃkāratāmārohatīti katthanaṃ guṇībhāva iti, tadidaṃbhuktam—syādalaṃkāra eveti
kuto labhyate pathika srastaraḥ śastarataṃ cātra grāmaṇīgṛhe
unnatapayodharānmedhān payodharau stanau vā dṛṣṭvā yadi vasasi tadvasa
atra praṣṭuḥ saṃdehajanakatvena nibhṛtānurāgaprakāśanaṃ pathikaviṣaye pratīyate
doṣaḥ sopakramo nāma citrahetau ca duṣyati || 140
arthānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ teṣāmeva paurvāparyaniyamādya iti pūrvārdhe'dhyāhāryam

paryasya vistārya candrodayarāgoddīpanayoḥ satyapi hetuhetumadbhāvena paurvāparye prathamaṃ rāgasāgaraḥ paścāccandramaṇḍalamudīrṇamiti viparyāsapratītisamasamayamuddīpanavibhāvanānusaṃdhānād himāṃśoratiśīghrakāritāprakāśanāt prakṛtaśṛṅgāraraso dīpyate
na doṣastasya tu kvāpi yatra cchāyā na hīyate || 141
galitavibhavasyājñevādya dyutirmasṛṇā rave- rvirahivanitāvakraklaibyaṃ bibharti niśākaraḥ || 183 ||’
atropamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyanta iti prakrāntarīteranirvāhe'pi samāsavyākhyāparatvenaiva ivaśabdataddhitayoḥ prayoge pratyuta cchāyotkarṣa iti guṇatvam
vākyārthasya dharmiṇo yadalaṃkārabhaṅgyā prakramasthayā nirvahaṇābhāvaḥ khedaḥ
sa tu pūrvālaṃkāraviśrāntau pratīteraskhalane na doṣaḥ
guṇatvaṃ ca tasya bhaṅgyantarairapi prakṛtālaṃkāre dhvananāt

tathā hi—‘abhinavavadhūroṣasvādu asaralajanāśleṣa iva krūraḥ’ ityupamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyanta iti samāsadvayenopamāmupakramya malinavibhavasyājñeveti samāsatyāgādvirahivanitāvakraklaibyaṃ bibhartīti cāntaradharmāropeṇa copamātyāgātsatyapi rīteranirvāhe upamāyāmeva paryavasānaṃ samādhānahetuḥ
galitavibhāvājñāmasṛṇeti samāse kartavye yo'yamivaśabdaprayogaḥ sa ivārthe pūrvau samāsau bodhayati

klaibyaṃ bibhartīti sāmānyālaṃkāre kathamanyadharmamanyo vahatīti pratisaṃdhānasamasamayaṃ vakraklaibyamasyetyantargatopamāprakaṭībhāve upamāsamāsapadayorapi sā pratīyate iti seyaṃ kavicāturīpratīyamānacchāyāmeva puṣṇāti
vārtādau tena tuṣyanti vidagdhā netare janāḥ || 142
laukikārthānuyāyi yajjagati loke kāntamucyate tathābhūtamatikramya yatkavīnāṃ prasthānaṃ pravartate tadapi gauḍānāṃ manaso mude proktam
nanu priyālāpavarṇanayorevaṃvidhā eva loke kāvye ca vacanasaṃdarbhā iti nāstyatimātratānatimātratayorbheda iti pṛcchati—atheti
‘hālāhalaṃ viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva sakhi mā tatra viśvasīḥ
yadvā na dahyase kāṣṭhaiḥ svalpaistvamiti me matiḥ || 188 ||’
viruddhalakṣaṇā laukikī tasyā hi jhaṭityabhidhānāvinābhāvādaparuṣārthapratīterabhidhānataḥ pāruṣyaṃ na doṣo lakṣaṇāparigraheṇa ca guṇatvam
āliṅganyo'vadhūtastripurayuvatibhiḥ sāśrunetrotpalābhiḥ kāmīvārdrāparādhaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ śāṃbhavo vaḥ śarāgniḥ || 189 ||’
atra karuṇe śrṛṅgārasyāprakṛtatve'pi śaṃbhuprabhāvavarṇanāṅgabhūtatvena dvayo- rapyaprādhānyādavairasyena guṇatvam
aprādhānya ityupalakṣaṇaṃ bādhyatve'pīti ca boddhavyam rasavastunoḥ parasparavirodhirasavyañjakayoḥ
jātipramāṇābhyāmapakṛṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ candrāpekṣayā kāminīkapolasyāpakarṣe ātmanastulyatāmuddīpanasya pratipādyamānaḥ prakṛtaśṛṅgāraprakarṣamarpayiṣyatīti guṇatvam
lokaprasiddhameva kavibhirupamāne kāntaṃ bhavati tena yatra loke prasiddhaṃ tena sahopamāvarṇane saṃbhavadapyaprasiddhopamatvaṃ rasānupraveśena guṇī bhavati
‘yācñāṃ dainyaparābhavapraṇayinīṃ nekṣvākavaḥ śikṣitāḥ sevāsaṃvalitaḥ kadā raghukule maulau nibaddho'ñjaliḥ
sarvaṃ tadvihitaṃ tathāpyudadhinā naivoparodhaḥ kṛtaḥ pāṇiḥ saṃprati me haṭhātkimaparaṃ spraṣṭuṃ dhanurvāñchati || 194 ||’
dainyaparābhavapraṇayinīmityādyutkṛṣṭapuṣṭiviśeṣaṇayogādastiśabde'spaṣṭe vakratārthe tu nāsti vakratvaṃ cālaṃkāra iti
yadyapi vākyārtho niralaṃkāra iva bhāsate, tathāpi viśeṣato'laṃkārādhyavasāye'pi sāmānyena vakratā prakāśata eva
asti hi vayaṃ yācāmaha ityukte yācñā ca bhikṣākarānālakṣitā(?)ityuktau nāyakaprakarṣābhivyañjako viśeṣa ityāha—
tasyeha dṛśyate bhūmnā prayogo nāpi duṣyati || 152
kvacittu na tasmiṃstathābhūte'pi saṃsargāntaramiti yadaślīlamarthāntaravāci vetyuktam
aviparītādviparītaṃ ratamutkṛṣyata iti śāstrakārairāmnānāttasya śṛṅgāroddīpanatayā kavibhirādṛtatvādityarthaḥ
atra deśaviruddhatve'pi tasya rājñaḥ prabhāveṇeti kāraṇopanyāsādguṇatvam
atra kālaviruddhatve'pi rājñāṃ vināśapiśuna ityaniṣṭasūcakotpāta rūpatvādguṇatvam
‘sa saṃkocaścandrādiva kumudarāśeraśaraṇaḥ sa sūryātkokānāṃ viraha iva luptapratividhiḥ
yadi candrādibhyaḥ kumudasaṃkocādayo bhaveyustadā bhavadguṇebhyaḥ khalānāmudvega upamīyeta na tu tathā saṃbhavati tenāyamalaukikatvādāścaryamarpayatīti vākyārthaparipoṣāttathopanyāso guṇa eveti
pibāmi taralaṃ tasyāḥ kadā nu radanacchadam || 201 ||’
tiraskṛtamityata eva vā pañcadhā vivakṣita ityāgamaḥ
atrāpanna: śatrurabhiyātavya iti nītiḥ, tacca mānino hriye bhavatītiviruddhamapi uddhatapuruṣabhāṣitatvānna duṣyatīti guṇatvam
atra trāsato layavaiṣamyeṇa geyasya rāgahetutve'pi kāminīmukhodgīrṇatvādrāgavivardhanatvena guṇatvam
layavaiṣamyāditi gītasya kalāprakathanāttasya ca viṣamalayasyārañjakatvātkathaṃ rāgavardhanamiti dūṣaṇaṃ dolāgatāgatatrastakāminīgītaprabhāvokteścamatkāritvāttirodhīyata iti guṇabhāvaṃ ca nīyate
itthaṃ guṇāśca doṣāśca kāvye doṣaguṇāśca ye
nanu guṇaireva śabdārthayoḥ sanāthīkaraṇe kimalaṃkāravivecanaprayāsenetyata āha—
yuvateriva rūpamaṅga kāvyaṃ svadate śuddhaguṇaṃ tadapyatīva
vikalpo viśeṣastarhi kimuttarasiddhau pūrveṇeti nyāyena tyajyantāṃ guṇā ityata āha—
yadi bhavati vacaścyutaṃ guṇebhyo vapuriva yauvanabandhamaṅganāyāḥ
te cālaṃkārā yathāsthānaṃ niveśyamānā eva sahṛdayarañjanakṣamā iti kavīñśikṣayati—
dīrghāpāṅgaṃ nayanayugalaṃ bhūṣayatyañjanaśrī- stuṅgābhogau prabhavati kucāvarcituṃ hārayaṣṭiḥ
madhye kṣāme vapuṣi labhate sthānakūrpāsalakṣmīḥ śroṇībimbe guruṇi raśanādāma śobhāṃ bibharti || 160
iti śrīmiśraratneśvaraviracite ratnadarpaṇanāmni sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇavivaraṇe guṇavivecano nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ
iti śrīmahārājādhirājabhojadevena viracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇanāmni alaṃkāraśāstre guṇavivecanaṃ nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ
evaṃ doṣaguṇeṣu nirṇīteṣvalaṃkārāḥ prāptāvasarāstatrālaṃkārasāmānyalakṣaṇamādyaparicchede tadvibhāgaṃ darśayanparicchedatrayaṃ saṃgamayati—
guṇaprastāve bāhyatvādikaṃ vivṛtaṃ śabdo'vacchedakatayā prathamapratisaṃdheyabhāvena ca śarīrasthānīyo bāhyastatastadāśrayā alaṃkārā api bāhyāḥ
artho vicchedyatayā paścādanusaṃdheyatayā cātmatulya ābhyantarastena tadāśrayā alaṃkārā apyābhyantarāḥ
tatko'tra kaveḥ śaktivyutpattyoraṃśo yenālaṃkāratā syādityata āha—seti
asti ca saṃskṛtāderapi tathābhāva iti bhāvaḥ
yadyapyarthaucitī pūrvaṃ darśayitumucitā tathāpi prādhānyamāvedayituṃ pṛthaktaucitīmāha—
na mlecchitavyaṃ yajñādau strīṣu nāprākṛtaṃ vadet
yathā hi—devatāstutyādau saṃskṛtaṃ pragalbhate na tathā prākṛtādi
yathā ca sūkṣmavastusvarūpoṭṭaṅkane prākṛtasya sauṣṭhavaṃ na tathā saṃskṛtāderityādi
bahmannityādinā nindārthānuvādena gauḍeṣu prākṛtānaucityaṃ rājaśekhareṇa vyañjitam
tā imāḥ parasparasaṃkīrṇāḥ ṣaḍeva saṃskṛtādibhāṣā bhavantīti sāmānyavibhāgametadviracanaprayojanaṃ copasaṃharati—
giraḥ śravyā divyāḥ prakṛtamadhurāḥ prākṛtadhurāḥ subhavyo'pabhraṃśaḥ sarasaracanaṃ bhūtavacanam
vidagdhānāmiṣṭe magadhamathurāvāsibhaṇiti- rnibaddhā yasteṣāṃ sa iha kavirājo vijayate || 16
tacca bhūtavacanaṃ sa cāpabhraṃśastāśca divyādyā iti ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena’ ityekaśeṣaḥ
pratibhārthaprāṇānāṃ jīvadvarṇanānipuṇo hi kaviḥ, sa eva hi sarvapathīnatādṛguktisiddhisaṃpannaḥ kavirājaḥ, ata eva vijayate sakalalokaśāstravacananirmātṛbhyaḥ prakarṣeṇa vartata iti
saṃskṛtādiṣu yathāyogaṃ śuddhādibhedena jātiḥ ṣoḍhā bhidyata ityāha—
iha bhāṣārūpaviṣayabhedena bhinnāḥ saṃskārā yānadhikṛtya pāṇini-vararuci-prabhṛtīnāmanuśāsanāni vyavatiṣṭante
tadyatraika eva saṃskāraḥ pratyabhijñāyate sā śuddhā
yatra tu lakṣaṇasaṃbhedena nānāsaṃskārasaṃpātaḥ kṣīranīravatsā sādhāraṇī
yā punaḥ prakṛtibhāvenāpi bhāṣāntarasaṃparkaṃ na sahate sānanyagāminī
saṃskārasaṃbhedena vā prakṛtibhāvena vā nānyaṃ gacchati yato'paśabdarūpā sāpabhraṣṭā
hastatalanihitaikakapolāyāstādṛkpulakitaikakapoladarśanādatimānātmā śṛṅgāraḥ suprabuddha iva tatkālaṃ nāyakasyāpīti mitho'nubandhalakṣaṇāpūrvānurāgakakṣāmadhirūḍhā ratireva kāvyasarvasvāyate
‘tujjha ṇa āṇe hiaaṃ mama uṇa maaṇo diā a rattiṃ a
ṇikkiva tavei valiaṃ tuha juttamanorahāiṃ aṅgāiṃ || 2 ||’
tava na jāne hṛdayaṃ mama punarmadano divā ca rātriṃ ca
aṇiśaṃ ca piāmi śoṇide valiśaśade śamale huvīadi || 3 ||’
aniśaṃ ca pibāmi śoṇitaṃ varṣaśataṃ samaro bhaviṣyati ||]
aniśaṃ ca pibāmi śoṇitaṃ varṣaśataṃ samaro bhaviṣyati
’ evaṃ nāma devīkope bhagavataḥ praṇayakātaratā yena yugapadiva sarvābhirapi mūrtibhiḥ praṇamatīti pratīyamānotprekṣā
‘tuṃ si mae cūaṅkura dipṇo kāmassa gahidadhaṇuhassa
‘lai vappula pia duddhaṃ katto amhāṇahuṃ chāsi
puttahumatthe hattho jai dahi jammevi jaa āsi || 6 ||’
putrakamastake hasto yadi dadhi janmanyapi jātamāsīt ||]
tena kaverabhiprāyaśaktyādibhyaḥ sarvā api sarvaprayojyā bhavanti
puttahumatthe iti śapathaḥ, putrasya mastakenāhaṃ śape yadi takrasya vyāpakaṃ daghi janmanyapi jātamāsīditi vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ prayuktā
yathā mālatyāṃ saṃskṛtamāśritya ‘eṣo'smi bhoḥ kāryavaśātprayogavaśācca prākṛtabhāṣī saṃvṛttaḥ’ ityādi
yatra vā kavervyutpattikṛto bhāṣāviparyāsaḥ śaktyā tiraskriyate

yathā sargabandhādau madhyamāderapi saṃskṛtameva, khaṇḍakathāparakathādau uttamāderapi prākṛtameva, bṛhatkathādau paiśācameva, vastubandhādāvapabhraṃśa eveti, tatra saṃdhisaṃdhyaṅgaghaṭanāsauṣṭhavena rasaḥ puṣyatīti bharatamuniprabhṛtīnāmatiprakāśa eva panthāḥ
virasaṃ virahāyāsaṃ soḍhuṃ tava cittamasahaṃ me || 7 ||’

saṃskṛtasya prākṛtādisādhāraṇye pañca prakārāḥ, prākṛtasya śaurasenyādisādhāraṇye catvāraḥ, śaurasenyāḥ paiśācyādisādhāraṇye trayaḥ, paiśācyā māgadhyādisādhāraṇye dvau, māgadhyā apabhraṃśasādhāraṇye eka iti
dvivikalpe pañcadaśa prabhedāḥ, trivikalpe viṃśatiḥ, caturvikalpe pañcadaśa, pañcavikalpe ṣaṭ, ṣaḍvikalpe ekaḥ, iti sarvamilane saptapañcāśatprakārā sādhāraṇī
evaṃ miśrādāvapi loṣṭaprastāvakrameṇa bahavo bhedā iti tāvadudāharaṇe granthagauravaṃ syāditi diṅmātramudāharati—tāsviti

madhyamapātraprakṛtyucito rāgādyabhinayastatra tiṣṭhati tatparigraheṇa tricatura(?)gavatsāmājikānāṃ samyaṅmithyāsaṃśayasādṛśyapratītivilakṣaṇapratipattipadavīmavataratīti madhyamapātrabhūmikāstham, upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam
tava virahāyāsaṃ soḍhuṃ mama cittamasahamiti yojanā

yadottamādiṣu nānāvaktṛbhirekā kāvyasamasyā kriyate, bhinnabhāṣocitavarṇanīyaviṣayaṃ vā kāvyamekamupakramyate, yadā vā śaktinirūpaṇāya kavereva nānābhāṣāmayaṃ kāvyamārabdhaṃ syāt, tadā kathaṃ nālaṃkārapadavīmadhyāste
‘akaṭagumaṭī candrajyotsnā kalaṃ kila koilo lavai a muhuryāmyo vāyurnivāara vāi a
avi sakhi alā raktāśokastavāpi manomude na kaja na kajaṃ mānenādya priyaṃ pratijāhudā || 10 ||’
tathā ca prayogaḥ—‘lavai a vijjūmaṇoharī’ ityārādhyāḥ
nivāara nirvañcako vārakaśūnyo vā idāvāraka iti
yadiha māno na kriyeta jyotsnādayo manomudamevādhāsyantīti prarocanā
yadā tu ‘manonude’ iti pāṭho'piśabdena nāyakasādhāraṇamutkaṇṭhākāritvamuktaṃ candrajyotsnādīnāmiti
ato nakajanakajannārtho nārtha īrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇena pratikūlabhāvāvalambinā mānena, tasmātpriyameva pratijāhudā yāmaḥ, yadāmananti svayaṃ vā tatra gamanamiti
atra pūrvārdhapadāni saṃskṛta eva, uttarārdhapadāni prākṛta eva
kāvyasamasyā krīḍā, uktapūrvā goṣṭhī, tatra vinodo manonukūlena samayātivāhanam
nanu mā bhūtprakṛtibhāvena bhāṣāntarasaṃbhedaḥ saṃskārasaṃpāte tu bhaviṣyati, tathā ca kathaṃ sādhāraṇīto bhidyata ityata āha—asādhāraṇī ceti
ārādhyāstu yathā sarastīre kamalarajaḥpaṅktiḥ prasṛtā śobhate tathā vidvadvaktreṣu bhīṣmavākyānītyupamākalpanayā kathaṃcidekavākyatāmāhuḥ
‘muddhe gahaṇaaṃ geṇhau taṃ dhari muddaṃ ṇie hatthe
ṇicchau sundari tuha uvari mama suraappahā atthi || 12 ||’
[mugdhe grahaṇakaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dhāraya mudrāṃ nije haste
sarva eva hi laukikaḥ padārtho'bhinayakakṣāmadhirūḍhaḥ parityajya grāmyamabhimukhībhūto vibhāvādiṣu kathaṃ nālaṃkārastadidamuktaṃ prayogata iti
anukaraṇe tu sarveṣāmiti doṣasāmānyāvalambinā guṇībhāvenāsya viṣayīkṛtatvāditi
nānāvacchinnajātiḥ kāvyaśarīre niviśata iti tadavacchedarūpāṃ gatimanantaraṃ lakṣayati—
padyaṃ gadyaṃ ca miśraṃ ca kāvyaṃ yatsā gatiḥ smṛtā
paṭhitiparimāṇaṃ ca kāvyaṃ samāśrayata iti tadapi gatistacca padyādibhedena trividhamiti saṃkṣepaḥ
ata eva gadyabandhe tu kaiścidvṛttamāśritaṃ vṛttaṃ vartanamiyatteti yāvaditi
sarvanāmaśabdā hi kadāciduddeśyasya liṅgamāśrayante kadācitpratinirdeśyasyeti kāvye yatsā gatirityuktam
tatra padyaṃ catuṣpadīti na lakṣaṇamullālamātrādau dvipadapañcapadādiśarīre tadabhāvāt
tasmācchandoniyamavatī kāvyam, atathābhūtā tu gadyamiti vibhāgaḥ
kavituṃ kaścana dvābhyāṃ kāvye'rthaḥ kaścana tribhiḥ || 19
yathā hyaṭavīvarṇanādau gadyaṃ pragalbhate tathā na padyam, yathā ca kāvyaśāstratānirvahaṇocite'rthe padyamutsahate na tathā gadyamityādi
evaṃ kathākhyāyikādau gadyameva, campūprabhṛtau miśramevetyādipadopāttabandhaucitī draṣṭavyā
āstāṃ tāvadarthādyaucityagaveṣaṇaṃ svarūpeṇaiva padyādikaṃ parisphuratkavipratibhāviśeṣāvedanena sahṛdayāvarjakamavasīyate
gatyāṃ gatyāmiyaṃ devī vicitrā hi sarasvatī || 20
sa cāyaṃ saṃdarbhāvacchedo gurulaghusaṃniveśenaiva śobhata iti tamāśritya vibhāgamāha—
padye gadye ca miśre ca ṣaṭprakāropajāyate || 23
na gadyādikameva gatiḥ kiṃtu tadādhāraḥ paṭhitisaṃcāra iti vyanakti-padye gadye ca miśre ceti
tatra vṛttaṃ ca jātiṃ ca padyamāhuratho pṛthak
nanu lalitādayo gadyabhedāḥ kaiścidalaṃkārakāraiḥ parisaṃkhyātāste kasmānnocyanta ityata āha—
na khalu saṃnipātamātreṇodabindurapi grāvaṇi nimnatāmādadhāti’ iti
tathā lalitaṃ kaiśikyādau, niṣṭhurabhārabhaṭyādau, cūrṇaṃ vaidarbhyādau, āviddhaṃ gauḍīyāprabhṛtau, yathāyathamantarbhavatīti noktabhedāḥ parisaṃkhyātā ityarthaḥ
aruṇakarodgama eṣa vartate varatanu saṃpravadanti kukkuṭāḥ || 13 ||’
atra pratipādamaṣṭau laghavaścatvāro gurava iti laghubāhulye saṃyogākṣarāṇāmudreke ca tālalayavadativyakta eva drutabhāvaḥ
atra yadyapi padacatuṣṭaye gurulaghūnāṃ samasaṃkhyatvameva, tathāpi saṃyogākṣarairantarāntarā paṭhitidīrghābhāvonmeṣādārohaprādhānye vilambitā
vadanti sma balaṃ bāhvoḥ sitacchatrasmitāḥ śriyaḥ || 15 ||’
atra yadyapi guravo bahavastathāpi na drutirna vilambanaṃ paṭhiterityanubhavasākṣiko'yamarthastadetadāha—nātilaghvakṣareti
tadetasmin drutavilambitākhye vṛtte samākhyaiva rūpaṃ bodhayatīti
‘api turagasamīpādutpatantaṃ mayūraṃ na sa rucirakalāpaṃ bāṇalakṣyīcakāra

utpannāvirbhavadbarhagatojjvalavicitrakomalamayūrastatkālamavyājapremaniryantraṇakaṇṭhagrahavilulitapriyākeśapāśavāsanāvikāsahetuḥ sarvasvāyamānaḥ kathaṃ bāṇalakṣyatāṃ sahata iti cvipratyayena vyajyata iti
atra pādacatuṣke'pi prathamaṃ drutā paścānmadhyā ca bhāgaśaḥ pratyabhijñāyata ityāha—seyamiti
atrāpi pratipādaṃ pūrvaṃ madhyā tato vilambitā ca khaṇḍaśaḥ pratibhāsata iti darśayati—seyamiti
‘vihitāṃ priyayā manaḥ priyāmatha niścitya giraṃ garīyasīm
‘pātāla—’ ityādau vasantatilakābhāga iva, ‘hara iva’ ityādāvāryābhāga iva pratibhātīti
padyagandhigadye vṛttagandhau madhyā, jātigandhau drutā yathā—
aviralamiva dāmnā pauṇḍarīkeṇa naddhaḥ snapita iva ca dugdhastrotasāṃ nirjhareṇa
kavalita iva kṛtsnaścakṣuṣā sphāritena prasabhamamṛtavarṣeṇaiva sāndreṇa siktaḥ || 23 ||’
āścaryastimitasya hantetyeva vāganubhāvastato'bhimānonmeṣe puṇyavānasmīti anantaraṃ lokottaravibhāvavarṇanāttvaritasya yadahamityāgadyaparyavasāna evāviralamityādivṛttamāvirāsīditi
atra bālasuhṛdā makarandena saha vidyāmānvīkṣikīmadhīte sa eṣa mādhavo nāma iti
tenaikasminvarṇanīyavastuni vṛttaprapañcenokte prakṛtasaṃgatimātraṃ gadyena kṛtavatīti yukteyamānupūrvī vākyaikavākyatā ceti
vaidarbhādikṛtaḥ panthāḥ kāvye mārga iti smṛtaḥ
teṣāmanyonyamīlanakṣamatayā pānakarasa iva, guḍamaricādīnāṃ khāḍava iva madhurāmlādīnāṃ yatsaṃmūrcchanarūpāvasthāntaragamanaṃ tatsaṃskārādeva hi lokaśāstrapadaracanātaḥ kāvyarūpā ca racanā vyāvartate
vaidarbhādayo vidarbhādideśaprabhavāstaiḥ kṛtamukhahevākagocaratayā prakaṭito na tu tattaddeśaiḥ kāvyasya kiṃcidupakriyate
kathaṃ punaruktamupamāde rītipadaṃ pravṛttamityata āha—rīṅ gatāviti
riyante paramparayā gacchantyanayeti karaṇasādhano'yaṃ rītiśabdo mārgaparyāya ityarthaḥ

tadīyāḥ svarāstantrīkaṇṭhotthitāḥ sthānakramavaiparītyānumeyaśārīrāḥ pratibimbabhāvāḥ ṣaḍjādayasteṣu śrutasaṃmūrcchanarūpeṣvapi mithovibhaktāḥ śrutayaḥ śrotrarañjakasvarāvasthāmāpannāḥ samastagāndharvavitsākṣikāḥ prakāśante
ata eva vīṇaiva pradhānaṃ samastasya svarajātasya tatraiva śrutimaṇḍalonmeṣāditi
yadā tu pānakādinyāyena kaścidaṃśa udito bhavati tadā rītyantaramuttiṣṭhatītyāha—
madhurāṃ sukumārāṃ ca pāñcālīṃ kavayo viduḥ || 30
ata evaujaḥprakāśakaḥ ṣaḍadhikeṣu padeṣu samāso na kriyate
mādhuryasaukumāryayoḥ kiṃcidudbhavena nimīlanāṅgaprādhānyena vāntarālakalpanā tāṃ vyanakti—dvitrairiti
dve trīṇi vā trīṇi catvāri veti vārthe bahuvrīhiḥ
ekāṃ rītimupakramya yadanyayā saṃdarbhanirvahaṇamasāvanya eva prakāraḥ
‘manīṣitāḥ santi gṛheṣu devatāstapaḥ kva vatse kva ca tāvakaṃ vapuḥ
padaṃ saheta bhramarasya pelavaṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ na punaḥ patatriṇaḥ || 25 ||’
atra dīrghasamāsābhāve kathamoja iti kasyacitkudeśyamaparītimatprakaraṇa evetyapāstam
etena guṇanavakasya samakakṣatayā saṃbhedaḥ kṣaṇa iti
atrādyatṛtīyayoḥ ṣaḍ dvitīye ca pañca padāni samastāni
śliṣṭā prāptā yathāsaṃkhyamojaḥkāntinimīlanalabdhaprādurbhāvā ślathā purāṇī ca cchāyā yayeti vigrahaḥ
‘etāni niḥsahatanorasamañjasāni śūnyaṃ manaḥ piśunayanti padāni tasyāḥ
ete ca mārgataravaḥ prathayanti tāpa- mālambitojjhitapariglapitaiḥ pravālaiḥ || 28 ||’
‘niḥsahatanorasamañjasāni’ ‘mārgataravaḥ’ iti dve dve pade, ‘ālambita-’ ityādau trīṇi padāni samastāni
ayasudayatītyādyasamāsena vaidarbhī ca pratyabhijñāyata iti pūrvoktasamastarītisaṃbheda iti
atra pūrvārdhe yathoktābhāvantīmupakramya caramārdhe gauḍīyāparigrahādupakrāntarīteranirvāhaḥ khaṇḍanam, tathāpi ca na cchāyāvairūpyamiti kaviśaktivyañjakatvādalaṃkārabhāva iti
yā vikāse'tha vikṣepe saṃkoce vistare tathā
cetaso vartayitrī syātsā vṛttiḥ sāpi ṣaḍvidhā || 34
sa ca vyāpāraḥ sattvādyudrekalakṣaṇo janmāntarānubhavabhāvitavāsanāsamutthaḥ paripūrṇībhaviṣyadrasāsvādasarvasvāyamānacittāvasthanidānabhūto'rthagataḥ pañcame'bhidhāsyate
śabdagataḥ punaratra saṃgataḥ saṃdarbhasya rasaprakāśakāraṇeṣu pradhānatvāt
vartate'nayā cittamiti karaṇasādhano'yaṃ vṛttiśabda iti vartayitrītyanena prayojakavyāpārapradhānena darśitam
ata eva śuktirajatavadbhāvodaye'pi doṣamahimnaiva kāvyamahimnā tavdyañjanāt
tatsamānabhūmikayā hāsyo rasaḥ prādurbhavatītyabhisaṃdhāyāha—‘śṛṅgārāddhi bhaveddhāsyam’ iti bharatamuniḥ
ata eva samānabhūmikayā ‘raudrācca karuṇo rasaḥ’ ityāha
nyagbhūtarajoguṇasya prabuddhatamasaścetaso'vasthāviśeṣaḥ sasaṃkocastamālambya bībhatsaḥ prādurāste tadekabhūmikaśca bhayānaka iti ‘bībhatsācca bhayānakaḥ’ ityāha
‘śaśiruciṣu daleṣu nāgavallyā vicakiladāmani candane ca hṛdye
seyamarthasya ca saṃdarbhasya ca saukumāryātkaiśikī nāma vṛttiḥ

niyamitādiṣu mugdhāṅganācumbanarasotsukānāmatimanojñādhararāgasamarpakeṣu nāgalatādaleṣu, tato mānaparigrahe valitakādicumbanaviśeṣārthinīnāṃ kacagrahasaubhāgyasundare mallikādāmni, tataḥ sarvāṅgīṇāśleṣasaubhāgyārthakacandanarase'nantaramīrṣyāroṣavāsanāniḥśeṣakeliyantraṇaratotkaṇṭhitānāṃ sīdhupātre, tataḥ sarvopakaraṇajīvitasarvasve priyatame samakakṣatayaiva dṛṣṭayaḥ peturiti
seyaṃ kaiśikī masṛṇe śṛṅgārādau viniyujyata iti
‘yo yaḥ śastraṃ bibharti svabhujagurumadaḥ pāṇḍavīnāṃ camūnāṃ yo yaḥ pāñcālagotre śiśuradhikavayā garbhaśayyāṃ gato vā
yo yastatkarmasākṣī carati mayi raṇe yaśca yaśca pratīpaḥ krodhāndhastasya tasya svayamiha jagatāmantakasyāntako'ham || 32 ||’
yasmādiyamārabhaṭī dīpte raudrādau viniyuktā, tena yuktaṃ śabdārthayoḥ prauḍhatvamiti
‘uttiṣṭhantyā ratānte bharamuragapatau pāṇinaikena kṛtvā dhṛtvā cānyena vāso vigalitakabarībhāramaṃse vahantyāḥ
bhūyastatkālakāntidviguṇitasurataprītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyāmāliṅgya nītaṃ vapuralasalasadbāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu || 33 ||’

sarvāṅgīṇāśleṣasamutsuke priyatame bahirvyāvartanamantaranuvartanaṃ ca mugdhāṅganājātiriti nyāyena nīvībandhakeśapāśasaṃyamārthinyā nirbharakelikhedena bhujalatālasaṃ lasatyeva na tu vyāpārayitumapi śakyeti tatkāliko'tipoṣaḥ
atra masṛṇe'pi rase vṛttyaucityena saṃdarbhasya prauḍhirucitaiva
dīrghasamāso hi śrṛṅgārādau niṣiddho na tu prauḍhiḥ
‘vandyau dvāvapi tāvanāryacaritaprāptapratāpodayau bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ sa ca munirbhāsvatkuṇṭhārāyudhaḥ
ekenāmṛtavadvidārya karajaiḥ pītānyasṛñji dviṣāmanyenāpi hatāhitāsrasarasi snātaṃ krudhaḥ śāntaye || 34 ||’
seyaṃ prauḍhārthā nātiprauḍhasaṃdarbhā sāttvatī nāma vṛttiḥ
‘kiṃ dvāri daivahatake sahakārakeṇa saṃvardhitena viṣapādapa eṣa pāpaḥ
seyaṃ sukumāre'rthe prauḍhasaṃdarbhā madhyamakaiśikī nāma vṛttiḥ
‘tvaṃ nāgarāja bahumasya nitambabhāgaṃ bhogena gāḍhamupaveṣṭaya mandarādreḥ
seyaṃ prauḍhe'rthe sukumārasaṃdarbhā madhyamārabhaṭī nāma vṛttiḥ
prakṛtipariṇāmaḥ, parapurapraveśaḥ, khaṇḍasaṃghātyam, cūlikā, parimala iti pañca yonijakāvyabhedāḥ
ṇahayā avasāhāo ṇia avvāṇa vayaḍi gaāo disāo ||’
iharai arayā aliaṃ vittharadi disāhiṃ kaṭṭhiaṃ vaṇahaalam ||’
atrākāśadiśāṃ vistārabhaṇanaṃ manāgvikṛtamupalakṣyata iti prakṛtipariṇāmanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
‘devādhipo vā bhujagādhipo vā dharādhipo vā yadi haihayaḥ syām
saṃdarśanaṃ te guṇakīrtanaṃ te sevāñjaliṃ te tadahaṃ vidadhyām ||’
garbhagranthiṣu pañcaṣāḥ sumanaso badhnanti cūtadrumāḥ saṃprāptāḥ prakaṭībhavanti kurarīkaṇṭheṣu kūjormayaḥ ||’
atra kāvyacatuṣkāducchidya pādacatuṣṭayaṃ grathitamiti khaṇḍasaṃghātyanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
‘ubhau rambhāstambhāvupari viparītau kamalayo- stadūrdhvaṃ ratnāśmasthalamapi durūhaṃ kimapi yat
tataḥ kumbhau paścādvisakisalaye kandalamatho tadanvindāvindīvaramadhukarāḥ kiṃ punaridam ||’
‘anena yūnā saha pārthivena rambhoru kaccinmanaso ruciste
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau māsānetāngamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 37 ||’
locane mīlayitvetyanena lokoktyanukāreṇa nayananimīlanavadāśubhāvitā samāgamasamayasya pratipādyate
tathā ca—sukumāratarakāntājī vitādhyavasāyābhiprāyaḥ pravāsavipralambhāviṣṭacetasaḥ prakāśito bhavatīti
seyaṃ tasmai nṛpaśave nama iti vidagdhokteranukṛtiśchekokticchāyā
‘kiṃ sa svargataruḥ ko'pi yasya puṣpaṃ niśākaraḥ
te vṛkṣāḥ kīdṛśā mātaryeṣāṃ muktāphalaṃ phalam || 39 ||’
nūnaṃ trijagadvartisakalārthisārthakīkaraṇavikhyātakīrteḥ pārijātapramukhasya kasyacidekaḥ stabakaḥ sudhābhirāhlādayannayamavaloke dṛśyata ityādi
‘dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ sutanu kiṃ kurute kimasmadvārtāṃ sa pṛcchati śrṛṇoti nivedyamānām
āstāṃ kimasya kathayā kathayāśu tāvadatrāgamiṣyati na vā khalu so'bhimānī || 40 ||’
kathamityādinā tadekatānatāmāviṣkṛtya sahasaivāstāmityādinā saṃprahāṇam, kathaya tāvadityādinā ca punarādānamasamañjasam
‘pi pi priya sa sa svayaṃ mu mu mukhāsavaṃ dehi me ta ta tyaja du du drutaṃ bha bha bha bhājanaṃ kāñcanam
iti skhalitajalpitaṃ madavaśātkuraṅgīdṛśaḥ prage hasitahetave sahacarībhiradhyaiyata || 42 ||’

yadyapi saṃpūrṇameva kāvyaṃ vaktrabhiprāyapraticchandakabhūtam, uktaṃ ca—‘vakrabhiprāyaṃ sūcayeyuḥ’ iti, tathāpi nāsminnitarasādhāraṇatayā vākyārthagocaramabhiprāyamāvedayatyeva kāvyasanāthīkaraṇakṣamavakrabhiprāyaviśeṣapratirūpaka ekadeśaniveśo dṛśyate
‘nirmālyaṃ nayanaśriyaḥ kuvalayaṃ vakrasya dāsaḥ śaśī bhrūyugmasya sanābhi manmathadhanurjyotsnā smitasyāñcalaḥ
saṃgītasya ca mattakokilarutānyucchiṣṭameṇīdṛśaḥ sarvāṅgīṇamaho vidheḥ pariṇataṃ vijñānacitraṃ cirāt || 43 ||’
atra nirmālyaṃ, dāsaḥ, sanābhi, añcalaḥ, ucchiṣṭamiti padānāṃ gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇa mutpradāyināṃ sābhiprāyaniveśādiyaṃ padamudrā
‘tālā jāanti guṇā jālā te sahi~aehi~ dheyyanti
ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyapi |’
‘yatsvacche salilātmani pratiphaladdeve triyāmāpatau pīyūṣākṛti paryavasyati kila jyotsneti tattvāntaram
tigmaṃ dhāma ciraṃ cakāsti divi yattatrāsti divyaḥ pumānyaṃ vijñātavatāṃ truṭanti nikhilā bhūyo bhavagranthayaḥ || 44 ||’
atra ‘tatrāsti divyaḥ pumān’ ityādervākyāntarasya pūrvavākyopakāritvena mutpradāyakasyābhiprāyapūrvaniveśādiyaṃ vākyamudrā
ādityakalā eva prati phalitāścandravyapadeśaṃ labhanta ityāgamaḥ
deve pīyūṣākṛti tattvāntaraṃ tigmaṃ dhāma cakāstīti ca yadagādhatayā tarkitamiti kilaśabdakaṭākṣitamabhidhānam
tathā hi—‘ya eṣa ādityapathaṃ vyāpya puruṣo dīpyate’ ityādyupaniṣadarthaniveśanamabhiprāyapūrvakamābhāsate
‘śriyaḥ pradugdhe vipado ruṇaddhi yaśāṃsi sūte malinaṃ pramārṣṭi
saṃskāraśaucena paraṃ punīte śuddhā hi buddhiḥ kila kāmadhenuḥ || 45 ||’
atra pradugdhe, ruṇaddhi, sūte, pramārṣṭi, punīte, iti tiṅvibhaktīnāṃ ‘duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayorupasaṃkhyānam’ (3
śriyaḥ, vipadaḥ, yaśāṃsi, malinaṃ saṃskāraśaucena, iti ca subvibhaktīnām ‘aci śnudhātubhruvāṃ yvoriyaṅuvaṅau’ (6
buddhirūpā kāmadhenuḥ śriyaḥ prathayatītyukte na tathā prakarṣaḥ, yathokte tu viśiṣṭaḥ kaverabhiprāya unnīyate
tathā hi—yathodumbaraḥ sa lohitaṃ phalaṃ pacyata iti karmakartari phalodumbarayoraikātmyabhavasīyate tathehāpi śrīrūpamātmānaṃ buddhiḥ prakāśayatīti
śriya iti prakṛtibhāge iyaṅādeśo vikāro vibhaktāvapi vikāraḥ
tathā śriya iti māṅgalyam, vipada iti viparītamiti krameṇa śuddhā buddhiḥ kāmadhenuriti
maṅgalaparamparāniveśanenopasaṃhāraścitrāṃśukojjvala iva pratibhāsamāno nu bimbamiva kāmapi kāntimabhivyañjayattūpalakṣyate
‘viśvabharā bhagavatī bhavatīmasūta rājā prajāpatisamo janakaḥ pitā te
teṣāṃ vadhūstvamasi nandini pārthivānāṃ yeṣāṃ kuleṣu savitā ca gururvayaṃ ca || 46 ||’
atra vayamityātmani bahuvacanena savitā ceti savitaryekavacanena saviturapyahaṃ bahumata ityabhiprāyo vakturitīyaṃ vacanamudrā
132) iti bhūtavadbhāvasya hayagrīvaprabhāvātiśayaśaṃsinaḥ samuccayadvāreṇa niveśādiyaṃ samuccayamudrā
gatamiti niṣṭhāpratyayena bhūtatādyotanādāśaṃsāpratītāvapi kathaṃ prakṛtapoṣa ityata uktam—samuccayadvāreṇeti
tena hi tulyakakṣatāpratītau tvaṃ cedaṅgīkṛtaroṣastadā siddhameva samīhitamiti vakturadhyavasāyaviśeṣaprartītau samuccaya eva mudrāpadavīmārohatīti
labdhaṃ yenādyayogena tena kiṃ kīrtitena vaḥ || 48 ||’
atra ‘kathāpi khalu pāpānāmalamaśreyase yataḥ’, tataḥ ‘kiṃ tena vaḥ kīrtitena’ iti sābhiprāyasaṃvṛtikaraṇādiyaṃ saṃvṛtimudrā
vidhidvāreṇa vā yatra niṣedhenātha vā punaḥ
tarhi gorapatyamayaṃ gaurityataḥ ko bheda ityāśaṅkya vidhidvāreṇa vetyādi
loke gṛhītavyutpattibalena bhāvābhāvānyatarasaṃvitsaraṇimāruhya kāvyaikagocare rasādyātmani paryavasyantī bhavatyuktiralaṃkāra iti bhāvaḥ
so'yaṃ bhāvādiprapañcena ṣoḍhā vidhiḥ prathata ityāha—
śuśrūṣasveti, bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhava dakṣiṇeti dve vihite
mā sma pratīpaṃ gama iti, bhogeṣvanutsekinīti dve niṣiddhe
‘eko netā kṣatriyo vā dvijo vā ekā vidyādhyātmikī vā trayī vā
ekā bhāryā vaṃśajā vā priyā vā ekaṃ mitraṃ bhūpatirvā yatirvā || 50 ||’
viśeṣaṇasaṃgata evakāraḥ kevalaviśeṣaṇayogasyāsaṃbhave vyutpattivaśena tadabhāvaṃ vyavacchindanyogavyāvṛttāvavatiṣṭhate
pārtha eveti viśeṣyasaṃgata evaśabdastadanyasya dhanurdharatārūpaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vyāvartayannanyayogavyavacchedadyotako bhavati
kevalamiti abhinandanasya nāyogaṃ navānyayogaṃ vyavacchinatti, kiṃ tu tatsaṃbandhaṃ bodhayannātyantikamayogamatyantāyogavyavacchedo'bhidhīyate
kucayorasyāḥ kāṭhinyaṃ na vacanādāviti viśeṣavidhī śeṣaniṣedhamanujānītaḥ
vāmena na paśyati dakṣiṇena tu paśyatyeva
kimasatkimaśobhanam ? yadyasmai na rocate itarattu sadeveti viśeṣaniṣedhau śeṣavidhyabhyanujñāviṣayāviti
pūrvaṃ padaikavākyatā tato vākyaikavākyatvamanantaraṃ prakaraṇaikavākyatvamiti prabandhanirvahaṇaṃ yāvatkavivyāpāraḥ

tatra ‘gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ daṇḍena’ ityādīnāṃ loke gṛhītavyutpattīnāmeva yadyapi kāvyānupraveśastathāpi bhaṅgībhaṇitisanāthānyeva kāvyapaddhatimadhyāsata ityaprahatānāmupādeyatve yatrāpātataḥ parasparamanvayo na pratibhāsate tatrāvaśyaṃ kavinā svābhiprāyapraticchandakabhūtaviśeṣaniveśanena vivakṣitavākyārthapratītyaskhalanaṃ vidheyam, ata eva vaicitryādalaṃkāratā
śabdāthā śabdaḥ padaṃ vākyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ prabandhaḥ
padaṃ caiva padārthaśca vākyaṃ vākyārtha eva ca
yadyapi padānāmarthadvāraka eva saṃbandhaḥ, tathāpi tadaupayikaviśeṣaḥ kvacitpadeṣveva sākṣādavasīyate kvacitpadārtheṣvityabhipretyāha—
yojanā yeha tāṃ yuktiṃ padārthaviṣayāṃ viduḥ || 47

atra jambhajiddvipa iti yogarūḍhiparamparā, hayāṅganāsyahutabhugiti paryāyaparamparā, prātarjātamadonmiṣatkamalinīkiñjalkakalkodbhaṭamiti hetuparamparā, nabhaḥkaṭāhakuharakroḍamityaṅgāṅgigabhāvaparamparā ca parisphurantī dṛśyate
tadetadubhayaṃ yogenātiprayujyamānaṃ nirūḍhidvayena vivakṣitairāvatarūpe vastuni niyamyate
madasya kiñjalkonmeṣe tasya kalke tasyāpyudbhaṭatāyāṃ hetubhāva iti kāryakāraṇaparamparā
tasyāṅgamekadeśaḥ kuharaṃ tasyāpi kroḍa ityaṅgāṅgigaparamparā ca yathābhimatapadaikavākyatānidānamiti tadetad vyācaṣṭe—atreti
vārāhyā iti narmaṇībhavadanaḥ paśyanyadāsyā mukhaṃ nābhiṣṭauti hasanna nindati tadā śliṣṭo'mbayā pātu vaḥ || 54 ||’
atra strīpuṃsākṛtīti viruddhajātiyojanā, nābhiṣṭauti na nindatīti viruddhakriyāyojanā, ramyogramiti viruddhaguṇayojanā, mukhe vapurīkṣāmahe iti viruddhadravyayojanā ca lakṣyate
nāgendrakaravadūruḥ pārvatībhāge, dorbāhuśca devabhāge, karikumbhavatpīnaḥ stano devībhāge, aṃsaḥ skandhaśca devabhāge evaṃvidhatvatpiturīśvarasya vapustvanmukhe
ekaviṣāṇatayā karikariṇīsamāhārātmani vīkṣāmaha iti vārāhyāḥ parihāsoktiḥ

strītvapuṃstvayoḥ parasparaparihāreṇopalambhādviruddhayorapi tvatpiturityanena stutinindayoḥ pratiṣedhena ramyatābhīṣaṇatayorbhāgavyavasthayā mukhavapuṣoḥ sādṛśyenābhito'bhiprāyapratibimbitena yojanā vihiteti tatpratipādakānāṃ padānāmekavākyatāsiddhiḥ
‘diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭā mahī sādhyate siddhā sā ca vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata
viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namo yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam || 55 ||’
atra vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyateti vākyagarbhaḥ
kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai nama iti vākyasaṃvṛttiḥ
garbhavākyena samarpyamāṇaprakṛtarasānvayini rase prakarṣādhāyako nigūḍho garbho nigarbha ityucyate
viprāya pratipādyate saṃpannā tairabhujyata ityādi vaktavye kimaparamityasya saṃvṛttitvena yojanā
evaṃ hi kiyadasya mahānubhāvasya tādṛśācaritaṃ prāpyate tadiha maunamevocitamiti bhūyānprakarṣo'vasīyate
‘yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam’ iti vākyadvayasya pūrvavākyagatatarkārthasamuccayavācinā cakāreṇa yojanā vyaktaiva
‘tiṣṭha dvāri bhavāṅgaṇe vraja bahiḥ sadmeti vartmekṣate śālāmañca tamaṅgamañca valabhīmañceti veśmāñcati
dūtiṃ saṃdiśa saṃdiśeti bahuśaḥ saṃdiśya sāste tathā talpe kalpamayīva nirghṛṇa yathā nāntaṃ niśā gacchati || 56 ||’
atra prathamapāde kriyāsamuccayaḥ, dvitīye kriyābhyāsaḥ, tṛtīye dūtīṃ saṃdiśa saṃdiśeti yāvatkriyāsamabhihāraḥ
śeṣe tu tathā sāste yathā niśāntaṃ na gacchatīti yattadorupādānaṃ vākyārthayukterhetuḥ pratīyate
‘dhūmajyotiḥsalilamarutāṃ saṃnipātaḥ kva meghaḥ saṃdeśārthāḥ kva paṭukaraṇaiḥ prāṇibhiḥ prāpaṇīyāḥ

nāyakasya sarvathā hṛdaya vaiśasaṃ sarvathaivāśraddadhānā dūradūrataradūratamarathyābhāgāvalokanārthinī śālāgṛhamārohati, tatastasmāduccaistamaṅgagam aṭṭālakam, anantaraṃ tasmāduccatarāṃ valabhīmuparitanakuṭīmiti
ata evāñcanakriyaivātrāvṛtteti ‘kriyāsamabhihāre loṭra loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ’ (3
evamapyanāgacchati nāyake dūtīvyāpāraḥ śaraṇaṃ yatkuṇṭhanāyāṃ svayaṃ vā tatra gamanamityupadiśyate tena tattadabhiprāyasaṃvardhakasaṃdeśaprakarṣaḥ so'yamābhīkṣṇyadviruktyā vyajyate
ata eva loṭaḥ samabhivyāhāro viṣayo na tu ghañādivadabhidheya iti pūrvācāryāḥ
itiśabdādadhikaṃ caturthavākyānupraviṣṭamiti yāvacchabdenāvacchinatti saṃdiśa saṃdiśeti yāvaditi dik
uktirabhidhānamuccāraṇakriyā lakṣaṇakriyā sā sarvavākyasādhāraṇī kathamalaṃkāra ityāśaṅkya prakārapadam
uktirūpatvāviśeṣe kathamayameva saṃgacchatāmityato vibhāgapradarśanavyājena viṣayaviśeṣādeva tadrūpatāmupapādayati—saṃbhava ityādi
tatra bahirasaṃbhāvyamānasyāpi pratibhānirbhitacitraturagavatpratītiḥ saṃbhavastāmarpayantī saṃbhāvanātmikā bhaṇitiḥ

saiva hi ‘kiṃtvasti kācidaparāpi padānupūrvī yasyāṃ na kiṃcidapi kiṃcidivāvabhāti’ iti nyāyena tattadarthanirmāṇapravīṇā ‘yathāsmai rocate viśvaṃ tathaiva parivartate’ iti vyavahārakāraṇaṃ bhavatīti tathāvidha eva viṣaye śāstraprasiddhaprakāravaiparītyena bādhavarṇanamasaṃbhāvanā
vāāsu ṭhiaṃ dīsai āmoa ghaṇaṃ va tucchaṃ va ||’

ataeveyaṃ niṣedharūpā tajjātīyavyāvṛtto dharmo viśeṣastaṃ kvacidvidadhānā kaverabhiprāyaviśeṣamarpayantī ‘niṣedhaprasaṅge viśeṣabhaṇitirvidhirūpā bhavati’ iti tāmavalambamānā camatkārakāriṇī viśeṣe paryavasyantī varṇanā pallavaprasaṅge saṃkocamavagāhamānā vidhau niṣedharūpā paryavasyati

atarkitopanataṃ vismayajanakamāścaryaṃ tasya niṣedhe vidhātavye yatkiṃcidvidhānaṃ tadāścaryarūpatāmantareṇa kāvyakakṣāmāroḍhuṃ na kṣamata iti nūnamanayā vismayārpaṇameva sarvasvabhūtamavalambanīyamiti niṣedhavidhi-prasaṅge niṣedharūpā bhaṇitirbahirasaṃbhāvinaḥ kvacidasato viśeṣasyotprekṣākalpanā
tāmāśrayantī vidhānaniṣedhamātreṇa caritārthā kiṃcidviśeṣaṃ vidadhātīti vidhiniṣedhaprasaṅge sāmānyataḥ pratiṣedhati viśeṣataśca vidhatta iti niṣedhavidhirūpā kalpanā bhaṇitiḥ
utsekyā kalaśībhirañjalipuṭaiḥ peyā mṛṇālāṅkurairmātavyā ca śaśinyamugdhavibhave sā vartate candrikā || 59 ||’

ketakodaradalānāṃ drāvaṇam, tataḥ srotorūpatā, tatastenopamitāyā bahalatarabahirbhāgasya kalaśībhirutsecanam, anantaraṃ kiṃcidalpībhūtamadhyabhāgasya karatalāñjalipuṭairmānam, tataḥ śeṣībhavataḥ sārabhāgasya mṛṇālāṅkuraiḥ pānamiti bahirasaṃbhāvina eva śriyaṃ bibhratīti nidarśanayā yogyapadenautsekyetyādibhiścamatkāriṇī saṃbhāvanā jāyate
‘kva peyaṃ jyotsnāmbho vadanabisavallīsaraṇibhirmṛṇālītantubhyaḥ sicayaracanā kutra bhavati
kva vā pārīmeyo bata bakuladāmnāṃ parimalaḥ kathaṃ svapnaḥ sākṣātkuvalayadṛśaṃ kalpayatu tām || 60 ||’
svapnasya sākṣātkalpane sāmarthyamasaṃbhāvitaṃ tadevamevocyamānaṃ tathā śobhāmunmīlayatīti kva peyamityādi prativastunā nirdeśavyaṅgyāraktisuṣamāvistāraṃ kurvāṇā bhavatyasaṃbhavabhaṇitiḥ
atra revatīdaśanocchiṣṭayorapi halidṛśoryatpūtatvaṃ, madakṣībasyāpi halino yatpāvanatvamasau viśeṣa itīyaṃ viśeṣabhaṇitirniṣedhe vidhirūpā
ucchiṣṭakṣībayorna kvacitpūtatvaṃ pāvanatvaṃ vā dṛṣṭacaramiti halinetrapuṭahalinorvidhīyamānaṃ devatācaritasya lokottaratāṃ gamayatīti niṣedhaprasaṅge vidhirūpeyaṃ bhaṇitiḥ

atra candramukhī dugdhadhavalanayanā bimboṣṭī karikumbhastanītyādikavisamayaprasiddhavarṇanāprapañcaprasaṅge yathoktarūpeṇa tasya saṃkoco niṣedhastatpratiṣṭhābhaṇitiralaṃkaraṇamevānayā kriyata iti kāntiviśeṣaṃ vyañjayantī vidhau prasakte niṣedharūpā bhavati
‘jyotirbhyastadidaṃ tamaḥ samuditaṃ jāto'yamabhdyaḥ śikhī pīyūṣādidamucchritaṃ viṣamayaṃ cchāyāptajanmātapaḥ
ko nāmāsya vidhiḥ praśāntiṣu bhavedbāḍhaṃ draḍhīyānayaṃ granthiryatpriyato'pi vipriyamidaṃ sakhyaḥ kṛtaṃ sāntvanaiḥ || 63 ||’

yadi jyotirādestamaḥprabhṛtīnāmudgamaḥ syādapi priyādapriyamiti sarvathaiva niṣedhe vidhātavye pratyakṣaparikalpitasyānyathākartumaśakyatvātprameyavirodhamasahamānā vidhatte ca niṣedhati ceti niṣedhavidhiprasaṅge vidhiniṣedharūpā bhaṇitirbhavati

yadyapi dvābhyāmekenālpīyasā ca netrābhyāṃ manasā sukṛtena ca vayaso yauvanasya dṛśyatvavibhāvanīyatvabhogyatvāni pratītimukhamavatīrṇāni, tathāpijīvitasarvasvabhūtāyāmitarakāminīsādhāraṇyāmitarasādhāraṇyamasahamāno dṛgādisāmānye sahasratvādikaṃ kalpayansādhāraṇadharmaniṣedhasaraṇimāruhya viśeṣaṃ vidhatte
seyaṃ bhaṇitirvidhiniṣedhaprasaṅge niṣedhaghaṭakadvārā vidhirūpā bhavatītyāstāṃ vistaraḥ
ekārthapratipādanāvacchinnaḥ śabdasamudāyo vākyam, tasminviṣayabhūte ānupūrvyeṇa granthanaṃ racanā, sā kathamatiprasaktāpyalaṃkāra ityata āha—samyagiti
tena dvayoreva gumphanā samāpyata ityāśayena śavdārthayorityuktam
rājyābhiṣekotsavajātaharṣāyāḥ karātpracyutasya sopānaparamparāsu skhalataḥ kāñcanakalaśasya bhūbhāgaprāptiryāvatkrameṇoccarantī śabdamālānukṛteti prakṛtārthānuguṇyam
evaṃ hi karacyutamapi na saṃbhāvayatīti ko'pi madaprakarṣo vyajyate
‘dikkālātmasamaiva yasya vibhutā yastatra vidyotate yatrāmuṣya sudhībhavanti kiraṇā rāśeḥ sa yāsāmabhūt
yastatpittamuṣaḥ sa yasya haviṣe yastasya jīvātave voḍhā yadguṇameṣa manmatharipostāḥ pāntu vo mūrtayaḥ || 66 ||’
dikkālātmatulyaṃ sarvamūrtaṃ saṃyogāśrayatālakṣaṇaṃ vibhutkmākāśasyaiva tasminnarthākṣipte yacchabdo'yamuddeśyagāmī niviśate tamupajīvya tacchabdena pratinirdeśo yuktaḥ
ākāśe viśeṣeṇa candratārāditejobhibhavasāmarthyalakṣaṇena dyotate bhagavānāditya iti yacchabdena tamuddiśyottaravākye'dasā pratinirdiṣṭavān

karṇagatyā pratiphalitāḥ sūryakiraṇāḥ salilamayeṣṭāśinyeva sudhāvyapadeśaṃ labhante, tatraiva yacchabdo niviṣṭastadupanītamarthamuttarastacchavdo viṣayīkarotītyādi—apāmeva rāśeścandro jātastāsāṃ pittaṃ vanhistasya sāyaṃprātarāhutaye yajamānaḥ sa vāyunā jīvati
sa ca pṛthivīguṇaṃ gaṃndhaṃ vahatīti pūrvapūrvasaṃkalanenottaravākyārtharacanā vihiteti
yadyapi cārthagumphe śabdagumpho dhruvabhāvī, tathāpi prathamānusaṃdheyamarthagumphanamevātra pradhānamiti tenaiva vyapadeśo yukta ityāśayavānvyācaṣṭe—atreti
yadīyaṃ śṛṅkhalā na pratisaṃdhīyate kathaṃ parameśvaramūrtayo'ṣṭau labhyanta iti bhāvaḥ
anuvādenāpyupamā pratīyate dūṣaṇena vyatireka iti prakṛtaparyavasāne samāsoktyā yatra dānādīnāṃ vidvadvādiprasiddhānāṃ śabdānabhidheya eva krama upādhibhūto grathita ityudāharaṇavyākhyānagranthārthaḥ
pūsaabhāsaṃ muñcasu ṇa hu re haṃ dhavvavāāḍī || 68 ||’
kīrabhāṣāṃ muñca na khalu re'haṃ dhṛṣṭaśukī ||]
sā tasya durvidagdhatvamākalayantī taducitamuttaramadāt śukapralapitāni kila śukī jānāti nānyā
tadeteṣāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ yathoktarūpānuguṇānāmekatravākye gumphanameva kavisaṃrambhagocara iti

atra lāṅgūlavallīvalayitabakulairnadadbhirgolāṅgūlaiḥ pratirasitajaratkandarāmandireṣu khaṇḍeṣu uddaṇḍapiṇḍītagarataralanāḥ puṭakinībandhavo gandhavāhā velāmālambya yena prāpire ityato'dhikānāmapuṣṭārthānāmapi padānāmanuprāsāya cchandaḥpūraṇāya cārthānuguṇyena racitatvādiyaṃ padaracanā
lāṅgūlavallīvalayitetyādi yathoktavākyaviracanamātreṇaiva prayojanaparigrahe siddhe yadadhikānāṃ loladvallīprabhṛtipadānāmāvāpastena vinā nocitānuprāsasiddhirnaca tayā vinā vṛttaucitī samāpyate
na vā tāmantareṇa lāṅgūlādīnāmabhimatāste te viśeṣāḥ pratīyanta iti pallavapratiṣṭhaiva hi sarasvatī sahṛdayānāvarjayatīti—‘vākyapratītimātrārthamupātteṣu padeṣu yaḥ
iha mahato'rthasyālpīyasā granthenābhidhānamiti vyutkrameṇāpi granthalāghavāya vākyārtho racita itīyaṃ vākyaracanā
patiśvaśuratetyādikamalpākṣarameva vākyaṃ mahato'rtharāśeḥ samarpakamiti bhāvayatāṃ sahṛdayānāṃ kavitvaśaktirapratyūhaiva prakāśate
ata eva śaktitiraskārādādyantāvabhidhāya madhyamābhidhāne kramabhraṃśo'pi tiraskriyata ityāha—atreti
kiṃcidekaṃ vastu buddhau samādhāya tadadhikāraprabandharacanāyāmadhikasyāntarāntarā prakṛte yojanā śayyā
vākyārthe vākyayoḥ kvāpi prakīrṇānāṃ ca dṛśyate || 55
iyamatikrāntasyāpi kadambavanarājīnāmārdramukulodbhedasya virahimanaścamatkārakāriṇo rāmasya smṛtidvāreṇa ghaṭanādatikrāntaghaṭanā
kadambakusumodbhedasya pratyakṣasyaiva virahijanatātaṅkadāyitvaṃ saṃbhavatīti kathamatītasya tadbhayasyetyuktaṃ ‘smṛtidvāreṇa’ iti

svāhākārapradāno homastatra sadyaśchinnena śirasā prāṇaśeṣayogāt padārdhamātre niṣpādite tadaiva bhūtakaruṇāsaṃtānaśāntātmanā parameśvareṇa khedāviṣkāravācī hāśabdaḥ prayuktastenaiva nirantaramuccaratā svāhāpadaṃ siddhamiti
iyaṃ pūrvaśāstranibaddhasyottarārdhasya tadarthānanuyāyināpi prastutārthāviruddhena pūrvārdhenaikavākyatayaiva ghaṭitatvādvākyaghaṭanā
‘ekkiṃhiṃ acchihiṃ sāvaṇu aṇṇahiṃ bhaddavau māhau mahialasatthari gaṇḍatthala sarau
aṅgahiṃ gimha suhacchii tilavaṇa maggasiru muddhihiṃ muhapaṅkaasari āvāsiu sisiru || 76 ||’
aṅge grīṣmaḥ sukhāsikā tilavane mārgaśīrṣaḥ mugdhāyā mukhapaṅkajasarasi āvāsitaḥ śiśiraḥ ||]
tenānyāsāmapi prakīrṇaghaṭanānāmihāvakāśo bhavati, tena yā imā mahākaviprabandheṣu mukhyagauṇīlakṣaṇāstadbhāvāpattirupacaritā lakṣitalakṣaṇeti śabdavṛttayastā apīha śrūyante
yatrāditaḥ ṣaṭsvādhāravacaneṣu mugdhāyā iti saṃbandhipade ca mukhyā
ṣaṭsvapi cādheyavacaneṣu varṣādiṣu lakṣitābhihiteṣvapi yugapadasaṃbhavatsu śrutārthāpattilabhyā tāvadbhāvāpattiḥ
sa upacāreṇa śrāvaṇādiṣu prayujyamānasteṣāmapi mahattvamabhilakṣya mahāparicchadatāṃ mahāsaṃbhavatvaṃ ca lakṣayan prastutāyā api pravṛttermahāntamanubandhaṃ lakṣayati
te ca yugapallocanādau cānupapadyamānasthitayaḥ svaśabdaśaktitastatra tatra ca niveśyamānāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ pratyāsannāyāṃ taddharmasaṃpadamupalakṣayanti
asāvasau virahavatyā api viyogavedanātiśayaṃ lakṣayantī kamitari snehātiśayaṃ lakṣayati
sa ca locanayoranupapadyamānasthitirapi vibhaktiśrutyā niveśitaḥ payaḥpṛṣatpravāhalakṣaṇāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ pratyāsannāmavicchinnāśrusaṃpadamupalakṣayansamāgamotkāyā utkaṇṭhātiśayaṃ lakṣayati

so'pi mahītalasrastare'nupapadyamānasthitiḥ prāgvadeva śabdaśaktyā niveśitaḥ kusumakisalayamṛṇālakamalinīdalādikāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ samāsannāṃ śiśiropakaraṇasāmagrīmupalakṣayankāmavatyāḥ śarīrāntastāpaṃ lakṣayati

sā gaṇḍayoranupapadyamānasthitiḥ praśaṃsāvacanasyāpi sthalaśabdasyānusmaraṇaśattkyā samākṛṣyamāṇakāśakusumahaṃsāgamanakumudasaraḥprasādacandrātapādikāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ samāsannaṃ gaṇḍayoḥ pāṇḍubhāvaṃ lakṣayanmṛgekṣaṇāyā virahakārśyamupalakṣayati
mārgaśīrṣa ityanena tu pūrvāvayavena hemanto lakṣyate
tena ca yathā hemante tilavanaṃ lūyate tathā tasyāḥ sukhāsikā sāṃprataṃ lūyata iti lakṣitenātiśayinī manaḥpīḍopalakṣitā bhavati
kā punaḥ sukhāsikā tilavanayoḥ samānadharmatā yeyaṃ snehanirbharatā nāma

tatra śiśira ityanena ṛtuviśeṣeṇa mugdhāmukhe'pi padmasarasīva śabdaśaktyā niveśitena kamalavanopaplavādeḥ svadharmasaṃpado lokapratītāyāḥ pratyāsannā mugdhāmukhāmbhoruhalocanotpalasmitakusumadaśanakesarādeśchāyāparimlānirlakṣyamāṇā vipralambhānubhāvaprakarṣamupalakṣayati
śiśiralakṣmīvarṇanaprastāvācca ‘mukhamardhaṃ śarīrasya sarvaṃ vā mukhamucyate’ iti prasthānaprādhānyalakṣaṇayā sarvartubhyaḥ śiśira eva pradhānamityapi lakṣitaṃ bhavati
atra hi śrāvaṇādimāsartuṣaṭkasya yugapadasaṃbhavata ekatra virahiṇīśarīre yugapadbhāvo nibaddhaḥ, saguṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇa śrāvaṇādipade pratipādyamānaḥ pravāsavipralambhaprakarṣamāvedayatīti
yathā—‘amṛtamabhṛtaṃ candraścandrastathāmbujamambujaṃ ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyapi
iti na bhajate vastuprāyaḥ parasparasaṃkaraṃ tadiyamabalā dhatte bhāvānkathaṃ sakalātmakān
’ yastvatra siddhādibhedaḥ kaścidupavarṇitaḥ sa tathā na camatkārakārīti granthagauravabhayādupekṣito'smābhiḥ
tāsu mukhamiva prathamaṃ yasyāmarthaḥ pratīyate sā mukhyā, tathābhūtārthā tadbhāvāpattiśca
vyāpte jagatyaparamicchati yo'tra vaktuṃ ko'nyo gatatrapatayā sadṛśo'sti tena
ata eva svato'nyato vā svārthāvacchinnasya sākṣādabhidhānaśaktireva mukhyetyācāryāḥ
yathā—‘kamalā aṇṇasaṇīā haṃsā uḍḍāviāṇa api ucchā
keṇa vi gāmataḍāe abbhaṃ uttāṇaaṃ vūḍham
tatra dvayordravyavacanayoryatra sāmānādhikaraṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā prayoge viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānyathānupapattyā pratīyamānābhidhīyamānaguṇadvārakasaṃbandho bhavati sā guṇanimittā
’ mukhyayā gauṇyā vānyaviśeṣaṇasyānyatra prayoga upacaritā sāpi guṇayogamupajīvantī guṇavṛttireva
etāvāṃstu viśeṣo yadguṇanimittāyāmabhidheyaguṇayogaḥ, iha tu svābhidheyaviśeṣyaguṇayoga iti
yathā—‘parārthe yaḥ pīḍāmanubhavati nirvyājamadhuro yadīyaḥ sarveṣāmiha khalu vikāro'pyabhimataḥ
na saṃprāpto vṛddhiṃ sapadi bhṛśamakṣetrapatitaḥ kimikṣordoṣo yanna punaraguṇāyā marubhuvaḥ
yayā pūrvapūrvalakṣitameva lakṣyate sā lakṣitalakṣaṇeti kecit
atra hi dvirephādinā śabdena lakṣita eva bhramaraprabhṛtirlakṣyate na tu kurarādiḥ
‘ekkahi acchihiṃ aṇṇahiṃ mahialasatthare gaṇḍatthale aṅgahiṃ’ ityādi ṣaḍādhāravacanāḥ
atra yadyapi gaṇḍasthalapadaṃ gauṇameva, tathāpyanādiprayogayogitayā mukhyakalpamiti ṣaṭsvādhāravacaneṣvityuktam
aṅgādipadāni ca svārthaviśiṣṭānyaparāṇyeva prayuktānīti mukhyaiva vṛttiḥ
mukhapaṅkajasarasītyatra yadyapi padadvayaṃ gauṇaṃ tathāpi paṅkajapadasya vṛttirabhidhātulyeti na kavisaṃrambhagocarastena vyavahāro'yuktaḥ

te ca svārthasaṃbandhavyavahitaṃ varṣāprabhṛtisabhudāyaṃ lakṣayantīti vakṣyamāṇarītyā varṣādayaḥ ṣaḍādheyavacanāste ca virahavatīśarīre yugapaccāsaṃbhavadavasthitayo jalādisaṃpadādisvasvapravṛttinimittādhyāsena prayujyamānāstadbhāvāpattirūpāṃ vṛttimāsādayanti
asyāśca vivartapariṇāmādhyāsādayaḥ ṣaṭprakārā gauravabhiyā na darśitāḥ
sa svaviśeṣaguṇavyavahite'rthāntare prayukto gauṇīvṛttimanubhavan vasantāderapi viśeṣaṇatāmāsādayati
sā kathamāvāsitetiśabde saṃpadyata ityata āha—sa upacāreṇeti
kathaṃcitsārūpyeṇa śrāvaṇādiṣu prayogādupacārastamupajīvya prayuktaḥ svārthāvinābhūtaṃ mahattvādikaṃ prakṛteṣu lakṣaṇayā saṃkrāmayatīti
āvāsitasyāpi hi yathoktaviśeṣaṇasya paradurgagrahaṇādau mahānanubandho dṛṣṭaḥ
sa iha prastutāyāṃ virahavatīsaṃtāpalakṣaṇāyāṃ pravṛttau lakṣyata ityekalakṣaṇāvyavadhāneneyaṃ lakṣaṇā
śrāvaṇādayaḥ svadharmasaṃpado nirantaravarṣaṇādeḥ svārthāvinābhāvena lakṣitāyāḥ pratyāsannā sadṛśī teṣāṃ locanādīnāṃ dharmasaṃpadaśruprabhāvādilakṣaṇā lakṣyata iti dvitīyā lakṣaṇā
snehapratītyā tu vibhāvādisaṃvalitayā raso vyajyate, na tu lakṣyata ityanyatra vistaraḥ
kasyāḥ punaḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ pratyāsannā kā taddharmasaṃpadityato vivecayati—tatreti
yadi śrāvaṇādipadeṣu samudāyalakṣaṇā na syāttadā māsānupakramya ṛtūnāmabhidhāne prakramabhedo bhavet ! na bhavecca tattadṛtupratīta ṛtusaṃpatpratītiḥ kvaciditi yuktaiva samudāyalakṣaṇā
pratyekaṃ na tu padadvaye lakṣaṇā saṃbhavati
evaṃ caitravaiśākhasamudāyātmano vasantasyottarāvayavo vaiśākhastadvācake'pi mādhavapade samudāyalakṣaṇādvāreṇa lakṣaṇā bhavati

tacca sārūpyaṃ prakarṣalakṣaṇameveti praśaṃsāparatve sthitenābhidheyamapratītyasārūpyaṃ vā rūpāntaraṃ vā pratyetuṃ na śakyata ityabhidheyapratītyanuniṣpādinī ghaṇṭānusvānasodarā svadharmasaṃpadyathoktā pratīyate
na mukhacandrādivatsukhāsikātilavanayoḥ sādṛśyapratītirna ca tadabhidhīyamānaṃ kiṃcidatrāstīti pṛcchati—kā punariti
mā bhūttathā prasiddhiḥ kaverabhiprāyārūḍhā tu pratīyata ityuttaramāha—yeyamiti
na sneho nāma dvayorekaḥ kaścidasti na cānabhidhīyamānamapi sādṛśyaṃ śabdasāmānyamāśrayata ityataḥ prakārāntaramāha—abhisārikāṇāṃ ceti
nanu kamalinīśabdasyātra bahumānagocaratā pratipāditā, na tu tilavanasyetyata āha—ata eveti
upamānopameyayordvayorapi kāminībahumānagocaratāṃ vitarantī śiśireṇa sāṃprataṃ tilavāṭikālavanamapi vartata ityabhipraitīti bhāvaḥ
‘mukhamardhaṃ śarīrasya’ ityādinyāyena mukhaśabdaḥ prādhānyaṃ lakṣayati, tato mukhapaṅkajasarasi śiśira iti tadbhāvāpattyā hemantasyāpi ṛtuṣu prathamatayā prādhānyameva dyotitamiti
yadi tasyāḥ priyā vācastanmamāpi priya priyā || 78 ||’
kiṃcidekaparatayā pravṛttamuccāraṇamarthāntaravivakṣayā yadanyathā kriyate sā paṭhitiḥ
yadi dūtī priyā tadāhamapi priyetyādi ṛjūktyā śaṭhanāyakaviṣayā kṛtrimā prītiḥ pratīyate, kākvā tu tavaiva nāhaṃ priyetīrṣyāroṣaḥ
‘subhrūstvaṃ kupitetyapāstamaśanaṃ tyaktā kathā yoṣitāṃ dūrādeva mayojjhitāḥ surabhayaḥ sraggandhadhūpādayaḥ
rāgaṃ rāgiṇi muñca mayyavanate dṛṣṭe prasīdādhunā satyaṃ tvadvirahādbhavanti dayite sarvā mamānghā diśaḥ || 79 ||’
nāmīṣāṃ veda iva kāvye bhūyānprayoga iti kiṃcidudāharati—subhrūstvamiti
caraṇatalāgrapatite mayi dṛṣṭe sati tvaṃ prasīdeti dīrghamātroccāraṇe kupitakāntāprasādaparatvaṃ, yathoktaplutakaraṇe tu dūrāhvānādau tadanuśāsanātkupitadṛṣṭisaṃbodhanavuddhirupajāyate
aśanādayo hi dvayoḥ sādhāraṇā eveti śleṣopādānameveti
yathā—‘viśvāmitro viśvānaraḥ’ iti ṛṣirājarṣiviśeṣau pratīyete tathā yuvatīti saṃbodhanapratītiḥ
atra mayā virahitetyetāvati padacchede purūravasastvayetyetāvati tu parvatasya vākyabhedo bhavati
ekasya śabdasya madhye vicchedena dvaidhīkaraṇamātraṃ bhaṅgaḥ
mayā virahitetyetāvati samudāye madviyogavatī tvayā dṛṣṭetyaṣṭamakāmāvasthāviṣṭasya purūravasaḥ parvataviṣayaṃ praśnavākyaṃ bhavati
yadā tu mayeti vicchidya pūrvavākyasaṃbandhi kriyate tadā tvayā virahitā satī mayā dṛṣṭeti parvatasyottaravākyaṃ saṃpadyate
atra yathāśrutavarṇaparigrahe—‘kalikāmadhuno garhaṇā nindā’ iti pratīyate, yadā tu ‘kalikāmadhug arhaṇā’ iti varṇāntarakalpanayā chedaḥ, tadā pūjaiva ‘kalau kāmadhenuḥ’ iti

atra yathāśrute duḥkhena rasanīyamudbhrāntaśuktikoṣaṃ matsyāṅkitaparyantamiti pratīyate, yadā tu dūrasamunmuktaśuktimīnāṅkāntamiti piṇḍacūrṇanena cchedaḥ, tadātyantaharṣayukteti tyaktaśoketi ca saṃbodhanadvayaṃ kṛṣṇasya pratīyate
‘yena dhvastamanobhavena balijitkāyaḥ purā'strīkṛto yo gaṅgāṃ ca dadhe'ndhakakṣayakaro yo barhipatrapriyaḥ
yasyāhuḥ śaśimacchirohara iti stutyaṃ ca nāmāmarāḥ so'vyādiṣṭabhujaṅgahāravalayastvāṃ sarvadomādhavaḥ || 81 ||’
atra yena dhvastamanobhavenetyāderyena dhvastamano'bhavenetyādeśca padabhedādumādhavo mādhava ityarthadvayaṃ pratīyate
tayośca dvayorapi prādhānyenopapādanādaṅgāṅgibhāvena prakṛtāprakṛtarūpatayā cānavasthānātparasparamasaṃbandhenāyaṃ śleṣaḥ
padabhedena tu pāṭhe paryāyato'rthadvayapratīteriyaṃ śleṣopasarjanā padabhedapaṭhitiḥ

dhvastamanobhavena dagdhakāmena balijito nārāyaṇasya kāyaḥ purā tripuradāhavyatikare'strīkṛtaḥ śaratāṃ nītaḥ, gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīṃ dadhe, andhako daityaviśeṣastasya kṣayo vināśaḥ, barhipatro mayūravāhanaḥ kārtikeyaḥ, śaśimaccandrakalāṅkitaṃ śiro viśvamohacchidurasya hara iti stutyaṃ ca nāma, bhujaṅgā eva hāravalayāni yasya, sarvadā sarvakālamiti umādhavapakṣe

mādhavapakṣe tu—yena dhvastaṃ vināśitamana: śakaṭam, abhavena saṃsārabandharahitena,baliṃ jitavānyaḥ kāyaḥ sa pūrvaṃ samudramathanāvasare'bhṛtagṛhayāludaityavyāmohanāya strīrūpatāṃ nītaḥ, agaṃ govardhanākhyaṃ gāṃ pṛthivīmekārṇavamagnāmuddhṛtavān
barhiṇo mayūrasya pattraṃ picchaṃ tatpriyaḥ ‘barhipattrakṛtāpīḍam’ iti gopāladhyāne gautamenābhidhānāt
śaśimadrāhustasya śirohara iti stutyaṃ ca nāma
rave śabdabrahmaṇi layo yasya saḥ, tathā sarvado yāvadabhimataprada iti
nanu vibhinnarūpāṇāṃ śabdānāmuccāraṇe tantratayā śleṣa evāyaṃ na paṭhitirityata āha—tayośceti
sa ca saṃbandho rūpatātparyasaṃbandhalakṣaṇo vā aṅgāṅgibhāvovā upamānopameyabhāvo vā yathāgre vakṣyate
na cāyameko'trābhimataḥ kiṃtvekaparamevoccāraṇe padabhedenārthāntaraṃ gamayatīti paṭhitireveyam
yatra hi yasya prādhānyena vivakṣā tatra tena vyapadeśo yuktaḥ, ata eva vivakṣāntareṇa śleṣavyavahāro'pyatra samarthanīya eva
atra iyanmātrastanādīnāṃ tathābhūtahastābhinayaiḥ saha paṭhanāttathāvi dhārthaviśeṣo gamyate
yāvacca svarūpasamuccāraṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ nānusaṃdhīyate na tāvacchrīprāptikṣamayoḥ kāraṇaviśeṣaḥ pratīyata iti
atrāvalambanamabalaṃ vanamiti pade padadvaye vā dvitīyacaturthasthānayoryau vakārabakārau tayorantaḥsthapavargābhyāṃ pavargāntaḥsthābhyāṃ ca kāntimati pāṭhe'rthabhedo jāyate
kāntiśchāyā sā apratihatarūpā padavadvarṇeṣu na saṃbhavatīti śrutirūpā gṛhyate
yadā tu dvitīye'balaṃ vanamityatra tayoreva pavargāntaḥsthabhāvānusaṃdhānaṃ bhavati tadā balaṃ vanamiti cchedena padadvayasaṃpattau balarahitaṃ sadvanamaraṇyaṃ yayāvityarthāntarapratītirupajāyate
śayanaṃ śīḥ, adanaṃ at, nirjharasaṃbhogaiḥ nirjharajalamātropabhogairapyapagataṃ ata eva balarahitam
tena prāguktabhedaiḥ saha dvādaśaprakārā paṭhitiriti tātparyam
yadyapi ca pādādyanyathākaraṇamapi padabhedaprakāra eva tathāpi na tatra pūrvoktatyāgaḥ, iha tu tatparityāgena padāntarakalpanamityetāvānviśeṣaḥ
pibatu madhusugandhīnyānanāni priyāṇāṃ tvayi vinihitabhāraḥ kuntalānāmadhīśaḥ || 84 ||’
atra tvayītyasya sthāne mayīti yadā paṭhyate, tadaitatprārthanāvākyamapyanumativākyaṃ bhavati
atra yadā pāṇḍusutaḥ suyodhanamityasya sthāne ‘pāṇḍusutaṃ suyodhanam’ iti paṭhyate, tadaitadamaṅgalārthamapi suyodhane maṅgalārthaṃ bhavati
tatra padaṃ vibhattkyantaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhedena dvidhā kriyate ityāha—padānyathākaraṇaṃ dvidheti
atra tṛtīyapādasthāne ‘tanvaṅgī yadi labhyeta’ iti pāṭho bhavati, tadaitatparīkṣaupayikamapi kāmaupayikaṃ bhavati
abhyudyate sakaladhāmanidhau tu tasminnindoḥ sitābhraśakalasya ca ko viśeṣaḥ || 87 ||’
atra yadā madhyamapādayoḥ sthāne ‘yāvanna tāḥ kimapi gauritarā hasanti
tābhiḥ punarvihasitānanapaṅkajābhiḥ’ iti paṭhyate, tadaitadvīrārthoktirūpamapi śṛṅgāroktirūpaṃ saṃpadyate
‘tyāgena yuktā divamutpatanti tyāgena hīnā narakaṃ vrajanti
na tyāgināṃ duṣkaramasti kiṃcittyāgo hi sarvavyasanāni hanti || 88 ||’
atra turīyapādamevopādāya pādatrayasya cānyathākaraṇena vakṣyamāṇaḥ pāṭho bhavati
‘kiṃ tādeṇa narendaseharasihālīḍhaggapādeṇa me kiṃ vā me sasureṇa vāsavasahāsīhāsaṇaddhāsiṇā
te desā giriṇo a te vaṇamahī sa jjea me vallahā kosallātaṇaassa jattha calane vandāmi ṇandāmi a || 90 ||’
atra yadi bhāṣāntareṇa paṭhyate tadaitacchaurasenībhāṣayā sītāvākyaṃ saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ sumantreṇa daśarathāya niveditam
‘kiṃ tātena narendraśekharaśikhālīḍhāgrapādena me kiṃ vā me śvaśureṇa vāsavasabhāsiṃhāsanādhyāsinā
te deśā girayaśca te vanamahī sā caiva me vallabhā kausalyātanayasya yatra caraṇau vandāmi nandāmi ca || 91 ||’
bhāṣābhedena kathaṃ strīpuṃsavacanatā gamyata ityata āha—tadaitacchaurasenīti
tena dvayorekasya vā nirarthakatve'pi yamakamupagṛhītaṃ bhavati
vibhinnārthaikarūpāyā varṇasaṃhateryā āvṛttiḥ sā yamakamiti vyavahitenānvayaḥ
madhyāntau madhyādī ādyantau ādimadhyāntāśceti militvā catvāraḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ
evaṃ pādavikalpānāmādyādivikalpānāṃ ca parasparayojane'nye'pi bahavaḥ prakārā granthagauravakāriṇo bhavantītyāha—atyanteti
śiṣyavyutpattaye tu katipaye darśanīyā ityāha—tatra kecaneti
rājīvarājī padmapaṅktistadvaśā lolāḥ saspṛhā bhṛṅgā yatra tam
phaṇavatāma bhito vitataṃ tataṃ dayitaramyalatābakulaiḥ kulaiḥ || 94 ||’
anīraśanairna nirgatā dūrībhūtā raśanāḥ kṣudraghaṇṭikā yebhyastaiḥ kāñcīguṇayuktaiḥ
samaṃ samantādapagopuraṃ puraṃ paraiḥ parairapyanirākṛtaṃ kṛtam || 96 ||’
vahnisamāgataṃ sad drutaṃ vilīnamata eva drutaṃ śīghraṃ mahīṃ gataṃ pṛthivyāṃ vistīrya patitamahīnayā dyutyā rocitaṃ śobhitam
paraiḥ śatrubhiḥ paraiḥ śreṣṭhairanirākṛtaṃ yadāsīttadeva vahninā hemamayaṃ puramapagopuramapagatadvāraṃ mahīṃ gataṃ ca kṛtamiti saṃbandhaḥ
‘udayi te dayite jaghanaṃ ghanaṃ stanaktī navatīrthatanustanuḥ
sumanasāmanasā sadṛśau dṛśau dyukurume kuru me'bhimukhaṃ mukham || 97 ||’
‘sumanasāṃ manasām’ iti pāṭhe sumanasaḥ sahṛdayāstanmanasāṃ sadṛśau saṃvādinyau
dyauśca kuśca dyukū dyāvāpṛthivyau tayorumā lavaṇākaro lāvaṇyaviśrāntisthānatvāt
devādevāptarakṣaḥkṛtabhava bhavato'gre na dīno nadīno muktāmuktāccharatnaḥ sitarucirucirollāsamudraḥ samudraḥ || 98 ||’
mānaṃ parimāṇātiśayaḥ mānaḥ pūjā vā, tadbhūmiḥ
phaṇibalaṃ bhujaṅgasamudāyastasya yadvalanaṃ tenodbhāvinī yā rājī rekhā tayā virājanaśīlaḥ
devādevāḥ devāsurāstairabhṛtalābhenāntaravasthānena cāptā rakṣā yasmātsa tathā kṛtabhavaḥ saṃpāditodbhavaḥ
nadīnāminaḥ svāmī samudro bhavato'gre na dīnaḥ? kākvā dīna eva
sitaruciścandrastena rucirā manoharā ullāsamudrā vṛddhikāṣṭhā yasya
tadeteṣāmudāharaṇānāṃ caturṣvapi pādeṣu yathoktaṃ yamakamastīti catuṣpādayamakaprapañjo'yam
nāsya caturaḥ prayoga iti śeṣabhedā nodāhriyante
alini yo malinimā kajjalābhatvaṃ sa mādhavayoṣitāṃ yādavastrīṇāṃ vilocanatārakāstulayati smeti saṃbandhaḥ
mahākaviprayogeṣu viśeṣaśobhākaratayā prasiddherabhāvo'nullekho na tvasaṃbhava eva
āvṛttiḥ sakṛdāvartanenaiva nirvahati tatkimasakṛdāvṛttau yamakaṃ na bhavatītyata āha—evamiti
tārāṇāṃ tāratā nirmalatāprakarṣaḥ kiṃciddhanarodhasadbhāvādīṣatāratā yasyāṃ sā tathā
yajjātīyamādyapāde padamāvṛttaṃ tajjātīyameva dvitīyādipādeṣvapi yathāsthānamāvartata iti prakārāntaramapyāvṛttipadenaiva saṃgṛhītamityarthaḥ
yāmatrayādhīnāyāmayā praharatrayaviśrāntiyāvaddīrghatāprakārayā niśā rātryā maraṇaṃ yāmeti viyogakhinnasya prārthanā

dhiyā vudhdyā yāmayāṃ jīvitasarvasvābhimānagocaratāmanaiṣaṃ sā anayā kalpakoṭiśatāyamānayāmayā rajanyā asūnāṃ prāṇānāmārtiḥ pīḍā tayā dvārabhūtayā prāyeṇa mathitaiva bhaviṣyatīti sukumāratarakāntājīvitānadhyavasāyoktiriyam
amāyatā māyāśūnyatvaṃ sāpi tava iyate paricchettumaśakyāya kṣayaṃ vināśamayate'gacchate sukhāyābhūt
‘bhavādṛśā nātha na jānate nate rasaṃ viruddhe khalu sannatenate
ya eva dīnāḥ śirasā natena te carantyalaṃ dainyarasena tena te || 107 ||’
nateḥ kupitakāminīprasādarūpāyā raso vipralambhapṛṣṭhabhāvī madhurataraḥ saṃbhogaḥ kimiti tādṛśā rasaṃ na jānate
yasmāt sannatā avasādayogitvaminatā prabhutā, ete dve viruddhe naikatra saṃbhavataḥ
ye dīnāsta eva natena śirasā lakṣitāstena hetunā dainyarasenālamatyantaṃ caranti vyavaharantīti
kāñcirnagarī tasyāḥ pratolī rājarathyā tāmanu lakṣīkṛtya
kena pānīyenāñcanaśīlā yā sravantī nadī tadvanamātariśvā vāyuḥ
atra pratipādaṃ kāñcīkāñcītyādi nairantaryeṇāvartanena vyapetam, sāntaratvena punarādimadhyayamakameva syāditi pādabhedenaivāsya saṃbhavaḥ
