taruṇidāruṇa eṣa diśaḥ samaṃ mama hṛdāruṇadāmravaṇānalaḥ || 109 ||’
madana eva dāru kāṣṭhaṃ tata utthitaḥ
svabhāvatāmrameva madhumadena yavddiguṇamaruṇaṃ hūṇamukhaṃ tacchavirdāruṇo bhayaṃkaro mama hṛdā samaṃ diśo'ruṇadruddhavān
atra yadyapi pratipādamapi vyavāyena madhyayamakaṃ saṃbhavati, tathāpi na tathollekhīti pūrvāparasadṛśamevodāhṛtam
ratotsavāmodaviśeṣamatyā na me phalaṃ kiṃcana kāntimattayā || 110 ||’
yā tava priyā ratotsavāmodaviśeṣeṇa ratikeliharṣaprakarṣeṇa mattā tayedamaṃśumanmaṇikiraṇakarambitaṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ dhāryam
tvayā ki miti na dhāryamityata āha—na me bhūṣaṇasaṃpādyayā kāntyā kiṃcana phalam
‘kāmināṃ maṇḍanaśrīrvrajati hi saphalatvaṃ vallabhālokanena’ iti nyāyāt
atra ghanetyādiśabdabhāgaḥ pādacatuṣṭaye'pi girīndretyādyanāvṛttavyavahita evādimadhyayorāvartata iti
gāḥ kūjitāni kadambasaurabhānītavarṣartupayodāḥ kalayanti kalarūpatāṃ nayanti
‘mitamavadadudāraṃ tāṃ hanūmānmudāraṃ raghuvṛṣabhasakāśaṃ devi yāmi prakāśam
tava viditaviṣādo dṛṣṭakṛtsnāmiṣādaḥ śriyamaniśamavantaṃ parvataṃ mālyavantam || 113 ||’
mitamalpākṣaramaramatyarthamudāramalpākṣaravyañjakaṃ mudā harṣeṇa raghuvṛṣabho rāmastasya sakāśo vāsabhūmistayā puraskṛtaḥ
‘samaṃ sa sainyena samantataḥ samaṃ puraṃdaraśrīḥ puramuccagopuram
madālasāṃ tāṃ pramadāṃ susaṃmadāṃ yayau nidhāyākṣayayauvanā yayau || 114 ||’
asyāpi nātipracuraḥ prayoga iti viśeṣabhedā nodāhriyante
evaṃ dvitīyādipādagocaraṃ madhyādiyamakaṃ ca kimiti nodāhiyata ityata āha—asyāpītiṣa
ramaṇaṃ vallabhaṃ mudā harṣeṇānvītaṃ saṃgataṃ kartuṃ kṣamā ityanvayaḥ
atra yadyapi caturṣu pādeṣu yamakamasti, tathāpi dvayordvayorevāvṛttiḥ paryavasyatītyudāharaṇadvayamidaṃ draṣṭavyam
‘iha muhurmuditaiḥ kalabhai ravaḥ pratidiśaṃ kriyate kalabhairavaḥ
sphurati cānuvanaṃ camarīcayaḥ kanakaratnabhavāṃ ca marīcayaḥ || 117 ||’
ekapādayamakamiha śuddhaṃ na saṃbhavati, tasya sthāne dvipādayamakamevodāhiyate
sāntaratve tvādimadhyādibhāvaprasaṅga iti śuddhaṃ na bhavati tatkimanudāharaṇīyamevaitadita āha—tasyeti
sā tu pratiyogitayā dvitīyamapekṣata iti pādāntarasvīkāra iti kathaṃcitprakṛtigaṇanāsamādhānametat
sa vaḥ karotu niḥsaṅgamudayaṃ prati maṅgalam || 119 ||’
‘avasitaṃ hasitaṃ prasitaṃ mudā vilasitaṃ hrasitaṃ smarabhāsitam
na samadāḥ pramadā hatasaṃmadāḥ purahitaṃ vihitaṃ na samīhitam 120’
atra pratipādaṃ sitaṃ sitamityādi dvābhyāmeva yamakaṃ nirvyūḍham
tṛtīyaṃ tu sitamityādikamādhikyameva prayojayati, tacca sarvamanāvṛtti vyavahitamiti vyapetayamakameva bhavati
sārasā saśabdā kāñcirmekhalā yasyāḥ sā tathā
sārasānukṛteti ‘jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā vaktavyā’ iti niṣṭhāyāḥ paranipātaḥ
‘līlāsmitena śucinā mṛdunoditena vyālokitena laghunā guruṇā gatena
vyājṛmbhitena jaghanena ca darśitena sā hanti tena galitaṃ mama jīvitena || 122 ||’
evasādimadhyāntayamakamapi nātra saṃgacchate tarhi saṃdhivinākṛtamudāhriyatāmityata āha—ādimadhyānteti
na bhāsurā yānti surānna te guṇāḥ prajāsu rāgātmasu rāśitāṃ gatāḥ 123’
ekaikasminpāde tṛtīyādyāvṛttyā pūrvamādhikyaṃ pādāntarāvṛttisarūpatayā sārūpyaṃ coktam
iha tu sarūpāvṛttyaivādhikyaṃ nirūpyata iti saṃkaraprakāropalakṣaṇamidam
rāgo'nurāgastatpraghāna ātmā yāsāṃ tāsu prajāsu rāśitāṃ puñjatāṃ gatāḥ
nādau na madhye nānte yatsaṃdhau vā yatprakāśate
pāde śloke ca tatprāyaḥ pādasaṃdhau ca badhyate
svabhede cānyabhede ca sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca sūribhiḥ || 64
nedaṃ sthānayamakaṃ taddhi pratipādaṃ sthānaniyamena nirūpyata ityuktaprāyam
pādasaṃdhau ca yadbadhyate tatsvabhede cānyabhede ca sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca bhavatītyarthaḥ
etadyathāsthānaṃ vivariṣyate—sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ceti pūrveṇāpi saṃbadhyate
‘vīnāṃ vṛndaṃ caitatkūṭe samaruti sutaruṇi samaruti sutaruṇi
cittaṃ vā tena kroḍe'sminsuramaṇiguṇaruci suramaṇi guṇaruci 124 ||’
atra sthūlenaivāvṛttidvayena ślokapādayorvyāptatvādādimadhyāntatā na saṃbhavatītyasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlāvyapetamucyate
suramaṇīnāṃ devamaṇīnāṃ guṇena dāmnā rocate śobhata iti kvip
atra samaruti sutaruṇi suramaṇi guṇarucīti dvitīyacaturthapādayorvarṇāṣṭakāvṛttidvayamiti pādavyāpakamavyapetamucyate
loko yadvaddaityānīkaṃ guru gurumayi mayi taritari satisati || 125 ||’
atra punaḥ sūkṣmeṇāvṛttyaṣṭakena ślokapādau vyāptāviti asthānayamakamidaṃ sūkṣmāvyapetamucyate
yathā mayadaityānīkavijaye loko'yaṃ sukhamāste tathāsau rururiti vākyārtho'bhimataḥ
tadidaṃ varṇadvayāvṛttyā sūkṣmaṃ na cānyonyavyavahitamavyavahitamityavyapetaṃ ca bhavati
‘nagajā na gajā dayitā dayitā vigataṃ vigataṃ lalitaṃ lalitam
atrāvṛttyaṣṛkena śloko'pi vyāpta ityasthānayamakamidaṃ śloke sthūlāvyapetamucyate
evaṃvidhā api gajā hastino na dayitā na rakṣitāḥ
vīnāṃ haṃsaprabhṛtīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ gataṃ caṅkramaṇaṃ vigatamapagatam
ruruśaśalalanānā nāvabandhundhunānā mama hi hitatanānānānana svasvanānā || 127 ||’
atra sūkṣmatarābhiraṣṭāviṃśatyāvṛttibhiḥ śloko vyāpta ityasthānayamakamidaṃ śloke sūkṣmāvyapetamucyate
vividhāni dhavānāṃ tarubhedānāṃ vanāni yasyāṃ sā
nāgeṣu sarpeṣu gardhenābhilāṣeṇa bubhukṣayā ṛddhaiḥ sabhṛddhairnānāvidhairvibhiḥ pakṣibhirvitataṃ vyāptaṃ gaganaṃ yasyāṃ sā
anāmena anamanena majjanto janā yasyāṃ sā
anāmani viṣṇunāmani majjabhdyastatparebhyo jātaṃ nānaṃ yasyāṃ sā
na naṃ anaṃ na anaṃ nānam
rurūṇāṃ śaśānāṃ ca lalanaṃ krīḍanaṃ yatra sā
nau āvayorabandhuṃ vairiṇaṃ dhunānā nāśayantī hi niścitaṃ mama hitaṃ tanoti sā
īdṛśo yaḥ svasvanaḥ śabdastatra anāḥ prāṇā yasyāṃ sā
nāgān sarpān hastino vā gṛdhyantyabhilaṣantīti nāgagardhāḥ
arddhā upacitā nānāvayo vicitrāḥ pakṣiṇastairvitataṃ vyāptaṃ gaganaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathā
rurūṇāṃ śaśānāṃ ca lalanamutphālo yasyāṃ sā tathābhūtā
anānano mukhaśūnyaḥ yaḥ sva ātmā tena svanānā śabdāyamānā
yadi vā anānano mukhaṃ vinā kṛtaḥ svakīyaḥ svano yasyāḥ sā
na yojitātmānamanaṅgatāpitāṃ gatāpi tāpāya mamāsa neyate || 128 ||’
vyapetaṃ tu pādasaṃdhiṣu nivartata ityasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlāvṛtteḥ, saṃdhisthūlāvyapetamucyate
‘svabhede cānyabhede ca’ ityatra vyapetāvyapetayoḥ svatvamanyatvaṃ ca vyākhyeyaṃ prakaraṇāt
tattve prasaṅge ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ saptamī yojanīyā
madena prāptarāgāpi tata eva manmathonmādena tāpitā uttāpaṃ gatāpi yadātmānamabalā na yojitavatī tannūnaṃ madenasā madīyaduritena bhūyo'pi mānarasaṃ prāpitā syāt
ata eveyate vaktumaśakyāya saṃtāpāya nāseti kākvā tāpaprakarṣabhaṇanam
atra prathamadvitīyayostṛtīyacaturthayoścāntarato vicchidya pāṭhe kriyamāṇe saṃdhiṣu vyapetaprasaṅgaḥ syāt
atra vyapetānucchedenaiva pādasaṃdhiṣvavyapetamutpadyate ityasthānayamakamidaṃ sūkṣmāvṛtteḥ saṃdhisūkṣmāvyapetamucyate
ataevottamatāyā vilomatāmatirekamayatī na gacchantī īdṛśī tavātāmyataḥ saṃsārakhedenābādhyamānasya matau samatā na tu vāmatā vaiṣamyamiti
na vā saṃdhau viratiriti prasaṅgaḥ saṃgacchate

atra viṣamapādayoḥ samapādāvante'vatiṣṭhamānāvādiyamakādyantayamakayorādimadhyāntayamakatāmāpādayantaḥ pārāpāreti sahyaḥ sahya ityāvṛttī sthūle evādimadhyayamakavyapadeśaṃ ca labhete ityasthānayamakamidam

pārā nāma nadī tasyāḥ pāre āyato vistīrṇo dāvo vanaṃ tadbahulatvādadāvo vanavahniprabhāvarahito lokālokaścakravālākhyaḥ parvatastadanukṛtistatsadṛśo yaḥ so'yaṃ sahyanāmā girirabhrakūṭaśūnyaiḥ kūṭaiḥ śṛṅgairlakṣitaḥ
atra pādāntādiṣu vyapetaṃ yadā madhyeṣvavyapetaṃ tadubhayamapi pādāntādisaṃhitāyāmavyapetamabhinnajātīyaṃ jāyate
na ca prācīnāṃ madhyayamakatāṃ jahātītyasthānayamakamidaṃ sūkṣmāvṛtteranyato bhedena svabhedānucchedi sūkṣmāvyapetamucyate
nākavanitāḥ svargastriyastābhiḥ sahitam, yato nitambe svacchandaviharaṇocite ruciraṃ manojñam, suninadaiḥ śobhanaśabdairmahāphaṇavān vāsukiravato rakṣato rasaparā rasanīyeṣu śreṣṭhā
saṃdhiṣu ca viratipāṭhe ciraṃ ciramityādi vyapetaṃ pratīyate
atrāpi vṛttaucitī pūrvavadeva śaraṇamityupasaṃhāre darśayati—ubhaṃyamapi caitaditi
bhṛṅgāvaliryasya taṭe nipītarasā namattāmarasā na mattā || 132 ||’
atra mā bhūdavyapetaprasaṅga ityekamevākṣaraṃ vihāya sthūlāvṛttidvayena ślokapādayorvyāptatvādādimadhyāntatā na saṃbhavatītyasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlavyapetamucyate
yasya girestaṭe ravimādityamudagratāpaṃ dadhāne'pi bhṛṅgāvalirbhramaramālā nākhidyata
ata eva mattā namanti tāmarasāni yasyāḥ sakāśātsā tathā
atra dvitīyacaturthapādayoḥ ‘raviṃ dadhāne ravindradhāne’ iti, ‘rasā namattā rasā na mattā’ iti dvābhyāmeva vṛttibhyāṃ vyāptatvādādyādivibhāgāsaṃbhave asthānayamakamevedam
vyapetaṃ tu kathaṃ bhavatītyata āha—mā bhūditi
kare'ṇuḥ śīkaro jajñe reṇustena śamaṃ yayau || 133 ||’
tattu svāpekṣayā na madhyamanyāpekṣayā nādirityasthānayamakamidaṃ sūkṣmavyapetamucyate
nanu viṣamapādayorādyakṣareṇa vinākaraṇena madhye samapādayoḥ punarādāveva reṇurityāvṛttirasti tatkathamasthānayamakamidamityata āha—tattviti
anto vṛttairasaṃbhāvitatvādādau madhye vā sā vācyā
‘jayanti te sadā dehaṃ namasyanti jayanti te
atra sthūlavyapetāvṛtticatuṣṭayena śloko'pi vyāpta ityādimadhyāntābhāvādasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlavyapetamucyate
he jayanti, ye tava dehaṃ durgātārādirūpeṇa prapañcamānāṃ mūrtiṃ sadā namasyanti te jayanti sarvotkarṣeṇa vartante
bhavātparameśvarāt anyatā bhedastenonamataḥ śreyasa ādānaṃ grahaṇaṃ yatra tādṛśī īhā ceṣṭā yatreti dvayamasanakriyāviśeṣaṇam

atra jayanti te iti prathamadvitīyayorādyantau sadādehamiti prathamacaturthayorantādī namasyantīti dvitīyatṛtīyayorbhavānyata iti ca tṛtīyacaturthayorādyantau ca sthūlāvṛttyā vyāptāviti anāvṛttabhāgābhāvācchloke sthūlavyapetamasthānayamakamidam

atra yadyapi yāmāyāmetyādau vyapetamādyantayamakaṃ nītānītetyādau ca madhyayamakamavyapetaṃ vidyate, tathāpi maṇḍūkaplutyā gatapratyāgateryateśca naitadullikhati api tu śloko'pi dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmakṣarābhyāṃ sūkṣmavṛttyā vyāpta iva lakṣyate
ānītaḥ prāpita āyāmo vṛddhiryasyāḥ sā tathā
saha inā senānyā vartata iti senā, asannā avasādarahitā evaṃbhūtā yā senā sā āsannā nikaṭavartinī satī āramarisamūhaṃ hatvā tvā tvāṃ sāraṃ kāryasiddhiṃ āha bravīti
nanu yāmā yāmā, lokāloketyādikamādyantayornītānītetyādikaṃ tu padacatuṣṭayasyāpi madhya iti vyapetam, ādyantavyapetayamakaṃ tu madhyayamakamiti sthānayamakamevedam
saṃkaro'pi na pṛthag yamakatāṃ prayojayatītyata āha—atra yadyapīti
yāmetyādikamādāvanusaṃdhāya varṇacatuṣkavyavadhinā pādānte'nusaṃdhīyamānaṃ maṇḍūkaplutiṃ prayojayatīti na tathā sollekham
yāmānītetyādisthūlacatuṣkapratyāgatena nītāyāmetyādinātyantamudbhaṭena yamakacchāyā tirodhīyata iti ca na sollekham
ślokastu dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmāvṛttibhyāṃ vyāpta iti samudāyasollekhataiva
tadidamuktaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā gatapratyāgateryateśceti madhye yatikṛto vyavāyo boddhavyaḥ
api tvekasyādāvanyasya vāntyasthāne yamakamidaṃ sthūlāvṛtteḥ sthūlavyapetamucyate
nanūpoḍharāgetyādau pūrvodāhṛte'pi yativicchedādasti vyavadhānātko'sya viśeṣa ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti
dharādharaḥ śeṣo mahīṃ pātuṃ sahata ityanvayaḥ
atra sālaṃ sālamiti svabhede suratāpanīyaṃ suratāpanīyamiti sthūlaḥ
rakṣobharakṣobha laṅkākalaṅketi anyabhede kūṭā kūṭeti sūkṣmavyapete bhedo vartate
surāṇāṃ tāpanaṃ saṃtāpajananaṃ tasmai hitamala-matyarthaṃ sā laṅkā
rakṣasāṃ bharaḥ samūhastasya kṣobhaḥ prakarṣajaḥ kolāhalaḥ
akalikāni kalirahitānyadrikūṭāni suvelaśikharāṇi yasyāṃ sā tathā
bhāgaśo vivicyamānaṃ sūkṣmameva, vṛttibhūyastayā tu sthūlamiva prathata iti sūkṣmekṣikayābhidhānam
mandayā tatkālocitapratipattividhurayā āvarjito māna īrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇo yayā sā tathā
namanpādānte luṭhannapi dayāvarjitau mānasātmānau yasyā iti bahuvrīherḍāp
nānākalālī rucireṇanetrā devī yadasmādajani svayaṃ śrīḥ || 141
ānākaṃ svargāvadhi lalanamullāsastacchīlaḥ rucireṇa manohareṇa netrā nāyakena nānākalānāṃ cātuḥṣaṣṭikīnāmālī paramparā
‘smarānalo mānavivardhito yaḥ sa nirvṛtiṃ te kimapākaroti
samaṃ samakālaṃ kṣaṇena tato vistīrṇastāmanubhavaikasākṣicintānuvṛttilakṣaṇāṃ nirvṛtimarase iti sopālambhasaṃbodhanam
samantataḥ sarvatastāmarasekṣaṇe kamalanetre na kimapākarotīti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ
sa bhāsurāṇāmabalā vibhūṣitā vihārayannirviśa saṃpadaḥ purām || 143 ||’

abalā balākhyena dānavena rahitā vibhunā śakreṇādhyāsitā surāṇāṃ devānāṃ sabhā mṛṇālanirmalaistava guṇairārohi yataḥ, ataḥ sa tvaṃ purāmabalā vibhūṣitāḥ striyo'laṃkṛtā vihārayan bhāsurāṇāṃ satāṃ saṃpado nirviśetyāśaṃsā
‘kalaṃ kamuktaṃ tanumadhyanāmikāstanadvayīṃ ca tvadṛte na hantyataḥ
na yāti bhūtaṃ gaṇane bhavanmukhe kalaṅkamuktaṃ tanumadhyanāmikā || 144 ||’
kalaṃ madhurāvyaktaṃ uktaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tanormadhyasya bhareṇa nāmikāstanadvayīṃ ca tvāṃ vihāya kaṃ nāyakaṃ hanti vaśīkaroti
ato jitendriyeṣu prathamagaṇanīye tvayi sati kalaṅkamuktaṃ nirdoṣaṃ tanumadhi śarīramadhikṛtya bhūtamanāmikā'nāmikāṅguliḥ na yāti parasya tvatsadṛśasyābhāvāt

kālimnaḥ śyāmatāyā ālayā kajjalaprabhṛtīnatītya varṇaprakarṣeṇa yā sthitā, tayā gātumupakrāntayā bhramaramālayā hetubhūtayā kā nāmātra parvataṃ kāntaṃ na namati na praṇamatīti na, na sukhena ānamyate iti asvānamā yā prāgāsīt sāpyuddīpanaprakarṣe niḥśeṣitamānā namatītyarthaḥ

anekeṣu pādeṣu pratyantaparvateṣu bhramantyabhrāṇi meghā eva sālo varaṇaḥ prākāraḥ, mānyāḥ pūjārhā īdṛśā yathādṛśyaṃ tathaiva manohāriṇo'bhīravo bhayarahitāḥ patattrikūṭāḥ pakṣisaṅghā yatra, anekapā hastinasteṣāmadabhra utkaṭo madastaṃ bharanti dhārayantīti mūlavibhujāditvātkapratyaye anekapādabhramadabhrāḥ sālā vṛkṣā yatra
vidārī kandabhedaḥ, arjunaḥ kakubhaḥ, bāṇo gulmaviśeṣaḥ, pūgo guvākaḥ
arjunaḥ pārthastasya bāṇapūgaṃ śaṟasamūhastaṃ vidārya bhittvā
ayugalocanastrinetraḥ kirātasvarūpadharastasya sasāra gataḥ sārabāṇa utkṛṣṭaśabdastena sahito'yugadvitīyaḥ, alocanasya durjñānasya
ke pānīye lapanaśīlā haṃsāsteṣāṃ vṛndāni cārutayā manojñabhāvenopayānti saṃgacchante
lāpena parasparasaṃlāpamātreṇoḍhaḥ prāpto ghano nirantara āgama āgamanaṃ yeṣām
vṛndānilo vātyā tenāpoḍho nirākṛto ghanāgamo meghadurdinaṃ kalāpino mayūrā ārutayaḥ samantataḥ kekāyitāni apayānti tirobhavanti
ekaśloke pādatrayābhyāsasyāsaṃbhavācchlokāntare ca tathā saundaryābhāvātpādatrayābhyāso na cintanīya ityata āha—pādatrayeti
bhāsaḥ kāntiḥ, mānaścittasamunnatiḥ pūjā vā, āsaḥ śatruvidhūnanam, hasaḥ smeratā, etaiḥ saha vartate iti sabhāsamānāsahasā yato'parāgaṃ cittakāluṣyamatti
sahasā mārgaśīrṣeṇa hetunā prāvṛḍvi cchedaprādurbhūtān parāgān rajaḥkaṇānatati prāpnotīti parāgāt
bhā kāntistayā samānā sarūpāstaiḥ saha vartata iti sabhāsamānā
syanti parāniti sāḥ, taiḥ saha vartata iti sahasā
evaṃbhūtā asamānā anupamā sabhā janasamavāyo'parāgādaparasmātparvatāt sahasā śīghraṃ parāgātparāgateti
adabhreṇa mahatā madena darpeṇa calanto ye vayaḥ pakṣiṇastaiḥ parājitā mūḍhavayobālāḥ pakṣiṇo yatra tam, alamatyarthaṃ pūrvoktarūpānamūḍhān vīn pakṣiṇo malate dhārayatīti vā
pratītaḥ prakhyātaḥ śikhī vaḍavānalastena caritavanaṃ bhakṣitajalotpīḍamiti prathamaḥ ślokārthaḥ
pravaṇamadāḥ madāyattadarpāḥ satatanisyandamānamadajalāśca bhramanto ye mainākaprabhṛtayo'calā dvipāḥ karimakarāśca taiḥ śobhitam
ūḍhā vimalā svabhāvanirmalā mahitāḥ pūjitāstaraṅgā yena tam
na cyutaṃ dhāma tejo yasya tam
pratītāḥ pratyāgatāḥ śikhino mayūrāstaiścaritavanaṃ bhrāntatīrakānanaṃ samudraṃ paśyeti vākyāntaravartikriyayā saṃbandha iti dvitīyaḥ ślokārthaḥ

he samāna sakhe, yāsamānayā avinayavatīnāṃ dhuri gaṇanīyayā anayā samānayā samāno yāsaḥ prayatno māna īrṣyāroṣastau samānau yasyāstayā, tathā samānayā cittānusbhṛtisārūpyaṃ bhajamānayā pūjāsihatayā asamānayā anupamayā sa tvaṃ mā māṃ samānaya saṃgamayeti manmathonmādāviṣṭasya kasyacidvayasyasya prārthanā
arthabhedena śabdā bhidyanta iti naye kathamekena vākyena dvayoruktirityata āha—tantreṇeti
dvayoriti saṃkhyā na vivakṣitā, triprabhṛtīnāmapi śleṣasaṃbhavāt
vibhāgavākye vibhaktīnāṃ sākṣādupādānātpratyapadaṃ tadanyaparaṃ, viśeṣaśobhākaratvaṃ ca viśeṣopādānaprayojanam
bhayakṛdbhūpate bāhurdviṣāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ ca te || 152 ||’
atra kīrtinudityatra nauti-nudatyorbhayakṛdityatra karoti-kṛntatyoḥ prakṛtyoḥ kvipi tulyaṃ rūpamiti prakṛtiśleṣo'yam
suhṛdāṃ ca bhinattīti dhāturūpaprakṛtibhedādevārthabhedaḥ kvippratyayasya sādhāraṇyāt
‘kuvalayadaladyutāsau dṛśā ca vapuṣā ca kaṃ na darśayate
atra dṛgvapuṣorāsyacaraṇayośca kuvalayadaladyutetyadharīkṛtapravālaśriyeti ca liṅgabhede'pi tulyarūpe viśeṣaṇe iti liṅgaśleṣo'yam
nanu ‘varṇapadaliṅgabhāṣāprakṛtipratyayavibhaktivacanānām’ iti kaiścitparisaṃkhyātam, tataścāṣṭadhā śleṣo bhaviṣyatītyata āha—liṅgaśleṣo'pīti
darśayata ityātmanepadena taṭasthamapi kaṃ na haṭhāddarśanāya prerayatīti vyajyate
nanu ca kuvalayadaladyuteti adharīkṛtapravālaśriyeti ca prakṛtibhāgo na bhidyate, tatkathamayaṃ prakṛtiśleṣa iti
pañcakaprātipadikārthapakṣe vibhaktirdyotikaiva tathā ca liṅgabheda iti vibhinne viśeṣaṇaprakṛtī mithaḥsaṃśliṣṭe iti
āvaśyakārthaṇinipratyaye sahṛdayānāṃ mano harata iti hāriṇau
apiśabdena virādhadyotakena hārahīnayorapi hārasaṃbandho vismayarasārpaka iti matvarthīyonmudraṇātsodbhedaḥ
atra hariṇībhūteti cverṅīpaśca tulyarūpatāyāṃ tadudbhedo nāstītyanudbhedaḥ pratyayaśleṣo'yam
vraṇarūḍhisthānaṃ śyāmaṃ bhavatīti lāñchanacchāyābhūtā kīdṛśī hariṇī haritā
varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ’ iti ṅīpi nādeśe ca rūpam
ahariṇarūpāpi vyavahārārūḍhahariṇatāmāpanneti cvipratyaye ca hariṇībhūte rūpam
atra ḍīpaścvervā na kiṃcidbhedakaṃ nibaddhamiti nirudbhedaḥ pratyayaśleṣo'yam
dehe yenāṅgajo dadhre jāyā ca sa jayatyajaḥ || 156 ||’

atra yenaviṣaṃ nijagale, bhujagarājaśca nijagale babhre, aṅgajo dehe, jāyā ca dadhre iti tiṅsubvibhaktyoḥ liḍātmanepadaprathamapuruṣaikavacanasaptamyekavacanāntayorekarūpatvādvibhinnārthakatvādbhinnajātīyasuptiṅvibhaktiśleṣo'yam
nijagala iti girateḥ karmaṇi liṭi rūpam
yena viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ nigīrṇam, nije ca gale kaṇṭhe bhujagarājo dhṛtaḥ
aṅgajaḥ kāmo yena dagdhaḥ, nije ca dehe śarīre jāyā pārvatī dhṛtā sa jayatīti
arthāntare tu dhātuḥ kriyāvacanaśabdarūpaḥ pūrva eva prakṛtitvāttataḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ tiṅādiḥ
tena ca kathaṃ tiṅantenopamānamasti bhinnārthatvācceti śabdamedadṛḍhīkaraṇārthamuktam
muktātmā naḥ śivaṃ nemiranye'pi dadatāṃ jināḥ || 158 ||’
atra nemirityanye'pīti ekavacanabahuvacanābhyāṃ dadatāmityatra tiṅante prājyaprabhāvaḥ prabhava ityādiṣu ca subanteṣvekavacanabahuvacanayorudbheda ityayaṃ sodbhedo nāma vacanaśleṣaḥ
atrābhavanniti valaya iti padayostiṅantasubantayorekavacanabahuvacane anudbhinne eva śliṣyete ityayaṃ nirudbhedo nāma vacanaśleṣaḥ
ekavacanena valayaḥ kaṅkaṇaṃ bahuvacanena ca madhyarekhā iti subantapade
uttarārdhe ca sālānāṃ kānanena śobhata ityevaṃśīleyamudyānamāleva vdyarthena sālakenānanena śobhata ityevaṃśīlā bāletyupamānārthaḥ śliṣyate
arīṇāṃ bhedaḥ śarīradhātubhedaḥ, palaṃ māṃsamaśnāti yaḥ sa tathā, cakāra uttaravākyāpekṣayā
aribhedo viṭkhadiraḥ palāśaḥ kiṃśukaḥ sālāstaruviśeṣāsteṣāṃ kānanam, alakāścūrṇakuntalāstatsahitamānanaṃ ca
nanu vibhaktyantānnānyatpadaṃ tatra pūrvabhāgena prakṛtiśleṣa uttarabhāgena ca pratyayaśleṣa uddiṣṭa eva, tatko'nya, padaśleṣa ityata āha—atreti
atra tvameva pātālamityakāraḥ pāścātye, tvaṃ ca amaramarudbhūmiriti cakāraḥ paurastye'kṣare śliṣṭaḥ pātālaṃ cāmare iti ca padaṃ racayati
‘alaṃkāraḥ śaṅkākaranarakapālaṃ parijano viśīrṇāṅgo bhṛṅgī vasu ca vṛṣa eko bahuvayāḥ
avastheyaṃ sthāṇorapi bhavati sarvāmaraguro- rvidhau vakre mūrdhni sthitavati vayaṃ ke punaramī ||’
avayavābhede samudāyasaṃbhavādavayavabhede ca samudāyabhedadhrauvyātpadaśleṣavyavasthitau tatraivāsyāntarbhāvo yukta iti bhāvaḥ

alamatyarthaṃ pātā rakṣitā, āśānāṃ nibandhanaṃ manorathasaphalīkaraṇabījaṃ, āśānāṃ diśāṃ saṃśleṣasthānam, cāmaramarudbhūmiḥ svarloko'marāṇāmindrādīnāṃ bhūmiramarāvatyādirmarutāṃ ca vivahādīnāṃ bhūmirvaimānikapathaścāmaramarudbhūmiścāmaramarutāmāśrayaśca
‘paticaṇḍibhyāmālañ’ iti paterālañpratyaye pātālamiti rūpasiddhāvākāra eva madhyavartivarṇaḥ, tatraiva punarekadeśapratisaṃdhāne pātālamityākāraśca pratīyate
atra ca ‘ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ’ iti vacanādākāra eva śrūyate tenottaraḥ paurastyena saṃbhinnaḥ
hariṇārisāradehe vare varaṃ hara ume bhāvam || 162 ||’
‘dhyānānītāṃ ca rudrāṇīṃ kāntāṃ ca purataḥ sthitām
tatra rudrāṇīpakṣe—he ume, hare bhave varaṃ śreṣṭha bhāvaṃ kuru
ataeva tohanti ardayanti tuhā arayastairvicchinne virahite
aparamapyarīṇāṃ vicchedakāraṇamāha—hariṇārisāradehe hariṇāriḥ siṃhastasya sāro balaṃ sa dehe yasya tasmin
kāntāpakṣe tu—he kānte, tava yo'yaṃ harināryāḥ śriyāḥ sāra utkṛṣṭo dehastatra yadvaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vilocanānanastanajaghanādi tanme bhāvamabhilāṣaṃ haratu
kuṭilālasabhrūlekhe mahimohahare gṛhe hāriṇi vicchinne ca tanumadhyatvādibhiriti
lālasa icchā tasmādbhavatīti lālasabhūḥ saṃkalpayonitvātkāmastaṃ leḍhīti karmaṇyaṇ
hariṇārisāra iva sāro yasyetyuttarapadalope hariṇārisāro deho yasyeti vigrahavākyamavaseyam
harinārī lakṣmīstasyāḥ sakāśāt sāraḥ prakarṣaśālī dehaḥ
mahīśabdena bhūgolavartinaḥ prāṇino'bhimatāsteṣāṃ mohagṛha iti vyākhyeyam
jagāma samaraṃ ko'pi kasya śreyasi tṛptayaḥ || 165 ||’
ruciraṃ manoharaṃ jitārihetiṃ bhagnasapatnāyudhaṃ janairnamitaṃ śyāmakāya-makalaṅaṃka śāntaṃ śāntarūpaṃ amitamanantam
kamalāsanaṃ brahmāṇamabhilakṣīkṛtya virājantaṃ śobhamānaṃ mānaya pūjayeti

rucibhī rañjitā ārihetayaścakradīptayo yena tam, jananairdaśabhiravatārairbhitaṃ paricchinnam, sāmāni kāyati gāyati yaḥ sa sāmakāyastam, na vidyate kalā yasya so'kalastam, kaṃ santaṃ brahmāṇaṃ aṃ viṣṇumitaṃ gatam, abhivirājaṃ garutmantamabhi taṃ prasiddhaṃ kamalāsanaṃ śriyā saṃsaktaṃ mā māṃ naya prāpayeti
evaṃ paiśācādibhirapi saṃskṛtasya prākṛtādeśca parasparasaṃbhedanācchleṣo gaveṣaṇīya ityāśayavānāha—yathā veti
akalaṅkaṃ doṣarahitaṃ mānayeti dhātvarthasya bhāvyatvenānvayātpūjāṃ kurvityarthaḥ
sāmāni kāyati kīrtayatīti ‘apavādaviṣaye kvacidutsargaḥ pravartate’ iti karmaṇyam
vīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ rājā garuḍastabhabhi itaṃ gatam
kamalā lakṣmīstasyā āsanamadhiṣṭhānaṃ mā māṃ nayeti
tena yamakavyatiriktā varṇāvṛttiranuprāsa iti lakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati
asti kaściduñcāraṇasya jñānasya vā viśeṣo yaḥ śīghrameva saṃskāramudbodhayatīti tadvatī varṇāvṛttirabhipretā
ata eva prācīnavarṇajātyanugataḥ sahṛdayāvarjakatayā prakṛṣṭaśca varṇānāmanuprāsa iti kāśmīrikā niruktiḥ
śrūyate hi tayābhivyakto varṇavyāpāro'bhivyañjanarūpaḥ, sa eva rasaviṣaye vartanaṃ vṛttirucyate
sanāthaiva hi vaidarbhī bhāti tena vicitritā || 72
anuprāsāntaraṃ tu prauḍhiṃ vā mādhuryaṃ vā prakarṣayatīti na tathānukūlyam
sthitiprayojako loke nātha ityucyate, teṣu nāyaka ityeva vaktavye punaranuprāsapadamanuprāsāntarasādhāraṇyenaiva śabdālaṃkāratvaṃ darśayitumiti samādheyam
kathaṃ punarasyānuprāsasya pṛthakprayatnānusaṃdheyasyāpi rasaprakāśasāmagryāmantarbhāva ityata āha—niveśayatīti
tena rasavattvavyavasthitasya kaverahaṃpūrvikākṛṣṭo'nuprāso na pṛthakprayatnanirvartya iti tātparyam
atra sthānataḥ samānaśrutīnāṃ mūrdhanyatālavyadantyauṣṭhyakaṇṭhyavarṇānāṃ prathamatṛtīyapādayornirantarā dvitīyacaturthayośca sāntarā paṭa iva sragdāmnīva vā varṇapradānānmasṛṇaivāvṛttiḥ
eṣa rājetyādāvudāharaṇe ṣakārarephau mūrdhanyau, jakārayakārau tālavyau, dakāralakārau dantyāviti prathamapāde
takāradakārau dantyau, pakārabhakārāvauṣṭhyau, takāradhakārau dantyāviti tṛtīyapāde ca
vinā krameṇa sāntaramāvartanaṃ navarūpasājātyaṃ kvacidullikhatīti masṛṇa evāyam
valīṣu tasyāḥ skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ 167’

atra dantyau mūrdhanyāvoṣṭhyau ḍalayoraikyena dantyapañcakaṃ mūrdhanya ityādinā krameṇa yadyapi pūrvavatsthānataḥ samānaśrutitayā masṛṇaivāvṛttiḥ, tathāpi citrapaṭa iva mālyagrathana iva vā yo'yaṃ kṣaṇaṃ pakṣmasu tāḍitādharāḥ, payodharaḥ, valīḥ, skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ, iti nānāvarṇātmakaḥ sūtrāntarasyeva puṣpāntarasyeva vā sthānabhedena masṛṇa eva niveśastenaiṣa śrutyanuprāso varṇamasṛṇa ityucyate
atra thakāratakārau dantyau, ṣakāraṇakārau mūrdhanyau, pakāramakārāvoṣṭhyau
tāḍitetyatra ḍakāre lakārakalpanayā sanalatadhāḥ pañca dantyāśca repho mūrdhanya iti prathamapāde
dvitīyapāde ca dhakārasakārau nakāratakārau dantyāvityādinā krameṇa sāntarā nirantarā ca śrutita eva varṇāvṛttiḥ pūrvavadupalabhyate
kiṃtu takārādīnāṃ rūpato'pi sthāne sthāne pūrvamasṛṇatānyagbhūtaivāvṛttistenāyaṃ varṇamasṛṇaḥ
ata eva sā māṃ ko'pi vārayediti kātaratāprādurbhāvāditastato viloladṛṣṭiḥ
atra hakāramakārāvoṣṭhyau, cakārayakārau tālavyāvityādinā krameṇa masṛṇā hakārādīnāṃ rūpasājātye'pi masṛṇatāprādhānyādvarṇamasṛṇā cāvṛttirityāha—atra sarvamiti
na jātu bālā labhate sma nirvṛtiṃ tuṣārasaṃghātaśilātaleṣvapi || 169 ||’
atra dantyavarṇaprāyatayātimasṛṇatve śilātaleṣviti dantyavarṇābhyāmeva varṇastomo dattaḥ
tāpodrekāddattaṃ dattameva candanamāśyānabhāvena reṇubhiralakacchaṭāsu viśīryata iti dvitīyakāmāveśo dhvanitaḥ
atra takāranakārau dakāranakārāvityādinā krameṇa ślokasamāptiṃ yāvadbahavo dantyāḥ
na ca śruterudbhave'pi masṛṇatā na prakṛṣyata iti varṇānutkaṭo'yam
atra hakārasya tulyasyātulyasthānena ghakāreṇa saha bhede'pyekatvabuddhestulyaśrutitvamiti bhede'pyekatvabudhdyā nāgarānuprāso'yam
śrutiśca vāstavī pratipādanamātrārūḍhā veti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ
vijātīyayorekajātyapratibimbanaṃ dvidhā bhavati sthānasāmye tadasāmye ca
dīrgheṇa raṃhaseti, ghoro'ṅghririti, raṃhaḥsaṅghamiti, ghakārahakārāṇāṃ sthānasāmye'pi vaijātyamastyeva
atrocchalanmatsyapucchāgretyatra tsyacchakārayoriva tsyakārasyāpi tulyaśrutitvamityasamānasthānatvena bhede'pyekatvabudhdyā nāgarānuprāso'yam
cachau tālavyau, tasau dantyāviti sthānabhedaḥ prakāśa eva
tathāpi piṇḍībhūtābhyāṃ ca stambībhūtamadhyapatitau tasau samānaśrutikāviti paṭhitau saubhāgyamarpayataḥ
atra ḍakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭatādibhirekatve'pi bhedāvabhāsa iti tattve'pyekatvanihnavena nāgarānuprāso'yam
drutādau vṛttimātraṃ bhidyate, na tu rūpamiti mahābhāṣyakāroktadiśā yeṣāmekasthānatve'pīṣatspṛṣṭataratvādikṛtā bhedaprathā te ḍakārādayaḥ
anena kila pracchannapriyagocaro gāḍhāliṅganamanorathaḥ prakaṭito bhavati
atra ca kroḍaḍimbhetyādau ḍakāravakārayakārāṇāmīṣatspṛṣṭataratvādibhedaḥ śrutisājātyaṃ ca suprasiddhameveti
atra ḍhakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭatādibhirekatve'pi bhedāvabhāsa iti tattve'pyekatvanihnavena nāgarānuprāso'yam
dūre patataḥ kacagrahādikeliṣu pravṛttirlaṅghanena sarvāṅgīṇaḥ pulakodbhedo bahirvyāvartanamantaranuvartanaṃ ca mugdhāṅganājātiḥ
atra kṣuṇṇeṣu sainyeṣu śūnyāraṇyānīti nakāraṇakārayoḥ svalpaśrutitvamekatvaṃ vā bhāsata iti upanāgaro'yaṃ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
ratnaiḥ punaryatra rucā rucaṃ svāmāninyire vaṃśakarīranīlaiḥ || 176 ||’
atra karīranīlairiti rephalakārayoraikyena tulyaśrutyā caturṣvapi pādeṣvanuprāsanirvahaṇamityupanāgaro'yaṃ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
etadanuprāsasidhdyā caturṣvapi pādeṣu rephānuprāsanirvahaṇamapi kaviśaktivyutpattivyañjakamupapannaṃ bhavatītyāha—caturṣvapīti
‘vidyāsyando vāgvidāṃ yaḥ prasannaḥ puṇyāṃ vācaṃ devatāṃ tāṃ namāmaḥ
yāṃ brahmāṇaścintayante viśokāḥ sā no deyātsūnṛtā sūnṛtāni || 177 ||’
sarve'pi cānuprāsāḥ prāyeṇa visadṛśavarṇāntaritā eva svadante ityauṣṭhyakaṇṭhyādīnāmihānupraveśo bhavati
vidyāsyandaḥ sārasvatapravāhaḥ saiva vāgdevatā śabdabrahmarūpā taccintayā parabrahmādhigamaniḥśreṇībhūtayā śokasya iṣṭahānijakhedasya vicchedaḥ
atra syandaḥ prasanna iti dantyau sakārau, brahmāṇaścetayanto viśokā ityādeśānādeśau śakārau tālavyau, punarante sā sūnṛtāmīti trayo dantyāḥ, sarveṣāṃ saṃbhūya pāṭhe tulyaśrutitaiva pratibhāsata iti
nanu sajātīyānāṃ nirantaramāvāpe kartavye kimiti vijātīyavyavahitairāvṛttirudāhriyata ityata āha—sarve'pīti
śleṣanirvāhakatayā śrutyanuprāso'laṃkāra ityuktam, tacca saṃdarbhavyāpakatayaiva nirvahatītyāha—yatheti
nanvevamanuprāsāntaraviṣaye'pi śrutyanuprāsaḥ prasaktastatra ca kimanena kariṣyata ityata āha—anuprāsaḥ kavigirāmiti
svavarge bhavāḥ svavargyāḥ kaca ṭatapāntaḥsthoṣmopalakṣitāḥ saptavargāḥ
māṇikyastabakitahāralatāvadanyonyālambanena parabhāgalābha ityabhiprāyatayā ca kāvyavyāpakenaiva saṃdarbheṇa nirūpyamāṇā vargyā vṛttirvṛttyanuprāsa iti paryavasito'rthaḥ
varṇānuprāsādbhedo vakṣyate—karṇāṭādiprabhavakavihevākagocarāḥ kārṇāṭīprabhṛtayo na tu vṛttīnāṃ deśaiḥ kaścidupakāraḥ
kāmaṃ kathaya kalyāṇi kiṃkaraḥ karavāṇi kim || 178 ||’
miṣantī nirnimeṣeṇa cakṣuṣā mānuṣī na sā || 184 ||’
tatra saṃkaro dvidhā—vijātīyasaṃvalanam, mithaḥ saṃbhedena saṃyogarūpatā ca
atra pūrvārdhe svāntyasaṃyoginau cavargau, uttarārdhe tu kavargāviti
ata eva nṛṇāṃ vidagdhamithunānāṃ cittameva sarvasvabhūtaṃ vittaṃ haratīti
kvacidasti kvacinnāsti kvacidasti na cāsti ca
nanvanuprāsād vṛttīnāṃ ko viśeṣa ityata āha—kvaciditi
seyaṃ mūrdhanyānāṃ prathamacaturthapañcamadvitraistadāvṛttyā ca prāyo jāyate
viśīrya patanenātyantadhavalā nirjharā eva hāso yasya tādṛśena darīmukhenāntaḥprarūḍhabakulakusumāmodaniḥsaraṇarañjitajaladharapratibimbabhūtatāmranayanonmudraṇāt
atra kurvansvarlokanirvartyeteṣu mūrdhanyānāmantaḥsthasaṃyogā uccaiḥśabda ityādau svabhāvagurūṇāmapi pūrvarūpasaṃyogasannidhau chāyāviśeṣo bhavatītyāhuḥ kecit
so'yamasyāḥ saṃyujyamānāviśeṣe'pi vṛttyantarādviśeṣo niṣṭhurādvaiparītyena śleṣodāharaṇaṃ sugamam
seyaṃ prāyo vyañjanā nāma saṃyogena janyate
āsajya rājyabhāraṃ svaṃ sukhaṃ svapiti manmathaḥ || 200 ||’
kalayā kalāvato'pi hi kalayati kalitāstratāṃ madanaḥ || 201 ||’
iti dvādaśadhā vṛttiḥ kaiścidyā kathiteha sā
atra guñjatāṃ kuñjarāṇāmityādervarṇastabakasya sthāne sthāne vinyāsādayaṃ varṇānuprāsastabakavānityucyate
‘bāle māleyamuccairna bhavati gaganavyāpinī nīradānāṃ kiṃ tvaṃ pakṣmāntarālairmalinayasi sudhāvakramaśrupravāhaiḥ
eṣā prodvṛttamattadvipakaṭakaṣaṇakṣuṇṇavindhyopalābhā dāvāgnervyomalagnā malinayati diśāṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhūmarekhā || 203 ||’
prathamo bhāgo nīnī iti pratibhāsārūḍhastṛtīyādi prathamapāde
atra kālaṃ kapālamāleti, aṅkamekamiti, vande varadamīśānaṃ śāsanamityādiṣu pakārarephakakāragarbhādhānādayaṃ varṇānuprāso garbha ityucyate
kālaṃ kapāletyatra lakārāvṛttiḥ kakāreṇa vyavadhāne prakṛte kapāle'nyatra pakāro
‘na mālatīdāma vimardayogyaṃ na prema navyaṃ sahate'parādhān
mlānāpi na mlāyati kesarasragdevī na khaṇḍapraṇayā kathaṃcit || 205 ||’
atra prathamapāde na mālatīdāmetyādibhirvikāsaḥ, dvitīyapāde premetyākārāvṛttyā saṃkocaḥ, tṛtīyapāde mlānāpi na mlāyatītyetābhyāṃ ca vikāsaḥ, caturthe neti saṃkocaḥ
na mālatīdāmetyādau prathamapāde makārāvṛttirdvayena vivaraṇam, dvitīyapāde sakṛtprayogeṇa tasyaiva saṃvṛtiḥ tṛtīyapāde nakārasakārayorāvṛttyā vivṛtiḥ, caturthe neti saṃvaraṇam
pūrvavalanenottaragrahaṇaṃ cakravālaṃ vyañjanamātravalanamabhipretam, tena valī valetyatrāpi cakravālasiddhiḥ
atra gurvī guruṇā prayukteti, vadhūrvidhātṛ iti, cakāra cakoreti, lajjāvatī lājavimokamiti dvayostrayāṇāṃ ca svarasaṃyogavarṇānāṃ krameṇāvṛttiḥ, so'yaṃ varṇānuprāsaḥ kramavānityucyate
tathā calatpraktyā durvahanitambabhārālasāyā api kathaṃcitpadavinyāsena kāntiviśeṣo dhvanyate
svabhāvatāmrayorapi netrayostatkāle dhūmāśleṣād dviguṇo rāga iti upamāne mattapadapoṣaḥ pūrvārdhe dvayordvayorūttarārdhe trayāṇāmanullaṅghitakramāṇāmeva vyañjanānāmāvṛttiriti sphuṭaṃ vivaraṇam
svādyavarṇavartinā svareṇa saha pādamadhyāntayoranuprāsaḥ saṃpuṭaṃ yathā—
‘sthirāpāyaḥ kāyaḥ praṇayiṣu sukhaṃ sthairyavimukhaṃ mahārogābhogaḥ kuvalayadṛśaḥ sarpasadṛśaḥ
gṛhāveśaḥ kleśaḥ prakṛticapalā śrīrapi khalā yamaḥ svairī vairī tadapi na hitaṃ karma vihitam || 209 ||’
āvartanīyo varṇaḥ svapadenābhimatastasya pūrvo yo varṇastadvartinā svareṇa saha tasyāvṛttiḥ
‘tyaja manasi sadāhe he smara sthānamasmi- nnanu kirasi śarīre re kimindo mayūkhān
api parihara vāyo yogamaṅgairmadīyaiḥ praṇayini samavete te bhavantaḥ sakhāyaḥ || 210 ||’
‘vidrāṇe rudravṛnde savitari tarale vajriṇi dhvastavajre jātāśaṅke śaśāṅke viramati maruti tyaktavaire kubere
vaikuṇṭhe kuṇṭhitāstre mahiṣamatiruṣaṃ pauruṣopaghnanighnaṃ nirvighnaṃ nighnatī vaḥ śamayatu duritaṃ bhūribhāvā bhavānī || 211 ||’
tatra hi kila keśagrathanā nirvyūḍhaiva bhaktiḥ punaranyānyeti
‘nīte nirvyājadīrghā maghavati maghavadvajranidrānidāne nidrā drāgeva devadbiṣi muṣitaruṣaḥ saṃsmarantyāḥ svabhāvam
devyā dṛgbhyastisṛbhyastraya iva galitā rāśayo raktatāyā rakṣantu tvāṃ triśūlakṣatikuharabhuvo lohitāmbhaḥsamudrāḥ || 212 ||’

tathāhi prakṛtodāharaṇe sthāne sthāne stabakāvivakṣāyāṃ na stabakavān, vibhāgaparihāreṇa na sthānī, varṇāntarāyānupapattau na garbhaḥ, saṃkocavikāsābhāvena na vivṛtasaṃvṛtaḥ, cakravālakramābhāvena na gṛhītamuktaḥ
tasyāṃ pratīyamānāyāmevāntarāntarā nānājātīye varṇāvṛttiścitraśobhādāyinī vicitrānuprāsa ityucyate
prakṛtodāharaṇe saṃdarbhasamāptiṃ yāvadāvartamāne eva cakāre kāñcana kāñceti layavaladityādiṣu kakāralakārādyanuprāsodbhaṭabhāvenava varṇāvṛtternyagbhāva iva prakāśate
‘sarvāśārudhi dagdhavīrudhi sadā sāraṅgabaddhakrudhi kṣāmakṣmāruhi mandamunmadhulihi svacchandakandadruhi
śuṣyatsrotasi taptabhūrirajasi jvālāyamānāmbhasi jyeṣṭhe māsi kharārkatejasi kathaṃ pāntha vrajañjīvasi || 214 ||’
vibhinnārthaikarūpatvaṃ sthānavibhāgālambanaṃ vyapetāvyapetabhāvaśca yamakacchāyāvarṇānuprāsavāniti atiśāyane matup
‘udyadbarhiṣi dardurāravapuṣi prakṣīṇapānthāyuṣi cyotadvipluṣi candraruṅmuṣi sakhe haṃsadviṣi prāvṛṣi
te'mī śuddhavarṇā vṛttiprakārāḥ ṣaṭratriṃśallakṣitāḥ, sāṃprataṃ dvādaśatāpannavarṇāvṛttayo lakṣyanta ityāha—varṇāvṛttiranuprāsa iti
nanu yadi padāvṛttirabhinnārthā tadā punaruktireva, bhinnārthā cedyamakānna bhidyata ityata āha—visargeti
vṛtteḥ pādādiyamakatābhāvo nirvāhaḥ prāyonirvāha iti yojanā
atra raṇeraṇeti śaneśanīti kārakāramiti bhujaṃbhujeti padaṃ tadekadeśāvṛttiḥ sphuṭamupalabhyate
sa naiṣadhetyādau niṣadharūpo varṇasamudāyaḥ padaikadeśatāmāpannaḥ sādhāraṇa eva
atra karoti karotītyekaṃ saṃpuṭam, kiṃ kirātaḥ kiṅkirāta iti dvitīyam, samākṛṣya samākṛṣyeti tṛtīyam, śilīmukhāñchilīmukhāniti caturtham
karoti kiṃ kirāto'yamityādau madhye śilīmukhāñchilīmukhāniti prathamaṃ saṃpuṭam
tasyāpi kiṃ kirātaḥ kiṅkirāta iti tṛtīyam
caturthapāde tu bhavabhaveti rītibhaṅgo na ca doṣaḥ
ke na yānti nibandhāraḥ kālidāsasya dāsatām || 222 ||’
‘paraṃ joṇhā uṇhā garalasariso candaṇaraso khadakkhāro hāro malaapavaṇā dehatavaṇā
muṇālī vāṇālī jaladi a jaladdā taṇuladā variṭṭhā jaṃ diṭṭhā kamalaṇaaṇā sā suvaaṇā || 223 ||’
[paraṃ jyotsnā uṣṇāṃ garalasadṛśaścandarasaḥ kṣatakṣāro hāro malayapavanā dehatapanāḥ
mṛṇālī bāṇālī jvalati ca jalārdrā tanulatā variṣṭhā yaddṛṣṭā kamalanayanā sā suvadanā ||]
joṇhā uṇhā riso raso ityādikā pratipādaṃ madhyāntasthānaniyamenāvṛttiḥ
‘puraḥ pārā'pārātaṭabhuvi vihāraḥ puravaraṃ tataḥ sindhuḥ sindhuḥ phaṇipativanaṃ pāvanamataḥ
tadagre tūdagro giririti giristasya purato viśālā śālābhirlalitalalanābhirvijayate || 224 ||’
atra pārāpāreti sindhuḥ sindhuriti dagre dagra iti śālāśāleti krameṇa prathamādipādeṣu dvayorevānuprāsayorvinyāsaḥ
yadyapi tṛtīyapāde girigirīti dvitīyamapi miṃthunaṃ saṃbhavati tathāpi varṇadvayavyavadhānādanullekhītyupekṣitavān
‘śirasi śarabhaḥ kroḍe kroḍaḥ karī karaṭe raṭa- nnurasi ca rururmarmaṇyeṇaḥ śikhī mukharo mukhe
kavirapi hṛdi hrādī dūrāddharirdvipajiddhato dhanuṣi laghutā lakṣye'pūrvo jayo'sya yaśasvinaḥ || 225 ||’
tadevāvṛttibhūmnā mithunāvalī śaraśareti kroḍakroḍeti karakareti davadavetyādinā krameṇa supratyabhijñānaiva
nanu varṇāvṛttiranuprāsasāmānyalakṣaṇayuktā na cāsau padādyāvṛttāvastītyata āha—
tatra ca kāryānumeyaḥ samayasaṃnikarṣaviśeṣa eva prayojaka iti
yadyapi padānu-prāsādau nāmadviruktirativyāpikā tathāpyarthopakṣepopanipātinī saha vivakṣitā
dvaruktirapi nāma śarīrasaṃpādikā nāmnaḥ sataśceti dvayī boddhavyā
gulu ityavyaktānukaraṇasya ḍāci dvirvacane ca guluguleti nāmasiddhiḥ
‘amṛtamamṛtaṃ candraścandrastathāmbujamambujaṃ ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyāpi
iti na bhajate vastu prāyaḥ parasparasaṃkaraṃ tadiyamabalā kāntiṃ dhatte kutaḥ sakalātmikām || 229 ||’

atra dvitīyāntānāmamṛtādipadānāṃ dviruktidoṣeṇa tātparyāparyavasānādamṛtādiguṇaparatve kalpanīye'pi nikṛṣṭaguṇaparāṇāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattestattadasādhāraṇaguṇopabṛṃhitāmṛtādiniṣṭhānāmādyapadopāttasāmānyāpekṣo viśeṣyabhāvaśca viśeṣaṇatvaṃ ca nirvahati
‘śaile śaile na māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ na gaje gaje
deśe deśe na vidvāṃsaścandanaṃ na vane vane || 230 ||’
ata eva yā kācidarthasāmarthyākṛṣṭā dviruktiḥ sā saptavarṇādivannāmadviruktisamākhyayā pratipādyate
atra kiṃcidekamasādhāraṇaguṇāśrayaṃ vivakṣan taditarasya tajjātīyasya guṇasaṃsparśamasahamāno'prastutameva śailādikaṃ prastutavān
śabdādupasarjanatayā pratīyamānaḥ siddhasvabhāvaḥ padārtho guṇa ityucyate
mandamandamuditaḥ prayayau khaṃ bhītabhīta iva śītamayūkha || 231 ||’
prakāraḥ sādṛśyaṃ tatpūrṇaguṇena nyūnaguṇasya sādhāraṇaguṇānvaye bhavati
iyāṃstu viśeṣo yadekatra siddhasyānyatra pratibimbanaṃ sādṛśyaṃ, śuddhavīpsāyāṃ tu yugapadekasya nānāpadārthasaṃbandha iti
yāṃ kila kriyāṃ kartā prādhānyenānuparatyā ca kartumicchati tadrūpamābhīkṣṇyam
siddhe hi vastuni paunaḥpunyapratītiḥ kriyopādhite eva na svarūpeṇa
nanu ṇamulaivābhīkṣṇyābhidhānātkiṃ dviruktiḥ kariṣyata ityata āha—so'yamiti
svarūpārthābhyāmantaratamaśabdadvayarūpa ādeśo vā dviruccāraṇaṃ vā dviruktiśabdārthaḥ
‘jayati jayati devaḥ śyāmakaṇṭhaḥ pinākī jayati jayati devī lokamātā bhavānī
jayati jayati dhanyaḥ so'pi bhaktastayoryaḥ kimaparamiha dhanyaṃ varṇyate tāvadeva || 233 ||’
na cāvaśyaṃ dvāveva śabdau prayoktavyau kiṃtu yāvadbhirabhimato'rthaḥ pratīyate tāvanto'bhīkṣṇyaśabdāḥ prayoktavyāste nāvyayakṛtsu dṛśyante kiṃtu tiṅpadeṣvevetyāha—kriyāpadeti
yadyapyekavākyārthasaṃgatyā kriyāpadasya dvayamevoccāraṇaṃ tathāpi kāvyāpekṣayā bāhulyamavaseyam
evaṃ svārthe'vadhāryamāṇe ityādayo'pi dviruktiprakārāḥ svayamavaseyā ityāśayavānupalakṣaṇatayā kiṃcidudāharati—nimūlakāṣamiti
‘asthīnyasthīnyajinamajinaṃ bhasma bhasmendurindu- rgaṅgā gaṅgoraga uraga ityākulāḥ saṃbhrameṇa |’
bhūṣāveṣopakaraṇagaṇaprāpaṇavyāpṛtānāṃ nṛtyārambhapraṇayini śive pāntu vāco gaṇānām || 235 ||’
harṣādayo'pi saṃbhramaprayojakāstairasādhāraṇatāmāpannairavacchidyamānaḥ saṃbhramo'nyonyo bhavati na ca saṃbhramatā jahātīti saṃbhramadviruktiprakāra evāyamityarthaḥ
atra muñca parityaja dahati apākuru iti kriyāpadeṣvāvegasaṃbhramānnadvirukteḥ
tathāhi—araṇyānīpraveśe vijigīṣudviṣāṃ yoṣiddāvāgnisaṃbhramāvegātkayāpyevamucyate, tatra prathamaṃ kañcuka evāvegasaṃbhramaḥ
nanu kañcukaṃ kañcukamitivanmuñcetyādikamāvegasaṃbhramaprabhavameva tatkathaṃ na dvirucyata ityata āha—atreti
‘jaya jaya jaya śrīmanbhoja prabhāti vibhāvarī vada vada vada śravyaṃ vidvannidaṃ hyavadhīyate
śṛṇu śṛṇu śṛṇu tvadvatsūryo'nurajyati maṇḍalaṃ nahi nahi nahi kṣmāmārtaṇḍaḥ kṣaṇena virajyate || 239 ||’
nanu vākyārthaprayuktyaiva kāvyasya sanāthīkaraṇātkimanuprāsenetyata āha—jāyate na ceti
arthabhede kathaṃ na punaruktidoṣa ityata uktam—pravṛttyā bhinnayeti
sa cāvyavahito vyastaḥ samasta ubhayaḥ punaḥ
yastu vyavahito nāma neyatā tasya śakyate
dvitiyaṃ tu cakravālai garbhaścetyukta vyavahitasya tarhi kiyanto bhedā ata āha—yastviti
tena bahubhāvāvāntaraviśeṣatayā nāyaṃ samaśīrṣikayā gaṇita ityarthaḥ
‘uahissa jaseṇa jasaṃ dhīraṃ dhīreṇa garuiāi vi garuam
rāmo ṭhiea vi ṭhiiṃ bhaṇai raveṇa a ravaṃ samupphundanto || 240 ||’
rāmaḥ sthityāpi sthitiṃ bhaṇati raveṇa raveṇa ca ravaṃ samabhikrāman ||]
tvanmūrtiriva mūrtiste tvamiva tvaṃ kṛśodari || 241 ||’ iti
dhairyagurutāsthitigāmbhīryānuniṣpādī vāganubhāvo rasapūrṇakumbhocchalananyāyena sākṣādiva tattatprakarṣamarpayan śobhāvikāsahetuḥ
nanu jaseṇa dhīreṇa garuiāi vi i raveṇa a iti yadapañcake vibhaktyā taduttarayoścakāradvayena ca vyavadhānātkathamavyavahitabheda udāhriyata ityāha—atreti
tathā ca dyotakānāṃ paraśaktisahakāritvena tadanupraveśātsvāṅgamavyavadhāyakamiti nyāyāt
tatra cāvaśyabhedakalpanayā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvī vācyastathā ca gauṇī nāma dviruktiḥ syāditi saṃkaraśaṅkanāyodāhṛtamiti siddhāntatātparyasaṃkṣepaḥ
sakhi vijitā parasumanaḥsumanaḥ subhaga ca madhutilakam || 242 ||’
atra ‘kisalaya kisalaya’ iti, ‘sumanaḥ sumanaḥ’ iti ca samastānāmevāvyadhānādayaṃ lāṭīyo'nuprāso'vyavahitasamastaḥ pūrvaḥ punaravyavahitavyasta ityucyate
svāpekṣayā vyasto'nyāpekṣayā ca samastaḥ, dvitīyo vyasto'paraḥ samasta iti sa dvitīyobhayaśabdavācyaḥ

atra timiravallabhapūrvāśetiśabdāstimirādiśabdāpekṣayā vyastāḥ yathā—svapūrvottarapadāpekṣayā ca samastāḥ padāntādyorviniveśitā iti yathoktalakṣaṇānugamāllāṭīyānuprāso'yamavyavahito vyastasamastaścakravālamityucyate
yatha śrutidviruktaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrveṇottaraścottareṇa samasta iti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ
savibhramā vibhramadāyinī vaḥ sapaṅkajā paṅkajalocanā śrīḥ || 246 ||’
du saho vidviṣāṃ svāmī duḥsahastamasāṃ ca saḥ || 247 ||’
‘kiṃcidvacmi na vacmi vacmi yadi vā kiṃ vacmi vacmīdṛśaṃ dṛśyante na bhavādṛśeṣu patiṣu sveṣāmadoṣe damāḥ
te kiṃ santi na santi santi yadi vā ke santi santīdṛśāḥ sarvasteṣu guṇairgṛhītahṛdayo lokaḥ kuto vartate || 248 ||’
āvṛttidvaiguṇyādinānekaguṇatvam, na ca guṇanāyāmiyattāvadhāraṇakāraṇamastītyabhisaṃdhāya tasyeyattā na śakyate kartumiti pūrvamuktam
sveṣāmātmīyānāṃ madhye yaḥ kaściddoṣastatra damā daṇḍaprakārā na dṛśyanta iti
na kevalamasamastaṃ bhinnārthatayā lāṭīyānuprāse'pi na saṃgacchate
na ca lāṭīyānuprāso vā nāmānuprāso vā padānuprāsādbhidyata iti
tatkimanuprāsa evāyaṃ na bhavatīti pṛcchati—kena tarhīti
śatadhṛtirbrahmā tasya bhuvanabhūtamambhoruda padmaṃ tasya, kṣoṇī pṛthvī tadrūpā yā naustaristasyāḥ kūpadaṇḍaḥ guṇavṛkṣaḥ
eko daśaśabdo vyastaḥ, anye trayaḥ samastāḥ
‘vastrāyante nadīnāṃ sitakusumadharāḥ śakrasaṃkāśakāśāḥ kāśābhā bhānti tāsāṃ navapulinacarāḥ śrīnadīhaṃsahaṃsāḥ
nanu vyavahita eva kiṃ guṇanādibhedo netyāha—avyavahite'pīti
tatra hi prathamaḥ kāśaśabdo bhinnārtha eva
dhanebhyo hi kaścitsuhṛnnāsti loke dhanānyarjayadhvaṃ dhanānyarjayadhvam 253’
dṛśyata ityanena yadvavdyavahite bhūyasī guṇanā mahākaviprabandheṣu pratīyate na tadvadavyavahite'pīti pūrvaṃ vyavahitamātre guṇanādikamupanyastamiti tātparyam
atra dhanapadavyavadhānena bahvīṃ guṇanāmavalambamānameva caturthapāde tvavyavahitā tvanuprāse'pi praviṣṭamiti bhavati vyavahitāvyavahitabhedatā
‘yaistvaṃ sākṣātkṛto nātha teṣāṃ kāmeṣu ko grahaḥ
yaistvaṃ sākṣātkṛto nātha teṣāṃ kāmeṣu ko grahaḥ || 254 ||’
tāvubhau yadi na syātāṃ medhayā kiṃ prayojanam || 255 ||’
atra yadi syātāmiti pādabhāgena saha padāvṛttistribhāgāvṛttirbhavati
na subhruvāṃ tulyamihāsti ramyaṃ na subhruvāṃ tulyamihāsti ramyam 256’
phullapaṅkajamiva cāru phullena paṅkajena cāruriti yadyapi vṛttyarthau bhidyete, tathāpi padānāmabhinnārthatvādudāharaṇatā
‘līneva pratibimbiteva likhitevotkīrṇarūpeva ca pratyupteva ca vajralepaghaṭitevāntarnikhāteva ca
sā naścetasi kīliteva viśikhaiścetobhuvaḥ pañjabhi- ścintāsaṃtatitantujālanibiḍasyūteva lagnā priyā || 258 ||’
arthābheda iti nārthaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ kiṃtu śabdapratipādyamātravacana ityāśayavānāha—ivādīti
nanvanye'pi padāvṛttiprakārāḥ kimiti nodāhṛtā ityata āha—yamakānāṃ hīti
bhedabhaktayo'vāntaraprakāravicchittayaḥ sthānāsthānapādabhedalakṣaṇā ślokāvṛttiḥ paramatra nāstīti yamakādapakarṣaḥ
etadeva khaṇḍasarasvatīṣu kaviṣu na tathā kāvyasiddhiriti darśayandraḍhayati—śrutivarṇānuprāsāviti
jajā yuddhaśauṇḍāsteṣāmojasā jātā yā ājiḥ saṅgrāmastaṃ jayatiti kvip
taṃ veṇudāriṇaṃ tato'nantaraṃ atitatān caturaṅgabalena prāptavistārān ātinaḥ satatagamanaśīlān tudatīti kvip
bhānāṃ dīptatārānurūpāṇāṃ śukrabṛhaspatyādīnāmābhevābhā kāntiryasyetyupamānapūrvapadabahuvrīhau uttarapadalope ca bhāmaḥ
tasyā īro dhūnanaṃ rāti dadāti arīraraḥ
devaḥ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakrīḍārataḥ, dānavanandī hiraṇyakaśipustasya dāne'vakhaṇḍane yo nādo vakṣaḥkapāṭapāṭanakaṭakaṭāśabdastena divaṃ svargaṃ dudāva kimetadityākasmikasaṃbhrameṇetyupatāpayāmāsa
bhūribhirbahubhirbhāribhiḥ prakṛtisārabhāravāhibhiratipramāṇakāyatayā bhuvo bhārabhūtairantaḥkāṃsyabhājano niḥsvāno bherī tadvadebhibhiḥ
abhrābhaiḥ prathamonnatameghakāntibhiribhairhastibhirbhiya rānti prayacchantīti bhīrā ibhāḥ pratidvipā abhirebhire abhiyuktāḥ
nanu nānānanā vividhākāravadanā gaṇā ūnena hīnena nunno jito nā na na puruṣaḥ
tathā nunna inaḥ prabhuryasya so'pyātmani jīvati nānā puruṣo'puruṣa eva
tathā nunnanunnaḥ jita iva klībatayā parābhūta iti
tamapi yo nudati sa nānenā na niṣpāpaḥ bandhacchāyārpakānyavarṇagurutvonmeṣamātraprayojakastakāro na vṛttiśarīrāntargata iti dvivyañjanatā nāśaṅkanīyā
varṇasamāmrāye yena krameṇa kādayo māvasānāḥ paṭhitāstena krameṇa vyañjananiveśaḥ
kaḥ khagaughastattatprasiddhāvadānapakṣisamūhastamañcatīti kvini saṃyogāntalope kṛte ca khagaughāṅiti rūpam
citaṃ saṃvidaṃ chyati chinattīti cicchaṃ yadojastannāsti yasyāsāvacicchaujāḥ
64’ iti nakāra iti jhān parabalabhakṣako jñaḥ paṇḍitaḥ
aṭāḥ saṅgrāmāṅgaṇaparyaṭanaśīlāḥ subhaṭāstānoṭhate bādhata iti kvip
tathā abhīrbhayarahitaḥ evaṃvidhaḥ ko nāmāyamudadhīn papharba pūrayāmāseti praśnaḥ
uttaram—arīn lunanti yā āśiṣastāsāṃ sahaḥ kṣamo mayo daityarāja iti
saha ena viṣṇunā vartate iti sā lakṣmīḥ
arīn dhamati tāpayati iti dhamaterlyuṭi bahulavacanamanyatrāpīti dhamādeśaḥ
samaḥ tattulyaḥ kṣaṇavisarpā bhaṅguraḥ samāgamo yasyāḥ sā tathā
yadyapi ca ‘aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānāmuraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śirastathā
jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikoṣṭau ca tālu ca’ iti, tathāpi jihvāmūlīyasya svaratvādurasyanāsikyayoḥ kāvyapraveśābhāvāduronāsikājihvāmūlaparyudāsena sthānapañcake caturādinirūpaṇam
he sūcirucidhīḥ śucibhiḥ śuddhābhirnutibhiḥ stutibhiryathoktaviśeṣaṇa viriñciṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhinu prīṇayeti
kuṇḍalaratnaugha eva maghavato dhanustena karburo meghanādanāmā rākṣasaḥ
natāṅgyā kasyāścidanyasyāḥ saṅge saṃgata, tava śobhanāṅganā kāmākramaṇaprāptanānārūpatayā vartate
gāṅgakaṃ gaṅgāsaṃbandhi jalaṃ tasyākaḥ kuṭilā gatiḥ
kutsitamaghaṃ pāpamaghakaṃ sa eva kākastaṃ hatavānaghakakrākrahā
evaṃvidhastvaṃ gāṃ svargaṃ agāḥ yāyā iti āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtapratyayaḥ

hānaṃ hāḥ na hā ahāstāñjihīte prāpnotīti ahāhaṃ tādṛśamaṅgaṃ yasya sa khago garuḍaḥ sūryo vā so'ṅkaścihnabhūto yasya tādṛśo'go'rthānmerustadvartinaḥ kaṅkākhyā agakhagā vṛkṣanivāsinaḥ pakṣiṇaste'pi ākākakā gamanaspṛhayālavo yasya sa tathā

vidhirviriñciḥ, ī lakṣmīstasyā inaḥ prabhurviṣṇuḥ, īśo mahādevaḥ, indro vāsavaḥ, ījaḥ kāmo lakṣmīputratvāt, ilā pṛthvī, jino buddhaḥ, siddhā devaviśeṣāḥ, mitraḥ sūryaḥ, raido dhanadaḥ kuberaḥ, devā uktavyatiriktā marudādayaḥ, eṣāṃ saṃbandhibhidhaiṃyaiṃrdhṛtibhiḥ svairvittaiśca naikairanekavidhaistaistaiḥ prasiddharūpairahaṃ svairaiḥ suṣṭhu āsamantātsamṛddho bhavānītyāśaṃsā
mama tryakṣa namaddakṣa hara smarahara smara || 278 ||’
kṣitiḥ pṛthvī tasyāḥ sthitiḥ pālanaṃ mitirmānaṃ kṣiptiḥ saṃhārastadvidhiṃ vetti
smarahara kāmadahana, tryakṣa trinayana, hara mahādeva, mama smara
edhete dve dve te ye neme deveśe || 279 ||’
ime ye deveśe'pi na staste dve tava edhete vardhete
uru rurudhurguru dudhuvuḥ svamarikulaṃ yudhi kuravaḥ || 280 ||’
kṣitervijitiḥ vijayaḥ, sthitervarṇāśramamaryādālakṣaṇāyā vihitirvidhānaṃ tadeva vrataṃ tatra ratiryeṣām
parā śreṣṭhā gatirjñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā
evaṃvidhāḥ kuravaḥ svadviṣāṃ kulamuru vistīrṇa rurudhuḥ
bhogo rogo moho modo dhyeye vecchetkṣeme deśe || 281 ||’
āmrāyānāṃ vedānāmantyā vāgupaniṣat sā hitāhitapratipādanaparā kimāha
kiṃtu yāvadhdyeye dhyātavye kṣeme kleśarahite deśe viṣaye mokṣalakṣaṇe icchedicchāṃ kuryāditi
tatra ye lobhino lobhavantastannindanaśīlena tāpena tejasārthādugraścaṇḍaraśmiḥ sa naḥ mama dehe'stu
kimityevamāśāsyata ityata āha—amṛtasyandini kāntāgre guṇināṃ priyatame'kṣepo'vilamba eva hito'rthataḥ samarasya
‘karṇikāyāṃ nyasedekaṃ dve dve dikṣu vidikṣu ca
tadyathā—yā devī pavitratvenāśritā anīcayā tuṅgyā budhdyā māyāyāmasyāvidyāvistārasyāyāsaṃ glāniṃ vicchedaṃ yācanīyā prārthanīyā yato yātanaṃ narakānubhavanīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ chinatti śriyāpi stuteti
ādyo yāvarṇaḥ karṇikāyāṃ śriteti pāveti krameṇa dvikaṃ dvikamaṣṭapatreṣu
saṃcaraṇaśīlaḥ sphāro yo varastaṃ kṣarati dadāti iti
varāñchreṣṭhān kirati kṣipati kṛṇoti hinasti veti karmaṇyaṇ
valakṣa dhavaladeha, alavala prāptaśakte, kālagala nīlakaṇṭha, jvala dīpyamāno bhava
atha prathamārdhe eka eva repho'ṣṭadhā karṇikāyām
aparārdhasyānye'ṣṭau lakāravarjaṃ daleṣu ceṣāṃ saṃdhiṣvanye'ṣṭau lakārāḥ
pūrvaṃ karṇikāyāmādyo nakāro grāhyaḥ, tataḥ śeti parṇamadhye, śīti parṇāgre, parāvṛtya parṇakarṇikayoḥ śakāranakārau, punaḥ karṇikāto dalāgragamāgame'pi

pīvareṇa stanāḍhyenorasā natā sāradhāmā utkṛṣṭakāntiḥ sahasā sahāsyā akasmādvā śrṛṅgāroddīpanasvabhāvena mārgaśīrṣeṇa hetunā śobhanena vāsasā ca lakṣitā he sāhasardha sarvaniśīthābhisaraṇa sāhasarasika, tvāmeti upagacchatīti
yasyaitāni saṃbodhanaviśeṣaṇāni te tubhyaṃ namaskurute kaściditi
samāḥ samā iti vīpsā prativarṇaṃ makārasāhityabodhanārthā
‘rātāvadyādhirājyā visarararasavivdyājavākkṣmāpakārā rākā pakṣmābhaśeṣā nayanananayanasvā [sā] khayā stavyamārā
rāmā vyastasthiratvā tuhinananahituḥ śrīḥ karakṣāradhārā rādhā rakṣāstu mahyaṃ śivamamamavaśivyālavidyāvatārā || 294 ||’
’ tathāhi—vyājo māyā saiva vāgrūpā vyājaśabdopapadaṃ vāgabhidhānaṃ yasyāḥ sā mahyaṃ rakṣāstviti saṃbandhaḥ
rātaṃ dattamavadyaṃ doṣabahulamādhirājyam, avadyā ādhayo yatra tādṛśaṃ vā rājyaṃ yayā
viśiṣṭaṃ saraṇaṃ visarastaṃ rāti prayacchati yo raso'rthādvīrastaṃ vetti vindati vā
yā kṣmāyāṃ pṛthivyāmapakāraḥ putrakalatrādirūpo yasyāḥ sakāśāditi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ
stavyo māro māraṇaṃ kāmo vā yasyāḥ
tuhinaṃ nayati prāpayatīti nayaterḍapratyaye tuhinanaścandrastasya nahiturjaṭājūṭe bandhayituḥ parameśvarasya śrīḥ śaktirūpā
kaṃ sukhaṃ rāti dadātīti karastasya kṣārabhūtā dasyavasteṣāṃ khaṅgādidhāreva dhārā chettrī
śive manatvaṃ mānti paricchindanti ye vaśino yoginasteṣāmapi vyālavidyāṃ kṣudravidyāmavatārayati yā sā tathā
muktvā kāmamapāstabhīḥ paramṛgavyādhaḥ sa nādaṃ hare- rekaughaiḥ samakālamabhramudayī ropaistadātastare || 296 ||’
harernādaṃ siṃhanādaṃ ropairbāṇairājirabhasātsaṅgrāmaharṣāduddharataraśrīvatsabhūmirunnatahṛdayaḥ sa tvamālambya mānena tadviśiṣṭamiti viśeṣaṇam
prāptapāpavināśo mudā harṣeṇa apagatabhīḥ śatrurhariṇavyādho'bhramākāśaṃ pidadhe tadā tasminkāle siṃhanādamuktveti saṃbandhaḥ
puraḥ puro likhitvānyānagre likhedyathā ṣaḍarāḥ saṃpadyante
‘śuddhaṃ baddhasurāsthisāraviṣama tvaṃ rugjayātisthira bhraṣṭoddharmarajaḥpadaṃ gavi gavākṣīṇena cañcadbhuvā
tathyaṃ cintitaguptirastavidhidigbhedaṃ na cakraṃ śucācāro'prāṃśuradabhramugra tanu me ramyo bhavānīrucā || 298 ||’
cakraṃ me mama gavi vāci śuddhamakaluṣam, dharmādutkāntamuddharmamīdṛśaṃ yadrajo rājasabhāvastasya padaṃ sthānaṃ tadbhraṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ yasmāt
astā vidhidigdaivapāratantryaṃ yatra tathāvidhaṃ, śucā śokena ca na vakrīkṛtamanapahatamadabhramupacitaṃ yadbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ tattanu vistārayeti prārthanā
akṣīṇenopacitena cañcadbhuvā sāhlādena gavā vṛṣeṇa lakṣita
bhiyaṃ yena yānti tādṛśānāṃ gaṇānāmāravo yatra
varitāḥ subhaṭairyuddhārthamāhūtā arayo yasyāṃ sā tathā
‘vara īpsāyām’ iti dhātoḥ ktapratyaye variteti rūpasiddhiḥ
atrāyukpādayoḥ prathamatṛtīyayorānulomyena varṇāvalīṃ gṛhītvā tatpratilomarūpau yukpādau dvitīyacaturthau gṛhyete
paṭhitervarṇādvarṇāntarasaṃcāro gatistanniyamanena citraṃ gaticitraṃ sa cātra yathoktarūpa eva
cāruṇā ramate janye ko bhīto rasitāśini || 300 ||’
he amaraṇā maraṇarahitāḥ, niśitakhaṅgarato bhayaśūnyaśca rucā tejasā nyejate na kampate
yo hi bhītaḥ sa kathaṃ śabdāyamānāśanaśīlarakṣaḥpiśācādisaṃkule janye saṅgrāme cāruṇā karituragādinā ramate
atra saṃdarbhasamāptiparyantaṃ yā varṇamālā gṛhītā saiva samāpterārabhya pratyāgatyā yāvadārambhaṃ samāpyata iti pūrvaṃ tvardhenaivamiti
sārājāvutkṛṣṭasaṅgrāme mānāse paramānakṣepake mattāḥ sāragāḥ sotkarṣagatiśālino rājebhā rājadantino yatra
bhāriṇaḥ svāminārpitasamarabharāḥ ata eva yathocitaceṣṭāvantasteṣāṃ janānāṃ dhvaniḥ siṃhanādo yatreti kriyāviśeṣaṇamityanulomaślokārthaḥ
nidhvanantaḥ stananto javena vegena hāriṇa ibhā yatra
tato vistīrṇo mānavajārāsaḥ sainikakṛta ārāvaḥ kolāhalo yatra
īdṛśī senā rāgarasātparalakṣmīharaṇarasena tamo bheje krodhamavāpeti pratilomaślokārthaḥ

lāse nṛtye bahalā asaṃkucitā rāhumalīmasā śyāmā sālakā bhrūkarṇādiparabhāgārpakacūrṇakuntalavatī rasācchṛṅgārāllīlā yasyāḥ sā, tathā tuṅgā uccavyavahārā evaṃvidhā sā bālā he catuḥṣaṣṭikalārata, alāli lālitā tvayeti saṃskṛtaślokārthaḥ
kalā gītavādyanṛtyānāṃ saṃkarīkaraṇasahitā paṭīyasī gātuṃ taralā tvaritā sālālī nānāvṛkṣapaṅktistadīyena sarakeṇa madhunā alasā
saha irayā madirayā vartante selā vā
vigadaṃ gavi roddhāro yoddhā yo natimeti na || 305 ||’
vidite svarvāsināmapi prasiddhe nijitāḥ pareṣāmājayo yuddhāni yena tādṛśyanīke samare prāptaṃ gavi parāhvānarūpāyāṃ vāci vigadaṃ hṛdayajvararahitaṃ ke nāma bhaṭā yoddhāraḥ
yo yoddhā sankathamapi natiṃ namratāṃ naiti na yāti
sa yathā—‘natimeti na yoddhā yo roddhāro vigadaṃ gavi
bālā ṣoḍaśavarṣadeśīyā śobhanakṛṣṇakeśī kāntipradacūrṇakuntalaśobhitā sasvā ātmasaṃpadyuktā sutavatī putrayuktā utkṛṣṭābhimānātmakaśṛṅgāravatī abhilaṣitasvavivāhādivratākāṅkṣā atastaṃ bhajasveti
lalito manojñastīvraḥ pravīṇaḥ sva ātmā yasyāḥ
tale lāsakā nartakā yasyāḥ sā tathābhūtā
kasya mastakasya sannā saṃgatā ādā grahaṇaṃ yatreti vā
saiva svaṃ vittabhūtā yeṣāmevaṃvidhā ye svakā ātmapakṣīyāstānājihīte iti vic
kaṃ madajalamākirati iti kākārastādṛśa ibhabharo hāstikaṃ yatra
niḥsvā nirātmāno bhavyā ādheyaguṇāstānapi vyayanti svabalenopabṛṃhayanti ye te nisvabhavyavyāsteṣāṃ bhasvani bhartsanaśīle
śikharamālāṃ saṃdhimālāṃ ca pūrvārdhavarṇaiḥ krameṇa bibhṛyātpūrayet
dve śṛṅgāṭake mitho vaiparītyena yatra śikharaṃ dviśṛṅgāṭakam
khe vyomni gauravaṃ yasya sa tathā
candrakalāsu rasamanurāgaṃ saṃdhāya kṛtvā antaḥsvacchatayā dṛśyanabhobhāganemimadvalayākārollekhinīṃ me mamāgaurīṃ śyāmāṃ śaṅkāmapanaya
sāraṃ paraṃ sa ca jayī śamitāsyandanenasā || 315 ||’
prasiddhānubhāvā satī gaurī sarantī nirargalaprasarā na trasyatītyatrasā
asyandanena sthireṇa enasā kalmaṣeṇa śamitā viklavībhūtā
atra jagati paraṃ sāraṃ yaṃ bhagavantamitā saṃgatā
jagatāṃ nāmarūpaprapañcasya gātrabhūta dānavakulakṣayeṇa sahita mudāṃ harṣāṇāṃ rakṣaka aja viṣṇo, atra jagati satāṃ madhye na ko'pi te tava samaḥ
‘kamalāvalihārivikāsaviśeṣavahaṃ janakāṅka na nagāmikaraṃ divi sāramanāramaṇaṃ jaratāṃ na
tamasāṃ balahānivilāsavaśena varaṃ janakānta na namāmi ciraṃ savitāramanādimahaṃ jagatāṃ na || 319 ||’

kamalāvaliṣu padmakhaṇḍeṣu praśasteṣu hārī manojño yo vikāsa[viśeṣa]stasya voḍhāraṃ janairlokaiḥ stutyaṃ tadīyaṃ kaṃ śirastatrāṅka cihnabhūta, na nagāmikaraṃ, kiṃtu visṛtvarakiraṇameva divi vaimānikapathe sārabhūtaṃ jaratāṃ pariṇatānāmanāramaṇaṃ na, kiṃtu prītikarameva
tamasāṃ balahānau yo vilāsavaśaḥ saṃtato vyāpārastena varamutkṛṣṭaṃ, janakānta lokahṛdayaṃgama, jagatāmanādiṃ na, kiṃtvādimeva
evaṃvidhaṃ bhagavantaṃ savitāramahaṃ na namāmi kiṃtu namāmyeva
‘surānana tvāṃ na na hānanaṣṭaye punaḥ stuve'narghaghanaplavānanam
hānanaṣṭaye hānināśāya tvāṃ na na stuve, kiṃtu staumyeva
praṇatānāṃ manasi yadanūnamanādibhavaparamparānupāti vyasanaṃ tasya pradhūnanaṃ pratikṣepakam
sakānaneṣu vanagahaneṣu sthāneṣu nadīnasya payorāśeriva nardanaṃ kolāhalo yasyeti
prathamapādasthādakṣarādārabhya caturthapādasthamakṣaraṃ yāvadekajātīyākṣaracatuṣkāvalīṃ gṛhītvā parāvṛtya tajjātīyānāmeva catuṣṭayī gṛhyate
turyācca pādaprathamākṣarādupakrame yena yena mārgeṇa murajākṛtirlabhyate tenāyamaparaḥ śloko bhavati
varasya īpsitasya vastunaḥ kāraḥ kāraṇaṃ tatpradaṃ tāraṃ dīptaṃ dhāma kāntiryasyāḥ
asamā ananyasādhāraṇī āsikā sthitiryasyāḥ sā nāyikā latāmālayā saṃketalatāmaṇḍapena amā sārdhaṃ āpa prāptavatī
udāharaṇamātraṃ caitat, tena gativicitrādigomūtrikādayo'nye'pi citraprakārā bhavanti
nanu yāvadudāhṛtameva kiṃ gatyādi citraṃ, tathā sati kiṃ gomūtrikādīnāṃ pṛthagbhāgavibhāgavyāghātaḥ syādityata āha—udāharaṇamātraṃ caitaditi
nyāso yathā—ayugmataḥ prathamāttṛtīyā-ccopakramya dvitīyacaturthapādasaṃdaṃśena gomūtrikayā prathamadvitīyayostṛtīyacaturthayośca parasparamunmeṣaṇamitīyamayukpādagomūtrikā
citte mahāsurajanena śubhaṃ vidhattāṃ cittaṃ mahāsurajanānatabhaṅgadhanvā || 325 ||’
śubhaṃ kalmaṣarahitaṃ cittaṃ vidhattām, aviśeṣeṇa saṃsāriṇāmeva
atra pūrvavatsamapadamupakramya viṣamapādasaṃdaṃśena samāptiriti viśeṣasteneyaṃ yukpādagomūtrikā
krīḍādhūteśabhāmā dyusadanatanimacchedanī ca bhruvā no dehe devī durīrandamamaratanatā nandinomānyadhāmā || 326 ||’
bhruvā bhrūkṣepeṇa durīrandūramapanayan no'smākaṃ dehe damaṃ deyāditi saṃbandhaḥ
kaṃdarpaḥ kṣodapakṣaḥ sarasasuravadhūmaṇḍalīgītagarvo daityādhīśāndhakenānatacaraṇanakhaḥ śaṃkaro bhavyabhāvyaḥ || 327 ||’
deyānnaścaṇḍadhāmā salilaharakaro rūḍhakandāravindo dehe rugbhaṅgarāgaḥ suramanujadamaṃ tyāgasaṃpannidhānam
bhandaṃ dikkṣobhadaśrīḥ sadasadaravadhūkhaṇḍanāgīragamyo- 'daityaidhī bandhahānāvatatarasanayaḥ śaṃparo divyasevyaḥ || 328 ||’
purākhyadānavasya davo dāvāgniḥ styānāyāḥ ghanāyāḥ saṃvido nidānam
surāṇāṃ manujānāṃ ca damaṃ damatīti vā
sade upavane sadarā sabhayā yā vadhūstadīyānāṃ khaṇḍanāgirāṃ nirbhartsanavacasāmaviṣayaḥ
śaṃ sukhaṃ piparti pūrayatīti śaṃparo divyaḥ sevyaśceti
evaṃvidhaścaṇḍadhāmā ravirno'smākaṃ dehe bhandaṃ kalyāṇaṃ deyādityarthaḥ
pareṣāṃ darpamardanaśīlasya nāgasya kāliyākhyasya daṃṣṭrābhiḥ, kuvalayāpīḍākhyasya hastino vā viṣāṇābhyāṃ yā ājiḥ saṅgrāmaḥ tatrājayyaṃ jetumaśakyam
‘skando rundarddhimiṣṭāṃ vitaratu saralo dāritārātivarge saspando mandasajjo bhavabhayakalane saṅgare kelikārī
saṃdohollāghalāsī jana iha balihā caṇḍatābhūrakharvo devaujorājadehe mahimani nirato vikramāḍambareṇa || 333 ||’
dārite śatrusamūhe saspandaḥ sphuradrūpo mandaḥ svasthacittaḥ bhavabhayasya saṃsāratrāsasya kalane kṣepaṇe ihajane martyaloke saṃdohena ya ullāghaḥ sāmarthyaṃ nīrogatvāttena lasanaśīlaḥ
devaujasāṃ rājñāṃ khaṇḍayitrī īhā ceṣṭā yatra tādṛśe mahimni nirataḥ
‘cando kandappamittaṃ viharaṇasahalo hāritārāpabandho sacchando vandaṇijjo kuvalayadalano saṅkare melikārī
kandodollāsalāsī jaai sivasihāmaṇḍanībhūdakhaṇḍo dentājoṇhājaloho vihiaṇiaraī vibbhamāṇaṃ baleṇa 334’
[candraḥ kandarpamittraṃ viharaṇasaphalo hāritārāprabandhaḥ svacchando vandanīyaḥ kuvalayadalanaḥ śaṃkare melikārī
kandodollāsalāsī jayati śivaśikhāmaṇḍanībhūtakhaṇḍo dattajyotsnājalaugho vihitanijaratirvibhramāṇāṃ balena ||]
vibhramāṇāṃ balena vihitā nije ātmani ratiryena sa tathā
dehaṃ harantī sahasā surāmā gehaṃ carantī sahasābhirāmā || 335 ||’
natānāṃ bhavyānāmaridāra iti vā, natā bhavyā aridārā yasminniti vā
suṣṭhu sāro layastatra layanaṃ taṃ bhāvayati yastasmai
bhāni nakṣatrāṇyāvarituṃ śīlaṃ yasyeti bhavāri ākāśaṃ pūrayati vyāpnoti evaṃbhūtāya
suṣṭhu tāra ucchrito yo rayo vego gamanaṃ tena bhāvine
mama cidgato madīyāṃ saṃvidamārūḍhaḥ sāmaraḥ sadevo haraḥ sphuratu
samastairdvādaśabhirapi ravibhirādityaiścitritā ālekhyīkṛtā stutā praśastā ruciḥ kāntiryasya
smarasya kṣemaṃ kuśalaṃ kṛntati chinattīti smarakṣemakṛt
namaskāreṇa cihnitā praṇāmapṛcchābhāvinī prasādajanmā smitaprabhā yasya sa tathā

krameṇa pādānāṃ nairantaryeṇa prathamadvitīyābhyāṃ dvitīyatṛtīyābhyāṃ prathamacaturthābhyāṃ dvitīyacaturthābhyāmiti vyutkramabhedāstrayo vaiparītyavaśena caturthāditaḥ prathamaṃ yāvadyojanenātrāpi kramavyutkramābhyāṃ ṣaṭ prakārāḥ
tadyathā—prathamatṛtīyābhyāṃ ca prathamadvitīyābhyāṃ ca prathamacaturthābhyāṃ ca dvitīyatṛtīyābhyāṃ ca prathamacaturthābhyāṃ ca tṛtīyacaturthābhyāṃ ca prathamatṛtīyābhyāṃ ceti draṣṭavyam
tadevameka eva gomūtrikāśloko yathoktarītyā ṣaṭūtriṃśadgomūtrikātarṇakānprasūta itīyaṃ gomūtrikādhenuḥ
‘vandyā devī parvataputrī nityaṃ madhumadhurakamalavadanā purandhryadhidevatā devaiḥ stutyā kinnarageyā bhaktyā varacaritamahiṣamathanī jagattrayanāyikā
siddhairdhyeyā kesariyānā kāmyā raṇacaturarasikahṛdayā trilocanavallabhā dhīraiḥ pūjyā darpaṇapāṇirnūnaṃ guṇanilayalaṭabhalalitā satīṣu dhuraṃdharā ||’
vareṇa devatāprasādena carito nirargalaprasaro guṇānāmāśrayo laṭabhaṃ manojñaṃ ca lalitaṃ vilāso yasyāḥ sā tathā
’ sthitaṃ pratilomamāgantukaṃ kramavinyastamīpsitaṃ hi pratilomasya krameṇa phalaṃ guṇakārastathaivānulomaṃ bhāgahāraḥ
atra ca kriyāhīnatvena kārakavihīnatvena ca padāvayavavattayā padāvayavamātratvena ca nirarthakān ṣaḍviṃśatimapāsya ślokadhenurekaiva vṛttabhedena śataṃ ślokatarṇakānprasūte
‘nakhamukhapāṇikaṇṭhacikurairgatibhiḥ sahasā smitena laliteṣu dṛśā maṇiśaśipadmakambucamarāḥ kariṇaḥ sutanoḥ sudhā ca hasitā hariṇāḥ
phaṇigaṇasiddhasādhyadayitā na samāḥ sakalāstvayā ca khabhuvacchalitāḥ tava baladarparūpavijitā nitarāṃ vibudhāścirāya caturaiścaritaiḥ 340’
he lalite gauri, tava śobhanayā dṛśā sutanoḥ śobhanasya śarīrasya
sādhyā devaviśeṣāḥ khabhuvo grahatārādyāḥ ( rāpyata iti rāpyam
padānyatra pratipādaṃ sudhākalaśābhidhāne chandasi ṣaḍ vibhajyante

yadyapi dvitīyatṛtīyapādayoścakārābhyāṃ nakāreṇa caturthapāde taveti padādhikyaṃ tathāpyādyapadārthānurodhena samuccīyamānaniṣidhyamānārthānurañjakatvena saṃbodhyamānārthānuyāyitayā cakāranakārayostaveti ca tatpādāvayavarūpā eveti tadasatkalpameva

tathā ca ṣaḍbhyaḥ padatraya upādīyamāne saptadaśākṣarāyāṃ jātau yathāsaṃkhyānurodhenādye'rdhe prastāraracanākrameṇa daśa vikalpāḥ, tṛtīyacaturthayośca pādayostāvantastāvanta eveti daśabhirāhatairdaśabhiḥ śatam
śatena cāhatairdaśabhiḥ sahasraṃ tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ sahasradhenuḥ
‘kriye jayasi jṛmbhase sṛjasi jāyase trāyase stuṣe mṛṣasi mṛṣyase hṛṣasi pīyase prīyase
stuṣe mṛṣasi hoḍase kuṭasi galbhase klībase hnuṣe harasi rajyase rajasi rājase bhrājase || 341 ||’
‘miṣa spardhāyām’, ‘pīṅ pāne’, ‘mṛḍa sukhane’ tudādau, ‘hoḍṛ anādare’, ‘kuḍa saṃhāre’, rajyase āsajasi

iha pṛthvīnāmani chandasi ṣaḍbhyaḥ saṃbodhanānuge padacatuṣṭaye upādīyamāne ekādaśākṣarāyāṃ jātau prastārālpatvena yadi vā chandobhedasya śabdenāpratipāditatvāt tadbhedo'pyudāharaṇīya iti tasyāmeva rathoddhatābhidhāne chandasi daśasu vikalpeṣu pratipādaṃ bhavatsu daśabhiḥ śataṃ śatena sahasraṃ sahasreṇa ca daśasahasrāṇi tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyante itīyamayutadhenuḥ
‘durge bhadrepsubhadre'diti surabhidite saiṃhike gauri padme nitye hṛdye vareṇye kalikamalikale kālike caṇḍi caṇḍe
dhanye puṇye śaraṇye śaci śabari śive bhairave rājñi sandhye chāye māye manojñe'vani janani jaye maṅgale dhehi śaṃ naḥ || 342 ||’

atra hi sragdharābhidhāne chandasi pādatrayapadānurodhenāntyapādadvayenaikaikameva padaṃ turyapāde parikalpyamiti sarvatra navasu padeṣu sthiteṣu padacatuṣṭaye padapañcake copādīyamāne prathame āpātalikāyāṃ pañcaviṃśatau dvitīye ekayā prācyavṛttyā saha vaitālīyake yadi vā pañcabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamaupacchandasike caturviṃśatau tṛtīyavaitālīya eva caturviṃśatau caturthe ca pāde prācyavṛttidvaye samamāpātalikāyāṃ ṣoḍaśabhirekayā prācyavṛttyā vaitālīyaprācyavṛttyā saha vaitālīyaiḥ ṣaṅbhistathaivaupacchandasike dvābhyāmiti caturviṃśatau vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu pañcaviṃśatyāhateṣu caturviṃśatau śatāni ṣaṭ
tairāhateṣu caturviṃśatau lakṣāṇi trīṇi sahasrāṇi ca ṣaṣṭiḥ tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ lakṣadhenuḥ
tathā hyatra pādatraye navasu turyapāde ca daśasu
traye padacatuṣke padapañcake copādīyamāne prathama aupacchandasika ekasya padasya dviruktyā viṃśatau yadi vā āpātalikāyāṃ daśa

vaitālīye pañcadaśasu aupacchandasike udīcyavṛttidvayena yad vaitālīye catasṛbhirudīcyavṛttibhiḥ samamekonaviṃśatiriti ca pañcaviṃśatau tṛtīyasminnaupacchandasike pañcabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamekādaśa
vetālīye tathaiva caturdaśa aupacchandasike tisṛbhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ saha ṣaḍiti viṃśatau tṛtīyāsminnaupacchandasike tisṛbhirudīcyavṛttibhiḥ samaṃ pañcaviṃśatau caturthe tvāpātalikāyāmeka eva

dviruktyādinā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamaśītau vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu viṃśatyāhatapañcaviṃśatau pañcaviṃśatyā dvāviṃśatau pañcaśatādhikāni dvādaśasahasrāṇi tairapyāhateṣu aśītau daśalakṣāṇi tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ prayutadhenuḥ
‘sthūlaṃ datse sūkṣmaṃ dhatse bhuvi bhavasi rabhasi ramase rame divi modase chintse bāḍhaṃ bhintse gāḍhaṃ ruṣimiṣasi dhanuṣi manuṣe jaye puri jṛmbhase
svalpaṃ śeṣe kalpaṃ preṣe'citi carasi yaśasi yatase cale yudhi galbhase brūṣe vāmaṃ śrūṣe kāmaṃ hṛdi viśasi vacasi sacase ruce dṛśi dīpyase ||’
preṣa iti iṣa gatāvityasya, citi caitanye, gṛdhu gārghye
sacase vacase rame jaye cale ruce iti devyāḥ saṃbodhanapadāni
atra bhuñjaṅgavijṛmbhite chandasi ekādaśabhyaḥ padebhyaḥ pañcasu ṣaṭsu ca padeṣu upādīyamāneṣu jagatījātau prasiddhākṣarojjvalā jaladharamālā navamālinī chandaḥsu saptatau

dvitīye pūrveṣu candravartmadrutavilambitamaṇimālāprabhavatsu ca śate tṛtīye'smin prathamapādacchandasyeva pañcāśati caturthapāde dvitīyapādacchandasyeva śateṣu vikalpeṣu prabhavratsu saptatyāhateṣu śateṣu saptatisahasrāṇi śatairāhatāyāṃ saptatilakṣāṇi, saptatisahasraiṃrāhateṣu pañcāśallakṣāṇi trīṇi sahasrāṇi ca pañcaśatairāhate śate koṭyastisraḥ sārdhāstarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ saṃpadyanta itīyaṃ koṭidhenuḥ

tathāhi padatraye padacatuṣke padapañcake copādīyamāne pūrvasyāmeva jātau prathamadvitīyacaturtheṣu pādeṣu pratyekaṃ jaladharamālāprabhācchandasorekasya dvayordviruktyā śate tṛtīyasmiṃśca pūrvasyāṃ maṇimālojjvalānavamālinītāmaraseṣu chandaḥsu tathaiva śate vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu śatenāhate śate daśa sahasrāṇi taiścāhate śate daśa lakṣāṇi tairapyāhate śate koṭyastarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ saṃpadyanta itīyameva daśakoṭidhenuḥ
‘yā gīḥ śīḥ śrīrdhī strī hrīrbhīrjūrmūstūḥ sūḥ strūrdhūḥ pūrbhūḥ
struk sragyugbhugruk śuk tṛṭ dviṭ yut krut cidvinmugdigdyūḥ || 344 ||’
ṛk dṛk vāmā mṛtkṛdbhāmā mutkṣutkāmā dvārdyaurgauḥ
agre bhāge bhāraṃ dhuraṃ vahatīti dhūḥ
bhojanaṃ pālanaṃ kauṭilyaṃ ca bhuk rogo dīptirbhaṅgaśca ruk
śrutivākyaṃ vivecanaṃ ca hiṃsā ca ṛk
saha ena akāreṇa viṣṇunā vartata iti sā lakṣmīḥ
jalayānaṃ na vidyate aurdvivacanaṃ yasyāṃ sā advitīyetyarthaḥ śabdāvayavaśca nauḥ

tathāhi pañcadaśabhyaḥ padebhyaḥ kramavyutkramābhyāṃ navādipadayoge'ṅgīkriyamāṇe bṛhatījāterārabhya pratijātipāde ye vikalpāstairuttarottaramāhanyamānaiḥ, yadi vā samaste'pi śloke ṣaṣṭipadebhyaścaturviṃśatyaṣṭāviṃśatyādipadayojanāyāṃ gāyatrījāterārabhya praṃtijātipāde ye vikalpāstaiḥ parārdhebhyaḥ parārdhāni tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyante itīyaṃ parārdhaparārdhadhenuḥ
arthatrayapratipādakatvena pratipādaṃ padatraye parikalpyamāne'nekavidhacchandobhiruktāni caturvyañjanādīnyanuktāni khaṅgaprabhṛtīni sarvacitrāṇyeṣaiva yathākāmaṃ prasūyata ityarthaḥ
mahomi bhāruñcule mellāsato vikiṇaku uvāṇau ujju akkhu kahahi 345
‘vāṇau ujju māigahilla uaṇṇavi komahlaṇa u vārijjantu ṇṇaṭṭhāi
karai valivaṃ uu ca vakkasa macchalu ahimuhaṃ hi taruṇihiṃ aacchāsai dukkam || 346 ||’
seyamubhayato'pi ṛjunaiva mārgeṇoktipratyuktyoḥ samā pravṛttiritīyamṛjūktirnāma vākovākyam
‘bāle, nātha, vimuñca mānini ruṣaṃ, roṣānmayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ, khedo'smāsu, na me'parādhyati bhavān sarve'parādhā mayi
tatkiṃ rodiṣi gadgadena vacasā, kasyāgrato rudyate, nanvetanmama, kā tavāsmi, dayitā, nāsmītyato rudyate || 347 ||’
‘kiṃ gauri māṃ prati ruṣā nanu gaurahaṃ kiṃ kupyāmi kāṃ prati mayītyanumānato'ham
jānāmi satyamanumānata eva sa tva- mitthaṃ giro giribhuvaḥ kuṭilā jayanti || 348 ||’
‘keyaṃ mūrdhnyandhakāre timiramiha kutaḥ subhru kāntenduyukte kāntāpyatraiva kāminnanu bhavati mayā pṛṣṭametāvadeva
nāhaṃ dvandvaṃ karomi vyapanaya śirasastūrṇamenāmidānī- mevaṃ prokto bhavānyā prativacanajaḍaḥ pātu vo manmathāriḥ || 349 ||’
te ime ubhe api śleṣavakroktirnāma vākovākyam
‘nādeyaṃ kimidaṃ jalaṃ ghaṭagataṃ nādeyamevocyate satyaṃ nāma pibāmi katyapatṛṣaḥ pītena nāmnābhavan
kiṃ varṇā api santi nāmni rahitaṃ kiṃ tairalaṃ tvaṃ kuto yasmādeva bhavānbhaginyasi tatastenaiva māṃ bādhase || 350 ||’
‘kuśalaṃ rādhe, sukhito'si kaṃsa kaṃsaḥ kva nu sā rādhā
atra gotraskhalite vipakṣanāmnaiva vaiyātyenottaraṃ dattamiti naimittikīyaṃ vaiyātyoktirvākovākyam
atra priye haṃsa ityatrāvarṇalope priye ahaṃ sa ityarthasya mukhyayaiva vṛttyā gūḍhatvādiyaṃ mukhyā gūḍhoktirnāma vākovākyam
‘nirarthakaṃ janma gataṃ nalinyā yayā na dṛṣṭaṃ tuhināṃśubimbam
utpattirindorapi niṣphalaiva kṛtā vinidrā nalinī na yena || 353 ||’
tāvimau pūrvottarārdhayoranyonyoktyā gūḍhakāmalekhāvitīyaṃ gauṇī gūḍhoktirnāma vākovākyam
‘kka prasthitāsi karabhoru ghane niśīthe prāṇeśvaro vasati yatra manaḥpriyo me
ekākinī vada kathaṃ na bibheṣi bāle nanvasti puṅkhitaśaro madanaḥ sahāyaḥ || 354 ||’
‘labhyante yadi vāñchitāni yamunābhāgīrathīsaṃgame deva preṣyajanastadeṣa bhavato bhartavyatāṃ vāñchati
nanvetanmaraṇena kiṃ nu maraṇaṃ kāyānmanovicyuti- rdīrghaṃ jīva manastavāṅghrikamale kāyo'tra nastiṣṭhati || 356 ||’
tadidaṃ svakalpitoktipratyuktibhyāṃ jīvato'pi janmāntarāvāptisādhanenāścaryaheturiti citrā nāma citroktipratyuktirvākovākyam
‘ko'yaṃ bhāmini bhūṣaṇaṃ kitava te śoṇaḥ kathaṃ kuṅkumā- tkūrpāsāntaritaḥ priye vinimayaḥ paśyāparaṃ kvāsti me
paśyāmītyabhidhāya sāndrapulako mṛdnanmṛḍānyāḥ stanau hastena pratinirjitenduravatāddyūte hasanvo haraḥ || 357 ||’
padamekaṃ na kā yāti yadi hāreṇa varjitā || 358 ||’
atra vihaṅgikā kāhāreṇa varjitā na yātīti vaktavye hāreṇa varjitetyuktam
atra śabara iti śambara ityanusvārākṣarasya dattatvāddattākṣareyam
tanvaṅgyāliṅgitaḥ kaṇṭhe kalaṃ kūjati ko viṭaḥ || 360 ||’
atra viṭa ityasminpade vikāre cyute ghakāre datte ghaṭaḥ kūjatīti dvitīyo'rtho bhavatīti seyaṃ cyutadattākṣarā
‘atiḥ atiḥ anmaalaṃ prīdya radya jadya phadya
melā melā melaṃ melaṃ phasa phasa phasa phasa || 361 ||’
‘adya me saphalā prītiradya me saphalā ratiḥ
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ phalam || 362 ||’
phalaṃ pratyadbhutopāyaṃ yaśāṃsi natu na kvacit || 363 ||’
ityanena ślokenoktārthasya yathāsthitasvarānusvāravisarjanīyasaṃyogasya ślokottarasya bindubhireva sūcanākrama iti bindumatī
sāhase sāhase siddhiḥ sarvatra tava kīrtayaḥ || 364
atra jaghanabharābhirāmamandaṃ madirekṣaṇāyā gamanamavalokayanto he yuvānaḥ, kathamiva yūyaṃ madanaśarajvarajarjarā na stheti kriyāpadasya stanaśabdena jaghanasāṃnidhyādgopitena kriyāgūḍhamidam
atra na me āgorasābhijñaṃ ceta iti saṃbandhipadasya mayeti tṛtīyābhrāntyā gopitatvādidaṃ saṃbandhagūḍham
‘jai deareṇa bhaṇiā khaggaṃ ghettūṇa rāulaṃ vacca
tā kiṃ sevaavahue hasiūṇa valoiaṃ saaṇam || 370 ||’
[yadi devareṇa bhaṇitā khaṅge gṛhītvā rājakulaṃ vraja
atra nirīkṣitamanenātra puruṣāyitalakṣma pādalākṣādikaṃ, tena niyuṅkte māṃ na karmaṇītyabhiprāyeṇa vadhvāḥ śayanāvalokanamityabhiprāyagūḍham
yadi dāsyasi necchāmi no dāsyasi pibāmyaham || 371 ||’
atra dāsyasīti dāsīlakṣaṇasya vastuno gūḍhatvādidaṃ vastugūḍham
vidagdhagoṣṭhyāṃ vākyairvā taṃ hi praśnottaraṃ viduḥ || 136
atra ‘kadarthayasi’ iti padaṃ kathamuktaṃ rephayakārayuktaṃ darthayasīti, ato vākyāntare praśnottarasyoktatvādantaḥpraśnamidam
atra ‘vāyutaḥ’ ityuttareṇa praśnādbahiruktena vāyuto naro vānaro bhavati, subhadropayantāpyucyate
‘ko so joaṇavāo ko daṇḍāṇaṃ duve sahassāiṃ
kā kālī kā madhurā kiṃ śukapṛthukānanacchāyam || 376 ||’
atra ya eva praśnāḥ kaḥ sa yojanapādaḥ kaḥ sa yo daṇḍānāṃ dve sahasre ityādayaḥ ta eva ‘krośo yojanapādaḥ’ ‘kodaṇḍānāṃ dve sahasre’ ityādīnyuttarāṇi bhavanti
evaṃ ‘kā kālī kā madhurā kiṃ śukapṛthukānanacchāyam’ ityuttaraṃ kimabhihitaśeṣasya praṣṭavyamiti pṛṣṭapraśnam
atra praśnasya he kānanāda he timirāda pikālītyetadevottaraṃ bhavatītyuttarapraśnamidam
yadvidhau ca niṣedhe ca vyutpattereva kāraṇam
kāvyaṃ śāstretihāsau ca kāvyaśāstraṃ tathaiva ca
‘yadi smarāmi tāṃ tanvīṃ jīvitāśā kuto mama
śliṣṭāṅgulī kamalakāntitalau ca yasyā- stāmudvahedyadi bhuvo'dhipatitvamicchet || 379 ||’
bhayābhdrāntaiḥ suraiścakre tasyai tasyai diśe namaḥ || 380 ||’
daṣṭe'dhare praṇayinā vidhutāgrapāṇi sītkāraśuṣkaruditāni jayanti nāryāḥ || 381 ||’
‘dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha
ākṣiptikā dhruvā ceti śeṣo dhyeyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 141
‘bhaddaṃ bhodu sarassaīa kaiṇo ṇandantu vāsāiṇo aṇṇāṇaṃ pi paraṃ paaṭṭhadu varā vāṇī chaillappiā
vacchobhī taha māahī phuradu ṇo sā kiṃ a pañcāliā rīdīyo vilihantu kavvakusalā joṇhaṃ caorā via 385
[bhadraṃ bhavatu sarasvatyāḥ kavayo nandantu vyāsādayaḥ, anyeṣāmapi paraṃ pravartatāṃ varā vāṇīvidagdhapriyā
vaidarbhī tathā māgadhī sphuratu naḥ sā kiṃ ca pāñcālikā rītikā vilihantu kāvyakuśalā jyotsnāṃ cakorā iva ||]
so'yaṃ kathāśarīravyāpino vastuno nāyakasya nirdeśo vastunirdeśaḥ
tallāsyaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ caiva chalikaṃ saṃpayā saha
hallīsakaṃ ca rāsaṃ ca ṣaṭprakāraṃ pracakṣate || 143
jaliu jāṇai ṇaru riusantāvaṇu aṇalasariccha jai hoi mahāraṇu 391’
jvalito jāyate naro ripusaṃtāpano'nalasadṛśo yadi bhavati mahāraṇaḥ ||]
ṇiakantaṃ ḍāḍhajualehiṃ puṇu puṇu ṇa a balanti || 392 ||’
nijakāntaṃ daṃṣṭrāyugalena punaḥ punarna ca daśati ||]
‘vīhesi harimuhi avi hohi maṃ gale lehi sai
[vibheṣi harimukhi api bhava māṃ ca gale gṛhāṇa sadā
durmanasāṃ durmanaskaṃ saṃkrāmitamaṇḍanaṃ māninyānanaṃ kiṃ tava karasthitam ||]
maṇḍalena tu yatstrīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ hallīsakaṃ tu tat
jeṇa jivijjai jeṇa vilāso palihijjai kīsa jaṇo 395
[ayi durmanaska adya kiṃ no pṛcchāmi tvām
yena jīvyate yena vilāsaḥ parihriyate kimiti janaḥ ||]
‘dordaṇḍāḥ kva dhṛtāṅgadāḥ kva nu śirānaddhau bhujau dvāvimau vakrāṇi kva nu kāntimanti balimatkvedaṃ mamaikaṃ mukham
vācastāḥ kva jitārṇavadhvanighanāḥ kvāyaṃ vacaḥsaṃyamo helākampitabhūdharaḥ kva caraṇanyāsaḥ kva mandā gatiḥ 396’
‘durvārāṃ madanaśaravyathāṃ vahantyā tanvaṅgyā yadabhihitaṃ puraḥ sakhīnām
‘vāraṃvāraṃ tirayati dṛśorudgamaṃ bāṣpapūra- statsaṃkalpopahitajaḍima stambhamabhyeti gātram
sadyaḥ svidyannayamaviratotkampalolāṅgulīkaḥ pāṇirlekhāvidhiṣu nitarāṃ vartate kiṃ karomi || 398 ||’
maurvyā mekhalayā niyantritamadho vāsaśca māñjiṣṭhakaṃ pāṇau kārmukamakṣasūtravalaye daṇḍo'paraḥ paippalaḥ || 399 ||’
ātaṅkādvikalaṃ drutaṃ karuṇayā vikṣobhitaṃ vismayā- tkrodhena jvalitaṃ mudā vikasitaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ vartatām 400’>
kathamiha na vayasyastatkimetatkimanya- tprabhavati hi mahimnā svena yogeśvarīyam || 401 ||’
iti śrīrājādhirājabhojadevenaviracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇanāmni alaṃkāraśāstre'laṃkāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ
nāstyevāsavarthālaṃkāro yaḥ svarūpaṃ nāśrayata iti prāthamyaṃ jāterevetyāha—
nanvevaṃ ‘ya ete yajjvānaḥ prathitamahaso ye'pyavanipā mṛgākṣyo yāścaitāḥ kṛtamaparasaṃsārakathayā
aho ye cāpyanye phalakusumanamrā viṭapino jagatyevaṃrūpā vilasati mṛdeṣā bhagavatī
’ ityādāvapi jātitvaṃ syādityata āha—svebhyaḥ svebhya iti
ata eva jātyantaraprakārāṇāmapi pṛthagalaṃkāratā syāditi na yuktamavāntaravacasaiva vyāghātāt
nanu kimanena prapañcena pūrvābhihi- tarūpamātrasyaiva jātitvādityata āha—teṣu seti
deśaḥ kālaśca śaktiśca sādhanāni ca hetavaḥ || 8
atra dhanurdhareṇaivamaṅgāni samyagbuddhipūrvakaṃ sthāpanīyānīti saṃsthānamidaṃ jātibhedaḥ
taduktam—‘apāṅge dakṣiṇāṃ muṣṭiṃ vāmāṃ vinyasya mastake
atra sarvasyaiva dhanurdharasyaivaṃvidhaśarīrāvayavasaṃniveśo bhavati na kāmasyaiveti nāśrayaviśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ
atra striyāḥ śūlaprollāsanādau vyāpāre buddhikāritamapi śarīrāvasthānamīdṛśaṃ jāyata itīdamavasthānaṃ nāma jātibhedaḥ
ata eva valīnāṃ viśleṣo mitho vibhāgaḥ upariśarīrākarṣaṇātkañcukaprāntāpasaraṇam
musalollāsanādau dṛṣṭamidamabuddhijameva nārīṇāṃ rūpamiti bhagavatīviṣaye pratibimbanamatisphuṭameva
‘kassa kaa cūamañjari putti tue maṇḍio gāmo || 3
kasyakṛte cūtamañjari putri tvayā maṇḍito grāmaḥ ||]
atra vasantotsave grāmataruṇīnāmayaṃ veṣo janamanaḥpramodāya jāyata iti veṣo nāmāyaṃ jātibhedaḥ
yadyapyatra kālaḥ pātraṃ cāsti tathāpi ‘saṃvāllaṇamaulijhavivaraurāhaiambiraiauṇa tālaṅkam
’ ityādau na saṃkaraḥ kādācitkastvasau guṇa eva veṣasya kathaṃ rañjakatetyavaśiṣyate
‘agre gatena vasatiṃ parigṛhya ramyā- māpātya sainikanirākaraṇākulena
yānto'nyataḥ plutakṛtasvaramāśu dūrā- dudbāhunā juhuvire muhurātmavargyāḥ || 4 ||’
atra tādṛśi vyāpāre vyāpṛtānāmīdṛśameva svarūpaṃ jāyata iti vyāpāranāmāyaṃ jātibhedaḥ
’ ityatraikasyāḥ kadācidvitarkāyedamapi vākyaṃ bahūnāṃ tu neti bahuvacanasvarasaḥ
prasphoṭyamānāmapi tvayā nāpasaratītyaho tava saukumāryamiti cāṭugarbhaṃ hasitam
ata eva priyatamā tasyānubandho vartamānanirdeśena vyajyate
etasminmadagandhavāsitavaṭaḥ sāvajñatiryagvala- tsṛkkāntāhatidhūtalolamadhupaḥ kuñjeṣu śete hariḥ || 7 ||’
sāvajñaṃ tiryak valantī ye sṛkkiṇī tābhyāmāhatā iti saṃbandhaḥ
yathaikatra kuñje svapataḥ svarūpaṃ tathānyatrāpīti bahuvacanarahasyam
‘bhadraṃ te sadṛśaṃ yadadhvagaśataiḥ kīrtistavoddhuṣyate sthāne rūpamanuttamaṃ sukṛtinā dānena karṇo jitaḥ
ityālocya ciraṃ dṛśā karuṇayā śītātureṇa stutaḥ pānthenaikapalālamuṣṭirucinā garvāyate hālikaḥ || 8 ||’
latākuñje yāsāmupanādi rataklāntaśabarī- kapolasvedāmbhaḥ paricayanudo vānti marutaḥ || 9 ||’
atra vindhyādrerīdṛśeṣu pradeśeṣvitthaṃbhūtā vāyavo vāntīti hetutvenoktatvāddeśasya deśaheturjātiriyam
deśaviśeṣamuddiśya marutāṃ vidhānamuddeśyasya ca vidhau hetubhāvaḥ
vaṃśīvanānāṃ duṣpraveśatayā marutāṃ mandībhāvo dviradaistarubhaṅgādavakāśalābhe pragalbha- tvamataḥ klamasvedāpanayanasāmarthyametatsarvamāha—atra vindhyādreriti
‘kampante kapayo bhṛśaṃ jalakṛśaṃ gojāvikaṃ glāyati śvā cullīkuharodaraṃ kṣaṇamapi kṣipto'pi naivojjhati
śītārtivyasanāturaḥ punarayaṃ dīno janaḥ kūrmava- tsvānyaṅgāni śarīra eva hi nije nihnotumākāṅkṣati || 10 ||’
yadyapi tiryagāśrayeyaṃ jātiḥ tathāpi hetoradhikasya praveśātpṛthagbhāvaḥ
atra jāyamānakriyāhetubhūtayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ sādhanayoḥ svarūpavarṇanādayaṃ sādhanaheturnāma jātibhedaḥ
agāradvārasya halīśāvaruddhatayā duṣpraveśatvamata eva bahiściraṃ vilambāt pratyeṣaṇaveśanayorvartamānatā
pakṣe svabhāvaparyavasānamastīti jāteḥ kiṃcidapakṛṣṭāṃ vibhāvanāṃ vibhāvayitumāha—
yatra svābhāvikaṃ vāpi vibhāvyaṃ sā vibhāvanā || 9
śuddhā citrā vicitrā ca vividhā sā nigadyate
prasiddhasparśahetorvibhāvyatayā prasiddhagrahaṇaṃ niyamena tadbhāvāpattimūlatvaṃ cāsyāstena virodhaḥ
tathā hi ‘ṇamaha avaṭṭhiatuṅga—’ ityādau vardhanajanyamanyadeva tuṅgatvamanyacca pārameśvaramājānikamiti tayorabhedādhyavasāyaḥ
yadyapi kāraṇābhāve'pi kāryotpattirityeva lakṣaṇaṃ tathāpi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaprayojanaṃ kimityāśaṅkāyāṃ dvayaṃ vibhāvyamāha
pratyekaṃ ca śuddhādibhedātṣoḍhā saṃpadyata ityetāvataiva vibhāvanā śarīraniṣpatteḥ
yathā varṇo varṇena karambitaṃ citraṃ tathā vibhāvanāpi vibhāvanayā tādṛśī citretyāha—
aneko yatra sā citrā vicitrā yatra tāṃ prati
kāmasya puṣpavyatiriktamastraṃ bālyātparaṃ sātha vayaḥ prapede 15’
atraikameva vayolakṣaṇaṃ padārthamuddiśyāpyaneko maṇḍanādeḥ prasiddho hetuḥ saṃbhṛtatvādirvyāvartyate
‘anāsavākhyaṃ karaṇaṃ madasya kāmasya puṣpavyatiriktamastram’ ityatra tu katham
ādye madasya karaṇamāsavo vayastu tato bhinnamiti kadācivdyatirekaḥ syānnatu vibhāvanā
dvitīye'pi vayo madasya kriyā āsavanāmnī na bhavatīti na saṃgatam
evaṃ puṣpavyatiriktamastramityatrāpi vikalpya yathāyathaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vācyam
tathā hetupratiṣedha eva bhaṅgyā darśito bhavati
astramapi kriyārūpaṃ tatpuṣpavyatiriktaṃ puṣpacyutaṃ vinā puṣpebhya iti pūrvavadunneyam
seyaṃ vibhāvanayaiva vibhāvanāyāṃ viśeṣoktestayaiva gīrbhaṅgyā vicitrā nāma vibhāvanā bhavati
tasyā yathokte vakravapuṣī mamākāraṇaripurnirnimittaṃ suhṛccetyanvayo vivakṣitapratītilābhācca nārthāntaraikavācakatvalakṣaṇo doṣaḥ
atrātailapūrāḥ suratapradīpā iti svābhāvikatvavibhāvanāyāṃ śeṣapadārthairavibhāvanārūpairviśeṣa uktaḥ
seyamanyayā gīrbhaṅgyā vicitrā nāma vibhāvanā bhavati
kriyāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ kārato jñāpakaśca saḥ
hetupratiṣedho vibhāvanāyāmuktaḥ, atha hetureva ka ityapekṣāyāṃ hetulakṣaṇamāha—kriyāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ heturiti
upapattau kriyāyāmeva sarvasya nimittabhāvo nirūpyata ityabhisaṃdhāya kriyāyā ityuktamiti kaścit
dravyaguṇakriyā-viṣaye hetuḥ kriyāmātraviṣayaśca kārakamiti prakīrṇapravṛttau vibhāgakaraṇātkriyāgrahaṇaṃ ceha niṣphalaṃ syāt
tasmādyatra kriyāṃ pratyavadhibhāvo nirūpyate tatra dvayīgatirnimittatvamātravivakṣā avastuvivakṣā vā, dvitīye'pi kārakatvavivakṣā vā
na ca kārakamiti tṛtīya eva prakāraḥ prasiddhakāryakāraṇabhāvaviparyāsenopanibadhyamāno heturāścaryakāritayā citra āropitamapi ca hetutvaṃ hetutvameveti bhavati caturthaḥ prakāraḥ
yadāha—‘ko hi pratītimātrakāvye vastusthitiṃ bhāvayet’ iti
yaḥ pravṛttiṃ nivṛttiṃ ca prayuktiṃ cāntarā viśan
so'yaṃ yathokto malayamārutaḥ prītyutpādanakriyāsamāveśātpravartako nāma kārakahetubhedaḥ
atra prabhāvaḥ kriyāyāmaniviśamāna eva hetau tṛtīyāṃ pravartayati na kartarīti kriyāyāmanāviṣṭakārakahetubhedaḥ
tasya rājñaḥ prabhāvenetyatra sadapi kartṛtvamavivakṣitaṃ, ato hetumātravivakṣāyāṃ pākṣikī tṛtīyā bhavatītyāha—hetau tṛtīyāyāmiti
atraivaṃvidhasya pavanasya pathikapramāthasādhanakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvenāveśānnivartako nāmāyamāviṣṭakriyaḥ kārakahetubhedaḥ
sa eva tu nāsti nañā niṣedhādityarthaḥ
atra balapratyujjīvanamaraṇakriyayoḥ saptamīvācyanaimittikādhikaraṇakārakabhāvena hanūmānāviśanprayojako bhavatīti kriyāviṣṭo'yaṃ prayojako nāma kārakahetubhedaḥ
prayojakatā cāsya (te eva) jīvatyujjhitaprāṇe iti padābhyāmupāttā
nanu ca—‘aṅgulyagre madakalaghaṭāndarśayantīva dhūrtā’ ityādau kālpanikādāvapi saptamībhāvātkathaṃ kārakatetyata āha—naimittiketi
atra mānābhyāsakriyāyā bhrūbhaṅgajihmākṣiprekṣaṇādirūpāyā ātmanyevātmanaḥ samāveśo na bhavatīti kriyānāviṣṭo'yamiti śabdābhidheyaprayojako nāma kārakahetubhedaḥ
bhrūbhaṅgajihmākṣisphuritādharādiprekṣaṇārūpāyāṃ mānābhyāsakriyāyāmapi bālāyāḥ svātantryaṃ, tādṛśīṃ tu tāmiti śabdanirdeśyo'bhiprāyaviśeṣaḥ prayuṅkte
yadāha mahābhāṣyakāraḥ—‘yat kiṃcittadabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ preṣaṇamadhyeṣaṇaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ pacyartha’ iti
smaraṇādikaṃ cāsya vyāpāraḥ saṃbhavatītyato nākārakatvaṃ vācyam
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī saptamī ca yam
pravālaśobhā iva pādapānāṃ śṛṅgāraceṣṭā vividhā babhūvuḥ || 25
atra kriyānāviṣṭatayaivendumatyāṃ mahīpatīnāṃ śṛṅgāraceṣṭā bhavantyo lakṣyante
38’ iti sūtre cakārasya samucceyatayā na pradhānā seti nātra tulyakakṣatayā gaṇitā
kriyānāviṣṭaṃ svavyāpāraśūnyaṃ taṭasthameva yavdyāpriyate, tena kārakādbhedaḥ
atra hi kriyānāviṣṭasyaiva indumatyāmitīndumatīmālambanavibhāvīkṛtya (vidhīya)mānāḥ śṛṅgāraceṣṭāstayaivāvacchidyante, tadavasthā eva ca lakṣyante, tato bhavati hetutvaṃ lakṣaṇatvamavadhitvaṃ ceti
nanu kathamatra dvitīyā, yāvatā hetutvāttṛtīyayā bhavitavyamityata āha—dvitīyāmiti
nāprāptāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmiyaṃ vidhīyamānā balavatī tāṃ bādhata ityarthaḥ
atra kaṇṭhekāla ityādīni kriyāyāmaniviśamānānyeva vṛṣadhvajaṃ jñāpayanti yathā jaṭābhistāpasa iti
yadyapi kapālena jaṭābhirityevodāharaṇaṃ tathāpi prasaṅgāditaravdyākhyānaṃ jñāpakatvam
tenānyo'pyevaṃjātīyo lakṣaṇaprakāraḥ svayamūhanīya ityuktaṃ bhavati, yadvakṣyati ‘upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat’ ityādinā
yathāhītthaṃbhūtasya tenaiva prakāreṇa prakāravato lakṣaṇaṃ jaṭā bhavanti tathehāpi kapālādikamiti bhāvaḥ
atra vapuṣā caturbhujo mukhena trilocanastejasā ravirityaṅgavikārairaṅgino vikṛtirlakṣyate yathākṣṇā kāṇa iti
aṅgaṃ ca dvividhamājānikamaupacārikaṃ ca dvayamapīha vivakṣitaṃ vikārādikaṃ cetthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇamevedam
ata eva sūtrakramo nāddata ityāśayavānvyācaṣṭe—atra vapuṣeti
‘gonāsāya niyojitāgadarajāḥ sarpāya baddhauṣadhiḥ kaṇṭhasthāya viṣāya vīryamahite pāṇau maṇīnbibhratī
bharturbhūtagaṇāya gotrajaratīnirdiṣṭamantrākṣarā rakṣatvadrisutā vivāhasamaye prītā ca bhītā ca vaḥ || 28 ||’
atra gauryā vivāhamaṅgalānaucityenotpātarūpairagadarajoniyogādibhirbhagavadgatā gonāsādayo jñāpyante, yathā vātāya kapilā vidyuditi
tataścotpātena jñāpiteceti saṃbandhasyobhayaniṣṭhatvāttādarthya iva lakṣyavācinaścaturthī na lakṣaṇavācinaḥ
tṛtīyāviṣayāpahārādekayaiva ca vibhaktyobhayagatasyāpi saṃbandhasya rājñaḥ puruṣa itivaduktatvāttṛtīyāpi na bhavati
