nanūtpātenāviṣṭena yajjñāpyate tatra caturthīti lakṣaṇamevāsyā vācyaṃ pratibhāti, naitat
tataśca yato vidhīyate tasya lakṣaṇīyatāmarthāditarasya lakṣaṇatāṃ bodhayatīti
nanu tathāpi lakṣaṇavācina eva caturthīti kathamavasitabhityata āha—tataśceti

yathā tādarthyasyobhayaniṣṭhatve'pi kaṅkaṇāya kanakamityatra kāryavācina eva caturthī na tu kāraṇavācinaḥ, tathehāpi saṃbandhasyobhayāśrayatve'pi lakṣyavācina eva caturthī natu lakṣaṇavācina ityarthaḥ
tarhi tṛtīyā kathaṃ na bhavatītyata āha—ekayaiva ceti
saṃbandhasya saṃbandhināveva viśeṣastena lakṣaṇamapi caturthyeva pratipādayatyata āha—uktārthatvātkathaṃ tṛtīyā na bhavatīti śuddhaprātipadikārthābhidhāne prathameti bhāvaḥ
atra senānyaḥ palāyamānagaṇānuśāsanakriyayāndhakāreḥ svaprakāśanakriyā lakṣyate yathā—‘goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ’ iti
tenānyadapi bhāvalakṣaṇaṃ śatrādyabhidheyamupalakṣyate, yathātraiva hasatā tasthe iti
37’ ityasya sūtrasyārthastu yasya vastuno bhāvena kriyayā vastvantarasya bhāvaḥ kriyā lakṣyate tadvacanātsaptamītyata āha—atra senānya iti
hasatā tastha iti lakṣaṇe śatṛvidhiḥ ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ 3
nanu na prāgabhāvādireko'sti pratiyogibhedena bhedādityata āha—ghaṭābhāvādīti
sāmānyaṃ tu prāgabhāvatvādikamāśritya cāturvidhyam, so'yaṃ tuśabdasyārthaḥ
gato mohaścyutā tṛṣṇā kṛtaṃ puṇyāśrame manaḥ || 32 ||’
yāvadvidyāṃ nābhyasyanti tāvanna dhīmadbhiḥ saṃsṛjyante, yāvaccākṣāṇi na nigṛhṇanti tāvavdyasanamiti vivakṣitam
mṛgā ime na dāyādāstanme nandati mānasam || 33 ||’
atra vanāni amūni na gṛhāṇītyāderitaretarābhāvasya manaḥpramodakāraṇatvam
vaidharmyaṃ tu bhedākhyamalaṃkārāntaraṃ kiṃciddharmamantarbhāvyaiva svarūpasyāpi bhedavyavahārapātratā
bhūtabhavyasamuccāraṇe bhūtaṃ bhavyāyeti nyāyānmañjarīṇāmudbhedasya kārakatālābho'nyathā vākyabhede na kiṃcitsyāt
‘pīnaśroṇi gabhīranābhi nibhṛtaṃ madhye bhṛśoccastanaṃ pāyādvaḥ parirabdhamabdhiduhituḥ kāntena kāntaṃ vapuḥ
atra yathoktena vapuṣā yo'yamāliṅgane'pi vidhinivāsanābhipaṅkajānupaghātaḥ, sa iha vastuno'vasthānameva pradhvaṃsābhāvābhāva ucyate
yathā—‘avanirudakaṃ tejo vāyurnabhaḥ śaśibhāskarau puruṣa iti yatkecidbhinnā vadanti tanūstava
tadanagha vacovaicitrībhirnirāvaraṇasya te vidadhati payaḥpūronmīlanmṛṣā mihiropamām
’ atra bhinna ityanyonyābhāvamupanyasya nirāvaraṇasya mṛṣetyetābhyāṃ niṣedhaḥ
yathā ca—‘na vidyate yadyapi sarvavāsanāguṇānubandhi pratibhānamadbhutam
śrutena yatnena ca vāgu-pāsitā dhruvaṃ karotyeva kamapyanugraham
' atra na vidyata ityatyantābhāvamupanyasya kamapīti pratibhāsattābhidhānena pratiṣedhaḥ
kāryāḥ kāvyeṣu vaicitryaṃ tathā te kartumīśate || 17
so'yaṃ bālya eva navayauvanakāryakaraṇādvidūrakāryo nāma citrahetuḥ

kālāntarabhāvyavasthāsaṃpādyaṃ prāgavasthāvata eva kāryamupajāyamānaṃ yatrocyate sa vidūrakāryastacca kāryaṃ śaktiviśeṣādhīnamiti bālye'pi prabhāvātiśayadarśanādbhujenaiva rakṣā kṛteti gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayatā
atra rājyābhiṣekaripumaṇḍalākramaṇayorhetuhetumadbhāvena satyapi paurvāparye kṣiprakāritvāttulyameva kāryakāraṇabhāvo vivakṣitastena sahajo nāmāyaṃ citrahetuḥ
kāraṇaśaktiprakarṣātsamakālamiva kāryaṃ pratibhāsate, tena hetuśaktiprakarṣābhivyaktiratra mūlam
evamanantaraje'pi kiṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvamuta kāryamasti sa eva vyaṅgyaḥ
yukte'pi kāraṇaguṇānuvidhāyi kāryamasadevāropyate na pramukteti tadeva viparītamiti gauṇavṛttyāśrayatā
atra candrodayalakṣaṇāddhetoḥ pūrvakālameva rāgasāgara udīrṇa iti kāryasyodayalābhaḥ
sa iha guṇavṛttyāśrayaṇe hetāvatiśayaṃ puṣyatītyayaṃ kāryānantarajo nāma citrahetuḥ
atra digvadhūmukheṣu te guṇānurāgaḥ kuṅkumaṃ, yaśastu candanamityayaṃ yukto nāma gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayaścitrahetuḥ
atra mukhendoḥ padmanimīlanādi na yujyata iti nayukto nāma citrabhedaḥ
nanu vyaktibhede'pi hetorasaṃkhyatā cedbivakṣitā kimevaṃ śabdenādhikenetyata āha—
‘sā bālā vayamapragalbhavayasaḥ sā strī vayaṃ kātarāḥ sā pīnonnatimatpayodharayugaṃ dhatte sakhedā vayam
sākrāntā jaghanasthalena guruṇā gantuṃ na śaktā vayaṃ doṣairanyajanāśrayairapaṭavo jātāḥ sma ityadbhutam || 42 ||’
atrābhivyaktameva vyadhikaraṇatvaṃ kāryakaraṇayoḥ pratīyata ityayaṃ vyadhikaraṇo nāma citrahetuḥ
prakārasyopādhereva bhedo vivakṣito na tu vyaktimātrasyeti bhāvaḥ
bālyādīnāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇya eva prāgalbhyādikaṃ prati hetubhāvaḥ pratītaḥ sa iha gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayatayonibadhyamānaḥ kāntimāvahati
anyatprāgalbhyaṃ bālāyāḥ saralālokitavāṅmiśraṇādyasāmarthyalakṣaṇam, anyacca nāyakaprakāṇḍe kathameṣāṃ niyantraṇā syādityanadhyavasāyalakṣaṇam
ādigrahaṇena svahetukatayā kāryahetukatayā copanibadhyamānaḥ saṃkalito bhavati
tatra dvayaṃ nibandhanaṃ yadgataṃ kāryamupajanayitavyaṃ tasya vastunaḥ svabhāvo hetutvābhimatasya śaktihānirvā

tatra vastusvabhāvena śakteratyantāsattvena ca dvirūpasvarūpāvyabhicārīkṛtātmīkārya ityanenoktam, vastusvabhāvena śaktipratibandhena ca dviprakāro'pi ca vyāpārāvyabhicārī vyāhataḥ, ityanena yadyapi śaktiratyantāsattve hetubhāva eva na bhavati, tathāpi guṇavṛttyā hetubhāvādhyāso boddhavyaḥ
nanu cātra ceṣṭāyā hetutvaṃ tṛtīyayā pratīyata iti sā hetutvena vaktumucitetyata āha—
‘na viracitā lalāṭataṭalāsyakarī bhrukuṭi- rna paruṣahuṃkṛtena madhurasmitamantaritam
na tava niśumbhasaṃbhramavaśādapi dāruṇayā bhagavati ceṣṭayā kaluṣitaṃ vadanāmburuham || 43 ||’

atra niśumbhasaṃbhramasya hetoranutpāditabhrukuṭyādidāruṇaceṣṭādvāreṇa bhagavatīmukhāmbukāluṣyasya karaṇe yadasāmarthyaṃ tatra tanmukhākhyasya vastunaḥ svabhāvo nimittamiti svabhāvādanutpāditakāryo'yamahetuḥ
anyathā niśumbhasaṃbhramavaśāditi pañcamī asaṃgatā syāditi bhāvaḥ
atrānurāgavattvatatpuraḥ saratvayoḥ samāgamahetvoḥ sāmarthyavighāte daivagatiḥ kāraṇamiti śakterhānihetunāyamakṛtasvakāryo nāmā'hetuḥ
arcistuṅgānabhimukhagatānprāpya ratnapradīpā- nhrīmūḍhānāṃ bhavati viphalaḥ preraṇācūrṇamuṣṭiḥ || 45 ||’
atra ratnapradīpanirvāpaṇe cūrṇamuṣṭerapatyaktasvarūpasyāpi vighāte ratnapradīpākhyavastusvabhāvaḥ kāraṇamityayaṃ vastusvabhāvena vyāhato nāmā'hetubhūtaḥ
tatkālapraṇate muradviṣi nave dṛṣṭvā vilāsaṃ śriyaḥ kurvatkopakaṣāyitena manasā mithyotplutīḥ pātu vaḥ || 46 ||’
atra kopakaṣāyitena manasastasyotplutikaraṇasamarthasyāpīśvarakaragrahaṇānmithyāpadābhidhīyamānaḥ pratīto vyāghātastato'yaṃ śakterhānihetunā vyāhato nāmā hetubhedaḥ
iha kaiścitkāraṇamālā pṛthagalaṃkāra ityuktam, pūrvasyottarottaraṃ prati hetubhāvoktistallakṣaṇam
yadyapi prathamasya prathamaṃ hetubhāvo nivṛtta eva tathāpyuttarasya prathamamukhanirīkṣaṇapravṛttasyottaraṃ prati hetubhāvo'bhidhīyate
na hi svatantrasyaiva hetubhāve kāraṇamālā bhāsate

atra jitendriyatvādīnāmuttarottaraṃ prati hetubhūtānāmapi saṃpadutpattau pūrvapūrvasavyapekṣāyāṃ samuditānāmeva kāraṇatvaṃ sādhanādipadairabhidhīyata iti so'yamabhidhīyamānahetutvakāraṇamāletyahetubhedaḥ
riṭṭhassa visamavaliaṃ kaṃṭhaṃ dukkheṇa jīviaṃ volīṇam || 48 ||’
atra jīvitaduḥkhātikramaṇe kaṇṭhasya valanaṃ, valanasya niṣṭhuragrahaṇaṃ, niṣṭhuragrahaṇasyāpi pīnatvena durgrāhyatvaṃ heturiti pratīyamānakāraṇatvaṃ kāraṇamāletyahetubhedaḥ
yadyatra hetumālā na syāttadā parasparānapekṣāyāmupanyāse vākyārthapoṣo('pi) na syāditi
atra svayaṃvaramilitānāṃ rājñāṃ rājaputrīṃ prati prāptilakṣaṇasya manorathasyābhidhīyamānasya śṛṅgāraceṣṭātmakeneṅgitena vyaṅgyatvādayamiṅgitalakṣyo'bhidhīyamānaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ
sūkṣmārthadarśanaṃ sūkṣmamityarthaguṇeṣūktaṃ tena paunaruktyamāśaṅkyāha—sūkṣmaguṇāttu sa iti
yathāhi kaveḥ pratibhā sūkṣmaviśeṣollekhinī tathā tanmūlakaḥ śabdo'pīti sphuṭābhatayā pratyakṣa- prameyajñānamutpadyate
sūkṣmālaṃkāre tu kavipratibhāyā liṅgaviṣayatvācchabdo'pi tadviṣaya eva
liṅgācca pratītirutpadyamānā sāmānyapuraskāreṇa pravṛttā na pratyakṣavattadviśeṣollekhakṣameti sūkṣmaguṇavaidharmyam
atra kaiścitpratīyamānasya sūkṣmasya bhāva iti saṃjñāṃ vidhāyālaṃkārāntaramuktaṃ tadasat, sūkṣmasāmānyalakṣaṇena kroḍīkaraṇādityāha—iṅgitākāralakṣyatvamiti
na ca śṛṅgāraceṣṭāpratyarpitasya manorathaśabdenābhidhīyamānamarthaṃ punaruktamiti vācyam
nahi yathānurāgānubhāvena cittavṛttayaḥ sphuṭā upasthāpyante tathā svaśabdeneti vistareṇa saprapañcameva vakṣyāmaḥ

svayaṃvarasamājapraveśādinā yeṣāṃ sāmānyata utkaṇṭhā pratītipathamavatīrṇāsītteṣāmindumatīsaṃnidhau tadanubhāvabalenāsaṃkhyasūkṣmaviśeṣavatī saivābhivyakteti dṛḍhānubandhalakṣaṇasya premṇaḥ prakarṣakāṣṭhāṃ puṣṇāti
‘sā yūni tasminnabhilāṣabandhaṃ śaśāka śālīnatayā na vaktum
atrābhilāṣabandho romāñcalakṣyeṇa gātrayaṣṭiṃ bhittvā nirākrāmadityanenābhidhīyamāna ākāralakṣyaḥ sūkṣmabhedo'bhihitaḥ
atra tvadarpitadṛśa iti iṅgitacchāyā kāpi mukhāmbuja ityākārastābhyāmuddāmarāgapiśunetyanenābhidhīyamānasyānanarāgasya sūkṣmarūpatayā lakṣyamāṇatvādayamabhidhīyamānobhayalakṣyaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ

atra prativacanādānaṃ parijanaprakopābhyāṃ pradīpyamāne nadīkacche iti hetunā pratyāyyamānaḥ saṃketakuḍyāṅgadāvodbhavavadhūmanastāpo vākyārthatvena lakṣita ityayamiṅgitalakṣyaḥ pratīyamānaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ

nahi prativacanapradānābhāvamātramatra camatkārakāri, tasmādanyathāpi saṃbhavāt, ataḥ prativacanapradānābhiprāyā viparītacittavṛttiviśeṣonnāyikā samīpadeśāpasaraṇādilakṣaṇā kriyā kācitprativacanāpradānapadenābhimatā
atrārdhākṣipralonamukhaśyāmatābhyāmākārabhyāṃ jambūdalakalpitāvataṃsa ityanena pratyāyyamānaḥ saṃketagamanabhraṃśasaṃbhavaḥ śyāmāyā matastāpo lakṣyata ityayamākāralakṣyaḥ pratīyamānaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ
na kiṃcidūce caraṇena kevalaṃ lilekha bāṣpākulalocanā muvam || 53 ||’
atra caraṇena bhūmilekhanamiṅgitaṃ dṛśorbāṣpākulatvamākhārastābhyāṃ gotraskhalanodbhavo māninyā manastāpaḥ pratīyamāna itīṅgitākāralakṣyaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ
atra dānasatyakīrtyādīnāṃ vittādivastudharmāṇāṃ sārabhūtānāmuddhārādayaṃ dharmarūpaḥ sāraḥ
atra madhuprabhṛtīnāṃ vibhūtibhyaḥ sārabhūtānāmuddharaṇādayaṃ dharmirūpaḥ sāraḥ
vibhūtayaḥ prathamānirdiṣṭāstena pūrvavannāmūṣāṃ dharmibhāvena pratītibhāso'stīti viśiṣṭamadhvādirūpaṃ vastunāṅgabhāvena gamyata iti
jajjaṃ asikkhiaṃ ṇavavahūṇaṃ taṃtaṃ raiṃ dei || 56 ||’

atra prauḍhānāṃ suśikṣitaṃ suratakarma, aprauḍhastrīṇāṃ punaraśikṣitaṃ sukhayatīti karmāntaralakṣaṇebhyo dharmebhyaḥ suśikṣitāśikṣitaratakarmalakṣaṇā dharmāḥ strīdharmāvyatirekeṇa pratipādyanta iti dharmavyatirekarūpo'yaṃ sāraḥ
rata ityanena sāmānyata upādānāt prauḍhastrīsaṃbandhino lalitasya suśikṣitatvaṃ viśeṣamupādāya mugdhastrīsaṃbandhino'śikṣitattvaṃ vyatirekī viśeṣa upāttaḥ
‘rājye sāraṃ vasudhā vasudhāyāṃ pattanaṃ pure saudham
atra vasudhādayo dharmiṇa uttarottarakrameṇa pūrvataḥ pūrvato vyatiricyanta ityayaṃ dharmavyatirekaḥ sāraḥ
atra gītādīnāṃ jagataḥ sārabhūtānāmaviśeṣeṇaiva sarveṣāmupādānāddhetutṛtīyāntatayā ca saṃsārasāravattve'ṅgabhāvādayaṃ sāmānyato dharmadharmirūpaḥ sāraḥ
ata evādiśabdo'pi sajīvastathāpi dadhyādīnāmaṅgabhāvaḥ pratīyata ityata āha—tṛtīyāntatayā ceti
tṛtīyayā hiṃ kārakatvamuktam, kārakatvaṃ ca kriyopasarjanarūpamityarthaḥ
atra gaṅgāprapātasaptarṣipādodakayorviśeṣeṇa sārabhūtayorupādānāddhimavataḥ pūtatve cāṅgabhūtatvādayaṃ viśeṣato dharmadharmirūpaḥ sāraḥ
yathā ‘digvāsā yadī’tyādau virodhasyāropamātreṇa sarūpatayā pratipattimātraṃ vā
pratīyamānastu tadvinākṛto yathā bhaṭṭabāṇasya ‘yatra mātaṅgagāminyaḥ śīlavatyaśca gauryo vibhavaratāśca śyāmāḥ padmarāgiṇyaśca dhavaladvijaśucivadanā madirāmodiśvasanāḥ pramadāḥ’ iti
tadeteṣāṃ lakṣaṇābhedādvirodha evāntarbhāvo na hyavāntarabhaṅgibhedamātreṇa sāmānyāntarbhāvo na bhavatītyāśayavānāha—asaṅgatiḥ pratyanīkamiti
‘kva yuvatimārdavaṃ kva ca mahāhavadāruṇatā kva ca valayī karaḥ kva karidantajamuṣṭirasiḥ
kva ca navayauvanaṃ kva kusumāyudhaniḥspṛhatā tava lalanāviceṣṭita/?/ lalitam || 60 ||’
atra yuvatimārdavādīnāṃ mahāhavadāruṇatādīnāṃ ca śuddhānāmeva parasparamasaṃgatatvādayaṃ śuddhavirodhaḥ
‘digvāsā yadi tatkimasya dhanuṣā śastrasya kiṃ bhasmanā bhasmāthāsya kimaṅganā yadi ca sā kāmaṃ paridveṣṭi kim
yadyapyekena virodhinā sahoktau virodhyantareṇāpi tathā bhāvamāsādayanneva grathitastathāpyuttaragrathanayā śobhāviśeṣārpako bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ
bhiḍiya pacelliu so marai jjassa ṇa laggai kaṇṭhi || 62 ||’
bhidyate pratyuta sa mriyate yasya na lagati kaṇṭhe ||]
atrāyaṃ viṣagranthiryasya kaṇṭhe na lagati sa mriyata ityetayoḥ parasparamasaṅgaterayamasaṅgatirnāma virodhaḥ
mayā tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvāntastāpādikaṃ mayāptamiti pratyanīkaphalatvādayaṃ pratyanīkākhyo virodhaḥ
yadyapyekasya viruddhaṃ kāryakāritvaṃ na viruddhaṃ, tathāpi yayaiva pravṛttyā kiṃcitkāryaṃ kartumudyato na tayaiva tadviruddhaṃ karoti tadetatsukhāyeti caturthyā dyotyate
te tu yāvanta evājau tāvadvā dadṛśe sa taiḥ || 64 ||’
atraikasya dāśaratheranekasaṃkhyairyātudhānairyatsamarakarma tatra tairasya tāvadvā dṛśyamānatvenaikasaṃkhyāviruddhamādhikyaṃ gamyata ityayamadhikākhyo virodhaḥ
atra malīmasādhvaradhūmasaṃcayena yadyaśasaḥ śuklīkaraṇaṃ tadyadyādṛśādeva jāyate tattādṛgeva bhavatīti prasiddhervaiṣamyātparasparamasaṅgaterayaṃ viṣamākhyo virodhaḥ
sāmagryekadeśasadbhāvamātreṇa kāryasadbhāve sthite virodhacchāyāmūlatvamiti tada- nantaraṃ saṃbhavaḥ prāptāvasara ityāha—
sa vidhau vā niṣedhe vā dvaye vā na dvaye'pi vā || 25
bhūyāṃsi kāraṇāni dṛṣṭvā kāryamutpatsyate nāpi daivātkadācinna syāditi jñānasaṃbhavaḥ
na cāyaṃ saṃśaya eva nahi syādvā naveti dolāyate
kva tarhyayamantarbhavati na kvacit, jñānāntarasyevocyamānatvāt, aniścayarūpatāmātreṇa tatrāntarbhāve'tiprasaṅgāt, nāpi bhrāntirnyagbhūtabādhapuraḥ saratvāt
bhrāntau tu siddhāyāṃ bādhotpattiriti vakṣyate 'sa vidhau vā niṣedhe vā' iti
ādyaṃ pratyuktyākhye śabdālaṃkāre vidhidvāreṇetyanenoktam, dvitīyaṃ tu bhūtabhavanalakṣaṇamihocyate
‘tvayyādātuṃ jalamavanate śārṅgiṇo varṇacaure tasyāḥ sindhoḥ pṛthumapi tanuṃ dūrabhāvātpravāham
prekṣiṣyante gaganagatayo nūnamāvarjya dṛṣṭī- rekaṃ muktāguṇamiva bhuvaḥ sthūlamadhyendranīlam || 66 ||’
atra tvayi jalamādātumavanate sati tasyāḥ saritaḥ pravāho madhyaniviṣṭendranīlamaṇirmuktāguṇa iva gaganagatiprekṣaṇīyo bhaviṣyatīti vidheḥ saṃbhāvyamānatvādayaṃ vidhiviṣayaḥ saṃbhavaḥ
bhīṣme'pyasaṃbhāvyamidaṃ gurau vā na saṃbhavatyeva vanecareṣu || 67 ||’
atredaṃ bhīṣmadroṇayorasaṃbhāvyamānaṃ dhanurvedakauśalamasminvanecare na saṃbhavatīti niṣedhaviṣayaḥ saṃbhavaḥ
paravivarābhiyoge svavivararakṣārūpabahutarakāraṇālokānnāyaṃ vanecara iti niṣedha eva saṃbhāvyate
‘utpaśyāmi drutamapi sakhe matpriyārthaṃ yiyāsoḥ kālakṣepaṃ kakubhasurabhau parvate parvate te
muktāpāṅgaiḥ sajalanayanaiḥ svāgatīkṛtya kekāḥ pratyudyātaḥ kathamapi bhavāngantumāśu vyavasyet || 68
atra drutamapi yiyāsoḥ kālakṣepaṃ tavotpaśyāmīti vidhirūpaḥ kathamapi na bhavān gantumāśu vyavasyediti niṣedharūpastadevaṃ vidhiniṣedhayorasaṃbhāvyamānatvādayamubhayaviṣayaḥ saṃbhavaḥ
yato yaiva kālakṣepasāmagrī saiva śuklāpāṅgairityādi kāraṇasahakṛtā niṣedhamapi viṣayīkaroti
‘tasyāḥ pātuṃ suragaja iva vyomni pūrvārdhalambī tvaṃ cedacchasphaṭikaviśadaṃ tarkayestiryagambhaḥ
saṃsarpantyāḥ sadasi bhavataḥ srotasi cchāyayā sā syādasthānopagatayamunā saṃgamenābhirāmā || 69 ||’
atra yadi tvamevaṃ kuryāstadaivaṃ syāditi vidhiniṣedhayoranavagaterayamanubhayaviṣayaḥ saṃbhavaḥ
na tāvadatrābhāvaḥ pratīyata iti na niṣedhasaṃbhavaḥ
yo hi vyavasthitakāraṇadarśanena vyavasthitasyaiva bhavanasya saṃbhavaḥ sa vidhisaṃbhavaśabdenābhidhīyate, naceha tathā
‘yadi bhavati mukhānāṃ vākpaṭūnāṃ sahasraṃ nirupamamavadhānaṃ jīvitaṃ cātidīrgham
kamalamukhi tathāpi kṣmāpatestasya kartuṃ sakalaguṇavicāraḥ śakyate vā naveti || 70 ||’
droṇasya saṃbhavaḥ khāryāṃ śate pañcāśato yathā
tathā ca samudāyasya samudāyivyāptatvādiyaṃ khārī droṇavatī khārītvāditi sulabham
kathaṃ tarhi tavāpi saṃbhavo bhidyate sāmagrī kāryavyāpteti tatrāpyanumānameva bhaviṣyatītyata āha—bhidyata iti
nahi sāmagrī dṛṣṭā yataḥ kāryamanumīyate, kiṃtu prabhūtakāraṇadarśanena kāryasya jñānamanyadevotpadyata iti vaktavyam

atra yathā khāryāṃ droṇaḥ śate pañcāśaditi niyamo naivaṃ vipralambhe'lakānāmakalpanamanañjanamakṣṇormadhuno vā pratyādeśaḥ, suhṛdudantalābhārambhe vā nayanaspandanāni, saṃbhāvyante ca prabhūtakāraṇalokādityeṣo'pi vidhirūpa eva saṃbhava iti
evaṃ viśleṣaduḥkhena karśitā yathā'cetanāmapyalakānāṃ karuṇotpannaiva lakṣyate
tasmādiyaṃ mā jaladharaṃ drākṣīditi nisargacapalasyāpāṅgasya prasaramavarundhanti
tena tannayanādanyatra nāñjanaṃ kāntimāpnotīti ko'pi lāvaṇyaprakarṣastathābhūtasyāpyañjanasya tyāge yadekatānatayā nātmānamapi pratisaṃdhātuṃ samartheti vyanakti
vipralambharūpakāraṇālokāccopari-nayanaspandanaṃ saṃbhāvyata iti saṃbhavadvayamatreti vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atra yathā khāryāmiti
parasparopakārakayorekasya viśeṣaṃ dṛṣṭvāparasya viśeṣo jñāyata iti saṃbhavasāmyātta- danantaramanyonyalakṣaṇamāha—
viśeṣārpaṇamupakāro na ceyaṃ parivṛttiḥ sthitasyānapanayanāt dānapratidānābhāvācca
abhidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣataḥ śabdenopāttaṃ sāmānyataḥ śabdena viṣayīkṛtaṃ viśeṣatastu pratīyamānamevetyubhayātmakam
‘uddhaccho piai jalaṃ jaha jaha viralaṅgulī ciraṃ pahio
pāāvaliā vi taha taha dhāraṃ taṇuampi taṇueī || 73 ||’
[uddharṣaḥ pibati jalaṃ yathā yathā viralāṅguliściraṃ pathikaḥ
prapāpālikāpi tathā tathā dhārāṃ tanumapi tanūkaroti ||]
atra pathikaprapāpālikayormitho'nurāge yadekasya viralāṅgulinā kareṇa pānīyapānamanyasyāḥ sutarāṃ vāridhārātanūkaraṇaṃ tena parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāvātpratīyamānamidamanyonyam
tathā hi karasya viralāṅgulikaraṇe kathamahametāṃ cirāya paśyāmīti prapāpālikābhiprāya eva vardhito bhavati
na cāyamevaṃvidho'rthaḥ kenāpi śabdenābhihita iti bhavati pratīyamānatā vaktṛpratipādyādiviśeṣaparyālocanenaiva dhvananamunmiṣati
atra godāvarīviṣamāvatāravyājena tayā tasyorasi ātmā kṣiptastenāpyanukampā nirdoṣā sā gāḍhamupagūḍhetyabhidhīyamānaḥ parasparamanurāgādupakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ pratīyata ityubhayātmakamidamanyonyam
na ca śabdopātte kiṃ dhvananeneti vācyam
‘śaśinā ca niśā niśayā ca śaśī śaśinā niśayā ca yathā gaganam
bhavatā ca sabhā sabhayā ca bhavān sabhayā bhavatā ca tathā bhuvanam || 75 ||’
atra niśāśaśinoḥ sabhābhavatośca parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāve vartamānayoryadidaṃ gaganaṃ jagatī ca prasiddhayorupakārakatvacūḍikevoparyupari labhyate seyamanyonyacūḍikā
sā yathā śarīratadavayavebhyo bhinnaivopalakṣyate tathātrāpi niśāśaśinoḥ sabhābhavatoḥ parasparamupakārakatvamabhisaṃdhāya dvayordvayorgaganajagatī pratyupakārakatvamanyadevābhidhīyate
na caitāvataiva viśeṣeṇa pṛthagbhāvo'nyonyālaṃkārakavalīkṛtasyaiva tasya saṃbhavāt
‘jambūnāṃ kusumotkare navamadhunyārabdhapānotsavāḥ kīrāḥ pakvaphalāśayā madhukarīścumbanti muñcanti ca
‘eteṣāmapi nīlakiṃśukadalairebhiḥ samānatviṣāṃ puṣpabhrāntibhirāpatanti sahasā cañcūṣu bhṛṅgāṅganāḥ || 76 ||’
atra jambūkusumakuñjasthitamadhukarīṣu śukaśakuntānāṃ yā pakvajambūphalabhrāntiryā ca madhukarīṇāṃ śukacañcuṣu kiṃśukakusumabhrāntiḥ seyamanyonyabhrāntiranyonyasmādapṛthageva
tathā ca camatkārivastvantaropamāparyavasāyitvamiti bhrāntisaṃsarga eva viśeṣārpaṇa upakāraḥ
anyonyavacanena parasparagāmitā tasya tenaiva darśitetyanyonyalakṣaṇāśleṣātkathaṃ pṛthagbhavatīti
vyatyayo vastuno yastu yo vā vinimayo mithaḥ
sā tridhā-ekasthānasthitasya vastunaḥ sthānāntaraprāptivacanena, dānapratidānavacanena, ubhayavacanena vā
sarvatra mukhyavṛttyā gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇa vā tathābhāvoktiriti ṣaṭprakāratvaṃ darśayati—
udayamahimaraśmiryāti śītāṃśurastaṃ hatavidhilasitānāṃ hī vicitro vipākaḥ || 78 ||’
atra yatkumudavanādīnāmapaśrīkatvādikaṃ yaccāmbhojakhaṇḍādīnāṃ śrīmattvādikaṃ mukhyameva prātarupalabhyate, seyaṃ vyatyayavatī mukhyā nāma parivṛttiḥ
sa eva dṛśyate prātaḥ sapatnīnayaneṣu saṃkrāntaḥ ||]
tāmbūlādihetuko'nya evādhararāgo'nyaśca matsarahetukaḥ kaṣāyatālakṣaṇo nayanagāmīti tayorabhedādhyavasāyo yattatpadābhyāṃ pratīta iti gauṇī vṛttiḥ
atra karikapolamadāmodasyāmbhojarajaḥ parimalasya ca saritsaliladvipakapolapālyormukhyatvenaiva parasparopakaraṇādiyaṃ vinimayavatī mukhyā nāma parivṛttiḥ
gajendrāṇāṃ madayāsamacandrakayoḥ(?) svāśritayornadīṣu saṃkrāmaṇaṃ nadīsthitayośca kiñjalkāmbhojaparimalayorgrahaṇaṃ tena dānapratidānavattayā vinimayo bhavati
‘tasya ca pravayaso jaṭāyuṣaḥ svargiṇaḥ kimiha śocyate'dhunā
atra jarjarakalevaraṃ datvā śaśikiraṇaśubhraṃ yaśaḥ krītamityamukhyayaiva vṛttyā vinimayokteramukhyeyaṃ vinimayavatī parivṛttiḥ
mūlyārpaṇakrayaṇayoratra bādhāvdyakta evopacāraḥ, śabdavṛttistu pūrvavadeva kuṇṭhaiveti bhavati vinimayaḥ
vāruṇī paraguṇātmaguṇānāṃ vyatyayaṃ vinimayaṃ ca vitene || 82 ||’
atra vāruṇyā yadadharādrāgo'pahṛtya cakṣuṣornikṣiptasteneyaṃ vyatyayavatī, yacca mukhāmodavāsitayā svāmodena mukhāmodo viśeṣitastena vinimayavatī
locanādharayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ kṛta āhṛto rāgo yayā tena locane kṛto'dharādapanīta iti vyatyayaḥ
vāsite ānane viśeṣito gandho yasyāḥ sā tathā
tena tayā mukhaṃ vāsitaṃ mukhena ca seti bhavati vinimayaḥ
paraguṇānāmiti paraguṇānāṃ vyatyayaḥ, ātmaguṇānāṃ vinimaya iti saṃbandhaḥ
devo'pi dāpitaḥ kiṃ tairna punaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ karam || 83 ||’

atra bhūbhṛtāmakaradānāṃ yatkarapradānaṃ jigīṣośca yatpṛṣṭhe hastanikṣepaḥ sa eva dravyaguṇādīnāṃ sthānādiparivṛttau vyatyayo, yacca devena bhūbhṛtaḥ karadīkṛtāḥ devo'pi taiḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ karaṃ dāpita iti so'yaṃ dānapratipādanalakṣaṇo'pi vinimaya ityetadubhayamapīha śliṣṭapadābhidheyatvādamukhyavṛttyaivocyamānamupalabhyata ityubhayavatīyamamukhyā parivṛttiḥ
ekatra pratītasyānyatra pratyayaḥ parivṛttau; tathā nidarśane'pīti tadanantaraṃ nida- rśanaṃ lakṣayati—
nanvanumānāṅgamapi dṛṣṭāntābhidhānaṃ pṛthagalaṃkāraḥ syādityata āha—siddhe'rtha iti
siddha evārthe kaṃcidviśeṣamāvedayituṃ dṛṣṭāntoktirnidarśanam, sādhye tvarthe'numānamiti vibhāgaḥ
yatra śabdata eva tulyetivṛttatā dṛṣṭāntadarṣṭāntikayoranugamyate tadṛju nidarśanam
atra ṛjūttkyaiva pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ paścāddārṣṭāntikaṃ pradarśitamitīdamṛ- jupūrvaṃ ca nidarśanaṃ sūryadṛṣṭāntena vibhūtīnāṃ suhṛdanugrahaḥ phalamiti jñāpayati
ṛddhibhiḥ suhṛdanugṛhyata iti siddho'rthaḥ, kiṃtu tadetadeva tāsāṃ phalamiti viśeṣamabhidhātuṃ sūryadṛṣṭāntopanyāsaḥ
atra samṛddhatāphalaṃ suhṛttvamanugrahatvaṃ ceti śabdata eva sūryādiṣu dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikābhimateṣu pratīyata iti ṛjutvamityarthaḥ

kiṃtu yathā pūrvatrodayamānaḥ savitā suhṛtpadmeṣu śriyamarpayatīti tulyetivṛttatā ṛjūktyā śabdenaivābhidhīyate, naivamatra kiṃ tarhi jvalanetivṛttena tulyaṃ tattu tatpuruṣāṇāmitivṛttamaśābdaṃ yukticāturyātpratīyate tadidaṃ pūrvaṃ ca vakraṃ nidarśanam
ca ca taddārṣṭā- ntike saṃbhavati śabdena vā pratyāyyate; kiṃtu bimbapratibimbanyāyenātra bhavati

tathā hi yathā pānakuṭyāṃ hutavahasya jvalanaṃ yajñavāṭe ca tathā'vyavasthitacittatayā grāmīṇāvidagdhayuvatiprasakto bhūtvānyatra nāgarikāsu vidagdhāsu rajyate so'pi na tyājya ityukticāturyāttulyetivṛttatā gamyate'to vakratvamityāha—kiṃtu yatheti
pahia ekkejje goraḍī ṇaṃ cauhaṭṭa uvaccha || 83 ||’
atra ṛjūttkyā śabda evābhidhīyamānasādharmyaṃ dārṣṭāntikamabhidhāyottarakālaṃ dṛṣṭānto'bhihitastadidamuttaramṛju nidarśanam
hṛdaye smaraṇārūḍhā satī lagnā ataeva tiracchīyai tiryakśalyāyamānā pathikasaṃmukhābhimukhasya tasya calitatvāt
paścācca gṛhītakaṭākṣā paścādbhūtena gṛhītaścamatkṛtaḥ kaṭākṣo yasyāḥ
ṇaṃ nanu catuṣyathe kaścitsaṃmukhatāṃ kaścittiraścīnatāṃ kaścitpaścādbhāvaṃ dhatte; gaurī tu pathikasyaikaiva tatheti

atrāpi dārṣṭāntikamabhidhāyottarakālameva dṛṣṭānto vihitastadidamuttaraṃ ṛju nidarśanam; kiṃtu yathā pūrvasmin hṛdaye tiryagityādibhiḥ śabda eva ṛjūktyā sādharmyābhidhānam, naivamatra tathā; api tu kimetadāpatitamityukticāturyeṇa viparyayeṇa ca liṅgasaṃkhyā yathāsaṃkhyānām
nanu ca uparītyanena vyavadhānamupāttaṃ dṛṣṭānte'pi śabda eva pratiphalati tatkathaṃ vakratvamityata āha—viparyayeṇeti
ghanapaṭalaṃ napuṃsakam, phaṇī pumān, dayitā caikavacanavatī, oṣadhayo bahuvacanāliṅigatāḥ
ghanapaṭalaṃ pūrvaṃ dārṣṭāntikamupakramya dṛṣṭāntoktau na pūrvaṃ phaṇī nirdiṣṭaḥ
tato liṅgasaṃkhyānāṃ viparyayo bhavati, tadayamarthena śabdata evopari paryavasthānaṃ dūratvaṃ ca dṛṣṭāntayoḥ pratīyate; śirasi himavatītyetābhyāmanyathākāraṃ bodhitatvāt
atra rājaviruddhānāmiti śliṣṭapadena darśayantīti vartamānakālalakṣaṇātsadya iti taddhitena ca samakālameva dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ śabdato ṛjūktyaivoktatvādidamṛju samaṃ ca nidarśanam
candrāṃśuparābhūtadhvāntarājīnṛpativiruddhadurantayorapi darśayantīti śatrā, sadya iti taddhitena ca samatvam
kiṃtu dhvāntarājī parabhavaṃ yātīti dṛṣṭāntoktau satyāṃ madhye rājaviruddhānāmiti darṣṭāntikamuktvā punarapi dṛṣṭāntaviśeṣaṇaṃ darśayantītyuktam

atra na kevalaṃ kodaṇḍadaṇḍake mānuṣe'pyevamevetītaretarayogavadvakratayā yugapadabhidhānaṃ guṇavarjitavaṃśotpanne'pi ṭaṅkāro na jāyata iti śliṣṭapadatve'pi vyatirekamukhena guṇavṛttyā cābhidhānāddhanuṣīva mānuṣe'pi guṇavatyeva mahāñśabdo bhavatīti vakroktyā sādharmyāvagatiḥ
tadidamaśabdatvādibhiḥ pūrvādbhidyamānaṃ samaṃ vakraṃ ca nidarśanam
guṇo dhairyādistantrī ca, vaṃśaḥ kulaṃ veṇuśca, ṭaṅkāro'vyaktānukaraṇaṃ khyātiśca
tathāhi—‘tvanmukhaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca phulle’ ityatra phullaṃ cetītaretarayogenaikaśeṣe ekayoktyā phulleti dvābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate
tathā vināpyekaśeṣaṃ guṇavajjieṇa vaṃsuppaṇṇe ṭaṅkāra iti yugapadanvīyante
nanu yathā rājaviruddhānāmityatra śeṣeṇa ṛjutvaṃ tathātrāpi bhaviṣyatītyata āha—śliṣṭapadatve'pīti
na ca vyatirekamukhenopanaye'yamarthaḥ śabdādavagamyate, pratīyate cārtha iti yuktaṃ vakratvam
nanu vyatirekeṇaiva kathaṃ na tulyavṛttitā saṃmatetyata āha—guṇavṛttyā ceti
evaṃ cet merusarṣapayorapitathābhidhānamalaṃkāraḥ syādata uktam—sādṛśye vastunoriti
aśabdopāttamapi dhvananānumānādibhiravagamyata iti na virodhastadidamuktam—pratīte veti
yena rūpeṇa vaiyatirekyamupādīyate tadrūpavantaṃ vyatirekaprati-yoginaṃ parikalpya tato vyatireko'pīti svajātivyatirekaḥ prathamaḥ prakāraḥ
etatprakāradvayaṃ yathāsaṃkhyamabhidhīyamānasādṛśyayoriti mūlabhedadvayaṃ tathaivāparamekānekalakṣaṇaṃ prakāradvayaṃ tatraivānyatsādṛśyavaisādṛśyarūpaṃ dvayamiti krameṇa ṣoḍhā bhedo vivakṣitaḥ
yathā ca svajātivyatireṃkayoḥ pratīyamānābhidhīyamānasādṛśyagāmitā na saṃbhavati tathāgre vakṣyate
atra yauvanaprabhavasya tamasastamojātyā saha dṛṣṭirodhakaramiti sādṛśyamuktvā, aratnālokasaṃhāryamavāryaṃ sūryaraśmibhiriti vyatireko vihitaḥ, so'yaṃ svajātivyatirekaḥ
anena tu prakāreṇa rasaḥ puṣyatītyalaṃkāramadhye gaṇanam
appaṇavi ṇa hu mahuvi aha appāṇeṇa samāṇu || 91 ||’
asyāpi na khalu mahānapi athātmanā samānaḥ ||]
yau tu kalpitabhedādhikaraṇatve- nopāttau virodhidharmavattayā śabdātpratīyeti tayorniryantraṇatvādikamiti bhavati sādṛśyaṃ pratīyamānam
‘preyāneva vṛṣastavāpi satataṃ bhūtistavāpi sthirā durgāyā bhavatāpi bhūgharabhuvaḥ samyaggṛhītaḥ karaḥ
nirvyājaṃ parameśvaratvamiyatā no yāsi vaktuṃ janai- rhelollāsitavāhinīśamathane yatro viṣadī bhavān || 92 ||’
yadyapyatrānurūpaṃ sādṛśyaṃ nāsti tathāpi śabdasādṛśyenāpyupamā pravartata eva
‘sakalaṅkena jaḍena ca sāmyaṃ doṣākareṇa te kīdṛk
atra pratīyamānasādṛśyasya pūrvārghe candropamānasya sakalaṅkatādiruttarardhena varṇanīyopameyasyābhujaṅgatvādirekasyaiva bhedakaḥ svadharmo'bhihitaḥ so'yamapyekavyatireka eva
samanayano yuganayanaḥ sarvān samaṃ nayatīti ca
atra mukhāmbhojayoḥ 'phulle surabhigandhinī' iti padābhyāmabhidhīyamānasādṛśyayoḥ sadṛśameva bhramadbhramaratvaṃ loladṛṣṭitvaṃ ca bhedakamupanyastamiti so'yaṃ śabdopāttasādṛśyayoḥ sadṛśavyatirekaḥ
atra pūrvārdhe candrahaṃsayoḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyayorambarottaṃsatvatoyabhūṣaṇatve, uttarārdhe tu nabhaḥpayasornakṣatramālitvotkumudatve sadṛśe eva bhedake
atra bhūbhṛta ityanena sākṣādupāttasādṛśyayo rāmamālyavatoryo'yamutsaṅge samasto'śrudhārāpāto yasya meghavṛṣṭerabhāvastadidamubhayorasadṛśameva bhedakam
atra kāntāmṛgekṣaṇayoḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyayorbhrūvilāsamadarāgau tadabhāvau ca visadṛśau bhedakāviti so'yaṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyayorasadṛśavyatirekaḥ

atra nabhaḥsarasoḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyayornirmalendutvaṃ vikacābjatvaṃ ca prāgvadeva sadṛśe bhedake; tābhyāṃ ca mukhacandramukhakamalābhyāṃ manoharāhlādakatvābhyāṃ ca pratīyamānasādṛśyayoreva rāmalakṣmaṇayoryeyaṃ mukhaparyaśrutā, tanau ca mlānirnirmalendutāvirājamānayorvikacābjatvaśobhamānatvayośca sā visadṛśīti so'yaṃ sadṛśāsadṛśabhedakatvakṛtabheda eva tadubhaya- vyatirekaḥ
mukhasya candrakamalabhāvo'nādikavikalpanāsiddha iti tenāpi rūpeṇa pratīyamānasādṛśyatvamuktam
nanu mitho vyatirekabhedagaṇanamanupapatraṃ sadṛśāsadṛśavyatirekasyāpi saṃbhavā- dityata āha—
‘mithyā deva bhujena te'lpavibhavaḥ kalpadrumaḥ spardhate nahyenaṃ bhuvanatrayābhayamahāsatrī kṛpāṇo'ñcati
tulyastatrabhavānprayāgaviṭapī yasyaitadekārṇave kāyāntarviniveśya viśvamakhilaṃ śākhāsu śete hariḥ || 101 ||’
atra varṇanīyabāhukalpadrumayorabhimataphaladāyitvādibhiḥ pratītasādṛśyayorbhuvanatrayābhayapradāyī varṇanīyabāhau kṛpāṇo bhedaka ityekavyatirekaḥ
tathā varṇanīyabāhoḥ prayāgavaṭasya ca prāgvadeva pratīyamānasādṛśyayorekasya bhuvanatrayābhayamahāsatrī kṛpāṇaḥ śākhāsu śete, anyasya tu mahāpralaye svakāyāntarniveśitārakhilaviśvo vaikuṇṭhaḥ
tāvimau tayoḥ sadṛśāveva bhedakau harikṛpāṇayorvā śyāmatādibhiḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyayorimāveva dharmau bhedakau so'yamevaṃprakāro vyatirekasaṃkara utreyaḥ
svajātivyatireke pratīyamānasādṛśyam, svavyaktivyatireke cābhidhīyamānasādṛśyaṃ yadyudāharaṇaṃ dṛśyate saṃbhavati vā tadā tadapyudāhāryam
na hyekavākyasthatāmātreṇa tathā camatkaroti yathāṅgāṅgaṅigabhāvādibhiḥ parasparagrathanayeti
na hi svajātivyatireke dvayorabhedādhyavasāyaḥ sādṛśyamantareṇa camatkāramarpayatīti kalpitameva vācyam
na ca kalpanāśabdamantareṇa pratīyamānasādṛśyasaṃbhavaḥ; sādṛśyasya bhedādhiṣṭānatvāt
svavyaktivyatireke'pyasaṃbhavastathābhūtameva tu śabdenopādīyata iti syādata uktaṃ yadi dṛśyate iti
atra mānanirākaraṇopakrame kālotpannasyākasmikaghanagarjitasya mānavidhvaṃse sahakāritvādākasmikīyaṃ daivakṛtā sahāyasaṃpattiḥ
sahāyaḥ prakṛtakāryakāraṇasya sahakārī, tenālaṃkāratā ākasmikyacintitapūrvā buddhipūrvādviparītā
atra bhīmānuśāsanakālopakrama eva vyāsāgamanasya tadupakāritvādākasmikīyamadaivakṛtā sahāyāptiḥ
viśvaikārṇavatāviśeṣamuditau tau matsyakūrmāvubhau karṣandhīvaratāṃ gataḥ syatu jaganmohaṃ mahābhairavaḥ || 104 ||’

atra pralayasamaye maheśvareṇa samāpayitumupakrāntānāṃ trivikramādīnāṃ yo'yaṃ tadbhuvā baḍiśādinā matsyakūrmayorākarṣaṇaprakāraḥ sa bhagavatā bhairaveṇa buddhipūrvakamupakalpyamāno daivāttathābhūtaireva taiḥ saṃpadyata iti buddhipūrveyaṃ daivakṛtā sahāyāptiḥ
narasiṃhanakhādīnāṃ baḍiśādyucitamūrtiśālināṃ daivameva nimittam, baḍiśādicintā ca viṣayīkṛteti buddhipūrvatā
hastasparśavaśena mūrdhni daśamaṃ mūrdhānamāropayan śaṃbhoradbhutasāhasaikarasikaḥ kairna śruto rāvaṇaḥ || 105 ||’

atra yo'yaṃ daśavadanena svayaṃ chinnaiḥ śirobhirbhagavataḥ śaṃbhorarcanāprakāra upakrāntastatra mūle pañca tataścatuṣṭayamiti śiroviracanāprapañcobuddhipūrvako'daivakṛtaḥ kriyamāṇo'sya karmaṇaḥ samāptau sahakārikāraṇatāmāsādayatītyayamadaivakṛto buddhipūrvakaḥ samāhitabhedaḥ
adho'dhaḥ sthūlapuṣpasya saṃniveśa uparyupari tanuriti dūrvāpūjāprakāraḥ prasiddhaḥ
idaṃ ca rāvaṇaprayatnaniṣpādyatvādadaivakṛtaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ ca bhavatītyanyatamena mūrdhnānyatamasyāropaṇaṃ na navamacchedaparyantamāsīt
pūjāsvarūpeṇaiva bhagavāṃstuṣyati na tathā viditenetyabhiprāyavato nistaraṅgā bhaktistena sāhasasyādbhutatvam
‘sā kaumudī nayanayorbhavataḥ sujanmā tasyā bhavānapi manorathabandhabandhuḥ
tatsaṅgamaṃ prati sakhe nahi saṃśayo'sti yasminvidhiśca madanaśca kṛtābhiyogau || 106 ||’
atra yo'yaṃ mādhavasya mālatīṃ prati samāgamābhilāṣastatreyaṃ mālatyā ākasmikī buddhipūrvā ca tathā pravṛttiḥ sobhayyapi daivakṛtā ca sahāyāptiḥ samāhitabhedaḥ
vidhiśca madanaśca kṛtābhiyogāvityanena mālatyāḥ pṛrvānubhāvāḥ kathyante
te ca dvidhā bhavantītyākasmikī daivapūrvā sahāyasaṃpattiḥ
‘dṛṣṭirvandanamālikā stanayugaṃ lāvaṇyapūrṇau ghaṭau śubhrāṇāṃ prakaraḥ smitaḥ sumanasāṃ vakraprabhā darpaṇaḥ
romāñcodgama eva sarṣapakaṇaḥ pāṇī punaḥ pallavau svāṅgaireva gṛhaṃ priyasya viśatastanvyā kṛtaṃ maṅgalam || 107 ||’

atrāgacchataḥ priyasyeyaṃ vandanamālikādimaṅgalakriyā manaḥparitoṣahetustasyāstanvaṅgyā iṅgitākāraireva yannivartanaṃ so'yamākasmikaḥ svabuddhipūrvakaśca tatsahakārikāraṇatvādadaivakṛtaśca samāhitabhedaḥ
buddhipūrvāyāṃ sahāyāptau kvacidbhrāntirapyasti tatastadanantaraṃ tāṃ lakṣayati—
atattve tattvarūpā yā trividhā sāpi paṭhyate
sā dvidhā—yasya yatrāsadbhāvastasya tatra sadbhāvāropaḥ, yasya vā yatra sadbhāvastasya tatrāsadbhāvāropaḥ
so'yaṃ bhāvābhāvakṛto niyamo bhrānterbādhaniyame'pi kvacidvāropanyāso bhavati kvacinna bhavati
yatra bādhopanyāse bādhitānupanyāse vā'bādhitā tasminneva vākye'vijñātabādhetyarthaḥ
atra suravadhūstanamaṇḍale karikumbhatvena gṛhīte'tattvarūpe yanmithyaiva tattvāropaṇaṃ na cānantaraṃ vādhakopanyāsaḥ kṛtasteneyamabādhitā atattve tattvarūpā bhrāntiḥ
itthaṃ ca dṛḍhānubandho'sau raso yadbalavattaravirodhisaṃparke'pi na kārkaśyamagāditi sthūlamaṇḍalasuravadhūpadaiḥ prakāśyate saṃbhāvanayā na tu pūrvotpannajñānena
atra pattraphalito'yaṃ nyagrodha ityatattvarūpe tattvabuddhāvutpannāyāṃ ya uttarakālamapattratāniṣphalatāpratyayasteneyamatattve tattvarūpākhyā bādhitā bhrāntiḥ
yadyapi nātra bādho'bhihitastathāpi uḍḍīṇa ityanenārthābhāvaviṣayā pratītiḥ kriyate
asitasicayaprāntabhrāntyā muhurmuhurutkṣipa- ñjayati janitavrīḍāhāsaḥ priyāhasito hariḥ || 110 ||’
atra śyāmāyāmātmadyutāvasitasicayaprāntabuddhiratattve tattvarūpā priyāhasitena ca kāraṇena yadbādhitā saiṣātattve tattvarūpā kāraṇabādhitā bhrāntiḥ
nātra pūrvodāharaṇavacchabdena kayācidapi vṛttyārthābhāvo viṣayīkṛtaḥ kiṃtu prakārāntareṇonnīyate
tathāhi nāyakenāṃśukāpaharaṇalīlāyite'pi yadidaṃ rādhāyāḥ sicayāvarodhāṅgacalanabhrūkṣepādi mugdhāṅganocitavibhramavirodhi hasitaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ bādhasyeti
‘so muddhamio miatahṇiāhiṃ taha dūmi tuha āsāhim
jaha saṃbhāvamaī ṇavi ṇaīṇa paraṃmuho jāo || 111 ||’
atra pāramārthikīṣvapi nadīṣu mṛgatṛṣṇāpratāritaḥ sanyanna mṛgaḥ payaḥ pātuṃ pratipadyate pratyuta tyajati teneyaṃ tattve'pyatattvarūpā hānaheturbhrāntiḥ
dvidhāpyatrābhimatamiti vyā- khyānena sphuṭayati—na pratipadyate pratyuta tyajatīti
‘samarthaye yatprathamaṃ priyāṃ prati kṣaṇena tanme parivartate'nyathā
ato vinidre sahasā vilocane karomi na sparśavibhāvitāpriyaḥ || 113 ||’

atrāṅgīkṛtalatārūporvaśīpariṣvaṅgasukhanimīlitākṣasya purūravasaḥ śāpāntāvirbhūtasatyarūpāyāmapi tasyāṃ yeyaṃ pūvānubhūtevaṃvidhānekavidhavipralambhasaṃbhāvanayā nayanayoranunmīlanabuddhiḥ seyaṃ tattve'pyatattvarūpopādānaheturbhrāntiḥ
vibhāvitāpriya iti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, priyādiṣu puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhāt
na ca vācyaṃ dolāyamānatayā saṃśayarūpamidaṃ jñānamiti
yato nāstyevātra priyatamā tathāpi tadāropeṇa manastāpātivāhanamucitamiti jānataḥ purūravaso'nubandhaprakarṣaḥ puṣyati nānyatheti sahṛdayahṛdayasākṣikamidam
atra tattvarūpe'pi mārjāre kṛtrimo'yamiti buddhau jātāyāṃ tasyāṃ prayojakatvena yadupekṣaṇaṃ seyaṃ tattve'pyatattvarūpopekṣāheturbhrāntiḥ
yā pravṛttiṃ nivṛttiṃ vā na prasūte'pekṣā- buddhiṃ vetyarthaḥ
bhūmārtho dvividho bahūnāṃ bhrāntīnāmekaviṣayato bhinnaviṣayāṇāṃ vā samānakartṛtā
na hi bhrāntimati mālākramaniyamo'sti yugapadapi bhinnakartṛkāṇāṃ jāyamānatvāt
bhrānteratiśayaḥ śabdopanītaprakarṣā bhrāntiriti svakāryabhūtaṃ vitarkamādāya pratīyamāno viparyayaheturbhramāntarānubandhī
‘kapole mārjāraḥ paya iti karā~lleḍhi śaśina- starucchidraprotānbisamiti karī saṃkalayati
ratānte talpasthānharati dayitāpyaṃśukamiti prabhāmattaścandro jagadidamaho vibhramayati || 114 ||’
atrendumarīciṣu payaḥprabhṛtibhrāntibhūmnāyaṃ bhrāntimān nāma bhrāntereva bhedaḥ
‘nīlendīvaraśaṅkayā nayanayorbandhūkabuddhyādhare pāṇau padmadhiyā madhūkakusumabhrāntyā tathā gaṇḍayoḥ
līyante kabarīṣu bāndhavajanavyāmohajātaspṛhā durvārā madhupāḥ kiyanti taruṇi sthānāni rakṣiṣyasi || 115 ||’
atra yuvatyavayaveṣu nayanādiṣu madhuvratānāṃ yeyaṃ nīlotpalādibuddhiḥ seyaṃ mālākrameṇopajāyamānā bhrāntimālā bhrāntereva bhedaḥ
atra śādvale'pi samutpannastanāṃśukabhramasya purūravaso yo'yaṃ sādṛśyātiśayito vitarkaḥ seyamupamābhrāntiḥ
tattvena pratīyato madhye manāktavdyatirekamullikhito nūnaṃ bhedābhedatulyatayā manasi sādṛśyaṃ pravartata iti bhāvaḥ
atra gaṅgāmbhaḥpratiphalitāṃ rajanikarakalāmālokayato vāsukeryeyaṃ śapharībhrameṇa mukulīkurvan phaṇālīṃ śapharīyamityadhyāsitā viparyayabuddhiḥ so'yaṃ bhrāntyatiśayo nāma bhrāntereva bhedaḥ
‘virahiṇihiaakaantahiṃ ṇiṇṇāai takkhaṇi chāijjai aliṇivahehiṃ caitteṇa cūavaṇī
aha tāsu vi maarandahiṃ saṃdāṇiai jaha ṇa kalamba ṇa amba ṇa jambū jāṇiai || 118 ||’
atha tāsvapi makarandairvadhyate yathā na kadambo nāmro na jambūrjñāyate ||]
na kadambo nāmro na jambūriti jñāyata iti trayāṇāmevāvalambanabhūtatvātsālambano nāmāyaṃ bhrāntyanadhyavasāyo bhrāntibhedaḥ
‘ubhau rambhāstambhāvupari viparītau kamalayo- stadūrdhvaṃ ratnāśmasthalamatha durūhaṃ kimapi yat
tataḥ kumbhau paścādbisakisalaye kandalamaye tadanvindāvindīvaramadhukarāḥ kiṃ punaridam || 119 ||’
atrorvādiṣu yuvatyavayaveṣūtpanno rambhāstambhabhrānteryo'yametatsamudāye kimidamityālambanaṃ vinā kṛto'nadhyavasāyaḥ sa eṣa nirālambano nāma bhrāntyanadhyavasāyo bhrāntereva bhedaḥ
yathā—ghaṭapadārthatayā vyāvṛttau saṃdihānasya kalaśapadārthatayā niścayavato yaḥ kalaśaḥ sa ghaṭa iti
saṃdeho nānākoṭikastathābhūtāmeva jijñāsāṃ prasūte, tarkastu tadanantarabhāvī niyatakoṭikastathābhūtāmiti
tadayaṃ tarkābhāsasya viparyayāparyavasāyino viṣayavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ, sa tu tarkasya viṣayavibhāgaḥ sphuṭa eva saṃdehanirṇayayormadhyamadhiṣṭitaḥ sa tadvartī
‘mainākaḥ kimayaṃ ruṇaddhi gagane manmārgamavyāhataṃ śaktistasya kutaḥ sa vajrapatanādbhīto mahendrādapi
tārkṣyaḥ so'pi samaṃ nijena vibhunā jānāti māṃ rāvaṇaṃ ā jñātaṃ sa jaṭāyureṣa jarasā kliṣṭo vadhaṃ vāñchati || 120 ||’
atra nirūpitalakṣaṇe vitarke jaṭāyureṣa iti tattvānupātī nirṇayānto vitarkaḥ
kimayamiti kākvā pūrvaṃ dolāyamānacittasya niyatakoṭisparśī jñānaviśeṣa upanīyate sa eva tarkaḥ
‘asyāḥ sargavidhau prajāpatirabhūccandro nu kāntipradaḥ śṛṅgāraikarasaḥ svayaṃ nu madano māso nu puṣpākaraḥ
vedābhyāsajaḍaḥ kathaṃ nu viṣayavyāvṛttakautūhalo nirmātuṃ prabhavenmanoharamidaṃ rūpaṃ purāṇo muniḥ || 121 ||’
atra kimidaṃ rūpaṃ nirmātuṃ yathoktaḥ purāṇo muniḥ prabhavet, ataścandrādiṣvanyatamena prajāpatinā bhavitavyamityatattvānupātitvādatattvānupātyayaṃ nirṇayānto vitarkaḥ
‘citte niveśya parikalpitasattvayogā- nrūpoccayena racitā manasā kṛtā nu
strīratnasṛṣṭiraparā pratibhāti sā me dhāturvibhutvamanucintya vapuśca tasyāḥ || 122 ||’
‘adreḥ śṛṅgaṃ harati pavanaḥ kiṃsvidityunmukhībhi- rdṛṣṭocchrāyaścakitacakitaṃ mugdhasiddhāṅganābhiḥ
atra kimidamadreḥ śṛṅgaṃ pavano haratīti meghaṃ prati kalpanāyāṃ mithyātvādvastunaścānirṇayādanirṇayānto mithyārūpo vitarkaḥ
samadhirūḍhamajena nu jiṣṇunā sviditi vegavaśānmumuhe gaṇaiḥ || 124 ||’
bhagavatpārthayoravasthānayoḥ samadhirohārohayośca na kiṃcidbādhakamasti cakṣurjñānasya viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣata iti
‘māyā svideṣā mativibhramo vā dhvastaṃ nu me vīryamutāhamanyaḥ
gāṇḍīvamuktā hi yathāpurā me parākramante na śarāḥ kirāte || 125 ||’
atra māyādīnāṃ vikalpānāṃ mithyārūpatvānmama śarāḥ kirāte na vyāpriyanta ityasyā mithyārūpatvādanirṇayāntatvāccāyamanirṇayānta ubhayarūpo vitarkaḥ
na parameśvarasya māyā chadma, na śaktau matibhramaḥ, na dhvaṃso vīryasya, navārjunādevārjunasyānyatvamiti viṣayabādhāt
atra mīlitamabhidhīyamānaguṇena pratīyamānaguṇena ca vastunā saṃbhavati
majjaṇataṃbesu mao taha maataṃbesu loaṇesu amariso || 126 ||’
atra majjanatāmrayorlocanayormadarāgo madatāmrayoḥ kopānurāgaḥ sākṣādabhidhīyamānenaiva guṇena tiraskriyamāṇo nidarśita ityabhidhīyamānaguṇena vastunaitanmīlitam
‘pi adaṃsaṇeṇa suharasamuulia jaise ṇa honti ṇaaṇāim
tā keṇa kaṇṇaraiaṃ lakkhijjai kuvalaaṃ tassā || 127 ||’
atra priyadarśanasukhena mukulitayoreva locanayostasyāḥ karṇakuvalayaṃ lakṣyate natvamukulitayoriti vastunā vastvantaratiraskāraḥ pratīyamānaguṇatayopapādita iti pratīyamānaguṇena vastunā mīlitamidam
nanu piadaṃsaṇeṇetyādi kathaṃ mīlitaṃ, na hyatra tiraskāraḥ kenāpi śabdena pratyāyyata ityata āha—natvamukulitayoriti
yadi mukulite na syātāṃ kathaṃ kuvalayaṃ lakṣyata iti tarkasya tiraskāraparyavasānāditi bhāvaḥ
atra prakaṭitasnehavibhramatayā tvāmavalokya naitadanyo jano jānātviti sarvatra snigdhadṛṣṭipātena pihitamapyetanmīlitabheda eva
uvaāro jaṇṇa kao teṇa a kaliaṃ chaillehim || 129 ||’
upacāro yanna kṛtastena ca kalitaṃ chekaiḥ ||]
atra dṛṣṭayā yanna dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhāṣitayā yanna saṃbhāṣito na cābhyāgatopacāro bihitastena tadanurāgaḥ paraṃ na pihitaḥ pratyuta chādanena chekānāṃ prakaṭita ityapihitākhyo'yaṃ mīlitabhedaḥ
nanu dṛṣṭayāpi na dṛṣṭa ityapi kathamalaṃkāraḥ
tacchāāhiṃ puṇa caliau sāmala- gatto taha maaṇu manti ahim || 130 ||’
atra gaurāṅgastaruṇījanaḥ sitanepathyo jyotsnāyāṃ śyāmastu nīlanepathyastasyāśchāyāsu gacchatīti tadguṇāśrayamīlanāttadguṇākhyaṃ mīlitamidam
‘karkandhūphalamuccinoti śabarī muktāphalākāṅkṣiṇī kruddholūkakadambakasya purataḥ kāko'pi haṃsāyate
kīrtyā te dhavalīkṛte tribhuvane kṣmāpāla lakṣmīḥ puraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya balo'yamityupahitavrīḍaṃ śanairjalpati 131 ||’
sadṛśā jñāyamānasādṛśyāt prayatnajā smṛtiścintādiryasyārthamagre kathayiṣyati—anubhūtārthavedanaṃ samānaviṣayānubhavaniyatajñānaviśeṣarūpaṃ smaraṇam
sa ca kāraṇatāsādṛśyamanantarbhāvya khañjanajñānasyāstīti ca pratītaṃ sādṛśyamiti bhāvaḥ
manasijena sakhe prahariṣyatā dhanuṣi cūtaśaraśca niveśitaḥ ||133 ||’
atra munisutāpraṇayasmṛtirodhinā tamasā me mano viyuktamityadṛṣṭakṛtaṃ smaraṇamidam
‘purā yatra srotaḥ pulinamadhunā tatra saritāṃ viparyāsaṃ yāto ghanaviralabhāvaḥ kṣitiruhām
bahordṛṣṭaṃ kālādaparamiva jātaṃ vanamidaṃ niveśaḥ śailānāṃ tadidamiti buddhiṃ draḍhayati || 134 ||’
atra pratyakṣeṣvapi srotastaruvipinādiṣu smaraṇasya cintājanyatvādidaṃ cintodbhūtaṃ smaraṇam
smṛtikāriṇā tvayā me punarapi citrīkṛtā kāntā || 135 ||’
‘jāne svapnavidhau mamādya culukotsekyaṃ purastādabhū- tpratyūṣe pariveṣamaṇḍalamiva jyotsnāsapatnaṃ mahaḥ
tasyāntarnakhanistuṣīkṛtaśaraccandraprabhairaṅgakai- rdṛṣṭā kāpyabalā balātkṛtavatī sā manmathaṃ manmatham || 136 ||’
yadi svapnasmṛtirapi smaraṇameva tadā katamadatra sādṛśyādiṣu kāraṇamata uktam—cintādīti
‘gṛhīto yaḥ pūrvaṃ pariṇayavidhau kaṃkaṇadharaḥ sudhāmūrteḥ pādairamṛtaśiśirairyaḥ paricitaḥ
sa evāyaṃ tasyāstaditarakaraupamyasubhago mayā labdhaḥ pāṇirlalitalavalīkandalanibhaḥ || 137 ||’
atra gṛhīto yaḥ pūrvaṃ sa evāyaṃ tasyāḥ pāṇiriti pratyabhijñānamapi smaraṇameva
nanu sūtre svapnātpūrvaṃ pratyabhijñānamuddiṣṭaṃ paścādudāhriyata iti kathametat
pravṛttipratipādakena svārthaprakāśanadvārā prakāśyamāno'bhiprāyaḥ kvacitpadāntaravṛttisahakṛtena prakāśyate, kvacitkevalena
ata eva tatkāryayoḥ pravṛtteranubhāvarūpatayā tadyāvānakuṇṭha iti hṛdayam (?)
atra sutasya dantodgamādahamupabhogayogyāsmīti gṛhiṇyā evamabhiprāyaḥ prakarṣavikāsitanayanatayodbhidyate; na punaḥ patyurityekataḥ sodbhedo'yaṃ bhāvaḥ
atra sāloka eva sūrye gṛhapatergṛhāgamanaṃ gṛhiṇyāśca yatpādadhāvanaṃ ttadāvābhyāmadya veśmano na nirgantavyamiti bhāvaḥ
sa ca dvayorapi hāsenābhita udbhidyata ityabhittaḥ sodbhedo'yaṃ bhāvaḥ
sarvāṅgasundaryā api pathikā akṣiṇī eva prekṣante ||]

atrātisaundaryeṇa devībhrāntyā śālivanagopikāmālokayatāṃ pathikānāṃ tadakṣinirīkṣaṇe'yamabhiprāyaḥ—‘śālivanatiraskāreṇa devamānuṣayorviśeṣabhūtaḥ pabhdyāmeva bhūmisparśo bhūmyasparśo vā na lakṣyata iti tadakṣiṇī eva paśyāmo yadiyaṃ nimiṣati tadā mānuṣīyaṃ yadi na nimiṣati tadā devīyam
’ iti sarvāṅgasundaryā api pathikānāmeva jāyamāno bhāvo neha kenacitkarmaṇodbhidyata ityekato nirudbhedaścāyaṃ bhāvaḥ

atrāgacchantīṃ hālikasnuṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhapatisūnorgodāvarītaṭe yadavasthānam, yaśca tamavalokya tasyā duruttaramārgeṇāvataraṇārambhastatrāyaṃ tayorabhiprāyo hastāvalambadānenāvayoraṅgasaṅgamaḥ saṃpadyatāmiti
sa cābhito dvayorapi jāyamāno neha kenacitkarmaṇodbhidyata ityabhito nirudbhedaścāyaṃ bhāvaḥ
hṛdyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca bhidyeta na hi bhāvātkathaṃcana
ṇaha udao(?) māṇaṃsiṇīe a thoraṃ suaṃ ruṇṇam || 142 ||’
atra hṛdaye roṣoddhūrṇapādaprahāraṃ yadayaṃ śirasā prārthitavān, yacca tayāsau na tāḍitastatra hṛdaye vallabhā vasatīti bhāvaḥ
sa ca prārthanārodanābhyāmudbhidyamānaḥ sodbhedo bhāvo hṛdya ityucyate
nanu ca sūkṣmaḥ kathaṃ pūrvoktātsūkṣmādbhidyata ityata āha—iṅgitākāralakṣyā- diti
kadā nau saṃgamo bhāvītyabhiprāyasya vyañjakaṃ neṅgitaṃ na vikāro vā kāntasya kaścidupāttaḥ, avetyetyādiprakāśitābhiprāyānuguṇā kācidasti kriyā vā
atrānukāryānukaraṇe'pi bhūmikāntarite eva bhavata iti so'yaṃ nirudbhedo bhāva eva sūkṣma ityucyate
ājānikaṃ padmamīlanamanukāryaṃ kāntāhastāṅgulījanitamanukaraṇaṃ rātrau samāgamo bhaviṣyatīti kāntāgato'bhiprāyaḥ
jñānasaṃgatyanantaraṃ pramāṇarūpālaṃkāraprastāvastatrānyeṣāṃ pramāṇānāṃ pratyakṣamūlakatvāt prathamaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇamāha—pratyakṣamiti
akṣaṃ bahirindriyaṃ tasmājjātam, mānasaṃ bāhyendriyānapekṣeṇa manasā janitam
śarīrābhighātādyabhibhūte pratyāhāratiraskṛte vā manasi yat kadācidatisphuṭābhaṃ jñānamutpadyate na tasya manonibandhanatā śakyate'bhidhātumiti cicchaktimevāśrayate
nanu indriyajanya eva loke sākṣātkāritāprasiddheḥ kathamanubhūtibhavaṃ tathetyata āha—upacāreṇeti
atha bhāvanādibalena vināpīndriyaṃ bhavatīti pakṣastadā mukhyata eveti bhāvaḥ
ekasminvākye ghrāṇarasanacakṣustvakśrotrāṇāṃ pañcānāmapi yugapatpravṛttyabhidhānādyaugapadyaṃ rasānuguṇatayā yaugapadyāccamatkāritāmāvahatīti dvidhāpyalaṃkārakāṇḍe parisaṃkhyānamucitam
saṃskāralakṣaṇayā hi pratyāsattyā yathā smaraṇātiriktaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ tathedamapīti na kiṃcidanupapannam
mayi ca nimīlitanayane tathāpi kāntāmukhaṃ vyaktam || 148 ||’
nahi smaraṇena vyaktatā bhavati kiṃtu ātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate
yadālokyāhlādaṃ hrada iva nimajjyāmṛtamaye dadhatyantastattvaṃ kimapi yaminastatkila bhavān || 150 ||’
nididhyāsanabalalabdhātmano jñānasya yogimātre prasiddha- viṣayatvānna hyasmadādayastathā taṃ paricinvanti yathā yogina ityarthaḥ
yasya yena sahāvinābhāvalakṣaṇā vyāptiḥ saṃdigdhasādhyadharmadharmirūpapakṣavṛttitārūpā pakṣadharmatā ca gṛhyate tasmāttasya pratītiranumānaṃ yathā dhūmādvahneḥ
yadyapi jñānamanumānamityuktaṃ tathāpi tasya sādhāraṇameva kvacidanupanyāsapradhānaṃ vācyam, kvacitkaraṇībhūtaliṅgaparāmarśopanyāsapradhānamiti bhavati yathokto viśeṣaḥ
anumānaśabdo hi bhāvalyuḍantaḥ karaṇe lyuḍanto vā
teṣu yatra kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāryamanumīyate tatpūrvavadyathā—
āyātaścejjaladāgamastadā pūrvapravṛtta iva pathikanārīvināśo lakṣyata iti niṣṭhāpratyayena dyotyate
neyamarthāpattiḥ; kiṃtu tathābhūtā nāyakasya lalāṭe'laktakabinduviśeṣapaṅktiḥ pramadāpadāvapātapratibaddheti
na cālaktakabindupaṅktijñānaṃ tathā svadate yathā vipakṣacaraṇāvanamanānumeyasya jñānaṃ phalabhūtam, tatkila vipakṣagocarāmīrṣyāṃ vyañjayadvipralambhaprakarṣaṃ puṣṇāti
yatra na kāryaṃ na kāraṇaṃ kevalamavinābhāvamātraṃ pratīyate tatsāmā- nyato dṛṣṭaṃ yathā—
‘gajjante khe mehā phullā ṇīvā paṇaddiā morā
[garjanti khe meghāḥ phullā nīpāḥ pranartitā mayūrāḥ
atra varṣarturavinābhūtairmeghagarjitādibhiḥ sāmānyenaivānumīyata iti sāmānyato dṛṣṭamidam
atra samasamaye meghagarjitādibhiḥ kālopādhibhiranumānaṃ tena kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ
atra hi na pṛthaṅrameghagarjitādijñānaṃ tathā camatkrāramāvahati yathā varṣārātrijñānapratibaddham
sa hi jñātaḥ ketakakarṇapūrādividagdhanepathyaparigrahautsukyaṃ pravāsināyakāgamanautsukyaṃ vā janayatīti phala eva bharaḥ
yadāha—‘sa eva cobhayātmāyaṃ gamyo gamaka iṣyate
‘ai sahi vakkullāviri cchuhihisi gottassa matthae chāram
atraivaṃprakārayā vakroktyā evaṃvidhena hasitenopalakṣitatvamagrato gotraṃ dūṣayasīti kāraṇato yatra kāryānumānaṃ tadidaṃ sāmagrīpakṣe pūrvavadityucyate
nanu māpayitavye liṅgajñānaviṣayatayā pūrvaṃ kāraṇamāśrayatīti pūrvavat
yathāhi vakra ālāpo mugdhāṅganāprakṛtyaucityāgataṃ hasitaṃ dhvananaśaktyā viṣayatayā kāntimarpayati na tathā śabdābhilapitaṃ cāritryakhaṇḍanamiti sāhityamudrāvidāmatiprakāśameva
‘dīsai ṇa cūamaulaṃ attā ṇa a vāi malaagandhavaho
ettaṃ vasantamāso sahi jaṃ utkaṇṭhiaṃ ceam || 156 ||’
[dṛśyate na cūtamukulamadya na ca vāti malayagandhavahaḥ
atrotkaṇṭhālakṣaṇena kāryeṇa vasantaḥ kāraṇabhūto'numīyata iti sāmagrīpakṣe idaṃ śeṣavadityucyate
yathā priyasya saṃnidhāsyataḥ saṃbhāvanā lokottarābhimānapratiṣṭhitā bhavati na tathā saṃnidhānamiti sahṛdayasākṣiko'yamarthaḥ
seyaṃ vidyudiva dṛṣṭiṃ kāmandakyapi prathamata upalabhyamānā avinābhāvena mālatyāgamanaṃ gamayatīti sāmagrīpakṣe sāmānyato dṛṣṭametat
uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ cātha jaghanyaṃ ceti tatridhā || 49
dadadhva iti vāgdaivī dayadhvaṃ datta dāmyata || 158 ||’
atra caiṣā daivī vāganuvadati, yat stanayitnurdadadhva iti dayadhvaṃ datta dāmyateti ‘tadetattrayaṃ śikṣeta damaṃ dānaṃ dayām’ iti śrutestadetadvidhirūpamāptavacanam
dayadhvaṃ datta dāmyateti daivī vāgato damadānadayāḥ kartavyā iti vidhiḥ paryavasyati
na kevalaṃ yo mahato'pabhāṣate śṛṇoti tasmādapi yaḥ sa pāpabhāk 159’
atrottarārdhoktaniṣedhānuvādavardhitavyutpattervayasyāyā yo'yamapavadamānabaṭunivāraṇopadeśastasya mahānto nāpabhāṣitavyā iti vākyārthe tātparyādayaṃ niṣedharūpa āgamaḥ
nanu 'na kevalaṃ yo mahato'pabhāṣate' ityādi vartamānāpadeśātkathaṃ vidhitvamata āha—atrottarārdheti
apabhāṣaṇasya nindārthavādena niṣedhavidhiḥ kalpyate, tena mahānto nāpabhāṣitavyā iti vacanavyaktirunnīyata iti
atra jīvannaraḥ paśyati bhadramityayamevārtho nirdiṣṭavaktṛkastadetatsarvāvākyānāṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ paryavasānāt prāṇeṣaṇāyāṃ yatitavyamiti vidhirūpamāptavacanam
atrāpi prāgvadeva stutyarthavādena jīvanāya yatitavyamiti vidhiḥ kalpyate
atrāpi sarvavākyānāṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ paryavasānāt—‘tasmādakṣaṃ na seveta, picumandaṃ na kṛnteta, vaṭaṃ na chindyāt, padmaṃ na mūrdhni bibhṛyāt, madhūkaṃ na padā spṛśet’ ityadhyāhāro bhavati
etenaitihyamāgama evāntarbhūtamiti darśitam; ajñātavaktṛkasyāgamasyaiva tathā prasiddheriti
‘vayaṃ bālye bālāṃstaruṇimani yūnaḥ pariṇatā- vapīcchāmo vṛddhānpariṇayavidhau naḥ sthitiriyam
tvayārabdhaṃ janma kṣapayitumakāṇḍena vidhinā na no gotre putri kvacidapi satīlāñchanamabhūt || 163 ||’
tvayārabdhamityādau gaṇikayā satīcāritryavatyā na bhavitavyamiti sphuṭo niṣe- dhavidhirjaghanyatvaṃ vyācaṣṭe—ubhayamapi caitanmūlakāribhiriti
asaṃnikṛṣṭe sadṛśāntararūpe'rthe yato buddhimutpādayati tena bhavati sadṛśātsadṛśapratipattirupamānam
tathāhi—nāgarikeṇa yadā āraṇyakaḥ pṛṣṭa ācaṣṭe ‘yathā gaustathā gavayaḥ’ iti

tadā khalu nāgarikasyātideśavākyārthamanusmarato gāṃ ca sādṛśyapratiyoginaṃ jānato yadgavaye gosādṛśyajñānaṃ tadupamānaṃ pramāṇaṃ; tenāyaṃ gavayaśabdavācya iti saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhajñānaṃ paścādupajanyate sopamitiriti
tatra sadṛśādbuddhau viparivartamānādyatsadṛśajñānaṃ sadṛśe gavaye saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhajñānamityarthaḥ
evaṃ vegātkuliśamakarodvyoma vidyutsahasrai- rbharturvajrajvalanakapiśāste ca roṣāṭṭahāsāḥ || 164 ||’

atra rāmakarākṛṣyamāṇabhagnadhūrjaṭidhanurvimuktajyotiśchaṭāsahasrasaṃkulamākāśaṃ paśyato rāvaṇadūtasyeyaṃ svayaṃ dṛṣṭeṣu prabhuvakṣaḥsthalavidīrṇavajraśakalavisphūrjathuṣu tadroṣāṭṭahāseṣu viyadvyāpiṣu tatsādṛśyabuddhistadidamanubhūtaviṣayaṃ nāmopamānaṃ mīmāṃsakā varṇayanti

atra yathāvidhaḥ śakaṭākārastathāvidho rohiṇītārakāsamūhākāra ityevamavadhāritāptopadeśasya tadākāratārakācakradarśanādidaṃ tadrohiṇīśa-kaṭamiti yeyaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhapratipattistadidamananubhūtaviṣayamupamānaṃ naiyāyikāḥ samunnayanti

grāmataruṇairananyabaddhāntaḥkaraṇairhālikavadhūstanābhogo musalollāsanādau vāraṃvāramanubhūtaḥ sa tulyākāradhṛtavivaraprasūnairaṇḍadaladarśanādeva buddhimārohatīti sā buddhirmīmāṃsakopamitimadhyamadhyāste
atha svidyatpāṇistvaritamapamṛjyaitadaparā kare pauṣpaṃ cāpaṃ makaramupariṣṭācca likhati || 167 ||’

atra yadānubhūtanāyakasaṃdarśanāyāstadrūpālekhyapradarśanādevaṃbhūtaḥ sa iti vijñānamutpadyate, gopanārthaṃ ca tathābhūtayoreva devakulādidṛṣṭaviṣṇukāmayoḥ pratītirbhavati, tadaitadanubhūtārthaviṣayaṃ bhavati
evaṃbhūtaḥ suparṇaketuścakrapāṇirviṣṇurbhavati, evaṃbhūto makaradhvajaḥ puṣpacāpaḥ kāmo bhavati, yādṛśāvimau tādṛśaśca te manorathabhūmiḥ; kevalamasya garutmadādayo na vidyante

tadā taduttarakālamālekhyagatatadākāradarśanāt so'yaṃ mama preyāniti madvidhayā kayāpi likhito bhaviṣyatīti tadgopāyāmyenaṃ viṣṇucihnābhyāmiti garutmaccakre adhaḥpradeśahastayoḥ ketuhastayorniveśayati
athāparā pratividhitsurgopāyantī prakāśayantī ca pratyāsannopamānaṃ manmathākāramācikhyāsuḥ kare pauṣpaṃ cāpaṃ makaramupariṣṭācca likhati
atrākṛtau padārthe yā imāstayorlokānāṃ so'yamiti viṣṇuriti kāma iti ca saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhapratipattayastadidamanubhūtārthaviṣayamupamānamālekhyamākhyāyate
tadaprāptikarśitā citrapratimādinā parinodanena kathaṃcidātmānaṃ dhārayatīti tanvīpadena dhvanyate
na ca jīvitamātrārthinī sā kiṃtu tvadākṛtidarśanakutūhalenodvignā satī nigūḍhamapyabhiprāyamālekhyanirmāṇena vyanaktīti kautūhalataraṃlapadābhyāṃ vyajyate
sā niryantraṇaprārthanīyatāvirodhinaṃ devatābhāvamanusaṃdhatte, tayā trailokyātiśāyisaubhāgyaprakarṣasya puṣpeṣościhnabhūtau cāpamakarau likhitāviti, atha svidyatpāṇistvaritamityetervyajyate
tatra mīmāṃsakapakṣe tāvattanvyālekhyamunmṛditaṃ dṛṣṭvā kācidanubhūtapūrvaṃ nāyakaṃ jānāti
sādṛśyāviśeṣācca kṛṣṇakāmāvapi pratyeti tadā sadṛśātpratiyattirupamānaṃ bhavati

naiyāyikapakṣe yadā sāmānyato nāyakāgame utpannapūrvānurāgāyā viśeṣataśca pratyaṅgalāvaṇyamajānantyā itthaṃbhūtākārau kṛṣṇa kāmau yādṛśau tādṛśastava preyānityāptopadeśaśnabaṇānantaraṃ gṛhīta-citrākārāyāstattacchabdābhidheyatāpratipattirupamānamiti
yadapi cādṛṣṭe'pi jiṣṇupade mṛgīdṛśāmīdṛśaḥ sa ityanumānajñānaṃ tadapyupamānārthanibandhanameva
nanu caraṇamudrayā jiṣṇucaraṇānumānamatra pratibhāti tatkathamupamāne'ntarbhāva ityata āha—yadapi ceti
atrāviśeṣasya caraṇaviśeṣapratibandhe satyapi sadṛśātsadṛśajñānamutpannaṃ [tkaṭaṃ] tādṛśena ca vyapadeśo bhavatītyarthaḥ
vīkṣya bimbamanubimbamātmanaḥ kāni kānyapi cakāra lajjayā || 170 ||’
atra yadā tāvadevaṃ saṃbandhagrahaḥ kīdṛśaṃ svaṃ mukhaṃ yādṛśamādarśe pratibimbaṃ tadālokanādadṛṣṭe'pi svamukhe yeyamīdṛśaṃ me mukhamiti pratipattistadidamanubhūtārthaviṣayam
yadā punaritthamāptopadeśādyādṛśaṃ vastu tādṛśamādarśādau pratibimbaṃ tadāpi priyapratibimbālokanādidaṃ tanmama priyapratibimbamitīyaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhapratipattistadapyananubhūtārthaviṣa-yam

yadā tu citrādiṣvanubhūtasvamukhadarśanāyāḥ pratibimbadarśanādanena sadṛśaṃ me mukhamiti pratipattirdṛṣṭapriyatamākārāyāśca pratibimbākāradarśanādetadākāro mama preyāniti pratipattiḥ pratibimbasaṃnidhau pratibimbodayo dṛṣṭastadiha saṃnihitena tena bhavitavyamiti yo vrīḍāvikārabhūtastadānubhūtaviṣayametadupamānaṃ pratibimbamityācakṣate
tatastatpūrvārthāpattirapi ṣoḍhā saṃpadyate, yadarthāntaraṃ gamayati tāmarthāpattiṃ vadantīti
atra stanabharanitambayormadhyaṃ nopalabhyate, stanabharāvasthānaṃ ca dṛśyate, tatra yeyaṃ payodharabharasthitiḥ sānyathānupapadyamānā dhārakaṃ madhyamanupalabhyamānaṃ bodhayati
iyamapi hyevaṃ bahuśo bhavati yattadarthāpattilabdhaṃ madhyaṃ tadapi dhāraṇaśaktimantareṇa tatkarmāsamarthamiti tasyapi śaktiḥ kalpyate
yaścāyamarthāpattivikalpasya madhyasyopalambhābhāvaḥ so'pi prakārantareṇāsaṃbhavan kāntikārśyayorutkarṣaṃ brūte
na caitadiha śābdamapi tu vākyārtha- sāmarthyādgamyate
stanabharasthitiḥ pratyakṣagṛhītā sā cādhāramantareṇānupapadyamānā madhyaṃ kalpayati
śaktirmīmāṃsakanaye nityātīndriyā, abhāvo'bhāvenaiva gṛhyata iti madhyānupalambho'bhāvapramāṇapūrvakaḥ
adbhutaprabhāvatiraskṛtaṃ hi nayanamāsannamapi na madhyagrahaṇasamarthamiti bhāvaḥ
tatredaṃ rūpamapratimaṃ taveti pratyakṣapūrvatā abhāvapūrvatā ca vyaktameva pratīyate

atrāpi yeyaṃ rūpasyāpratimatānyathānupapadyamānā kalātattvaguruvinirmitatvamātmano'vasthāpayati sorvaśyahalyādirūpopamānajñānapūrvikā, yā tatkarturarthāpattikalpitā kālātattvagurutā sāpi tathāvidhaśaktikalpanāpūrviketyupamānapūrvikārthāpāttipūrvikā ceyamarthāpattiḥ
sāpi tatkarturvedhasaḥ kalātattvagurutā tathābhūtaśaktyādhāratā vā, sāpyanumānata āgamato vājñasya kalpyata ityanumānapūrvikā ceyamarthāpattiḥ
pratimāśūnyaṃ rūpaṃ viśiṣṭameva tatra viśeṣaṇāṃśe'bhāvasya vyāpāraḥ, viśeṣyāṃśe pratyakṣasya
pratimābhāvajñānaṃ pratimājñānapūrvakama, pratimā ca sādṛśyaṃ, tacca sahaśabdadvayadarśanavedyāmityasti pūrvamupamānam
atra yo'yaṃ kapolapulakānumīyamāno manobhavajvaraḥ sa manasaḥ priye nirantarāsaktimantareṇānupapanna ityanumānapūrvikeyamarthāpattiḥ
atra tvadāsyendū samau dṛṣṭvetyupamānapūrvakatā arthāpatteḥ pratyakṣapūrvatā ca śabdata eva pratīyate
yā ca mithaḥ sādṛśyānupapattilabhyā lāvaṇyānyonyagāmitā sāpi tathāvidhaṃ vidhātāramantareṇa na saṃgacchata ityādīhāpi pūrvavadvākyārthasāmarthyato'vagantavyam
atra vibhramiṇīmiti praśaṃsāyāṃ matvarthīyastena vibhramāṇāmutkarṣo lakṣyate
iyameva ca manobhūrmanasi kāminīnāṃ saṃbhavatītyāptopadeśādāgamapūrvikāpi bhavati
yathā abhāvapūrvikāyāmarthāpattau karaṇaṃ bhedānumānamuktaṃ tathātrāpi boddhavyam
‘jaṃ jassa hoi sāraṃ taṃ so daitti kimattha accheram
aṇahottaṃ vi hu diṇṇaṃ tai dohaggaṃ savattīṇam || 180 ||’
[yadyasya bhavati sāraṃ taṃ sa dadāti kimatrāścaryam
abhavadapi khalu dattaṃ tayā daurbhāgyaṃ sapatnīnām ||]
sthānāntarapramitasya sthānāntare traikāliko'bhāvaviśeṣo'tyantābhāva iti darśanamāśritya catuṣṭayamadhyapātī tāvadatyantābhāva udāhṛtaḥ
'na martyalokastridivātprahīyate mriyeta nāgre yadi valabho janaḥ
nivṛttameva tridivaprayojanaṃ mṛtaḥ sa cejjīvita eva jīvati || 184 ||’
vallabhajanamaraṇaṃ pradhvaṃsaḥ sa nañā niṣidhyate sa tu niṣedhaḥ prāgasattvarūpa eva
mṛtaḥ sa cediti maraṇottaramabhāvo bhavatpradhvaṃso bhavati sa cāsaṃbhavannapiśabdena saṃbhāvyamānaḥ kāntikāraṇaṃ bhavatītyalaṃkārakakṣāmārohati
maraṇena pradhvaṃsanaṃ tasyābhāvaḥ samastena na jātasyāpyabhāvo bhinnena pratipāditaḥ
kathamapītyanena pravāse daśamyavasthā kaṭākṣitā tasyātyayaḥ pradhvaṃsapradhvaṃsaḥ
tvatprayojanadhanaṃ dhanaṃjayādanya eṣa iti māṃ ca māvagāḥ || 187 ||’

śrīrāmasiṃhadevājñāmādāya racito mayā | darpaṇākhyaḥ sadā tena tuṣyatāṃ śrīsarasvatī || ratneśvaro nāma kavīśvaro'sau virājate kāvyasudhābhiṣekaiḥ | dustarkavakrāhatadurvidagdhāṃ vasuṃdharāṃ pallavayannajasram || adya sphuratu vāgdevyāḥ kaṇṭhābharaṇakautukam | mayi brahmamanovṛttau kurvāṇe ratnadarpaṇam || iti śrīmanmahārājaśrīrāmasiṃhena mahāmahopādhyāyamanīṣiratneśvareṇa viracayya prakāśite darpaṇākhye sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇavivaraṇe'rthālaṃkārastṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ
yāsūbhayālaṃkriyāsu ivādibhyaḥ śabdebhyo viśiṣṭa upamādirūpo'rtho jñāyate tā ubhayālaṃkriyāḥ syuḥ
artayorūpamānopameyayormitho yo bhūyasā pracurāṇāmavayavasāmānyānāmekadeśasādharmyāṇāṃ yogaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, sā iha granthe [śāstre] upamā matā
tarhi mukhaṃ kamalamivetivat kumudamivetyapi syādata āha—prasiddheriti
tathā ca kumudamukhayorupamā na lokaprasiddheti doṣaḥ
evaṃ bisakisalaye iva komale śailaśileva viśāleti
he sundari, eva mukhaṃ candravatsundaram, tava bhujālatike bisakisalayakomale mṛṇālapallavavatkomale, tava jaghanasthalī śailapāṣāṇavaddīrghā ceti pūrvāpekṣayā, vākyasamāptau vā
‘candasarisaṃ muhaṃ se amaasariccho a muharaso tissā

atra candreṇa sadṛśaṃ candrasadṛśaṃ mukham, amṛtena sadṛkṣo'mṛtasadṛkṣo mukharasa iti samāse sundaramadhurādisāmānyaśabdaprayogo na śrūyate pratīyate ca, sadṛśāderdyotakāditi sāmānyadharmasya saundaryamādhuryāderupamāna-prasiddhasyopameye samāsenaiva pratipāditatvādiyamantarbhūtasāmānyā nāma samāsopamāsu padopamābhaktiḥ
kacagrahe keśapāśagrahaṇe yo rabhasa āveśastena sahitamujjvalaṃ manojñaṃ cumbanam
kahaṃ ṇu ṇavacampaaṅgī muṇālabāhū piā tavai || 3 ||’
kathaṃ nu navacampakāṅgī mṛṇālabāhuḥ priyā tapati ||]

atra kamalamiva tāmrau, rambhe iva pīvarau, kuvalayamiva, śyāme, mṛgāṅka iva prekṣaṇīyaṃ, navacampakamiva gauram, mṛṇālamiva komalau karau, ūrū, nayane, vadanam, aṅgam, bāhū yasyāḥ sā tathoktetyanyapadārthena samāsenaiva dyotakasāmānyayoruktatvādiyamantarbhūteva sāmānyā nāma samāsopamāsu padopamābhāktiḥ
kathaṃ nu navacampakāṅgī mṛṇālabāhuḥ priyā dahati
īdṛśī kāntā kathaṃ nu (na) dahati tāpayati kiṃtu tāpayatyeva
iha kamalamiva tāmrau karau yasyāḥ setyādāvivaśabdo dyotakaḥ sāmānyaṃ tāmratvādikaṃ tayośca samāsenaivoktatayāntarbhūtobhayārtheyam
atropamānopameyadharmāṇāmindusundarādipadairivārthasya samāsenaivābhidhānam, sarvaṃ samāse'syāmiti sarvasamāsopamānāmeyaṃ samāsopamāsu padopamābhaktiḥ
īdṛśī sā strī mama manaḥ kathamaniśaṃ dahati
śaradinduriva sundaraṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā itīvārthasyāpi samāsābhidheyatā
sarvaḥ samāso yasyāmityādivigrahe vivakṣitārthālābha ityata āha—sarvamiti
79’ ityanena yadopamāne upapade dhvāṅkṣa iva virautīti sāmānādhikaraṇyena kartaryeva pratyayastadopameyasyārthe bha-vati
yadi tvaṃ vadasi tadā haṃso dhvāṅkṣavirāvī kāka iva virauti, kokila uṣṭrakrośī uṣṭra iva kruśyati śabdāyate, mayūraḥ kharanādī gardabha iva nadati
79’ iti ṇinipratyayaḥ upamāna upapade kartari vihita upameyasyārthe bhavati sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt

atra pūrṇenduriva pūrṇendurityādikayopacāravṛttyā yadyapi pūrṇenduprabhṛtaya upamānaśabdā apyupameyeṣu vadanādiṣu vartante, tebhyaśca yadyapi svārtha eva svārthikāḥ kalpabādayo bhavanti, tathāpi te śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādguṇabhūtamupamānārthamātraṃ bruvate yathā śuklādibhyastarabādayaḥ
tathā hyayaṃ caṃ śuklo'yamanayoḥ śuklatara ityukte śauklyasyaiva prakarṣo gamyate na śauklyavataḥ
iha pūrṇendvādaya upacāreṇopameyavṛttayastatsamabhivyāptakalpabādinā svārthikapratyayena copamānārthātiśaya evābhidhīyata iti pratyayasyopamānārthatā
atropamānādācārādibhiḥ sūryādibhyaḥ kyajādaya ācāralakṣaṇakriyāviśeṣa utpadyamānā upamānopameyayoḥ sāmānya evotpadyanta iti seyaṃ sāmānyārthapratyayānāma pratyayopamāsu padopamābhaktiḥ
‘eka eva hi bhūtātmā bhūte bhūte vyavasthitaḥ
115’ ityanena candraśabdāccandreṇa tulyaṃ dṛśyata itīvārtha eva pratyayo na tu tulyakriyārthaḥ anyathā dṛśyata iti ivārtha iva tulyakriyāprayogo'pi na syāt
tadaprayoge'pi ca gauriva gavaya ityādau vatiḥ prasajyeta
priyāviyoge mṛtasya punaḥ svargo'pi narakīyati naraka ivācarati
eka eva bhūtātmā paramātmā pratidehamavasthitaḥ san ekadhā bahudhā caikānekaprakāreṇa jalacandravaddṛśyate
iha jalacandravaddṛśyata ityatrevārthe sādṛśye vatirna tu tulyaḥ kriyate tadā dṛśyata iti padena vatinā ca samarthatayā paunaruttkyaṃ syāt
na bhavatu tulyakriyāprayogaḥ, tataḥ kimaniṣṭamata āha—taditi
gauriva gavaya ityādau kriyāyā aprayogāttulyakriyāprayogābhāva iti bhāvaḥ
vākyopamā tu yā tatra dvaividhyaṃ sāpi gacchati
ādyā pūrṇā ca luptā ca luptavarṇā tathaiva ca
atra kamalamṛṇālālimālādīnāmupamānadyotakatulyadharmopameyavācakānāṃ caturṇāmapi padānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak prayoge padārthayoḥ sādṛśyasyābhidhīyamānatvādiyaṃ pūrṇānāma padārthopamāsu vākyopamābhāktiḥ
he madirekṣaṇe raktanetre, tava vadanaṃ padmamiva cāru

iha kamalamupamānam, ivapadaṃ dyotakam, cārupadaṃ tulyadharmopasthāpakam, vadanamupameyamiti pūrṇatā, padārthayoḥ sādṛśyaṃ vākyārthaḥ, sāmānyadharmādīnāṃ virahe lope luptā tarhi sarvalope upamaiva na syādata āha—pratīyamāna iti
‘na padmaṃ mukhamevedaṃ na bhṛṅgau cakṣuṣī ime
idaṃ na padmaṃ kiṃtu kāntāyā mukhameva
na kesarāṇi kiṃtu imāstāḥ prasiddhā dantapaṅktaya eva
padmamidaṃ kāntāsyamiti mithyājñānaṃ tasya pratyākhyānaṃ niṣedho na padmamiti
atra sāmānyadharme lupte pratīyamānasādṛśyatvena padārthayorupamānopameyabhāvasya paripūrṇatve luptapūrṇānāmeyaṃ padārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
he priye, tava mukhaṃ padmamiva, netre nīlanaline iva, ūrū kadalīstambhāviva, stanau hastikumbhāviva staḥ
iha sāmānyadharmasya kāntyāderlopaḥ, itareṣāṃ pūrṇateti luptapūrṇā
dyotakasya tu lope yā pūrṇalupteti sā smṛtā || 17

atra tantreṇa sadṛśayoranabhidhānātsādṛśyasya punarupamānopameyabhāvavivakṣitena śleṣato'nyatve satītaretarayogenopamānopameyayorekaśeṣeṇa ca tadviśeṣaṇayoḥ samudāyenābhidhānādivādimantareṇāpyupamānādīnāṃ caturṇāmapi pūrṇatve satyuktārthatvādivādirlupyata iti pūrṇaluptānāmeyaṃ padārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
yadvā tantreṇa ekārthaprayojakeneha sadṛśayormukhapadmayoḥ pradhānāṅgabhāvenābhidhānaṃ tulyatā ca padārthaḥ
yatra samakakṣatayā dvayorabhidhānaṃ tatra śleṣa evetyativyāptirata āha—śleṣata iti

atra himavatpāṇḍyayornirjharahārayorbālātapaharicandanayośca parasparamupamānopameyavivakṣāyāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaparikalpanena vākyārthayordvayorapi kalpitatvādekenaivevaśabdena tayoḥ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvo'bhihitaḥ itīyamekevaśabdānāma vākyārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
aṃse skandhe'rpito datto lambahāro yena saḥ
haricandanena candanamedena kṛtāṅgānulepanaśca, abhinavakiraṇalohitaśṛṅgaḥ pravahannirjharaśca himavānivābhāti
‘dine dine sā parivardhamānā labdhodayā cāndramasīva lekhā
atra kriyāpadasya vākyārthadvayaikatāpattihetoḥ sakarmakatvātkartuḥ karmaṇaścopamānāt pṛthagivaśabdaprayoga iti seyamabhi dhīyamānasādṛśyā anekevaśabdānāma vākyārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
sā gaurī dine dine pratyahaṃ parivardhamānā satī lāvaṇyamayānkāntipradhānān viśeṣānutkarṣān pupoṣa puṣṇāti sma
labdhaḥ prāpta udaya upacayo yayā sā
yathā cāndrī lekhā kalā prāptodgamā pratyahaṃ vardhamānā ca satī kalāntarāṇi anyānyā kalā dhatte jyotsnāntarāṇi ca dhatte tathetyarthaḥ
iha poṣaṇarūpakriyayā vākyārthayorekavākyatā, sā ca sakarmaketi kartṛkarmaṇoḥ pṛthagivapadaprayogādanekevopameyam

atra pulomārivarṇanīyayordyāvābhūmyorasurāṇāmavaliptapārthivānāṃ ca tulyakriyāsamāveśādivādimantareṇāpi vākyārthānāṃ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvo'vagamyata itīyamanivādiśabdānāma vākyārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
bhavān bhūme rakṣāyai pulomāririndro divaḥ svargasya rakṣāyai jāgarti
pulomanāmā daityabhedaḥ sa cendreṇa hatastatsutā pulomajendrāṇī ca gṛhīteti purāṇam
iha tulyā samaikakriyā jāgaraṇarūpā hananarūpā ca tavddayaghaṭita evopamānopameyabhāvaḥ

atra satyupamāne satyupameye satyapi cevaśabde mahaujasāṃ malimlucānāṃ ca yo'yaṃ chalāpakaraṇaṃ nāma vastudharmaḥ sa upamāna eva nakāreṇa niyamyata iti vaidharmyavatīnāmeyaṃ vākyārthopamāsu vākyopamābhaktiḥ
ayaṃ vividha ucyatāsadṛśopamaviśeṣaguṇe(?) ihānyarūpaiḥ sāmye'pi vācyadharma upamāna eva niṣedhena niyamita iti vaidharmyam
vākyārthe vacanabhaṅgyā yatra vākyārthayorvistareṇa sādṛśyaṃ jñāyate sā prapañcopamā
sā tu prakṛtarūpā syādrūpeṇa vikṛtā tathā
tayoḥ prakṛtarūpā sā vijñeyā ca caturvidhā || 20
bhānti latā lalanā iva pāṇibhiriva kisalayairadhikam || 17 ||’

atra vasantalakṣmīpariṣkṛtalatānāṃ lalanānāṃ ca pratīyamānasādṛśyānāmupamānopameyabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ yeyamalivalayādibhiralakādīnāṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyānāmeva pṛthakpṛthagivaśabdaprayogavatīti vistareṇāvayavino'vayavānāṃ ceti sāmastyena vākyārthayoraupamyoktibhaṅgiḥ
latā vasante lalanā iva striya ivādhikaṃ śobhante
alakairiva bhṛṅgavṛndaiḥ, puṣpagucchaiḥ kucairiva, pallavaiḥ pāṇibhiriva

atra nalinīnāṃ vilāsinīnāṃ ca parasparamupamānopameyabhāve vaktavye vilāsinīlakṣaṇamupamānārtham, evamavayavāntarāṇi ca yāni stanādyupameyāni, tāni parityajya kamalamevaikaṃ tadavayavairdalādibhiḥ sahādharādibhirupamānaiḥ pṛthakpṛthagivaprayogādvistareṇopamitam
adharairiva padmapattraiḥ, dantairiva kiṃjalkaiḥ, alakairiva bhṛṅgasaṃghaiḥ, mukhairiva padmaiḥ
iha vistaropamayā prapañcopamā, haṃsastanādityāgātkamaladalādinā sahādharāderekadeśasyopamayā caikadeśopameyam
kittivva pavaṇataṇaaṃ āṇavva balāiṃ se vilaggai diṭṭhī || 19 ||’
atra rāmadṛṣṭerlakṣmaṇamukhādiviniveśinyāḥ śobhādyupamānamālayā pratīyamānasādṛśyayā vistareṇopamitermālopamā nāmeyaṃ prakṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ

haripateḥ sugrīvasya vistīrṇamuraḥ sā vilagati vanamāleva pauruṣādhyavasāyanimittam, samastavakṣaḥsthalavilokanāddhavalaśyāmalayā dṛṣṭyā vanamāleva pramāṇāvasare prabhuṇā sugrīvāya prasādīkṛteti bhāvaḥ
pavanatanayaṃ hanūmantaṃ vilagati kīrtiriva, tasya jñātapauruṣasya vikasitayā dhavalitagaganayā dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ
balāni vilagati ājñeva, tadanantaramevātibalānāṃ teṣāṃ gamanodyogāt
iha rāmadṛṣṭeḥ śobhādyupamānamālayā sūtreṇa grathanameva, vistareṇopamitermālopameyam
na ceyaṃ bahūpamā; ekasya dharmasya bahubhiranupasthitatvāt
kāntāyate sparśasukhena vāri vārīyate svacchatayā vihāyaḥ || 20 ||’

atra candrādīnāṃ śauklyādibhirabhidhīyamānasādṛśyairhaṃsādibhiryeyaṃ rasanānyāyena paścādvalanayā vistaravatī hetumatī ca pratyayopamāpaṅktistathehaikavākyatākaraṇena śaradramaṇīyatoyavarṇanamiti seyaṃ rasanopamā nāma prakṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ
atha haṃsaḥ śvetadīptyā candrāyate candra ivācarati
iha paścādvalanā pūrvāpekṣatayā kṣudraghaṇṭikākramaḥ prapañcavattvaṃ rucetyādihetumattvaṃ pratītyupamābāhulyaṃ ca sphuṭameva
‘yattvannetrasamānakānti salile magnaṃ tadindīvaraṃ meghairantaritaḥ priye tava mukhacchāyānukārī śaśī
ye'pi tvadgamanānusārigatayaste rājahaṃsā gatā- stvatsādṛśyavinodamātramapi me daivena na kṣamyate || 21 ||’

atra netrādīnāmupameyatvamindīvarādīnāmupamānatvamiti prasiddhau yeyamatyanurāgānnetrādiṣvādhikyabuddhirnātyanurāgādindīvarādiṣu tadanukāribuddhistayeha rāmeṇa virahiṇābhidhīyamānasādṛśyānāmamīṣāṃ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvaḥ prasiddherviparyāsena kalpita iti seyaṃ viparyāsopamā nāma vikṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ
he priye, mama tvatsādṛśyaharṣamātramapi na daivena kṣamyate
nilīnāṃ nalinīkhaṇḍe kathaṃ nu tvāṃ labhemahi || 22 ||’
atrāpyatyantasādṛśyādekasminpakṣe prasiddherviparyāsa iti seyaṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyobhayopamā nāma vikṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ
he priye, tvāṃ kathaṃ nu labhemahi
mukhenāpi na lābha ityāha—tava mukhamiva padmam padmamiva mukham
atropamānārthamutpādyopameyena pratīyamānamabhidhīyamānaṃ ca sādṛśyamabhihitamiti seyamutpādyopamānāma vikṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ

atra tvamevedṛśī nānyā tvatsadṛśītyananvaye sati upamānopameyabhāvavivakṣayaikasyāpi vastuno bhedamupakalpya pratīyamānasādṛśyamaupamyenābhihitamiti seyamananvayopamānāma vikṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ
yadopamānapadānāṃ padmādīnāmupameyeṣu mukhādiṣu vṛttirbodhakatā bhave-ttadā rūpakam
evaṃ ca yatropamānopameyapadābhyāmabhedo guṇādipuraskāreṇa bodhyate tatra rūpakaṃ, yatra sādṛśyamātraṃ tatropameti tayorbhedaḥ
tatra śabdabhūyiṣṭhaṃ prakṛtavikṛtabhedāddvidhya, arthabhūyiṣṭhamaṅgipradhānāṅgapradhānabhedāddvidhā, ubhayabhūyiṣṭhamapi śuddhasaṃkīrṇabhedāddvidheti vibhāgaḥ

56’ iti samāse padmānīva padmāni candrā iva candrā ityabhedopacāreṇotpannasādṛśyātpāṇīnāṃ nakhānāṃ ca padmacandrādibhirabhidhāne sāmānyevādiśabdāprayogādupamānārthastirobhūta iti so'yaṃ gauṇaśabdavyapāśrayaḥ samāsahetukaḥ samastarūpaṃ nāma prakṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
tvatpādanakhacandrāṇāmarciṣastejāṃsi bhūpānāṃ karakamalāni saṃkocayituṃ nimīlayitumīśate samarthā bhavanti
pāṇiḥ padmamiva nakhaścandra ivetyatra ‘upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge 2
tirobhūtatvaṃ ca paramārthataḥ sannapi bhedo na bhāsata iti, tattu samāsenaiva kṛtam, ata eva śabdaprācuryācchabdabhūyiṣṭhatā

atrāpi pūrvavatpallavakusumalatāvasantaśrīśabdānāṃ guṇavṛttyāśrayeṇāṅgulīnakhārcirbāhuvarṇanīyanāmikābhiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyātsāmānyevādiśabdāprayogācca tirobhūte'pyupamānārthe samāso na kṛta ityasamastarūpaṃ nāma prakṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyeṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
he sundari, tvaṃ no'smākaṃ pratyakṣacāriṇī dṛṣṭiviṣayā pādavihāriṇī vā vasantasya śrīrasi

atra mukhendoḥ smitameva jyotsnā, kucakumbhayoḥ prabhaivāmbu, dorlatayoḥ pallavabhūte pāṇau nakhārciṣa eva puṣpamiti samastānāmasamastānāṃ ca gauṇaśabdānāmupamātiraskāreṇa darśitatvādidaṃ samastavyastarūpaṃ nāma prakṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
he sakhi, tava mukhendau smitamīṣaddhāso jyotsnāsti

atra yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo yo haripādo yaśca harihatāsurebhyo niḥśaṅkānāṃ surāṇāmānandotsave dhvajastayoḥ saviśeṣaṇayoreva pratīyamānasādṛśyayoḥ parasparamupamānopameyabhāva iti saviśeṣaṇaṃ nāma prakṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ

śirasi agraṃ lagnaṃ balivañcane trivikramadaśāyāṃ brahmāṇḍāptau brahmaṇā pādyārthamāvarjitaṃ yajjahnukanyāyā gaṅgāyā jalaṃ tadevāṃśukaṃ vastramiva yatra tādṛśo harervāmanarūpasya pādo balivijayādasurebhyo niḥśaṅkānāṃ devānāṃ harṣotsave dhvaja eva jayati
ata eva jāhnavījalamaṃśukatvena rūpitam, tena vinā dhvajānupapatteḥ ‘śiro'gre mastake'pi ca’ iti medinīkāraḥ
kaha kaha vi dāsarahiṇo jaakesaripañjaro gao ghaṇasamao 29’

atra dāśarathisaṃbandhino vyavasāyasya raviṇā, roṣasya gajendreṇa, jayasya kesariṇā sahopamānopameyabhāvakalpanayā yadekaṃ rūpaṇamathaitatsaṃbandhitayā pradoṣaśṛṅkhalāpratibandhapañjarāṇāṃ dvitīyaṃ tatra trayāṇāmapi ghanasamayena tṛtīyaṃ tenedaṃ rūpakaṃ paramparānāma vikṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
’ atra dāśarathe rāmasya kathaṃ kathamapi kaṣṭasṛṣṭyā ghanasamayo varṣarturatītaḥ
vyavasāyaḥ kāryodyogaḥ sa eva ravistejomayatvāttasya pradoṣo'stagamanakālaḥ
doṣa eva gajendro durnivāratvāttasya dṛḍhaśṛṅkhalāpratibandhaḥ pratibandhakatvāt
jaya eva kesarī tasya pañjaro gṛhabhedo niyāmakatvāt

atra kisalayakaraiḥ, karakamalaiḥ, kamalamukhaiḥ, mukhendubhiriti raśanākrameṇa śabdānāṃ saṃdarbha upalabhyamānastadarthānāṃ manobhuvo jagadvijaye latādisaṃbandhātkaraṇabhāvamanumāpayatīti raśanānāmaitadvikṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
iha raśanā kṣudraghaṇṭikā tasyāḥ kramaḥ paścādvalanayaikaikaprathanā śabdagatā pratīyata iti raśanārūpakamidam
‘svāmī durnayavāraṇavyatikare śauryopadeśe guru- rvisrambhe hṛdayaṃ niyogasamaye dāso bhaye cāśrayaḥ
dātā saptasamudrasīmaraśanādāmāṅkitāyāḥ kṣiteḥ sarvākāramaho svayaṃvarasuhṛtko vā na karṇo mama || 31 ||’
atra svāmyādīnāṃ mālopamādikrameṇa nirūpitatvānmālārūpakaṃ nāma vikṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
ko vā na, api tu sarva eva
tadevāha—durnayasya vāraṇe nivāraṇe vyatikara āsaṅgastatra svāmī prabhuḥ
aho āścaryaṃ sarvākāraṃ yathā syādevaṃ svayaṃvarasuhṛt sahajamitraṃ ca, nirupadhitvaṃ svayaṃvaraśabdārthaḥ
atra mukhameva paṅkajaṃ tadeva raṅgaḥ, bhrūreva latā saiva nartakī, līlaiva nāṭyaṃ tadevāmṛtamiti rūpitānāmapi rūpaṇena samāsena rūpakarūpakaṃ nāmāyaṃ vikṛtarūpakeṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
he sakhi, tava bhrūlatāsminmukhapadmaraṅge nartakī yūnāṃ dṛṣṭau netre līlānāṭyāmṛtaṃ niṣiñcati
iha mukhaṃ paṅkajena rūpayitvā raṅgatvena rūpitam, evaṃ bhruvau latātvena rūpayitvā nartakītvena rūpite
samastaṃ cāsamastaṃ ca yuktaṃ cāyuktameva ca

atra samastopamāyāmiva pādākhyaḥ paṅkajākhyaścāvayavī parasparamupamānopameyabhūtaḥ pratīyamānābhidhīyamānasādṛśyairaṅguliśreṇinakhadīdhitibhirdalaśreṇikesaraiśca saha sāmastyena rūpitastadyogyasthānavinyāsena cārthasya prādhānyamabhihitamiti samastaṃ nāma rūpakamidamaṅgipradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
na caitadvācyam—'pāṇipadmāni bhūpānā'mityāderudāharaṇādidaṃ na bhidyata iti
tatra hi nakhārciṣāṃ kriyāsamāveśena prādhānyamavagamyate, na nakhacandrāṇāṃ tataśca na rūpakam
pāṇipadmetyasya tu yadyapi saṃkocakriyāyāmasti samāveśastathāpi na tāni varṇanīyatvenopanyastāni, api tu jigīṣubhāvavarṇanāṅgatayā
ataḥ samāveśamātrabhaṇanānna tatra pāṇipadmānāṃ nāpi nakhacandrāṇāmarthaprādhānyamapi tu śabdaprādhānyameva
iha tu caraṇapaṅkajatāmrāṅgulidalaśreṇyādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya bhūpālamauliviniveśanena prādhānyaṃ pratīyata ityubhayamapi niravadyam
yathā samastopamāyāmavayavinoḥ sāmastyenopamā, tathātrāpyavayavinoreva prādhānyena sāmastyena rūpakamityarthaḥ
tatrārciṣāṃ prādhānyaṃ sākṣātkriyānvayāt, samarthānāmavayavinoreva prādhānyamato'nayorbheda ityāśayaḥ
tarhyarciṣāmeva rūpakatvamastu, tathāpi sa doṣastadavastha evetyata āha—tāśceti
prakṛte tu caraṇāderavayavinaḥ pradhānakriyānvaya ityarthaprādhānyamiti bhedaḥ
atrāpi ca sphuritādharapallavamiti viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya mukhyavastunaḥ gharmāmbhaḥkaṇamañjarīdhāraṇakriyāsamāveśaḥ prādhānyaṃ sthāpayati
he caṇḍi kopane, tava sphuritādharapallavaṃ mukhaṃ kartṛ, akasmādeva kāraṇaṃ vinaiva mauktikacchāyā gharmāmbukaṇamañjarīrdhatte bibharti
atra smitapuṣpojjvalaṃ lolanetrabhṛṅga surabhiśvasitānilaṃ te mukhaṃ na kasya nandanamiti puṣpabhṛṅgādīnāṃ parasparaṃ yuktyupapatteryuktaṃ nāmāyamaṅgāṅgipradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭho rūpakabhedaḥ

atra yadyapi nandanamiva nandana-miti gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayaḥ śabda eva samastaviśeṣaṇaiḥ pariṣkriyate tathāpi nandayatīti nandanamiti kṛdabhihitakriyāsamāveśe mukhākhyasyaiva vastunaḥ prādhānyamavagamyate tasya tvapahriyata ityarthapradhānamevaitat
he subhru, tavedaṃ mukhaṃ kasya na nandanaṃ harṣajanakamapi tu sarvasyaiva
tathā hi puṣpabhramarayoryuktiryogaḥ puṣpaiḥ saha bhramarāṇāṃ makarandapānakṛtaḥ saṃbandhaḥ
ata evopapadyate puṣpabhramarayorekatrāvasthānam, na hi puṣpāṇi bhramarairvinā śobhanta iti yuktarūpakatetyāśayavānāha—parasparamiti
nandanamiva nandanamiti śabdaprādhānye'pi nandayatīti nandanamiti kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśata iti vacanādanyaprādhānyameva vivakṣitamiti śaṅkottarābhyām
atra jyotsnotpalayorayogājjagannetrendośca mukhasya saṃtāpakāraṇamidamayuktaṃ nāmāṅgipradhānarūpakabhedeṣvartha bhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
atrāpi pūrvavanmuravākhyavastuno viśeṣaṇaiḥ pariṣkaraṇamiti tasyaiva prādhānyamavagamyate
he kānte, tavedaṃ mukhaṃ jagannetrāṇāmindurasmākaṃ tāpāya kathaṃ kalpate śakto bhavati
ārdrasmitaṃ saraseṣaddhāsa eva jyotsnā yatra tat
iha jyotsnāyā utpalasya ca sahānavasthānaṃ tacca mitho'nupakāryopakārakabhāvādityayuktarūpakatā

atrauṣṭhādīnāṃ dalādīnāṃ ca mukhāmbhojāvayavānāṃ sphuritavigalitotkhaṇḍitasphuṭaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭānāṃ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvarūpitānāṃ mukhapakṣe kamalapakṣe ca sahajatvaṃ gamyata iti sahajāvayavo nāmāyamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
tatra hi bhūpālamaulidhāraṇakriyāsamāveśenāvayavinaḥ prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam, iha tu patanakriyāyāmavayavānāmata eva te sphuritādiviśeṣaṇairviśiṣyante
iha mukhasyauṣṭhādīni padmasya patrādīnyavayavāste ca sahajā iti tatprādhānyādidaṃ sahajāvayavarūpakam
na ca tāmrāṅgulītyanenāvayavipradhānenāsyābheda iti vācyam, tatrāṅgiprādhānyasya vivākṣitatvādihāṅgaprādhānyasya tattvādityāha—na ceti

atra kumbhakarṇaprativacanamamarṣo'śukamiti daśānanapakṣe daṇḍo ghora-viṣaṃ nirmoka iti bhujagapakṣe ye'vayavāsteṣāmāhāryatvādidamāhāryāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
’ tato'nantaraṃ daśānana eva bhujagaḥ sarpaḥ so'tibhayānako jātaḥ
kumbhakarṇaprativacanameva daṇḍastena parighaṭṭita utthāpito'marṣa eva ghoraviṣaṃ yasya saḥ
galitaścyutoṃśukaṃ vasrameva nirmokaḥ kañcuko yasya saḥ
‘yasyā bījamahaṃkṛtirgurutaro mūlaṃ mametigraho nityatvasmṛtiraṅkuraḥ sutasuhṛdbhṛtyādayaḥ pallavāḥ
skandho dāraparigrahaḥ paribhavaḥ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ durgatiḥ sā me tvaccaraṇārhaṇāparaśunā tṛṣṇālatā lūyatām || 39 ||’

atra bījaṃ mūlamaṅkuraḥ puṣpaṃ phalamiti latāpakṣe sahajāḥ, tṛṣṇāpakṣe punarahaṃkṛtyādaya āhāryāvayavā iti tadidaṃ sahajāhāryāṇāmavayavānāṃ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvarūpaṇenobhayāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamidamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ

atrāpi cāhaṃkāramamatādhrauvyasmaraṇasutādidāraparigrahaparābhavadurgatīnāmavayavānāmeva bījādirūpeṇa rūpitānāṃ bhagavadārādhanakuṭhāreṇa tṛṣṇālatā lūyatāmiti prārthanakriyayā samāveśena prādhānyamavagamyate
sā mama tṛṣṇaiva latā he kṛṣṇa, tvatpādapūjāparaśunā lūyatāṃ chidyatām, tvaccaraṇārhaṇaiva paraśuḥ kuṭhāraḥ

yasyāstṛṣṇālatāyā ahaṃkṛtirahaṃkāra eva bījamādikāraṇam, gurutaro mametigraho mamatvaniścayo mūlam, nityamidamiti smṛtiraṅkuraḥ, putramitrabhṛtyādayaḥ kisalayāḥ, dārāṇāṃ patnīnāṃ parigraho'nurāgaḥ skandhaḥ, paribhavaḥ parābhavaḥ kusumam, durgatirnarakaḥ phalam
iha bījādīnāṃ sahajāvayavatā, ahaṃkṛtyādīnāmāhāryāvayavatā, teṣāmeva ca prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitamityubhayāvayavapradhānamidam
atrendunā mukhāvayavī rūpitaḥ, bhruvau ca tadavayavau latāvayavibhyām, madaraktau tu kapolau na kenāpīti sarvato veṣamyādviṣamāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamidamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
atrāpi madaraktanartitayoḥ kapolabhruvoreva manmathasya jagatritayamardanakriyāyāṃ prādhānyaṃ sādhakatamatvamavagamyate
he priye, tvanmukhendunā manmatho bhuvanatrayaṃ mardituṃ jetumalaṃ samartho'sti
iha mukhamavayavi candratvena rūpitam, bhruvau cāvayavau latātvena, gaṇḍastu na kenāpīti vaiṣamyam, prādhānyaṃ cāvayavānāmeveti viṣamāvayavarūpakatā

atra samudratvena rūpitaṃ gaganamādhāraṃ parikalpya rajanīmeghatārakau-ghānāṃ velāśuktimuktāphalaprakarāṇāṃ ca pratīyamānābhidhīyamānasādṛśyānāṃ śabdaprādhānyato'rthaprādhānyataśca rūpakaṃ kṛtamityādhāravannāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣu śabdārthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
iha gaganameva samudrastatra tārā eva suktāstāsāṃ prakaraḥ samūhaḥ śobhate
sphuṭavighaṭitā vyaktībhūya vidīrṇā meghā eva śuktisaṃpuṭāstairvimuktaśca
iha sādṛśye rajanyādīnāṃ pratīyamānatā velādīnāmabhidhīyamānatā, śuddharūpakatā upamādyasaṃbhedāt

atra dhūmotpīḍānāṃ vanarājikeśahastatvena kusumāyudhasurabhisaṃcaracdvvajapaṭatvena śaśikaramuhūrtameghatvena ca tamaḥpratihastatvena ca rūpitānāṃ nirādhārāṇāmeva śabdaprādhānyamarthaprādhānyaṃ cāvadhāryata iti nirādhāraṃ nāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣu śabdārthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
vanarājyā vanapaṅkteḥ keśahastāḥ keśakalāpā eva, ‘pāśaḥ pakṣaśca hastaśca kalāpārthāḥ kacātpare
kusumāyudhasya kāmasya sugandhi caladdhvajapaṭā eva candrakiraṇānāṃ muhūrtameghā eva tamasāmandhakārāṇāṃ pratihastāḥ pratinidhayaḥ

atrāvayavina eva kevalasya vadanaṃ paṅkajamiveti rūpaṇādasya śabdaprādhānyaṃ vellitabhruprabhṛtiviśeṣaṇopādānāccārthaprādhānyameva lakṣyate tena kevalaṃ nāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣūbhayabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
tavedaṃ vadanapaṅkajaṃ kartṛ madāvasthāṃ madyapānajāṃ daśāṃ vivṛṇoti prakāśayati
‘anāghrātaṃ puṣpaṃ kisalayamalūnaṃ kararuhai- ranāviddhaṃ ratnaṃ madhu navamanāsvāditarasam
akhaṇḍaṃ puṇyānāṃ phalamiva ca tadrūpamanaghaṃ na jāne bhoktāraṃ kamiha samupasthāsyati vidhiḥ || 44 ||’

atra puṣpakisalayaratnamadhupuṇyaphalānāmanāghrātamityādiviśeṣaṇāpāditavyatirekāṇāṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyena śakuntalārūpeṇa rūpaṇādarthataḥ śabdataśca prādhānyamavadhāryata iti vyatirekavannāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣūbhayabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
anaghamanavadyaṃ tasyā rūpamiha bhuvi kaṃ bhoktāraṃ samupasthitaṃ kariṣyati tadahaṃ na jāne
anāmuktamaparihitam, anāsvāditarasamagṛhītāsvādaṃ nūtanaṃ madhu,puṇyānāṃ cākhaṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ phalamapi
atra pitāmahotpattipaṅkajamiva nabhastalaṃ śobhata ityupamānopameyabhāvenāvayavāvayavinorabhedasyāvivakṣāyāmupamaiva na rūpakam

ravikaradhavalābhradalasahasrayoḥ kesaranikaradalasahasrayośca pratīyamānābhidhīyamānasādṛśyayośca sahajāhāryāvayavabhūtayorabhedopacāreṇa rūpaṇamiti sāvayavarūpeṇopamāyāḥ saṃkīrṇatvādidaṃ sāvayavasaṃkīrṇaṃ nāma saṃkīrṇarūpakeṣūbhayabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
iha nabhastalaṃ śobhate pitāmahasya brahmaṇa utpattipadmamiva tasya padmayonitvāt
ravikarāḥ sūryakiraṇā eva kesaranikarā yatra tat
dhavalābhrāṇi śvetameghā eva dalasahasrāṇi taiḥ parigatamanvitam
madhumathasya viṣṇordarśanayogyam, śaradi tasya jāgaraṇādasya ca ramyatvāt, padmapakṣe'pi nābhikamalatayā madhuripudarśanayogyatā
yadvā madhumathasya bhṛṅgasya daṃśanaṃ kavalanaṃ tadyogyam
atra ravikaradhavalābhrasahasrayoḥ sahajāhāryāvayavayoḥ kesaranivahatvena dalasahasratvena ca rūpaṇāt paṅkajanabhastalayoravayavinorupamānopameyatvācca sāvayavasaṃkīrṇarūpakamidam
