atra divasāvayavino bhujaṅgāvayavinaścābhidhīyamānapratīyamānadairdhya-dāruṇādidharmayorabhedopacāreṇa rūpaṇamavayavānāṃ caturṇāṃ ravibimbātapaphaṃṇāmaṇinirmokāṇāṃ satyāmapyabhedopacārayogyatāyāṃ dvayorivaśabdaprayogenopamāyāṃ dvayostulyarūpaṇe'pyasāmānādhikaraṇyānnāvayavāvayavibhāvo vibhāvyata iti niravayavasyopamāyāṃ saṃkīrṇatvānniravayavasaṃkīrṇaṃ nāma saṃkīrṇarūpakeṣūbhayabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
iha divasa eva bhujaṅgaḥ sarpo'parasamudraṃ paścimasamudraṃ gata iva
sūryabimbameva phaṇāmaṇiprabhāṃ vikāsayan ātapasamūhaṃ kañcukamiva tyajan
atrāsāmānādhikaraṇyenāvayavāvayavibhāvo na jñāyate, ivaprayogeṇa copamā jñāyata iti niravayavasaṃkīrṇarūpakamidam

atra pādaparūpeṇa rūpitasya nabhaso yadetaddiśāṃ śākhārūpeṇa rūpaṇaṃ meghānāṃ ca madhukaraprakareṇa tadubhayamapyanyapadārthaṣaṣṭhīsamāsayorabhidhīyamānena sāvayavaṃ niravayavaṃ cetyutprekṣayā ca saṃkīryamāṇamubhayasaṃkīrṇarūpakavyapadeśaṃ labhate
iha diśo nijasthānaṃ svakīyasthānaṃ pratigatā iva
dhutā meghā eva madhukarā bhramarā yāsu tāḥ
ghanasamayena varṣākālena ghanāvaraṇādākṛṣṭāḥ saṃnihitīkṛtā avanatā bhūmilagnāḥ paścādvimuktāstyaktāḥ
nabhaḥpādapapade ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastābhyāṃ sāvayavatvaṃ niravayavatvaṃ ca yathākramamuktam
kīdṛśyaḥ dhutamedhaṃ(dhyaṃ) yanmadhu madyaṃ tatkare yāsāṃ tāḥ
yadvā dhutā medhā buddhiryena tādṛśaṃ madhu kare yāsāṃ tāḥ, yadvā dhutā medhā yasmādevaṃvidho madhukaro vidagdho yāsāṃ tāḥ
ghanena dṛḍhena samayena śapathena samadena puṃsā vā ākṛṣṭā āhatā avanatā vaśīkṛtāḥ
nakhasya pātaḥ kṣataṃ tadeva prasādhaḥ prasādhanaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ

atra sarasanakhapadākārasyendradhanuṣa utpannasādṛśyādabhedopacāreṇa rūpeṇa yo'yaṃ sarase nabhasi padamasyeti vyutpattyā śliṣṭarūpeṇa tadviśeṣaṇaprakāro yaśca śobhāyāḥ prathamamagryaṃ cihnaṃ saubhāgyasya ca prathamaṃ cihnaṃ pīnapayodhare meghe stane vā lagnamityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastenedaṃ śleṣeṇopadhīyata iti śleṣopahitaṃ nāma saṃkīrṇarūpakeṣūbhayabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
pravasatā gacchatā jaladasamayena varṣākālena diśāṃ vitīrṇaṃ dattam
sarase snigdhe nabhasi gagane padaṃ sthānaṃ yasya tat
diśāṃ prauḍhāṅganānāṃ sundarīṇāṃ vā pīne māṃsale payodhare stane lagnam
jalān mūrkhān dyati khaṇḍayati jalada īdṛśaḥ samaya ācāro yasya saḥ
sā kriyāyoganimittasāmyā dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmānyataḥ pūrvā yathā—
seyaṃ kriyāyoganimittasāmyā sāmānyataḥ pūrvā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
yadyapi triṣu sādṛśyamasti tathāpi prakārakṛto bheda iti bhāvaḥ
yadyapi bhedānāmānantyādasaṃkhyaṃ tatsāmyaṃ tathāpi tisra uktayaḥ prakārānugamakāstatretyarthaḥ
vastu vācyaṃ kimapyupanyasya tatsadharmaṇastena tulyaguṇasya nyasanādudāharaṇātsāmyajñānaṃ prativastūktirityarthaḥ
sthato'vasthitaḥ uccalitaḥ prasthitaḥ, āsanavānupaviṣṭaḥ, jalābhilāṣī jalecchāyutaśca
sthitām, prayātāṃ kṛtagamanām, niṣeduṣīmupaviṣṭām, jalamādadānāṃ gṛhṇantīṃ ca
loke ca chāyāyā āvarakānugamanaiyatyaṃ natvanyasyeti tāvanmātramevoddeśyamiheti na doṣaḥ
upamāyāmeka eva vākyārthaḥ, iha tu vākyārthayorbheda iti bhitrālaṃkāratā
ṭhāi ṇa ciraṃ ravimmi va vihāṇapaḍiā vi mailadā sappurise 50’
tiṣṭhati na ciraṃ ravāviva vidhānapatitāpi malinatā satpuruṣe ||]
atra jagaduddyotanakriyā pratāpaguṇayogahetusāmyamasādhāraṇaśca sūryadṛṣṭanta iti viśeṣataḥ kriyāguṇayoganimitteyaṃ pūrvā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
iha satpuruṣe malinatā ciraṃ na tiṣṭati
sakaloddyotitā vasudhā yena tasmin, samaste jīvaloke martyaloke vistīryamāṇaḥ pratāpo yasya tasmin
ravāviva yathā sūrye malinatā ciraṃ na tiṣṭhati tathetyarthaḥ
sakalojjvalīkṛtavasudhe samastajīvaloke vistīryamāṇaḥ pratāpaḥ pratapanaṃ yasya tasmin
ihāsādhāraṇyameva viśeṣaḥ, pūrvatāpi samastakriyayā prathamataḥ sāmyena
na kāraṇātsvādbibhide kumāraḥ pravartito dīpa pratīpāt 51’
atra rūpādiguṇayogajanmajanitaṃ sāmya sāmānyarūpaśca paścātpradīpadṛṣṭānta iti sāmānyato guṇayoganimitteyamuttaro nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
kumāro bālako'jaḥ, svānnijātkāraṇātpiturna bibhide na bhedaṃ jagāma
abhede hetumāha—ojasvi dīptaṃ tadrūpaṃ, saukumāryaṃ tadeva, vīryaṃ tejastadeva, naisargikaṃ svābhāvikamunnatatvamucchritatvaṃ ca
yathā dīpātpravartita utpādito dīpaḥ svātkāraṇāddīpānna bhinno bhavati
ucchāho subhaḍāṇaṃ visamakkhalio mahāṇariṇa va sotto || 52 ||’

atrāvyavacchinnaprasṛta iti kriyāyoganimittaṃ sphuritaśauryacchāya iti guṇayoganimittaṃ sphuritasūryacchāya iti dravyayoganimittaṃ ca sāmyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarūpaśca viṣamaskhalitamahānadīsrotodṛṣṭānta iti viśeṣataḥ kriyādiyoganimitteyamuttarā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
iha subhaṭānāmutsāho viṣame duṣkaro skhalitaḥ satradhikaṃ yathā syodevamuddhāvati prakāśate
avyavacchitro nirantaraḥ san prasṛtaḥ, sphuritā śūrasya subhaṭasya śauryasya vā chāyā khyātiḥ kāntirvā yatra saḥ
yathā mahānadīnāṃ srotaḥ pravāho viṣame deśe skhalitaḥ sannadhikamuddhāvati udgacchati so'pi nirantaraṃ prasṛtaḥ sphuritā sūrasya chāyā kāntiḥ pratibimbo vā yatra saḥ
‘visaveo vva pasario jaṃ jaṃ ahilei vahaladhūmuppīho
sāmalaijjai taṃ taṃ ruhiraṃ va mahoahissa viddumaveṇṭam (ḍham) 53 ||’
atra dhūmaviṣayorvidrumarudhirayośca dravyajātiyogakṛtaṃ pratīyamānaṃ śyāmalāyata iti dhūmaviṣadravyayogajanitamabhidhīyamānaṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ ca sāmyam
seyaṃ dṛṣṭāntasya pūrvamevopanyāsāddravyacātiyoganimittasāmyā sāmānyataḥ pūrvā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
iha bahaladhūmotpīḍo mahādhūmasamūho viṣavega iva prasṛto yadyadvidrumapīṭhamabhilīyate'bhilāti gṛhṇāti vā tattanmahodadhervidrumapīṭhaṃ śyāmalāyate kajjalībhavati
abhilīyata iti abhipūrvāt līṅ āśleṣe daivādikaḥ...
atra jāterdravyasya sāmānyata eva sāmyamiti sāmānyarūpatā dṛṣṭāntasya pūrvāmupanyāsātpūrvatā ca
‘saṃcāriṇī dīpaśikheva ratrau yaṃ yaṃ vyatīyāya patiṃvarā sā
narendramārgāṭṭa iva prapede vivarṇabhāvaṃ sa sa bhūmipālaḥ || 54 ||’
atra dīpaśikhādidravyayogakṛtaṃ sāmyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarūpau saṃcāriṇī dīpaśikheti ca rājamārgāṭṭa iti ca dṛṣṭāntau pūrvamevopanyastau
seyaṃ viśeṣato dravyayoganimittasāmyā pūrvā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
sā patiṃvarā indumatī yaṃ yaṃ bhūmipālaṃ vyatīyāya tatyāja sa sa bhūmipālo vivarṇabhāvaṃ vivarṇatvaṃ prapede leme
yathā rātrau saṃcariṇī dīpaśikhā yaṃ yaṃ rājamārgāṭṭaṃ vyatikrāmati sa sa rājamārgāṭṭo vaivarṇyaṃ prāpnoti tathetyarthaḥ
vyatīyāyeti vyatipūrvāt ‘iṇ gatau’ iti dhātorliṭi rūpam
atra dravyayogakṛtaṃ sāmyaṃ sāmānyarūpaśca pradīpaḥ paścātpradīpaśikhāvartirdṛṣṭāntaḥ
tvayā tyaktā snigdhā snehavatī sakhī na rājate iti priyāyāḥ sakhīṃ prati patyurvacanam
yathā pradīpaśikhayā tyaktā vartirna śobhate tathetyarthaḥ
ālekkhapaīvāṇaṃ va ṇiaaṃ paiicaḍulattaṇaṃ pi vialiam 56’

atra hatacchāyamityādīnāmantargataguṇatvena kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt kriyāguṇayoganimittaṃ nijaṃ prakṛticaṭulatvamapi vigalitamiti guṇayoganimittaṃ ca sāmyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarūpaścālekhyapradīpadṛṣṭānta iti kriyāguṇayoganimitteyaṃ viśeṣata uttarā nāma dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
‘laukikaparīkṣakāṇāṃ yasminnarthe buddhisāmyaṃ sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ’ ityarthaṃ prati tu na kaścidviśeṣaḥ
iha tatasteṣāṃ vānarāṇāmālekhyapradīpānāmiva nijakamātmīyaṃ prakṛticañcalatvamapi vigalitamapagatam
hatā chāyā pratiṣṭā kāntirvā yatra tat
pakṣe hatā chāyā ātapābhāvarūpā yatra tat
proṣito'ntargataḥ pratāpa pauruṣaṃ pratapanaṃ ca yatra tat
sādharmyaṃ samānadharmatā tasyā nimittaṃ guṇādi tayoḥ siddhirityarthaḥ
seyaṃ sāmānyena prakṛtā nāma prapañcoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
tasyāṃ gauryāṃ ca tathā tena prakāreṇa hariṇā viśaśvasuḥ viśvāsaṃ jagamuḥ
yathā sā gaurī tadīyairmṛgasaṃbandhibhirnetrairagre sakhīnāṃ locane'mimīta samīcakāra kautukāt
amimīteti ‘māṅ māne’ ṇici luṅi caṅi rūpam
santīdṛśāni diśi diśi saraḥsu nanu nīlanalināni || 58 ||’
atra tava dve locanotpale eva, sarasāṃ punarbahūni nīlotpalānītyupamānotkarṣaḥ prakṛta eva pratīyate
nanu he nāyike, locanadvayenāsaṃvāhyaṃ garva tvaṃ kiṃ vahasi
diśi diśi pratidiśaṃ saraḥsu taḍāgeṣu rhadṛśāni tvannatratulyāni nīlotpalāni santi
‘anyato naya muhūrtamānanaṃ candra eṣa sarale kalāmayaḥ
mā kadācana kapolayormalaṃ saṃkramayya samatāṃ nayiṣyati || 59 ||’
hesarale ṛjuprakṛtike, ānanaṃ mukhaṃ muhūrtamanyato'nyatra naya prāpaya
eṣa candraḥ kalāmayaḥ kadācana kapolayormalaṃ saṃkramayya melayitvā mā samatāṃ sāmyaṃ nayiṣyati prāpayiṣyati
iha candrasyopamānasya kalaṅkarūpamalasaṃbandhakṛto'pakarṣaḥ sāhajika eva jñāyate
kālaḥ kalirjagadidaṃ nakṛtajñamajñe sthitvā hariṣyati tavaiva mukhasya śobhām || 60 ||’
he āpātamātrarasike etatkṣaṇamātrarasavaśe he nāyike, sarasīruhasya padmasya bījaṃ vāpikāyāmarpayituṃ kṣeptuṃ kimicchasi
ayaṃ kālaḥ kaliyugākhyaḥ, ata evedaṃ jagannakṛtajñamamaryādam
tato he ajñe, sthitvā kālāntara idaṃ sarasīruhaṃ tavaiva mukhasya śobhāmatha ca saṃpadaṃ hariṣyati grahīṣyati
iha padmasyopamānasya mukhādupameyātkiṃcidutkarṣaḥ sāhajika eva vivakṣitaḥ
chittaṃ muhaṃ hasijjai candāvatthaṃ gaaṃ paiṇā || 61 ||’
spṛṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ hasyate candrāvasthāṃ gataṃ patyā ||]
seyamupamānopameyayoḥ sāmyāpattyā vikṛtā nāma prapañcoktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
spṛṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ hasyate candrāvasthāṃ gataṃ patyā
’ iha kayācinnāyikayā candreṇa spardhamānayā pākāsaktayā śyāmitahastena mukhe spṛṣṭe sati nāyakastanmukhasya candrasamatvaṃ sūcayannupahasatītyekāparasyai kathayati—gṛhiṇyā iti
gṛhiṇyāḥ pākakriyālagnaśyāmabhāgaśyāmitena kareṇa spṛṣṭaṃ mukhamata eva candrāvasthāṃ gataṃ patyā hasyate
atra masīmālinyaṃ vaikṛtaṃ tata eva mukhacandrayoḥ sāmyāpattiḥ
iha kathāpi nāyikayā locanābhyāṃ caṣake sugandhimadyabhṛte pratimayā pratibimbena patitābhyām
ata eva madenātāmrābhyāmatilohitābhāyāṃ manojñā raktotpaladalasya śobhā laghvīkṛtātyalpā kṛtā
atra netrayorupameyayormadatāmratvaṃ vaikṛta utkarṣaḥ sphuṭa eva
‘mṛgaṃ mṛgāṅka sakalaṃ sadāṅke bibhārti tasyāstu mukhaṃ kadācit
atra mṛgāṅka sakalaṃ mṛgaṃ sadāṅke bibhārti, tanmukhaṃ ca kadācinmṛganābhimātrajapatramevetyupameyasya vācanikyapakarṣāpattiḥ pratīyate
mṛgāṅkaścandro'ṅke kroḍe sadā sakalaṃ mṛgaṃ bibharti
tasyāḥ punarmukhaṃ (kartṛ), kapoladeśe mṛganābheḥ kastūrikāyāḥ pattraṃ pattrāvalīṃ kadācidvahati
kalaṅkinā samamanayoralpa evotkarṣa iti hi vacanamapasarṣabodhakameva
‘na martyalokastridivātpratīyate mriyeta nāgre yadi vallabho janaḥ
nivṛttameva tridivaprayojanaṃ mṛtaḥ sa cejjīvata eva jīvati || 64 ||’
atropameyasya yathoktadharmayoge satyupamānena pūrvārdhe sāmyamuttarārdhe tu kiṃcidutkarṣo bhavati
ihopameyasya martyalokasya yathoktadharmasyāgre vallabhamaraṇābhāvarūpasya yoge satyupamānena tridivena taulyamagre tridivaprayojananivṛttyukterutkarṣa eva jñāyate
sā dṛṣṭāntokticchāyayā vidhāvṛjuḥ pūrvā ca yathā—

atra tadindostārakaughena kāntirucchedyā iti pūrvamṛjūktyā dṛṣṭāntarūpaṃ paścādyadetanmukhaṃ yuvatimukhāni vijayanta iti ṛjūktyaiva dārṣṭāntikarūpaṃ prativastūpanyastamiti seyaṃ dṛṣṭāntokticchāyayā vidhāvṛjvīpūrvā ca prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
etasyā etanmukhaṃ yadi yuvatimukhāni (kartṝṇi) vijayante tattadā himabhāsaścandrasya kāntistārānikareṇocchedyetyahaṃ manye
tathā ca dṛṣṭāntokticchāyā vyaktaiva, vidhimukhatāpi vyaktaiva

atra śuddhāntadurlabhamiti vakroktyā pūrvaṃ dārṣṭāntikarūpaṃ vastūpanyasya paścāddūrīkṛtāḥ khalu guṇairiti vakroktyaiva dṛṣṭāntarūpaṃ prativastūpanyastamiti seyaṃ dṛṣṭāntokticchāyayā vidhau vakrottarā ca prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
yadyāśramavāsino janasya vapuridaṃ śuddhānte'ntaḥpure durlabhamasti tadā khalu niścayena vanalatābhirudyānalatā guṇairdūrīkṛtāḥ santi
atra śuddhāntadurlabhapadenedṛśaṃ rūpamantaḥpure'pi nāstīti vakroktayā pratipāditapūrvaṃ dārṣṭāntike
uttarārdhe'pi vakroktyaiva dṛṣṭāntakathanamiti dṛṣṭāntokticchāyatvavighitā tu sphuṭaiva
‘na mālatīdāma vimardayogyaṃ na prema navyaṃ sahate'parādhān | mlānāpi na mlāyati kesarasragdevī na khaṇḍapraṇayā kathaṃcit 67’

atra na mālatīdāma vimardayogyāmiti, mlānāpi na mlāyati kesarasragiti ca ṛjūktibhyāmeva pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭāntarūpe vastunī pratiṣidhyottarakālaṃ na prema navyaṃ sahate'parādhāniti, devī na khaṇḍapraṇayā kathaṃciditi ca dārṣṭāntikarūpe prativastunī ṛjūktyaiva pratiṣiddhe
seyaṃ niṣedhe ṛjvī pūrvā ca dṛṣṭāntokticchāyāyā prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
kesarasrak bakulamālā mlānāpi satī na mlāyati atimalinā na bhavati tadvaddevī kathaṃcinna khaṇḍapraṇayā na khaṇḍitapraśrayā bhavati
atra kathaṃ vā syāditi vakrayā niṣedhoktyā dārṣṭāntikamabhidhāya paścānna vasudhātalātprabhātaralaṃ jyotirudetīti vaiyadhikaraṇyavakrayaiva niṣedhoktyā dṛṣṭanto'bhihitaḥ
seyaṃ niṣedhe vakrottarā ca dṛṣṭāntokticchāyayā prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
atra kathaṃ vā syāditi vitarkotthatayā vakroktirniṣedharūpā, uttarārdhe tādṛśajyotiṣo bhūmāvasaṃbhave'tirūpavatyā bhūmāvasaṃbhava ukta iti vaiyadhikariṇyaṃ vakratā ca
‘taraṅgaya dṛśo'ṅgane patatu citramindīvaraṃ sphuṭīkuru radacchadaṃ vrajatu vidrumaḥ śvetatām
kṣaṇaṃ vapurapāvṛṇu spṛśatu kāñcanaṃ kālikām udañcaya mukhaṃ manāgbhavatu ca dvicandraṃ nabhaḥ || 69 ||’
seyaṃ prapañcokticchāyayā vidhāvṛjvī nāma prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
he aṅgane rūpavati, dṛśo netrāṇi taraṅgaya cañcalāni kuru
tato vidrumaḥ pravālavṛkṣaḥ śvetatāṃ vrajatu yātu
kṣaṇaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ vapuḥ śarīramapāvṛṇu nirāvaraṇa kuru
tataḥ kāñcanaṃ kanakaṃ (kartṛ) kālikāṃ śyāmikāṃ spṛśatu
manāk alpaṃ yathā syādevaṃ mukhamudañcayottolaya ca
tato nabha ākāśaṃ dvicandraṃ candradvayānvitaṃ bhavatu
taraṅgayeti taraṅgaśabdāt ‘tatkaroti-’ iti ṇici loṭi rūpam
atra vikṛtatayā prakṛtatayā ca prapañcokticchāyā vaikṛtamasāhajikam
ehu sasibimbau kalaṅgagārau paṇḍarau khittau uppareṇa bhamāia ṇimañchaṇakhapparau || 70 ||’
etacchaśibimbaṃ kalaṅkāgāraṃ pāṇḍaramutkṣiptam upari bhrāmayitvā nirmañchanakarparam ||]
atropameyotkarṣo vaikṛtaḥ, upamānāpakarṣaḥ prākṛtaḥ prakāśata eva
yā punariyamuttarārdhena rūpakeṇopamānāpakarṣasyoktibhāṅgistayeyaṃ prapañcokticchāyayā vidhau vakrā nāma prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
‘ekonnāmita bhrūbhaṅge vimalakapole vadane tava mṛgākṣi tiryaṅgayane
’ iha he mṛgākṣi, tava vadana etacchaśibimbaṃ nirmañchanakarparamupari bhrāmayitvotkṣiptam
eka unnamita uttolito bhrūbhaṅgo yatra tasmin
śaśibimbe nirmañchanakarparadharmamāha—kalaṅka evāṅgāro yatra tatpāṇḍaraṃ śvataṃ ca
‘dātāro yadi kalpaśākhibhiralaṃ yadyarthinaḥ kiṃ tṛṇaiḥ santaścedamṛtena kiṃ yadi khalāstatkālakūṭena kim
kiṃ karpūraśalākayā yadi dṛśoḥ panthānameti priyā saṃsāre'pi satīndrajālamaparaṃ yadyasti tenāpi kim || 71 ||’
atropameyotkarṣa ṛjūktyaiva ca nibaddha iti seyaṃ prapañcokticchāyayā niṣedhe ṛjurnāma prativastūktiḥ sāmyabhedaḥ
yadi dātāraḥ santi tadā kalpaśākhibhiḥ kalpavṛkṣapañcakairalaṃ niṣphalam
yadyarthino yācakāḥ santi tarhi tṛṇaiḥ kim
khalā durjanā yadi tadā kālakūṭena viṣeṇa kim
panthānaṃ mārgaṃ yadi priyā eti āyāti tadā karpūraśalākayā kiṃ karpūraghaṭitakāṣṭhikayā kim
saṃsāre'pi sati vidyamāne tasmādaparamindrajālamasti tenāpi kim
atra dātṛprabhṛterutkarṣa upamāne ca niṣedha ṛjūktyaiva
‘tadvakraṃ yadi mudritā śaśikathā taccetsmitaṃ kā sudhā taccakṣuryadi hāritaṃ kuvalayaistāścedgiro dhiṅmadhu
dhik kaṃdarpadhanurbhruvau ca yadi te kiṃ vā bahu brūmahe yatsatyaṃ punaruktavastuvirasaḥ sargakramo vedhasaḥ || 72 ||’
te ime dve api mālopamācchāyayā prapañcoktipūrve, punaḥ upamācchāyayeti mantavyam
tasyāstatprasiddhaṃ mukhaṃ yadyasti tadā śaśikathā mudritā luptā
yadi te bhruvau ca tadā kaṃdarpadhanurdhik
yadvā kiṃ bahu brūmahe vadāmo yatsatyaṃ niścitaṃ vedhaso dhātuḥ sṛṣṭikramaḥ punaruktavastuṣu dviruktapadārtheṣu vimukha eva
tathā ca tadvakrādau sati taccandrādisargo na syāditi bhāvaḥ
atra kathāmudraṇādinā candrādereva niṣedha iti vakroktiḥ
yathotpādyopamāyāmupamānārthamutpādyopameyena pratīyamānamabhidhīyamānaṃ ca sādṛśyamuktaṃ tathā pūrvayorapīti prapañcokticchāyatvamityarthaḥ
arthayorvācyayoratisāmyādyatra mano dolāyate naikatra sthiraṃ bhavati idaṃ vedaṃ veti kṛtvā taṃ saṃśayamāhuḥ
‘āhāre viratiḥ samastaviṣayagrāme nivṛttiḥ parā nāsāgre nayanaṃ yadetadaparaṃ yaccaikatānaṃ manaḥ
maunaṃ cedamidaṃ ca śūnyamakhilaṃ yadviśvamābhāti te tadbrūyāḥ sakhi yoginī kimasi bhoḥ kiṃ vā viyoginyasi 73’
atraikasminvastuni vastudvayasyābhidhīyamānasāmānyapratyakṣaṃ tadviśeṣapratyakṣādubhayaviśeṣasmaraṇācca yo vimarśaḥ so'yamekaviṣayaḥ saṃśayaḥ
kiṃ yoginyasi yogavatyasi kiṃ vā viyoginyasi viyogavatyasi
ubhayasādharmyamāha—āhāre bhakṣye viratirvirāgaḥ samaste viṣayagrāme sragādau parātyarthaṃ nivṛttiḥ
etadyadaparaṃ yacca mana ekatānamacañcalaṃ dhyeye patyau ca
viśvasya śūnyatvavibhāvanaṃ ca viyogikṛtyaṃ munayo vadanti
atraikasminvastuni sakhīviṣaye vastudvayasya yogaviyogarūpasyābhidhīyamānaṃ yatsāmyaṃ tasya pratyakṣāddarśanāt
atra mukhalakṣaṇe locanalakṣaṇe caikasminneva padmalakṣaṇaṃ bhramaralakṣaṇaṃ cāparamapi vastu pratīyamānasādṛśyamāśaṅkyate so'yamapyekaviṣaya eva saṃśayaḥ
he ghanastani kaṭhinakuce, tvāṃ paśyato mama cittaṃ dolāyate saṃśayārūḍhaṃ bhavati
tadevāha—antarmadhye bhrāntaḥ kṛtabhramaṇo'lirbhramaro yatra tatkiṃ padmam
lolamīkṣaṇaṃ cakṣuryatra tādṛśaṃ tava mukhaṃ kimiti dolāyate dolevācarati
‘vālī bhaṃbhurabholī(bhambhalabhelī) ullasiaṇiaṃsiṇī gahaṇaṃ suṇia vinikkantā ṇiddāe bhe(bha)mbhalī
rahuvi tīa muhu johaī puṇa johaī gaaṇu bhullalleo ṇa hu āṇaī doṇhavi candu(nda)kaṃ vaṇu(ṇe) 75’
[bālā mūrkhaceṭyullasitanivasanā grahaṇaṃ śrutvā viniṣkāntā nidrayā jaḍā
rāhurapi tasyā mukhaṃ paśyati punaḥ paśyati gagane bhrāntimān na khalu jānāti dvayoścandraḥ kaḥ ||]
atra dvayoḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyayorbālikāmukhacandrayorekaścandra eva viśaṅkayata iti so'yamanekaviṣayaḥ śuddhaḥ saṃśayaḥ
‘bālī(lā) bhumbhurabholī(?) skhalitanivasanā grahaṇakaṃ śrutvā viniṣkāntā nidrayā bhembhalī(jaḍā)
rāhurapi tasyā mukhaṃ vilokate punarvilokate gagane bhrānto na khalu jānāti dvayoścandraḥ kaḥ
ullasitaṃ skhalitaṃ nitambopari nivasanaṃ yasyāḥ sā
ni drayā bhembhalī vihvalā grahaṇaṃ candroparāgaṃ śrutvā viniṣkrāntā
gagane bhrāntaḥ saṃśayānaḥ san naiva jānāti kāntāmukhacandrayordvayormadhye kaścandra iti
astaṃ ko yātyudayati ca kaḥ ko raviḥ kaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ kā ca prācī tadiha na vayaṃ kā pratīcīti vidmaḥ || 76 ||’
atra dvayorabhidhīyamānasādṛśyayoḥ sūryācandramasoḥ prācīpratīcyorvā tadanyatamamekameva vastu paryāyato viśaṅkyata ityanekaviṣayo'yaṃ miśraḥ saṃśayaḥ
upasaṃdhyaṃ saṃdhyāsamīpe dvayamapi ravicandrarūpaṃ viyanmaṇḍalasyākāśamaṇḍalasyānte'vasāne tiṣṭhati
kaḥ sūryaḥ, kaścandraḥ, kā prācī pūrvā dik, kā pratīcī paścimā digiti na vayaṃ vidmaḥ
tarhi vitarkoktiḥ pṛthak kathaṃ noktetyata āha—upalakṣaṇamiti
iti pralīnāṃ nalinīvane sakhī vidāmbabhūvuḥ sucireṇa yoṣitaḥ ||’
nilīnāḥ saṃbaddhāḥ ṣaṭpadā bhramarā yayoste padmapatre nu
niśabdaṃ śabdaśūnyaṃ niścalaṃ sthiraṃ ca bhramaravṛndaṃ nu
agūḍhena prakāśena hāsena sphuṭo vyakto danta eva kesaro yatra tat
ityanena prakāreṇa nalinīvane padminīmadhye pralīnāmavasthitāṃ sakhīṃ yoṣitaḥ sriyo bahukālena vidāmbabhūvurjñātavatyaḥ
‘muhe maakhaliullāve ṇhāṇollae ciure veṇīaṃsaṇasāre samottiahāre ure
kālāntare taralācchihumaaṇa samullasai māhau puma tthaṇaguḍare ṇa muṇai kahiṃ vasai || 79 ||’
[mukhe madaskhalitollape srānoptlute cikure veṇīnivasanasāre samauktikahare urasi
kālāntare taralākṣṇormadanaḥ samullasati māghe punaḥ stanagṛhe na jñāyate kutra vasati ||]
saṃśayāno hi vitarkasya koṭimāruhya tato vibhraṣṭastattvamabhiniviśate
saṃśayameva vā vigāhate yathā—'māhau puṇa tthaṇaguḍare ṇa muṇai kahiṃ vasai
‘mukhe madaskhalitollape srānārdre cikure veṇīnivasanasāre samuktāhāre urasi
kālāntare taralākṣṇi madanaḥ samullasati māghe punaḥ stanagṛhe na jñāyate kutra vasati
’ iha kālāntare māghātiriktakāle madaskhalitollāpe mukhe srānārdre keśe veṇīnivasanena kañcukavasreṇa sāre muktāhārasahite vakṣasi taralanetre ca madanaḥ kāmaḥ samullasati dīpyate
māghe punaḥ stana eva gṛhaṃ tatra na jñāyate kutra vasatīti
yathā parārthānumāne śabdaprayogakārito viśeṣastathā śabdapakṣe svarūpamarthastatpakṣe svārthānumānavatpravṛttiḥ
tathā ca svarūpamātrasyoktau nirvacane'rthālaṃkāratā saṃśayatarkāderuktiprādhānye punarubhayālaṃkārateti
vācye pratīyamāne ca sādṛśye prathamā tayoḥ
kiṃcitprasiddhaṃ dharmiṇaṃ dharmaṃ vāpahnutyāpalapyānyasyārthaṃsya prasiddhasya dharmāderdarśanaṃ prakaṭanamapahnutiḥ
tatra hi pratiṣedhamātramartho'tra tu pratiṣedhapūrvakamanyārthakathanamiti bhedaḥ
āśvasihi proṣitapati ke na bhavanti navaprāvṛḍabhrāṇi ||]
’ iha virahiṇī dāvāgninā digdhe vindhye meghabhrāntyā ārtā sakhyā samāśvāsyate—grīṣma iti
he virahiṇi, vindhyaśikharāṇi grīṣme vanāgninā śyāmitāni dṛśyante
natu nūtanavarṣākālīna(lika)meghā amī bhavantīti samāśvāsaṃ kuru
atra śyāmikayā vindhyaśikharanavame ghayoḥ sāmyamabhihitamata aupamyavatīyam
‘na ketakīnāṃ vilasanti sūcayaḥ pravāsino hanta hasatyayaṃ vidhiḥ
taḍillateyaṃ na cakāsti cañcalā puraḥ smarajyotiridaṃ vijṛmbhate 81’
atra ketakīsūcīnāṃ vidhivihasitaiḥ pratīyamānasādṛśyaistaḍillatāyāśca smarajyotiṣāpahnutatvādiyaṃ pratīyamānaupamyavatyapahnutiḥ
ayaṃ vidhiḥ sraṣṭā pravāsinaḥ pānthān hasatyupahasati
iyaṃ cañcalā capalā taḍillatā na śobhate
atra rājakanyānurāgalakṣaṇasya romāñcakāraṇasya rakṣakāvagatihetoḥ pūrvamevābhihitasya ca vanānilaśaityalakṣaṇena kāraṇāntareṇāpahnavaḥ
romodbhedena romāñcena rājakanyānuraktaṃ bhūpakanyānurāgiṇaṃ māṃ rakṣakāstadavekṣakā avagaccheyurjñāyeran
atrānandāśrupravṛttamiti pūrvaṃ kāryasya, paścāt dṛṣṭvaiva kanyakāmiti kāraṇasyopanyāsaḥ
atra naitasyāḥ stanayorupapatinā nakhakṣataṃ kṛtamapi tu kaṇṭakairiti pratīyamānāpahnotavyaṃ vastu prakāśate
pūrvavadeva ca pūrvārdhe kāraṇasyopanyāsaḥ, paścimārghe tu kāryopadeśo dṛśyate
seyamanaupamyā pratīyamānāpahnotavyavastuḥ pūrvā nāma—‘apahnutirapahnutya kiṃcidanyārthadarśanam’ iti lakṣaṇayogājjāyate
’ iha he dayitavatsale priyapremavati kaṇṭakalikhitapīnonnatastani, idānīṃ tāmyodvignā bhava
urasā vakṣasā preritā yā vṛtirveṣṭanaṃ tatra kāravellīphalāni uccinoṣi troṭayasi
‘kassa va ṇa hoi roso daṭṭhūṇa piāi savvaṇaṃ aharam
[kasya vā na bhavati roṣo dṛṣṭvā priyāyāḥ savraṇamadharam
atrāpi nāsyā upapatinādharo vraṇitaḥ kiṃ tarhi bhramareṇeti pratīyamānāpahnotavyaṃ vastu
pūrvārdhe tu savraṇamadharamiti kāryamupanyasya, paścimārdhe sabhramarakamalāghrāyiṇīti kāraṇamupanyastam
‘kasya vā na bhavati roṣo dṛṣṭvā priyāyāḥ savraṇamadharam
’ iha preyāyā adharaṃ sakṣataṃ dṛṣṭvā kasya roṣo na bhavati
tato hetorbhramarasahitapadmasyāghrāṇakārike, he vāritavāmye dākṣiṇyavati, saṃprati tvaṃ sahasva sahiṣṇurbhava
anyadharmasyānyatra viśeṣe ya āropaḥ sa samādhiḥ

’ ihātyarthadhṛtalauhitye'tyarthaṃkṛtānurāge ca dinakare sūrye vallabhe cāparadiśaṃ pratīcīmaparanāyikāṃ cāvagūhamāne saṃbadhnātyāśliṣyati ca sati dinaśobhā vallabhasphuṭadūṣaṇamasahamāneva klāmyati mlānā bhavati
atra ca nāyakatvādyāropaṇaṃ rāgādipadaiḥ śliṣṭaiḥ kriyata iti nirudbhedatā
‘vallahe lahu volantai ettai puṇu bahu bali kijjami tāmarasiṇi tujjha rosahu thirahu
jeṇa ṇiraggalu jampai kimpi ṇa jāva jaṇu(ṇa) tāva himeṇa visitti jhatthi(tti) puluṭṭhataṇu || 87 ||’
[vallabhe laghu vyapakrāmatyāgacchati punarbahu baliḥ kriye tāmarasini tava roṣasya sthirasya
yena nirargalaṃ jalpati kimapi na yāvajjanas tāvaddhimena viśīrṇā jhaṭiti pluṣṭatanuḥ ||]
atrāpi priyatamavyalīkāsahiṣṇuḥ kāpi kāminī himānīpluṣṭāṃ kamalinīmālokya tasyāmātmadharmān, priye ca sūryadharmānāropayati
te ca baliḥ kriye'haṃ tava roṣasyetyādibhiḥ padairudbhidyamānā iha pratīyanta ityayaṃ sodbhedaḥ samādhibhedaḥ
‘vallabhe laghu vyapakrāmati punarāgacchati cireṇa baliḥ kriye tāmarasini tava roṣasya sthirasya
yena nirākulaṃ jalpati kimapi na yāvajjanastāvaddhimena viśīrṇā jhaṭiti pluṣṭatanuḥ

’ iha he tāmarasini padmini, vallabhe sūrye laghu śīghraṃ vyapakrāmatyapagacchati sati himasamaye rātredīṃrghatvāccireṇa punarāgacchati sati tava roṣasya sthirasya balirupahāro'haṃ kriye iti kācitkhaṇḍitā padminīmuddiśya vadati
yena hetunā nirākulo jano yāvadeva kimapi na jalpati tāvadeva himena viśīrṇā jhaṭiti tvaṃ dagdhatanurasi
eko brūte prathamanihataṃ keśinaṃ kaṃsamanyaḥ sa tvaṃ tattvaṃ kathaya bhavatā ko hatastatra pūrvam || 88 ||’
atra saṃbodhya varṇanīye viṣṇusvarūpasya dharmiṇastaddharmāṇāṃ cādhyāsādayaṃ dharmidharmādhyāsarūpaḥ samādhiḥ
kayościt siddhayūnoḥ sarayvā nadībhedasyāsmin saikate bahukālaṃ vādadvaitaṃ vacanavivādo'bhavat
‘vādadyūtam’ iti pāṭhe vādo vivāda eva dyūtamityarthaḥ
candrajyotsnayā viśadaṃ svacchaṃ pulinaṃ toyotthitabhāgo yatra tatra
vādasvarūpamāha—ekaḥ keśinaṃ prathamanihataṃ brūte, anyaḥ kaṃsaṃ prathamanihataṃ brūte
he bhagavan, sa prasiddhastvaṃ tattvaṃ yathārthaṃ kathaya
bhavatā tatra tayoḥ keśikaṃsayormadhye kaḥ pūrvaṃ hata iti
siddhau ca tau yuvānau ceti siddhayuvānau
atra viṣṇostaddharmāṇāṃ ca cakradharatvādīnāmāropaḥ sphuṭa eva
‘prāptaśrīreṣa kasmātpunarapi mayi taṃ manthakhedaṃ vidadhyānnidrāmapyasya pūrvāmanalasamanaso naiva saṃbhāvayāmi
setuṃ badhnāti kasmātpunarayamakhiladvīpanāthānuyātastvayyāyāte vitarkāniti dadhata ivābhāti kampaḥ payodheḥ || 89 ||’

atra prāptaśrīreṣa kasmādityādibhirmanthakhedādidharmāṇāṃ nivartitatvāt prāptaśrīrityādīnāṃ ca śleṣeṇaivābhidhānāt tvayīti varṇanīyapade viṣṇusvarūpasya dharmiṇa evādhyāsāt taddharmāṇāṃ cānadhyāsādayaṃ dharmyadhyāsarūpaḥ samādhiḥ
svavyāghāte sati iti vitarkān dadhata iva
eṣa prāptalakṣmīḥ ko'pi kasmātpunarapi madviṣaye manthena manthanadaṇḍena khedaṃ vidaghyātkuryāt
akhiladvīpanātho rāvaṇastamanulakṣyīkṛtya yātaḥ prayātaḥ punarayaṃ kasmāddhetoḥ setubandhaṃ badhnāti
atra prāptaśrīrityādiśliṣṭapadairdharbhiṇa eva viṣṇurūpasyāropo na tu taddharmāṇāmasuraghātakatvādīnām
atra pallavitamiva puṣpitamiva phalitamivetyutprekṣayā latādharmāṇāṃ lāvaṇyadharmiṇi dharmādhyāropo dṛśyate
karapallavādīnāṃ cānupāttavyāpārahetutvena sādhakatamatvena vā prādhānyaṃ lakṣyate
so'yamanyavastuni punaranyadharmāṇāmevāropeṇa melitaṃ nāma samādhereva bhedo bhavati
’ ihāryāyā gṛhapatiputryā nāyikāyā lāvaṇyaṃ saukumāryaṃ hastapallavābhyāṃ pallavitamiva netrābhyāṃ phullitamiva pīnastanābhyāṃ phalitamivāsti
anupātto'nukto yo vyāpāro'dhyāsaviṣayastaddhetutvena tadupasthitikāraṇatvena tatkaraṇatvena vā
samādhyuktirityatra samādhiriti kartavye uktigrahaṇamadhikārthasūcakamityuktipadenaiva melitoddeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ
‘deho vva paḍai diaho kaṇṭhaccheo vva lohio hoi raī
galai ruhiraṃ vva saṃjhā gholai kesakasaṇaṃ sirammia timiram || 91 ||’
[deha iva patati divasaḥ kaṇṭhaccheda iva lohito bhavati raviḥ
galati rudhiramiva saṃdhyā ghūrṇate keśakṛṣṇaṃ śira iva timiram ||]

atra dehādayo yathoktakriyāvanto jantuvadhakriyāyāṃ nibaddhā divasādibhirupameyā divasāvasānakriyāyāṃ melitāstadetat guṇakriyāvatāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pradhānakriyādhyārope dharmidharmādhyāse melitaṃ nāma samādhereva bhedo bhavati
‘deha iva patati divasaḥ kaṇṭhaccheda iva lohito bhavati raviḥ
galati rudhiramiva saṃdhyā ghūrṇate keśakṛṣṇaṃ śira iva timiram
’ iha dinamaṅgamiva patati, raktaḥ sūryaḥ kaṇṭhaccheda iva bhavati, raktamiva saṃdhyā galati, timiraṃ keśaśyāmaṃ śira iva ghūrṇate itastato yāti
atra patanādayaḥ kriyāḥ, lauhityādayo guṇāḥ, pradhānakriyāḥ patatītyādikāḥ, tadadhyāropo divasādiṣu
ubhe ślāghāgarhe ca, nobhe aślāghāgarhe caitānupādhīnprayojakān samāsoktau vadanti
viśeṣyamātrābhyāṃ yuktāyuktābhyāṃ bhinnāpi viśeṣaṇadvayabhedavatī ekā tulyākāraviśeṣaṇā, uparā tulyātulyaviśeṣaṇā
‘uttuṅge kṛtasaṃśrayasya śikhariṇyuccāvacagrāvaṇi nyagrodhasya kimaṅga tasya vacasā ślāghāsu paryāpyate
bandhurvā sa purākṛtaḥ kimathavā satkarmaṇāṃ saṃcayo mārge rūkṣavipattraśākhini jano yaṃ prāpya viśrāmyati || 92 ||’
atra nyagrodhenaivopamānena pratīyamānasādṛśyasya varṇanīyavadānyopameyasyoktatvāttacchlāghayaiva tacchlāghā pratīyata iti seyaṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyā ślāghāvatī samāsoktiḥ
tasya nyagrodhasya vaṭavṛkṣasya ślāghā svapraśaṃsā svavacasoktyā kiṃ samāpyate
uccāvacā nimnonnatā ye grāvāṇaḥ pāṣāṇāstadyukte ca śikhariṇi girau kṛtāvāsasya
ślāghāhetumāha—sa vaṭo bandhurmitraṃ vā purā pūrvaṃ kṛtaḥ
athavā satkarmaṇāṃ śreṣṭhavyāpārāṇāṃ saṃcaya upacayaḥ kim
rūkṣā asnigdhā vipatrāḥ patraśūnyāḥ śākhino vṛkṣā yatra tādṛśe mārge yaṃ vaṭavṛkṣaṃ prāpya jano viśrāmyati
uccāvacetyatra bahuvrīhyanantaraṃ matubiti bhramo na kāryaḥ
atra paropakāritayā nyagrodhavadānyayoḥ sādṛśyaṃ pratīyamānaṃ tata evobhayoḥ ślāghāpi
‘kiṃ jāto'si catuṣpathe yadi ghanacchāyo'si kiṃ chāyayā saṃpannaḥ phalito'si kiṃ yadi phalaiḥ pūrṇo'si kiṃ saṃnataḥ
he sadvṛkṣa sahasva saṃprati śikhāśākhāśatākarṣaṇa- kṣobhonmoṭanabhañjanāni janataḥ svaireva duśceṣṭitaiḥ || 93 ||’
atropamānabhūtasya sadvṛkṣasya vyājagarhaṇayā tadupameyaḥ ko'pi satpuruṣo vigarhyata iti seyaṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyā garhāvatī nāma samāsoktiḥ
yadi tvaṃ ghanā nibiḍā chāyā yasya tādṛśo'si tadā chāyayā kiṃ vṛthā
yadi saṃpannaḥ samṛddhaḥ san phalito'si tadā phalabharaistava kim
yadyāḍhayo'si mahānasi tadā samyakprakāreṇa nataḥ kim
saṃpratyadhunā svairnijaireva duśceṣṭitairjanato lokāttvaṃ śikhāyāmagrabhāge śākhāśatasyākarṣaṇamākṛṣṭiḥ, kṣobhaścālanam, āmoṭanaṃ saṃkocanam, bhañjanaṃ chedanametāni sahasvānubhava
sahasveti ‘ṣaha marṣaṇe’ iti loṭi madhyamapuruṣaikavacane rūpam
‘niṣkandāmaravindinīṃ sthapuṭitoddeśāṃ sthalīṃ palvale jambālāvilamambu kartumaparā sūte varāhī sutān
daṃṣṭrāyāṃ caturarṇavormipaṭalairāplāvitāyāmiyaṃ yasyā eva śiśoḥ sthitā vipadi bhūḥ sā putriṇī potriṇī 94’
atra pūrvārdhe garhā, uttarārdhe ślāghā gamyate, seyaṃ pratīyamānasādṛśyobhayavatī samāsoktiḥ
itarānyā varāhī sūkarī sutān sūkarān sūte janayati
aravindinīṃ niṣkandāmunmūlitamūlāṃ kartuṃ, sthapuṭito nimnonnatīkṛta uddeśo yasyāstādṛśīṃ sthalīṃ kartuṃ, palvale'lpasarasi ambu jalaṃ jambālena kardamenāvilamanacchaṃ kartum
yasyāḥ śiśoreva bālakasyaiva daṃṣṭrāyāmiyaṃ bhūrvipadi pralaye sthitā
‘itaḥ svapiti keśavaḥ kulamitastadīyadviṣāmitaśca śaraṇārthinaḥ śikharipakṣiṇaḥ śerate
ito'pi vaḍavānalaḥ saha samastasaṃvartakairaho vitatamūrjitaṃ bharasahaṃ ca sindhorvapuḥ || 95 ||’
sindhoḥ samudrasya vapurāśayo vitataṃ vistīrṇamūrjitaṃ balavat bhāravahanakṣamaṃ ca
ito'traiva harirvasati, atraiva keśavaripūṇāmasurāṇāṃ puraṃ nagaramasti
atraiva śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ śikhariṇāṃ parvateṣu madhye pakṣiṇaḥ sapakṣā mainākādayaḥ śerate svapanti
tanniṣedhasyānityatvānnirdhāraṇasyāvivakṣaṇādvā nirdhāraṇadyotakajātyāderabhāvena tadunnayanāt, yadvā śikhariṇaśca te pakṣiṇaśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ
pūrvanipāte tu bahuṣvekatra niyama iti vyavasthitiḥ
‘nālasya prasaro jaleṣvapi kṛtāvāsasya koṣe rucirdaṇḍe karkaśatā mukhetimṛdutā mitre mahānpraśrayaḥ
āmūlaṃ guṇasaṃgrahavyasanitā dveṣaśca doṣākare yasyaiṣā sthitirambujasya vasatiryuktaiva tatra śriyaḥ || 96 ||’
yasyāmbujasya padmasyaivamanenākāreṇa sthitiravasthitistatrāmbuje śriyo lakṣmyā vasatirvāso yukta eva
tadāha—nālasya nālāyāḥ prasaro vistāraḥ, atha ca na ālasyasyālasatāyāḥ prasara ādhikyam
jaleṣvapi toyeṣu kṛtāvāsasya, atha ca mūrkheṣvapi kṛtāvāsasya
koṣe kuṅmale ruciḥ kāntiḥ, atha ca koṣe pātre'rthasārthe vā ruciḥ prītiḥ
daṇḍe prakāṇḍe karkaśatā kāṭhinyam, atha ca daṇḍe śāsane karkaśatā kārkaśyam
mukhe upakrame mṛdutā komalatā, atha ca mukhe vadane mṛdutā madhuravāṇīkatā
mitre sūrye mahān praśrayaḥ prītiḥ, atha ca mitre suhṛdi mahāprītiḥ
āmūlaṃ mūlādārabhya guṇasya tantoḥ saṃgrahe grahaṇe vyasanitā āsaṅgaḥ, atha cāmūlamādipuruṣādārabhya guṇānāṃ śīlādīnāṃ saṃgrahe vartulīkaraṇe vyasanitā prayatnaḥ
doṣākare rajanikare dveṣo'sūyā, atha ca doṣāṇāmākareutpattisthāne jane dveṣo'prītiḥ
‘jalaṃ nīre ca mūrkhe ca’ iti viśvaḥ
‘doṣaḥ syāddūṣaṇe doṣā rātrau bāhau ca kīrtitā
atra padmasajjanayoḥ prasiddhisiddhamupamānopameyatvamata ubhayārthakaviśeṣaṇapadairaśleṣa iva sādṛśyamabhidhīyate
‘upādhvaṃ tatpānthāḥ punarapi saro mārgatilakaṃ yadāsādya svecchaṃ vilasatha vilīnaklamabharāḥ
itastu kṣārābdherjaraṭhakamaṭhakṣiptapayaso nivṛttiḥ kalyāṇī na punaravatāraḥ kathamapi || 97 ||’
atra pūrvārghe'bhidhīyamānasādṛśyayoḥ ślāghā, paścimārghe tu pratīyamāna-sādṛśyayorgarhāvagamyate; seyamubhayavatī tulyātulyaviśeṣaṇābhidhīyamānapratīyamānasādṛśyā samāsoktiḥ
yatsara āsādya gataśramabharā yūyaṃ svecchaṃ vilasatha yathecchaṃ krīḍadhvam
ito'smātkṣārābdhernivṛttireva kalyāṇī kuśaladā na punaḥ kathamapyavatāro'tra kuśaladaḥ
jaraṭhena jīrṇena kamaṭhena kacchapena kṣuṇṇaṃ payo jalaṃ yasya tasmāt
uttarārdhe tu kṣārābdhestādṛśasyānupakārakatayā garhā vyaktaiva jñāyate, ihāsajjanagatā nindāpi pratīyate; kiṃtu sā viśeṣaṇadvārā netyatulyaviśeṣaṇatā
atra hariśabdena baliśabdena vā kaścit samānetivṛttaḥ puṃviśeṣa evocyate; seyaṃ svajātiviṣayānyoktiḥ saṃkṣepoktirūpatvātsamāsoktireva
yena balināsya harerviṣṇoḥ karo hasto bhikṣāpātrīkṛto bhikṣāpātratvamāpāditaḥ
atra bhramaraśabdena kaścit kāmī, phullapaṅkajaśabdena kāpi prauḍhā ṅganā, kuṅmalaśabdena kāpi mugdhāṅganābhidhīyate; seyamanyajātiviṣayānyoktiḥ samāsoktireva bhavati
bhramaro yathākāmaṃ yathecchaṃ praphullapaṅkaje madhu piban san asaṃnaddhasaurabhyamaprāptasaugandhyamapi kuṅmalaṃ cumbati
upaprākārāgraṃ prahiṇu nayane tarkaya manāganākāśe ko'yaṃ galitahariṇaḥ śītakiraṇaḥ || 100 ||’
sā ceyaṃ pūrvārdhe'bhidhīyamānatulyaviśeṣaṇā, paścimārdhe punaranākāśe ko'yaṃ galitahariṇa ityatra tulyaviśeṣaṇā samāsoktirevānanyoktiḥ
he sakhe, upaprākārāgraṃ prākārāgrasamīpe nayane netradvayaṃ prahiṇu dehi
anākāśe ākāśātiriktadeśe galitahariṇastyaktalāñchanaḥ ko'yaṃ śītakiraṇaścandra iti
navā nūtanā yā lavalī latābhedastasyāḥ pākasya praṇayinīṃ praśrayavatīṃ ca

kamale punaḥ kuvalaye nīlanalinadvayam, tāni ca kamalakuvalayāni kanakalatikāyāṃ suvarṇalatāyām, sā ca kanakalatikā sukumārā komalā satī subhagā ramyetyanena prakāreṇa keyamutpātaparamparāriṣṭapaṅktiḥ
kasyāścinmukhādau kamalādyāropaḥ, vicitratā ca kamalādau kuvalayādyabhidhānenaivoktā tasyā evābhidhānādananyatayoktiḥ
‘lāvaṇyasindhuraparaiva hi keyamatra yatrotpalāni śaśinā saha saṃplavante
unmajjati dviradakumbhataṭī ca yatra yatrāpare kadalikāṇḍamṛṇāladaṇḍāḥ || 102 ||’
atrāpūrveyaṃ lāvaṇyasindhurityanyoktiḥ, yatrotpalāni śaśinā saha saṃplavanta ityādirananyoktiḥ, seyamubhayayogādubhayoktirapadiśyate
tenānyāpi yopamānopameyaviṣaye saṃkṣepoktiḥ sāpi samāsoktireva bhavati
yatra candreṇa saha padmāni saṃplavante saṃmilitāni bhavanti
‘indurlipta ivāñjanena jaḍitā dṛṣṭirmṛgīṇāmiva pramlānāruṇimeva vidrumadalaṃ śyāmeva hemaprabhā
pāruṣyaṃ kalayā ca kokilavadhūkaṇṭheṣviva prastutaṃ sītāyāḥ purataśca hanta śikhināṃ barhāḥ sagarhā iva 103’

atra saṃkṣepataḥ sītāśabdavācyasya mukhāderavayavasamūhasyāśrayata indurañjanenaiva liptaḥ, jaḍiteva mṛgīṇāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ, pramlānamivāruṇyaṃ vidrumasya, śyāmeva hemakāntiḥ, paruṣā iva kokilālāpāḥ, sagarhā iva śikhināṃ barhā ityutprekṣokteranuktānyapi tadupameyāni mukhādīni pratīyante, seyamapi saṃkṣepoktiḥ samāsoktireva bhavati
yatra prākaraṇike'prākaraṇiko dharmo'dhyāsyate sā samādhyuktiḥ yathā—'asahantibba kilimmai piaamapacchakkhadūsaṇaṃ diṇalacchī
‘sa tvaṃ tattvaṃ kathaya bhavatā ko hatastatra pūrvam—’ ityādiṣu ‘anākāśe ko'yaṃ galitahariṇaḥ śītakiraṇaḥ’ ityādiṣu ca pravyakta evādhyāsaviśeṣo dṛśyate
ekatra manasānyatra tu vacaseti so'yaṃ samādhyukteḥ samāsokteśca bhedo bhavati
sītāyāḥ purato'gre'ñjanena kajjalena lipta iva candraḥ
śikhināṃ mayūrāṇāṃ barhāśca sagarhā iva jātāḥ
atra sītāpadena mukhādyavayavasamūha uktastadagre upamānānāṃ tattaddṛśā utprekṣābhidhānādanuktā nyapi tadupameyāni mukhādīni jñāyanta ityupamānopameyaviṣaye saṃkṣepoktiriyam
atra bhramare'prakṛte prakṛtasya kāmino'dhyāsaḥ tarhi dharmyadhyāsatulyataivāsyetyāha—nanviti
prākaraṇikāprākaraṇikatvābhyāmeva viśeṣastayoriti dharmyadhyāse'pi na doṣa ityāha—neti
sa tvaṃ tattvamityādau dharmidharmayoradhyāsaḥ, anākāśa ityādau dharmiṇa evādhyāsa iti bheda ityarthaḥ
sa tvaṃ tattvamityādau manasā, anākāśa ityādau ca vacanenādhyāsaḥ
dravyaṃ guṇaḥ kriyā cāpi tāmutprekṣāṃ pracakṣate || 50
prakārāntareṇāvasthitaṃ vastu yatra prakārāntareṇotprekṣyate parikalpyate sotprekṣā
dravyaṃ pṛthivyādi, guṇo rūpādiḥ, kriyā pākādiḥ
atra pratibimbarūpeṇa darpaṇe'nyathāvasthitasyārdhanārīśvararūpalakṣaṇasya dravyasya yadaparārdhotpannārdhanārīśvararūpāntareṇa dravyāntararūpeṇotprekṣaṇaṃ seyamutprekṣā dravyotprekṣeti bhavati
yasya darpaṇe pratimāṃ pratibimbaṃ dehasthā gaurī paśyati anyārdhābhyāmutpannamardhanārīśvarāntaramiva
atra karapallavādirūpeṇānyathāvasthitasyāṅgalāvaṇyalakṣaṇasya yadetat pallavitatvādirūpeṇānyathotprekṣaṇaṃ seyamutprekṣā guṇotprekṣeti bhavati
atra saundaryasya guṇasya pallavitatvādinā kalpanaṃ guṇotprekṣā

atra senāgajānāṃ gaṇḍasthalebhyo lekhanyākāraiḥ karairmaṣīrūpasya madapayaso yadādānam, yaścāsya tīratālīpatrodareṣu mahāvarṇatayā nikṣepaḥ sa uktarūpeṇānyathotprekṣyata iti seyamutprekṣā kriyotprekṣā bhavati
svakarāṇāṃ hastihastānāṃ yāni puṣkarāṇyagrāṇi tānyeva lekhanyaḥ kāpa iti khyātāstābhirgaṇḍasthalāt madameva maṣīṃ vāraṃvāramādadānā gṛhṇantaḥ
na ca likheḥ kuṭādipāṭhāt ṅittve guṇābhāve likhanīti syāditi vācyam
na ceha dravyotprekṣaiveti vācyam; likhanarūpakriyāyāmeva sarveṣāṃ tātparyāt
tasyā eva sarvairnirvāhāt yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti nyāyāt
atrāṅgulībhiḥ keśeṣu gṛhītvā priyāmukhaṃ cumbyate sā ca locane nimīlayatīti prāyovādaḥ
tatra mukhacumbanādikriyā pradhānamaṅgibhūtā pratīyate, keśagrahaṇākṣinimīlane cāṅgabhūte'pradhāne

yathā hi ‘kuṅmalī kṛtasarojalocanam’ ityatra notprekṣāpadam, evaṃ ‘aṅgulīmarīcibhistimirakeśasaṃcayaṃ saṃnigṛhya’ ityatrāpi tanna prāpnoti; marīcyaṅgulisaṃnigṛhītatimirakeśasaṃcayamityevaṃ vā vaktavyaṃ bhavati
tatra yo'yamavayavakriyāyāmapyanyapadārthoktadvitīyāvayavakriyāvilakṣaṇa iva prayogeṇa pṛthakpadatayā vākyakalpaḥ sa ivāsyāpi vyākhyānaparatvenāpyanuyojyamānaḥ kavibhirutprekṣāvayava ityucyate
anye punaryatra pradhānakriyā notprekṣyate, avayavakriyā tūtprekṣyate tamutprekṣāvayavaṃ varṇayanti
kuṅyalīkṛtāni sarojānyeva locanāni yatra cumbane tadyathā syādevam
atra dvitīyenevapadena bhinnapadatayā vākyakalpanamitarapadasyāpi tacchūnyapadasyāpi tadartha-paratvamityutprekṣāvayavatvam
‘līneva pratibimbiteva likhitevotkīrṇarūpeva ca pratyupteva ca vajralepaghaṭitevāntarnikhāteva ca
sā naścetasi kīliteva viśikhaiścetobhuvaḥ pañcabhiścintāsaṃtatitantujālanibiḍasyūteva lagnā priyā || 108 ||’
atra vyapadeśaśabdena kiṃśukakusumānāmagnisādṛśyamabhidhāya darśanakriyotprekṣyata iti seyamutprekṣopamā
pūrvasminnapyudāharaṇe marīcibhiraṅgulībhiriva timiraṃ keśasaṃcayamiva saṃnigṛhyetyupamānārthānupraveśa utprekṣāyāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
vibhāvasuragniraraṇyānyā mahāraṇyasya dagdhādagdhaṃ dagdhamadagdhaṃ ca bhāgaṃ paśyatīva
‘yadetaccatdrāntarjaladalavalīlāṃ vitanute tadācaṣṭe lokaḥ śaśaka iti no māṃ prati tathā
atra kaṭākṣolkāpātavraṇakiṇakalaṅkāṅkitatanumindumahaṃ manye ityanena svamatadvārakamutprekṣāyāḥ samarthanaṃ kṛtamityayaṃ matābhidhānamutprekṣāyā eva prakāraḥ
yadetaccandrasyāntarmadhye meghakaṇavilāsaṃ kurute lokastacchaśaka ityācaṣṭe vadati
tvadīyaśatruvirahagrastāyā yuvatyāḥ kaṭākṣa evolkāpātastasya vraṇakiṇa eva kalaṅkastenāṅkitā tanuḥ śarīraṃ yasya tādṛśam
kuto'pi hetorvācyā ca pratyetavyā ca socyate || 52
astotavyasya ninditasya kuto'pi kāraṇātstutiḥ praśaṃsā aprastutastutiḥ ata eva samāsokterbhedaḥ
tatra hyupamānopameyatā, atra tu ninditamarthāntaram, anyasya stutiriti
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca teṣāmanyatasamasya prāyo bāhulyena bādhayā sarvatra svābhiprāyasya prakṛṣṭasidhdyā sotpadyamānā pratīyata ityarthaḥ
‘medacchedakṛśodaraṃ laghu bhavatyutsāhayogyaṃ vapuḥ sattvānāmapi lakṣyate vikṛtimaccittaṃ bhayakrodhayoḥ
utkarṣaḥ sa ca dhanvināṃ yadiṣavaḥ sidhyanti lakṣye cale mithyaiva vyasanaṃ vadanti mṛgayāmīdṛgvinodaḥ kutaḥ 111’
atra yathoktairhetubhiḥ svābhiprāyasādhanena yadidamīdṛgvinodaḥ kuta iti sākṣānmṛgayābhinandanaṃ seyaṃ vācyā nāmāprastutastutiḥ ‘ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ’ iti dharmaṃ bādhate
hi yato vapurlaghu bhavati ninditamiva bhavati
medaso balasya chedena saṃcalanena kṛśamudaraṃ yatra
sa ca dhanvināṃ dhanurdharāṇāmutkarṣo yadiṣavaścale lakṣye sighyanti ca bhedakā bhavanti
atroktahetudvārā nijābhiprāyasya sidhdyā mṛgayābhinandanaṃ dharmabādhanayābhidhīyamānamata iyamaprastutastutiḥ
‘kālākkharadu ssikkhia bālaa re lagga majjha kaṇṭhammi
doṇha vi ṇaraaṇivāso samaaṃ jai hoi tā hou || 112 ||’
dvayorapi narakanivāsaḥ samakaṃ yadi bhavati tadbhavatu ||]
atra kālākṣaraduḥ śikṣiṇetyanena lipijñānādibhiradhītadharmaśāstrābhimatarūpakapogaṇḍaḥ ko'pi kayāpyavinayavatyā sopālambhamehi re kaṇṭhe lagetyabhiyujyate
tatra te matamevaṃ kṛte yadi narakaḥ syāt; sa yadyāvayoḥ sahaiva, nāsau naraka iti; kiṃ tarhi svarga iti
so'yaṃ svābhiprāyasādhanānmahāsāhase niyogastasyeha sākṣādastutasyāstotavyasya stutiḥ pratīyate
seyaṃ pratyetavyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā ‘parasya dārānmanasāpi necchet’ iti dharmaṃ bādhate
dvayorapi narakanivāsaḥ samako yadi bhavati tadā bhavatu
’ iha re kālākṣareṣu duḥśikṣita durupadeśa bālaka ṣoḍaśavarṣavayaska, mama kaṇṭhe laga
dvyorāvayostathā sati narakanivāsaḥ samakastulyo yadi bhavati tadā bhavatu
atra nijābhiprāyasidhdyā mahāsāhase suratarūpe niyogasya sākṣādanabhidhānātpratīyamāne vā prastutastutiḥ
‘paṅgo vandyastvamasi na gṛhaṃ yāsi yo'rthī pareṣāṃ dhanyo'ndha tvaṃ dhanamadavatāṃ nekṣase yanmukhāni
ślādhyo mūka tvamapi kṛpaṇaṃ stauṣi nārthāśayā yaḥ stotavyastvaṃ badhira na giraṃ yaḥ khalānāṃ śrṛṇoṣi || 113 ||’
atra stotavyānāṃ paṅgvandhamūkabadhirāṇāṃ vandyadhanyaślāghyastotavyapadaiḥ sākṣādabhinandanādiyaṃ vācyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsābhimānino'rthasiddhiṃ bādhate
he paṅgo khañja, tvaṃ vandyo'si; yastvamarthī san pareṣāṃ gṛhaṃ na yāsi
he andha dṛṣṭiśūnya, tvaṃ dhanyaḥ, yaddhanagarvavatāṃ mukhāni tvaṃ nekṣase na paśyasi
he mūka, tvaṃ ślādhyo'si; yastvaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ janamarthāśayā na stauṣi
he badhira śravaṇaśūnya, tvaṃ stotavyo'si; yastvaṃ khalānāṃ durjanānāṃ giraṃ vārṇī na śrṛṇoṣi
vidadhati dhaniṣu na dainyaṃ te kila paśavo vayaṃ sudhiyaḥ || 114
atra te kila paśavo vayaṃ sudhiya iti mṛgāṇāmasākṣādaminandanaṃ teneyamastotavyānāmamīṣāṃ vākyārthatvena stutipratīteḥ pratyetavyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā manasvino'rthasiddhiṃ bādhate
hariṇā vaneṣvaprayatnataḥ sulabhena tṛṇena kāmamatyarthaṃ jīvanti
dhaniṣu dhanikeṣu dainyaṃ na vidadhati na kurvanti
tathāpi te hariṇāḥ paśavo vayaṃ punaḥ sudhiyaḥ paṇḍitāḥ
atra mṛgāṇāṃ na sākṣādabhinandanam, kiṃtu tatpratīyata itīyaṃ pratyetavyā
‘ṇa muanti dīhasāsaṃ ṇa ruanti ṇa honti virahakisiāo
dhaṇṇāo tāo jāṇaṃ bahuvallaha vallaho ṇa tumam || 115 ||’
[na muñcanti dīrghaśvāsaṃ na rudanti na bhavanti virahakṛśāḥ
dhanyāstā yāsāṃ bahuvallabha vallabho na tvam ||]
atra dhanyāstā yāsāṃ tvaṃ na vallabha iti yeyamatiraktāyāḥ sākṣādastotavyastutiḥ seyaṃ vācyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā tasyā eva kāmasiddhiṃ bādhate
‘na muñcanti dīrghaśvāsaṃ na rudanti na bhavanti virahakṛśāḥ
dhanyāstā yāsāṃ bahuvallabha vallabho na tvam
’ nāyikāṃ nāyakaviśeṣavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsakhī nāyakamupagamya tasyā anurāgaṃ daśāṃ cāha—na muñcatīti
he bahuvallabha, tā nāthikā dhanyā dīrghaśvāsaṃ virahajaṃ na tyajanti, na rūdanti, virahakṛśāśca na bhavanti
atra dhanyā ityādinā anurāgiṇyāḥ sākṣātstutirabhihitā tasyā eva kāmasiddhibādhikā
‘suhaucchaaṃ jaṇaṃ dullahaṃ vi dūrāhi amha āṇanta
uaāraa jara jīaṃ vi ṇenta ṇa kaāvarāhosi || 116 ||’

atra pūrvoktāsmadabhiprāyasidhdyaivaṃnāma tvayāsmākamupakṛtaṃ yena jīvitamapi harannāparādhyasīti jvaraṃ prati yadatiraktatayā vākyaṃ tenehāstotavyasya jvarasya stutiḥ pratīyate; seyaṃ pratyetavyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā tasyā eva śarīrabādhayā sarvānapi kāmān bādhate
he jvara, sukhapṛcchakaṃ tavāṅge sukhamadhuneti praśnakārakaṃ janaṃ durlabhamapi mama kṛte dūradeśādānayamāna prāpaka, ata evopakāraka, jīvamapi gṛhṇan tvaṃ na kṛtāparādho'si
atra sukhapṛcchaketyādinā svābhiprāyasidhdyānuraktāyā jvaraṃ prati vākyam
vivakṣito vaktumiṣṭo yo guṇastenotkṛṣṭā adhikā ye taiḥ saha stutyarthaṃ nindārthaṃ vā kasyacitsutyasya nindyasya vā tena guṇena tasya yatsamīkṛtya kīrtanamabhidhānaṃ sā tulyayogitā
atra eva stutirvā nindā vā syāt
atrābhidhīyamānamahattvādiguṇotkṛṣṭābhyāṃ śeṣāhituṣāraśailābhyāṃ saha stutyarthaṃ tulyayogena kṣitipaterabhihitatvādiyaṃ stutyarthā tulyayogitā
śeṣaḥ sarpaṃbhado himālayastvaṃ ca sarve yūyamimāṃ kṣitiṃ bibhṛtha dhārayatha
mahānto mahattvavantaḥ guravo gurutvāśrayāḥ sthirāḥ sthairyavantaśca
laṅghitātikrāntā maryādā yayā tāmata eva calantīmitastato gāminīṃ ca
atra ghanārabdhānyapītyādibhirabhidhīyamānatulyaguṇānāṃ mṛgākṣīsaṃgatānāṃ taḍidvilasitānāṃ ca nindārthaṃ tulyayogenābhidhānādiyaṃ nindārthā tulyayogitā

mṛgākṣīṇāṃ saṃgatāni saṃgamāḥ svayaṃ ghanaṃ nirantaramārabdhānyapi kṛtānyapi, tathā taḍitāṃ vidyutāṃ vilasitāni ca ghanairmedhairārabdhānyapi kṣaṇadvayamārambhakṣaṇādūrdhvamaparamapi kṣaṇaṃ na tiṣṭhanti; kuto dīrghakālam
atra prasiddhacāpalayā vidyutā strīṇāṃ saṃgamasya capalatā samīkṛtyocyata iti nindātulyayogiteyam
atra yamādayaḥ pañca bhavanto lokapālā ityanuktamapi tulyavastuyogitayaiva stutyarthameṣāṃ mithaḥ sādṛśyaṃ pratīyate; seyaṃ pratīyamānatulyaguṇatve stutyarthā tulyayogitā
yamādayo bhavanto'nanyaviṣayāmananyagāminīṃ lokapāla ityanenākāreṇa śrutiṃ khyātiṃ bibhrati dhārayanti
‘śrutiḥ khyātau ca vede ca’ iti viśvaḥ
atra catvāro yamādayo lokapālāḥ, idānīṃ bhavān pañcamo lokapālaśabdavācya iti yamādisamānatākhyāpanenotkṛṣṭasāmyakathanādrājñaḥ stutiḥ

atra yo'yaṃ sevādirmānavānāṃ rājaviṣaye strīṣu ca vaiṣamyahetutulyatvena yogo rājādīnāṃ vā karmāditulyatayā tatkriyāyāṃ samāveśaḥ so'mīṣāṃ mithaḥ sādṛśyaṃ pratyāyayan rājasevāparastrīratyorviṣopabhogatulyatāṃ gamayatīti seyaṃ pratīyamānatulyaguṇatve nindarthā tulyayogitā
bhūpamapi sevante, viṣamapyupabhuñjate khādanti, anyastrībhiḥ saha ramante vilasanti
atra viṣamatāyāṃ vā tulyayogastatkriyāviṣayatayā vā rājasevāparastrīratyorviṣopamogatulyatāṃ bodhayati sa ca pratīyamāna eva
anye sukhanimitte ca duḥkhahetau ca vastuni
atra rāmasya rājyābhiṣekavanagamanayoḥ piturādeśena tulyarūpatayā stutiḥ pratīyate
abhiṣekāya rājyābhiṣekāyāhūtasya kṛtāhvānasya, vanāya vanaṃ gantuṃ visṛṣṭasya ca tasya rāmasya svalpo'pyākāravibhrama ākārānyathātvaṃ mayā na lakṣitaḥ
atra rājyābhiṣekaḥ sukhahetuḥ, vanagamanaṃ duḥkhahetuḥ, tayoḥ pitṛbhaktyā tulyatvena stutitvam
atra yaḥ paraśunā chinatti, yo'muṃ madhusarpiṣā siñcati, yo vā gandhamālyābhyāmarcati taṃ prati tulyameva nimbasya kaṭutvamiti samāsoktyā tadupameyasya nindā pratīyate
yo nimbavṛkṣaṃ paraśunā kuṭhāreṇa chinatti, yaścainaṃ nimbaṃ madhusarpiṣā madhusahitena ghṛtena siñcati, yaścainaṃ gandhamālyābhyāmarcati sarvasya kṛte sa nimbaḥ kaṭureva tikta eva
doṣasya yo guṇībhāvo doṣībhāvo guṇasya yaḥ
doṣasya guṇatvam, guṇasya ca doṣatvaṃ yattadeva leśalakṣaṇam

atra yeyamuttarārdhena rājño vīryaprakarṣasya stutiḥ sā kanyāyā nirantarānbhogān nirvivikṣordoṣatvena pratibhāsiṣyata ityabhipretya yo'yaṃ vidagdhasakhyā rājaprakopaparijihīrṣayā doṣo'pi guṇarūpeṇoktaḥ; so'yaṃ doṣasya guṇībhāvo nāma leśato'lpatayā śanairananyavidita ucyamāno leśa ityucyate
svayaṃvare kasminnapi nṛpe darśitabhāvāṃ sakhīṃ nivartayituṃ kāpi stutivyājāttaṃ nindati
yasya kāmotsavādapi viṣayotsavamanādṛtya raṇotsave manaḥ saktamāsaktam
atra vidagdhayā sakhyā rājakopaśāntaye bhogecchuṃ prati vīryaprakarṣarūpastavasya doṣatve'pi guṇatvenālpatayopanyasanālleśo'yaṃ doṣasya guṇībhāvalakṣaṇaḥ
‘capalo nirdayaścāsau janaḥ kiṃ tena me sakhi

atra pūrvārghena mānaparigrahānuguṇaṃ sakhīnāmagrataḥ prakāśaṃ pratijñāya tadanirvāhamāśaṅkamānā tadupahāsaṃ parijihīrṣurdoṣābhāsaṃ tadguṇagrāmamāha —āgaḥpramārjanāyaiva cāṭavo yena śikṣitā iti; so'yaṃ guṇasya doṣībhāvo nāma leśabhedo bhavati
anye punaḥ samastameva leśalakṣaṇamācakṣate—yatra doṣasya guṇībhāvo guṇasya ca doṣībhāva iti
he sakhi, capalo nirbhayaścāsau jano bhavatu tena mama kim
yena janenāgaḥpramārjanāyāparādhaproñchanāya paraṃ cāṭavaḥ priyavādāḥ śikṣitāḥ
atra doṣavadābhāsate pratibhātīti doṣābhāso na tvayaṃ paramārthato doṣaḥ
cāṭukāritā hi guṇo yena kṛtāparādho'pi māmanukūlayanmānabhaṅgaṃ karoti
tathā ca capala ityādinā sakhījanoddiṣṭaṃ mānaṃ rāgātkartumaśaktatayā bālayā cāṭukāritā doṣābhāso guṇaḥ ko'pi darśita iti guṇasya doṣatātra
guṇadoṣayormilitayoreva tattvaṃ leśa iti matamāha—anye iti
guṇānāṃ vahanakṣamatvādīnāṃ daurātmyāddoṣāddhuryo dhuraṃdharo gaurvṛṣo dhuri dhurāyāṃ niyujyate
galiḥ punargaurasaṃjāto'nutpannaḥ kiṇo mṛtaśoṇitamāṃsapiṇḍo yatredṛśaḥ skandho sasya sa sukhaṃ yathā syādevaṃ svapiti
‘santaḥ saccaritodayavyasaninaḥ prādurbhavadyantraṇāḥ sarvatraiva janāpavādacakitā jīvanti duḥkhaṃ sadā
avyutpannamatiḥ kṛtena na satā naivāsatā vyākulo yuktāyuktavivekaśūnyahṛdayo dhanyo janaḥ prākṛtaḥ || 126 ||’
santaḥ sadā duḥkhaṃ yathā syādevaṃ jīvanti
sarvatra karye janānāmapavāde dūṣaṇoktau cakitāḥ satarkāḥ
na satā sādhunā kṛtena kāryeṇa naivāsatā asādhunā kāryeṇa vyākulaḥ
doṣaguṇībhāvo guṇadoṣībhāvaśca vyasto'tra kathaṃ na leśa iti pṛcchati—atheti
atra śuddhaparadārāpaharaṇalakṣaṇanindāvyājena stutervihitatvādiyaṃ śuddhānāma vyājastutirguṇadoṣībhāvalakṣaṇālleśānna pṛthak
purāṇātpuṃsaḥ purāṇapuruṣādviṣṇoḥ śrīḥ kamalā ācchidya gṛhītvā tvayā paribhujyate sevyate
he rājan, ikṣvākurnṛpaviśeṣo vaṃśyo yasya tasya tavedaṃ kiṃ yujyate
atha ca purāṇātpuṃso vṛddhātpuruṣācchrīḥ saṃpadācchidya tvayā bhujyata iti tātparyārthaḥ
‘priyo'si prājño'si prabhurasi kulīno'syasi yuvā yuvatyastvāmevaṃ kati na patimurvīśa vṛṇate
ataścaitāṃ kīrtiṃ raghunahuṣamāndhātṛmahiṣīṃ parāmraṣṭuṃ vṛddhāmadhigatanayo nārhati bhavān || 128 ||’
atra stutipadamiśraiva vyājagarhayā stutiritīyaṃ miśrānāma vyājastutirleśabhedaḥ
evaṃ sati kiyatyastaruṇyastvāṃ patiṃ na vṛṇate na svīkurvanti
raghunahuṣamāndhātṝṇāṃ nṛpaviśeṣāṇāṃ mahiṣīṃ mahādevīmata eva vṛddhāmativayaskāṃ ca
kriyādiṣu kartrādīnāmanyaiḥ saha yaḥ samāveśo'vasthānaṃ sā sahoktiḥ
sa samāveśo viviktaḥ kevalaḥ, avivikto miśraḥ
atra surabhivāsarā iti kartṛpadārthaḥ kevala eva janānandaiḥ saha vṛddhiprāptikriyāyāṃ samāviṣṭa iti seyaṃ viviktakartṛkriyāsamāveśā nāma vaisādṛśyavatī sahoktiḥ
surabhivāsarā vasantadivasāḥ janaharṣaiḥ saha vṛddhiṃ yānti
kokilālāpo madhuro manoharo yeṣu te, sugandhayaḥ śobhanagandhavanto vanavāyavo malayānilā yeṣu te
atra kevalasya karturvasantadinasya janānandaiḥ saha vṛddhiprāptikriyāsamāveśaḥ
‘ujjhasi piāi samaaṃ taha vi hu re bhaṇasi kīsa kisiaṃ tti
uvaribhareṇa a aṇṇua muai vaillo vi aṅgaiṃ || 130 ||’
[uhyase priyayā samadaṃ tathāpi khalu re bhaṇasi kimiti kṛśeti
uparibhareṇa ca he ajña muñcati vṛṣabho'pyaṅgāni ||]
atra saṃbodhyamānayuṣmadarthaḥ karmatāmāpanna uhyasa iti kriyāyāṃ kevala eva kriyāpadārthena saha samāviṣṭaḥ; seyaṃ viviktakarmakriyāsamāveśā nāma vaisādṛśyavatī sahoktiḥ
"uhyase priyayā samadaṃ tathāpi khalu re bhaṇasi kimiti kṛśeti
uparibhareṇa ca he ajña muñcati vṛṣabho'pyaṅgāni
" aparādhavatā kenacidabalā durbalā kimiti tvaṃ kṛśeti pṛṣṭā
priyayā samadaṃ sagarvaṃ yathā syādevaṃ tvamuhyase bhriyase
tathāpi re tvaṃ vadasi kimiti kṛśāsi tvamiti
he ajña jñānahīna, uparibhareṇa goṇyādigauraveṇa vṛṣabho'pyaṅgāni muñcati tyajati
atra vahanakriyāyāṃ tvamiti bodhyo'rthaḥ karmībhūtaḥ kevala eva priyāpadārthena saha samāśliṣṭastayośca visadṛśatā vyaktaiva
yatrānekaḥ kartrādirbhinnai kriyādibhirbhedaṃ labhate sā vivikteti kathyate
atra cūtamañjarī mūrcchayā saha varghanakriyāyām, malayānilāścāśrubhiḥ saha vahanakriyāyāṃ pṛthak pṛthagvivekenaiva kartāraḥ samāviṣṭāḥ, seyamapi viviktakartṛkriyāsamāveśaiva vaisādṛśyavatī sahoktiḥ
cūtamañjarī pānthānāṃ mūrcchayā saha vardhate, malayānilāsteṣāṃ pānthānāmaśrubhiḥ saha vahanti vānti bhraśyanti ca
‘dhīreṇa samaṃ jāmā hiaeṇa samaṃ aṇiṭṭhiā uvaesā
ucchāheṇa saha bhuā bāheṇa samaṃ galanti se ullāvā || 132’
utsāhena saha bhujau bāṣpeṇa samaṃ galantyasyā ullāpāḥ ||]
atra yāmādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ dhairyādibhiḥ saha galanakriyāyāmekasyāmevāviviktaḥ samāveśo dṛśyate; seyamaviviktakartṛkriyāsamāveśā nāma vaisādṛśyavatī sahoktiḥ
utsāhena saha bhujau bāṣpeṇa samaṃ galantyasyā ullāpāḥ
" asya rāmasya dhairyeṇa samaṃ yāmā rātripraharā galanti
hṛdayena samamaniṣṭhitā anirvyūḍhā aniścitā vā upadeśā galanti
tato manaḥśūnyatā, tata utsāhatyāgaḥ, tato bhujaskhalanam, tato'śruṇā saha vacanateti krameṇādhikārtito manmathadaśādhikyamuktam
karmaṇāmaviviktakriyāsamāveśe ivaśabdena sahaśabdasya sthāne sasādṛśyā yathā—
ṇaisotteva taraṅge raaṇāi~ va garuaguṇasaāi~ vahantam || 133 ||’
atra dhairyeṇa saha jalasamūhasya, timinivahena sapakṣaparvatalokasya, nadīsrotobhistaraṅgāṇām, ratnaiśca gurukaguṇaśatānāṃ mithaḥ pratīyamānaṃ sādṛśyamivena dyotyate
sahārthaśca vākyārthasāmarthyena labhyata iti seyaṃ dhairyādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ vahanakriyāyāmekasyāmevāvivekataḥ karmabhūtānāmāveśenāviviktakarmakriyāsamāveśā nāma sasādṛśyā sahoktiḥ

dhairyamiva jalasamūhaṃ vahantam, timinivahamiva matsyaviśeṣasamūhamiva sapakṣaṃ pakṣayuktam, svapakṣaṃ svamitraṃ vā parvatalokaṃ mainākādikaṃ vahantam, nadīpravāhāniva taraṅgān vahantam, ratnānīva gurukaguṇaśatāni mahattvādīni vahantam
atra dhairyajalasamūhādīnāṃ mithaḥ sādṛśyaṃ vyaktameva pratīyamānamivaśabdena dyotyate, sāhityaṃ ca vākyārthatayā gamyata iti sahoktiriyaṃ sādṛśyavatī
atra rātrayo dīrghāḥ pāṇḍurāśceti dairghyapāṇḍuratvaguṇayoravivekena rātriṣu rātrīṇāṃ ca tayoḥ śvāsairaṅgaiśca saha samāveśo dṛśyate; seyamaviviktaguṇasamāveśānāmevādyaprayoge'pi sasādṛśyā sahoktiḥ
imā rātrayaḥ saṃprati virahāvasthāyāṃ mama saha dīrghāḥ, mamaivāṅgaiḥ saha candrabhūṣaṇāścandrālaṃkārāstā rātrayaḥ pāṇḍurāśca
virahadaśāyāṃ khedānniḥ śvāsadīrghatā, aṅgapāṇḍimā, rātridīrghatā ca bhavati
atra dīrghatvapāṇḍutvaguṇayoḥ samāveśaḥ sādṛśyagarma eveti sasādṛśyeyaṃ sahoktiḥ
anvācaya ihānyo yaḥ so'pi nānyaḥ samuccayāt || 61
padaiḥ śuddhāśca miśrāśca turīyo dyotakaṃ vinā || 63
samāhārastirohitāvayavabhedaḥ saṃhatipradhānaḥ samuccaya eva, anvācayo yatraikaṃ pradhānamanyadapradhānamanvīyate saḥ
eṣu madhye ādyāstrayaḥ pratipadaṃ vottaratra vā padadyotakaiḥ saha saṃbhavantītyāha—traya iti
turīyo'nubhayāśrayaḥ samuccayo dyotakaṃ cakārādikaṃ vinaiva bhavati
tatra dvipadāśrayaḥ pratipadāśritadyotakatvena dravyayoḥ kriyāsamuccayo yathā—
atra dīpakaśca madanaśceti dve dravye pratipadaṃ cakāreṇaikasyāṃ didyute iti kriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśite; tena didyutāte iti dvivacanam, dīpakamadanāviti cārthe dvandvaśca na bhavati
dīpakaḥ praśastadīpaśca madanaḥ kāmaścādhikaṃ didyute dīpto babhūva
niryatā gacchatā sevakena sakhyādinā ca bodhitaḥ prakāśito jāgaritaśca
ullasantī daśā vartiravasthā ca sya saḥ
dvāre gṛhadvāre madanabodhakabhāve ca saṃvalanaṃ milanaṃ tena māṃsalaḥ sphītaḥ
didyuta iti ‘dyuta dīptau’ ityasya liṭi rūpam
yadi samuccayena niveśanaṃ na syāttadā doṣamāha—teneti
‘nikāmaṃ kṣāmāṅgī sarasakadalīgarbhasubhagā kalāśeṣā mūrtiḥ śaśina iva netrotsavakarī
avasthāmāpannā madanadahanoddāhavidhurā- miyaṃ naḥ kalyāṇī ramayati manaḥ kampayati ca 136’
atra ramayati kampayati ceti dve kriye uttarapadavartinā cakāreṇaikasminmanolakṣaṇe dravye karmaṇi samuccayenaikakālameva niveśite; tenāyamanvācayo na bhavati
iyaṃ mālatī no'smākaṃ mano ramayati kampayati ca
madana eva dahano'gnistasmāduddāhaḥ prakṛṣṭadāhastena vidhurā vihvalāmavasthāṃ daśāmāpannā prāptā
saraso yaḥ kadalyā garbho majjā tadvatsubhagā manoharā
candrasya kalāśeṣā kalanāmātrāvasthitā mūrtiriva netrānandajanikā kalyāṇī kuśalavatī
atra kampayati cetyuttarapadasthena cakāreṇaikatra manolakṣaṇe dravye kriyādvayaniveśanātsamuccayaḥ
‘aprākṛtastu kathamastu na vismayāya yasminnuvāsa karuṇā ca kṛtajñatā ca
lakṣmīśca sāttvikaguṇajvalitaṃ ca tejo dharmaśca mānavijayau ca parākramaśca || 137 ||’
atra karuṇā ca kṛtajñatā cetyādayo guṇāḥ pratyekaṃ bahupadāśrayatvena cākareṇaikasyāmuvāseti kriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśyante
tena guṇeṣu bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati, karuṇākṛtajñatādīnāṃ dvandvasamāsaśca na bhavati yasminnityapekṣāyāṃ cāyameva guṇānāṃ dravyasamuccayo bhavati
yasmin karuṇā dayā, kṛtajñatā vijñatā, lakṣmīḥ saṃpattiḥ, sāttvikaguṇena jājvalyamānaṃ tejaśca, dharmaḥ sukṛtaṃ, māno vinayaḥ, parākramaścovāsa vasati sma
iha kāruṇikasya karuṇāmātrapravṛttyā kṛtajñatāyāḥ sāhajiko'bhāva iti
tathāpyalakṣmīkasya na kimapi ślāghāviṣaya iti salakṣmīkatoktā
niṣpratāpasya sarvamuktaṃ lakṣaṇalaśobhākarameva bhavatīti tejasa ādhikyamuktam
bhavatu yathoktaguṇasaṃpattiḥ, adhārmike sarve guṇā viguṇāyante
mānavinayaparākramāḥ pratyekaṃ mahāpuruṣe viśeṣaguṇā iti te'pyuktā iti
atrānekapadāśritacakārairekākriyāyāṃ nānāguṇāḥ samuccayena niveśitā iti samuccayatā
yadi yasminnityaikadravye guṇasamuccayavivakṣātra tadā so'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ
atra rūpaṃ prema cāṭu ceti bahavo guṇā uttarapadāśrayeṇa cakāreṇāgamadityekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśyante, tenāgamanniti bahuvacanaṃ dvandvo vā na syāt
āsāṃ srīṇāṃ ramaṇeṣu viṣaye idamidaṃ kārmaṇatvaṃ vaśīkaraṇe mūlakarmatvamāgamat yayau
manojñarūpaṃ kāryamanapekṣya vikāśi sahajaprakāśavatprem, akṛtakaḥ svābhāvikaḥ saṃbhrama ādaro yatredṛśaṃ cāṭu kauśalaṃ ca
atra rūpādayo guṇā antyapadasthitacakāreṇa gamanarūpākriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśitā iti samuccayaḥ
‘vicintyamānaṃ manasāpi dehināmidaṃ hi lokeṣu cakāsti durlabham
niśā sacandrā madirā ca sotpalā priyānurāgo'bhinavaṃ ca yauvanam ||’

atra niśā madirā ca dravye, anurāgo yauvanaṃ ca guṇau, bahuṣvapi padeṣu dvandve satyapi uttarapadāśrayaniveśinā cakāreṇa cakāstītyekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ niveśyante; tena cakāsatīti bahuvacanaṃ samāsaśca na syāt
ayameva ca durlabhamityapekṣāyāṃ dravyaguṇānāṃ guṇasamuccayo bhavati
idaṃ lokeṣu bhuvaneṣu madhye dehināṃ prāṇināṃ vicintyamānaṃ manasāpi dulabhameva cakāsti
sacandrā rātriḥ, sakamalaṃ madyam, priyāyā anurāgaḥ prītiḥ, abhinavaṃ yauvanaṃ ca
ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca saṃdhye dharmaśca jānāti narasya vṛttam 140’
atrādityacandrādayo dravyaviśeṣā uttarapadaniveśinā pratipadaniveśinā ca cakāraṇa jānātītyekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ saṃniveśyante
tena ca bahuvacanābhāve samāsābhāve caiṣa miśraḥ samuccayabhedo bhavati
anilo vāyuḥ, analo'gniḥ dyaurākāśaḥ, āpo jalam, hṛdayam, yamaḥ, aho dinam, ubhe prātaḥsāyam, dharmo vidhātā cāyaṃ janasya vṛttaṃ caritraṃ jānāti
atroktam, upekṣā, utthitamityete kriyādravyaviśeṣā itaretarayogena madavilāsadyotanakriyāyāṃ niveśyante; tena dyotayantīti bahuvacanaṃ dvandvasamāsaśca tadvivakṣāyāṃ syāt
na ceha dyotakaścakāra uttarapade pratipadaṃ vā vidyata iti so'yamanubhayāśrayaḥ samuccayamedaḥ
yatra dvipade bahupade vā cakāro nāsti samuccayo'nvācayo'pi na bhavati
dīpakalakṣaṇena tasya viṣayīkaraṇādekatravartinā kriyādivācakapadena sarvavākyopakārakatvasya dīpakatvāt, tādṛśasamuccayānvācayayośca tatsattvādityāśayaḥ
āsāṃ strīṇāmetāni madavibhramaṃ mattatāvilāsaṃ dyotayanti sma
tānyāha —sahāvaśeṣairavaśiṣṭabhāgairvartate sāvaśeṣaṃ sakhaṇḍaṃ padaṃ yatredṛśamuktaṃ vacanam
srastāni skhalitāni yāni mālāvastrālaṃkaraṇāni teṣūpekṣā asaṃvaraṇam
akāraṇato hetuṃ vinaiva gantuṃ gamanaṃ kartumutthitamutthāna ca
atroktādervacanādirūpakriyātmakasya tadāśrayasya dravyasya mitho yogena pradhānakriyāyāṃ niveśaḥ
vareṣu yadbālamṛgākṣi mṛgyate tadasti kiṃ vyastamapi trilocane 142’
atra ‘yadvareṣu mṛgyate tatkiṃ trilocane vyastamapyasti’ iti bruvan vapurvayovasūnāṃ samudāyaṃ samastamevābhisaṃdhatte
sa iha yadityekavacanāntena napuṃsakena ca kathyate
na ceha kvacidapi cakāro'stīti so'yamapyanubhayāśrayaḥ samuccayamedaḥ
he bālamṛgākṣi śiśuhariṇanetre gauri, vareṣu yanmṛgyate'nviṣyate tattrilocane śive vyastamapyekaikamapyasti kim
tadāha—vapuḥ śarīraṃ virūpamakṣi yatra tādṛśaṃ virūpaṃ virūddhasvarūpam
diśa evāmbaraṃ yasya tadbhāvena vasu dhanaṃ niveditaṃ kathitam
bhṛgyata iti mṛga anveṣaṇe karmaṇi lakāraḥ
sā babhūva vaśavartinī dvyoḥ śūlinaḥ suvadanā madasya ca || 143 ||’

atra śūlino madasya cetyattarapadāśrayeṇa cakāreṇa dvau dravyaviśeṣau ‘vaśavartinī’ ityetasmin guṇapade yadītaretarayogena saṃniveśyete tadā ‘viparivartitahriyoḥ’ ityādiṣu ‘dvyoḥ’ itiparyanteṣu dvivacanamekaśeṣo vā na syāt
sā suvadanā gaurī śūlino harasya madasya mattatāyāśca dvyorvaśavartinī āyattā babhūva
ata eva śayanaṃ neṣyatoḥ śavyāṃ necchatoḥ
vicintyamānamiti śloke idamityekatvaklībatvābhyāṃ samāhāra ukta ityarthaḥ
samāhārastu cayogaviṣayo vicintyamānamityādinaivoktaḥ, anvācayastu kriyāviṣaya evopapadyate
‘gacchantīnāṃ ramaṇavasatiṃ yoṣitāṃ tatra naktaṃ rūddhāloke narapatipathe sūcibhedyaistamobhiḥ
saudāminyā kanakanikaṣasnigdhayā darśayorvī toyotsargastanitamukharo mā ca bhūrviklavāstāḥ || 144’

atra pūrvaṃ ‘darśaya’ ityurvīkarmaviṣayatvena kriyāmupanyasya ‘toyotsargastanitamukharo mā ca bhūḥ’ iti tatkartaryeva dharmiṇyakarmakaṃ kriyāntaramanvācīyate, so'yaṃ bhinnakālatvabhinnaviṣayatvābhyāmanvācayaḥ samuccayādbhinno bhavati
nanvevaṃ yadi samuccaye'pi bhinnaviṣaye kriye tulyakālameva prayujyete; ko doṣaḥ syāt
kiṃtu tasya samuccayamudrayā viṣayo'pahṛta iti nodāhriyate
tatra strīṇāṃ saudāminyā vidyutā tvamurvī bhūmiṃ darśaya
kanakasya hiraṇyasya nikaṣaḥ kaṣapaṭṭikāyāṃ kaṣaṇarekhā tadvatsnigdhayā ramyayā toyatyāgastanitamukhastvaṃ mā bhūḥ mā bhava
‘nikaṣaḥ kaṣarekhāyāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ kaṣasya ca’ iti medinīkāraḥ
samuccaye ekakālika ekaviṣaye'nvayaḥ, atratvanvaye kālabhedo viṣayabhedaśceti bhedādityarthaḥ
samuccaye ubhayadharmavattve'pi samuccayatvenaiva viṣayaparihāraḥ, iha tu vivakṣayaiva vinigamanetyāśayaḥ
atra ‘vāgarthāviva’ iti paravalliṅgatā ‘saṃpṛktau pitarau’ ityatra yo'yaṃ ‘pumān striyā 1
70’ iti caikaśeṣastenaiṣa viśeṣalakṣaṇayogādvakroktitve satyalaṃkāratā labhata iti; na dhavakhadirādiṣvatiprasaṅga ityayamapi samuccayabhedaḥ
yathā śabdastadvācyo'rthaśca dvau nityasaṃbaddhau vācyavācakatvasaṃbandhena tathā yau nityasaṃbaddhāvityarthaḥ
pitā ca mātā ceti dvandve ‘pitā mātrā 1
yadvā pārvatīṃ pātīti pārvatīpo haraḥ, ramāyā lakṣmyā īśvaro haristau vande
yadvā pārvatīparo haro māyā lakṣmyā īśvaro haristau haraharī vande
77’ iti ca viśeṣalakṣaṇayogastena dhavakhadirapalāśamityevamādiṣu nātiprasaṅgā bhavati
yatra nagare manobhuvā kāmena tanmukhe strīṇāṃ mukhe'kṣibhruvanibhaṃ netrabhrūvyāja śarakārmukaṃ nyastamāropitam
strīṇāṃ hāvaiḥ śṛṅgārajakriyāmirnijakārye manaścāpalādau kṛte sati
śuddhā miśrā ca sākṣepo rodho nākṣepataḥ pṛthak || 64
vidhinā hetunā pratiṣedhena vā hetunā yā pratiṣedhasyoktirnirvacanaṃ sā ākṣepaḥ
ākṣepalakṣaṇenaiva gṛhītatvādrodho na tato bhinna ityarthaḥ
‘gaccha gacchasi cetkānta panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ
mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyādyatra gato bhavān || 147 ||’
atra ‘gaccha’ ityasya vidhivākyasya ‘mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyāt’ ityāśiṣānukūlatayaiva maraṇasūcanānniṣedhaḥ kriyata iti śuddho'yaṃ vidhyākṣepaḥ
iha he kānta vallabha, cedyadi gacchasi tadā gaccha
kiṃtu bhavānyatra gato bhūyāttatraiva mamāpi janma bhūyāditi
atra gamanasya vidhirūpasya janma bhūyādityanena vidhirūpeṇaiva tvayi gate mayā martavyamiti maraṇasūcanādvidhinā gamanapratiṣedhoktiḥ anyāsaṃkareṇa ca śuddhatā
‘alaṃ vivādena yathā śrutaṃ tvayā tathāvidhastāvadaśeṣamastu saḥ
mamātra bhāvaikarasaṃ manaḥ sthitaṃ na kāmavṛttirvacanīyamīkṣate 148’

atra ‘alaṃ vivādena’ iti niṣedhena, ‘tathāvidhaḥ so'stu—’ iti vidhinā ca tanmatamavasthāpya, ‘mamātra bhāvaikarasaṃ manaḥ sthitam’ iti vidhinā, ‘na kāmavṛttirvacanīyamīkṣate’ iti pratiṣedhena ca yatpunarākṣipati, so'yaṃ vidhiniṣedhābhyāṃ vidhimiśra ākṣepo bhavati
tvayā yathā śrutaṃ tatra vivādenālaṃ niṣphalam
aśeṣaṃ samagraṃ yathā syādevaṃ sa tāvattathāvidha evāstu
yadyapi bhave virūpākṣatvādikaṃ tvaduktaṃ vartate, tathāpi manmanastadekaparamityarthaḥ
atra hetuḥ kāmavṛttiricchāvyāpāro vacanīyaṃ vaktavyaṃ nekṣate na paśyati
atra niṣedhavidhibhyāṃ tanmatasthāpanarūpasya vidhervighiniṣedhābhyāmākṣepa iti vidhyākṣepo'yaṃ miśraḥ
atra ‘kutaḥ kuvalayaṃ karṇe karoṣi’ ityasya niṣedhavākyasya ‘kimapāṅgam—’ ityādinā praśnapareṇāpi niṣedhaparyavasāyinā vākyena samarthanaṃ kriyata ityayaṃ śuddho niṣedhākṣepaḥ
he kalabhāṣiṇi madhuravacane, kasmānnīlotpalaṃ karṇe karoṣi
kuta iti pratiṣedhe hetumāha—asmin karmaṇi kāmivaśīkaraṇādau kimapāṅgaṃ netraprāntamaparyāptamasamarthaṃ tvaṃ manyase
‘saccaṃ guruo giriṇo ko bhaṇai jalāsaā ṇa gambhīrā
dhīrehiṃ uvama māuṃ taha vi khu maha ṇatthi ucchāho || 150 ||’
[satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ ko bhaṇati jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ

atra ‘satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ’ iti vidhiḥ, ‘ka āha jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ’ iti paramatākṣepastābhyāṃ girīṇāṃ gurutvam sāgarāṇāṃ ca gāmbhīryaṃ yadayamuttarārdhena dhīrāpekṣayā niṣedhati, anyāpekṣayā tattadeva vidhatte; sa eṣa miśro niṣedhākṣepaḥ
‘satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ ko bhaṇati jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ
ko vadati jalāśayāḥ sāgarā na gambhīrāḥ kiṃtu gambhīrā eva
girisāgarau dhīraiḥ sahopamātuṃ sadṛśīkartuṃ tathāpi mama notsāho'sti dhīrāṇāṃ tayorādhikyāt
‘jalāśayo jalādhāraḥ’ iti koṣādyadyapi jalāśayapadaṃ jalādhāramātrārthakaṃ tathāpyatigāmbhīryayogyatayā sāgaraparam
uktyā yuktyā ca rodho ya ākṣepaḥ so'yamucyate || 65
kriyāsūdyogināṃ hetudvārā yannivāraṇamuktyā yuktyā ca sa rodhaḥ
ettia jampiasāraṃ ṇihaṇaṃ aṇṇe vi vajjadhārāsu vaā || 151’
atra ‘kimaḥ’ pratikulavācitvād vacanavṛttyaiva jalpan daśānanaścitrarathena ruddhaḥ, kāraṇaṃ ca vajraprabhāvakīrtanāditi prātikūlyenopanyastam; so'yamauktaḥ pratikūlaśca vidhyākṣepo rodha ityucyate
" iha he daśamukha rāvaṇa, jalpitena bhāṣitena kim
etāvadetadeva jalpitasāraṃ śreṣṭham yadanye'pi yodhā vajradhārasu nidhanaṃ nāśaṃ gatāḥ
atra jalpan rāvaṇaścitrarathena vajraprabhāvakīrtanarūpapratikūloktyā rūddha iti vidhyākṣepavirodhaḥ
kiṃ icchasi kāuṃ je pavaavai piaṃ ti viṇpiaṃ rahavaiṇo 152’
kimicchasi kartuṃ yatplavagapate priyamiti vipriyaṃ raghupateḥ ||]
atrāpi ‘kimaḥ’ pratiṣedhavācitvāt vacanavṛttyaiva daśānanavadhāyottiṣṭhamānaḥ sugrīvo jāmbavatā ruddhaḥ, kāraṇaṃ punarānukūlyenaivoktam—'kimetat tvayā raghupateḥ priyarūpaṃ viprayamupakrāntam’ iti
kimicchasi kartuṃ plavagapate'sya priyamiti vipriyaṃ raghupateḥ
" iha he plavagapate sugrīva, daśavadanaṃ hantuṃ vimārgamāṇo yācamānastvaṃ raghupate rāmasya kiṃ priyamiti kṛtvā vipriyamaniṣṭaṃ kartumicchasi
daśavadanamevātmanā hantuṃ tvaritasya, prabhuṇā jighāṃsitasya hi vadhe'parādha iti sa eva puruṣottamastaṃ ghātayatu
atra rāvaṇavadhodyamo vidhiruktyaiva jāmbavatā ruddho'nukūlatayā hetumudbhāvyeti rodho'yaṃ vidhyākṣepaśeṣaḥ
nirgacchati mukhādvāṇī mā gā iti karomi kim || 153 ||’
atra kimaḥ praśnārthatve'pi yuktyā niṣedhārthatvaṃ gamyate, so'yaṃ yaukto'nukūlaśca vidhyākṣepo rodha ityucyate
ayameva cāsyā vaiyātyoktipakṣe yauktaḥ pratikūlavidhyākṣepo rodho bhavati
matpriyaiṣiṇī strītvena strī priyatvānmā gā iti vāṇī mama mukhānnirgacchatīti kiṃ karomi
‘matpriyaṃ tvatpriyaiṣiṇī’ iti pāṭhe tu tvatpriyaiṣiṇyahaṃ gaccheti vivakṣāmi, matpriyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā mā gā iti vāṇī niḥsaratīti yojyam
atra kiṃ karomītyasya yuktyā prakṛtopapattyā niṣedhārthatāvagamaḥ
yadi vaiyātyātprāgalbhyād viparītamabhidhatte tadā mā gaccheti vaktumicchāmi, gaccheti vāṇī niḥsaratītyatra kiṃ karomīti tadā yuktisiddha eva rodho'yam
juṇṇasurā sāhīṇā asaī mā hou kiṃ marau || 184 ||’
jīrṇasurā svādhīnā asatī mā bhavatu kiṃ mriyatām ||]
atra ‘asatī mā bhavatu’ iti yaḥ pratiṣedhamāha sa ‘pracurayuvā grāmaḥ—’ ityādi kāraṇamuktvā tataḥ ‘kiṃ mriyatām’ iti pratikūlyena rudhyate
tatra kimaḥ kākvā sāsūyapraśnārthasya yuktyā niṣedhārthatvaṃ gamyate; so'yaṃ yauktaḥ pratikūlaniṣedhākṣepo rodha ityucyate
jīrṇasurā svādhīnā asatī bhā bhavatu kiṃ mriyatām
madhumāso vasantaḥ, yauvanam, svāmī sthaviro vṛddhaḥ
jīrṇasurā purāṇamadyaṃ svādhīnaṃ nijāyattamato'satī sā mā bhavatu kiṃ mriyatām
yadyasmin vatsare sā cañcalā na syānmriyetaivetyarthaḥ
atra kiṃ mriyatāmiti kimaḥ kākugarbhatayā sāsūyapraśnārthatā yuktyā niṣedhaviṣayiṇī jñāyata iti rodho'yam
atra ‘stanādivadasyā madhyo'pi mā kṣīyatām’ iti niṣedhavādī kenacidānukūlyena rūdhyate
iyaṃ hyetābhyāmanyamīkṣamāṇā yanna paśyati so'hamiva madhyo'pi kṣīyamāṇo lakṣyate tatra kimaḥ praśnārthatve niṣedhārthatvaṃ gamyate; so'yaṃ yaukto'nukūlaśca niṣedhākṣepo rodha ityucyate
" ihāsyā nāyikāyā madhyaḥ kathaṃ mā kṣīyatāṃ na kṣīṇatāṃ yātu
atrānayā netrābhyāmanyamīkṣamāṇayā yathāhaṃ na dṛṣṭa ityahaṃ kṣīṇastathā madhyo'pi tenaiva kṣīṇatāpanna iti lakṣyate
iyamatiprabhutā kriyate balādakupito'pi hi yatkupito janaḥ 156’

atra ‘akupito'pi kupitaḥ kriyate’ iti yo'yaṃ niṣedhākṣeparūpa upālambhaḥ, tatra ca ‘bhrukuṭirāracitā—’ ityādivaiyātyena pratikūlaṃ kāraṇamupanyasya, ‘seyamatiprabhutā, so'yaṃ balātkāraḥ’ iti kakvā vācanikamevopālambhamabhidhatte; tenāyamauktaḥ pratikūlaśca niṣedhākṣepo rodha ityucyate
ayameva cāsyā avaiyātyoktipakṣe svarūpākhyānādaukto'nukūlaniṣedhākṣepo rodho bhavati
hi yato'kopavānapi jano balātkāreṇa kopavān kriyate
atra dhārṣṭyena pratikūlakāraṇamupanyasya kākvā vācanika evopālambhaḥ
yadā tu kāraṇamupanyasyāpi kriyāsūttiṣṭhamāno na rūdhyate tadākṣepa eva na rodhaḥ
sahio gajjiasaddo taha vi hu se ṇatthi jīvie āsaṃgo ||’
atra kadambavātātivāhanādīnāṃ jīvitādhyavasāyahetūnāmupanyāse'pi kriyāsūttiṣṭhamāno na rudhyate kathamayaṃ na jīvatīti
kiṃ tarhi kāraṇamevākṣipyate—‘tathāpi nāstyasya jīvite'dhyavasāya’ iti
soḍho garjitaśabdastathāpi khalvasya nāsti jīvite āsaṅgaḥ
’ ihāsya rāmasya tathāpi jīvite prāṇadhāraṇe āsaṅgo'dhyavasāyo nāsti
yadyapi kadambapuṣpasaṃparkiṇo vātā gamitā nītāḥ dṛṣṭaṃ meghāndhakārayuktaṃ gaganatalam, garjitarūpaḥ śabdaḥ soḍhaḥ śrutaḥ
prayāṇocitakāle śaradyapi yadi na gamanaṃ syāttadā priyāsamāgamo me na syāditi buddhiḥ
yadvā kadambavātā gamitāḥ, vikasadamalakamalavātāḥ kathaṃ gamitavyāḥ
moghāndhakāritaṃ gaganatalaṃ dṛṣṭam, śaraccandracandrikādhavalitaṃ kathaṃ draṣṭavyam
garjitaśabdaḥ soḍhaḥ, kalahaṃsakalaravaḥ kathaṃ soḍhavya iti vimarśenānadhyavasāyaḥ
yadvā etairevānarthasārthaiḥ kadarthitā vyarthapratyāśāsamarthanā sītā yadi bhṛtā syāttadā madīyāśānāśa eva bhaveditibudhdyānadhyavasāyaḥ
atra jīvanakriyāyāmupasthitasya na rodhaḥ, kiṃ tu kāraṇākṣepa evetyākṣepatā
kriyodyatasyāpi vāraṇe kāraṇānāmanyaparatve rodho na bhavati
‘dhanaṃ ca bahu labhyante sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ ca vartmani
na ca me prāṇasaṃdehastathāpi priya mā sma gāḥ || 158 ||’
prabhūtārthalābhādīnāṃ kāraṇānāṃ gamanaparatvameva na nivāraṇaparatvam; ato'yaṃ na rodhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ākṣepa eva bhavati
he priya, yadyapi te tava dhanaṃ bahu pracuraṃ labhyaṃ prāpyam
tathāpi tvaṃ mā gāḥ sma māyāsīḥ
kiṃcana kimapi vastu vācyaṃ prastutya prakramya tadvastusādhanasamarthasyānyasya vastuno vākyārthanyāsa upanyāso yaḥ so'rthāntaranyāsaḥ
atra parītāpāpaharaṇakṣamasya jaladākhyasya mahāvastuno nyasanaṃ vidhāya tatsādhanasādharmyeṇaiva tatsādhanakṣamaṃ mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaṃ vastvantaramupanyasyati, so'yaṃ sādharmyeṇārthāntaranyāsaḥ
srajaṃ na kācidvijahau jalāvilāṃ vasanti hi premṇi guṇā na vastuni || 160
atrāpi priyatamena svayaṃ kāntāhṛdaye samāropitāyāḥ srajaḥ prema-kāraṇamupanyasya jalāviladoṣavatyā api srajo yadatyāgakāraṇaṃ tadiha vaidharmyadvāreṇa pratipāditamato vaidharmyeṇāyamarthāntaranyāsaḥ
kācinnārī jalāvilāmapi srajaṃ mālāṃ na vijahau na tatyāja
priyeṇa saṃgrathya grathitvā māṃsalakucavati hṛdaye vipakṣasva sapatnyāḥ samīpe upāhitāmāropitām
atropapattimāha—hi yataḥ premṇi prītau guṇā vasanti na vastuni guṇā vasanti
‘jo jassa hiaadaio dukkhaṃ dento vi so suhaṃ dei
[yo yasya hṛdayadayito duḥkhaṃ dadadapi sa sukhaṃ dadāti
atra sādhanasamarthaṃ vastu prathamata evopanyasya paścāt tatsādhyamabhihitamiti viparyāsādayaṃ viparyayo nāmārthāntaranyāsaḥ
“yo yasya hṛdayadayito duḥkhaṃ dadadapi sa tathā tasya
” iha yo yasya hṛdayapriyaḥ sa duḥkhaṃ dadadapi tasya tathā priya eva
atra hetuḥ—dayitanakhena duḥkhitayorapi stanayo romāñco vardhate
pratyanīkaḥ paripanthī, pratīko'vayava ekadeśa iti yāvat
‘te viralā sappurisā je abhaṇantā ghaḍanti kajjālāve
thoaccia te vi dumā je amuṇiakusumaṇiggamā denti phalam ||’
stokā eva te'pi drumā ye'jñātakusumanirgamā dadati phalam ||]
stokā eva te'pi drumā ye'jñātakusumanirgamā dadati phalam
ye kāryārthamālāpamājñāmabhaṇyamānā ghaṭante kāryārūḍhā bhavanti, te'pi vṛkṣāḥ stokā evālpā eva ye'jñātapuṣpodgamāḥ santaḥ phalaṃ dadati
kṣīyante teṣāṃ virahe viralā eva saritpravāhā iva ||]
atra yadidamupakṛtyānapekṣitapratyupakārāṇāṃ gamanam, yaccākṛtapratyupakārāṇāṃ tadvirahe'vasādanaṃ tadubhayamapi jaladharasaritpravāhayoranyonyātiśayitayorupanyasyamānaṃ pratyanīkanyāso bhavati
kṣīyante teṣāṃ virahe viralā eva saritpravāhā iva
” iha ye upakṛtya upakāraṃ kṛtvā nirapekṣāḥ pratyupakārānapekṣā vartante te viralā alpāḥ
yathā medhā upakāraṃ kṛtvā pratyupakāranispṛhā vartante tathetyarthaḥ
teṣāmupakāriṇāṃ virahe viralā eva kṣīyante duḥkhitā bhavanti
yathā nadīpravāhā upakāriṇāṃ meghānāṃ virahe kṣīṇā bhavanti tathetyarthaḥ
pratinidhibhūtamanīkaṃ sainyaṃ yasya saḥ pratyanīkaḥ paripanthī
atra vighnaprotsāraṇasamarthāyā bāṇamokṣalakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ prathamāvayavabhūtaṃ jyāśabdaṃ dhanuṣo huṃkāramiveti tatsādhanamupanyasya pratīkanyāsanāmānamarthāntaranyāsamabhidhatte
bāṇasaṃdhāne dhanuṣi bāṇāropaṇe tasya kā kathā
yataḥ sa rājā dūrāt jyāśabdenaiva vighnānyapohati vārayati
yadyapi ‘vighno'ntarāyaḥ pratyūhaḥ’ ityamarādvighnaśabde puṃstvam, tathāpi ‘liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvāt’ iti napuṃsakatvamapi
ata eva ‘avighnamastu te stheyāḥ piteva dhuri putriṇām’ iti raghuprayogo'pi
‘sa hi vighnānapohatī’ ti vā pāṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ
viśeṣadarśanāyādhikyakhyāpanārthaṃ guṇādīnāṃ madhye yatteṣāṃ vaikalyadarśanaṃ vikalatvābhidhānaṃ sā viśeṣoktiḥ
tatra hi nātiśayo vācyaḥ kiṃtu kāraṇāntaram
atra tīkṣṇenākaṭhoreṇa cāyudhena puṣpadhanvā trīṇi jaganti vijayata iti tasya prabhāvātiśayaḥ pratīyate; seyaṃ pratīyamānaviśeṣaheturguṇavaikalyavatī viśeṣoktiḥ
kāmasya praharaṇaṃ na kaṭhinaṃ na vā niśitam
atra devakanyakātvābhāve'pyeṣā vedhaso'pi tapobhaṅgaṃ vidhātumalamiti varṇanīyāyā rūpātiśayaḥ pratīyate; seyaṃ pratīyamānaviśeṣaheturjātivaikalyavatī viśeṣoktiḥ
eṣā na devakanyā nāpi gandharvavaṃśajā tathāpi vedhaso brahmaṇo'pi tapobhaṅgaṃ vidhātumalaṃ samarthā
na ca raktābhavaddṛṣṭirjitaṃ ca dviṣatāṃ kulam || 167 ||’
atra bhrūbhaṅgāderabhāve'pi yo'yaṃ dviṣatāṃ jayastena varṇanīyasya pratāpātiśayaḥ pratīyate; seyaṃ pratīyamānaviśeṣahetuḥ kriyāvaikalyavatī viśeṣoktiḥ
bhrūbhaṅgo na baddhaḥ, adharo'pi na sphuritaḥ, dṛṣṭirapi na raktā vṛttā, tathāpi vīra, tvayā dviṣatāṃ śatrūṇāṃ kulaṃ jitam
‘na rathā na ca mātaṅgā na hayā na ca pattayaḥ
na rathā na ca hastino nāśvā na vā padātayaḥ santi tathāpi strīṇāmapāṅgadṛṣṭyaiva kaṭākṣeṇaiva lokatrayaṃ jīyate
prathamā dravyavaikalyavatī, iyaṃ tu dravyaikadeśavaikalyavatīti bhedaḥ

atra rathādīnāṃ dravyāṇāmekacakratvādibhirvaikalye'pi yadetadbhagavato bhāskarasya bhuvanatrayākramaṇaṃ tasyeha tejasvitā heturabhidhīyate; seyamabhidheyaviśeṣaheturvaikalyavaddravyā nāmāparā viśeṣoktiḥ
rathasyaikaṃ cakram, yantā sārathiranūrurvikalaścaraṇahīnaḥ, aśvā viṣamāḥ sapta, tathāpi ravistejasvī jagattrayamākrāmati
dravyasya yogāyogābhyāmavaikalyenāpi kvacideṣā viśeṣāyāviśeṣāya ca yathā—
atra ‘ayaṃ tathā spṛṣṭoṃ'saḥ sa puṇyavān, tayā cāspṛṣṭaṃ śeṣamaṅgaṃ me nirarthakam’ iti yo'yamavaikalyadarśane'pi viśeṣastenaiṣāhetumatyāpi hetumatā viśeṣyamāṇā yathoktā viśeṣoktirbhavati
yā punarihorvaśyāmito vākyādguṇādivaiśiṣṭyāvagatiḥ sā paryāyoktirna viśeṣoktiḥ
ayamaṃso bāhumūlaṃ tayā striyā ratilobhānnijāṃsena nipīḍita ityeka evāyaṃ mamāṅge kṛtī ramyaḥ
kriyā dhātvarthaḥ, kārakaṃ karmādi, saṃbandhī saṃbandhavān, sārdhyaṃ sisādhayiṣitam, dṛṣṭānto nidarśanam, vastu padārthaḥ
atra ‘mārutilabdhapratyayāgataharṣam’ ityanena, ‘uraḥsthalavanamālāmṛditamadhukaram’ ityanena copagūhanakriyāyāḥ parikaritatvādayaṃ kriyāparikaraḥ
yadvā vyavasitaścikīrṣito rāmasāhāyyarūpo nivedito'rtho yena saḥ
mārutinā hanūmatā labdhapratyayena prāptaviśvāsenāgataharṣaṃ yathā syādevamuraḥsthalasya vanamālāyāṃ mṛditā madhukarā yatra tadyathā syādevamityupagūhanakriyāyā viśeṣaṇadvayam
atra ‘hastaśithilitanirodhapāṇḍurasamucchvasatkapolā’ ityanena, ‘preritavāmapayodharaviṣamonnatadakṣiṇastanī’ ityanena ca ‘janakasutā’ iti ca kārakapadasya parikaritatvādayaṃ kārakaparikaraḥ
na kevalaṃ mūrcchitā kiṃtu patitāpīti cakārārthaḥ
hastena śithilīkṛto nirodho yantraṇaṃ kapolasya ata eva pāṇipīḍanatyāgātpāṇḍuraḥ samucchvasan kapolo yasyāḥ sā
yadvā hastaprahatanirodhena tatsaṃparkātpāṇḍuraḥ pīḍanatyāgātsamucchvasan kapolo yasyāḥ sā
preritena vāmena payodhareṇa stanena viṣamastiraścīna unnato dakṣiṇaḥ stano yasyāḥ sā
yadvā strīṇāṃ vāmaḥ stano nijo dakṣiṇaḥ puruṣasyeti tenaiva patitā
ṇijjantāṇa ṇirāā girīṇa maggeṇa patthiā ṇaisottā ||173||’
nīyamānānāṃ nirāyatāni girīṇāṃ mārgeṇa prasthitāni nadīsrotāṃsi ||]
atroddriyamāṇagirisaṃbandhino'prayojakā api nadīpravāhā viśeṣaṇairupaskṛtā iti saṃbandhiparikaro'yam
nīyamānānāṃ nirāyatāni girīṇāṃ mārgeṇa prasthitāni nadīsrotāṃsi
unmūlitānāṃ cālanataḥ khaṇḍitāni, utkṣipyamāṇānāṃ ṛjukamavakraṃ yathā syādevamapasṛtāni, nīyamānānāṃ nirāyatāni vegavaśādavakrāṇi ca
‘dhīraṃ harai visāo viṇaaṃ jovvaṇamao aṇaṅgo lajjam
ekkantagahiavakkho kiṃ sesau jaṃ ṭhavei vaapariṇāmo || 174 ||’
ekāntagṛhītapakṣaḥ kiṃ śiṣyatāṃ yaṃ sthāpayati vayaḥpariṇāmaḥ ||]
atra gatavayaso na dhairyam, na vinayo, na lajjeti sādhyaṃ viṣādayauvanamadānaṅgakriyādṛṣṭāntairupaskṛtamiti sādhyaparikaro'yam
ekāntagṛhītapakṣaḥ kiṃ śiṣyate yaṃ sthāpayati vayaḥpariṇāmaḥ
” iha viṣādo dhairyaṃ harati, vinayamanauddhatyaṃ vaśitvaṃ vā yauvanamado harati, anaṅgo lajjāṃ harati
yadvāntaḥsvarūpe eko gṛhītapakṣaḥ sarvaharasvarūpo yena sa kyaḥpariṇāmo yatsthāpayati sthirīkaroti tatkiṃ śiṣyate'vaśiṣyate, kiṃtu sarvameva haratīti bhāvaḥ
atra prakṣiptamandarasamudrodāharaṇabhūtaṃ ravirathacakraṃ ‘utkaṭākṣakoṭi’ iti viśeṣaṇena sāmyasiddhaye parikaritamiti dṛṣṭāntaparikaro'yam
‘devī putramasūta nṛtyata gaṇāḥ kiṃ tiṣṭhatetyudbhuje harṣādbhṛṅgiriṭāvudāhṛtagirā cāmuṇḍayāliṅgite
atra cāmuṇḍābhṛṅgiriṭipariṣvaṅgasaṃghaṭṭitaparasparahṛdayāsthijanmanaḥ śabdasya vastutayā parigṛhītasya ‘devī putramasūta—’ ityādibhiḥ parikaritatvādayaṃ vastuparikaraḥ

tato he gaṇāḥ, nṛtyata nṛtyaṃ kuruka kimupaviṣṭā bhavatha iti kṛtvā udbhuje uttolitabāhau bhṛṅgiriṭau bhṛṅgināmake gaṇe cāmuṇḍayā āliṅgite sati tayorbhṛṅgiriṭicāmuṇḍayo ravaḥ śabdo vo yuṣmān pāyādrakṣatu
parasparāṅgasaṃbandhena jarjaraṃ sphuṭitaṃ yajjīrṇaṃ sthūlāsthi tasmājjanma utpattiryasya saḥ
atra śabdaviśeṣasya vastutvena gṛhītasya viśeṣaṇaiḥ pariṣkāraḥ
yathā samāsena kriyā viśeṣyate tathā yadi kṛttaddhitādibhirviśeṣyate tadā kriyāparikara eva
‘gehādyātā saritamudakaṃ hārikā nājihīṣe maṅkṣyāmīti śrayasi yamunātīravīrudgṛhāṇi
gosaṃdāyī viśasi vipinānyeva govardhanādre- rna tvaṃ rādhe dṛśi nipatitā devakīnandanasya || 177 ||’
10’ ityādibhirupapadabhūtāpi kriyaiva viśeṣyate, tenāyamaparaḥ kriyāparikaro bhavati
he rādhe, tvaṃ devakīnandanasya kṛṣṇasya dṛśi netre na nipatitāsi
tvaṃ gehātsaritaṃ nadīṃ yātā gatā udakaṃ hārikā udakamāhartuṃ na punarājihīṣe na punarāgacchasi
maṅkṣyāmi snāsyāmīti kṛtvā yamunātīre vīrudhāṃ latānāṃ gṛhāṇi śrayasyāśrayasi
gosaṃdāyī gavāṃ bandhanakāriṇī satī govardhanādrervanānyeva viśesi ca
130’ ityanena lakṣaṇādiśatrādyantena kriyā viśeṣyate tatrāpi kriyāparikaro draṣṭavyaḥ
yathā puṣpāt svavṛkṣe svayaṃ gataḥ phalatastu samāyāta ityādi(?)
stanopapīḍaṃ nunude nitambinā ghanena kaścijjaghanena kāntayā ||’
salīlaṃ savilāsaṃ yathā syādevaṃ puṣpāvataṃsakaṃ samāsajantyā āropayantyā
tatra hi yasmāddhātorloḍādistasmādevāgrimapratyaya iti kriyāyā viśeṣaṇatvena parikaratā
‘śayyante hataśāyikāḥ pathi tarucchāyāniṣaṇṇādhvagaiḥ śrīkaṇṭhāyataneṣu dhārmikajanairāsyanta uṣṭrāsikāḥ
śūnye tatra nikuñjaśākhini sakhi grīṣmasya madhyaṃdine sajjānāṃ dayitābhisāraṇavidhau ramyaḥ kṣaṇo vartate || 179 ||’
atra ‘uṣṭrāsikā āsyante’, ‘hataśāyikāḥ śayyante’ ityamūbhyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣopacaritarūpo bhāvātmā ṇvulaiva pratyāyyate

yāhi nāmoṣṭrasya kutsāvatyo bahuprakāravatyo vakṣaḥsu āsikāḥ, yāśca hatānāmatiśayavatyastathābhūtā eva bhūyasyaḥ śāyikāḥ pratītāstābhirviśeṣarūpābhiriyamāsikā śāyikā copamānopameyasaṃbandhajanitabhedābhedaparigrahāllakāreṇāpi bahutvenaiva pratyāyyate
tenoṣṭrāsikā ivāsanāni, hataśāyikā iva śayanāni kriyante bhavantīti vākyārtho bhavati, so'yaṃ yathoktaḥ kriyāparikaraḥ
pathi vṛkṣacchāyopaviṣṭapānthairhataśāyikā ninditaśayanānīva śayyante śayanāni kriyante
yathoṣṭro yatra kutracidupaviśati tathā tapasvibhirapyupaviśyata ityarthaḥ
he sakhi, tatra nikuñjaśākhini nikuñjavṛkṣe śūnye vijane grīṣmasya madhyāhne sajjānāṃ susajjānāmabhisārikāṇāṃ priyasyābhisāraṇavyāpāre ramyaḥ kṣaṇo vartate
śāyikā iti ‘dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvul vaktavyaḥ’ iti śīṅdhātoḥ ṇvul
‘āsa upaveśane’ dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvul vaktavyaḥ’ iti ṇvul
‘sajjaḥ syāt saṃnaddhe saṃbhṛte triṣu’ iti medinīkāraḥ
sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ śuyyante āsyante iti sāmānyam, hataśāyikā uṣṭrāsiketi viśeṣastābhyāmuparacitamupasthāpitaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya saḥ
tarhi bhāvasyaikatvādekavacanaṃ syāttatkathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ śayyante āsyante iti syādata āha—bahuvacanamiti
kvacit punarbāhyamapi kṛdrūpaṃ kṛdartharūpaṃ vā kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
‘śataṃ vārānuktaḥ priyasakhi vacobhiḥ sa paruṣaiḥ sahasraṃ nirdhūtaḥ padanipatitaḥ pārṣṇihatibhiḥ
kiyatkṛtvo baddhāḥ punariha na vedmi bhrukuṭaya- stathāpi kliśyanmāṃ kṣaṇamapi na dhṛṣṭo viramati || 180 ||’
tāvimau dvāvapyāvṛttirūpeṇa kriyāyā viśeḥ ṣaṇaṃ bhavataḥ
nanvevamuṣṭrāsikādīnāṃ vārādīnāṃ ca kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt karmateva napuṃsakaliṅgatāpi prāpnoti
tridhā khalu kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati— bāhyam, ābhyantaram, bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca
tatra bāhyaṃ karmarūpaṃ vārādi, ābhyantaraṃ viśeṣarūpamuṣṭrāsikādi, bāhyābhyantaraṃ guṇarūpaṃ mṛdvādi
teṣu bāhyaṃ so'yamityabhidhāyāsaṃbandhādabhedopacāreṇāvicalitasvarūpameva pradhānaṃ viśiṣat kathamiva svaliṅgaṃ jahyāt, ābhyantaraṃ tu viśeṣāparigrahādāviṣṭaliṅgasaṃkhyaṃ kathamivānyaliṅgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
bāhyābhyantaraṃ tu guṇatvāt khaliṅgavirahe ‘guṇavacanānāmāśrayato guṇavacanāni’ iti viśeṣyaliṅgagrāhyeva bhavati
he priyasakhi, tathāpi sa dhṛṣṭo māṃ kliśyan kṣaṇamapi na viramati na virakto bhavati

paruṣairniṣṭhurairvacanaiḥ śataṃ vārānyathā syādevamuktaḥ, pade nipatitaḥ, sa ca pārṣṇihatibhiḥ pādatalaprahāraiḥ sahasraṃ vārānnirdhūtaścālitaḥ, iha viṣaye bhrukuṭayaḥ punaḥ kiyatkṛtvaḥ kiyadvārān na baddhā iti na vedmi
tena vārapadamāvṛttivacanaṃ svata eva kiyatkṛtva iti

atrādyaḥ prakāravacane thāl anekavārānityarthe ‘asakṛt’ iti taddhitena, ‘paśyanti’ iti kriyāyām, ‘valitagrīvam’ iti samāsena, ‘kimapi’ iti nāmnāvyayena, ‘sthitvā’ iti kṛtā, ‘muhuḥ’ iti kṛdarthe vīpsayā ca kriyāviśeṣaṇena saha viśeṣayati, dvitīyaśca ‘yathā bhramannayanodakaṃ nipatati’ iti śatṛlakṣitayā ‘patati’ iti kriyayā tamevārthamanusaṃdadhānaḥ pūrvakriyāyā eva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, so'yaṃ kṛttaddhita-samāsāvyayānāṃ saṃnipātarūpe'pi kriyāparikare ‘yathā, tathā’ ityetayoḥ prādhānyāttaddhitenaivopadiśyate
etā mṛgapaṅktayastathā tena prakāreṇa nibiḍanetrajalairmukhairasakṛdvāraṃvāraṃ gaganaṃ paśyanti
yathā yena prakāreṇa nayanajalaṃ bhramat sat śṛṅgāgrebhyo nipatati
akṛtakavalodyamairāsyaiḥ kimapi valitagrīvamuttolitaghāṭākaṃ yathā syādevaṃ sthitvā
bhayena sthagite niścale īkṣaṇe yāsāṃ tāḥ
vāraṃvāraṃ sthitvetyatra pūrvakālikāvasthāna eva vīpseti kṛdarthe vīpsā syādevetyarthaḥ
tamevārthaṃ prakārarūpaṃ saṃdadhāna upasthāpayan pūrvakriyāyāḥ pradhānakriyāyāḥ paśyantītirūpāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
