tathā ca kṛtvasucā pratyayenoktaṃ yatsthānaṃ vāraṃvārādilakṣaṇaṃ tena yadi taddhita ucyate taddhitasya vāraṃvārārthatā bhavati tadāyaṃ parikarabhedaḥ kṛtprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃnipātarūpaḥ samanvayarūpa ityarthaḥ
‘jaha jaha ṇisā samappai taha taha vevirataraṅgapaḍimāpaḍiam
kiṃkāavvavimūḍhaṃ vevai hiaaṃ vva uahiṇo sasibimbam || 182 ||’
[yathā yathā niśā samāpyate tathā tathā vepamānataraṅgapratimāpatitam
atra ‘yathā, tathā’ iti kriyāviśeṣaṇayoraparamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ vīpsā bhavati
“yathā yathā niśā samāpyate tathā tathā vepamānataraṅgapratimāpatitam
” iha niśā yathā yathā samāpyate svayaṃ samāptiṃ yāti
yathā śaśibimbaṃ ghūrṇate tathā niśā samāpyata iti vaktavye yathoktaṃ viparītam
‘dharmasyotsavavaijayanti mukuṭasragveṇi gaurīpatestvāṃ ratnākarapatni jahnutanaye bhāgīrathi prārthaye
tvattoyāntaśilaniṣaṇṇavapuṣastvadvīcibhiḥ preṅkhatastvannāma smaratastvadarpitadṛśaḥ prāṇāḥ prayāsyanti me || 183 ||’

he bhagīrathi bhagīrathāvatārite he gaṅge, tvāmahaṃ prārthaye dharmasyotsave vaijayanti patākārūpe, he bhavānīpatermukuṭamālārūpā veṇī pravāho yasyāstādṛśe, he ratnākarasya samudrasya patni jāye, he jahnumunikanyake
tvattoyasyānte samīpe śilāniṣaṇṇāṅgasya tvadvīcibhiḥ tvattaraṅgaiḥ preṅkhataścalatastvadīyaṃ nāma smaratastvadarpitadṛśastvayi dattanetrasya ca
mukhena dīrghojjvalalolacakṣuṣā vayasya kāntā kathaya kva vartate || 184 ||’
atra jaghanasthalādīni lakṣaṇāni mahāprathimnetyādibhiḥ pariṣkriyante; so'yaṃ lakṣaṇaparikaraḥ
mahāvākyasthasaṃbandhipadairlakṣaṇādayo yatra lakṣyante sa parikara evetyuktaṃ vivṛṇoti—lakṣaṇeti
he vayasya mitra, tvaṃ kathaya sā kāntā kva vartate
mahān prathimā sthūlatvaṃ yasya tena jaghanasthalena lakṣitā
mahākumbhikumbhasthalādapyuccau kucau yatra tena hṛdayena lakṣitā
dīrghe, ujjvale, nirmale, lole capale cakṣuṣī yatra tena mukhena lakṣitā ca
atra prathamatṛtīyapādayoḥ ‘tvayā, tvayā’ iti hetū dvitīyacaturthapādābhyāṃ pariṣkriyete; so'yaṃ hetuparikaraḥ
‘anena yūnā saha pārthivena rambhoru kaccinmanaso ruciste
atra ‘anena’ iti sahārthaḥ ‘yūnā, pārthivena’ iti ca padābhyāṃ pariṣkriyate; so'yaṃ sahārthaparikaraḥ
he rambhoru, anena taruṇena bhūpena saha tava manaso rucirabhilāṣaḥ kaccitkathayetyarthaḥ
atra ‘anyonyaśobhāparivṛddhaye’ iti tādarthyārthaḥ śeṣapadārthaiḥ pariṣkriyate; so'yaṃ tādarthyaparikaraḥ
ayaṃ nṛpo nīlanalinaśyāmāṅgaḥ, tvaṃ ca gorocanāvat gaurāṅgayaṣṭiḥ
atra parivṛddhaye iti tādarthye caturthīti tādarthyārthapariṣkāraḥ
pratyakṣo vastūnāṃ padārthānāṃ viṣayo rūpādikaṃ yasya tasmai
yadvā pratyakṣau vastuviṣayau padārthaghaṭapaṭādī yasya tasmai
viśvasya bhuvanasya sthitiravasthānam, pralayo nāśaḥ, saṃbhava utpattisteṣāṃ hetave
sarvaṃ vastu ātmā svaṃ yasya tasmai
tribhuvanasya prabhave īśvarāya śivāya kalyāṇakārakāya ca
16’ iti tubhyamiti namoyoge upapadavibhaktiścaturthī tadartha itarapadārthaiḥ pariṣkriyate
‘kaha kaha viraei paaṃ maggaṃ pulaei chejjamāvisai
coravva kaī atthaṃ laddhuṃ dukkheṇa ṇivvahai || 189 ||’
[kathaṃ kathaṃ viracayati padaṃ mārgaṃ pralokate chedyamāviśati
cora iva kavirarthaṃ labdhuṃ duḥkhena nirvahati ||]
caura iva kavirarthaṃ labdhuṃ duḥkhena nirvahati
’ iha kavirarthaṃ vācyaṃ labdhuṃ prāptuṃ duḥkhena nirvahati samartho bhavatītyarthaḥ
caurasāmyamāha—kathaṃ kathamapi kaṣṭasṛṣṭyā padaṃ vibhaktyantaraṃ racayati, kutrakutrāpi vā padaṃ racayati, mārgaṃ kavivartma pralokate paśyati
yathā cauraḥ kvāpi kathamapi padaṃ vyavasāyaṃ pādaṃ vā racayati, mārgaṃ gatāgatavartma paśyati, chedyaṃ chedārhaṃ sthānaṃ praviśati, arthaṃ sādhudhanaṃ prāptuṃ duḥkhena śaknoti tathetyarthaḥ
‘viaḍe gaaṇasamudde diase sūreṇa mandareṇa va mahie
ṇīi mairavva saṃjjhā tissā maggeṇa amaakalaso vva sasī || 190 ||’
niryāti madireva saṃdhyā mārgeṇāmṛtakalaśa iva śaśī ||]
atra gagane samudratvena rūpite sūryasaṃdhyāśaśibhiḥ, mandaramadirā'mṛtakalaśaiśca mathanādikriyāniveśibhirarthaiḥ parasparopamānātsādharmyamutpāditamityartho'yaṃ rūpakaparikaraḥ
nirgacchati madireva saṃdhyā tasyā mārgeṇāmṛtakalaśa iva śaśī
vikaṭe mahati gaganasamudre mandaragiriṇeva raviṇā divase mahite pūjite'tha ca mathite sati madireva yathā mandaramathite samudre madirā nirgacchati tathetyarthaḥ
tasyāḥ saṃdhyāyā mārgeṇa yathā candro'mṛtakalaśa ivāsti nirgacchati vā

atra ‘priyasaṃgame'pi madanākalpaprasādhanaṃ bhavati’ iti viruddhārthayoḥ sādharmyotpādanāya jale krīḍato yuvatijanasya yathoktaviśeṣaṇābhyāṃ śabdato'rthataścopaskāraḥ kṛta ityubhayakṛto'yaṃ virodhaśleṣaparikaraḥ
’ iha yuvatijanaḥ patisaṃgame'pi madanasyākalpa utkaṇṭhā tadarthaṃ prasādhanamalaṃkāraṃ vahati
utthagita iti utpūrvāt ‘thagi’ (ṣṭhage) saṃvaraṇe’ karmaṇi ktaḥ
atra priyasaṃgame kāmajanakameva prasādhanaṃ yuktamiha tu tadvaiparītyena viruddhārthatā
jalakrīḍāyāṃ tu mṛṇālanalinībhyāṃ yuvaterupaskāraḥ śābda ārthaśca vyakta eva
ekāvalīti yā sāpi bhinnā parikarānna hi
pūrvaṃ prati yatrottarasya vastuno vīpsayā viśeṣaṇatvena sthāpanaṃ niṣedho vā saikāvalī
harimiva harimiva harimiva vahati payaḥ paśyata payoṣṇī || 192 ||’
atra ‘harimiva, harimiva, harimiva’ iti śabdaikāvalyā vibhinnārthayā ‘payaḥ’ karmakārakamupaskriyate; seyaṃ śabdaikāvalī parikarasyaiva bhedaḥ
iyaṃ payoṣṇī nadībhedaḥ payo jalaṃ vahati tatpaśyata
narakasya nirayasya jaitramata eva bahumatamanekasaṃmataṃ gahanamagādham
‘adripakṣasya chedyatvena parvatabhedī pavinā vajreṇa trāyate ‘anyatrāpi dṛśyate’ iti traḥ pavitraḥ
yadvā parvatabhedinā pavinā trāyate iti parvatabhedipavitrastam
kasya bahumatamīṣanmataṃ jaitraṃ kiṃtu sarvasyaiva saṃpūrṇameva svīkṛtam
sa cādau bhavati ‘vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāttu 5
bahurbahumānaviṣayo mataṅgo munibhedo yeṣāṃ te bahumataṅgā hastinasteṣāṃ pitṛtvena tasya pūjyatvāt tān hanti tam
bahūnāṃ vātayogināṃ svīkṛtaḥ gahanaḥ kaṣṭena pariceyaśca bhavati
atra harimivetyādiśabdarūpaikāvalyā viśeṣaṇatvena payorūpasya karmakārakasya pariṣkāraḥ
‘kimiti kabarī yādṛk tādṛg dṛśau kimakajjale na khalu likhitāḥ patrāvalyaḥ kimadya kapolayoḥ
ayamayamayaṃ kiṃca klāmyatyasaṃsmaraṇena te priyasakhi sakhīhastanyasto vilāsaparicchadaḥ || 193 ||’

atra ‘ayamayamayam’ iti sarvanāmaparāmṛśyamānayā prāgupanyastakāraṇabhūtayā tato'nyayā vā tathāvidhayārthaikāvalyā ‘paricchadaḥ’ iti kartṛkārakamabhinnārtha iva pariṣkriyate; seyamarthaikāvalī parikarasyaiva bhedaḥ
he śaśimukhi, sakhīhastāropito'yamayaṃ vilāsārthaṃ paricchadastavāsaṃsmaraṇena kiṃcitklāmyati
dṛśau netre akajjale kim, kapolayoḥ patrāvalyo'dyādhunā kiṃ naiva likhitāḥ
atrāyamiti sarvanāmopasthāpitayārthaikāvalyā tulyayaiva paricchadarūpasya kartṛkārakasya pariṣkāraḥ
‘ambā tuṣyati na mayā snuṣayā sāpi nāmbayā na mayā
ahamapi na tayā na tayā vada rājan kasya doṣo'yam || 194 ||’

atrāmbāsnuṣāsmadarthalakṣaṇairarthaistadvācibhiḥ sarvanāmabhiḥ śabdairekāvalīkrameṇa mitho'nusyūtairmitho'nusyūta eva ‘tuṣyati’ iti kriyāheturmayetyādibhiḥ pariṣkriyate; seyamubhayagrathitatvādubhayaikāvalī parikarasyaiva bhedaḥ
ambā mātā na mayā tuṣyati tuṣṭā bhavati
sāpi snuṣā nāmbayā na mayā ca tuṣyati
ahamapi na tayāmbayā na tayā snuṣayā ca tuṣyāmi
saṃpuṭaṃ rasanā mālā cakravālaṃ ca tadbhidāḥ || 78
ekatra sthitena jātyādivācinā padena yadi sarvavākyopakāraḥ kriyate tadā dīpakam
atra ‘caranti’ iti kriyayā dvayorapi vākyayorādipasthayaivopakāraḥ kriyata ityādidīpakamidaṃ kriyāviṣayamucyate
kundapuṣpadīptayo nirmalāstava guṇāśca cakravālasya lokālokasyādreḥ kuñjeṣu caranti gacchanti
atra kriyāvācinā carantīti padenādisthena vākyadvayaṃ dīpitam
madhyāsthitena vā kriyāpadena yatra vākyadīpanaṃ tadapi madhyadīpakamantadīpakaṃ ceti mantavyamityāha—evamiti
sa eva ca natāṅgīnāṃ mānabhaṅgāya kalpate || 196 ||’
dakṣiṇaḥ pavano malayānilo vīrudhāṃ latānāṃ jīrṇaṃ pakvaṃ parṇaṃ patraṃ harati
sa eva pavano nāgarīṇāṃ mānabhaṅgāya kalpate śakto bhavati
dānavānāṃ danorapatyānāmasurāṇāṃ vibhūtayaḥ saṃpattayo vikrāntena viṣṇunā kvāpi nītāḥ prāpitāḥ
tenaiva devatānābhṛddhayaḥ śriyaḥ kuto'pyavadhibhūtādānītā āsan sthitāḥ
‘hṛṣyati cūteṣu ciraṃ tuṣyati bakuleṣu modate maruti
iha hi madhau kalakūjiṣu pikeṣu ca prīyate kāmī || 199 ||’
atra ‘hṛṣyati, tuṣyati, modate, prīyate’ ityetaiḥ padaiḥ sa evārtha āvartyamānaḥ sarvavākyāni dīpayati; seyamarthāvṛttirdīpakasya bhedaḥ
kāmī iha madhau vasante cūteṣu hṛṣyati hṛṣṭo bhavati
kalaraveṣu kokileṣu ca prīyate prīto bhavati
atrogdrīvaṃ karoti, utkaṇṭhāvantaṃ karotītyarthayoḥ ‘utkaṇṭhayati’ iti padamāvartyamānaṃ vākyadvayamapi dīpayati; seyaṃ padāvṛttirdīpakasya bhedaḥ
atra jayetyarthaḥ śabdaścāvartyamānaḥ sarvavākyāni dīpayati; seyamubhayāvṛttirdīpakasya bhedaḥ
he deva mahādeva, bhuvanasya jagato bhāvana janaka, jaya
he bhagavannakhileṣu janeṣu varaprada, nigamasya vedasya nidhe āśraya, jaya
‘tvamarkastvaṃ somastvamasi pavanastvaṃ hutavaha- stvamāpastvaṃ vyoma tvamu dharaṇirātmā tvamiti ca
paricchinnāmevaṃ tvayi pariṇatā bibhrati giraṃ na vidmastattattvaṃ vayamiha tu yattvaṃ na bhavasi || 202 ||’
atra pūrvārdhe tvamiti śabdārthayoḥ prathamāvṛttiḥ prathamapādasthayā ‘asi’ iti kriyayā dīpyate

tatastṛtīyapāde ‘tvayi’ iti rūpāntareṇa yuṣmadartha āvartyamānaḥ kriyāntareṇa saṃbadhyate, caturthapāde punarapi tenaiva rūpeṇāstyarthena bhavatinā saṃbadhyata iti; seyaṃ vṛttīnāmāvṛttirāvalīti dīpakasyaiva bhedo bhavati
pariṇatāḥ pariṇāmino'rkādayastvayi tvadviṣaya evaṃ paricchinnāṃ giraṃ vāṇīṃ bibhrati dhārayanti
iha jagati yattattvaṃ vastu tvaṃ na bhavasi tattattvaṃ vayaṃ punarna vidmo na jānīmaḥ
atra prathamārdhe tvamitiśabdārthayorāvṛttirasītikriyayā dīpitā, tṛtīyapāde tvayītirūpāntareṇa viṣayatvena yuṣmadarthastvamityevaṃrūpo dhāraṇakriyānvayī

atra ‘navapallaveṣu— ityādini ‘aśokasya’ iti; ‘lolati—’ ityādīni ‘vasantalakṣmīḥ’ iti pade dravyavācinī saṃpuṭakrameṇa mithaḥ saṃbadhyamāne mithaḥ saṃbaddhānyeva dīpayataḥ, tadetatsaṃpuṭaṃ nāma dīpakasya bhedaḥ
tasya viṭapeṣu śākhāsu ghūrṇate, tasya śikhareṣvagreṣu calati gacchati, tasya stabakeṣu puṣpaguccheṣu caraṇau sthāpayati
atra padadvayaṃ dravyavācakaṃ saṃpuṭakrameṇa mithaḥ saṃbadhyamānaṃ mithaḥ saṃbaddhānyeva padāni dīpayatīti saṃpuṭam
atra rasanākrameṇa mithaḥ saṃgrathitāni ‘salilaṃ vikāśikamalam’ ityādīni vākyāni ‘iha’ ityantasthitenādhikaraṇavācinā dravyadīpakena dīpyante; tadetat rasanādīpakaṃ nāmādidīpakabhedaḥ
līnaṃ yadalikulaṃ tenākulaṃ madhu, bhramarakulamapīha vasante madhuraṇitaṃ madhunā puṣparasena śabditaṃ madhau madhūkadrume vā śabditam
‘madhu puṣparasakṣaudramadye nā tu madhudrume’ iti medinīkāraḥ
‘imiṇā saraeṇa sasī sasiṇā vi ṇisā ṇisāi kumuavaṇam
kumuavaṇeṇa a puliṇaṃ puliṇeṇa a sohae haṃsaulam || 205 ||’
[anayā śaradā śaśī śaśināpi niśā niśayā kumudavanam
kumudavanena ca pulinaṃ pulinena ca śobhate haṃsakulam ||]
atra mālākrameṇa parasparagrathitāḥ kartāro hetavaśca śaśiprabhṛtayaḥ ‘śobhate’ iti kriyayā dīpyante; tadetanmālādīpakaṃ nāma dīpakasya bhedaḥ
pūrvatra vṛtticchinnaṃ rasanāyāṃ sarvatra iha tu svatantraṃ mālāpuṣpavat padaṃ padena yujyamānaṃ kriyādibhiḥ saṃbadhyataiti tato bhidyate
“anayā śaradā śaśī śaśināpi niśā niśayā kumudavanam
kumudavanena ca pulinaṃ pulinena ca śobhate haṃsakulam
rasanāyāṃ sarvatra vṛttyā chandasā chinnaṃ bhinnībhūtaṃ padaṃ padena yujyate
mālāyāṃ tu pratyekameva padaṃ padena yujyata ityanayorbheda ityartha
‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite devākarṇaya yena yena sahasā yadyatsamāsāditam
kodaṇḍena śarāḥ śarairariśirastenāpi bhūmaṇḍalaṃ tena tvaṃ bhavatā ca kīrtiratulā kīrtyā ca lokatrayam || 206 ||’

atra ‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite’ iti bhāvalakṣaṇākṣiptasya bhāvaviśeṣasya dvitīyapāde kārakavīpsayā yat saṃkṣepeṇābhidhānaṃ tadetaccakravālādriṇeva mālādīpakena vistāravatā veṣṭitamidaṃ cakravālaṃ nāma dīpakasya bhedaḥ
jñānasāmānyasya viśeṣe jijñāsodayāt tatra ca samāropaṇarūpe kāraṃkajijñāsāyāṃ sāmānyata eva vīpsayābhidhānaṃ yeneti yaditi ca
bhaṇanaṃ paripāṭyā yat kramaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ || 79
atrālāpasmitadṛṣṭibhiḥ padārthaurvallakīkundasragindīvarasaṃpadaḥ padārthā jīyanta iti śabdaparipāṭyā bhaṇanam; seyaṃ padataḥ śabdaparipāṭī kramaḥ
atra śabdasya padarūpasya paripāṭyā bhaṇanamiti padaghaṭitaḥ śābdakramaḥ
‘indurmūrdhni śivasya śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅka stane deyādvo'bhyudayaṃ dvayaṃ tadupamāmālambamānaṃ mithaḥ
saṃvādaḥ praṇavena yasya dalatā kāyaikatāyāṃ tayo- rūrdhvadvāri vicintitena ca hṛdi dhyātasvarūpeṇa ca 208’

atra ‘indurmūrdhni śivasya', śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅkaḥ stane’ iti vācyārthavācinau śabdasamudāyau krameṇa ‘ūrdhvadvāri vicintiteva ca’, ‘hṛdi dhyātasvarūpeṇa ca’ iti vākyārthadvayavācibhyāṃ śabdasamudāyābhyāṃ saṃbadhyete; seyaṃ vākyataḥ śabdaparipāṭi kramaḥ
atra vākyārthābhidhāyakau śabdasamudāyau tādṛśābhyāṃ śabdasamudāyābhyāṃ saṃbaddhāviti vākyaghaṭitaḥ śābdakramaḥ
cūḍāpāśe navakurabakaṃ cāru karṇe śirīṣaṃ sīmante ca tvadupagamajaṃ yatra nīpaṃ vadhūnām || 209 ||’
atra ‘haste’ līlākamalamalakaṃ bālakundānuviddham’ ityādyarthānāṃ śaradādikālakrameṇa bhaṇanam; seyaṃ kālato'rthaparipāṭī kramaḥ
yatra puryāṃ vadhūnāṃ haste līlākamalam, alakaṃ cūrṇakuntalaṃ bālakundenānuviddhaṃ saṃbaddham
lodhraprasavasya lodhrapuṣpasya rajasā dhūlyā mukhaśrīḥ pāṇḍutāṃ śvetatāṃ nītā
cūḍāpāśe praśastaśikhāyāṃ nūtanakurabakapuṣpam, cāru manojñaṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ karṇe, sīmante nīpaṃ kadambapuṣpam
maulau ratnaruci śrutau parilasattāṭaṃṅkānti kramā- jjātaṃ vakṣasi kaustubhābhamudare nābhīsarojopamam || 210 ||’

atra trivikramatonorvaikuṇṭhasya pravṛddhisamaye krameṇaiva mauliśrutivakṣaudaralakṣaṇeṣu śarīradeśeṣu bhāsvanmaṇḍalasya cūḍāratnatāṭaṅkakaustubhanābhyambujairyo'yamaupamyalābhaḥ; seyaṃ deśato'rthaparipāṭī kramaḥ
sa devo vo yuṣmān pāyāt rakṣatāt
racitā trivikramasya vāmanasya tanuḥ śarīraṃ yena saḥ
yasvākasmādvardhamānaśarīrasya sūryamaṇḍalaṃ maulo ratnaruci jātam, kramāt śrutau karṇe śobhamānatāṭaṅkakānti jātam, vakṣasi kaustubhadīpti jātam, udarai nābhipadmopamaṃ jātam
iha harernābhipadmasya śvetatayā rūpeṇa na sāmyaṃ kiṃ tvākārādinetyavadheyam
‘paṅkaa paṅki vahelia kuvalaa khittau dahahiṃ vālihiṃ bimba vivillio ghattio candu ṇahahi
karaṇaaṇāharavaaṇahiṃ tahiṃ līlāvaihiṃ ṇiasiṭṭi vi ucciṭṭhiṇā iṃ paāvaihiṃ || 211 ||’
[paṅkajaṃ paṅke'vahelya kuvalayaṃ kṣiptvā hṛde vṛnte bimbaṃ viprakīrṇe nirastaścandro nabhasi

atra paṅkajakuvalayabimbiphalacandramasāṃ karanayanāgharavadanairyathāsaṃkhyaṃ parājayata iti śabdaparipāṭhyaiva paṅkajāni paṅke nyastāni, kuvalayāni hṛde kṣiptāni, bimbaṃ vṛnte prakīrṇam, candro nabhasi nirasta ityādhārāṇāmuparyuparibhāvaḥ, kriyāṇāṃ ca tyāgatāratamyamityarthaparipāṭī nyagbhavati; seyaṃ śabdapradhānobhayaparipāṭī kramaḥ
“paṅkajāni paṅka nyastāni kuvalayāni kṣiptāni hrade kṛttau bimbaṃ vinikīrṇaṃ nirastaścandro nabhasi
” iha prajāpatinā brahmāṇā tasyāṃ līlāvatyāṃ nāyi-kāyā~ hastanetrādharamukhairnijasṛṣṭirapyutsṛṣṭeva datteva
vṛttau veṣṭane bimbaphalaṃ nyastam, candro gagane kṣipta iti
atra paṅkajādīnāṃ karādinā jaye śābdakramaḥ pradhānībhūto'dhikaraṇānāmuparyuparibhāvaḥ, kriyāṇāṃ ca tyāgatāratamyamityārthakramaśca nyagbhūto'pradhāna ityubhayakrame'pi śabdapradhānatā
‘gaṅge devi dṛśā punīhi yamune mātaḥ punardarśanaṃ saṃpraśno'stu pitaḥ prayāga bhagavannyagrodha māṃ dhyāsyasi

atra gaṅgāyamunāprayāganyagrodhatatpuṃbhāvāvantinagarīnāthalakṣaṇānāmarthānāṃ mukhyakrameṇa ‘ devi dṛśā punīhi’, ‘mātaḥ punardarśanam’, ‘pitaḥ saṃpraśnaḥ’, ‘bhagavanmāṃ dhyāsyasi’ iti mukhyakrameṇaiva saṃbhramadbhirvacoviśeṣairabhyarthya ‘bhavatāmeva puṃbhāvamavantinagarīnāthaṃ didṛkṣāmahe’ iti yeyamabhyarthanābhaṅgiḥ sārthaparipāṭīkṛtā tasyāṃ ca ‘gaṅge’ yamune, prayāga, nyagrodha’ iti, ‘hārāsilatāvataṃsavipulavakṣaḥsthūlāṃsa’ iti ca śabdaparipāṭī parasparamupamānopameyabhūte nyagbhavataḥ, seyamarthapradhānobhayaparipāṭī kramaḥ
he gaṅge devi, dṛśā māṃ punīhi, he mātaryamune, punardarśanamastu, he pitaḥ prayāga, bhavān svāpraśno'stu susaṃvādo'stu
he bhagavan nyagrodha akṣayavaṭa, māṃ dhyāsyasi, smariṣyasi
tamavantinagarīnāthamujjiyinīpatiṃ, bhojarājaṃ nṛpaṃ vayaṃ didṛkṣāmahe draṣṭumicchāmaḥ
vataṃsena karṇālaṃkāreṇa vipulaḥ sthūlaścāṃso bāhumūlaṃ yatra vakṣasi tat
tasyāṃ ca gaṅgayā hārasya, yamunayāsilatāyāḥ, prayāgeṇa vataṃsavipulasthūlāṃsavakṣasaḥ, nyagrodhena bhujasya śābdena krameṇa mitha upamānopameyabhāvo nyagbhūta ityubhayakrame'rthapradhānatā
drutaṃ tadenāṃ karavai nicolake kayācidevaṃ miṣato viniryaye 213’
kayācinnāyikayā evamanena prakāreṇa miṣato vyājādviniryaye bahirbhūtam
tadevāha—mayā tyaktā vallakī vīṇā bahireva gacchet
tata enāṃ śīghraṃ nicolake vastre'haṃ karavai kariṣyāmi
atra ‘kayācidevaṃ miṣato viniryaye’ itivadudarkānabhidhānāt sākāṅkṣametanmiṣaṃ nāma paryāyasya bhedaḥ
asau parabhṛtaḥ pikaḥ sahakārasya bhañjarī daśati tamahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi
‘rājan rājasutā na pāṭhayati maṃ devyo'pi tūṣṇīṃ sthitāḥ kubje bhojaya māṃ kumāra kuśalaṃ nādyājjuke bhujyate
itthaṃ nātha śukastavāribhavane mukto'dhvagaiḥ pañjarā- ccitrasthānavalokya veśmavalabhīṣvekaikamābhāṣate || 215 ||’
atrānayoktibhaṅgyā śūnyīkṛtārinagarasya narapateḥ kaścit pratāpaṃ varṇayati
he nātha he prabho, tabāribhavane śatrugṛhe itthamanenākāreṇa veśmavalabhīṣu gṛhoparikuṭīṣu citralikhitānetānvilokya pratyekaṃ śuka ābhāṣate vadati
ābhāṣaṇasvarūpamāha—he rājan, rājasutā kumārikā māṃ na pāṭhayati
he ajjuke gaṇike, adya mayā na bhujyate
‘śāntyai vo'stu kapāladāma jagatāṃ patyuryadīyāṃ lipiṃ kvāpi kvāpi gaṇāḥ paṭhanti ṣadaśo nātiprasiddhākṣarām
viśvaṃ sakṣyati vakṣyati kṣitimapāmīśiṣyate'śiṣyate nāgai rāgiṣu raṃsyate'tsyati jagannirvekṣyati dyāmiti || 216 ||’

atrānayoktibhaṅgyā brahmādyastamaye'pyanastamitasya bhagavato maheśvarasya prabhāvo varṇyate, tatra ca ‘yadīyāṃ lipiṃ kvāpi kvāpi gaṇmāḥ paṭhanti padaśo nātiprasiddhākṣarām’ ityanenaiva vākye'sminnākāṅkṣotthāpyate
sā ca ‘viśvaṃ srakṣyati’ ityasminnīdṛśī—brahmāṇāṃ caturyugasahasrānte dinamekamiti mānenaiṣa varṣaśatajīvī viśvaṃ srakṣyati brahmeti jñāpyate, kapālaṃ cāsya bhagavato bhūṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati
‘vakṣyati kṣitim’ ityasminnīdṛśī—brahmāṇāmayaṃ (?) varṣaśatenaikaṃ dinamiti mānenaiṣa puruṣāyuṣajīvī kṣitiṃ vakṣyati viṣṇuriti jñāpyate, kapālaṃ cāsya bhagavato bhūṣā bhaviṣyatīti
jagatāṃ patyurharasya kapāladāma lalāṭamālā vo yuṣmākaṃ śāntyai śamāyāstu
yadīyāṃ lipiṃ yatsaṃbandhinīmakṣarālīṃ gaṇā nandyādayaḥ kvāpi padaśaḥ padakrameṇa paṭhanti vācayanti
pāṭhaviṣayamāha—ayaṃ śivo viśvaṃ jagat srakṣyati nirmāsyati
‘kva nu te hṛdayaṃgamaḥ sakhā kusumāyojitakārmuko madhuḥ
na khalūgraruṣā pinākinā gamitaḥ so'pisuhṛdgatāṃ gatim || 218 ||’
iti yāni rateḥ paridevitākṣarāṇi tairākṛṣṭahṛdayasya madhoryo'yamātmadarśanāya prastāvaḥ so'yaṃ na kiṃcanākāṅkṣatīti nirākāṅkṣo'yamavasaraḥ paryāyasya bhedaḥ
‘ajjavi bālo dāmoaro tti ia jampie jasoāe

atra ‘adyāpi bālo dāmodaraḥ’ iti yaśodayā kṛtaprastāvanasya kṛṣṇasya vakre vinyastalocanayā tadrahasyavedinyā vrajavadhūmatallikayā yadetannibhṛtaṃ hasitaṃ tat tavāmbā bālaṃ tvāṃ brūte, tvaṃ tu mādṛśībhirnidhuvanavidagdhābhirdivāniśaṃ yamunānikuñjodareṣu viharasītyādinārthajātena sākāṅkṣamiti sākāṅkṣo'yamavasaraḥ paryāyasya bhedaḥ
” yaśodayā kṛṣṇabālya udbhāvite vrajavadhūḥ smeraṃ dṛṣṭvā kācit kasyaicit kathayati—adyāpīti
yaśodayādyāpi dāmodaro bāla evetyukte kayācidnopavadhvā kṛṣṇamukhe preṣitaṃ nyastamakṣi yatra hasite evaṃ nibhṛtamekānte hasitam
sā ca prāyo guṇānāṃ ca kriyāṇāṃ copakalpate
viśeṣasya prakarṣasya lokasīmātivartinī lokamaryādātiśayitā yā vivakṣā vaktumicchā sātiśayoktiḥ
yena tribhuvanodaramapi saṃkīrṇamāśaṅkyate; so'yaṃ mahattvātiśayo nāmātiśayabhedaḥ
he bhūpāla, yasmādatra bhuvanatritayodare mātuṃ paricchettumaśakyo'pi tava yaśorāśirmāti saṃmāti
atra yaśorāśirūpasya guṇasyātiśayena mahattvātiśayaḥ sphuṭa eva
asti nāstīti saṃdeho na me'dyāpi nivartate || 221 ||’
atraivaṃ madhyasya lokasīmatikrameṇa tānavātiśayavivakṣā yena tadasti nāstīti vā saṃdihyate; so'yaṃ tanutvātiśayo nāmātiśayabhedaḥ
he priye, tava stanayorjaghanasyāpi madhye'ntarāle madhyamavalagnamatikṛśatvādasti nāstīti saṃdeho mamādyāpi na nivartate
yena tasmin samānābhihāreṇābhisārikā api na lakṣyante so'yaṃ kāntyatiśayo nāmātiśayabhedaḥ
pihite candrātapasyotkarṣeṇābhisārikātiraskāro vivakṣyate, iha tvabhisārikātiraskāreṇa candrātapotkarṣa iti
īdṛśyo'bhisārikā jyotsnāyāṃ candrakiraṇe'pi na lakṣyante na jñāyante kenāpi
lokasīmātikramaśca nahi śuklāmbaratayā jyotsnāyāmabhisārikā na lakṣyanta iti lokasīmetyarthaḥ
candrātapotkarṣatayā taulye'pi pihite tenābhisārikātiraskāra iha tu tasyāstiraskāreṇa candrātapotkarṣa iti prakārābhyāṃ tayorbheda ityāśayaḥ
‘taṃ daiāhiṇṇāṇaṃ jammi vi aṅgammi rāhaveṇa ṇa ṇimiam
sīāparimaṭṭeṇa va ūḍho teṇa vi ṇirantaraṃ romañco || 223 ||’
atra dayitābhijñānasya yo'yaṃ romāñcakriyāviśeṣaḥ sa kriyātiśayasyaiva bhedaḥ prabhāvātiśaya ucyate

” iha taddayitāyā vallabhāyāḥ sītāyā abhijñānaṃ cihnaṃ maṇirūpaṃ yasminnapyaṅge rāmeṇa na nirmitaṃ na nihitaṃ tenāpyaṅgena sītayā pari sarvatobhāvena spṛṣṭeneva nirantaraṃ yathā bhavatyevaṃ romāñco vyūḍho dhṛtaḥ

atra rasātalamapi mṛdnatā śeṣeṇāpi ca tasya mūlaṃ na dṛṣṭam, tribhuvanamapyullaṅghayatā hariṇāpi na tuṅgaśikharāṇi prāptānīti yadetallokasīmātikrameṇa viśeṣavyavasthayā parvatānubhāvabhaṇanaṃ so'yamanubhūyamānamāhātmyātiśayasyaiva bhedo'nubhāvātiśaya ucyate
viṣaparapatinā śeṣeṇādṛṣṭo mūlasya chedaḥ śeṣo yasya tam
vimarditaṃ vimalitaṃ nirmalīkṛtaṃ vā rasātalaṃ yena tena
atra parvatānubhāvātiśayavivakṣayātiśayaḥ sa ca tairanubhūyamāna eva
‘raṇadujjao dahamuho surā avajjhā a tihuaṇassa ime
paḍai aṇatthotti phuḍaṃ vihīsaṇena phuḍiāharaṃ ṇīsasiam 225’
patatyanartha iti sphuṭaṃ vibhīṣaṇena sphuṭitādharaṃ niśvasitam

atra daśāsyaḥ samare na jīyate, surāścāmaratvānna vadhyante, tayośca parasparaṃ saṃghaṭṭakriyātiśayāttribhuvanamapi kṣayaṃ yāsyatīti yeyamanyonyakriyātiśayabhaṇanāllokasīmātikrameṇa viśeṣavivakṣā so'yaṃ kriyātiśayo nāmātiśaya evānyonyātiśaya ucyate
patatyanartha iti sphuṭaṃ vibhīṣaṇena sphuṭitādharaṃ niśvasitam
” iha sphuṭitādharaṃ vyaktīkṛtādharaṃ yathā syādevaṃ vibhīṣaṇena rāvaṇabhrātrā niśvasitaṃ niśvāsastyaktaḥ sphuṭaṃ vyaktameva
daśāsyo raṇe durjayaḥ, surā devā amaratvādavadhyāḥ
ekena padena vibhaktyantenānekeṣāmarthānāṃ kathanaṃ yatra sa śleṣaḥ kathyate
rājñā pradoṣo māmitthamapriyaṃ kiṃ na bādhate || 226 ||’
atra ‘pradoṣo rātreḥ prathamayāmaḥ kimiti priyārahitaṃ māṃ na bādhate’ ityukteryuktimāha—itthamanubhūyamānena prakāreṇa

yo hi doṣāṇāmākareṇa rājamārgātigāminā ca rājñā prakṛṣṭadoṣaḥ saṃbadhyate so'priyamavaśyaṃ bādhata eva; tadatra pūrvasminprākaraṇike'rthe dvitīyo'rtho'prākaraṇikaḥ padabhedenopaśliṣyamāṇo bhinnapadaśleṣāpadeśamāsādayati
prakṛṣṭo doṣo dūṣaṇaṃ yasya sa durjano māṃ kiṃ na bādhate, kiṃtu bādhata eva
itthamanubhūyamānena prakāreṇa rājñā bhūpena saha saṃbadhnan yuñjan
atra karmavadbhāvo na kṛtaḥ saṃbadhyamāna ityarthatvāt
kṣatrapathaḥ kṣatriyamārgastatra vartituṃ śīlaṃ yasya tena
pakṣe pradoṣo rajanīmukhaṃ māmapriyaṃ priyārahitaṃ kiṃ na bādhate kiṃtu bādhata eva
rājā harati lokasya hṛdayaṃ mṛdubhiḥ karaiḥ || 227 ||’
atrāyamudīyamānaścandramā lokasya hṛdayaṃ haratītyukteryuktimāha—rājānuraktamaṇḍala udayī mṛdukaraḥ kāntimāniti
yo hyevaṃbhūto rājā so'vaśyaṃ lokasya hṛdayahārī bhavati
atrāpi ca prākaraṇike'rthe'prākaraṇika upaśliṣyamāṇaḥ padānāmabhedenābhinnapadaśleṣo bhavati
asau rājā nṛpo mṛdubhirapīḍākaraiḥ karai rājagrāhyairlokasya hṛdayaṃ harati
pakṣe asau rājā candraḥ karaiḥ kiraṇairmṛdubhiḥ śītalairjanasya hṛdayaṃ harati gṛhṇāti

atra ‘ākarṇyante, śliṣyante ca’ iti kriyāpadadvitayasya prādhānyataḥ samuccayenopāttasya ‘madhurā—’ ityādibhiḥ śliṣṭapadaiḥ ‘kokilāgiraḥ', ‘asitekṣaṇāḥ’ iti vā viśeṣyaikapadavarjaṃ paryāyataḥ saṃbandho bhavati
sarvo'pi hi madhuraṃ śabdamākarṇayan niścalākṣo bhavati
madakalāḥ, kokilāgiraḥ, komalāḥ, rāgavardhinyaḥ, madhurā iti
so'yaṃ dvayorvibhinnakriyayorbhinnārthe ca rūpiṇāṃ padārthānāmupaśleṣo bhinnakriyaḥ śleṣa ucyate
kokilāgira ākarṇyante, asitekṣaṇāḥ śyāmanetrāḥ priyānāśliṣyante ca
āsite upaveśite niścalīkṛte'ntaḥpramodānubhavādīkṣaṇe yābhistāsāṃ madhuraṃ ravamākarṇayanniścalākṣo bhavati
dṛśo dūtyaśca karṣanti kāntābhiḥ preṣitāḥ priyān || 229 ||’
atra ‘karṣanti’ ityetasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ dṛśāṃ dūtīnāṃ ca śliṣṭapadatvenāveśādayamabhinnakriyo nāma śleṣaviśeṣaḥ
prathamayorasya vā ko viśeṣa iti cet
kāntābhiḥ preṣitā dṛśo dūtyaśca priyān vallabhān karṣanti
taduktaṃ matsaṃgītasarvasve—'madhurā kuñcitāntā ca sabhrūkṣepā ca sasmitā
samanmathavikārā ca dṛṣṭiḥ sā lalitā matā
bhinnapadābhinnapadābhyāmasya ca ko bheda iti pṛcchati—prathamayoriti
tayorekaikasyaiva prakaraṇāpannatvamatra tu dṛṣṭaṃ dvyorapi prākaraṇikatvamiti bheda ityarthaḥ

tatra gate-rveṇyāśca nāgena hastinā ahinā ca tulyatvam, vapuṣa ūrvośca rambhayā kadalyā apsarobhiśca tulyatvam, oṣṭhayoḥ pāṇyośca pravālairvidrumairnavapallavaiśca tulyatvaṃ varṇanīyayoḥ śleṣaprabhāvāllabhyate; so'yamanekakartṛkatvādbhinnakāraka iti śleṣo bhavati

tasyā nāyikāyā gatirgamanaṃ veṇī keśaracanā ca nāgena hastinā sarpeṇa ca, tasyā vapurūrudvayaṃ ca rambhayā'psarobhedena kadalyā ca, tasyāḥ pāṇī hastāvoṣṭhau ca pravālairvidrumaiḥ pallavaiśca sarvāṇi tulyatvamāyayuḥ
atra ‘he kalabhāṣiṇi, kasya te dṛṣṭirviśvāsyā bhavati’ ityukteryuktimāha—‘kṛṣṇārjunānuraktāpi karṇāvalambinī’ iti ca
yā hi kṛṣṇārjunenānurajyate kathaṃ sā karṇapakṣapātinī bhavati, yā caivamubhayagatā tasyāṃ ko viśvasiti; sa cāyamekakartṛkatvādabhinnakāraka iti śleṣo bhavati
he kalabhāṣiṇi madhuravacane, tava dṛṣṭiḥ kasya viśvasanīyatvaṃ viśvāsaviṣayatāṃ yāti kiṃtu na kasyāpi
atra hetuḥ kṛṣṇā śyāmā, arjunā dhavalā, anuraktā prāntalohitā ca
pakṣe kṛṣṇe harau, arjune pārthe cānuraktānurāgavatī karṇapakṣapātinī ca yā sā viruddhobhayagatā kathaṃ viśvasanīyā bhavati
anyāpadeśo vā yastu trividhaṃ bhāvikaṃ viduḥ || 86
‘ṇāvajjhai duggejjhiā diṭṭhammi jammi bhiuḍiā jattha ṇa avvāhārao ghippai āhāsattae
vicchuhai ahiṇiṃdae jattha ṇa so vaaṃsiā taṃ me kahau māṇaaṃ jai me icchahi jīaam || 232
[nābadhyate durgṛhītā dṛṣṭe yasmin bhṛkuṭikā yatra nāvyāhāro gṛhyate ābhāṣamāṇe
vikṣubhyate'bhinindyate yatra na sa vayasyayā taṃ me kathaya mānaṃ yadi me icchasi jīvanam ||]
atra bhrūbhedāsaṃbhāṣaṇapriyatamāvakṣepān pratyanabhimatapratipādanarūpasyābhiprāyasya kathitatvādidaṃ svābhiprāyakathanaṃ nāma bhāvikam
“nābadhyate durgrāhyā dṛṣṭe yasmin bhrukuṭikā yatra na ca (cā) vyāhāro gṛhyate ābhāṣamāṇe
vikṣubhyate'bhinīyamāne yatra na sa vayasyayā taṃ me kathaya mānaṃ yadi me icchasi jīvitam
” iha yasmin dṛṣṭe durgrahā bhrukuṭirnābadhyate samantānna badhyate yatrābhāṣamāṇe'vyāhāro na ca gṛhyate
yatrābhinīyamāne vayasyayā sa na kṣubhyate taṃ mānaṃ mama kathaya yadi mama jīvanamicchasi
hoi ghare sāhīṇaṃ musalaṃ dhaṇṇāṇaṃ mahilāṇam || 233 ||’
bhavati gṛhe svādhīnaṃ musalaṃ dhanyānāṃ mahilānām ||]
bhavati gṛhe svādhīnaṃ musalaṃ dhanyānāṃ mahilānām
” ihottamastrīṇāṃ gṛhe īdṛśaṃ musalaṃ svāyattaṃ bhavati
meḍhrapakṣe daṃśane bhagamardane valitaṃ saṃnaddhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vigatabandhanaṃ dīrghamatisthūlaṃ ca
atra parakṣetrasya ghasmaravṛṣanivāraṇāpadeśena cirātparijñāta upapatirnivāryate, tadidamanyāpadeśākhyaṃ bhāvikam
” iha he vṛṣabha, gṛhapatikṣetraṃ rakṣayitvā tvamuparamasva krīḍaya
ajñātena tvayā yāvadevāsvāditaṃ tāvataiva dhṛtiṃ bandhaya
atra māyāvino mahendrasyābhiprāyaḥ satyakena vyaktamevodbhinna iti vyakto'yamudbhedaḥ
” iha he suranātha indra, yadi madhumathasya kṛṣṇasya praṇayaṃ prītiṃ manuṣe svīkaroṣi
deve pādaparatnaṃ pārijātavṛkṣaṃ saṃdadāne sati mugdhaṃ svabhāvaṃ maugdhyamapajahi tyaja
‘niḥśeṣacyutacandanaṃ stanataṭaṃ nirmṛṣṭarāgo'dharo netre dūramanañjane pulakitā tanvī taveyaṃ tanuḥ
mithyāvādini dūti bāndhavajanasyājñātapīḍāgame vāpīṃ snātumito gatāsi na punastasyādhamasyāntikam || 236 ||’
atra ‘vāpīṃ snātumito gatāsi na punastasyādhamasyāntikam’ ityākṣepavatā prākaraṇikodāharaṇena yadyapi dūtyā duśceṣṭitaṃ nirbhinnaṃ tathāpi na pūrvavavdyaktamityavyakto'yamudbhedaḥ
he dūti, itaḥ sthānāttvaṃ vāpīṃ puṣkariṇīṃ snātuṃ gatāsi
tathā taveyaṃ tanvī kṛśā tanuḥ śarīraṃ pulakitā romāñcavatī ca
atra snānasaṃbhogayostulyacihnasyopadarśanena prakaraṇapariprāptaṃ dūtīduśceṣṭitamudbhinnam, na ca prāgvavdyaktatā
‘amlānotpalakomale sakhi dṛśau nīlāñjanenāñcite karpūracchuraṇācca gaṇḍaphalake saṃvellitaḥ pāṇḍimā
śvāsāḥ santu ca kandukabhramibhuvaḥ kiṃtu prabhāvāhinā- maṅgānāṃ kraśimānamutkaṭamamuṃ ko nāma notprekṣate || 237 ||’

atra ‘dṛśormlānatā, gaṇḍayoḥ pāṇḍuratvam, śvāsānāṃ dairdhyam’ ityutkaṇṭhācihnanihnavāya yo'yamavinayavatyā nīlāñjanādiprayogastasya tathābhyupagame'pi ‘aṅgānāṃ kraśimānamutkaṭamamuṃ ko nāma notprekṣate’ iti yo'yaṃ sakhīvyāhārastena tadabhiprāya udbhinno'nudbhinnaśca bhavatītyubhayarūpo'yamudbhedaḥ
kiṃtu he sakhi, tavāṅgānāmamumudbhaṭaṃ kraśimānaṃ kṛśatvaṃ ko na nāmotprekṣate kiṃtūnnayata eva
yadyapi tava dṛśāvamlāne mlānihīne utpanne iva komale manojñe staḥ
yataḥ karpūrasya churaṇāt saṃbandhāt pāṇḍimā pāṇḍuratvaṃ gaṇḍaphalake saṃvellitaḥ saṃbaddhaḥ
śvāsāśca kandukakrīḍanārthaṃ yā bhramirbhramaṇaṃ tatprabhavāḥ santu
prabhāvāhināṃ prabhāṃ dīptiṃ voḍhuṃ dhartuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣām
sā tu vyaktā tathāvyaktā vyaktāvyakteti ca tridhā || 88
phena eva candanam, diśa evāṅganā iti rūpakadvyam
yathā tilānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ ca mitho nirapekṣāṇāmeva saṃkīrṇatā tathātrāpi
atrādarśe chāyeva hetvalaṃkāre rāmalakṣmaṇamukhayorindupadmaupamyena sadṛśāsadṛśavyatireko dṛśyate
atra pūrvārdhena hetvalaṃkāre darśite tadādhāraka eva sadṛśāsadṛśayorvyatirekaḥ
sa ca darpaṇe pratibimba ivādhārādheyabhāvena vyavasthāpitaḥ
ṭaṅkena pāṣāṇadāraṇenollikhita utkhaṇḍitaḥ sūryo yasyāṃ sā
atra yathā mṛttikāpiṇḍe dhūlijalayormitho milanādavyaktatā tathā śleṣavirodhayorvyājastutiprasaṅgataḥ saṃkara
atra narasiṃhajātāviva siṃhanaraśarīrabhāgayoḥ parivṛttyalaṃkārahetūpamayoraṅgabhāvo vyaktāvyaktarūpaḥ parisphurannupalabhyate
hayakhurakṣuṇṇai rajobhirmeghatulyairhastibhiśca gaganaṃ bhūtalamiva, bhūtalaṃ gaganatalamiva kurvan
atra yathā narasiṃhajātau siṃhanarāṅgabhāgayorvyaktāvyaktarūpaṃ sphuraṇaṃ tathā parivṛttyalaṃkāre hetūpamayoraṅgabhāvo vyaktāvyaktarūpaḥ
atra paṭāvayavasthānāṃ nīlādīnāmiva paṭāvayavyāśrite citravarṇe śleṣarūpakopamārthaśleṣāṇāṃ padapadārthāśrayāṇāṃ śaradvarṇanavākyāśrayiṇi samādhyalaṃkāre vyaktāvyaktarūpo'ṅgaṅgibhāvaḥ pratīyate
mayūraśabdamukharāṃ, saha taḍiteva latayā vartate tām
atrāvayavāśritanīlādīnāmavayavyāśrite citravarṇe yathāṅgaṅgibhāvastathā śleṣādīnāṃ samādhyalaṃkāre vyaktāvyaktarūpo'ṅgāṅgibhāvaḥ pratīyata iti
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇe ubhayālaṃkāravivecano nāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ
ityanena prakāreṇa caturviṃśatiretā upamādayaḥ kāvyālaṃkṛtaya uktā ityanvayaḥ
ratnaṃ ratnadharo'janiṣṭa guṇināmādyo'navadyaḥ satāṃ sā śuddhā damayantikāpi suṣuve naiyāyikaṃ yaṃ sutam
śṛṅgārī cetkaviḥ kāvye jātaṃ rasamayaṃ jagat
sa eva cedaśṛṅgārī nīrasaṃ sarvameva tat || 3
paśyati strīti vākye hi na rasaḥ pratibhāsate
kanye kāmayamānaṃ māṃ tvaṃ na kāmayase katham
navo'rthaḥ sūktiragrāmyā śravyo bandhaḥ sphuṭā śrṛtiḥ
svarūpamāsāṃ yo veda sa kāvyaṃ kartumarhati || 12
trāsaḥ śaṅkā gado glānirunmādaḥ saṃbhramaḥ śramaḥ || 17
janitvā ye na jāyante te'thavā vyabhicāriṇaḥ
smṛtyādayo hi premādau bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 22
ratau saṃcāriṇaḥ sarvān garvasnehau dhṛtiṃ matim
saṃcāriṇaṃ vā janayan sāttvikaṃ vā sa jāyate || 24
śṛṅgārādyā rasā ye ca ye ca śāntoddhatādayaḥ
ye ca līlādayo yūnāṃ pariśeṣaḥ sa kīrtyate || 34
harṣāmarṣādayo ye ca jñeyāḥ saṃcāriṇo'tra te || 39
vilāsā ye varastrīṇāṃ jñeyā līlādayastu te || 40
bhṛśaṃ duḥkhāyate dīnā karuṇaḥ sa tadocyate || 50
kālasya haraṇaṃ cāhuḥ pratyādānaṃ ca vañcanam || 57
pratyādānaṃ punasteṣāṃ karuṇe ko na manyate
mānyate preyasā yena yaṃ priyatvena manyate
manute vā mimīte vā premamānaḥ sa kathyate || 69
yatrāṅganā yuvānaśca vasate na vasanti ca
pravāsayati vā yūnaḥ sa pravāso nirucyate || 72
abhūtotpādanāyāṃ kṛñ dṛṣṭaḥ kuru ghaṭaṃ yathā
abhyañjane'pi ca yathā pādau me sarpiṣā kuru || 75
karoti cittaṃ duḥkhena yo'sau karuṇa ucyate || 76
bhāve vā kārake vāpi rūpaṃ saṃbhoga iṣyate || 78
svato'pi kuṭilaṃ prema kiṃ nu mānānvaye sati || 80
nave hi saṅgame prāyo yuvānaḥ sādhvasādibhiḥ
tiryakṣu ca tadābhāsa iti dvādaśa nāyakāḥ || 102
mugdhā madhyā pragalbhā ca vayasā kauśalena vā || 110
mānarddheruddhatodāttā śāntā ca lalitā ca sā
sāmānyā ca punarbhūśca svairiṇī ceti vṛttitaḥ || 112
yasyā na militaḥ preyānvipralabdheti tāṃ viduḥ || 116
svādhīnapatikā sā tu yasyāḥ pārśvaṃ na muñcati
priyo deśāntare yasyāḥ sā tu proṣitabhartṛkā || 119
atra hrīḥ saṃcāribhāvo jāyamāno rasasya janma jñāpayati
atra dṛṣṭilakṣaṇaḥ śarīrārambho'nubhāvo bhavan rasāvirbhāvaṃ lakṣayati
atra devyāḥ smarārau pūrvamutpannā ratiḥ sābhilāṣatadavalokanaviviktavasantādibhiruddīpyamānā romāñcāvahitthalakṣaṇābhyāṃ sāttvikavyabhicāribhyāmanubadhyate
digdho'mṛtena ca viṣeṇa ca pakṣmalākṣyā gāḍhaṃ nikhāta iva me hṛdaye kaṭākṣaḥ || 6 ||’
atra mālatyā mādhavaviṣaye pūrvamutpannā ratirvasantāvatāratatsaṃnidhiviśeṣapradarśanādibhiruddīpyamānā punaḥ punarutpannena valitagrīvakaṭākṣavikṣepalakṣaṇena śarīrārambhānubhāvenānubadhyate
atraiva mādhavasya mālatīviṣaye tadaharevotpannā ratistairevoddīpanairuddīpyamānā harṣadhṛtismṛtimativyādhyādibhiḥ saṃcāribhāvairvāgārambheṇa cānubhāvenānubadhyate
‘taṃ vīkṣya vepathumatī sarasāṅgyaṣṭi- rnikṣepa eva padamuddhṛtamarpayantī
mārgācalavyatikarākuliteva sindhuḥ śailādhirājatanayā na yayau na tasthau || 7 ||’

atra janmāntarānubhavasaṃskārātpratikūle'pi śūlini śailātmajāyāḥ sarvakālamevāvicchinnā ratiściraviyuktasya duścareṇāpi tapasā prārthanīya-saṃgamasya tasyākasmikadarśanenoddīpyamānā sadyaḥsamupajāyamānasāttvikasvedastambhavepathūpalakṣitairharṣasmṛtyāvegasādhvasādibhirvyabhicāribhāvaiḥ padanikṣepalakṣaṇena ca śarīrānubhāvena saṃsṛjyate
‘pīnaśroṇi gabhīranābhi nibhṛtaṃ madhye bhṛśoccastanaṃ pāyādvaḥ parirabdhamabdhiduhituḥ kāntena kāntaṃ vapuḥ

atra sarvadaiva śrīvatsalakṣmaṇo lakṣmīviṣaye mahākulīnataudāryasthirānurāgitārūpayauvanavaidagdhyaśīlasaubhāgyamahābhāgyādibhiḥ samutpannā ratistadavayavaviśeṣakāmanīyakavibhāvanenoddīpanavibhāvātiśayenoddīpyamānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ samakṣamapyāliṅganalakṣaṇena śarīrārambhānubhāvenānumīyamānāṃ lajjāpraṇāśalakṣaṇāṃ premapuṣṭeraṣṭamīmavasthāmadhyāste
atra cānuktā api sāttvikā vyabhicāriṇo'nye'pi cānubhāvaviśeṣāḥ pratīyante

śriyo'pi ca samagrātmaguṇasaṃpadāśraye śrīvatsalakṣmaṇi tathābhūtā tadabhyadhikā vā ratiḥ pravṛddhapremapriyatamāliṅganalakṣaṇenoddīpanavibhāvevoddīpyamānā nayananimīlanānumeyāṃ samastasāttvikānubhāvavyabhicārihetuṃ premapuṣṭeruttamāmavasthāmāśrayati
so'yaṃ viṣayasaundaryādāśrayaprakṛteḥ saṃskārapāṭavāduddīpanātiśayācca parāṃ koṭimāvahan rasaḥ puṣṭa ityucyate

atraiva brahmaṇaḥ śriyaṃ prati manoharā mameyaṃ sṛṣṭiriti, ratnākarasyeyamātmajeti, candrā-mṛtādīnāmiyaṃ sodaryeti, viṣṇoriyaṃ priyatameti, kāmasyeyaṃ jananītyādibhya ālambanebhyaḥ samutpannā prītiḥ svāvāsānupaghātinā śarīrasaṃniveśena dṛṅmimīlanajanitayā ca tadupaghātaśaṅkayoddīpyamānā tatkṣaṇopajāyamānatayā āvegasmṛtivitarkonmādamohacintādibhirvyabhicāribhāvaistadanumeyaiśca stambhavepathuprabhṛtisāttvikaiḥ śivānudhyānalakṣaṇena budhdyārambhānubhāvena saṃsṛjyamānā paraṃ prakarṣamārohantī pratīyate
ātaṅkādvikalaṃ drutaṃ karuṇayā vikṣobhitaṃ vismayāt krodhena jvalitaṃ mudā vikasitaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ vartatām || 9 ||’

atra mādhavasya mālatyāṃ pūrvamutpannā ratistadavasthālokanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānā bhayaśokavismayakrodhaharṣairapi rasāntaraiḥ pṛthakpṛthagvibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogānniṣpadyamānaiḥ saṃkīryamāṇā manovāgbuddhiśarīrārambhānubhāvairbhayādyanurūpaiśca sāttvikavyabhicāribhiḥ saṃparke paraṃ prakarṣamārohantī pratīyate

tatra cetaso vaikalyādiparibhāvanaṃ manaārambhaḥ, vākyoccāraṇaṃ vāgārambhaḥ, rāhoriva dasyoścandrakalāmiva preyasīmityādi budhdyārambhaḥ, ācchindata ityādi śarīrārambhaḥ, bhayādīnāṃ ca pañcānāmapi yathākramaṃ rāhoriti, candrakalāmivānanacarīmiti, daivātsamāsādya me iti, dasyorasya kṛpāṇapātaviṣayāditi, ācchindataḥ preyasīmityālambanavibhāvāstatsvarūpaparibhāvanānyuddīpanavibhāvāḥ, vikalam, drutam, vikṣobhitam, jvalitam, vikasitaṃ ceta ityanubhāvāḥ, ātaṅkakaruṇāvismayakrodhamudanurūpāśca kampāśrustambhavaivarṇyaromāñcādayaḥ sāttvikāḥ, mohaviṣādavitarkogratādhṛtyādayo vyabhicāriṇaścānumīyamānā niṣpattihetavo bhavanti
so'yaṃ tulyakālabalotpattikāraṇānāṃ bhayādiniṣpattīnāṃ ratau saṃsargaḥ saṃkara ityucyate
‘kopo yatra bhrukuṭiracanā nigraho yatra maunaṃ yatrānyonyasmitamanunayo dṛṣṭipātaḥ prasādaḥ
tasya premṇastadidamadhunā vaiśasaṃ paśya jātaṃ tvaṃ pādānte luṭhasi na ca me manyumokṣaḥ khalāyāḥ || 10 ||’
nīvībandhavadāgataṃ śithilatāmābhāṣamāṇe tato mānenāpagataṃ hriyeva sudṛśaḥ pādaspṛśi preyasi || 15 ||’
‘eṣyatyutsukamāgate vicalitaṃ saṃbhāṣiṇi sphāritaṃ saṃśliṣyatyaruṇaṃ gṛhītavasane kopāñcitabhrūlatam
māninyāścaraṇānativyatikare bāṣpāmbupūrṇaṃ kṣaṇāccakṣurjātamaho prapañcacaturaṃ jātāgasi preyasi || 16 ||’
ta ete bhāvādayo daśāpi rasaprakārā hāsādiṣvapi prāyo dṛśyante
asitasicayaprāntabhrāntyā muhurmuhurutkṣipan jayati janitavrīḍāhāsaḥ priyāhasito hariḥ || 17 ||’
atra rādhāyā harinyaṅgād, harestu vrīḍāto hāsasya sattāmātraṃ pratīyate
atra daśasthasya rāmaviyogādutpannastadguṇasmaraṇādibhiruddīpitaścintāsaṃtāpādirvāgārambheṇa cānuṣajyamānaḥ śokarūpeṇa raso niṣpadyate

atra yadyapi vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogalakṣaṇāyā rasaniṣpatteḥ 'adhikamatiruṣātilohitākṣyā’ iti prakarṣanimittamatiśabdopādānaṃ vidyate, tathāpyuttamanāyikāśrayaḥ priyaviṣaye na roṣaḥ prakarṣamāsādayati
‘mūrdhnā jāmbavato'bhivādya caraṇāvāpṛcchya senāpatī- nāśvāsyāśrumukhānmuhuḥ priyasakhīnpreṣyānsamādiśya ca
ārambhaṃ jagṛhe mahendraśikharādambhonidherlaṅghane raṃhasvī raghunāthapādarajasāmuccaiḥ smaranmārutiḥ || 20 ||’

atra yadyapi pallīnāmālambanatvam, tadviśeṣaṇayoruddīpanatvam, mantrajapāderanubhāvatvam, tāluśoṣādīnāṃ vyabhicāritvamiti vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogo'sti, tathāpi mantrajapeṣṭadevatānudhyānayorlaṅghanopāyaparatvānna bhayarūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiḥ
‘he hasta dakṣiṇa mṛtasya śiśordvijasya jīvātave visṛja śūdramunau kṛpāṇam
rāmasya gātramasi nirbharagarbhakhinnasītā- pravāsanapaṭoḥ karuṇā kutaste || 22 ||’
atra yadyapi dvijaśiśorjīvanāya munirapi śūdro vadhya iti na rāmasyātmakarmanindā tathāpyanapakāriṇaṃ jighāṃsato ghṛṇānuvartata eva
‘kṛṣṇenāmba gatena rantumasakṛnmṛdbhakṣitā svecchayā satyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ka evamāha musalī mithyāmba paśyānanam
vyādehīti vikāsite ca vadane dṛṣṭvā samastaṃ jaga- nmātā yasya jagāma vismayapadaṃ pāyātsa vaḥ keśavaḥ || 23 ||’
atra śiśormuṃkhe jagaddarśanamālambanavibhāvaḥ, tatsāmagryaśaiśavādyālocanamuddīpanavibhāvaḥ, vismayavaśaṃ jagāmetyanenānupāttā api sarve saṃcāriṇo'nubhāvāśca gṛhyante
ayaṃ ca puṣṭo'pi sāttvikatvāt sadaivānyānuyāyīti nānubhāvādibhiranubadhyate
paiṇo dhaṇuravakaṃkhiṇi romaṃcaṃ kiṃ muhā vahasi || 25 ||’
‘pipipriya sasasvayaṃ mumumukhāsavaṃ dehi me tatatyaja dududrutaṃ bhabhabhabhājanaṃ kāñcanam
iti skhalitajalpitaṃ madavaśātkuraṅgīdṛśaḥ prage hasitahetave sahacarībhiradhyeyata || 26 ||’
‘mā garvamudvaha kapolatale cakāsti kāntasvahastalikhitā mama mañjarīti
anyāpi kiṃ na sakhi bhājanamīdṛśānāṃ vairī na cedbhavati vepathurantarāyaḥ || 28 ||’
‘sahi sāhasu teṇa samaṃ ahaṃ pi kiṃ ṇiggaā pahāammi
aṇṇacia dīsai jeṇa dappaṇe kāvi sā sumuho || 29 ||’
[sakhi sādhaya tena samamahamapi kiṃ nirgatā prabhāte
anyaiva dṛśyate yena darpaṇe kāpi sā sumukhī ||]
asminnalakṣitanatonnatabhūmibhāge mārge padāni khalu te viṣamībhavanti || 30 ||’
atra bāṣpaśavdena locanāśrayamaśrūcyate na kaṇṭhādyāśrayo duḥkhāveśaḥ
yathā—‘vilalāpa sa bāppagadgadam', ‘ muhurmagnaḥ kaṇṭhe taralayati bāṣpaḥ stanataṭīm’ ityādi
atra mohaśabdena mūrcchocyate, na vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇo mohaḥ
‘itaḥ pratyādeśātsvajanamanugantuṃ vyavasitā sthitā tiṣṭhetyuccairvadati guruśiṣye gurusame
punardṛṣṭiṃ bāṣpaprasarakaluṣāmarpitavatī mayi krūre yattatsaviṣamiva śalyaṃ dahati mām || 32 ||’
‘citte niveśya parikalpitasattvayogā- nrūpoccayena ghaṭitā manasā kṛtā nu
strīratnasṛṣṭiraparā pratibhāti sā me dhāturvibhutvamanucintya vapuśca tasyāḥ || 33 ||’
so'yamasatyaḥ satyo vā smṛtijñānacintanādidvāreṇa nirṇayānto niṣpanna ityucyate
‘yāsyatyadya śakuntaleti hṛdayaṃ saṃspṛṣṭamutkaṇṭhyā kaṇṭhaḥ stambhitabāṣpavṛttikaluṣaścintājaḍaṃ darśanam
vaiklavyaṃ mama tāvadīdṛśamidaṃ snehādaraṇyaukasaḥ pīḍyante gṛhiṇaḥ kathaṃ nu tanayāviśleṣaduḥkhairnavaiḥ || 34 ||’
atra vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogāt prītirivotkaṇṭhāpi tadanuṣaṅgiṇī niṣpannā uttarārdhapratipādyena niṣedhenaiva vismayādinābhibhūyamānā hrāsa ityucyate
suṇṇaṃ kalahāantī sahīhi~ ruṇṇā ṇa o hasiā || 35 ||’
śūnyaṃ kalahāyamānā sakhībhī ruditā na vā hasitā ||]
atra sakhīrodanena śūnyakalahaḥ, śūnyakalahena sākṣātkāraḥ, sākṣātkāreṇa cintā, cintayā tu mūlabhūtā ratiḥ prakṛṣyate
yadvā na siddhamastreṇa mama tatkena setsyati || 38 ||’
‘anena kasyāpi kulāṅkureṇa spṛṣṭasya gātreṣu sukhaṃ mamaitat
kāṃ nirvṛtiṃ cetasi tasya kuryā- dyasyāyamaṅgātkṛtinaḥ prarūḍhaḥ || 39 ||’
atra duṣyantasya sattvadamanadarśanādutpannastadaṅgasparśasukhādibhiruddīpitaḥ spṛhāmativitarkavāgārambhaiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ sneho niṣpadyate
‘nīto vikramabāhurātmasamatāṃ prāpteyamurvītale sāraṃ sāgarikā samāgaramahīprāptyekahetuḥ priyā
devī prītimupāgatā ca bhaginīlābhājjitāḥ kosalāḥ kiṃ nāsti tvayi satyamātyavṛṣabhe yasminkaromi spṛhām || 40 ||’
atra vatsarājasya sarvātmanā manorathasiddhayo dhṛteḥ prakarṣamāvahanti
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣe krodhaśokābhyāṃ saṃkaro yathā—
kīrṇā bāṣpakaṇaiḥ patanti dhanuṣi vrīḍājaḍā dṛṣṭayo hā vatseti giraḥ sphuranti na punarniryānti kaṇṭhādbahiḥ || 41 ||’
atrārjunasyānyāyenābhimanyuvadhādudbhūtau dīptāveva krodhaśokāvudbhūtavipratīkārotthayā tathāvidhayaiva vrīḍayā saṃkīryete
tathāhi krodhaśokayoranubhāvabhūtā dṛṣṭayo vācaśca vrīḍājaḍā iti viśeṣaṇāni saṃbadhyante
ityāderdevarṣivākyādudbhūtaḥ praharṣākāro gurusaṃnidhau lajjitayā līlākamalapatragaṇanavyājena gauryā gopyate
‘kānte talpamupāgate vigalitā nīvī svayaṃ bandhanā- dvāso viślathamekhalāguṇadhṛtaṃ kiṃcinnitambe sthitam
etāvatsakhi vedmi kevalamahaṃ tasyāṅgasaṅge punaḥ ko'yaṃ kā vayamatra kiṃ nu surataṃ svalpāpi me na smṛtiḥ 44’
ānanena na tu tāvadīśvaraścakṣuṣā ciramumāmukhaṃ papau || 45 ||’
‘jātasya te piturapīndrajito nihantu- rvatsasya vatsa kati nāma dinānyamūni
tasyāpyapatyamadhitiṣṭhati vīradharme diṣṭyā gataṃ daśarathasya kulaṃ pratiṣṭhām || 46 ||’

atra daśarathasuhṛdaḥ sumanttrasāratheḥ prabhukulasya pratiṣṭhāmāśaṃsatastatsūnumindrajito hantāraṃ paśyato manorathāvāptyā harṣo niṣpannastadapatye'pi vīradharmamācariṣṇau prakṛṣṭo diṣṭyetyavyayena sūcyate
ākṛṣṭapāṇḍavavadhūparidhānakeśāḥ svasthā bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ || 47 ||’
atra bhīmasenasya dhārtarāṣṭreṣu svasthā iti nāmno'pyasahanāt lākṣāgṛhādyapakārajanmāmarṣaḥ pratīyate
‘vandyāste na vicāraṇīyacaritāstiṣṭhantu huṃ vartate sundastrīnidhane'pyakhaṇḍayaśaso loke mahānto hi te
yāni trīṇi kutomukhānyapi padānyāsankharāyodhane yadvā kauśalamindrasūnudamane tatrāpyabhijño janaḥ || 48 ||’
atra yadyapi solluṇṭhadoṣakīrtanādibhirjugupsā niṣyadyate tathāpi na tayā svaniṣpattiheturasūyā saṃkīryate
‘huṃ ṇillajja samosara taṃ ccia aṇuṇesu jāi de eaṃ

atra kasyāścit preyasi sapatnīṃ prasādayituṃ gate tanmānamamṛṣyamāṇāyāḥ samutpannerṣyā priyānunayādibhirbhṛśāyamānatayā niṣpannālaktakatilakānumeyaistatpādapatanādibhiruddīptā huṃkārākṣepabhartsanapratibhedāvinābhūtairbhrūbhaṅgatāḍanāṅgakṣepavepathusvedagadgadādibhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānā prakṛṣyate
‘vyarthaṃ yatra kapīndrasakhyamapi me kleśaḥ kapīnāṃ vṛthā prajñāṃ jāmbavato'pi yatra na gatiḥ putrasya vāyorapi
mārgaṃ yatra na viśvakarmatanayaḥ kartuṃ nalo'pi kṣamaḥ saumitrerapi pattriṇāmaviṣayastatra priyā kvāpi me || 50 ||’
‘asmānsādhu vicintya saṃyamadhanānuccaiḥ kulaṃ cātmana- stvayyasyāḥ kathamapyabāndhavakṛtāṃ bhāvapravṛttiṃ ca tām
sāmānyapratipattipūrvakamiyaṃ dāreṣu dṛśyā tvayā bhāgyādhīnamataḥ paraṃ na khalu tadvācyaṃ vadhūbandhubhiḥ || 51 ||’
vapuṣi vadhāya tatra tava śastramupakṣipataḥ patatu śirasyakāṇḍayamadaṇḍa ivaiṣa bhujaḥ || 52 ||’
atra mādhavasya prakṛṣṭāpakāriṇyaghoraghaṇṭe viṣaye prakṛṣṭameva vākpāruṣyaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ ca jāyate
atra loladṛṣṭitā karābadhūnanaṃ ca strīṇāṃ svabhāvabhīrutvavilāsitvābhyāmapi bhavatīti trāsāvirbhāve'pyasamarthamiti nānubangho bhavati
accaṃtapahariseṇa vi jā a muā sā muā ccea || 54 ||’
atyantapraharṣeṇāpi yā ca mṛtā sā mṛtaiva ||]
atra virahiṇyāḥ kārśyātiśayamudvīkṣamāṇāyāḥ kasyāścidvayasyāyāḥ snehātiśayāt 'prema paśyati bhayānyapade'pī'ti priyāgamapraharṣātiśayabhāve'pyasahiṣṇutayā tanmaraṇaśaṅkā prakṛṣyate
glapayati paripāṇḍukṣāmamasyāḥ śarīraṃ śaradija iva gharmaḥ ketakīgarbhapattram || 56 ||’
‘kvākāryaṃ kva kalādharasya ca kulaṃ bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā doṣāṇāmupaśāntaye śrutamaho kope'pi śāntaṃ mukham
kiṃ vakṣyantyapakalmaṣāḥ kṛtadhiyo rekhaiva sānyādṛśī cetaḥ svāsthyamupaihi kaḥ khalu yuvā dhanyo'dharaṃ dhāsyati 57’
atra virahiṇaḥ purūravasa utkaṇṭhādibhiḥ premaprakarṣādasatpralāparūpa unmādo niṣpadyate
‘alamalamatimātraṃ sāhasenāmunā te tvaritamapi vimuñca tvaṃ latāpāśamenam
calitamiva niroddhuṃ jīvitaṃ jīviteśe kṣaṇamiha mama kaṇṭhe bāhupāśaṃ nidhehi || 58 ||’
atra ratijanmā saṃbhramātiśayo ratijanmanaiva matiprakarṣeṇa saṃkīryate
‘skhalayati vacanaṃ te saṃśrayatyaṅgamaṅgaṃ janayati mukhacandrodbhāsinaḥ khedabindūn
mukulayati ca netre sarvathā subhru khedastvayi vilasati tulyaṃ vallabhālokanena || 59 ||’
atra mālatyāḥ puṣpāvacayajanmā śramaḥ, mādhavāvalokanajā ca ratiḥ, svedagadgadāṅgasādanayanamukulaistulyadharmiṇau mithaḥ saṃkīryete
‘śithilaśithilaṃ nyasya svairaṃ dhanuḥśikhare śiro nayanasalilaiḥ kurvanmaurvīlatāmaparāmiva
ahaha vikalaḥ śrutvā śrutvā ghanastanitadhvaniṃ kimapi kimapi dhyāyannāryo na yāti na tiṣṭhati || 61 ||’
nāgāṅkaṃ moktumicchoḥ śayanamuruphaṇācakravālopadhānaṃ nidrācchedābhitāmrā ciramavatu harerdṛṣṭirākekarā vaḥ || 65 ||’
atra dṛṣṭeḥ pratyagronmeṣajihmatādibhiḥ prabodho nādyāpi niṣpadyata iti pratīyate
‘mṛteti pretya saṃgantuṃ yayā me maraṇaṃ matam

atrāvantyā vāsavadattāyā ālambanavibhāvabhūtāyāḥ sakāśādutpanno vatseśvarasya ratisthāyibhāvaḥ, tasyāḥ punarjīvanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamāno mṛtetyādinā vāgārambhānubhāvenānumīyamānairharṣadhṛtiprabhṛtibhiḥ sukhātmakairvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ karuṇānantaraḥ saṃbhogaḥ śṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate

atra vasudhāvijayāderālambanavibhāvādutpannaḥ sthāyyutsāhabhāvaḥ sthairyadhairyādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaiḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumīyamāneṣu smṛtimativitarkādiṣu niṣpanno vīrarasasaṃjñayā vyavahriyate

atra cālambanavibhāvabhūtadevīmaraṇādutpannaḥ śokaḥ sthāyibhāvaścitāniveśanahutāśanāṅgajvālādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamāno vāgārambhānumeyairnirvedaglānivaivarṇyādibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ karuṇa iti jñāyate
so'yaṃ duḥśāsanaḥ pāpo lavdhaḥ kiṃ jīvati kṣaṇam || 69 ||’

atra duḥśāsanālambanavibhāvāya krudhyato bhīmasenasya pūrvamutpannaḥ krodhaḥ sthāyibhāvastadavāpteḥ smaryamāṇasamakṣakṛtadraupadīnigrahakeśakarṣaṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumīyamāneṣvasūyāvegavepathuśramādiṣu duḥkhātmakeṣu vyabhicāriṣu nippadyamāno raudra iti niṣpadyate
atra śākhināṃ pravālapuṣpaphalaśākhāsaṃpannaṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ nandanaśākhināṃ punaḥ pravālādisthāneṣvaṃśukahāramadhumandirāṇi tadetadāścaryam

ataścaitebhya ālambanavibhāvebhyaḥ kasyaciddevabhūyaṃgatasya samutpanno vismayaḥ sthāyibhāvastadīyāvayavadarśanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumeyeṣu harṣaromodgamakhedagadgadādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu niṣpadyamāno'dbhuta ityucyate

atra mahendrakuliśāddhārāsaṃnihitānalādālambanavibhāvātsmaryamāṇādapi daityastrīṇāmutpanno bhayasthāyibhāvastadvidīrṇadānavamaraṇasmaraṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ svagarbhapātādibhiranubhāvādibhistadanumitaiśca svedastambhavepathuprabhṛtibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamāno bhayānakarasarūpeṇa niṣpannaḥ kenacidākhyāyamāno'pi bhayānaka ityākhyāyate

atrālambanavibhāvabhūtebhyaḥ kauṇapebhyaḥ kasyacidripujayaśaṃsinaḥ puṃsa utpanno jugupsāsthāyibhāvaḥ śiraśchedavigaladrudhiraghārāpariplutapraṇartitakabandhakauṇapānttrabhūṣaṇaśoṇitapānādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumeyeṣu bhayāveśaśaṅkāvahitthādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu niṣpanno bībhatsa iti nigadyate

atra kācit sakhīṃ pūrvaṃ bhartari gṛhītamānāṃ tenaiva nakhapadāṅkitastanīmālambanavibhāvabhūtāmupalabhamānāyāḥ kasyāścitsakhyā utpanno hāsaḥ sthāyibhāvastadīyamānaparigrahasmaraṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumiteṣu śaṅkāvahitthagadgadādivyabhicāriṣu niṣpadyamāno hāsyaśabdenābhidhīyate
iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā || 74 ||’

atra vatsalaprakṛterdhīratayā lalitanāyakasya priyālambanavibhāvādutpannaḥ snehasthāyibhāvo viṣayasaukumāryātmaprakṛtyādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samupajāyamānairmohadhṛtismṛtyādibhirvyabhicāribhāvairanubhāvaiśca saṃsṛjyamāno niṣpannaḥ preyāniti pratīyate

atra kasyacidupaśāntaprakṛterdhīraśāntanāyakasya yathopanatamanonukūladārādisaṃpatterālambanavibhāvabhūtāyāḥ samutpanno dhṛtisthāyibhāvo vastutattvālocanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samupajāyamānasmṛtyādibhirvyabhi-cāribhāvairvāgārambhādibhiranuṣajyamāno niṣpannaḥ śānta ityabhigīyate
anye punarasya śamaṃ prakṛtimāmananti sa tu dhṛtereva viśeṣo bhavati

atra rāmasyodāttaprakṛternisargata eva tattvābhiniveśinī matirnākṛtyaviṣaye pravartate, na ca pravṛttopāramati, sā ca sīteyaṃ mama svīkārayogyetyevaṃrūpeṇa pravṛttā rāvaṇaprārthanālakṣmaṇaprotsāhanābhyāmuddīpyamānā samupajāyamānacintāvitarkavrīḍāvahitthasmṛtyādibhiḥ kālocitottarānumīyamānaiśca vivekacāturyaudāryadhairyādibhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānodāttarasarūpeṇa niṣpadyate
vimukheṣu na me khaṅgaḥ prahartuṃ jātu vāñchati || 78 ||’
atra mayāsyāpakāraḥ kṛta iti yaccetasi bhayaṃ tanmābhūt ‘parāṅyukheṣu me khaṅgaḥ kadācidapi na prahartumutsahate’ iti sarvadaiva rūḍho'haṃkāraḥ pratīyate
ityevamūrjakhītyudāttapakṣe nikṣipantaḥ pūrvoktameva garvaprakarṣodāharaṇaṃ dhṛtāyudho yāvadahamityādyuddhataniṣpattau varṇayanti
‘bhittvā sadyaḥ kisalayapuṭān devadārudrumāṇāṃ ye tatkṣīrasrutisurabhayo dakṣiṇena pravṛttāḥ
āliṅgyante guṇavati mayā te tuṣārādrivātāḥ pūrvaspṛṣṭaṃ yadi kila bhavedaṅgamebhistaveti || 81 ||’
atra śaityasaurabhādibhirvirahijanodvejanīyā api vāyavaḥ priyatamāṅgasaṃsargasaṃbhāvanayā samāśliṣyanta iti saṃsargata iyaṃ bhavati
nanu punariva tanme gocarībhūtamakṣṇo- rabhinavaśatapattraśrīmadāsyaṃ priyāyāḥ || 82 ||’
atra seyaṃ durvāsasaḥ śāpādvismṛtavivāhādivṛttāntasya duṣyantasya śakuntalāyāṃ ratiradhyātmaṃ bhavati
hṛdayamaśaraṇaṃ me pakṣmalākṣyāḥ kāṭākṣairapahṛtamapaviddhaṃ pītamunmūlitaṃ ca || 84 ||’
huṃhu~ muñca mamameti ca mandaṃ jalpitaṃ jayati mānadhanāyāḥ || 85 ||’
atra tarjanārtha—mokṣārtha—vāraṇārthānāṃ mandaṃ mandaṃ prayogānmānavatyāḥ saṃprayoge ratyutpattiḥ pratīyate
‘iyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriyamamṛtavartirnayanayo- rasāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahalaścandanarasaḥ
ayaṃ bāhuḥ kaṇṭhe śiśiramasṛṇo mauktikasaraḥ kimasyā na preyo yadi paramasahyastu virahaḥ || 86 ||’
tathā hi śeṣendriyavṛttirāsāṃ sarvātmanā cakṣuriva praṃviṣṭā 89’
muhamāruaṃ pianto dhūmāi sihī ṇa pajjalai || 91 ||’
mukhamārutaṃ piban dhūmāyate śikhī na prajvalati ||]
atra yadā yadā ratirjāyate tadā tadā putreṣu snihyati putrarūpeṇa vā jāyata iti janmāntaravāsanārūpo nisargaḥ saṃgacchate
‘viśvaṃbharā bhagavatī bhavatīmasūta rājā prajāpatisamo janakaḥ pitā te
teṣāṃ vadhūstvamasi nandini pārthivānāṃ yeṣāṃ kule ca savitā ca gururvayaṃ ca || 93 ||’
punariva śiśurbhūtvā vatsaḥ sa me raghunandano jhaṭiti kurute dṛṣṭaḥ ko'yaṃ dṛśoramṛtāñjanam || 94 ||’
‘ajñātabandhurayamṛkṣaharīśvaro me paulastya eṣa samareṣu puraḥ prahartā
ityādṛtena kathitau raghunandanena vyutkrāntalakṣmaṇamubhau bharato vavande || 96 ||’
varāhasya ca māṃsasya so'yaṃ gacchati phālgunaḥ || 102 ||’
yatra srutakṣīratayā prasūtaḥ sānūni ganghaḥ surabhīkaroti || 103’
tenotsāhasya yuddhadānadayāvīrādayaḥ, krodhasya bhāmamanyūtprāsādayaḥ, hāsasya smitahasitavihasitādayaḥ, suptapralayamatyādīnāṃ tu svapnamaraṇaśamādayo bhedā jāyante

tatra yadyapi ‘ajitvā sārṇavāmurvīm’ ityanena yuddhavīraḥ, ‘aniṣṭvā vividhairmakhaiḥ’ ityanena dānavīraḥ, ‘adattvā cārthamarthibhyaḥ’ ityanena dayāvīraścotsāharūpeṇa niṣpattau varṇitaḥ, tathāpyekaśo'pyete rasaniṣpattyai prabhavantīti pradarśyante
‘etāṃ paśya puraḥsthalīmiha kila krīḍākirāto haraḥ kodaṇḍena kirīṭinā sarabhasaṃ cūḍāntare tāḍitaḥ
ityākarṇya kathādbhutaṃ himanidhāvadrau subhadrāpate- rmandaṃ mandamakāri yena nijayordordaṇḍayormaṇḍanam 104’
‘sa tvaṃ madīyena śarīravṛttiṃ dehena nirvartayituṃ yatasva
krodhasya yadyapi bhāmādayo mānabhedāścaturviṃśatiḥ saṃbhavanti tathāpi lalitālalitobhayabhedena rūpeṇa krameṇa sarvasaṃgrahāttatra traya eva prakārāḥ pradarśyante
yatra kopaiḥ kṛtā srīṇāṃ saṃprasādārthinaḥ priyāḥ || 107 ||’
nanviyamīrṣyā kasmānna bhavati, nātra mānadānāmarṣamātraṃ vivakṣitamapi tu tajjanito duḥkhātiśaya iti
‘pahavaṃti ccia purisā mahilāṇaṃ kiṃ tha suhaa vihiosi
hāsasya yadyapyupahāsādayo bhedāḥ saṃbhavanti tathāpi vihasitena teṣāṃ saṃgrahādīṣannyūnādhikamiti trayastadbhedā udāhriyante—
abhibhavasi tvamadya śaśinaḥ śriyamutkaṭayā daśanamayūkhamañjaritayā hasitaprabhayā || 111 ||’
‘cyutāmindorlekhāṃ ratikalahabhagnaṃ ca valayaṃ dvyaṃ cakrīkṛtya prahasitamukhī śailatanayā
avocadyaṃ paśyetyavatu sa śivaḥ sā ca girijā sa ca krīḍācandro daśanakiraṇāpūritatanuḥ || 112 ||’
‘jāne kopaparāṅmukhī priyatamā svapne'dya dṛṣṭā mayā mā mā saṃspṛśa pāṇineti rudatī gantuṃ pravṛttā puraḥ
no yāvatparirabhya cāṭukaśatairāśvāsayāmi priyāṃ bhrātastāvadahaṃ śaṭhena vidhinā nidrādaridrīkṛtaḥ || 113 ||’
idānīmasmākaṃ paṭutaravivekāñjanajuṣāṃ samībhūtā dṛṣṭistribhuvanamapi brahma manute || 115 ||’
jātyena candramaṇineva mahīdharasya saṃdhāryate dravamayo manasā vikāraḥ || 116 ||’
‘utkūjati śvasiti muhyati yāti tīraṃ tīrāttaruṃ tarutalātpunareti vāpīm
vāpyāṃ na rajyati na cātti mṛṇālakhaṇḍaṃ cakraḥ kṣapāsu virahe khalu cakravākyāḥ || 118 ||’
‘iyaṃ sā lolākṣī tribhuvanalalāmaikavasatiḥ sa cāyaṃ duṣṭātmā svasurapakṛtaṃ yena mama tat
itastīvraḥ kāmo gururayamitaḥ krodhadahanaḥ kṛto veṣaścāyaṃ kathamidamiti bhrāmyati manaḥ || 119 ||’
‘āyāte dayite marusthalabhuvāṃ saṃcintya durlaṅghyatāṃ gehinyā paritoṣabāṣpataralāmāsajya dṛṣṭiṃ mukhe
dattvā pīluśamīkarīrakavalān svenāñcalenādarā- dunmṛṣṭaṃ karabhasya kesarasaṭābhārāgralagnaṃ rajaḥ || 120 ||’
‘kṣiptaṃ puro na jagṛhe muhurikṣukāṇḍaṃ nāpekṣate sma nikaṭopagatāṃ kareṇum
‘sarasijamanuviddhaṃ śaivalenāpi ramyaṃ malinamapi himāṃśorlakṣma lakṣmīṃ tanoti
iyamadhikamanojñā valkalenāpi tanvī kimiva hi madhurāṇāṃ maṇḍanaṃ nākṛtīnām || 122 ||’
‘kiṃ rūpaṃ sphuṭameva sā śaśimukhī dhatte tadatyadbhutaṃ māmutsāhayituṃ parāpakaraṇe cittaṃ kimasmatsvasuḥ
ityantarvikasadvitarkavidhuraṃ cetastathā vartate svalpo'pyeṣa mama prayāti purataḥ panthā yathā dīrghatām 123’
‘kanyāratnamayonijanma bhavatāmāste vayaṃ cārthino ratnaṃ yatkvacidasti tatpariṇamatyasmāsu śakrādapi
kanyāyāśca parārthataiva hi matā tasyāḥ pradānādahaṃ bandhurvo bhavitā pulastyapulahapraṣṭhāśca saṃbandhinaḥ || 125 ||’
‘bhūyo bhūyaḥ savidhanagarīrathyayā paryaṭantaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā bhavanavalabhītuṅgavātāyanasthā
atra yadyapi viṣayaguṇāt paṭuḥ, āśrayaguṇādāhato'pi pratyayaḥ, paṭumāhataṃ ca saṃskāraṃ prasūte tathāpyabhyāsātpaṭīyānāhatatamaśca jāyamāno'bhyasta ityucyate
‘idamapulabhavastu prārthanādunirvāraṃ prathamamapi mano me pañcabāṇaḥ kṣiṇoti
ityādi nanviha nirarthakameva yasmā- tkāmaśca jṛmbhitaguṇo navayauvanaṃ ca || 132 ||’
sā babhūva vaśavartinī dvayoḥ śūlinaḥ suvadanā madasya ca 133’
tāpayanti virahe kimucyate mārayanti na yadetadadbhutam 134’
avaraṇhamajjirīṇaṃ kae ṇa kāmo dhaṇuṃ vahai || 135 ||’
‘vilimpatyetasminmalayajarasārdreṇa mahasā diśāṃ vaktraṃ candre sukṛtamatha tasyā mṛgadṛśaḥ
dṛśorbāṣpaḥ pāṇau vadanamasavaḥ kaṇṭhakuhare hṛdi tvaṃ hrīḥ pṛṣṭhe vacasi ca guṇā eva bhavataḥ || 137’
jaṇavāo vi ṇa jāo teṇa samaṃ haliautteṇa || 141 ||’
vajjhamahisassa mālavva maṃḍaṇaṃ se ṇa paḍihāi || 142 ||’
‘candasarisaṃ muhaṃ se sariso amaassa muharaso tissā
virahammi maṇṇai harīṇahe aṇatthapaḍiuṭṭhiaṃ va miaṃkam || 145’
samuhāvaḍie ko verie vi diṭṭhiṃ ṇa pāḍei || 146 ||’
[ālāpo mā dīyatāṃ lokaviruddha iti nāma kṛtvā
saṃmukhāpatite ko vairiṇyapi dṛpṭiṃ na pātayati ||]
‘ajja mae gaṃtavvaṃ ghaṇaṃdhaāre vi tassa suhaassa
‘diṭṭhe jaṃ pulaijjasi tharaharasi piammi jaṃ samāsaṇṇe
puṇaruttapechirīe vālaa kiṃ jaṃ ṇa bhaṇio si || 149 ||’
‘savvassammi vidaddhe(ḍḍhe) taha vi hu hiaassa ṇivvudi ccea
jaṃ teṇa gāmaḍāhe hatthāhatthiṃ kuḍo gahio || 150 ||’
‘katto saṃpaḍai maha pi piasahi piasaṃgamo paose vi
‘jaṃ jaṃ karesi jaṃ jaṃ jappasi jaṃ jaṃ ṇiacchesi
taṃ tamaṇusikkharīe dīho diaho ṇa saṃpaḍai || 152 ||’
acchāñjane ca nayane vasanaṃ tanīyaḥ kāntāsu bhūṣaṇamidaṃ vibhavaśca śeṣaḥ || 154 ||’
priyaṃ prati preṣitacittavṛtti- rnitambabimbe ca babhāra hāram || 155 ||’
‘tava sā kathāsu parighaṭṭayati śravaṇaṃ yadaṅgulimukhena muhuḥ
sā rañjayitvā caraṇau kṛtāśīrmālyena tāṃ nirvacanaṃ jaghāna || 161 ||’
reme muhurmadhyagatā sakhīnāṃ krīḍārasaṃ nirviśatīva bālye || 162 ||’
‘vyapohitaṃ locanato mukhānilai- rapārayantaṃ kila puṣpajaṃ rajaḥ
‘uttiṣṭhantyā ratānte bharamuragapatau pāṇinaikena kṛtvā dhṛtvā cānyena vāso vigalitakavarībhāramaṃse vahantyāḥ
bhūyastatkālakāntidviguṇitasurataprītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyāmāliṅgya nītaṃ vapuralasalasadbāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu || 165 ||’
‘jai ṇa chivasi pupphavaiṃ purao tā kīsa vārio ṭhāsi
‘loo jūrai jūrau vaaṇijjaṃ hoi hou taṃ ṇāma
ehi ṇimajjasu pāse pupphavai ṇa ei me ṇiddā || 167 ||’
[lokaḥ khidyate khidyatu vacanīyaṃ bhavati bhavatu tannāma
ehi nimajja pārśve puṣpavati naiti me nidrā ||]
‘jāo so vi vilakkho mae vi hasiūṇa gāḍhamuvagūḍho
so vi hasaṃtīeॅ mae gahio vīeṇa kaṃṭhammi || 171 ||’
so'pi hasantyā mayā gṛhīto dvitīyena kaṇṭhe ||]
‘ai diara kiṃ ṇa pecchasi āāsaṃ kiṃ muhā paloesi
[ayi devara kiṃ na prekṣasa ākāśaṃ kiṃ mudhā pralokayasi
‘ṇavalai pahāratuṭhṭhāi taṃ kaaṃ kiṃ pi haliasoṇhāe
jaṃ ajja vi juaijaṇo ghare ghare sikkhiuṃ bhamai || 175 ||’
yadadyāpi yuvatijano gṛhe gṛhe śikṣituṃ bhramati ||]

tatra nāyakayoḥ prāgasaṃgatayoḥ, saṃgatayośca, saṃgataviyuktayorvā, mithodarśanaśravaṇābhyāmavasthitābhimānajanmā parasparānurāgo'nyatarānurāgo vābhilaṣaṇīyāliṅganādīnāmanavāptau satyāṃ samupajāyamānaistaistairutkaṇṭhādibhirvyabhicāribhāvairmanovāgbuddhiśarīrārambhajanmabhiścānubhāvairanubaddhaḥ prāptaprāpyaprakarṣāvastho vipralambhaśrṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate
haṃsa iva darśitāśo mānasajanmā tvayā nītaḥ || 176 ||’
atra puṇḍarīkasya mahāśvetāyāṃ prāgasaṃgatāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃkalparamaṇīyo'bhilāṣastadanāptāvuktaprakāreṇa prakṛṣyamāṇastvayā me mānasajanmā dūraṃ nīta ityuttarakāmāvasthayā prakāśyate
piasahi visamaṃ pemmaṃ maraṇaṃ saraṇaṃ ṇavari ekkaṃ || 177 ||’
atrāpi prāgvadeva sāgarikāyā vatsarāje'nurāgaḥ prakṛṣyamāṇo maraṇaṃ śaraṇamityuttarayaiva kāmāvasthayā kathyate
atra premagateḥ svabhāvakauṭilyāddhetumantareṇopajāyamāno nirheturucyate sa eva saheturyathā—
‘paḍiucchiā ṇa jaṃpai gahiā vi pphurai cumbiā rusai
[paripṛṣṭā na jalpati gṛhītāpi sphurati cumvitā ruṣyati
atra yadyapyāliṅganāderneti netyādeḥ pratiṣedho na vidyate tathāpi tadartho'styeveti mānalakṣaṇaṃ ghaṭate
atra vivāhānantarameva mālatyāḥ kapālakuṇḍalayāpahārānmādhavamālatyorayaṃ navānurāgaḥ pravāsa ucyate
‘tvāmālikhya praṇayakupitāṃ dhāturāgaiḥ śilāyāmātmānaṃ te caraṇapatitaṃ yāvadicchāmi kartum
asraistāvanmuhurupacitairdṛṣṭirālupyate me krūrastasminnapi na sahate saṃgamaṃ nau kṛtāntaḥ || 181 ||’
sa eva puruṣasya vyapāye striyā yathā—
upacārapadaṃ na cedidaṃ tvamanaṅgaḥ kathamakṣatā ratiḥ || 183 ||’
ṇavabahuāi sarosaṃ savva ccia vacchalā mukkā || 185 ||’
navavadhvā saroṣaṃ sarve'pi ca vatsakā muktāḥ ||]
‘āpṛcchāmi vyathayati mano durbalā vāsaraśrīre- hyāliṅga kṣapaya rajanīmekikā cakravāki
nānyāsakto na khalu kupito nānurāgacyuto vā daivādhīnaḥ sapadi bhavatīmasvatastrastyajāmi || 186 ||’
‘nāntarvartayati dhvanatsu jaladeṣvāmandramudgarjitaṃ nāsannātsarasaḥ karoti kavalānāvarjitaiḥ śaivalaiḥ

tatra nāyakayoḥ prāgasaṃgatayoḥ saṃgataviyuktayorvā mithaḥ samāgame prāgutpannastadānīṃtano vā ratyākhyaḥ sthāyibhāvo'bhilaṣaṇīyāliṅganādīnāmavāptau satyāṃ samupajāyamānairharṣa-dhṛti-smṛti-matiprabhṛtibhirvyabhicāribhāvaiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ, ṛtūdyānopagamajalakrīḍāparvatopadeśaprasādhanagṛhamadhupānendūdayādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ, savibhramabhrūkaṭākṣavikṣepālāpasaṃbhramasmitādibhiranubhāvairabhivyajyamāna īpsitamāsādayan, jihāsitaṃ vā jihānaḥ, prāptaprāpyaprakarṣārambhaḥ saṃbhogaśrṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate
sa caturdhā—prathamānurāgānantaraḥ, mānānantaraḥ, pravāsānantaraḥ, karuṇānantara iti
pāṇosarantamairaṃ casaaṃ va ṇiaṃ muhaṃ bālā || 189 ||’
‘ṇa muammi mue vi pie diṭṭho uṇa piṃaamo jiaṃtīe
ia lajjā a pahariso tīe hiae ṇa saṃmāi || 191 ||’
[na mṛtāsmi mṛte'pi priye dṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ priyatamo jīvantyā
iti lajjā ca praharṣastasyā hṛdaye na saṃmāti ||]
‘induryatra na nindyate na madhuraṃ dūtīvacaḥ śrūyate nocchvāsā hṛdayaṃ dahantyaśiśirā nopaiti kārśyaṃ vapuḥ
svādhīnāmanukūlinīṃ svagṛhiṇīmāliṅgya yatsupyate tatkiṃ prema gṛhāśramavratamidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ samācaryate || 192 ||’
aṇamaāiṃ vva sijjhanti māṇasāiṃ ṇāi mihuṇāṇam 193’
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau' māsānetān gamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 194 ||’
‘na martyalokastridivātprahīyate mriyeta nāgre yadi vallabho janaḥ
nivṛttameva tridivaprayojanaṃ mṛtaḥ sa cejjīvata eva jīvati 195’
jai jaṃpai aphuḍatthaṃ taha se hiaaṭṭhiaṃ kiṃ vi || 200 ||’
‘so tuha kaeṇa suṃdari taha jhīṇo sumahilo haliautto
jaha se macchariṇīa vi doccaṃ jāāe paḍibaṇṇam 201’
[sa tava kṛtena sundari tathā kṣīṇaḥ sumahilo hālikaputraḥ
‘saudhādudvijate tyajatyupavanaṃ dveṣṭi prabhāmaindavīṃ dvārāttrasyati citrakelisadaso veṣaṃ viṣaṃ manyate
‘tiṣṭhaḥ dvāri bhavāṅgaṇe vraja bahiḥ sadmeti vartmekṣate śālāmañca tamaṅgamañca valabhīmañceti veśmāñcati
dūtīṃ saṃdiśa saṃdiśeti bahuśaḥ saṃdiśya sāste tathā talpe kalpamayīva nirghṛṇa yathā nāntaṃ niśā gacchati 209’
‘ramyaṃ dveṣṭiṃ pusa yathā prakṛtibhirna pratyahaṃ sevyate śayyo pāntavivartanaurviṃgamayatyunnidra eva kṣapāḥ
dākṣiṇyena dadāti vācamucitāmantaḥpurebhyo yadā gotreṣu skhalitastadā bhavati sa vrīḍāvanamraściram 210’
‘sītāveśma yato nirīkṣya harate dṛṣṭiṃ jhaṭityākulā manyonyārpitacañcudattakavalaiḥ pārāvatairdūyate
indordūrata eva naśyati viśatyantargṛhaṃ duḥkhitaḥ pracchādyānanamañcalena rajanīpvastatrapaṃ roditi || 211 ||’
‘jaha jaha se pariuṃbai maṇṇubhariāiṃ’ ṇihuvaṇe daio
acchīiṃ uvari uvari taha taha bhiṇṇāiṃ vigalaṃti || 214 ||’
‘candrāpīḍaṃ sā ca jagrāha kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhasthānaṃ jīvitaṃ ca prapede
tenāpūrvāṃ sā samullāsalakṣmīminduṃ spṛṣṭvā sindhuveleva bheje 217’
‘ṇāsaṃ va sā kavole ajja vi tuha daṃtamaṃḍalaṃ bālā
caḍuāraaṃ paiṃ mā hu putti jaṇahāsiaṃ kuṇasu || 299 ||’
caṭukārakaṃ patiṃ mā khalu putri janahasitaṃ kuru ||]
parighummirā a diṭṭhī piāgamaṃ sāhai vahūe || 220 ||’
parighūrṇanaśīlā ca dṛṣṭiḥ priyāgamaṃ sādhayati vadhvāḥ ||]
‘poḍhamahilāṇaṃ jaṃ suṭṭhu sikkhiaṃ taṃ rae suhāvei
jaṃ jaṃ asikkhiaṃ ṇavavahūṇaṃ taṃ taṃ dhiiṃ deṭṭha || 223 ||’
‘haṃho kaṇṇullīṇā bhaṇāmi re suhaa kiṃ pi mā jūra
ṇijjaṇapāraddhīsu tue kahiṃ vi puṇṇehiṃ laddhosi || 224 ||’
[haṃho karṇollīnā bhaṇāmi re subhaga kimapi mā khidyasva
‘ajja vi seaṃjalollaṃ pavvāi ṇa tīa haliasoṇhāe
‘tatto ccia ṇenti kahā viasaṃti tarhi samappanti
kiṃ maṇṇe māucchā ekkajuāṇo imo gāmo || 227 ||’
[tata eva niryānti kathā vikasanti tatra tatra samāpyante
‘teṇa ira ṇavalaāe diṇṇo paharo imīa thaṇavaṭṭhe
gāmataruṇīhiṃ ajja vi diahaṃ parivāliā bhamai || 228 ||’
[tena kila dolāvilāse daktaḥ prahāra etasyāḥ stanapṛṣṭhe
‘jai so ṇa vallaha ccia ṇāmaggahaṇena tassa sahi kīsa
hoi muhaṃ te raviaraphaṃsavisaṭṭaṃ va tāmarasam || 230 ||’
[yadi sa na vallabha eva nāmagrahaṇena tasya sakhi kimiti
dūiṃ appāheṃtī tasse a gharaṃgaṇaṃ pattā || 231 ||’
‘kaha ṇu gaā kaha diṭṭhā kiṃ bhaṇiā kiṃ ca teṇa paḍivaṇṇaṃ
eaṃ cia ṇa samappai punaruttaṃ jaṃpamāṇīe || 232 ||’
[kathaṃ nu gatā kathaṃ dṛṣṭā kiṃ bhaṇitā kiṃ ca tena pratipannam
sotthi ccia ṇa samappai piasahi lehammi kiṃ lihino || 233 ||’
svastyeva na samāpyate priyasakhi lekhe kiṃ likhāmaḥ ||]
‘prītyā svastipadaṃ vilokitavatī sthānaṃ stutaṃ tuṣṭayā paścājjñātamanukrameṇa puratastattāvakaṃ nāmakam
tanvyā saṃmadanirbhareṇa manasā tadvācayantyā muhurna prāpto ghanabāṣpapūritadṛśā lekhe'pi kaṇṭhagrahaḥ || 234 ||’
‘kiṃ kiṃ de paḍihāsai sahīhi~ ia pucchiāi muddhāi~
[kiṃ kiṃ te pratibhāsate sakhībhiriti pṛṣṭāyā mugdhāyāḥ
‘huṃhuṃ he bhaṇasu puṇo ṇa suaṃti karei kālavikkheaṃ
[huṃhuṃ he bhaṇa punarna svapanti karoti kālavikṣepam
jaṃ bhaṇaha taṃ karissaṃ sahio jai taṃ ṇa pecchissam 239’
yadbhaṇata tatkariṣye sakhyo yadi taṃ na prekṣiṣye ||]
bhrūyugena sapadi pratipede romabhiśca samameva vibhedaḥ || 240 ||’
‘ekko vi kālasāro ṇa dei gaṃtuṃ paāhiṇa valanto
[eko'pi kṛṣṇasāro na dadāti gantu pradakṣiṇaṃ valan
‘ullāai se aṃgaṃ ūrū vevanti kūvalo galai
vibhorvāraṃvāraṃ kṛtasamadhikoddhūlanavidhe- stanau bhasmasnānaṃ kathamapi samāptaṃ vijayate || 246 ||’
‘aṇṇua ṇāhaṃ kuviā uvaūhasu kiṃ muhā pasāemi
tuha maṇṇusamuppaṇṇeṇa majjha māṇeṇa viṇa kajjam || 248 ||’
[ajña nāhaṃ kupitā upagūhasva kiṃ mudhā prasādayāmi
tava manyusamutpannena mama mānenāpi na kāryam ||]
atra māninī pūrvamāliṅganādīnniṣidhya paścādayathāvatprayacchati yathā kaścidaṣṭau śatāni pradāsyāmīti pratiśrutyāṣṭabhiradhikaṃ śataṃ praya-cchati na tvaṣṭau śatānīti
‘ehii so vi pauttho ahaaṃ kuppejja so vi aṇuṇejja
ia kassa vi phalai maṇorahāṇa~ mālā piaamammi || 249 ||’
iti kasyāpi phalati manorathānāṃ mālā priyatame ||]
mihuṇāṇa~ marai jaṃ taṃ khu jiai iaraṃ muaṃ hoi || 250 ||’
‘diṭṭhāi jaṃ ṇa diṭṭho ālaviāe vi jaṃ ṇa ālatto
uvaāro jaṃ ṇa kao taṃ cia kaliaṃ chaillehiṃ || 252 ||’
‘ṇa muaṃti dīhasāse ṇa ruaṃti ṇa honti virahakisiā o
dhaṇṇāò tāò jāṇaṃ bahuvallaha vallaho ṇa tumam || 253 ||’
[na muñcanti dīrghaśvāsān na rudanti na bhavanti virahakṛśāḥ
dhanyāstā yāsāṃ bahuvallabha vallabho na tvam ||]
‘kaiā gao pio ajja putti ajjeṇa kai diṇā hoṃti
ekko eddahamette bhaṇie mohaṃ gaā kuṃvarī || 254 ||’
[kadā gataḥ priyo'dya putri adyeti kati dināni bhavanti
eka etāvanmātre bhaṇite mohaṃ gatā kumārī ||]
atraikasyāpi divasasya varṣāyamāṇatayā viśeṣato dairghyaṃ pratīyate
‘āvāabhaaaraṃ cia ṇa hoi dukkhassa dāruṇaṃ ṇivvahaṇam
ṇāha jiantīa mae diṭṭhaṃ sahiaṃ a tuha imaṃ avasāṇam ||’
nātha jīvantyā mayā dṛṣṭaṃ soḍhaṃ ca tavedamavasānam ||]
‘sā mahai tassa ṇhāuṃ aṇusotte sovi se samuvvahai
atra dvayorapyekakālamanyo'nyānurāgaḥ pratīyate tatraikā lāvaṇyādinā rajyate'nyaḥ snehādineti
‘māmi hiaaṃ va pīaṃ teṇa juāṇeṇa majjamāṇāe
‘saccaṃ jāṇai daṭṭhuṃ sarisammi jaṇammi jujjae rāo
marau ṇa tumaṃ bhaṇisyaṃ maraṇaṃ vi salāhaṇijjaṃ se || 258 ||’
[satyaṃ jānāti draṣṭuṃ sadṛśe jane yujyate rāgaḥ
mriyatāṃ na tvāṃ bhaṇiṣyāmi maraṇamapi ślāghanīyamasyāḥ ||]
atra na kevalaṃ lāvaṇyādinaiva rajyate kiṃ tarhyanurūpaviṣayiṇābhilāṣeṇāpīti pratīyate
‘gahavaisueṇa samaaṃ saccaṃ aliaṃ va kiṃ viāreṇa
atra yadyapi saubhāgyādiprasiddhikṛtasārūpyaṃ na vidyate tathāpi striyā uttamaprārthanamagarhitatvādanugatameva bhavati
atra 'māna pūjāyām’ iti dhātoḥ svārthikaṇijantāṇṇici ghañi ca māna iti rūpam
‘kāraṇagahio vi mae māṇo emea jaṃ samosario
tathā hi mānaṃ priyatvena manyamānā tadapahāriṇe'ṅkollāya kāpi māninī kupyati
‘jattha ṇa ujjāgarao jattha ṇa īsāvisūraṇaṃ māṇam
sabbhāvacāṭuaṃ jattha ṇatthi ṇeho tahiṃ ṇatthi || 262 ||’
mānena hi janaḥ premāsti nāsti veti budhyate
tadyathā 'prajñā paśyati no cakṣurdṛṣṭiḥ sārasvatī hi sā
‘kuviā a saccahāmā same vi bahuāṇa ṇavara māṇakkhalaṇe
[kupitā ca satyabhāmā same'pi bandhūnāṃ kevalaṃ mānaskhalane
tena ca yadyapi karaṇabhūtenaivātmani rukmiṇyāṃ ca priyapremṇaḥ parimāṇaṃ satyabhāmā pratyāyayati tathāpi pūrvavadihāpyayaṃ pūrvavatkartṛtvenopacaryate
pravāse vasata ityupalakṣaṇenātmānamaṅganā na bhūṣayanti yathā—
‘sāhīṇe vi piaame patte vi khaṇe ṇa maṇḍio appā
[svādhīne'pi priyatame prāpte'pi kṣaṇe na maṇḍita ātmā
atra ‘vasa ācchādane’ ityasya 'prasmarati’ ityādivanniṣedhārthakaprapūrvasya ghañi pravāsa iti rūpaṃ nirūpyate
mujjhaṃta paḍaṃta hasaṃta pahia kiṃ te pauttheṇa || 266 ||’
muhyan patan hasan pathika kiṃ tena proṣitena ||]
kaha tā mahaccia imaṃ ṇīsāmaṇṇaṃ uvaṭhṭhiaṃ vehavvam || 269 ||’
caturaiḥ surakāminījanaiḥ priya yāvanna vilupyase divi || 270 ||’
‘dalati hṛdayaṃ gāḍhodvegaṃ dvidhā tu na bhidyate vahati vikalaḥ kāyo mohaṃ na muñcati cetanām
jvalayati tanūmantardāhaḥ karoti na bhasmasāt praharati vidhirmarmacchedī na kṛntati jīvitam || 271 ||’
‘dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭimadho dadāti kurute nālāpamābhāṣitā śayyāyāṃ parivṛtya tiṣṭhati balādāliṅgitā vepate
niryāntīṣu sakhīṣu vāsabhavanānnirgantumevehate bālā vāmatayaiva saṃprati mama prītyai navoḍhā priyā || 272 ||’
‘pāde mūrdhani tāmratāmupagate karṇotpale cūrṇite chinne hāralatāguṇe karatale saṃpātajātavraṇe
aprāptapriyatāḍanavyatikarā hantuṃ punaḥ kopitā vāñchantī muhureṇaśāvanayanā paryākulā roditi || 273 ||’
atra premṇaḥ svabhāvakuṭilatvānmānavatyāḥ kacagrahaṇena yatpādatāḍanādirūpāḥ kuṭilā eva saṃbhogā jāyante
atra uttarārdhenopoṣitasyānnopayoga iva priyālokajanmā pibaterabhyavahāraḥ kathyate

atra yatheyaṃ matprāṇabhūtaivamasyā ahamapi jīvitameveti patyā visrambhajo'nurāgaḥ patnyāḥ punaḥ pretyāpi yatsaṃgamo mayābhilaṣitaḥ so'yaṃ jīvantyaiva jīviteśvaraḥ samāsādita iti visrambhādatisukhamevānubhūyate
muhurbaddhotkampaṃ diśi diśi muhuḥ preritadṛśo- rahalyāsutrāmṇoḥ kṣaṇikamiha tatsaṃgatamabhūt || 276 ||’
hiae māṇavaīṇaṃ cireṇa paṇaagaruo pasammaī roso 277’
hṛdaye mānavatīnāṃ cireṇa praṇayagurukaḥ praśāmyati roṣaḥ ||]
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau māsānetāngamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 278 ||’
atrāmunā virahivākyenāpi nirvekṣyāva iti bhaviṣyatkālopādheḥ pravāsānantare'pyavirudhyamānena taṃ tamātmābhilāṣamityādinā tadānīntanasaṃbhogasya saṃpūrṇatvaṃ varṇyate
do vi kaatthā puhaviṃ apurisamahilaṃ tti maṇṇaṃti || 280 ||’
atra pūrvārdhe rañjayatyartha uttarārdhe rājatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge saha bhāvena siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
‘adya prabhṛtyavanatāṅgi tavāsmi dāsaḥ krītastapobhiriti vādini candramaulau
ahvāya sā niyamajaṃ klamamutsasarja kleśaḥ phalena hi punarnavatāṃ vidhatte || 281 ||’
atra rañjayatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge puṃsi paścādbhāvena siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
iti samaguṇayogaprītayastatra paurāḥ śravaṇakaṭu nṛpāṇāmekavākyaṃ vivavruḥ || 282 ||’
atra rājatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge strīpuṃsayorapyānurūpyeṇa siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
yā dāsyamapyasya labheta nārī sā syātkṛtārtha kimutāṅkaśayyām || 283 ||’
atra pūrvārdhe rañjayatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge'nugatārthatvena siddhastadanantare tathaivānuvartate
bhāvasādhanapakṣe tu sarvatra sahārthādiviśiṣṭā ratirdīptirvānurāgaśabdenocyamānā tadanantare'pi samāsasāmarthyādanuvartate
ajahatsvārthā na hyatra nāyakau mithaḥ samāgatāvapi prathamānurāgamutsṛjataḥ
yuktaṃ punaryadajahatsvārthā parārthābhidhānarūpā vṛttiḥ syāt, avaśyaṃ hyanena parasyārthamabhidadhātā svārtha utsraṣṭavyaḥ
evaṃ hi dṛśyate loke bhikṣuko dvitīyā bhikṣāmāsādya pūrvāṃ na jahāti saṃcayāyaiva yatate, evaṃ tārhi dvayordvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti
abhihitaḥ so'rtho'nantarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti sāmarthyaṃ bhaviṣyati
tasmiṃśca samudāyārtha ekatvaṃ samavetamato vidyamānāyāmapyavayavasaṃkhyāyāṃ tadāśrayā subutpattirna bhaviṣyati
‘na spṛṣṭo'pi tridaśasaritā dūramīrpyānubandhā- nnāpyunmṛṣṭo bhujagapatinā tarjanābhirjayāyāḥ
mānasyānte nayanasalilaiḥ kṣālitaḥ śailaputryā patyurmaulau natiyuji jayatyātmanaḥ pādapāṃsuḥ || 284 ||’
sakhībhyaḥ snigdhābhyo giramiti niśamyaiṇanayanā nivāpāmbho datte nayanasalilairmānasuhṛde || 285 ||’
‘dūmeṃti je muhuttaṃ kuviaṃ dāsavva je pasāeṃti
te ccia mahilāṇa piā sesā sāmi ccia varāā 286’
[dūnayanti ye muhurtaṃ kupitāṃ dāsā iva ye prasādayanti
ta eva mahilānāṃ priyāḥ śeṣāḥ svāmina eva varākāḥ ||]
atrāsyāmapi premāsti nāsti veti jijñāsuḥ priyaḥ priyāṃ kelīgotraskhalanādinā dunoti
‘surakusumehiṃ kalusiaṃ jai tehiṃ cia puṇo pasāemi tumaṃ
to pemmassa kisoari avarāhassaṃ a ṇa me kaaṃ aṇurūaṃ 287’
[surakusumaiḥ kaluṣitāṃ yadi taireva punaḥ prasādayāmi tvām
tataḥ premṇaḥ kṛśodari aparādhasya ca na me kṛtamanurūpam ||]
atra rukmiṇyāḥ surakusumamañjarī dattā mama tu suratarureva preyasā pratipannastadahamasyāḥ sahasraguṇatvena priyatameti satyabhāmā svapremāṇaṃ-mimīte
tadyathā—ghṛtaghaṭastailaghaṭa iti niṣikte'pi ghṛte taile vā ghṛtaghaṭo'yaṃ tailaghaṭo'yamityanvayātpūrvapadārtho viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
bhavati tatra yā ca yāvatī cārthamātrā ihāpi tattulyameva
thoaṃ thoaṃ rososadhaṃ va māṇaṃsiṇa mairam || 288 ||’
sakaṣāyaireva vākyairnāyakaṃ nistudantī śayanīyaṃ gacchediti mānaśeṣānvayo dṛśyate
pravāsānantare priyā na vasata ityarthasyānvayo yathā—
atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddhaśīlā mama dīrghaṃ virahavrataṃ bibharti 289’
atra duṣyantena śakuntalāyāḥ pravāse vibhūṣaṇādyagrahaṇaṃ yadavagataṃ tattadanantare'pyanuvartamānaṃ premaprakarṣāya bhavati
tatraiva yuvānaḥ priyasaṃnidhau na vasantītyarthasyānvayo yathā—
‘samarthaye yatprathamaṃ priyāṃ prati kṣaṇena tanme parivartate'nyathā
ato vinidre sahasā vilocane karomi na sparśavibhāvitāpriyaḥ 290’
atra purūravāḥ pravāsānmatta urvaśībudhdyā latādikaṃ yadyadāsasāda tattadānekaśo'nyathā babhūva
tatsaṃskārāccāyaṃ yasyā latārūpaparivartanaṃ pratyeti so'yaṃ priyāsaṃnidhau yūnāmavāsaḥ saṃsiddhastadanantare'pyanuvartate
‘abbo dukkaraāraa puṇo vi tartti karesi gamaṇassa
ajja vi ṇa hoṃti saralā veṇīa taraṃgiṇo ciurā 291’
atra pravāsānubhūtabhṛśotkaṇṭhādicittavāsanāḥ pravāsānantare'pi tasyā nopaśāmyantīti veṇikāvarṇanādinā sūcyate
atrorvaśīvirahātpurūravā uttarāṃ kāmāvasthāṃ prapannaḥ priyāprāptau pretyeva pratyujjīvitastadevānusaṃdhatte
na tāvadanutsṛṣṭasvārthā, nahi proṣyasamāgatayoḥ pravāsasaṃbandho'pi vidyate
evaṃ hi dṛśyate lokepuruṣo'yaṃ parakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ svakarmotsṛjati
utsṛjannapyayaṃ svārthaṃ nātyantāyotsṛjati, yaḥ parārthavirodhī svārthastamevotsṛjati
tadyathā takṣā rājakarmaṇi pravartamānastakṣakarmotsṛjati na tu sthitavihasitakampitādīni
‘klāmyantī yadupekṣitāsi purataḥ kāmo yadagre hataḥ kliṣṭaṃ yattapasā vapuryadapi ca proktā baṭucchadmanā
tatsarvaṃ praṇatasya me'dya dayite dākṣāyaṇi kṣamyatāmityuktvā caraṇābjayorvijayate luṇṭhañchivāyāḥ śivaḥ 294’
atra karuṇāvasthāyāṃ priyāpādābjayorluṇṭhatā śokena yo vilāpaḥ kṛtaḥ sa iha prakarṣālāpatvena vipariṇamati
‘akhaṇḍitaṃ prema labhasva patyurityucyate tābhirumā sma namrā
‘yadaiva pūrvaṃ jvalane śarīraṃ sā dakṣaroṣātsudatī sasarja
‘bhinna sadyaḥ samādhāvuparamati parajyotiṣi spandasaṃjñe saṃjñāmāpadyamāne mṛdumanasi manāgunmiṣatsvindriyeṣu
vyāpāre pāravaśyaṃ visṛjati maruti brahmasabrahmacārī vāmārdhasparśajanmā jayati purariporantarānandapūraḥ || 297 ||’
atra yatkaruṇāvasthāyāṃ manaḥ śokaprakarṣeṇābhyaktamāsīttadiha priyāśleṣajanmānā paramānandenābhyajyate

yathā mallikāpuṭaḥ campakapuṭa ityatra niḥkīrṇāsvapi sumanaḥsu mallikādirvāsanāvaśādviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati—ayaṃ mallikāpuṭo'yaṃ campakapuṭa iti, evaṃ nivṛtte'pi svārthe vāsanāvaśātkaruṇo'nantarasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
sāmarthyaṃ ca bhedaḥ saṃsarga ubhayaṃ vā
tatra rājña ityukte sarvaṃ svaṃ prasaktam
ihedānīṃ rājapuruṣamānayetyukte rājā purūṣaṃ nivartayatyanyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ;puruṣo'pi rājānamanyebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ
evamasminnubhayato vyavacchinne yadi rājārtho nivartate, kāmaṃ nivartatām
prāk ca vṛtterakṛtārthasya nivṛttau sāmarthyābhāvādvṛttireva na syāt
tatra rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra yadā tāvadavadhṛtaparāyattavṛttirayaṃ puruṣo na svatantrastadā svāmisaṃsargasyāvagatatvātsvāmiviśeṣajñānāyopādīyamāno rājaśabdaḥ svāmyantarebhyaḥ puruṣaṃ vyāvartayati
yadā punaranavagataparāyattabhāvasya puruṣasya svāmisaṃbandhadyotanāya rājaśabdaḥ prayujyate tadā viśeṣasaṃsargasya śabdopādānatvādanavakāśo viśeṣāntarasaṃpāta ityaśabdā svāmyantaranivṛttiravasīyate
yadā tvarthāntaranivṛttiṃ vārthasaṃsargaṃ vābhisaṃdhāyopasarjanapadāni prayujyante tadā śabdārthasāmarthyayoḥ pratipattinibandhanayorabhedāpekṣayā bhedasaṃsargasamudayaḥ sāmarthyaṃ bhavati
yathā nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ceti nīlotpalam
prathamaścāsāvanurāgaśceti prathamānurāga iti, prathamānurāgānantara ityādiṣu ca bhedasāmarthyaṃ yathā rājño bhṛtya iti
yato'nantara ityukte'vadhṛtamidaṃ kasyāpyavagheranantaro'yaṃ na svatantra iti sarvo'vadhiḥ prasaktaḥ
tatra yo'sau bhedastatsāmarthyaṃ ca, tannimittā ca vṛttiḥ
bhedanimittāyāṃ ca vṛttau satyāṃ vṛttyabhimukhasya bhedamupajanayyopasarjanasya prathamānurāgasyārtho nivartate
yadi prathamānurāgādyartho nivartate, kāmaṃ nivartatām, na jātucidavadhimanmātrasya saṃpratyayo bhaviṣyati
prathamānurāgetyanantareti ca pratīyamānavibhāgaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamyate kanyāvisrambhaṇādiravadhimattvaṃ ca
tena manyāmahe yaḥ śabdabhāgo hīyate tasyāsāvarthaḥ; yo'rtho hīyate, ya upajāyate tasyāyamartho; yo'rtha upajāyate, yo'nvayī tasyāsāvartho; yo'rthaḥ so'nvayīti
tathā hi yatra bṛṃhitaṃ hīyate, hneṣitamupajāyate, reṇucakramanvayi; tatra hastino hīyante, aśvā upajāyante, pipīlikā anvayinyaḥ
yatra vā kṣīraṃ hīyate, dadhyupajāyate, pātramanvayi, tatra mādhuryaṃ hīyate, amlatopajāyate, tṛptiranvayinī
na caitāvatā pātrasya tṛptiḥ kāryaṃ bhavati
yathā loke badhiro'pi cakṣuṣmānālokayati, satyapi śrotra upahatacakṣurnālokayati rūpamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cakṣuḥśrotrasaṃnidhāne rūpālokanaṃ cakṣuṣa eva vyavasthāpyate na śrotrasya
yasya kevalasya yo'rtho'vadhṛtaḥ padārthāntarasaṃnidhāne'pi tasya sa eva
nahi rasanamasaṃnidhau darśanasya madhurādivyañjakaṃ darśanasaṃnidhau nīlādivyaktiṃ prati sāmarthyaṃ labhate
prathamānurāgaśabdasya kevalasyotkaṇṭhādiṣu, mānaśabdasyerṣyāyitādiṣu, anantaraśabdasya punaravadhimatsveva sāmarthyamavadhṛtamatasteṣāṃ tāvānevārtho bhavati
yaḥ punaḥ padayoranyonyopaśleṣādvisrambhaṇādirmānaśaithilyādirvāvadhimadviśeṣo'nyāvadhikaḥ pratīyate vākyārthaḥ sa bhavatīti

yadi vā yathānapekṣitāvayavārthā vṛkṣaśrotriyaśakragopādayaḥ svasāmarthyaniyatamarthamācakṣate tathā saṃghātā evaite prathamānurāgānantarādayo rājapuruṣādayaścānapekṣitāvayavārthā yathāsāmarthyamartheṣu niviśante

nanu cāvyapadeśyapūrvāparavibhāgā bhinnārthābhidhāyino vṛkṣādayaḥ pratīyamānabhāgabhedānuyātāḥ saṃbandhipadārthopahitabhedavṛttyabhidhāyinaḥ punarime tatkathaṃ prathamānurāgānantarādayo vṛkṣādivadrūḍhiśabdā bhavitumarhanti
rūḍhiśabdā yaugikā iti vibhāgo'bhedadarśanādarśanābhyāmabhiniviṣṭa- buddheḥ pratipādanopāya eva
yataḥ prapalāśo'pyanudbhinnapalāśo'pi ca vanaspatiḥ sapta parṇānyasya parvaṇi parvaṇīti saptaparṇa ityākhyāyate
atha ca pañcāṅgulamivāśvakarṇa iva parṇamasyetyupacaritārthāvayavā jātivācina eva pañcāṅgulāśvakarṇādayo varṇyante
tatra hi sannapi varṇaviśeṣaḥ samudāyasya jātivacanatvācchabdārthatvena nāvasīyate
tadevamayaṃ śakalīkṛtavṛttipadārthābhiniveśaḥ prathamānurāgānantarādāviva rājapuruṣādāvapyavayavābhiniveśaṃ śakyate tyājayitum
ata eva prathamānurāgādīnāṃ vipralambhasaṃbhogādīnāṃ ca pāribhāṣiko'pi saṃsargaḥ saṃnidhīyata iti
‘luliā gahavaidhūā diṇṇaṃ va phalaṃ javehiṃ savisesaṃ
ekameva kusumanirbharaṃ śālmalivṛkṣamāśritya sunimīlitakādibhiḥ khelatāṃ krīḍaikaśālmalī
[ka eṣa iti pratyāvartituṃ śālmalivalitaṃ priyaṃ paripātayati
yatrāṅganābhiścūtamañjaryo'varujyānaṅgāya bāṇatvena dāyaṃ dāyamavataṃsyante sā cūtabhañjikā
‘raiaṃ pi tā ṇa sohai raijoggaṃ kāmiṇīṇa chaṇaṇevacchaṃ
yatra yuvatayo madirāgaṇḍūṣadohadena bakulaṃ vikāsya tatpuṣpāṇyavacinvanti sā puṣpāvacāyikā
tuṃgasiharaggapaḍaṇassa jaṃ phalaṃ taṃ tue pattaṃ || 307 ||’
yatra kaste priyatama iti pṛcchadbhiḥ palāśādinavalatābhiḥ priyo jano hanyate sā cūtalatikā
‘vihalai se ṇevacchaṃ pammāai maṃḍaṇaṃ gaī khalai
varṣāsu kadambanīpahāridrakādikusumaiḥ praharaṇabhūtaurdvidhā vanaṃ vibhajya kāminīnāṃ krīḍāḥ kadambayuddhāni
prathamavarṣaṇaprarūḍhanavatṛṇāṅkurāsu sthalīṣu śādvalamabhyarcya bhuktapītānāṃ kṛtrimavivāhādikrīḍā navapattrikā
tatra ca varaṇavidhānādau teṣāmevaṃvidhāḥ parihāsā bhavanti
‘tā kuṇaha kālaharaṇaṃ tuvarantammi vi vare vivāhassa
abhinavabisāṅkurodbhedābhirāmaṃ saraḥ samāśritya kāmimithunānāṃ krīḍā bisakhādikā
‘aṇṇe vi hu hoṃti chaṇā ṇa uṇo dīāliāsaricchā de
‘vāaggiṇā karo me daṭṭhotti puṇo puṇo ccia kahei
[nirvāṇāgninā karo me dagdha iti punaḥ punareva kathayati
paḍhamaṃ hiaaṃ bahuā pacchā gaṇḍaṃ sadantavaṇaṃ || 317 ||’
so vi dūsihii jai raṅgavihaḍaṇaarī gahavaighūā ṇa baccihii ||’
so'pi dūṣayiṣyati yadi raṅgavighaṭanakarī gṛhapatiduhitā na vrajiṣyati]
‘āśleṣe prathamaṃ krameṇa vijite hṛdye'dharasyārpaṇe kelidyūtavidhau paṇaṃ priyatame kāntāṃ punaḥ pṛcchati
hasiūṇa saṃṭhavijjai pieṇa saṃmarialajjiā kāvi piā 321’
hasitvā saṃsthāpyate priyeṇa saṃsmṛtalajjitā kāpi priyā ||]
jassa ṇisaṇṇāi ure sirīe pemmeṇa lahuio appāṇo 322’
yasya niṣaṇṇayorasi śriyā premṇā laghūkṛta ātmā ||]
avāpyate vā kathamanyathā dvayaṃ tathāvidhaṃ prema patiśca tādṛśaḥ 323’
jaha gahiā taha hiaaṃ dhāreṃti a ṇivvaiṃ bālā || 324 ||’
yathā gṛhītāstathā hṛdayaṃ dhārayantīva nirvṛtiṃ bālāḥ ||]
‘ṇavi taha aṇālavaṃtī hiaaṃ dūmei māṇiṇī ahiaṃ
‘jai hosi ṇa tassa piā aṇudiahaṃ ṇīsahehi~ aṃgehiṃ
‘jaha jaha jarāpariṇao hoi paī duggao virūo vi
kulapāliāiṃ taha taha ahiaaraṃ vallaho hoi || 329 ||’
piadaṃsaṇe pavaḍḍhai maṇṇuṭṭhāṇe vi ruppiṇīa pahariso || 330 ||’
akaatthāiṃ vi jāāi jhaṃti siḍhilāiṃ aṃgāiṃ || 331 ||’
tathā tathā labdhāvāsa iva manmatho hṛdayamāviśati ||]
jaha jatthava tatthava jaha va taha va sabbhāvaramiāiṃ || 333 ||’
yathā yatraiva tatraiva yathā vā tathā vā sadbhāvaramitāni ||]
‘eṣā mano me prasabhaṃ śarīrātpituḥ padaṃ madhyamamutpatantī
‘taṃ pulaiaṃ vi pecchai taṃ cia ṇijjhāi tīa geṇhai gottaṃ
ṭhāia tassa samaaṇe aṇṇaṃ vi viciṃtaammi saccia hiae ||’
[tāṃ pulakitāṃ prekṣate tāmeva nirdhyāyati tasyā gṛhṇāti gotram
tiṣṭhati tasya samadane anyāmapi vicintayati saiva hṛdaye ||]
chitto jehiṃ piaamo mamamaṃ vi tehiṃ cia karehiṃ || 337 ||’
spṛṣṭo yaiḥ priyatamo māmapi taireva karaiḥ ||]
‘tuha virahujjāgarao siviṇe vi ṇa dei daṃsaṇasuhāiṃ
tassa piāpaḍivaḍḍhā ṇa samappai raisuhāsamattā vi kahā || 340 ||’
tasya priyāpratibaddhā na samāpyate ratisukhāsamāptāpi kathā ||]
aha sā bhamai disāmuhapasāriacchī tuha kaeṇa || 341 ||’
atha sā bhramati diśāmukhaprasāritākṣī tava kṛtena ||]
