‘avalaṃbaha sā saṃkaha ṇa imā gahalaṃghiā paribbhamai
‘jaṃ mucchiā ṇa a suo kalaṃbagaṃdheṇa taṃ guṇe paḍiaṃ
iaraha gajjiasaddo jīeṇa viṇā ṇa boliṃto || 344 ||’
[yanmūrcchitā na ca śrutaḥ kadambagandhena tadguṇe patitam
itarathā garjitaśabdo jīvena vinā na vyatikrāmet ||]
‘ajja vi tāva ekkaṃ māmaṃ vārehi piasahi ruaṃtim
kalliṃ uṇa tammi gae jai ṇa marissaṃ ṇa roissam 345’
[adyāpi tāvadekaṃ mā māṃ vāraya priyasakhi rudantīm
kalye punastasmin gate yadi na mariṣyāmi na roṣyāmi ||]
tā imā vipralambhajanmāno dvādaśāpi premapuṣṭibhūmayaḥ saṃbhogeṣu svānurūpāmeva premaprakarṣabhūmikāmāskandayanti
‘devīsvīkṛtamānasasya niyataṃ svapnāyamānasya me tadgotragrahaṇādiyaṃ suvadanā yāyātkathaṃ na vyathām
itthaṃ yantraṇayā kathaṃ kathamapi kṣīṇā niśā jāgrato dākṣiṇyopahatena sā priyatamā svapne'pi nāsāditā 352’
‘ślāghyānāṃ guṇināṃ dhuri sthitavati śreṣṭhānvavāye tvayi pratyastavyasane mahīyasi paraṃ prīto'smi jāmātari
teneyaṃ madayantikādya bhavataḥ prītyai bhavatpreyase mitrāya prathamānurāgaghaṭitāpyasmābhirutsṛjyate || 353 ||’
māi ṇa jhijjau raaṇī varadisāitapacchiammi miaṅke 356’
alliai tīraṇaliṇiṃ vāāi gamei sahacariṃ cakkāo 357’
āliṅgati tīranalinīṃ vācā gamayati sahacarīṃ cakravākaḥ ||]
‘rāmo'yaṃ jagatīha vikramaguṇairyātaḥ prasiddhiṃ parāmasmadbhāgyaviparyayādyadi paraṃ devo na jānāti tam
‘kiṃ no vyāptadiśāṃ prakampitabhuvāmakṣauhiṇīnāṃ phalaṃ kiṃ droṇena kimaṅgarājaviśikhairevaṃ yadi klāmyasi
jīvadbhrātṛśatasya me bhujabalacchāyāṃ sukhāmāśritā tvaṃ duryodhanakesarīndragṛhiṇī śaṅkāspadaṃ kiṃ tava || 359 ||’
‘ekasmiñśayane mayā mayasutāmāliṅgya nidrālasā- munnidraṃ śayitena maccaraṇayoḥ saṃvāhanavyāpṛtā
pādāgreṇa tilottamā stanataṭe sasnehamāpīḍitā harṣāvegasamarpitāni pulakānyadyāpi no muñcati || 360 ||’
‘śaktyā vakṣasi magnayā saha mayā mūḍhe plavaṅgādhipe nidrāṇeṣu ca vidravatsu kapiṣu prāptāvakāśe dviṣi
mā bhaiṣṭeti nirundhataḥ kapibhayaṃ tasyodbhaṭabhrūsthite- rmarmacchedavisaṃṣṭhulākṣarajaḍā vācastvayā na śrutāḥ 361’
asyāḥ sakhe caraṇayoradhigamya samya- gājñākaratvamahamadya yathā kṛtārthaḥ || 362 ||’
‘tapo vā śastraṃ vā vyapadiśati yaḥ kaścidiha vaḥ sa darpāduddāmadviṣamasahamānaḥ kalayatu
arāmāṃ niḥsīradhvajadaśarathīkṛtya vasudhā- matṛptastatkulyānapi paraśurāmaḥ śamayati || 363 ||’
‘snātā tiṣṭhati kuntaleśvarasutā vāro'ṅgarājasvasu- rdyūtai rātririyaṃ jitā kamalayā devī prasādyādya ca
ityantaḥpurasundarī prati mayā vijñāya vijñāpite devenāpratipattimūḍhamanasā dvitrāḥ sthitaṃ nāḍikāḥ || 364 ||’
‘cakraṃ vā madhuhā kṛtāntagṛhiṇīdattāgrapañcāṅgulaṃ vajraṃ bhūdharapakṣaśoṇitasurāpānonmadaṃ vā vṛṣā
śūlaṃ vāsuraraktabindunicitaṃ gṛhṇātu śūlāyudho dhṛṣṭadyumnamahaṃ nihanmi samare kaścitparitrāyatām || 366 ||’
‘ādhātuṃ vinayaṃ nirāgasi nare kupyantu nāmeśvarā- stena svāśayaśuddhireva sukarā prāyaḥ prabhūṇāṃ puraḥ
mithyāmānini manyase yadi tadā nityaṃ manovartinī dhyātā tāmarasākṣi citrapaṭake kā vā tvadanyā mayā || 367 ||’
‘kulamamalinaṃ bhadrā mūrtirmatiḥ śrutiśālinī bhujabalamalaṃ sphītā lakṣmīḥ prabhutvamakhaṇḍitam
prakṛtisubhagā hyete bhāvā madasya ca hetavo vrajati puruṣo yairunmādaṃ ta eva tavāṅkuśāḥ || 368 ||’
muhuḥ paśyañśrṛṇvanrajanicarasenākalakalaṃ jaṭājūṭagranthiṃ draḍhayati raghūṇāṃ parivṛḍhaḥ || 369 ||’
‘śataṃ vārānuktaḥ priyasakhi vacobhiḥ sa paruṣaiḥ sahasraṃ nirdhūtaḥ padanipatitaḥ pārṣṇihatibhiḥ
kiyatkṛtvo baddhāḥ punariha na vedmi bhrukuṭaya- stathāpi kliśyanmāṃ kṣaṇamapi na dhṛṣṭo viramati || 371 ||’
anena kalyāṇi mṛṇālakomalaṃ vratena gātraṃ glapayasyakāraṇam
prasādamākāṅkṣati yastavotsukaḥ sa kiṃ tvayā dāsajanaḥ prasādyate ||’
‘taṃ kira khaṇā virajjasi taṃ kira uvahasasi saalamahilāo
‘ṇa vi taha aṇālavaṃtī hiaaṃ dūnei māṇiṇī ahiam
chittaṃ muhaṃ hasijjai caṃdāvatthaṃ gaaṃ paiṇā || 382 ||’
spṛṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ hasyate candrāvasthāṃ gataṃ patyā ||]
bhāāmi ghare eāiṇitti ṇiṃto paī ruddho || 384 ||’
bibhemi gṛhe ekākinīti niryan patī ruddhaḥ ||]
purisā ekkaṃtarasā ṇa hu dosaguṇe viāṇaṃti || 388 ||’
puruṣā ekāntarasā na khalu doṣaguṇau vijānanti ||]
‘jaiā pio ṇa dīsai bhaṇaha halā kassa kīrae māṇo
aha diṭṭhammi vi māṇo tā tassa piattaṇaṃ katto || 390 ||’
[yadā priyo na dṛśyate bhaṇata halā kasya kriyate mānaḥ
‘taha sā jāṇaṃi pāvā loe pacchaṇṇamaviṇaaṃ kāum
jaha paḍhamaṃ cia saccia likkhai majjhe carittavaṃtīṇa || 394 ||’
[tathā sā jānāti pāpā loke pracchannamavinayaṃ kartum
yathā prathamameva saiva lekhyate madhye caritravatīnām ||]
dhūma ccia pajjaliāṇaṃ bahu mao surahidārūṇa || 397 ||’
dhūṃma eva prajvālitānāṃ bahu mataḥ surabhidārūṇām ||]
‘aha sā tahiṃ tahiṃ vvia vāṇīravaṇammi cukkasaṃkeā
‘ehii pio tti ṇimisaṃ va jaggiaṃ jāmiṇīa paḍhamaddhaṃ
[eṣyati priya iti nimiṣamiva jāgṛtaṃ yāminyāḥ prathamārdham
ṇecchaṃtassa vi pāe dhuai hasaṃtī hasaṃtassa || 402 ||’
‘gammihisi tassa pāsaṃ mā jūrasu taruṇi vaḍḍhau miaṃko
duddhe duddhambhiva caṃdiāe ko pecchai muhaṃ de || 403 ||’
[gamiṣyasi tasya pārśvaṃ mā khidyasva taruṇi vardhatāṃ mṛgāṅka
dugdhe dugdhamiva candrikāyāṃ kaḥ prekṣate mukhaṃ te ||]
‘asmin varṣamahe na vartata idaṃ yatkāmadevotsave stheyaṃ putri nirannayā tadadhunā kiṃcinmukhe dīyatām
ityuke jaratījanena kathamapyadhvanyavadhvā tataḥ paryaste'hani kalpitaśca kavalo dhautaśva dhārāśrubhiḥ || 405 ||’
maṃśaṃ ca khāduṃ tuha oṭṭhakāṃhi~ cuṃkuścakuścucukuścukuṃti || 406 ||’
māṃsaṃ ca khādituṃ tava oṣṭhakābhyāṃ cukuścukuścukkucukuścukuṃti ||]
lattiṃsovari jaggiri tuma sahiṃ kharāvidupopphali ṇa lekīsi ṇa āgasi || 407 ||’
‘hā vatsāḥ kharadūṣaṇatriśiraso vadhyāḥ stha pāpasya me hā hā vatsa vibhīṣaṇa tvamapi me kāryeṇa heyaḥ sthitaḥ
hā madvatsala vatsa rāvaṇa mahatpaśyāmi te saṃkaṭaṃ vatse kaikasi hā hatāsi na ciraṃ trīnputrakāndrakṣyasi 408’
‘daṃsemi taṃ pi sasiṇaṃ vasuhāvaiṇṇaṃ thambhemi tassa vi raissa rahaṃ ṇahaddhe
āṇemi jakkhasurasiddhagaṇaṃgaṇāo taṃ ṇatthi bhūmivalae maha jaṃ ṇa sajjham || 409 ||’
[darśayāmi tamapi śaśinaṃ vasudhāvatīrṇaṃ stabhnāmi tasyāpi rave rathaṃ nabho'rdhe
ānayāmi yakṣasurasiddhagaṇāṅganāstannāsti bhūmivalaye mama yanna sādhyam ||]
‘phullukkaraṃ kalamakūrasamaṃ vahaṃti je siṃduvāraviḍavā maha vallahā de
je gālidassa mahisīdahiṇo saricchā ruccaṃti muddhaviaillapasūṇapuṃjā || 410 ||’
[puṣpotkaraṃ kalamabhaktasamaṃ vahanti ye sinduvāraviṭapā mama vallabhāste
ye gālitasya mahiṣīdadhnaḥ sadṛkṣā rocante mugdhavicakilaprasūnapuñjāḥ ||]
akāryavarjaṃ me brūhi kimabhīṣṭaṃ karomi te || 411 ||’
yasya vīryeṇa kṛtino vayaṃ ca bhuvanāni ca || 413 ||’
‘jāṇai siṇehabhaṇiaṃ mā raaṇiaritti me juucchasu vaaṇam
ujjāṇammi vaṇammi a jaṃ surahiṃ taṃ laāṇa gheppai kusumaṃ 417’
[jānaki snehabhaṇitaṃ mā rajanīcarīti me jugupsasva vacanam
udyāne vane ca yatsurabhi tallatānāṃ gṛhyate kusumam ||]
adyāpyadbhutaharṣagadgadagiro gāyanti yasyedbhaṭaṃ viśvāmitrajayorjitasya bhujayorvisphūrjitaṃ gurjarāḥ || 418 ||’
‘diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭā mahī sādhyate siddhā sāpi vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata
viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namo yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam || 419 ||’
bharturnandanadevatāviracitasragdāmni bhūmeḥ sutā vīraśrīriva tasya vakṣasi jagadvīrasya viśrāmyatu || 420 ||’
‘kṛtakakupitairbāṣpāmbhobhiḥ sadainyavilokitai- rvanamasi gatā yasya prītyā dhṛtāpi tathāmbayā
navajalasadharaśyāmāḥ paśyandiśo bhavatīṃ vinā kaṭhinahṛdayo jīvatyeva priye sa kava priyaḥ || 421 ||’
‘ko'yaṃ bhāmini bhūṣaṇaṃ kitava te śoṇaḥ kathaṃ kuṅkumā- tkūrpāsāntaritaḥ priye vinimayaḥ paśyāparaṃ kvāsti me
paśyāmītyabhidhāya sāndrapulakau mṛdnanmṛḍānyāḥ stanau hastena pratinirjitenduravatāddyūte hasanvo haraḥ || 424 ||’
‘kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā kiṃ vā madabhyāgamakāraṇaṃ te
ācakṣva matvā vaśināṃ raghūṇāṃ manaḥ parastrīvimukhapravṛtti || 425 ||’
‘yadāttha kāmaṃ bhavatā sa yācyatā- miti kṣamaṃ naitadanalpacetasām
kathaṃ prasahyāharaṇaiṣiṇāṃ priyāḥ parānuvṛttyā malinīkṛtāḥ śriyaḥ || 427 ||’
‘khyātā eva vayaṃ jagatsu caritairvāgbhiḥ kimākhyāyate saṃyatto bhava śaktirasti bhavataḥ satyaṃ manuṣyo bhavān
śastrairavyavadhīyamānayaśasaḥ prāyo vayaṃ teṣu ce- tprāhuste nanu santi te'pi girayo yairvānarāḥ śastriṇaḥ || 428’
vinā vācaṃ naitatkṣamamiti nidhāyānanamadhaḥ patadbāṣpāmbhobhirnikhilamiva dattaṃ prativacaḥ || 429 ||’
‘bhrūbhede sahasodgate'pi vadanaṃ nītaṃ parāṃ namratā- mīṣanmāṃ prati bhedakāri hasitaṃ noktaṃ vaco niṣṭhuram
antarbāṣpajalīkṛtaṃ prabhutayā cakṣurna visphāritaṃ kopaśca prakaṭīkṛto dayitayā muktaśca na pratyayaḥ || 431 ||’
‘tāṃ nāradaḥ kāmacaraḥ kadācitkanyāṃ kila prekṣya pituḥ samīpe
kaha tā ciṃtijjaṃtaṃ mahilāsarisaṃ ṇa saṃpaḍai me maraṇaṃ || 433 ||’
kathaṃ tāvaccintitasulabhaṃ mahilāsadṛśaṃ na saṃpadyate me maraṇam ||]
ālāpo'pi na miśritaḥ parijanaṃ vyāpārayantyāntike kāntaṃ pratyupacārataścaturayā kopaḥ kṛtārthīkṛtaḥ || 436 ||’
asaī saajjhiā duggaā a ṇa hu khaṃḍiaṃ sīlam || 437 ||’
asatī prativeśinī durgatā ca na khalu khaṇḍitaṃ śīlam ||]
‘saṃcāriṇī dīpaśikheva rātrau yaṃ yaṃ vyatīyāya patiṃvarā sā
narendramārgāṭṭa iva prapede vivarṇabhāvaṃ sa sa bhūmipālaḥ || 438 ||’
sakhyoḥ samakṣamiti cādhikajātalajjā śūnyā jagāma bhavanābhimukhaṃ kathaṃcit || 439 ||’
‘yathā śrutaṃ vedavidāṃ vara tvayā jano'yamuccaiḥ padalaṅghanotsukaḥ
‘alaṃ vivādena yathā śrutaṃ tvayā tathāvidhastāvadaśeṣamastu saḥ
mamātra bhāvaikarasaṃ manaḥ sthitaṃ na kāmavṛttirvacanīyamīkṣate || 441 ||’
pākabhaktiṣu ādāvasvādu, ante svādu mṛdvīkāpākaṃ yathā—
‘prākkāmaṃ dahatā kṛtaḥ paribhavo yenātha saṃdhyāvatau serṣyā vo'vatu caṇḍikā caraṇayostaṃ pātayantī patim
kurvantyābhyadhikaṃ kṛte pratikṛtaṃ muktena maulau muhu- rbāṣpeṇāhṛtakajjalena likhitaṃ lakṣmeva candre yathā || 442’
‘jaha icchā taha ramiaṃ jāā pattā paiṃ gaā dhūā
[yathecchā tathā ramitaṃ jāyā prāptā patiṃ gatā duhitā
chāyā na mūrcchati malopahataprasāde śuddhe tu darpaṇatale sulabhāvakāśā || 444 ||’
‘hītvā sītāṃ daśamukharipurnopayeme yadanyāṃ tasyā evaṃ pratikṛtisakho yatkratūnājahāra
vṛttāntena śravaṇaviṣayaprāpiṇā tena bhartuḥ sā durvāravyathamapi parityāgaduḥkhaṃ viṣehe || 445 ||’
yadapaiti ca śobhate ca tatkusumbharāgaṃ yathā—
‘vahuvallahassa jā hoi vallahā kaha vi paṃcadiahāiṃ
sā kiṃ chaṭṭhaṃ maggai katto miṭṭhaṃ ca bahuaṃ ca || 446 ||’
[bahuvallabhasya yā bhavati vallabhā kathaṃ kathamapi paścadivasāni
sā kiṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mārgate kuto mṛṣṭaṃ ca bahukaṃ ca ||]
‘pratyagrojjhitagokulasya śayanādutsvapnamūḍhasya me sā gotraskhalanādapaitu ca divā rādheti bhīroriti
rātrāvasvapato divā ca vijane lakṣmīti cābhyasyato rādhāṃ prasmarataḥ śriyaṃ ramayataḥ khedo hareḥ pātu vaḥ 448’
‘cakṣuryasya tavānanādapagataṃ nābhūtkvacinnirvṛtaṃ yenaiṣā satataṃ tvadekaśayanaṃ vakṣaḥsthalī kalpitā
yenoktāsi vinā tvayā mama jagacchūnyaṃ kṣaṇājjāyate so'yaṃ dambhadhṛtavrataḥ priyatamaḥ kartuṃ kimapyudyataḥ || 449 ||’
‘kiṃ kaṇṭhe śithilīkṛto bhujalatāpāśaḥ pramādānmayā nidrācchedavivartaneṣvabhimukhī nādyāpi saṃbhāvitā
anyastrījanasaṃkathālaghurahaṃ svapne tvayā lakṣito doṣaṃ paśyasi kaṃ priye parijanopālambhayogye mayi || 450 ||’
‘atha sa viṣayavyāvṛttātmā yathāvidhi sūnave nṛpatikakudaṃ datvā yūne sitātapavāraṇam
munivanatarucchāyāṃ devyā tayā saha śiśriye galitavayasāmikṣvākūṇāmidaṃ hi kulavratam || 451 ||’
martrā tadarpitakuṭumbabhareṇa sārdhaṃ śānte kariṣyasi padaṃ punarāśrame'smin || 452 ||’
‘advaitaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoranuguṇaṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu ya- dvisrambho hṛdayasya yatra jarasā yasminnahāryo rasaḥ
kālenāvaraṇātyayātpariṇate yatsnehasāre sthitaṃ bhadraṃ tasya sumānuṣasya kathamapyekaṃ hi yatprāpyate || 453 ||’
ityuktaṃ tatra ‘alaṃkārasaṃsṛṣṭeḥ’ itīyatyeva vaktavye nānālaṃkāragrahaṇaṃ guṇarasānāmupasaṃgrahārtham
iti vaidarbhamārgasya prāṇā daśa guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
iti śleṣādīnāṃ daśānāmeva mārgapravibhāgakāritāṃ bruvankāvyaśobhākaratvena guṇāntarāṇāmapyalaṃkāratvamupakalpayati

tatrorjasvi rūḍhāhaṃkāramityanena ātmaviśeṣaniṣṭhasyotkṛṣṭādṛṣṭajanmano'nekajanmānubhavasaṃskārāhitadraḍhimnaḥ saṃgrāme guṇasaṃpadutpādātiśayahetoralaṃkāraviśeṣasyopasaṃgrahādahaṃkārābhimānaśrṛṅgārāparanāmno rasasya mānamayavikārarūpeṇābhimānināṃ manasi jāgrataḥ parāṃ koṭimupavarṇayati
rasa- vadrasapeśalamityanena vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisāttvikasaṃyogādrasaniṣpattiriti ratyādirūpeṇānekadhāvirbhavato'bhivardhamānasya paraprakarṣagāminaḥ śrṛṅgārasya madhyāvasthāṃ sūcayati

preyaḥ priyatarākhyānamityanena samastabhāvamūrdhābhiṣiktāyā rateḥ paraprakarṣādhigamād bhāvanādhigame bhāvarūpatāmullaṅghya premarūpeṇa pariṇatāyā upādānād bhāvāntarāṇāmapi paraprakarṣādhigame rasarūpeṇa pariṇatiriti jñāpayannahaṃkārasyottarāṃ koṭimupalakṣayati
sarveṣāmapi hi ratyādiprakarṣāṇāṃ ratipriyo raṇapriyaḥ parihāsapriyo'marṣapriya iti premṇayeva paryavasānaṃ bhavati
yuktotkarṣaṃ ca tat trayamityanenāyuktotkarṣāṇāṃ trayāṇāmapyūrjasviprabhṛtīnāṃ guṇatvameva nālaṃkāratvamityavasthāpayati
tathā hi—aurjityaṃ bhāvikatvaṃ preya iti guṇeṣūpadiśyate, kutaḥ punaridamekadorjasvi—rasavat—preyasāmalaṃkāratvamanyadā guṇatvam
yathā gomān deśaḥ, vācālo baṭuḥ, vāgmī vipaścit, kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ, balavān mallaḥ daṇḍī, gomatī śāleti
nityo hi kāvye guṇayoga iva rasādiyogaḥ
guṇeṣu preya iti rūpābhedāt kathamalaṃkāratve tadutkarṣapratītiḥ
yathā ‘yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kurūṇām’ iti tatrātiśāyikāntareṇa tadavagatiriti cet ihāpi ‘yuktotkarṣaṃ ca tattrayam’ iti vākyāntareṇa bhaviṣyati
na cātiśāyikā svārthātiriktaṃ kimapi bruvate, api tu prakṛtyupāttameva prakarṣādikaṃ gamayanti
evamavasthāpite guṇarasānāmalaṃkāratve ṣaṭprakāro rasālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ saṃbhavati—guṇasaṃkaraḥ, alaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, guṇālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, rasasaṃkaraḥ, rasaguṇasaṃkaraḥ, rasālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ iti
nanu ca guṇānāṃ saṃkaravyavahāro nopapadyate bahuṣvapi guṇeṣu guṇavadityeva vyapadeśāt
tatra śabdaguṇeṣu samādhimādhuryaudāryagāmbhīryādayaḥ sollekhāḥ, śleṣaprasādasamatāmādhuryādayo nirullekhāḥ
tatra sajātīyānāṃ sollekhānāmevaṃ, vijātīyānāṃ tu nirullekhānāmapi saṃkaravyavahāraḥ pravartate
thavai thavaesu a tahā vasaṃtalacchī asoassa || 455 ||’
atrānyadharmāṇāmanyatrāropaṇaṃ samādhiḥ pṛthakpadatā mādhuryaṃ, bandhavikaṭatvamudāratā, dhvanimattā, gāmbhīryamiti sajātīyāḥ saṃkīryante
yathā kasyacidaśokasya mānino'ṅgeṣu priyāṅganā savilāsaṃ ceṣṭate tathāsyeyamiti
‘janaḥ puṇyairyāyājjaladhijalabhāvaṃ jalamuca- stathāvasthaṃ cainaṃ nidadhatu śubhaiḥ śuktivadane
tatastāṃ śreyobhiḥ pariṇatimasau vindatu yayā ruciṃ tanvanpīnastani hṛdi tavāyaṃ viluṭhati || 456 ||’
atra saṃvidhāne susūtratā śleṣaḥ, arthasya prākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, utpattyādikriyākramo rītiḥ dīptarasatvaṃ kāntirityarthaguṇāḥ sajātīyāḥ saṃkīryante

atra hanyata ityamaṅgalārtham, varārohetyaślīlārtham, hanyate hanyata iti punaruktam, cārusarvāṅgītyuktvā varāroheti vyartham, ta ete sajātīyāścatvāro'pi doṣaguṇāḥ saṃkīryamāṇāḥ kasyacidunmattabhāṣiṇo'nukampādyatiśayavivakṣāyāmabhyanujñāyante
‘ko nāma nodayati nāstamupaiti ko vā lokottaraḥ punarayaṃ savitā jagatsu
yatrodayāstamayabhāji rucāṃ nidhāne dvedhā bhavatyahariti kṣaṇadeti kālaḥ || 458 ||’

atra yāvadarthapadatā saṃmitatvam, samyagbandhavikaṭatvamudāratā, ślādhyaviśeṣaguṇayoga udāttatvamiti śabdaguṇāḥ, uktārthanirvahaṇaṃ prauḍhiḥ, arthaprākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, rūḍhāhaṃkārataurjityamityarthaguṇāḥ saṃkīryante
‘ehyehi vatsa raghunandana pūrṇacandra cumbāmi mūrdhani ciraṃ ca pariṣvaje tvām
āropya vā hṛdi divāniśamudvahāmi vande'thavā caraṇapuṣkarakadvayaṃ te || 459

atra bhāvato vākpravṛttirbhāvikatvam, prasiddhārthapadatā prasādaḥ, priyārthapadopādānaṃ preya iti śabdaguṇāḥ, ehyehīti punaruktam, vatse-tyuktvā tvatpādābjadvayaṃ vanda iti viruddham, mūrdhni cumbāmi hṛdi vahāmītyādau vanda iti kriyāsvanupayogāt pūrṇacandretidarśanādikriyopayogi vyarthaṃ ceti doṣaguṇāḥ saṃkīryante
‘kiṃ dvāri daivahatike sahakārakeṇa saṃvardhitena viṣapādapa eṣa pāpaḥ

atra dīptarasatvaṃ kāntiḥ, arthaprākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, uktārthanirvahaṇaṃ prauḍhirityarthaguṇāḥ, daivahatike viṣapādapo'yaṃ pāpa ityamaṅgalārthaṃ grāmyaṃ, kimanena saṃvardhitenetyatra madanajvarasaṃnipātā ityatra ca kṛtyaprayojanādervirahiṇo draṣṭurityādeścādhyāhārādasaṃpūrṇavākyatāyāmarthavyaktiviparyayaḥ
asminvikāsavikārabhājīti vikāsaśabdasya puṣpaviṣayatvādvṛkṣe'pi prayogo'vācakatvādasamartha iti doṣaguṇā mithaḥ saṃkīryante

yato rasākṣepātparihāsaleśoktyāmaṅgalam, praviśa piṇḍīṃ dvāraṃ bhakṣaya iti nyāyātprasiddhādhyāhāraḥ, ‘darī vadati, mañcāḥ krośantī’ ti prayogadarśanādādhārādheyayorabhedopacāraśca viruddhalakṣaṇādibhiḥ prayujyamāno na doṣāyeti
sa yadyapi vyaktāvyaktobhayātmatayā tilataṇḍulakādibhedaiḥ pradhānāṅgabhāvasamakakṣatābhyāṃ purastāduktaḥ tathāpi teṣāṃ guṇādisaṃkarāsādhāraṇa-tvātsaṃprati sādhāraṇaḥ prakāra ucyate
sa ṣoḍhā śabdālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, arthālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, ubhayālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ śabdārthālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, śabdārthobhayālaṃkārasaṃkaraḥ, arthobhayālaṃkārasaṃkaraśca
atra saṃskṛtaprākṛtabhāṣāsaṃśleṣaḥ, gatapratyāgataṃ citraṃ, padāvṛttiyamakaṃ, varṇānuprāsaśceti catvāraḥ śabdālaṃkārāḥ saṃkīryante

atra tāmracūḍavayasāṃ kūjitairityanumānam, yatra tamo ghūrṇata iti jñāpakahetuḥ, kukūlakūṭavisarajjhampāghanamiti sandhyāntollasadacchabhallapaṭa- lacchāyājaṭālamiti ca kārakahetuḥ, jāyamānapadārthasvarūpābhidhānaṃ jātirityarthālaṃkārāścatvāro mithaḥ saṃkīryante
kajjalakajjaṃ ri kaaṃ uari bhamantehi~ bhamarehi~ || 462 ||’

atra campakādīnāṃ pradīpaśikhābhirākārakāntibhyāmupamā, virahiṇīhṛdayadāhodyānadyotanārthakriyābhyāṃ sāmyaṃ, kajjalapaṭalānāmiva bhramarapaṭalānāmupari melanānmelitaṃ, campakadīpakalikayoriva bhramarakajjalapaṭalayoraupamyādisaṃbandhātsamuccaya ityubhayālaṃkārāścatvāro mithaḥ saṃkīryamāṇā upalabhyante
‘sarvāśārudhi dagdhavīrudhi sadā sāraṅgabaddhakrudhi kṣāmakṣmāruhi mandamunmadhulihi svacchandakandadruhi
śuṣyatsrotasi taptabhūmirajasi jvālāyamānāmbhasi grīṣme māsi kharārkatejasi kathaṃ pāntha vrajañjīvasi || 463 ||’
atrāvantikā rītiḥ, padamudrā, vibhaktimudrā, anuprāsaśceti śabdā-laṃkārāḥ, jātiḥ, kārakajñāpakau hetū, citrahetuścetyarthālaṃkārā mithaḥ saṃkīryante
‘stokastokamamūbhirambaratale tārābhirastaṃ gataṃ gacchatyastagireḥ śirastadanu ca cchāyādaridraḥ śaśī
pratyāsannatarodayasya taraṇerbimbāruṇimnā tato mañjiṣṭhārasalohinī digapi ca prācī samunmīlati || 464 ||’
atra samunmīlatīti vibhaktimudrā, stokastokamastaṃ gataṃ gacchatītyādiranuprāsaśca śabdālaṃkārāḥ, hetūpamā, samādhiḥ, anukramaḥ, samuccayoktiścetyubhayālaṃkārā mithaḥ saṃkīryante
‘khaṃ vaste kalaviṅkakaṇṭhamalinaṃ kādambinīkambalaṃ carcāṃ pārayatīva dardurakulaṃ kolāhalairunmadam
gandhaṃ muñcati siktalājasurabhiṃ varṣeṇa dagdhā sthalī durlakṣyo'pi vibhāvyate kamalinīhāsena bhāsāṃ patiḥ || 465 ||’
atra jātiḥ, anumānam, kārakajñāpakahetū cetyarthālaṃkārāḥ, rūpakopamā, hetūpamā, utprekṣopameti cobhayālaṃkārā mithaḥ saṃkīryante
yato yadyapi guṇavatyeva vākye'laṃkārayogastathāpi kvacid guṇasya prādhānyaṃ kvacidalaṃkārasyeti pradhānāṅgabhāvena guṇālaṃkārayoḥ saṃkaravyavahāraḥ pravartate
sa ṣoḍhā—śabda-guṇapradhānaḥ, arthaguṇapradhānaḥ, doṣaguṇapradhānaḥ, śabdālaṃkārapradhānaḥ, arthālaṃkārapradhānaḥ, ubhayālaṃkārapradhānaśca
‘prāptaśrīreṣa kasmātpunarapi mayi taṃ manthakhedaṃ vidadhyānnidrāmapyasya pūrvāmanalasamanaso naiva saṃbhāvayāmi
setuṃ badhnāti bhūyaḥ kimiti ca sakaladvīpanāthānuyātastvayyāyāte vitarkāniti dadhata ivābhāti kampaḥ payodheḥ 466’
atra hetūtprekṣābhidhāne tvayītyādau pade viṣṇoḥ svarūpādhyāsena tadbhāvāpattau samādheriha prādhānyaṃ pratīyate
nanu ca tvayi iti, eṣa iti, asya iti, yuṣmadetadidamāṃ na kaścana viṣṇuvācī sa kathaṃ varṇanīye nyastastaṃ tamarthamabhidadhīta
sarvanāmāni hi sarvābhidhāyīnyapi prakaraṇādigamyaṃ viśeṣameva bruvate sa ca iha prāptaśrīrityevamādimirabhivyaktamevāvagamyata iti
yāni praṇāmamilitāni nṛṇāṃ lalāṭe lumpanti daivalikhitāni durakṣarāṇi || 467
vyāvartanairahipaterayamāhitāṅkaḥ khaṃ vyālikhanniva vibhāti sa mandarādriḥ || 468 ||’

atra ‘vyāvartanairahipaterayamāhitāṅkaḥ’ iti jñāpakahetoḥ ‘khaṃ vyālikhanniva’ iti utprekṣāvayavācca, devāsurairiti nityavairāvivakṣāyāṃ bahuvacanam, ‘amṛtamambunidhirmamanthe’ iti dvikarmakeṣvapi mathiprabhṛtīnāmupasaṃkhyānamiti amṛtaśabdāddvitīyā iti doṣaguṇayoḥ prādhānyaṃ pratīyate
nanu cātrārthasya prādhānyaṃ kathaṃ bhavati tadviṣayasya jñāpakahetunāpahṛtatvātso'pyarthālaṃkāra eva
guṇālaṃkārayośca tulyakakṣatāyāmalaṃkāraḥ pradhānaṃ bhavati na guṇaḥ
madhurāṃ sukumārāṃ ca pāñcālīṃ kavayo viduḥ
prasādi svabhidhānaṃ ca yamakaṃ kṛtinā matam ||’ iti
mā bhūdalaṃkāratulyakakṣatayā arthasya prādhānyaṃ śabdaguṇasya tu ślāghyaviśeṣaguṇayoga udāttamityādeḥ kimiti prādhānyaṃ na bhavati doṣaguṇānāmatīvollekhavattvena prādhānyāt
doṣasya yo guṇībhāvaḥ sa tato'pyadhikaṃ prakāśata iti
atrārthaprākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ vibhavotkarṣa udāttatā mṛduprasphuṭonmiśravarṇānāmavaiṣamyaṃ samatā, bandhagāḍhatā, aurjityamityādibhyo guṇebhyaḥ prādhānyena śabdālaṃkārānuprāsaḥ pratīyate
atra bandhavikaṭatvamudāratā, ślādhyaviśeṣaṇayoga udāttatvam, vibhavotkarṣa audāryam, dīptarasatvam, kāntirityādibhyo guṇebhyaḥ prādhānyena jātirarthālaṃkāraḥ pratīyate
‘abhyuddhṛtā vasumatī dalitaṃ ripūraḥ kroḍīkṛtā balavatā balirājalakṣmīḥ
atraikajanmani kṛtaṃ yadanena yūnā janmatraye tadakarotpuruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || 471 ||’
atroktiparipāṭīḥ prauḍhiḥ, bandhavikaṭatvamudāratā, āśayotkarṣa udāttatvam, arthaprākaṭyaṃ, prasādaḥ—ityādibhyo guṇebhyaḥ śleṣopasarjanā viśeṣoktirubhayālaṃkāraḥ prādhānyena pratīyate
‘nyakkāro hṛdi vajrakīla iva me tīvraḥ parispandate ghīrāndhe tamasīva majjati manaḥ saṃmīlitaṃ lajjayā
śokastārkṣyavipattito dahati māṃ nāstyeva yasminkriyā marmāṇyeva punaśchinatti karuṇā sītāṃ varākīṃ prati || 472 ||’
atrāmarṣalajjāśokānukampāḥ samakakṣatayā mithastilataṇḍulavatsaṃkīryamāṇā rāmasya virahiṇo vāgārambhānubhāvoktiparatayā pratīyante
dākṣiṇyamātramasṛṇena viceṣṭitena dhūrtasya tasya hi guṇā nu paraṃ jayanti || 473 ||’
atra sakhīṣu roṣaḥ priyaguṇeṣu cāsūyā, kṣīranīravanmithaḥ saṃkīryamāṇau māninīvāgārambhaparatayā pratīyete
atra krodhābhāse chāyādarśanyāyena ratyābhāsaḥ saṃkīryamāṇa upalabhyate
‘kiṃ dvāri daivahatike sahakārakeṇa saṃvardhitena viṣapādapa eṣa pāpaḥ
atra narasiṃhajātāviva siṃhanaraśarīrabhāgau sahakāravarṇanāvāgārambhānusāreṇa sakhīviṣayānukampā sahakāraviṣayā ca kutsā mithaḥ saṃkīryete
tathā hi daivahatike itiśabdena labdhāyāṃ niyatyupādhau sarvathaivānukampyamānatāyāṃ sahakārasaṃvardhananibandhanatvamevāsyāḥ kalā dyotyate
evaṃ nāma tvaṃ daivopahatāsi yatsahakārachadmānaṃ viṣapādapaṃ dvāri saṃvardhayasīti
viṣapādapaśabdena ca labdhāyāṃ sahakārasya sarvathaiva kutsāyāṃ vikāsakāle kāminīnāmasahyasmarajvarasaṃnipātahetukatvamevāsyāḥ kapratyayena pratyāyyate
na ca sāṃpratikī kutsā śabdabhede pratīyate
yaḥ premapāśapāśe mṛga iva na mṛgīdṛśāṃ patita || 476 ||’
‘mā garvamudvaha kapolatale cakāsti kāntasvahastalikhitā mama mañjarīti
anyāpi kiṃ na sakhi bhājanamīdṛśānāṃ vairī na cedbhavati vepathurantarāyaḥ || 477 ||’
‘virodho viśrāntaḥ prasarati raso nirvṛtighana- stadauddhatya kvāpi vrajati vinayaḥ prahvayati mām
jhaṭityasmindṛṣṭe kimapi paravānasmi yadi vā mahārghastīrthānāmiva hi mahatāṃ ko'pyatiśayaḥ || 478 ||’

atra vīrauddhatyasvātantryavyarasānāmānandapraśamapāravaśyarasaistiraskriyamāṇānāṃ paṭa iva nīlādibhiḥ sītādīnāṃ praśamā rāmadarśanaprabhāvodbhave-lavasya vismayātiśayapraśamajanmani vāgārambhānubhāvopamāpade citravarṇavatsaṃkīryamāṇāḥ samupalabhyante
kadācidalaṃkārayogo'pi tyajyate na tu rasāviyogo guṇayogaśca vyabhicaritasaṃbandhāviti
yatra citravarṇavannarasiṃhavatpāṃsūdakavaccāvayavāvayavinyāyena jātivyaktinyāyena cāpṛthakprayatnanirvartyānāṃ guṇarasānāṃ vākye saṃniveśastatra saṃkaravyavahāro na pravartate
tadyathā—rūḍhāhaṃkārataurjityam, bhāvato vākpravṛttirbhāvikatvam, krodhādāvapyatīvratā, mādhuryam, āśayotkarṣaḥ, udāttatvam, arthasyābhīṣṭatamatā, preyaḥ, dīptarasatvaṃ, kāntiriti
yatra tu tilatandulavat kṣīranīravacchāyādarśavat tulyakakṣatayaiva guṇarasānāṃ vākye'pṛthakprayatnanirvartyānāṃ viniveśastatra saṃkaravyavahāraḥ pravartata eva
sa ṣoḍhā—guṇapradhānaḥ—rasapradhānaḥ, ubhayapradhānaḥ, ubhayāpradhānaḥ, guṇādhikaḥ, rasādhika iti
devī vyapāsya śayanaṃ dhṛtamānatanturantaḥpuraṃ gatavatī saha sauvidallaiḥ || 479 ||’
atra ślādhvaviśeṣaṇayoga udāttatvam, bandhavikaṭatvamudāratā, arthaprākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, dīptarasatvaṃ kāntiriti guṇāḥ sādhvasavilāsānurāgasaṃgamarasairatiśayyanta iti rasapradhānaḥ
kālaḥ kalirjagadidaṃ na kṛtajñamajñe sthitvā hariṣyati tavaiva mukhasya śobhām || 481 ||’
atra bhaṇitiviśeṣa uktiḥ saṃvidhāne susūtratā śleṣa iti śabdaguṇayorlāvaṇyavilāsavarṇanīyarasayośca tulyakakṣatayā nirdeśa ityubhayapradhānaḥ
galitavibhavasyājñevādya dyutirmasṛṇā rave- rvirahivanitāvaktraklaibyaṃ bibharti niśākaraḥ || 482 ||’

atra svādukrūramasṛṇaklaibyamityanyadharmāṇāmanyatrāropaṇaṃ samādhiḥ, abhinavavadhūroṣādīnāṃ caturṇāmapyarthānāṃ svādvādīnāṃ ca lakṣaṇādilakṣitānāṃ prākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, abhinavavadhūroṣasvāduḥ karīṣatanūnapāt iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāṇāmupakrameṇa nirvahaṇaṃ rītiḥ, pādacatuṣṭaye caturṇāmarthānāṃ vibhaktyasamatvena niveśaḥ saṃbhitatvamiti catvāro guṇāḥ, catvāraśca ratyamarṣaviṣādajugupsātmāno rasāḥ kālāvasthānivedanaparatvena pratīyanta ityubhayāpradhānaḥ
mā yāciṣi mā seviṣi mā sahiṣi parābhavaṃ dhaninaḥ || 483 ||’

atra suptiṅvyutpattiḥ sauśabdyam, vākyānāṃ paripūrṇatvamarthavyaktiḥ, arthasya prākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, vibhūteranutpattau kāmā na pūryante, aparipūrṇakāmo yācate, yācamānastadanāpnuvan dhaninaḥ sevate, sevamānastu taiḥ paribhūyata ityutpattyādikriyākramo rītiriti guṇāścatvāraḥ, rasastu nirveda evaika iti guṇādhikaḥ

atra kamalamanambhaṃsi kamale kuvalayametāni kanakalatikāyām ityanyadharmāṇāmanyatrāropaṇaṃ samādhiḥ, sā ca sukumārasubhagetyutpātaparamparā keyamityaślīlāmaṅgalārthau doṣaguṇāvapi, ślādhyaviśeṣaguṇayoga udātta-tvam, vikaṭabandhatvamudāratā, upakramābhedo rītiḥ, arthaprākaṭyaṃ prasādaḥ, aniṣṭhuratā saukumāryam, abhīṣṭatamatā preyaḥ, dīptarasatvaṃ kāntiriti guṇā daśa, rasāstu ratyutkarṣaharṣadhṛtyutkaṇṭhāvegavismayamativitarkacintācapalatāhāsotsāhastambhagadgadonmādavrīḍāvahitthabhayaśaṅkāḥ viṃśatirvāgārambhānubhāve śrṛṅgāriṇaḥ priyācāṭukārasya kasyacitpratīyanta iti rasādhikaḥ
alaṃkāranibandho yaḥ sa kavibhyo na rocate || 175
roso vi harai hiaaṃ maapaṃko vva mialaṃchaṇammi ṇisaṇṇo 485’
roṣo'pi harati hṛdayaṃ madapaṅka iva mṛgalāñchane niṣaṇṇaḥ ||]
atropamātiraskāreṇa rasavato harervacasi vāgārambharūpe rukmiṇīpradattapārijātamañjarīvilokanaprabhavaṃ satyabhāmāyā roṣarāmaṇīyakaṃ prādhānyataḥ pratīyate
‘yattvannetrasamānakānti salile magnaṃ tadindīvaraṃ meghairantaritaḥ priye tava mukhacchāyānukārī śaśī
ye'pi tvadgamanānukārigatayaste rājahaṃsā gatā- stvatsādṛśyavinodamātramapi me daivena na kṣamyate || 486 ||’
atra virahiṇo rāmasya priyāvayavasādṛśyadarśanenātmānaṃ vinodayata upāyabhraṃśādaratipramavaviṣādavāgārambhe svarūpābhidhāne prakṣīṇaśaktiraprāghānyenopamā pratīyate
atra yadyapi ratiprabhavebhyo vismayādibhyaḥ saṃśayahetūtprekṣopamādibhyaśca paryāyālaṃkāraḥ prādhānyena pratīyate tathāpyasau vāgārambhānubhāva iti ratāvaprādhānyamevānubhavati
‘kṛcchreṇoruyugaṃ vyatītya suciraṃ bhrāntvā nitambasthale madhye'syāstrivalītaraṅgaviṣame nisyandatāmāgatā
maddṛṣṭistṛṣiteva saṃprati śanairāruhya tuṅgau stanau sākāṅkṣaṃ muhurīkṣate jalalavaprasyandinī locaneṃ || 488 ||’
atra vatsarājena svadṛṣṭau prāṇidharmāḥ samādhīyamānāḥ sāgarikādarśanottharativāgārambhe nyagbhavanti
muhurlagnaḥ kaṇṭhe taralayati bāṣpaḥ stanataṭīṃ priyo manyurjātastava niranurodhe na tu vayam || 489 ||’
atra yadyapyākṣepeṇa vākyopasaṃhārastathāpi priya ityādibhiḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyamānaḥ śleṣa eva śrṛṅgāriṇo vāgārambhānubhāvāṅgatāmaṅgīkaroti
‘muktāḥ kandharayā dhṛtā stanataṭenottuṅgutā kumbhayorūrubhyāṃ pariṇāhitā kramavatī hastasya pabhdyāṃ gatiḥ
etadvaḥ karighātinastu kaṭhinaṃ carmaiva ko'yaṃ haṭhaścaṇḍīti tripurārikelivacanairāryāsmitaṃ pātu vaḥ || 490 ||’
atra bhagavataścāṭūktivāgārambhe devyāḥ paryāyavarṇanā śeṣabhāvaṃ labhate-ya udāsīnena varṇyate so'laṃkārapradhānaḥ sa hi rasabhāvādeḥ saṃkaraprakāramabhidhitsuḥ svabhāboktiṃ vakroktiṃ vāvalambate
hoi a dūrapaāsaṃ uhaarasāaṃtavibbhamaṃ tīa mukham || 491 ||’

atra satyabhāmāyā roṣasyāpasarpataḥ praharṣasya ca prasarpato ye'nubhāvā jihnāvalokanamukhaprasādādayasta iha saṃkīryamāṇāḥ kavinobhayarasāyattavibhramamityanena yathāvadavasthitā bhavantīti vidhimukhenābhidhīyante
ullalai tulijjaṃte ekammi vi se thiraṃ ṇa laggai hiaaṃ 492’
ullalati tolyamāne ekasminnapyasyāḥ sthiraṃ na lagati hṛdayam ||]
atra yadyapi hetūpanyāso vartate tathāpi tasya svabhāvākhyānaparikaratvenāprādhānyena hṛdayakriyāsvarūpameveha niṣedhamukhenābhidhīyata itīyaṃ jātireva bhavati
‘helodastamahīdharasya tanutāmālokya doṣṇo hare- rhastenāṃsataṭe'valambya caraṇāvāropya tatpādayoḥ
śailoddhārasahāyatāṃ jigamiṣoraspṛṣṭagovardhanā rādhāyāḥ suciraṃ jayanti gagane vandhyāḥ karabhrāntayaḥ 493’

atra rādhāyāḥ preyasi harau yathāvadastitodbhūtavṛttisnehaśaṅkotsāhā mithaḥ saṃkīryamāṇā bhayāvegasmṛtimativitarkādibhirvyabhicāribhāvairālambanacaraṇākramaṇasahakṛtāyāṃ karabhrāntau śarīrārambhānubhāve pratīyamānā aspṛṣṭagovardhanā vandhyā iti niṣedhamukhena jayantīti vidhimukhena cābhidhīyante
ahnaśchede dayitavirahāśaṅkinī cakravākī tau saṃkīrṇau racayati rasau nartakīva pragalbhā || 495 ||’
atra nigadenaiva vyākhyāte spaṣṭatayaivopamāyāḥ pradhānatvena pratītiḥ
‘dṛṣṭe locanavanmanāṅmukulitaṃ pārśvasthite cakravannyagbhūtaṃ bahirāsitaṃ pulakavatsparśaṃ samātanvati
nīvībandhavadāgataṃ śithilatāmābhāṣamāṇe tato mānenāpasṛtaṃ hriyeva sudṛśaḥ pādaspṛśi preyasi || 496 ||’

atra kasyāścitsakhīvikhyātamānasaṃvidhānakopānmānavatyāḥ priyasaṃdarśanādālambanavibhāvādutpannaprakṛṣṭaratiprabhave praharṣasthāyibhāve tatpārśvopasarpaṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamāne samutpadyamāneṣu pulakādiṣu mukhātmakeṣu vyabhicāriṣu nayananimīlanādhomukhyanīvīvisraṃsanādibhiranubhāvaiḥ prakarṣaṇāropaṇādānandarasatāmāpādyamāne sthāyini prabalavirodhibhāvāntarodayādetebhya eva kāraṇebhyaḥ pratikṣaṇamapacīyamānayorlajjāroṣayoḥ praśamasaṃkarābhibhūya prādhānyenopamāsahoktiḥ prakāśate
atra bībhatso rasaḥ śleṣarūpakasāmarthyādavidyamānenāpi śrṛṅgārarasena saṃkīrṇa iva pratīyate
‘daṭṭhoṭṭha ho asilaaghāo devi maulāvai loaṇabhauho ve
supaoharakuvala apattalacchi kaha moha ṇa jaṇai ṇa laggavacchi ||’
[daṣṭauṣṭha ho asilatādhāto devi mukalayati locanabhruvau dve api
supayodharakuvalayapattralakṣmīḥ kathaṃ mohaṃ na janayati na lagnā vakṣasi ||]
atra vīro rasaḥ śleṣasāmarthyādavidyamānenāpi vipralambhaśrṛṅgāreṇa saṃkīryate
āliṅganyo'vadhūtastripurayuvatibhiḥ sāśrunetrotpalābhiḥ kāmīvārdrāparādhaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ śāmbhabo vaḥ śarāgniḥ 499’
atra karuṇo rasaḥ śleṣopamāsāmarthyenāvidyamānenāpi vipralambhaśṛṅgāreṇa saṃkīryate
‘padbhyāmūruyugaṃ vibhajya bhujayorbhadhyaṃ nipīḍyorasā pārśveṣu prasabhaṃ prahṛtya nakharairdantairvilūyādharam
suptānapyavabodhya yuṣmadahitānbhūyo'pi bhuṅke vane kiṃ kāntā surataiṣiṇī nahi nahi vyāghrī karālānanā || 500 ||’
atra śleṣasāmarthyādapāramārthikī śṛṅgārapratītiḥ pāramārthikena bībhatsarasena vyāvartamānā taddharmāṇāṃ mithaḥ saṃsargabuddhimutpādayati
etāḥ śoṇitapaṅkakuṅkumajuṣaḥ saṃbhūya kāntaiḥ pibantyasthisnehasurāḥ kapālacaṣakaiḥ prītāḥ piśācāṅganāḥ || 501 ||’
atra vībhatso rasaḥ śabdasāmarthyākṣiptena śṛṅgarābhāsena saṃkīryate
‘śikhaṇḍe khaṇḍenduḥ śaśidinakarau karṇayugale dṛśastārāstārāścalamuḍupacakraṃ ca kucayoḥ
taḍitkāñcī sandhyā sicayarucayaḥ kāli tadayaṃ tavākalpaḥ kalpavyuparamavidheyo vijayate || 502 ||’
atra bhayānako rasaḥ samādhirūpakādyupakalpitākalparāmaṇīyakākṣiptena śṛṅgārābhāsena saṃkīryamāṇaḥ śrotuḥ preyorasāṅgatāṃ gacchansaṃgacchate

evamiyamamanekaprakārasaṃsṛṣṭirguṇālaṃkārasaṃkaraprabhavābhimantavyā tatrāpi pradhānāṅgabhāvena samakakṣatayā ca vyaktāvyaktobhayātmakarūpāstilatandulakṣīrajalācchāyādarśakādayo bhedā yathāyogamavagantavyāḥ
tadyadhā--arthobhayālaṃkārābhidhāne ‘khaṃ vaste’ iti ‘carcāṃ pārayati’ iti vibhaktimudrā, kalaviṅkaṇṭhamalinaṃ kādambinīkambalam iti padamudrā ca śabdālaṃkārāvapi saṃkīryamāṇau pratīyete
atrāravindāni ‘mugdhe tava mukhaśriyamākṣipantīti’ upamā, ‘koṣa-daṇḍasamagrāṇāṃ kimeṣāmasti duṣkaram’ iti śleṣopasarjanārthāntaranyāsaḥ
bhavanti cāravindāni koṣadaṇḍasamagrāṇi tena teṣāṃ na kiṃcidaśakyamasti koṣadaṇḍayorvijayasādhanatvāt

nanu cābandhaḥ samatvātsyāditi kathaṃ sarveṣāṃ tulyakakṣatayā saṃbandhotpattiḥ evaṃ manyate ye utprekṣopamādayo'laṃkārā vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāryādivarṇanāparatayā rasāderaṅgatāṃ pratipadyante tadā bhavatyeva teṣāṃ tulyakakṣateti

tatra ‘limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ’ iti dve utprekṣe, ‘asatpuruṣaseveva dṛṣṭirniṣphalatāṃ gatā’ ityupamā ca varṇanīyasya tamasa uddīpanavibhāvabhūtasya samatayaivotkarṣapratipādakatvenāṅgabhāvamupagateti nāsti lakṣaṇānupapattiriti
upamānopameyaśabdapratipannasya sādṛśyārthasya dyotanamivena kriyate na ca limpatītyādāvupamānamupameyaṃ vāsti yatsādṛśyadyotanaya ivaḥ prayujyet
astu vā limpatitamasorupamānopameyabhāvastathāpi tulyadharmo na dṛśyate ya upamānopameyabhāvāya prabhavati
kimanyaina lepanameva bhavati tarhi limpatinā kena bhāvyam
nanu ceha dvayaṃ cakāsti thāturlimpati tadarthaśca lepanam
evaṃ sati limpatiriveti syāt na tu limpatīveti
atha yathā rāhoḥ śiraḥ iti bhedābhāve'pyavayavāvayavibhāvastatheha dharmadharmibhāvo bhaviṣyati
upamānopameyabhāvasya bhedasādṛśyapratipattinibandhanatvāt tadabhāve'pi yastanmanute sa kathaṃ nonmattaḥ syāt
taduktam—‘sa eva dharmo dharmī cetyunmatto'pi na bhāṣate
’ astu tarhi tiṅvācyaḥ kartā upamānamiti cet nyagbhūto'sau kriyāpade
śrūyatāṃ, ṣaḍarthāstiṅantena pratīyante kriyā kālaḥ upagrahaḥ sādhanaṃ saṅkhyā puruṣaśceti
teṣu kriyākālātmanepadaparasmaipadanimittāni prakṛtirabhidhatte pratyayaḥ sādhanaṃ, saṅkhyāṃ puruṣaṃ ca
eteṣāṃ tu kriyārthatvātkriyā pradhānaṃ, kālātmanepadanimitte kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena, saṅkhyāpuruṣau sādhanaviśeṣaṇatvena tayoreva nyagbhavataḥ
sādhanaṃ punaḥ ‘prakṛtipratyayau svārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ’ iti nyāyāt ‘pradhānabhūtamapi bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyata’ iti nyāyena kriyāsiddhāvutpa-nnavyāpāraṃ parārthaṃ tasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ nyagmavati
tenāyaṃ kartā svakriyāsidbhābākulaḥ kathamupamānatvenopameyatvena vānyadapekṣituṃ kṣamate
evaṃ tarhi yo'ṅgāni limpati tena kriyopalakṣitena kartrā tulyaṃ tama ityarthaḥ pratipatsyate
tadyathā—gaurityayaṃ śabdo mukhyayā vṛttyā sāsnādimantamarthaṃ pratipādayati sa eva tiṣṭhanmūtratvādiguṇasaṃpadamapekṣya vāhīkādau prayujyamāno gauṇīṃ vṛttimanubhavati

yadā tu mukhyayā gauṇyā vopāttakriyāsiddhau sādhanabhāvaṃ gantumasamarthastadā lakṣaṇayā svārthāvinābhūtamarthāntaraṃ lakṣayati yathā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasatīti gaṅgāśabdo viśiṣṭodakapravāhe nirūḍhābhidhānaśaktirghoṣakartṛkāyāḥ prativasanakriyāyā adhikaraṇabhāvaṃ gantumasamarthaḥ svārthāvinābhūtaṃ taṭaṃ lakṣayatīti
nāpi kriyākartrorasādṛśyena śuktikādau rajatādivattadbhāvāpattiḥ kriyāguṇānāṃ kartaryasaṃbhavāt
sākṣādiva prayogācca na gauṇī kriyāyāśca svayameva dharmarūpatvāt
yadi hīvaśabdaḥ sādṛśyameva vidyotayati tadā limpatikriyāyāḥ sattvabhūtena tamasā sādṛśyaṃ na saṃbhavatīti svārthāvinābhūte kartāra-mākṣipati
na ceha lakṣitalakṣaṇāviruddhalakṣaṇādayo'pi vartante, yathā ‘priye jane nāsti punaruktaṃ’, ‘svalpairasāvapi na dṛśyata eva kālaiḥ’ iti
na cendumukhādivadanabhidhīyamānasyāpi tulyaguṇasya pratyayo bhavatīti vācyam

tatrānaucityaparihāro yathā—māyayā kaikeyīdaśarathābhyāṃ rāmaḥ pralambhito na mātāpitṛbhyāmiti nirdoṣadaśarathe; rāmameva yodhayan rāmeṇa vālī nihato na sugrīveṇeti mahāvīracarite; rudhirapriyarākṣasena duḥśāsanasya rudhiraṃ pītaṃ na bhīmaseneneti veṇīsaṃhāre; durvāsaso'padhyānādduṣyantaḥ śakuntalāsvīkāraṃ visasmāra, nānāvasthititānurāgatayeti śākuntale; lavaṇaprayuktarākṣasābhyāṃ vā sopaskareṇa tadabhidhāya sītā parityājitā na kaikeyīmantharābhyāmiti chalitarāme; kiṃca dagdhāyāmapi vāsavadattāyāṃ vairapraticikīrṣayā padmāvatī mayoḍhā, avasite ca samīhite tathā vinā kṣaṇamapi na jīvāmītyavijñātavāsavadattāsaṃnighervatsarājasyāgnipraveśādhyavasāyaḥ priyāhṛdayato vyalīkaśalyamuccakhāneti tāpasavatsarāje; nīcākṣaḥ svāmikāryaṃ sādhayāmīti prabhubhaktyā niraparādhāmapi preyasīṃ hitvā svāmikāryāpekṣayāhamevaitāvanti dināni jīvitaḥ, adya tu kṛtasvāmikāryastāmevānugacchāmīti śivagaṇaḥ śūdrakanimittāṃ māyāmayīṃ citāṃ priyāsamakṣaṃ praviveśa, sāpi tatpremāvadānadarśanāpahnutapriyabyalīkā tadviyogakātarā tatraivātmānaṃ praticikṣepeti vikrāntaśūdrake, iti tadetaddoṣahānam
guṇopādānaṃ tu samyag guṇayogena saṃvidhāne susūtratā, api ca caturvṛttyaṅgasaṃpannamiti catasro vṛttayo bhāratī ārabhaṭī kaiśikī sāttvatī ceti
yā vākpradhānā nṛpatiprayojyā strīvarjitā saṃskṛtayātha yuktā
svanāmadheyairbharataprayojyā sā bhāratī nāma bhavettu vṛttiḥ
citrāṇi yuddhāni ca tatra vṛttimetādṛśīmārabhaṭīṃ vadanti
yā sāttvikenātmaguṇena yuktā tyāgena vṛttena samanvitā ca
harṣotkaṭā saṃhṛtaśokabhārā sā sāttvatīti prathiteha vṛttiḥ
āsāmaṅgāni ṣoḍaśa—teṣu prarocanā, vīthī, prastāvanā, prahasanamiti catvāri bhāratyaṅgāni
uddhātyakādīnāmaṅgānāṃ pravṛttiḥ vīthī uddhātyakaḥ kathoddhātaḥ prayogātiśayaḥ pravartako'valagitamiti
‘ko jayati jayati śarvaḥ kena jitaṃ jitamanaṅgadahanena
‘sākaṃ paṅkajajanmanā surapaterabhyarthanāyā vaśā- dikṣvākoḥ śaradindubimbavimale vaṃśe'vatīrya svayam
niḥśeṣāttapadaṃ trayīpathajuṣāṃ vidveṣiṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ yaḥ paulastyamahan sa pātu bhavato rāmābhidhāno hariḥ 508
utkhāya gāḍhatamasaṃ ghanakālamugraṃ rāmo daśāsyamiva saṃbhṛtabandhujīvaḥ || 510 ||’
avalagitaṃ yathā,—amumeva śaratsamayamāśritya gīyatām, tathā hyasyām
saṃkṣiptikā, avapātaḥ, vastūtthāpanam, saṃsphoṭaḥ, iti catvāri ārabhaṭyaṅgāni
nīyate rakṣasā tena lakṣmaṇo yudhi saṃśayam || 514 ||’
ātaṅkādvikalaṃ drutaṃ karuṇayā vikṣobhitaṃ vismayā- tkrodhena jvalitaṃ mudā vikasitaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ vartatām 515’
‘kṛṣṭā yena śiroruheṣu paśunā pāñcālarājātmajā yenāsyāḥ paridhānamapyapahṛtaṃ rājñāṃ gurūṇāṃ puraḥ
yasyoraḥsthalaśoṇitāsavamahaṃ pātuṃ pratijñātavā- nso'yaṃ madbhujapañjare nipatitaḥ saṃrakṣyatāṃ kauravāḥ || 516 ||’
narma, narmasphijaḥ, narmasphoṭaḥ, narmagarbha, iti catvāri kaiśikyaṅgāni
teṣu sthāpitaśṛṅgāraṃ vaco viceṣṭitaṃ vā saparihāsaṃ narma
‘vayaṃ tathā nāma yathāttha kiṃ vadāmyayaṃ tvakasmādvikalaḥ kathāntare
‘prāptāsau vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ priyasutā saṅketakhaṇḍe nave vṛṣṭiḥ seyamanambudā'mṛtamayī yātrāṇi me siñcati
kiṃ jānāsi vinodayiṣyati manaḥ saṃtaptamevādya me durvātyeva nivartayiṣyati na bhostāṃ devayānīṃ prati || 518 ||’
utthāpakaḥ, parivartakaḥ, saṃlāpakaḥ, saṃghātyakaḥ, iti catvāri sātvatyaṅgāni
‘prahara mama tu kāyaṃ prākprahārapriyo'haṃ mayi tu kṛtavighāte kiṃ vidadhyāḥ parasmāt
madanamupadadhe sa eva tābhyo duradhighamā hi gatiḥ prayojanānām || 522
‘kathamapi na niṣiddho duḥkhinā bhīruṇā vā drupadatanayapāṇistena pitrā mamādya
tava bhujabaladarpādhdyāyamānasya vāmaḥ śirasi caraṇa eṣa nyasyate dhārayainam || 523 ||’
caturvargaphalaṃ prabandhaṃ ko vā na bāndhavīyatītyanena śrotṝṇāṃ rāmādivadvartitavyam, na rāvaṇādivaditi vidhiniṣedhanibandhanasya prabandhasyābhīṣṭatamatvamākhyāyate

‘kathamapi kṛtapratyāsattau priye’ iti mukham, ‘skhalitottare’ iti pratimukham, ‘virahakṛśayā kṛtvā vyājaṃ prajalpitamaśrutam’ iti garbhaḥ, ‘asahanasakhīśrotraprāptiprasādasasaṃbhramaṃ vivalitadṛśā’ iti vimarśaḥ, 'śūnye gehe samucchvasitaṃ sametam’ iti nibarhaṇam
etena prācīnaprabandhārthe'pi ekavākyoktena prabandhatvamityākhyātaṃ na bhavati
agaṇitatanūtāpastaptvā tapāṃsi bhagīratho bhagavati tava spṛṣṭānadbhiścirādudadīdharat || 525 ||’
‘śravyavṛttam’ ityanena vṛttāntarairāśvāsakādi-parisamāptiriti pariśrāntāḥ śrotāra aśvāsyante, sragādisaṃniveśādivatsaṃdarbhe cāśvādayo vibhāvyante
udyānasalilakrīḍādyupalakṣaṇena kāminīnāṃ divāceṣṭāḥ, madhupānaratotsava ityanena ca rātriceṣṭā ucyante
‘vivāha’ ityupalakṣaṇena prathamānurāgo vivāhāntaḥ, mānaḥ premāntaḥ, pravāsaḥ, saṃgamāntaḥ, karuṇaḥ, pratyujjīvanāntaḥ, prabandhe kartavya ityupadiśyate

‘nāvarṇanaṃ nagaryāderdoṣāya’ ityādinā tu puruṣārthāsattvopakāritvena śailartūdyānacandrodayamadhupānaratotsavādīnāṃ mantradūtaprayogājināyakābhyudapādīnāṃ ca niyamena prayogaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ tu prabandhaśarīrānurodheneti pratipādyate
nirākaraṇam’ ityanena guṇavatā bhāvyaṃ na guṇadveṣiṇeti jñāpyate
‘vaṃśavīryaśrutādīni’ ityādinā punarābhijātyauddhatyaśauṇḍīryavīryādaya eva śatrorvarṇanīyā na tvavacchedahetavo nyāyyācaraṇabinayādaya iti pratyāyyate
‘dhinoti naḥ’ iti tvayameva pakṣaḥ śreyāniti granthakāreṇa svābhiprāyaḥ prakāśyate
tadanubhavasamutthānandasaṃmīlitākṣāḥ pariṣadi paritoṣaṃ hanta santaḥ prayāntu || 526
yāvanmūrdhni himāṃśukandalabhṛti svarvāhinī dhūrjaṭeryāvadvakṣasi kaustubhastabakitā lakṣmīrmuradveṣiṇaḥ
yāvaccittabhuvastrilokavijayaprauḍhaṃ dhanuḥ kausumaṃ bhūyāttāvadiyaṃ kṛtiḥ kṛtadhiyāṃ karṇāvataṃsotpalam || 527
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇālaṃkāre rasavivecano nāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ
